answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, after opening and before closure, outside refit closures, excluding closed holidays (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P02 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday 1 June to Sunday 28 June 2026
Store attributes taken as-is from the current dim_store version
Part-period stores kept in the table with their own trading days
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P02, the current fiscal year as of the request date of 9 October 2026. The period is fully loaded (warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026).
'Store league table' read as the company definition: ranking by net sales per trading day, rank 1 = highest.
Output limited to rank, store and the ranking measure (net sales per trading day); total net sales and trading day counts were left out as working figures.
Ties in rank would share a rank (none occurred).
Values rounded to 2 decimals; rank is based on the unrounded figure.
caveats: Kuopio (125) was shut for a refit from 15 June 2026, so it is ranked on its 14 trading days (1 to 14 June) against 26 for the other full-period stores. It still ranks 7th on a per-day basis, but its per-day figure covers only the first two weeks of the period.
Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays and are not counted as trading days, so a full-period store has 26 trading days, not 28.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and had no sales in the period, so it is not in the table.
Two stores that opened in autumn 2024 (Tampere Lamminpää 136, Lohja 137) are included with 26 trading days each. Neither has a comparator in this table, which does not use LFL.
Store 999 and ZZ Test lines (121 sales lines in the period) were excluded; the control check holds with them out.

Control check: the store-level net sales used for the ranking sum to 1,063,916.20 for the 38 stores, matching rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (gap 0.00), store by store. No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period.
The warehouse column comments for store format and region are out of date; no format or region filter was used here.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, n.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND n.business_date <= DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web sales = net sales (excluding VAT) after returns, for the web shop pseudo-store (store_id 900), not channel_code or channel_id
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only, click-and-collect included); cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines and are not sales
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, taken from fact_return_line booked to store 900
Store 999 and category ZZ Test left out
Products ranked by stable SKU, with the name from the current product version (as-is)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 over the same days
assumptions: 'Web sales' read as net sales excluding VAT after returns, the company definition, rather than gross or units
'Since the platform migration on 3 November 2025' read as 3 November 2025 to 4 October 2026, the last day loaded (the request is dated 8 October 2026)
The window is applied to the dispatch date, so orders placed before 3 November but dispatched on or after it are included, and orders placed but not yet dispatched are not
'Products' read as articles (SKU), not subcategories or brands
Returns in the window are counted whenever the original sale happened, since a return reduces net sales on its own date
caveats: Web sales are filtered on store_id 900, not channel_code (empty after 3 Nov 2025) or channel_id (absent before it)
Web dates use the Helsinki dispatch date, not sale_date, which is the order date on web lines
Test articles (ZZ Test) in web orders were left out, a net of 25.50 EUR in the window, which does not affect the ranking
The web total for the window, 2,150,090.07 EUR net, matches rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly
I found no duplicate sales lines, return lines or web orders, and no SKU with more than one current version
Seasonal and furniture items rank high, so the list will shift with the season
The 10th and 11th products are 6,889.60 and 6,679.65 EUR, so the cut-off is clear
Net figures are after returns. Some of the most recent web orders may still receive returns, since returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cs.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.format, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) / SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Return rate = refund_net divided by sold net_amount (both excluding VAT), sale-week cohort: sold lines picked by the fiscal period of fact_sales_line.sale_date, refunds matched through sales_line_id wherever and whenever they were booked
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 P2 = 26 May 2025 to 22 June 2025 (weeks 5 to 8), taken from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar
As-is store format: the store's current dim_store version (joined on store_id AND is_current)
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Web shop (store_id 900, format Web) shown as its own row, because the format column includes Web
Staff purchases included, as in the net sales definition
No deprecated tables or views used; web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Store-level control total against rpt_daily_store_sales not applicable: this is a ratio by format with refunds dated to the sale period, not net sales by return date
assumptions: 'Period 2 last year' read as FY2025/26 P2, since the request was received on 5 October 2026 (FY2026/27) and past requests in FY2026/27 read 'last year' as FY2025/26
'Goods sold in period 2' read as the sale-week cohort convention, so returns count in the period of the original sale
Format read as-is on the current store version; format is the same in every version of every store, so as-was gives the same result
Web sales lines are dated by the order date in sale_date, as in the accepted return-rate queries (REQ-D14 to D16); this is not the web dispatch-date convention used for net sales
Rate is based on refund value (refund_net / sold net), not on units
Result shows the four formats in use (Large, Medium, Small, Web); the Training format (store 999) is excluded
caveats: Web return rate (12.23%) is nearly three times the store formats (4.28% to 4.53%). It is not an error; web lines sit in a single row and web returns by post are booked to the web shop

The cohort is complete: returns on P2 sales run up to 23 July 2025, well before the warehouse load date of 4 October 2026. 16 of 1,992 return lines came more than 30 days after the sale and are still counted
Excluded 127 sales lines in P2 that belong to store 999 or category ZZ Test
Checks found no duplicate sales or return lines, no returns exceeding quantity sold, and no returns without a matching sale
If 'last year' was meant as the fiscal year before FY2025/26 (FY2024/25 P2), the figures would differ; FY2025/26 was chosen to follow the accepted reading of past FY2026/27 requests

answer.sql: WITH contacted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), spend AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted, (SELECT SUM(sp.net_amount) FROM spend sp JOIN contacted c USING (member_id)) AS net_sales_before_returns_eur
definitions_applied: Contacted member: a distinct member_id (through dim_member) with at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in campaign 19
Spend is net sales before returns (excluding VAT) on lines linked to the member, as in the campaign uplift definition
Web lines are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date; cancelled and processing orders have no lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key
Helsinki-time day boundaries
Deprecated objects (stg_, bak_, tmp_, old tables, rpt.v_ views) not used
assumptions: 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' is campaign_id 19 (4 to 24 May 2026); the 2024 and 2025 campaigns with similar names were not used
'Contacted' means any exposure row (a contact was made), whether or not it was delivered or opened; 14,814 of the 15,001 members had at least one delivered contact
'Spend' is net sales excluding VAT, before returns; returns were not subtracted and refunds are not shown
The spend window is 4 to 24 May 2026 inclusive, exactly as the requester stated, which is the campaign window without the extra 7 days used in the uplift definition
Spend is totalled across all contacted members (those who bought and those who did not, who add zero), as one figure; 2,605 of the 15,001 contacted members made a purchase in the window
caveats: The mailing list size in dim_campaign is 16,624 with 1,597 held out, which implies about 15,027 contactable members, but the exposure table has 15,001 distinct members. The 26-member gap is unexplained and the figure above is what the exposure data shows.
No member appears in both the contacted group and the holdout group (checked).
Web lines in the window all have a matching dispatched order, so the dispatch-date rule moved no web line out of the window; web sales within the 190,687.59 total are 35,168.92.
In February and March 2026 (outside this window) 1,309 web lines on logged-in orders have no member_key, which would understate member spend for those weeks. It does not affect 4 to 24 May 2026.
Figures are excluding VAT. A figure including VAT would need gross_amount and was not requested.

answer.sql:
SELECT 
  cp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current = true
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current = true
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 44 AND 47
  AND cs.region = 'West'
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category
definitions_applied: Average stock value: mean of weekly closing stock values (EUR at standard cost) across all stores and weeks
As-is reporting: stores and products shown in their current categories/regions, not as they were historically
Stock value: closing_value field from fact_stock_week (standard cost at week-ending date)
assumptions: Period 11 last year interpreted as FY2025/26 P11 (fiscal weeks 44-47, 23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026)
Average calculated across all West region stores and all products in each category for the 4 weeks in period 11
Category refers to product category in the current product dimension
caveats: Result includes only product categories that had closing stock recorded during the period
Values are in EUR at standard cost per unit (not sales value or market value)
No padding rows for categories with zero stock; only categories with recorded stock appear

answer.sql: SELECT ds.format as store_format, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(fsl.quantity), 2) as return_rate FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' GROUP BY ds.format ORDER BY ds.format
definitions_applied: Return rate = (units returned / units sold) × 100, expressed as a percentage
Period 2 last year = FY2025/26 Period 2 (fiscal period calendar definition)
Store format = classification from dim_store table
Goods sold = fact_sales_line records with sale_date in the period
Returns = fact_return_line records for those sales lines
assumptions: Request date context 2026-10-15 places 'last year' as fiscal year FY2025/26
Return rate is calculated by unit quantity, not by monetary value
All store formats are included (physical stores and pseudo-locations)
Returns of goods sold in period 2 are counted regardless of return date
caveats: Schema documentation states format should be 'Hyper, Standard or Express', but actual warehouse data contains: Large, Medium, Small, Training (pseudo-store 999), and Web (pseudo-location 900)
Training store recorded zero returns from 195 units sold; this may reflect business practice (training stock typically not returned) or a data collection gap
Web channel return rate (5.77%) is notably higher than physical store formats (2.37–2.44%); this may reflect different return policies or product mix

answer.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4), prev AS (SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4), lfl_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT st.store_id FROM dim_store st, cur, prev WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date < prev.period_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date > cur.period_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND ((c.closure_start_date <= cur.period_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= cur.period_start_date) OR (c.closure_start_date <= prev.period_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= prev.period_start_date)))), sales AS (SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prev' END AS p, sum(f.net_amount) AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key, cur, prev WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date OR f.sale_date BETWEEN prev.period_start_date AND prev.period_end_date) GROUP BY 1), rets AS (SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prev' END AS p, sum(r.refund_net) AS v FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key, cur, prev WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) AND (r.return_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date OR r.return_date BETWEEN prev.period_start_date AND prev.period_end_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round(100.0 * ((sc.v - rc.v) / (sp.v - rp.v) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM sales sc JOIN sales sp ON sc.p='cur' AND sp.p='prev' JOIN rets rc ON rc.p='cur' JOIN rets rp ON rp.p='prev'
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P04 (3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, fiscal weeks 14-17) compared with FY2025/26 P04 (28 Jul to 24 Aug 2025, fiscal weeks 14-17), both 4 weeks and 28 trading days
Net sales: net_amount of sales lines (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net of returns, with returns counted on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Web orders, home delivery and click-and-collect, excluded. Web channel is identified by channel_id 2 and 3 in FY2026/27 (channel_code is NULL there) and by channel_code WB in FY2025/26
Like-for-like store set: store open throughout both periods, not closed or closing, and with no refit closure overlapping either period
Stores identified by store_id (stable across versions), not store_key
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as fiscal period 4 of the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (the request is dated 2026-10-07, in FY2026/27 P06). P04 is fully loaded.
Compared with the same fiscal period of the prior year, aligned by fiscal week (Monday to Sunday), not by calendar dates
Like-for-like growth read as store like-for-like net sales growth excluding web

Stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2 Sep 2024) and 137 Lohja (opened 4 Nov 2024) are included, because both traded in full throughout the comparison period of Jul-Aug 2025. The warehouse states no minimum trading age, so this is my reading.
Store 125 Kuopio is included. Its refit (15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026) ended before P04 began, and it traded all 28 days in both periods.
Staff purchases are included in net sales, in line with rpt_daily_store_sales, which reconciles exactly to the fact tables
caveats: Store 129 Savonlinna is excluded: it closed on 2026-01-25 (it has no sales in FY2026/27 P04, but it traded in P04 last year). Including it would give about -0.96%.
The tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 tables were not used. They are undocumented temporary lists, and the 2025 one still contains the closed store 129 and omits 136 and 137.
The ref_store_closure refits of stores 104 (2024), 119 (Sep-Oct 2025) and 125 (Jun-Jul 2026) do not overlap either P04 window, so no store was dropped for refit.

The result is sensitive to the like-for-like rule. If stores 136 and 137 are excluded as too new, growth is -0.23%. If store 125 is excluded for the refit that ended just before the period, it is -0.19%. If both are excluded, it is -0.41%. All are small declines, so the sign is not firmly established.
Net sales before returns would give +0.01% on the same 38 stores. Returns in the like-for-like stores were higher in absolute terms this year.
Several individual stores moved a lot (for example 127 Mikkeli about -24%, 109 Hämeenlinna about -16%, 131 Oulu Kaakkuri about +16%). I did not investigate the causes. They net out in the total.

The channel migration changed how channels are coded: FY2026/27 has NULL channel_code and uses channel_id. A filter on channel_code='ST' would drop all of this year's store sales and produce a large false decline. I used store_id and channel_id instead.
The warehouse has no written like-for-like definition, so the store eligibility rule above is my own inference from the closure, opening and closing data.

No duplicate sales or return lines, VAT inconsistencies or missing trading days were found in either period. Result based on 38 stores: net sales of 1,010,478.52 EUR in FY2026/27 P04 against 1,010,743.32 EUR in FY2025/26 P04.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.format AS store_format, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (net_amount, excluding VAT) divided by distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop (store 900) left out
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
FY2026/27 period 4 taken from dim_date: Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026, 4 weeks, fully loaded
Format taken from the current dim_store version (format is the same in every version of a store)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (net_sales_before_returns and receipts)
assumptions: 'Average basket value' is read as average transaction value (ATV), as the request states
'Period 4 of FY26/27' is read as fiscal year FY2026/27, period 4 (3 to 30 August 2026), which is complete in the warehouse
Web is not shown as a format, because ATV excludes web orders
No filtered breakdown by region or store was requested, so there is one row per format
ATV is rounded to 2 decimals, in EUR excluding VAT
caveats: dim_store.format comment is out of date: the real values are Large, Medium and Small (plus Web for the web shop and Training for store 999), not Hyper, Standard or Express. Results use the real values.

Excluding staff purchases removed 280 staff receipts in the stores from the receipt count and net sales. Store 999 (127 lines) and ZZ Test articles are also excluded. Store 999 does not affect the result, since the store_id below 900 filter already leaves it out.

Control total: per-store net sales before returns and receipt counts for 3 to 30 August 2026 (all physical stores, staff purchases included) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, with no differences. The check cannot cover ATV itself, because staff purchases are taken out.

Source rows checked for the period: no duplicate lines (48,107 rows, all with unique sales_line_id and receipt_id + line_no), no sale_date versus Helsinki timestamp mismatches, no receipts spanning more than one store, no receipts mixing staff and non-staff lines or test and non-test articles, no sales on non-trading days, and no non-positive net lines. No corrections to the data were needed.
No stores were closed in the period: Kuopio's refit ended on 26 July 2026 and Savonlinna closed in January 2026. The stores counted are Large 8, Medium 18 and Small 12 (38 in total).

answer.sql: WITH campaign AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15), holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15), members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), member_sales AS (SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id CROSS JOIN campaign c WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end GROUP BY 1), by_group AS (SELECT mb.member_group, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_targeted_member_eur, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_holdout_member_eur, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS uplift_eur FROM by_group
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift: mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member
Measurement window: campaign window plus seven days (24 Nov to 7 Dec 2025)
Targeted member: at least one exposure row in the campaign, reduced to distinct member_id through dim_member
Holdout: campaign_holdout joined on member_id, not member_key
Members with no sales count as zero
Net sales before returns, excluding VAT, on lines linked to the member (staff purchases included)
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date; only delivered or collected orders count
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
assumptions: Black Week 2025 is campaign_id 15 (24-30 Nov 2025), the only campaign with that name and year.
Spend is net sales before returns, as the company uplift definition says; returns are not deducted.
Amounts are in EUR excluding VAT.
Targeted means any exposure row, whether or not the contact was delivered or opened, as the definition says. About 1,951 of 50,043 contact rows were not delivered.
The window is 24 Nov to 7 Dec 2025 (end date plus seven days). The warehouse is loaded well past that, to early Oct 2026.
caveats: Corrections applied: exposure has several rows per contact, so I reduced it to 23,818 distinct targeted members. A plain count of rows would be 50,043. 26 members appear under more than one member version, so I counted them by member_id.
Corrections applied: campaign_holdout holds member_id, so I joined it on member_id. This gives 2,747 held-out members.

The accepted template falls back to sale_date for web lines whose order is not delivered or collected. I used dispatch date only for the web shop (store 900). No cancelled or processing orders fell in the period, so the figures are unchanged.

Targeted and holdout members add up to 26,565, but dim_campaign lists a mailing list of 26,573. Eight members are not in either group and I could not trace them. The holdout share is 10.3% against the stated 10%.
No member is in both groups. All holdout members have no exposure rows. All targeted members had marketing consent on the contact date, and no member joined after the campaign start.

Only 3,279 of 23,818 targeted members (13.8%) and 323 of 2,747 holdout members (11.8%) bought in the window, so the average spend per member is small. The uplift of EUR 1.41 per member is a difference of two means with no significance test.
Uplift is about 1.41 per targeted member on 23,818 members, roughly EUR 33,500 in total, and this is not a statistically tested figure.

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category != 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Store scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding training store 999
Test articles excluded (category ZZ Test)
Best-selling defined as units sold (not net sales or margin)
Fiscal period resolved to complete periods only (FY2026/27 P05, weeks 18-21)
assumptions: Interpreted 'best-selling' as highest units sold, the standard retail definition; 'best-selling' is not defined in the metric dictionary
'Last period' resolved to the last completed fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05) as of warehouse load date 4 October 2026
caveats: No data quality issues found; query passed all validation checks
Staff purchases are included in the totals per house rules
Results shown in current product version (is_current = true implied by join)

answer.sql: WITH web_order AS (SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counted as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, as booked to the web shop (store 900)
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code or channel_id (neither works across the 3 Nov 2025 migration)
Click-and-collect identified through fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar from dim_date (FY2025/26 P09 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026; P10 = 26 Jan 2026 to 22 Feb 2026)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year that just ended on 3 May 2026. This follows how past requests asked in May 2026 or later (during FY2026/27) were read (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). The request came in on 6 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27.
'Periods 9 and 10' read as two separate fiscal periods (P9 and P10), so one share per period. Both periods are fully loaded.

Returns of web orders that were handed in at physical stores are booked to those stores, not to the web shop. They are therefore not deducted from web net sales, which follows the accepted web-only query pattern (store_id 900). Only returns booked to store 900 reduce web net sales, each attributed to the click-and-collect or home-delivery type of its original order.
Percentages are rounded to two decimals.
caveats: No data problems needing correction were found in the rows used. Web sales lines had no duplicate (receipt_id, line_no) keys. Every web line matched an order in fact_web_order. No test-article lines appeared in these periods.

Web net sales (after returns booked to store 900) matched rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly: P9 EUR 200,208.58 and P10 EUR 123,131.15. The click-and-collect part of each figure is EUR 58,536.07 in P9 and EUR 37,861.39 in P10.
Before returns the shares are 28.9% in P9 (63,662.80 of 219,929.50) and 30.6% in P10 (42,118.86 of 137,569.07). The reported shares are after returns.
Across both periods together the share is about 29.8% (96,397.46 of 323,339.73), in case a single combined figure is wanted.

Returns booked in physical stores for web orders (about 100 return lines in P9 and 70 in P10) are not netted off web sales, per the company's store-booking convention. If they were credited back to the web shop, the web net sales and the shares would change slightly.
Rows are keyed on fiscal period dates, not calendar months. P9 includes Christmas week and the first weeks of January, and P10 runs from 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 15 AS campaign_id
),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c 
    WHERE c.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM params)
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM params)
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    WHERE h.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM params)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY m.member_id
),
targeted_group AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
    FROM targeted m
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = m.member_id
),
holdout_group AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
    FROM holdout m
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = m.member_id
)
SELECT 
    'Average spend per targeted member' AS metric,
    ROUND(AVG(net_sales), 2) AS value_in_euros
FROM targeted_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Average spend per held-out member' AS metric,
    ROUND(AVG(net_sales), 2) AS value_in_euros
FROM holdout_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Uplift' AS metric,
    ROUND((SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM targeted_group) - (SELECT AVG(net_sales) FROM holdout_group), 2) AS value_in_euros
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift (mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member)
Net sales scope (excludes store 999 and ZZ Test category products)
Web recognition (web sales dated on Helsinki dispatch date)
Campaign window (official dates plus 7 days: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-07)
assumptions: Targeted members are those with at least one exposure (contact) recorded in fact_campaign_exposure for the Black Week 2025 campaign
Held-out members are those listed in campaign_holdout for campaign ID 15
Members with zero sales during the campaign window are counted as zero spend in the average
Staff purchases are included in spend calculations
All currency values are in euros, before VAT
caveats: No members appear in both targeted and holdout groups (proper separation confirmed)
Web order dates are converted to Europe/Helsinki timezone
Member versioning is properly handled (distinct member_id throughout)
The average spend calculations include only delivered or collected orders for the campaign period

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2

Units sold = quantity on fact_sales_line, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date), for store lines
Subcategory as-is: sku joined to the current dim_product version (is_current), where the subcategory is Interior Paint
Store identified by natural key store_id 108 (Lahti), joined through the store_key version on each line
Store 999 and category ZZ Test filtered out (neither changes this figure)

Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales: for Lahti over 29 June to 2 August 2026, daily units, net sales before returns and receipt counts all agree with the sales lines, with no differing day
Grain check: 142 sales lines, each unique on receipt_id + line_no and on sales_line_id, so no row multiplication from the versioned dimensions
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request received 5 October 2026), and 'period 3' as FY2026/27 P3 (29 June to 2 August 2026)

'Lahti store' read as store_id 108 (store_name Lahti, city Lahti, region South, format Large); the other store matching 'lahti' in a name search is Tampere Lielahti (store 116), which is a different store and was left out
'Units sold' read as units on the sales lines, before returns, as the request asks about sales volume and not net sales; staff purchases are included (4 of the 194 units)

Interior Paint read as dim_product.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' (category Paint & Decorating), as-is on the current product version; each sold product version had the same subcategory, so as-was gives the same figure

Total value of the 194 units is 6,365.76 EUR excluding VAT, for reference only.

Store 999 and ZZ Test filters did not change the total. No data problem was found for this store and period: no duplicate lines, no non-positive quantities, and the warehouse figure agrees with rpt_daily_store_sales day by day.

answer.sql: WITH active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, m.tier AS tier, count(*) AS active_members FROM active a JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks ending with, and including, the as-of week, in any channel (sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from the purchase lines (no effect on the result)
Fiscal calendar from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2025/26 P08 ends Sunday 21 December 2025
Canonical tables only; no staging, backup, tmp or deprecated report objects used
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26. The request is dated 7 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests made in FY2026/27 took last year as FY2025/26.
'The end of period 8' was read as the last day of P8, Sunday 21 December 2025 (P8 ran 24 November to 21 December 2025). The trailing window is therefore 22 December 2024 to 21 December 2025.

A purchase is any sales line dated by sale_date, store or web. This is the same dating the accepted active-member queries use; web lines are dated on the order date. Cancelled and still-processing web orders have no sales lines, so they do not count.
Returns were not netted off. The definition asks only whether a purchase was made.
caveats: fact_sales_line has duplicated lines (same receipt_id and line_no, different sales_line_id and etl_loaded_at) for 15 to 21 September 2025, from repeated loads. 836 rows in the window belong to these duplicated receipt lines, and the copies are identical in member, product and amount. Counting distinct members is unaffected, so no correction was needed, but any sales totals for that week would be overstated unless the lines are de-duplicated.
Excluding store 999 and ZZ Test did not change the count: no member-linked lines in the window were in store 999 or in ZZ Test.
The three tiers add up to 29,526 distinct active members. Every active member had a tier version valid on 21 December 2025, so none were dropped.
The tier shown is the one on 21 December 2025. A member who changed tier later, or earlier in the year, is counted under the as-of tier only.

answer.sql:
WITH sales_summary AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales,
    SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE s.region = 'South'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
),
returns_summary AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS total_refunds,
    SUM(r.standard_cost_returned) AS total_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE s.region = 'South'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
final_calc AS (
  SELECT
    s.sku,
    s.product_name,
    s.gross_sales - COALESCE(r.total_refunds, 0) - (s.total_cost - COALESCE(r.total_cost_returned, 0)) AS gross_margin_eur
  FROM sales_summary s
  LEFT JOIN returns_summary r ON s.sku = r.sku
)
SELECT
  sku,
  product_name,
  ROUND(gross_margin_eur, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM final_calc
ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC
LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin calculated as (net sales revenue minus standard cost of goods sold), in EUR
Net sales defined as sales net of VAT and inclusive of returns/refunds
South region identified from dim_store.region
Q4 defined as fiscal_quarter = 4 in fiscal_year FY2024/25
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag = FALSE)
assumptions: Gross margin interpreted as absolute EUR amount, not as a percentage
Returns and refunds included in calculation, matched to original sales lines
Ranking by total gross margin in EUR (products contributing most absolute margin)
Standard cost from dim_product at the sale date used for cost of goods calculation
caveats: Returns processed in different fiscal periods would not be matched to Q4 sales; all returns checked are those dated in Q4 FY2024/25
Staff purchases excluded by design; total product contribution to business may be higher
Gross margin calculated on net amount (excluding VAT), standard accounting approach but VAT treatment should be confirmed with Finance
Products with zero sales in the period are excluded from results (no padding rows)

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net 
    FROM fact_return_line 
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_share_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.format;
definitions_applied: Return rate on the sale-week cohort (returns matched to the original sale through sales_line_id, attributed to the week the item was sold)
Net sales excluding VAT (after returns)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from all sales metrics
assumptions: Period 2 last year interpreted as FY2025/26 P02 (the most recent completed fiscal period 2 as of the request date 2026-10-06)
Store format assigned on the sale date from the current store dimension version
Return share calculated as returned net amount divided by sold net amount
caveats: Return cohort may not be complete: some sales from P02 (2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22) may have returns arriving up to 30 days later (through approximately 2025-07-22), and the warehouse is loaded through 2026-10-04, so this cohort is fully loaded and complete
Web channel shows significantly higher return rate (12.23%) compared to physical stores (4.28-4.53%), typical for e-commerce
Return amounts are refund_net values from fact_return_line; this measures financial value returned, not unit quantities

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)), win AS (SELECT * FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07'), tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15), ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15), spend AS (SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) AS spend FROM win GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM tgt LEFT JOIN spend USING (member_id)), h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM ho LEFT JOIN spend USING (member_id)) SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, ROUND(t.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur, ROUND(h.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur, ROUND(t.avg_spend - h.avg_spend, 2) AS uplift_eur FROM t, h
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift: mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per held-out member
Campaign window plus seven days: 24 Nov 2025 to 7 Dec 2025 (window 24-30 Nov, plus 7 days)
Targeted member: at least one exposure row in the campaign, reduced to distinct member_id through dim_member (23,818 members)
Holdout: campaign_holdout joined on member_id, not member_key (2,747 members); no member is in both groups
Members with no sales counted as zero in both averages
Net sales before returns, on lines linked to the member (member_key mapped to member_id)
Net sales excluding VAT (net_amount)
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered or collected orders only), not the order date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases kept in (net sales definition includes them)
No deprecated tables or views used, and channel_code not used
assumptions: 'Black Week 2025' is campaign_id 15 (24-30 Nov 2025, email+sms+push, all consenting members). Campaign 5 is Black Week 2024.
Spend is net sales before returns, excluding VAT, per the campaign uplift definition. Returns were not netted off, and the request did not ask for them to be.

Targeted means members with an exposure row, as defined. That is 23,818 members. The mailing list was 26,573 less the 2,747 held out, which would give 23,826. The 8-member difference is presumably list members with no contact row, so they are not counted as targeted.
Money is in EUR, rounded to 2 decimals. The unrounded uplift is 1.4055.
Averages are per member over the whole group, not per buyer.
caveats: Corrections applied. Web lines were dated on the Helsinki dispatch date rather than the order date. Orders that were cancelled or still processing, or not yet dispatched, are not web sales and were left out.

Checks that found no problem. There is no overlap between targeted and holdout members. No exposure rows fall outside the campaign window or go to members without marketing consent. No sales lines are duplicated in the window. All members in both groups had joined by the campaign start and had consent on that day. The tier mix of the two groups is similar (Gold about 9% in each).
Before-returns net sales are used, so the uplift may be overstated if targeted members return more than holdout members. Returns were not measured here.

The uplift is small against the spread in spend. About 13.8% of targeted members bought in the window against 11.8% of held-out members, and most members in both groups spent nothing. No significance test was run, so the 1.41 EUR difference should be treated as an estimate.
The holdout is 2,747 of 26,573 on the mailing list (10.3%), slightly above the stated 10%.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply to a member subset, so it was not run.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT 'LY' AS p, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'TY', period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 1), sales AS (SELECT per.p, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e WHERE st.store_id < 900 UNION ALL SELECT per.p, st.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e WHERE st.store_id < 900), ok AS (SELECT store_id FROM sales GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(DISTINCT p) = 2), res AS (SELECT p, sum(amt) AS net_sales FROM sales WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ok) GROUP BY p) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round((t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM res t JOIN res l ON t.p = 'TY' AND l.p = 'LY'
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 1 of FY2026/27 is 4 May to 31 May 2026. It is compared with period 1 of FY2025/26, 28 April to 25 May 2025, the same 4 fiscal weeks, using ref_fiscal_calendar dates
Like-for-like store set: physical stores (store_id below 900) that traded in both periods. This gives 38 stores
Net sales: line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the period, which matches the net_sales logic of rpt_daily_store_sales
Stores identified by stable store_id, not by store_key (stores have several versions with region changes), so the 2025 region re-mapping does not affect the comparison
Web shop (store_id 900) and the training store (999) excluded from the store like-for-like base
Staff purchases included, as in the Data & Analytics daily sales report
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, because the request is dated 9 October 2026 and FY2026/27 started on 4 May 2026. 'Period 1' means fiscal period P01.
'Like-for-like growth' means the percentage change in net sales (EUR excluding VAT, after returns) for comparable stores, current P01 against last year's P01, with no trading-day adjustment.

The base is physical stores only. Online sales are excluded because the web channel has no like-for-like store base, and it was recoded to channel_id 2 and 3 after the web-platform migration. Say if Finance wants a version that includes online.

Stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2 September 2024) and 137 Lohja (opened 4 November 2024) are included. Both traded for the whole of both periods and were open more than 12 months at the start of the current period.
Returns are taken on the date the return was booked, in the store that booked it, as the daily sales report does. A return of an earlier sale counts against the period in which it is refunded.

I did not use the tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 tables. They are undocumented temporary lists. The 2025 list still contains the closed Savonlinna and omits stores 136 and 137. I built the store set from actual trading in the two periods.
caveats: Corrections: Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026. It traded in last year's P01 (about 12.5k EUR net sales) but has no sales this year, so it is excluded as non-comparable. Including it would understate growth.

Corrections: Web and training-store lines are excluded. The training store (999) has small test sales in both periods, about 2.2k EUR last year and 1.7k this year. Web sales are about 183.5k EUR last year and 229.3k this year, and are not in the store base.

Trading-day difference: last year's P01 had 27 trading days because May Day (Thursday 1 May 2025) was a non-trading day. This year's P01 has 28 trading days, because 1 May 2026 fell before the period started. The headline 6.7% is therefore flattered by about one extra trading day. Adjusted per trading day, growth is about 2.9%. The reported figure is unadjusted; Finance should decide which basis to use.
Staff purchases are included in the headline. Excluding them gives 6.64%.
Net sales for the 38 like-for-like stores are 1,103,969.88 EUR last year and 1,177,925.94 EUR this year.

The sales table had 418 duplicated receipt lines, all in the week of 15 to 21 September 2025. They are outside both periods used here, so they do not affect this answer. Anyone building a full-year like-for-like figure from this table would need to remove them.

From the start of FY2026/27, fact_sales_line.channel_code is null and the channel is held only in channel_id. The existing view rpt.v_daily_sales filters on channel_code = 'WB', so it would miss this year's web sales. I did not use the view.

Column comments in dim_store and dim_member do not match the data. For example, store format holds Small, Medium and Large where the comment says Hyper, Standard and Express. This does not affect the answer.

Store regions changed on 28 April 2025 for stores 101 to 105 (South to Capital Region) and store 114 (East to South). Any like-for-like breakdown by region would have to use one region mapping for both years. No breakdown is given here.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-08-25' AND '2025-09-21'
definitions_applied: Store selection: Store 107 (Hyvinkää) identified by store_id, using current store dimensions
Product category: Cleaning & Household (exact category name from dim_product)
Period definition: Fiscal period 5 of FY2025/26 (2025-08-25 to 2025-09-21, weeks 18-21)

Cleaning Products matched to dim_product category 'Cleaning & Household' based on name match
Store identified by exact name match: 'Hyvinkää' = store_id 107
Included all sales channels (store and web) at Hyvinkää during the period
Excluded returns; counted units sold on the sale date

Period 5 of FY2025/26 is complete as of warehouse load date 2026-10-04 (fully loaded through 2025-09-21)

Store location: Hyvinkää (store_id 107)
Product classification: Cleaning Products (subcategory within Cleaning & Household)

Last month: Calendar month of September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30)
