WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS this_year, 'FY2024/25' AS last_year,
           27 AS q3_first_week, 39 AS q3_last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
quarterly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.this_year, params.last_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.q3_first_week AND params.q3_last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, 
       ty.net_sales AS q3_fy2025_26,
       ly.net_sales AS q3_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM quarterly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN quarterly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.last_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.this_year
ORDER BY CASE ty.region 
    WHEN 'North' THEN 1
    WHEN 'South' THEN 2
    WHEN 'East' THEN 3
    WHEN 'West' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Capital Region' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Online' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
END;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns (return date accounting), on the company definition
Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date, not order date
Store scope: all stores except store 999 (training store) and all articles except category ZZ Test
As-is reporting: current region hierarchy applied to both years
Web shop (store_id 900) as its own region labelled Online
assumptions: Request date 2026-10-06; 'last year' = FY2025/26 Q3, 'the year before' = FY2024/25 Q3
Q3 = fiscal periods 7–9, spanning fiscal weeks 27–39 (13 weeks)
Figures are net sales excluding VAT per the company definition
As-is reporting is standard for management reports; as-was not requested
caveats: Capital Region was created on 28 April 2025. As-is reporting applies current region hierarchy to both years, so the FY2024/25 Q3 line for Capital Region shows sales from stores 101, 102, 103, 104, 105 which were in the South region at that time. This is not a like-for-like comparison; the Capital Region did not exist in FY2024/25.
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from all totals
Web shop shown as separate Online line; it is not part of any physical region
16 rows at the UTC/Helsinki midnight boundary may shift by a day if reported in UTC instead of Helsinki time; query uses the Helsinki business date

Join date = dim_member.join_date, the date the member joined

Counted every member who joined that day, whatever the tier, home store (including 900 for online sign-ups) or marketing consent
Used dim_member only. The staging table stg_member_updates holds the same 29 members for that date and adds none that are missing from dim_member

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date in Helsinki time, converted from order_ts_utc
Cancelled orders excluded
Processing orders included (none on this day)
Click-and-collect and guest orders counted as web orders
Test articles (category ZZ Test) and store 999 excluded (no such orders on the day)
assumptions: Cyber Monday is read as Monday 1 December 2025, the date given in the request
Web shop orders means all web orders, home delivery and click-and-collect, logged-in and guest
The day is the Helsinki calendar day (UTC+2 in December), not the UTC day

19 orders placed on the day were cancelled and are not counted. Including them would give 345.
Checks on the 326 orders: no duplicate order numbers, all have sales lines, all sit in web shop store 900, line counts match, and none contain test articles. No correction was needed.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the dispatch date in Helsinki time (not the order date)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (which is empty after the 3 November 2025 migration)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Click-and-collect counted as web, dated on the ready-for-collection date in Helsinki time
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Helsinki midnight day boundaries (UTC+2 in December)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales
assumptions: Daily web sales are read as company-definition net sales: gross web sales by dispatch date minus web refunds by return date, as a single net figure per day.
Returns count only where booked to the web shop (store 900), as the company definition does for web. Web-order refunds processed in physical stores stay in those stores' net sales.
The range is 15 to 23 December 2025 inclusive, nine days, all within the loaded data.
Click-and-collect orders are included in web sales, as the company rule says.
caveats: No corrections were needed. The daily figures match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 to the cent on every day, for both net_sales and net_sales_before_returns.
21 December 2025 is low (611.75) because it is a Sunday with only 18 orders dispatched. The 13 to 14 December weekend shows the same pattern. The data is complete for that day.

Web refunds booked in physical stores are not netted against web sales. Over 15 to 23 December these were about 1,900 EUR net across roughly 30 stores. Web net sales would be lower if those were attributed back to the web channel.

The figures are after web refunds booked to the web shop on their return date. The pre-return figures are 11714.52, 10967.03, 15214.54, 12189.13, 10258.50, 11379.59, 1445.65, 15720.91 and 11674.00 for 15 to 23 December in order. The difference is large on 21 December, where refunds for earlier sales outweigh the day's own dispatches.
Orders placed on one day and dispatched on another land on the dispatch day. A web order placed on 14 December and dispatched on 15 December counts for 15 December. Order-date sales would differ.
Amounts are in EUR excluding VAT.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Web net sales (dispatch date in Helsinki time, after returns)
Click-and-collect share (click-and-collect net sales / total web net sales, as percentage)
Net sales (net amount excluding VAT, after returns, excluding test articles and store 999)
assumptions: Last year refers to fiscal year FY2025/26 (previous fiscal year from the request date 2026-10-06)
Web sales are recognised on the dispatch date (not order date) in Helsinki time
Only delivered and collected orders are included (cancelled orders excluded)
caveats: Returns can arrive up to 30 days after the original sale, so period totals include returns booked in each period, regardless of original sale date
No data quality issues detected

answer.sql: WITH dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1), trading AS (SELECT cs.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND is_trading_day) d WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM dim_store cs JOIN store_sales ss USING (store_id) JOIN trading t USING (store_id) WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: net sales per trading day, ranked high to low
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT, minus returns on their own return date
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Trading days = days open, after opening and before closure, outside ref_store_closure refit closures, and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 P5 = weeks 18 to 21, 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025
Control total against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
assumptions: Request received 8 Oct 2026 (FY2026/27). 'Period 5 last year' is read as FY2025/26 P5, matching how past 'last year' requests read in May 2026.
Reported as-is (current store attributes); the table has no region or format column, so this has no effect on it.
Stores with the same net sales per trading day would share a rank; there are no ties.
Ranking uses the store version via store_id, so versioned store rows do not multiply.
caveats: Duplicate load in fact_sales_line: 418 lines for store 116 Tampere Lielahti (receipts dated 15 Sep 2025 onward within P5) were loaded twice (second load on 23 Sep 2025, new sales_line_ids, identical content). I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no. This lowers Lielahti's net sales before returns from 49,995.41 to 39,604.88 (10,390.53 less). After the fix, every store matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (net before returns, returns and net sales). Without the fix Lielahti would have ranked about 5th instead of 7th.

Pori (119) was closed for a refit from 8 Sep 2025 to 12 Oct 2025, so it traded 14 of the 28 days in the period (25 Aug to 7 Sep). It is ranked on its 14 trading days, so its figure is not directly comparable with stores that traded the full period. All other 38 stores traded all 28 days. No public holidays fall in this period.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, after this period. It traded all 28 days of P5 and is included.
Returns are counted on their return date and at the store where they were processed. Web returns booked to the web shop (store 900) are excluded as they are not store sales.
The figures are net sales per trading day in EUR excluding VAT.
'Last year' is read as the previous fiscal year (FY2025/26). If you meant the same period a year before that (FY2024/25 P5, 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024), tell me and I will rerun it.

answer.sql: SELECT l.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM (SELECT f.quantity, p.sku FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') l JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = l.sku AND cp.is_current GROUP BY l.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, l.sku LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by Helsinki sale_date (metric dictionary wording for units sold)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 5 = 31 Aug 2026 to 27 Sep 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Store scope: physical store 102 Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, matched on stable store_id across store versions
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (the filter changed nothing here)
Staff purchases included
Products grouped by stable sku, with the current product name (as-is)
Control total: units for store 102 over the period agree with rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
assumptions: 'Period 5 of FY26/27' read as fiscal year FY2026/27, period 5 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026), the last completed period
'Sold the most units' read as gross units sold before returns, ranked by quantity on sales lines
Web orders and click-and-collect lines are booked to the web shop (store 900), so they are not counted in Pitäjänmäki
Products identified by sku, so units across different versions of the same article are added together
caveats: No data problems needing correction were found: source lines are unique at sales_line_id and at receipt_id plus line_no, and the 3,740 units for store 102 in the period equal rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold exactly
Returns are not netted off. Netting them off changes no rank: the third product's 42 units become 41, still ahead of 30 for fourth place
Pitäjänmäki moved from South to Capital Region on 28 April 2025. This does not affect the answer, because the request is by store

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transactions, round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales excluding VAT divided by the number of distinct receipts
Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 (3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, 4 weeks), taken from the warehouse fiscal calendar and not calendar months
Physical-store sales only (channel_id 1, store_id below 900)
Web shop (900) and click-and-collect lines excluded, so web orders do not count as store transactions
Training store (999) excluded as a pseudo-location
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag = true)
Store format taken from the dim_store version attached to each sales line (store_key)
Sales before returns: refunds are not netted off the sales and are not counted as transactions
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, as the request is dated 6 Oct 2026. Period 4 is therefore 3 to 30 Aug 2026.
ATV is a customer metric, so staff purchases are left out. No written company ATV definition was available. Including them lowers ATV slightly: Small 50.67, Medium 60.15, Large 60.60.
ATV is measured on net sales excluding VAT (the warehouse's net_amount), not on gross sales including VAT.
The breakdown is by store format, as requested. The format labels in the data are Small, Medium and Large, even though the column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express.
The query keys on channel_id because channel_code is null for all sales in this period.
caveats: Period 4 is fully loaded (ref_fiscal_calendar.fully_loaded = true). The fact data matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly before returns: net sales 1,062,266.72 EUR and 18,027 receipts for all store channels, including staff purchases.

Excluded from the figures: web and click-and-collect lines (about 211 thousand EUR of net sales in the period), training store 999 lines (zero in the store channel, but 127 lines carried the training-store key) and staff purchases (about 1 percent of lines).
Returns are not deducted. Refunds booked in the period were about 51.8 thousand EUR net across stores. A returns-adjusted ATV would be lower.
No duplicate lines, no receipts spanning more than one store or date, no sales on non-trading days, and no overlap with the staging load were found for the period.
No stores were closed during period 4. The refit closure of store 125 ended on 26 July 2026, and Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026 and has no period 4 sales.
Small-format ATV (50.75) is about 9.5 EUR below Medium and Large, which are within 0.40 EUR of each other. The Medium and Large difference is small.

answer.sql: SELECT s.format AS store_format, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_amount), 0), 2) AS return_share_pct FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22' GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: Period 2 of fiscal year FY2025/26 (26 May 2025 – 22 June 2025)
Net sales amounts (EUR excluding VAT) from fact_sales_line
Returns (refund_net, EUR excluding VAT) from fact_return_line matched to original sales line
Store format from dim_store at time of sale
assumptions: Last year refers to FY2025/26, the fiscal year prior to current FY2026/27
Return share is calculated as total refunds / total sales for period 2, as a percentage
All sales in period 2 are included regardless of subsequent return date
Web channel includes both home delivery and click-and-collect orders
caveats: Store format values in the warehouse (Large, Medium, Small, Training, Web) differ from schema documentation (Hyper, Standard, Express), suggesting possible data model evolution or load mapping differences
Training format shows 0% return rate but represents only 126 sales lines (smallest segment); this is statistically thin
Web channel return rate (12.23%) is approximately 2.8× higher than physical store formats, suggesting potential differences in return behaviour between channels

answer.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(dsr.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, ds.format, SUM(dsr.receipts) AS receipts, SUM(dsr.units_sold) AS units_sold, SUM(dsr.net_sales) AS net_sales_eur FROM rpt_daily_store_sales dsr INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON dsr.store_id = ds.store_id AND ds.is_current = true WHERE dsr.business_date >= '2026-06-01' AND dsr.business_date <= '2026-06-28' AND ds.format IN ('Large', 'Medium', 'Small') GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, ds.format ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales from rpt_daily_store_sales, excluding VAT and after returns
Physical stores only (format: Large, Medium, Small)
Rank calculated by net sales in descending order
assumptions: This year refers to the current fiscal year FY2026/27
Store league table means stores ranked by net sales performance
Request from Store Operations implies physical stores only; web shop and training store excluded
Using pre-built daily sales report for efficiency and consistency with company analytics practice
caveats: Warehouse data current as of 2026-10-04; request received 2026-10-09
Schema comments for store format field were outdated (documented as Hyper/Standard/Express, actual data contains Large/Medium/Small)
Web shop (store_id 900) excluded from league table; 38 physical stores included in final result

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week = 22 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by sale date (metric dictionary, stock section)
Helsinki business date (sale_date) used for the day boundary
Last completed fiscal week, Monday to Sunday
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither affects this figure)
Staff purchases included (none on these lines)
Units sold before returns (returns not netted off)
Store scope: physical store 131, joined through versioned dim_store and dim_product keys on store_id and sku
assumptions: 'Oulu Kaakkuri' is the store (store 131), not part of the product name. SKU 101624 is Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251, so the question reads as units of that SKU sold in Oulu Kaakkuri.
'Last week' means the last completed fiscal week as of the request date, 8 October 2026: FY2026/27 week 22, Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026, which is the last loaded week.
Units sold are gross of returns, as the company definition of units sold is the quantity on sales lines. Returned units are not deducted.
The figure covers sales at the store's tills only. Web and click-and-collect orders are booked to the web shop (store 900) and are not in this count.
caveats: No data problem found, so no correction was made. The store's total units for the week across all articles (864) matches rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold for store 131 exactly, day by day, with no duplicate keys in the source rows.
The SKU sold on 6 of the 7 days (none on Wednesday 30 September). Eight sales lines in total: 1, 2, 0, 1, 9, 2 and 2 units on Monday to Sunday, apart from Wednesday, which had none.
The request wording ran the SKU and the store name together. If the intent was a different store or a different product, the figure would change.

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, p.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category = 'Garden' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND st.store_id <> 999), returned AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY sales_line_id) SELECT s.subcategory, round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)) / sum(s.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold s LEFT JOIN returned r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id GROUP BY s.subcategory ORDER BY s.subcategory
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: Q1 of FY2025/26 is 2025-04-28 to 2025-07-27 (ref_fiscal_calendar / dim_date)
Product category and subcategory taken from the product version in force on the sale date (fact_sales_line.product_key)
Return rate = units returned / units sold, with each return attributed to the original sales line (fact_return_line.sales_line_id) regardless of the return date
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Training store (store_id 999) excluded
Web (store_id 900) and physical store sales both included
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last complete fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request was received on 2026-10-06 and the company reports on a fiscal calendar that starts in late April. 'Q1' is fiscal Q1, not calendar Q1 (Jan-Mar).
'Goods sold in Q1' means a cohort view: all units sold in the quarter, with every later return of those units counted. Returns were all booked by 2025-08-22, so the return window is complete.

The rate is by units. A value-based rate (refund net / net sales) gives very similar figures, for example Garden Furniture 12.95, Barbecue & Grills 7.32, Edible Plants & Seeds 0.98 and Soil & Fertiliser 1.58.
'Garden' means the category as it stood when the goods were sold. Outdoor Lighting was part of Garden until 2025-10-26 and so is included.
caveats: Outdoor Lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27. It is included here because it was Garden when sold in Q1 FY2025/26 (7.25%, 1,723 units sold). A Garden total on today's product tree would exclude it.
Correction: the Training store (store_id 999) is excluded. It had 136 Garden lines in the period.

Correction: staff purchases are excluded. They are about 1,256 Garden lines in the period. Including them changes the rates by 0.1 percentage points or less. For example, Garden Furniture would be 12.73 and Barbecue & Grills 6.47.

Fact_sales_line was checked for duplicate lines, gaps in daily loads and sales on closed days, and none were found. Returns were checked for returns exceeding units sold and returns dated before the sale, and none were found. The staging tables (stg_*) and bak_*/tmp_* tables were not used.
Small volumes make some rates sensitive: Barbecue & Grills (2,038 units) and Outdoor Lighting (1,723 units) rest on a few hundred units each.
The fiscal period FY2026/27 P06 is not fully loaded, but it does not affect this result.

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id (the stable loyalty number), not by member_key
Current tier read from the latest version of each member (is_current = true, valid_to = 9999-12-31)
dim_member used directly; staging (stg_) and backup (bak_) tables not used
assumptions: 'Right now' means the current dim_member version of each member, so the figure is the count of all enrolled members whose current tier is Gold

'Members on the Gold tier' is read as enrolled members, not 'active members'. The metric dictionary's active-member definition (a purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks) was not applied because the request does not ask for it
The tier is as held in dim_member, with no restatement or as-was view
caveats: The warehouse's latest sales are dated 4 October 2026 and the latest member version starts on 4 October 2026, so the count reflects the warehouse as loaded to about 4 October, not 8 October when the request arrived. Tier changes after that date are not included

Gold members are 5,791 of 60,000 members in total. Members can change tier, so earlier tier versions are kept in dim_member. Counting rows without filtering to the current version, or counting all versions with tier = 'Gold', would give 8,203 and overstate the number
Checks run: each member has exactly one current version, none has two open-ended versions, and every member has exactly one version valid on 8 October 2026. No data corrections were needed

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending), closing AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current CROSS JOIN params WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), sold AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current CROSS JOIN params WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, c.category, ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover FROM closing c JOIN sold s USING (category) ORDER BY c.category
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover: closing stock units at the end of the fiscal week divided by average weekly units sold over the prior four fiscal weeks, for the same grouping
Closing stock is a weekly snapshot: summed across stores and articles within the single week-ending date 2026-09-27, never across weeks
Last period is the last completed fiscal period: FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, fully loaded
Units sold are the quantity on sales lines by sale_date (Helsinki date)
Physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop 900 excluded, no web stock in the snapshot
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
As-is product hierarchy: category taken from the current product version (outdoor lighting counts in Electrical for all history)
Staff purchases included in units sold, as in the company sales definition
Returns are not netted off units sold
assumptions: 'End of last period' is read as the closing snapshot on Sunday 27 September 2026, the last week of FY2026/27 P05

'Prior four fiscal weeks' is read literally, as the four fiscal weeks before the snapshot week: 24 Aug to 20 Sep 2026 (the weeks ending 30 Aug, 6, 13 and 20 Sep). This is the stock-skill reading, and it is not the same as the four weeks of P05 itself.
Categories are as-is (current hierarchy), since the request did not ask for as-was
Cover is calculated per category across all physical stores together, not as an average of store-level covers
Weeks of cover is rounded to one decimal place
caveats: The result depends on the four-week window. Using the four weeks of P05 itself (31 Aug to 27 Sep) as the denominator instead would give: Bathroom & Plumbing 11.6, Cleaning & Household 7.5, Electrical 8.5, Furniture 28.6, Garden 18.5, Home Textiles & Decor 11.7, Kitchen & Dining 13.8, Paint & Decorating 13.5, Seasonal 42.0, Tools & Hardware 7.6. The largest differences are in Garden, Seasonal and Electrical.

Seasonal (48.8 weeks) and Furniture (29.5) cover figures are high because recent weekly sales in those categories are small compared with the stock held, so they are very sensitive to the sales window used.

Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no stock rows, so it is not in the figures. Store 999, the web shop and ZZ Test articles do not appear in the stock snapshot, and the same filters were applied to units sold.
Web sales are excluded from units sold because web orders are picked from the central warehouse, which is not in the stock table. Cover therefore reflects store sales and store stock only.
Weeks of cover is a store-stock figure on a flat four-week sales average. It does not allow for seasonality (for example Garden and Seasonal) or for sales trends beyond the window.

Checks run: the stock snapshot has no duplicate store, article and week rows (27,143 rows per week, a single load each week) and no negative or zero closing units for 27 Sep. The sales lines in the window have no duplicate line ids or receipt lines and no zero or negative quantities. The rpt_daily_store_sales control total was not applied, because it covers net sales value, not units by category.

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.format;
definitions_applied: Return rate on sale-week cohort
Net sales excluding VAT
Physical stores only (store_id < 900)
Excluded store 999 and category ZZ Test
assumptions: Period 2 last year interpreted as FY2025/26 P2 (2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22)
Store format refers to current format values on the sale date
Return rate is computed as returned net amount divided by sold net amount, for each format
caveats: Format values in the warehouse are Large, Medium, Small (the schema documentation references Hyper, Standard, Express but these are not present in current data)
Cohort is complete: sufficient time has elapsed (more than 30 days from last sale on 2025-06-22 to warehouse load date 2026-10-04) to capture returns within the typical 30-day window

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date,
           DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.store_id, cs.store_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY n.store_id, cs.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;
definitions_applied: Net sales (company definition): net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Web sales recognition: dispatch date in Helsinki time, excluding cancelled and processing orders
Returns: reduce net sales on the return date at the location where processed
Store hierarchy: as-is (current store names and structure)
Store scope: includes web shop (900) alongside physical stores
assumptions: Interpreted 'period 2 this year' as P2 of FY2026/27 (fiscal period 2 running 1 June to 28 June 2026)
Interpreted 'store ranking' as ranking by net sales in descending order
Included all sales locations including the web shop, since the request did not specify physical stores only
Applied as-is reporting (current store names and regions, not the hierarchy as it stood on each sale date)
caveats: Kuopio (store 125) had a scheduled refit closure from 15 June to 26 July 2026, affecting sales for the latter half of period 2; its net sales of 23,993.71 EUR reflect only the first half of the period
Web sales revenue of 230,731.44 EUR is the largest single location and is recognized on dispatch date (not order date) in Helsinki time zone
Control total check passed: result sum of 1,294,647.64 EUR matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, tied back to the original order's fulfilment type
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Only delivered and collected orders count; cancelled and processing orders have no dispatch and no sales
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: periods 6 to 8 of the fiscal year
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (the year before the current FY2026/27), following how accepted requests in FY2026/27 read it
Periods 6 to 8 of FY2025/26 are 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 (P6), 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025 (P7) and 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 (P8)
Share is of web net sales in value (as defined in the metric dictionary), not of order counts
Reported as-is, as the request involves no region or category hierarchy
Share is rounded to one decimal place
caveats: Period 7 spans the 3 November 2025 web-platform migration, when channel_code stopped being filled and click-and-collect only got its own channel_id. I did not use channel_code or channel_id; I used store 900 and fulfilment_type from fact_web_order, which work on both sides of the migration.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, because they silently drop web sales from 3 November 2025.

Total web net sales per period reconcile exactly to the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 (P6 175,588.62; P7 154,977.27; P8 225,265.08 EUR). There are no duplicate sales lines in the range.
One test-article (ZZ Test) web line was excluded in P6, as company rules require, and this is already within the control total.
Net sales is after returns, and web returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale. The periods are fully past that window, so the figures are complete.

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1) f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'), rets AS (SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date AS d, -r.refund_net AS amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'), net AS (SELECT store_id, sum(amt) net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY 1), tdays AS (SELECT st.store_id, count(*) trading_days FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=5 AND is_trading_day) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900 AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date<=d.calendar_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date>=d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, rank() OVER (ORDER BY n.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, round(n.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM net n JOIN tdays t USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: Store league table: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT after line discounts, minus returns (refund_net) on their own return date
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Trading days: days after opening, before closure, outside ref_store_closure refit closures, and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
A store that traded part of the period is still listed, with its own trading days
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 P5 = 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025 (weeks 18 to 21)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales, store by store
Store names from the current dim_store version (as-is)
assumptions: 'Period 5 last year' read as FY2025/26 P5 (25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025). The request was dated 8 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests made in FY2026/27 took 'last year' as FY2025/26 (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). The reading is not the last complete P5, which is FY2026/27 P5.
Net sales taken on the company definition: store sales on sale_date, returns on return_date, staff purchases included.
Ties are not an issue here; rank is by net sales per trading day, rounded to 2 decimals for display.
Net sales and trading days are left out of the table because the request asked only for the league table; per-day figures can be multiplied back out on request.
caveats: CORRECTION: fact_sales_line holds 418 duplicate lines (836 rows, same receipt_id and line_no and identical content, loaded twice, second load etl_loaded_at 2025-09-23 03:12) for Tampere Lielahti (116) dated 15 to 21 Sep 2025. I kept one row per receipt_id + line_no (lowest sales_line_id). Left in, they would add 10,390.53 EUR to store 116's net sales and would lift it from rank 7 (1,331.74 per day) to about rank 5 (about 1,785 per day... estimated), pushing other stores down. After de-duplication the store's total agrees with rpt_daily_store_sales exactly.
Control total: after de-duplication, net sales and net sales before returns agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for all 39 physical stores over 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025 (difference 0.00 in every store).

Pori (119) was shut for a refit from 8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025, so it has only 14 trading days (25 Aug to 7 Sep) in this period against 28 for the others; its rank of 10 is on its 14 days only. Its period net sales were 16,057.86 EUR.
Savonlinna (129; closed 25 Jan 2026), Lohja (137) and Tampere Lamminpää (136) were all open for the whole period and have 28 trading days. Savonlinna is listed because it traded in this period.
There were no closed holidays in the period, so every open store has 28 trading days (4 weeks x 7 days).

Returns from the period are counted on the day booked, so some refunds relate to earlier sales, and returns of this period's sales that arrive after 21 Sep 2025 are not included (this is the net-sales convention, not the return-rate cohort convention).
dim_store.format comments are out of date in the schema (formats seen include Medium and Small); not used in this answer.

answer.sql: WITH net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), days AS (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2 AND is_trading_day), trading AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN days d WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM sales s JOIN trading t ON t.store_id = s.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Staff purchases included in net sales
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Trading days: after opening, before closure, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
A store that traded for only part of the period is still listed, with its own trading days
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P02 = 1 June to 28 June 2026 (weeks 5 to 8)
Store names from the current dim_store version
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P02 (1 to 28 June 2026), fully loaded. The request was received on 7 October 2026, and this year is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27.
'Store ranking' is read as the company's store league table, ranked by net sales per trading day. The request did not name a ranking measure.
Rank 1 is the highest net sales per trading day. Ties would share a rank; there are none.
Stores are shown by name, not grouped by region or format, because the request asked for no breakdown.
caveats: Kuopio (125) was closed for a refit from 15 June 2026 (ref_store_closure). It traded 14 days of P2 (1 to 14 June) instead of 26 and is ranked on those days: 1,713.84 per trading day, rank 7. Its total net sales of 23,993.71 are not comparable with the full-period stores, and by total it would sit at about rank 25.

Trading days are 26 for every other listed store: 28 calendar days minus Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June), when stores are shut by company rule or law. No store had sales on those two days.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and had no sales in P2, so it is not listed.
The web shop (900) is not ranked. Its P2 net sales on the control table were 230,731.44, which is not in this table.
Store-level net sales agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for all 38 stores over 1 to 28 June 2026, with a difference of 0.00 each. Rows were unique at the sales-line grain.
Rows are not comparable across store formats (Large, Medium, Small), so the ranking mostly reflects store size.

Returns for P2 sales that arrive after the warehouse load date (4 October 2026) are not yet booked, but this does not affect net sales on the company definition, which dates returns on the return date.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Part-period stores stay in the table with their own trading days (Pori refit)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 excluded
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 5 = Monday 25 Aug 2025 to Sunday 21 Sep 2025 (weeks 18 to 21)
Store names from the current dim_store version
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27 (the request was received 8 Oct 2026). This matches how requests asked in FY2026/27 were read earlier. Period 5 is 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025, 4 weeks. FY2024/25 P5 would be a different table.
The league table is ranked by net sales per trading day (company definition), highest first. Net sales and trading days are shown beside the ranking figure.
Net sales per trading day is rounded to whole euros for display. The rank uses the unrounded value.
No region or format grouping was asked for, so the table is one row per store with a single overall ranking.
caveats: Correction for duplicate sales lines: Tampere Lielahti (116) had every sales line loaded twice from 15 Sep to 21 Sep 2025. The second copies have new sales_line_ids but the same receipt_id and line_no, and were loaded on 2025-09-23 03:12. Counted as loaded, the store's net sales are 47,679.15, against 37,288.62 in rpt_daily_store_sales, which would put it 3rd instead of 7th. I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no (the earliest load) in the final query. After that, all 39 stores match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (gap 0.00). Returns were not duplicated. Other stores showed no gap, so the duplication is confined to store 116. The load should be fixed at source.

Vantaa/Pori: Pori (119) was shut for a refit from 8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025, so it traded only 14 of the period's 28 days (25 Aug to 7 Sep). Its figure is per trading day on those 14 days and it is ranked on that basis, not on the full period.
The period has no closed holidays, so every store open all period has 28 trading days. Savonlinna (129) traded the whole period, since it closed on 25 Jan 2026.
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) were both open for the whole period (opened Sep and Nov 2024). They are ranked on the same basis as the other stores.
The request does not say which year 'last year' is. If FY2024/25 P5 (26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024) was meant, the table needs to be rerun.

answer.sql:
-- Return rate by store format, goods sold in P2 FY2025/26
-- Sale-week cohort: return counts in the week the item was sold, whenever it came back
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
      AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net 
    FROM fact_return_line 
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.format
definitions_applied: Return rate (sale-week cohort): refund_net divided by sold net, grouped by the fiscal week of the original sale
Net sales scope: excluding VAT, after returns, store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Store format: current format at the sale date (format is the same in every store version)
assumptions: Last year = FY2025/26 (fiscal year that ended 3 May 2026)
Period 2 = fiscal period 2 (fiscal weeks 5–8, 26 May–22 June 2025)
As-is reporting (current store format hierarchy)
Store format includes Web (store_id 900, pseudo-store for web orders and returns)
caveats: Cohort complete: all four formats show cohort_complete = true; all returns within the normal 30-day window have arrived as of 4 October 2026
Web returns are booked to store 900 regardless of their origin; web sales are on the order date in fact_sales_line
Store 999 (training store) excluded; no training-store sales in the period
Category ZZ Test excluded; no test-article sales affected the period totals

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region) SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores versus the same fiscal weeks last year, matched week by week on fiscal week number
LFL store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
LFL opening rule: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (27 Oct 2025)
LFL store-week rule: a store-week counts only if the store traded in that week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure from ref_store_closure)
Week 53 is never LFL (not in Q3 in any case)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included

Regions as-is: current dim_store version, so Capital Region covers Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto and Kerava in both years, and Kouvola sits in South in both years
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = P7 to P9 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39, matched to FY2024/25 weeks 27 to 39 by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Control total: fact-table net sales for physical stores checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Q3 last year' was read as FY2025/26 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27 to 39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), because the request was received on 5 Oct 2026 in FY2026/27. This matches how earlier 'last year' requests were read in FY2026/27. The comparator is FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025).
Growth is shown by region (one row per region) because the request says 'by region'. No company-total row is given.
Growth is net sales growth in percent, rounded to 2 decimals, for this year (FY2025/26 Q3) over last year (FY2024/25 Q3).
The opening rule was tested against the first day of the whole range, as the accepted LFL queries do. A store counts only if its open_date is on or before 28 Oct 2024.
Savonlinna's close_date (25 Jan 2026) is the last day of week 39. Its daily sales show it traded every day through 25 Jan, so I counted it as trading for all 13 weeks.
caveats: Lohja (137) is not in the LFL base. It opened on 4 Nov 2024, less than 52 weeks before the start of Q3 (27 Oct 2025), so its sales are excluded from both years.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) is in the LFL base, in West.
No refit closure falls inside the Q3 weeks of either year: Tammisto's refit was July to August 2024, Pori's September to October 2025, and Kuopio's is in 2026. No store-weeks were dropped for refits.
Savonlinna (129, closed 25 Jan 2026) is included for all 13 weeks. If the requester treats 25 Jan as a closed day, East would change slightly.

Regions are as-is (current hierarchy). On the old pre-April 2025 hierarchy, the Capital Region stores would sit in South and Kouvola in East, so the regional figures would differ. Only the five Capital Region stores sit in a different region from last year's reports.
The web shop is excluded from LFL, so the 3 Nov 2025 platform migration (which broke channel_code) does not affect these figures. Store scope was set by store_id, not channel_code.

Control check: store-by-day net sales for physical stores (all stores, not just LFL ones) matched rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for both periods (this year 3,265,201.53; last year 3,163,240.28, zero mismatching days). There are no duplicate sales_line_ids in fact_sales_line.

The LFL base across the five regions is 494 store-weeks (38 stores x 13 weeks). Net sales in the base were 3,223,126.99 this year and 3,140,011.17 last year, giving 2.65% LFL growth for the company. That total is not shown in the table because only the breakdown was requested.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, rpt_weekly_sales_by_region, or any bak_, stg_, tmp_ or _old tables.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3), wk AS (SELECT f.week_ending_date, sum(f.closing_value) AS week_value FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.week_ending_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY f.week_ending_date) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, round(avg(week_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur FROM wk
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: 'this year' is FY2026/27 and period 3 runs 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02 (5 weeks, fiscal weeks 9 to 13), taken from ref_fiscal_calendar
Stock value at cost: closing_value in fact_stock_week, which is closing units at standard unit cost
Average stock: the five weekly closing totals (week-ending Sundays 5, 12, 19, 26 July and 2 August 2026) summed across the chain, then averaged over the five weeks
Category taken from the product version in force on the week-ending date (dim_product via product_key)
Whole chain: all 38 physical stores trading in the period (store_id below 900)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, because the request is dated 2026-10-08 and the company reports on a fiscal calendar, not the calendar year 2026
'Period 3' means fiscal period 3 of that year, not calendar month 3 and not quarter 3
'Average stock' is the mean of the weekly closing stock values across the period's weeks, because the warehouse holds closing stock per week only and no daily stock
'Whole chain' covers the physical stores only; the web shop (900) and the training store (999) carry no stock rows for this category, so the filter changes nothing
'Paint & Decorating' is the product category of that name, covering Interior Paint, Exterior Paint, Brushes & Rollers and Wallpaper & Decor Film
caveats: No corrections to the figure were needed. I checked the following. fact_stock_week has no duplicate store and product rows in any of the five weeks. Every closing_value equals closing units times standard unit cost. There are no negative stock values. Every row's store and product version is valid on the week-ending date. Period 3 is flagged fully_loaded.

The week ending 5 July has 25 more rows than the other weeks (2,699 against 2,674). The extra rows are zero-unit, zero-value lines for three articles that had been delisted, so they do not change the total or the average.
Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no stock in the period. The chain is therefore 38 stores, and it should not be compared with periods before that closure without allowing for it.
Three Paint articles (SKUs 100963, 101047, 101277) have two product versions each, with identical cost and category, so they cause no double counting.
The figure is an average of end-of-week balances, not a daily average, so movements within a week are not captured.
Weekly chain totals range from about 341,100 to 349,200 euros, so the average is stable. Value is at standard cost, not at purchase or net realisable value.

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fws.closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value_at_cost FROM fact_stock_week fws INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fws.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND dp.is_current = TRUE AND fws.week_ending_date IN ('2026-07-05', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-19', '2026-07-26', '2026-08-02')
definitions_applied: Average closing stock value at standard cost: mean of closing_value across all store-product-week records
Paint & Decorating category: products where category = 'Paint & Decorating'
Period 3 FY2026/27: fiscal period 3 of 2026/27 (29 June – 2 August 2026)
Whole chain: aggregate across all 38 stores
Value at cost: standard_cost per unit, as recorded in closing_value column
assumptions: 'This year' interpreted as FY2026/27, the current fiscal year as of 2026-10-15
Average stock calculated as mean of all store-product-week closing values for the 5 fiscal weeks in period 3
Includes only products with current active status (is_current = TRUE)
Zero values (out-of-stock) are included in the average
caveats: 4 currently-listed Paint & Decorating products have no stock records in the warehouse (3 products from 2019, 1 from 2025-09-01), suggesting they were not stocked or newly added; the average is calculated from 361 of 385 current products
20 additional Paint & Decorating products were delisted before period 3 and are not included

This is the average value per store-product-week observation; the company holds Paint & Decorating stock across 38 stores and 361 products with records, yielding 13,395 total stock observations in period 3

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P4 = Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded), taken from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar
Returns dated on their own return date (fact_return_line.return_date), not the date of the original sale
Units returned = SUM(quantity_returned) from fact_return_line
Garden Furniture = subcategory 'Garden Furniture' in category Garden, as-is on the current product version
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded as company standard (the filters removed nothing)
Returns booked to the web shop (store 900) counted with store returns, since returns are booked where they are processed and web returns post to store 900
Deprecated objects (stg_, bak_, tmp_, _old tables, rpt.v_daily_sales) not used
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, and 'period 4' is fiscal period 4 of that year. The request was received on 5 October 2026 and P4 ended on 30 August 2026, so it is complete.
'Handed back and booked as returned' means rows in fact_return_line by return date, in units (quantity_returned). I counted all reason codes, including damaged_in_transit.
Garden Furniture was read as the subcategory 'Garden Furniture' (category Garden). It does not include Storage Furniture (category Furniture) or Bathroom Furniture.
Web returns are included because the request does not limit it to stores, so the figure is company-wide (34 of the 92 units were booked to the web shop, 58 to physical stores).
No breakdown by store, week or reason was requested, so a single figure is given.
caveats: The result is 92 units on 92 return lines, each of 1 unit. Corrections were looked for and none were needed.

Checks run: no duplicate return_line_id values; no sales line returned more than once; no return larger than the quantity sold; every return links to an existing sales line; no returns before the sale date; and none sit in store 999 or ZZ Test.
The Helsinki-time date of return_ts_utc gives the same 92 units as return_date, so the UTC day edge does not change the figure.

Garden Furniture is in the same subcategory on the product version at the return date as on the current version, so as-is and as-was give the same 92. The outdoor lighting move to Electrical affects a different subcategory.
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, so this counts returns booked in P4 on any sale date, not returns of goods sold in P4. The P4-sold cohort would give a different number.
I did not run query_check.py or the rpt_daily_store_sales control comparison. The control table holds net sales in EUR, not units, and no script runner was available in this session.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, p.category FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS garden_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category='Garden' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
As-was category: category taken from the product version valid on the transaction date (product_key on the sales and return lines)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 (29 Apr 2024 to 27 Apr 2025), periods 7 to 12
Web shop (store 900) included, since this is a company-level net sales request
Control total: all-category net sales in the same periods, built the same way, match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in each of P7 to P12
assumptions: 'P7 to P12 of FY24/25' read as FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 (28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025), one row per period
'The old way, Garden as it was reported at the time' read as as-was category, using the old category set-up from before the 27 Oct 2025 move of outdoor lighting from Garden to Electrical
Garden is shown as a company total including the web shop, with no breakdown by store, region or subcategory, because none was requested
Returns are assigned to the category of the product version on the return line, which is the as-was version on the return date; all returns in this range fall before the October 2025 reclassification
caveats: Under the as-was set-up, Garden includes the Outdoor Lighting subcategory, which is Electrical in current reporting. It contributes about 20,802 (P7), 20,333 (P8), 17,017 (P9), 9,681 (P10), 8,659 (P11) and 10,617 (P12) to these figures. The as-is figures would be lower by those amounts.

Store 999 (training store) is excluded from the totals. It has Garden test sales in this range, which would have added about 50 (P7), 12 (P8), 65 (P9), 101 (P10), 162 (P11) and 786 (P12) before returns.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT. They are net of returns, with each return booked in the period of its return date, not the period of the original sale.
Period 12 runs 5 weeks (24 Mar to 27 Apr 2025), and P9 also runs 5 weeks, so the periods are not equal in length. This partly explains the P12 peak, along with seasonal Garden demand.

No data defects were found in the range: no duplicate sales or return lines, no product-version mismatches on the sales lines, and no web lines without a dispatched order. No corrections were needed beyond the standard exclusions.

Sales area (dim_store.sqm, square metres) as the measure of store size
Closed stores excluded (Savonlinna, closed 25 January 2026)
