answer.sql:
WITH stores_both_periods AS (
  SELECT a.store_id, a.region
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, s.store_id, s.region
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  ) a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, s.store_id, s.region
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025 AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  ) b ON a.store_id = b.store_id
  WHERE a.region = b.region
),
regional_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_year = 2024 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_year = 2025 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_2025
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.calendar_year = 2024 OR d.calendar_year = 2025)
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores_both_periods)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(((sales_2025 - sales_2024) / sales_2024 * 100), 2) as like_for_like_growth_pct
FROM regional_summary
ORDER BY region
definitions_applied: Like-for-like stores: stores with sales activity in both Q3 2024 and Q3 2025, and assigned to the same region in both periods
Net sales: net amount (EUR excluding VAT) from fact_sales_line
Store channel only: channel_code = 'ST' (physical stores, excluding web sales)
Growth percentage: (Q3 2025 sales - Q3 2024 sales) / Q3 2024 sales × 100
assumptions: Q3 last year interpreted as calendar Q3 2025 compared to Q3 2024 (current date October 2026)
Like-for-like comparison requires stores to maintain their regional classification across both comparison periods
Only stores with reported sales in both periods are included; stores without sales in either period are excluded
caveats: Capital Region was reorganised on 2025-04-28 when 5 stores (101-105: Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto, Kerava) transferred from South. These stores excluded from both regions' LFL calculation.
Store 114 (Kouvola) transferred from East to South between the periods; excluded from LFL due to regional change.
Store 137 (Lohja) opened 2024-11-04 and is new; no Q3 2024 sales; excluded from LFL.
LFL analysis covers 32 of 39 stores: East (8), North (6), South (8), West (10). Seven stores excluded due to regional changes or new status.
West region showed strongest like-for-like growth at 11.41%; South region showed minimal growth at 0.54%.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category ORDER BY cp.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their own return date
Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns, with returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned
Gross margin %: gross margin divided by net sales
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included in the company total
As-is category hierarchy: current product version, so outdoor lighting sits in Electrical
Fiscal calendar: period 6 is 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025, 5 weeks (fiscal weeks 22 to 26)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the fiscal year just completed, FY2025/26, as past requests asked in FY2026/27 did. Period 6 of the current year, FY2026/27, has only its first week loaded.
Period 6 means fiscal period 6 (22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025), not calendar month 6.
The category hierarchy is as-is, the company default, because the request did not ask for as-was.
Figures cover all channels (stores and web) because the request names no channel or region.
Gross margin percentage is rounded to one decimal place.
caveats: Outdoor lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 Oct 2025, the day after period 6 ended. On the as-is basis used here, outdoor lighting (net sales 33,781.91, margin 37.3%) counts in Electrical. As the categories stood during period 6, Garden would be about 148,588 net sales at about 39.5% and Electrical about 185,711 at about 41.7%. Garden is 40.2% and Electrical 41.0% on the as-is basis. If Commercial wants the old category split, the as-was figures are the ones to use.

Duplicate rows found: 418 sales lines (net 10,390.53) were loaded twice in the reload of 23 Sep 2025 (03:12 UTC) with new sales_line_ids. They are all dated 15 to 21 Sep 2025, before period 6 starts, so they do not affect these figures. Anyone querying P5 without de-duplicating on receipt_id and line_no would overstate it.
Control check: net sales for all ten categories in period 6 add up to 1,293,219.69, which matches the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 exactly.

Other checks on Garden and Electrical lines in period 6 found no problems: no duplicate return lines, no missing or inconsistent standard costs (all match quantity times the version's standard unit cost), and no non-positive quantities or amounts. A few lines (19 Garden, 70 Electrical) have a standard cost above the net amount because of discounts, and they are kept as they are.
Margin uses standard cost, which is revalued each April, so it is not the actual purchase cost.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')), cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS current_category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current), u AS (SELECT per.fiscal_year, c.current_category, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT per.fiscal_year, c.current_category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT current_category AS category, 8 AS fiscal_period, round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END) - 1), 2) AS growth_pct FROM u WHERE current_category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY current_category ORDER BY current_category
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns
Returns counted on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales (refunds booked on the day)
Fiscal period 8 dates taken from ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2024/25 P08: 2024-11-25 to 2024-12-22; FY2025/26 P08: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-21, 4 weeks each)
Category taken from the current version of each SKU (dim_product.is_current), applied to both years
Training store (store_id 999) and ZZ Test articles excluded
All real sales channels included: stores plus the web shop (store_id 900), home delivery and click-and-collect
Staff purchases included, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Last year is read as FY2025/26 and the year before as FY2024/25, because the request date (5 Oct 2026) falls in FY2026/27
Period 8 is the fiscal period 8 (late Nov to late Dec), not calendar month 8
Garden and Electrical are shown as two rows, one per category, with no combined total, since the request did not ask for a total
Net sales means all channels (stores and web), including staff purchases, because the existing daily store sales report does too
Growth is FY2025/26 P08 over FY2024/25 P08, in percent
caveats: Correction: 68 Outdoor Lighting SKUs moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27. Taken as booked, FY2024/25 P08 has them in Garden and FY2025/26 P08 has them in Electrical. That gives Electrical 143159.94 to 171286.19 (+19.65%) and Garden 56462.85 to 36665.72 (-35.06%), both of which are distorted. I restated FY2024/25 to the current hierarchy so both years compare the same range. About 19340 EUR of FY2024/25 P08 net sales moved from Garden to Electrical.

If Commercial wants the as-booked category view, use the as-booked figures above. Garden plus Electrical combined is 199622.79 in FY2024/25 P08 and 207951.91 in FY2025/26 P08 (+4.17%), and is the same either way.
Excluded the Training store (999) from sales. Its sales in these periods are mostly staff-flagged test transactions, and the existing daily store sales report excludes it too.
Staff purchases are included. They are small: Electrical about 1453 and 1761 EUR, Garden about 353 and 639 EUR (FY2024/25 and FY2025/26, before returns). Excluding them would shift growth slightly.

Web sales are included. Web shop net sales before returns were about 22457 (FY2024/25) and 27738 (FY2025/26) EUR for Electrical, and about 6938 and 6283 EUR for Garden. Electrical growth is partly web-driven.
Both periods are fully loaded. Sales lines were duplicated in the warehouse for store 116 in September 2025, but nothing in either period 8 window was duplicated, so no deduplication was needed.

The web channel is coded differently in the two years: channel_code WB in FY2024/25, and channel_id 2 or 3 with a null channel_code in FY2025/26. The query does not depend on channel columns, so it is unaffected.

Store mix differs between the years. Lohja (137) opened 2024-11-04 and Tampere Lamminpää (136) opened 2024-09-02, so both traded for the whole of both windows, but Savonlinna closes on 2026-01-25. These figures are total net sales, not like-for-like.

The daily store sales report (rpt_daily_store_sales) does not agree with the fact tables for the web shop day by day, so I did not use it and queried the fact tables directly. Store figures do agree with the fact tables.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.sku, cp.product_name, fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE cs.store_id = 124 AND cp.sku = 100011 AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
definitions_applied: Closing stock = fact_stock_week.closing_units at the fiscal week-ending Sunday (a snapshot, not summed across weeks)
Fiscal weeks run Monday to Sunday; last week = last completed fiscal week
Store and product resolved by natural key (store_id, sku) with is_current versions
Physical store scope (store_id < 900), store 999 and ZZ Test excluded (no effect on this figure)
assumptions: 'Last week' means the last completed fiscal week, Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026 (FY2026/27 week 22). The request was received Thursday 8 October, which falls in the following, still running, week.
'Jyväskylä Palokka' is store_id 124 (store_key 30, the only version, current) and SKU 100011 is 'Plants & Flowers Kuusela 570' (product_key 11, category Garden, one version, still listed).
'Units in stock' is the closing stock units in the weekly snapshot, not the stock at the time of the request.
caveats: No data problems were found for this store and article: one snapshot row for the week, no duplicate rows, and the 4 October snapshot has the same number of rows (27,143) as the preceding weeks.

Stock movement ties out across recent weeks: 13 units at 20 Sep, 2 sold in the week to 27 Sep gives 11, and no sales or returns in the week to 4 Oct leaves 11. The 4 October snapshot was loaded on 5 October 2026.
The figure is as of Sunday 4 October close. It does not include any sales, returns or deliveries made since then, and the warehouse has no data after 4 October.
Receipts and adjustments for this article were zero in all recent weeks, so the stock only reduced through sales.

answer.sql: SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS held_out_members FROM dim_campaign c JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Black Week 2025' GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
definitions_applied: Holdout members are listed in campaign_holdout by member_id, not member_key
Members counted by distinct member_id
Black Week 2025 identified through dim_campaign (campaign 15, 24 to 30 November 2025)
No deprecated, staging or backup tables used
assumptions: 'Black Week 2025 mailing' means campaign 15 in dim_campaign, the only campaign with that name; Black Week 2024 is campaign 5 and was not used
'Held out' means the members listed for campaign 15 in campaign_holdout
caveats: The held-out count (2747) is 10.34% of the mailing list of 26573, slightly above the nominal 10% (about 2657). The 2747 equals dim_campaign.holdout_size for the campaign and the number of rows in campaign_holdout.
Held-out members (2747) and members with at least one exposure row (23818) add up to 26565, 8 fewer than the recorded mailing list size of 26573. I did not find the reason for the 8.

Checks that came out clean: no member appears in both the holdout and the exposed group, no duplicate member_ids in the holdout, every held-out member exists in dim_member, none joined after the campaign, and all had marketing consent on the campaign start date.
No store, product or sales filters apply to this count, so the store 999 and ZZ Test exclusions and the control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales were not relevant.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13 AND s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
definitions_applied: Fiscal period system: period 3 within the fiscal year
Store scope: identified by store_id
Interior Paint: all products with subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
Units sold: quantity field from fact_sales_line (sales only, excludes returns)
assumptions: Period 3 this year: interpreted as FY2026/27 P03 (fiscal period 3 of the current fiscal year at request date 2026-10-05)
Interior Paint: all SKUs with subcategory = 'Interior Paint' (123 distinct products in this category)
Lahti store: store_id = 108
caveats: None: query passed all validation checks

answer.sql:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM web_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period;
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Web sales including VAT (sum of gross_amount per line)
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Store 999 excluded per standard exclusions
Web shop identified as store_id 900
assumptions: Q2 FY2024/25 is fiscal periods 4, 5, and 6
Before returns means pre-return sales value (gross sales before refunds)
One figure per period as 3 separate rows
caveats: None identified. Query validation passed all checks.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_sales_incl_vat FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6) AND f.channel_code = 'WB' GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales identified by channel_code = 'WB' in fact_sales_line
VAT included via gross_amount field (line value including VAT)
Before returns: reporting gross sales without return deductions
Fiscal periods 4-6 represent Q2 of FY2024/25
assumptions: Web sales are all transactions with channel_code = 'WB'
gross_amount field represents the complete transaction value including all taxes
'Before returns' interpreted as pre-return sales values, not net-of-returns
caveats: Return activity exists for web sales in this period (316-432 returns per period worth 16k-21k EUR refunds) but is not deducted per request
All Q2 FY2024/25 web sales use channel_code encoding; channel_id field is NULL for these transactions

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period, ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excluding VAT) divided by the number of sales receipts
Staff purchases left out of ATV
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test (test articles) left out
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Web shop is store 900, identified by store_id rather than channel_code
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: P1 to P3 of FY2026/27 are fiscal weeks 1 to 13, 4 May to 2 August 2026
Physical stores (store_id below 900) plus the web shop (store 900) as total company
One web order counts as one receipt (receipt_id equals web_order_id)
Cancelled orders, which have no sales lines, are not counted
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'periods 1 to 3' is P1 to P3 (Q1), weeks 1 to 13. The period is complete, and the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.
The standard ATV definition excludes web orders. You asked for them to be included, so I followed your request and added them. The standard store-only figure is given below for comparison.

A web order is one receipt, dated by its Helsinki dispatch date. That matches the numerator, which is also on the dispatch date and ties exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales. Counting orders by order date would give 12,962 orders (non-cancelled) against 13,004 on the dispatch basis.
ATV is shown in EUR excluding VAT, as the company definition says.
I did not use the rpt.v_daily_sales view, which drops web sales after 3 November 2025.
caveats: This is not the standard company ATV. By definition ATV is a store measure that leaves web out. Including web gives 56.14 EUR over 79,988 receipts and 4,490,717.08 EUR net before returns. Stores alone are 55.52 EUR (66,984 receipts) and web alone is 59.33 EUR (13,004 orders).

Corrections made to the raw data: I removed 1,037 staff-purchase receipts in the stores (48,734.94 EUR net), 3 web test-article receipts in ZZ Test (6.00 EUR), and all store 999 transactions (54 test-article receipts and 132 staff receipts, 7,806.26 EUR net in total). Removing these changes the totals.

Cross-check: store and web net sales before returns and receipt counts (including staff, before the staff exclusion) tie exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for the same dates (stores 3,767,921.27 EUR and 68,021 receipts; web 771,530.75 EUR and 13,004 orders). I found no duplicate receipt lines or receipts spanning several stores.
519 cancelled web orders in the period were left out. They have no sales lines, so they do not affect the figure.
I ran the query-check script's checks by hand (control total, duplicate grain, Helsinki-time dates) rather than through the script itself.

answer.sql: SELECT f.closing_units FROM fact_stock_week f WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
definitions_applied: Stock is measured at fiscal week end (Sunday of fiscal week)
Store matched by name to dim_store (current version)
Product matched by SKU to dim_product (current version)
closing_units from fact_stock_week reflects actual stock at week end
assumptions: Last week = fiscal week ending 2026-10-04 (the most recent complete fiscal week before request date 2026-10-08)
Store name 'Jyväskylä Palokka' uniquely identifies store_id 124

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year_filter,
           18 AS week_start,
           34 AS week_end
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year_filter
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.week_start AND params.week_end
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their own return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only), not the order date
Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost, both after returns, with returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned
Gross margin %: gross margin divided by net sales
Categories as-is: current product version (dim_product.is_current), so outdoor lighting counts in Electrical for all history
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal period 6 taken from dim_date: FY2025/26 P6, 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025, 5 weeks
Store 900 (web shop) included, since this is a category total and not a store analysis
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26. The request came in on 8 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests made in May 2026 read 'last year' the same way (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35).
'Period 6' was read as FY2025/26 P6, which is a complete period.
Categories are reported as-is because no as-was was requested.
Net sales and margin cover stores and the web shop together, with no split by channel, region or subcategory, because none was asked for.
Staff purchases are included, as in the company net-sales definition.
caveats: Outdoor lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 Oct 2025, the day after P6 ended. As-is puts it in Electrical, which gives Electrical 219493.00 and Garden 114805.94. As it stood on the sale dates (as-was), Electrical would be 185711.09 and Garden about 148588 (114805.94 plus about 33782 of outdoor lighting).

I found 418 duplicated sales lines (same receipt_id and line_no, loaded twice) in the pre-period week 15 to 21 Sep 2025. None fall inside P6: the all-category P6 net sales before returns are the same with and without removing duplicates, so no correction was applied to these figures.

Control total: net sales before returns for all categories (excluding store 999 and ZZ Test) over 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 are 1366812.79 in the warehouse and in rpt_daily_store_sales, so they agree. The check is at company level, not per store, and does not apply to a category subset.
Excluding store 999 and ZZ Test does not change the Garden and Electrical figures, because test articles are in their own category and store 999 sells only test and training items.
Returns on P6 sales that arrive after the period are not in these figures, because returns reduce net sales on their own return date. Returns booked in P6 on sales from earlier periods are included.

answer.sql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.closing_value) AS closing_value FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY d.fiscal_week) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur FROM weekly
definitions_applied: Closing stock is a weekly snapshot: summed across stores and products within each fiscal week first, then averaged over the weeks of the period (never summed across weeks)
Value at cost: closing_value, which is stock at standard cost
Fiscal period 3 of FY2026/27 from dim_date: weeks 9 to 13, 29 June to 2 August 2026 (ref_fiscal_calendar fully_loaded = true)
Physical stores only for stock by store/chain (store_id below 900, web shop and its central warehouse excluded)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Category as-is: Paint & Decorating taken from the current product version (dim_product.is_current joined on sku)
Deprecated tables, views and staging/backup/tmp objects not used
assumptions: "This year" read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (asked 8 October 2026), so period 3 is 29 June to 2 August 2026, which is a complete period
"Average stock" read as the average of the five weekly closing values in the period (not the last week's closing), as the Warehouse rules give both options and the request says average
"Whole chain" read as all physical stores. The central warehouse that supplies web orders is not in the stock table, so it is not included
Stores shut for a refit during the period (Kuopio, store 125, 15 June to 26 July 2026) are kept in, as stock is still held while a store is closed
Savonlinna (129), closed 25 January 2026, has no stock rows in the period, so 38 stores are included
Prior-year comparison not requested, so not given
caveats: No data corrections were needed. In the weeks 9 to 13 snapshots there were no duplicate rows at the store x article x week grain (one row per key, one load per row), no negative closing units, and closing_value equalled closing_units x standard_unit_cost on every row.

Week 9 has 25 more rows than weeks 10 to 13 (2,699 against 2,674). They are three articles (skus 101007, 101166, 101187) delisted on 1 July 2026, held at zero units and zero value in week 9, so they do not change the average.
The five weekly totals (EUR) are 341,138.89, 341,742.53, 344,245.91, 349,160.39 and 346,046.42, so the average (344,466.83) hides a rise of about 1.4% over the period.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_week, 13 AS last_week
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND cp.category = 'Garden'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;
definitions_applied: Return rate: returned net (refund_net) divided by sold net, grouped by the fiscal week of the original sale (sale-week cohort)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns; store 999 and test articles excluded
As-is reporting: current product category and subcategory hierarchy
assumptions: Q1 of last year = Q1 FY2025/26 (fiscal weeks 1-13, 28 April 2025 - 27 July 2025)
Goods sold refers to sales lines dated in Q1 FY2025/26
Returns are attributed to the fiscal week of the original sale, not the return date
As-is hierarchy applied (current product classifications)
caveats: Return cohort is complete for all Garden subcategories; the latest sale in Q1 was more than 30 days before the warehouse load date (4 October 2026)
Outdoor Lighting appears as a Garden subcategory with minimal sales (€375), suggesting these products may not yet have been fully reclassified to Electrical in the current product version

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key, because dim_member keeps one row per version
Tier read from the current version of each member (is_current, valid_to 9999-12-31)
Warehouse is not used through stg_, bak_, tmp_ or _old tables
assumptions: 'Gold-tier loyalty members at the moment' is read as all enrolled members whose current tier is Gold, whether or not they have bought recently. The metric dictionary defines 'active member' but has no definition for a total member count, so I did not apply the active-member rule.
'At the moment' is read as the current version of each member. The latest data in the warehouse is 4 October 2026, three days before the request date of 7 October 2026.
Checked that the current-version count equals the count of Gold versions valid on 7 October 2026 (both 5791), so the two readings of 'now' agree.
caveats: Loaded data runs to 4 October 2026 (latest sale and latest member version). Any tier change on 5 to 7 October is not in the warehouse.

If Mika wants only active Gold members (at least one purchase in the 52 fiscal weeks ending Sunday 4 October 2026, any channel), the figure is 4827 instead of 5791. I reported 5791 because the request does not say 'active'.

I found no data problems in dim_member: 60000 current rows, one per member, with no overlapping versions and no tier outside Basic, Silver and Gold. Counting version rows instead of distinct members would overstate Gold, because 2412 non-current Gold version rows also exist.

answer.sql: WITH sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: LFL growth: physical-store net sales for the period against the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the range (27 Oct 2025 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open_date, close_date and ref_store_closure refit weeks)
Web shop (store 900) excluded from LFL
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their return date
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date, using only delivered and collected orders (none of it ends up in the stores-only LFL figure)
Regions as-is: current dim_store region for every year
Same fiscal weeks (27 to 39) compared; calendar dates not lined up
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Q3 last year' read as FY2025/26 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27 to 39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026). The request is dated 5 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27, so 'last year' is FY2025/26 (as in REQ-D04, D08, D28 and D35). The comparator is FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025).
Regions as-is (current hierarchy), the management default. FP&A did not ask for as-was. Under as-was, the Capital Region would not exist for FY2024/25.
One row per region, because 'by region' asks for a breakdown. No company total was requested, so none is shown.
Week 39 counts in full: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, which is the Sunday of week 39, so it traded all 13 weeks under the close_date >= week-end rule.
caveats: Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) is not in the LFL base for this quarter, because it had not been open 364 days before 27 Oct 2025. It is excluded from every region (South), so South covers 9 of its 10 stores. The other 38 physical stores are in the base for all 13 weeks, because no refit or closure overlaps this quarter in either year.

Control total: my store-by-store daily net sales (stores, web, store 999 and ZZ Test filtered as stated) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for every store and day from 28 Oct 2024 to 25 Jan 2026. The check is on my net-sales source before the LFL store selection, so the regional figures inherit it.

Data problem found: 418 sales lines (836 rows) loaded twice in fact_sales_line, dated 15 to 21 Sep 2025, with the same receipt_id and line_no but a different sales_line_id and etl_loaded_at. They fall outside both Q3 windows, so they do not change this answer. My query removes duplicates by receipt_id and line_no anyway. Anyone totalling September 2025 would be overstated.

Q3 FY2025/26 is complete, but returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale. Returns here are booked on their return date, per the net sales definition, so late returns of January sales are not an issue.
Store 999 and ZZ Test are excluded as company policy. This did not change any LFL regional total, because LFL is physical stores only and store 999 is not one of them.

Regions Capital Region and South include the stores that moved region on 28 April 2025, shown on today's hierarchy for both years. Under as-was, last year's Capital Region comparison would be undefined.
dim_store.region comment is out of date (it lists four regions); the data has five regions plus Online, and I used the actual values.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web = store_id 900 (not channel_code); click-and-collect counts as web
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Cancelled and processing orders excluded from web sales (no dispatch)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods from dim_date (4-4-5 pattern, fiscal year starts 28 April 2025 for FY2025/26)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26. The request was made on 9 October 2026, during FY2026/27, and earlier accepted requests made in the current fiscal year read 'last year' as the previous fiscal year.
'Periods 5 to 8' means fiscal periods P05 to P08, 25 August to 21 December 2025 (fiscal weeks 18 to 34). All four periods are complete and fully loaded.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT, as the company definition requires. The request did not ask for VAT-inclusive figures.
The result has one row per fiscal period, which I took as the grain 'by period' implies. No total row.
caveats: The web platform migrated on 3 November 2025, which falls in P07. channel_code is empty from that date, so I identified web by store 900. The deprecated views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales leave out web sales from 3 November 2025 and were not used. A figure built on channel_code or those views would be too low for P07 and P08.

Web returns are booked to the web shop on the day they are processed, so each period's figure includes refunds for goods sold in earlier periods. Period 5 refunds, for example, include returns on August orders and on goods dispatched in P4.
Test-article (ZZ Test) lines on web orders are excluded. The 19 such web lines in the warehouse did not cause any gap to the control total.

Checks: the four period totals match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly (145,626.90; 175,588.62; 154,977.27; 225,265.08). There are no duplicate sales lines, web orders or return lines, and every web sales line has a matching web order with a delivered or collected status.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line frl INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4 WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND frl.return_date >= rfc.period_start_date AND frl.return_date <= rfc.period_end_date
definitions_applied: Garden Furniture = products where category = 'Garden' and subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
Returned = returns recorded in fact_return_line table with return_date in the period
Period 4 FY2026/27 = fiscal period 4 of fiscal year 2026/27, running 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30
Units returned = sum of quantity_returned column from fact_return_line
assumptions: This year = FY2026/27 (current fiscal year as of latest warehouse data 2026-10-04)
Period 4 this year = fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27, not calendar month 4
caveats: Warehouse data extends only to 2026-10-04; actual date is 2026-10-15 but no gap in returns data for period 4
All 92 returns are single-unit returns; no multi-unit return lines exist for Garden Furniture in this period
Data is clean with no NULL values in quantity_returned or return_date for this product/period combination

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value_eur FROM fact_stock_week fsw INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
definitions_applied: Category 'Paint & Decorating' is the exact product category in dim_product
Closing value in fact_stock_week is the standard cost valuation at the period end
Period 3 FY2026/27 is defined as fiscal weeks 9-13, 29 June to 2 August 2026
Average is calculated across all store-product-week combinations in the period
assumptions: Interpreted 'this year' as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (the year in which data was current as of the request date)
Interpreted 'for the whole chain' as all stores combined in a single aggregate figure
Stock value is the closing_value column from fact_stock_week, which is already calculated at standard unit cost
caveats: No data quality issues found: all 13,395 records have valid closing_value entries with no nulls or negative amounts
Covers all 38 stores and 361 distinct Paint & Decorating SKUs active during the period

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2), sales AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1), rets AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key, p WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1), names AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) DESC) AS sales_rank, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, n.store_name, round(s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0),2) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id) JOIN names n USING (store_id) WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= (SELECT e FROM p) AND closure_end_date >= (SELECT s FROM p)) ORDER BY sales_rank
definitions_applied: Fiscal period from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2026/27 period 2 = 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the period (same basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales)
Store identity by store_id through the store_key version at the sale or return date, so SCD versions do not split a store
Physical stores only: web shop (store_id 900) and Training store (999) excluded
Planned refit closures from ref_store_closure used to identify stores that did not trade the full period
Rank 1 = highest net sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as fiscal period 2 of the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (the request is dated 2026-10-07, which falls in FY2026/27 period 6), not calendar year or last year
'Store ranking' read as ranking by net sales in EUR excluding VAT, highest first; no other measure (units, margin, sales per sqm) was asked for
Returns are netted in the period they are booked (return_date), even if the original sale was in an earlier period, matching the D&A daily store sales report
Staff purchases are left in net sales, as in rpt_daily_store_sales; the warehouse carries no rule excluding them

Stores that were open and trading all 26 trading days of the period are ranked; the two non-trading days are Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) for every store, so they do not distort the comparison
Warehouse comments carry no company definition of net sales, so the choices above are mine and should be confirmed with Finance
caveats: Kuopio (store 125) is left out of the ranking. It was closed for a refit from 2026-06-15 (6 weeks, to 2026-07-26) and traded only 14 of the period's 26 trading days. Its net sales for those days were 23993.71, which would be rank 23 of 38 on the total but about 6th on sales per trading day (about 1714 a day), so the two readings give very different positions. Say if you want it shown on either basis.
Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in the period, so it does not appear.
The web shop (7: store_id 900, net sales 230731.44 after returns) and the Training store (999, 2381.03, almost all staff purchases) are not stores in the ranking and are excluded.

Staff purchases are included. Excluding them would change the order of close pairs: Vantaa Tammisto (staff 955.26), Oulu Kaakkuri (447.68) and Tampere Lielahti (291.45) are within about 150 EUR of each other at ranks 4 to 6 and would swap order. Staff purchases are 0.2% to 2.9% of a store's gross net sales, so ranks elsewhere move only in close pairs.
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in late 2024; both traded the full period, so they are ranked, but they are newer stores and not like-for-like with the older estate.

Several stores changed region on 2025-04-28 (Helsinki/Espoo/Vantaa/Kerava moved from South to Capital Region, Kouvola from East to South). No region is shown in the ranking, so this does not affect it, but any regional cut of this period needs the current store version.
Net sales figures match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for every store (checked); no duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period, and the staging load tables hold nothing for these dates.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), regional AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM regional ty JOIN regional ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after line discounts, less returns booked on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Web shop is store 900, shown as its own line (region Online)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Regions as-is (current dim_store version, store_id with is_current)
Fiscal quarter 3 = weeks 27 to 39, aligned by fiscal quarter and week number, not by calendar date
Helsinki time for day boundaries
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' means FY2025/26 (the fiscal year just completed when the request was received on 6 Oct 2026), and 'the year before' means FY2024/25. This follows how earlier accepted requests read 'last year' in this fiscal year.

Q3 means fiscal Q3 (P7 to P9, weeks 27 to 39): 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026 for FY2025/26 and 28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025 for FY2024/25. Both quarters have 13 weeks, and week 53 is not in Q3, so there is no week 53 issue.

Regions are as-is, because the request did not ask for as-was. Every store sits in its current region in both years, so the two years are comparable. This matters for the Capital Region (Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto and Kerava), which did not exist before 28 April 2025, and for Kouvola, which moved from East to South.
Growth percentage is FY2025/26 divided by FY2024/25 minus 1, as a percentage rounded to one decimal.
Figures are net sales in EUR excluding VAT.
caveats: No corrections were needed for this request. The figures reconcile exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for every store, including the web shop (store 900), in Q3 of both years.

Regional growth includes stores that were not open for the whole of both quarters, so it is not like-for-like. Lohja (South) opened on 4 Nov 2024, so Q3 FY2024/25 has only about 12 of its 13 weeks. Savonlinna closed on 25 Jan 2026, the last day of Q3 FY2025/26, so it traded the whole quarter. If a like-for-like view is wanted, that is a separate request.

As-was regions would give different regional figures. Under the regions of the time there was no Capital Region in Q3 FY2024/25, and Kouvola was in East. The as-is figures here move those stores into the same region in both years.

Duplicated sales lines exist in the warehouse for 15 to 21 September 2025 (one store, loaded twice, 836 rows). That is in Q2 FY2025/26, outside this request, so it does not affect these figures. It may affect other requests that cover those dates.

The web shop's 29.7% growth includes the effect of the November 2025 web-platform migration on channel_code. The query avoids this by identifying web through store 900 and fact_web_order, not channel_code. The deprecated views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used, as they omit web sales from 3 Nov 2025.

Raahe (North) has no sales receipts on 2 Jan 2025, only a small return of -24.28 EUR. Raahe is a small store and the amount is immaterial to the North figure. I could not tell whether the day was a true zero or a data gap.

answer.sql: WITH web_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE c.channel_group = 'web' AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'), sales AS (SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net FROM web_lines GROUP BY sku), refunds AS (SELECT w.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web_lines w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id GROUP BY w.sku), names AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) AS product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku) SELECT s.sku, n.product_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur FROM sales s JOIN names n USING (sku) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sku) ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales = line value in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), after line discounts, less refunds (refund_net) on the same lines
Web channel = channel_group 'web' in dim_channel (channel_id 2 Web home delivery and 3 Click and collect), the key used since the web-platform migration
Products identified by sku (stable across versions), not by product_key; name taken from dim_product
Platform migration cut-off: sale_date on or after 2025-11-03 (sale_date is the local business date)
Refunds attributed to the original sales line via fact_return_line.sales_line_id
Staff purchases excluded where flagged (none exist on web lines)
assumptions: Read 'web sales' as net sales after returns, excluding VAT, matching how the warehouse reports net sales (rpt_daily_store_sales).
Included click-and-collect together with home delivery, as both belong to the web channel group.
Read 'since the platform migration on 3 November 2025' as inclusive of 3 November 2025, through the latest loaded data (3 October 2026).
Read 'top 10 products' as individual SKUs, ranked by web net sales in EUR, not by units or by category.
caveats: Since the migration, web lines no longer carry channel_code (it is null). The pre-migration filter channel_code = 'WB' returns nothing for this period, so I used channel_id and dim_channel.
1,473 web lines have channel_id 2 (home delivery) but belong to click-and-collect orders (status collected, fulfilment_type click_and_collect). They are web sales either way, so they are included.

Refunds are deducted. On gross web sales (before returns) the ranking is different: Bedroom Peltola 793 would be first at 15,533.23 and Christmas Decorations Poutaranta Home 601 third at 13,389.94, rather than third and second. Garden Furniture Raudikko 536 loses 1,846.63 to refunds, and Bedroom Peltola 793 loses 5,396.16. Tell me if you want the gross ranking.
Products are grouped by sku across slowly-changing product versions, so a product that changed version is not split across rows.

The latest data is 3 October 2026, and the current fiscal period is not fully loaded. The last few days (1 to 3 October, 370 web lines) are thin and may be incomplete. Returns are recorded up to 4 October. Late returns on recent sales will still change these figures.
Tenth place is clear: Garden Furniture Norvik 499 at 6,610.15 against 6,444.60 for the next product, Interior Paint Kultala 377. Seventh and eighth are close, at 6,957.22 and 6,957.04.
All figures are in EUR excluding VAT. No cancelled or processing web orders appear in the sales lines, so none needed removing.

answer.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN f.net_amount END) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10) AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: periods 9 and 10 taken from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2025/26 P09 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026, P10 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026)
Web sales = sales lines on the web channels (channel_id 2 and 3, channel group web), excluding the store and the training store
Net sales value = net_amount, EUR excluding VAT
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, not by channel_id
Cancelled web orders excluded (they have no sales lines in the window)
Sale date (sale_date) used to place a line in a period
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, since the request is dated 6 Oct 2026 and the current year FY2026/27 has not reached period 9
Periods 9 and 10 are combined into one share, as the request asks for a single figure; the per-period shares are in the caveats
Share is measured on net sales value excluding VAT, before returns
Web sales means all web channel lines, home delivery plus click-and-collect
caveats: Correction: in this window channel_id 2 ('Web home delivery') also holds 758 click-and-collect orders (1,473 lines, 43,819.29 EUR net) that the sales lines mislabel. Only channel_id 3 ('Click and collect') is tagged correctly. Using channel_id would give 17.4% (60,496.25 of 347,431.30) instead of 30.02%. I used the order-level fulfilment_type, which agrees with pickup store and order totals on every order checked.

channel_code is NULL on web lines in this window (the old WB code is no longer filled in after the web-platform migration). The reporting view rpt.v_daily_sales filters on channel_code = 'WB' and so would miss these lines; I did not use it.
The share is 29.75% in P09 and 30.45% in P10 (30.02% combined).
On a gross (VAT-inclusive) basis the share is 30.03%, essentially the same.
Returns are not deducted. Deducting refunds booked in the window (click-and-collect 12,139.96 EUR, home delivery 32,788.52 EUR, net of VAT) moves the share to 30.47%.
Cancelled orders (about 290 in the window, roughly 20,800 EUR gross) are excluded because they carry no sales lines; they were not counted as sales.
The training store (store 999) is excluded as not a sales channel; it is not part of web sales anyway.
Both periods are marked fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar. No duplicate sales lines were found in the window.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: A member is counted by member_id, the stable loyalty number, not by member_key, because dim_member keeps one row per version of each member.
Join date is dim_member.join_date, the date the member joined.
assumptions: 'Joined' means the member's join_date in the loyalty member table. I read '3 October 2026' as that calendar date, with no time-zone shift, because join_date is a plain date.
I counted every member, whatever their tier, marketing consent or home store (online sign-ups included), because the request names no filter.
caveats: I found no problem in the data for this date, so I made no corrections. No member has more than one join_date, and no member_key repeats. The 29 versions with a 3 October join_date are 29 different members, and all 29 are the current version.
The loyalty member table is loaded up to 4 October 2026, so 3 October is covered.
The count is the same as the 29 rows for 3 October in stg_member_updates, a staging table that holds only the later member updates, and all 29 members there are also in dim_member.
29 is within the 25 to 49 joins per day seen in September 2026.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on the return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal calendar: weeks run Monday to Sunday; period 2 is fiscal weeks 5 to 8
Prior year lined up by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27; the request was received on 7 October 2026
'Period 2' means FY2026/27 P2, which is fiscal weeks 5 to 8 (1 to 28 June 2026)
'Last year' means FY2025/26, whose P2 runs 26 May to 22 June 2025
Each week is compared with the same fiscal week number last year
Growth percentage is this year over last year minus 1, rounded to one decimal
The total includes the web shop because it is a total company figure
caveats: Midsummer (stores shut on Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day) falls in a different fiscal week each year: week 8 last year (20-21 June 2025) and week 7 this year (19-20 June 2026). This is why week 7 shows -32.2% and week 8 shows +76.4%. Both are calendar effects, not a trading trend. Weeks 7 and 8 combined: 590,943.83 this year against 535,679.88 last year, +10.3%. Weeks 5 and 6 are normal.

The comparison is not like-for-like. Savonlinna closed on 25 January 2026, so it traded last year but not this year, and the totals include its sales only for last year. No adjustment was made because the request asks for total company net sales.

No data corrections were needed. The weekly totals match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in all 8 weeks, and there are no duplicate sales line ids. I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, which leave out web sales from 3 November 2025.
All eight weeks are fully loaded; the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026. Week 53 is not in period 2, so no week 53 issue arises.

answer.sql:
SELECT
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT: sum of gross_amount from fact_sales_line, which includes all applicable VAT rates (10%, 14%, 24% in August; 10%, 14%, 25.5% from 1 September 2024)
Before returns: based on fact_sales_line only, excluding fact_return_line

As-was regions: using the store region from the dim_store version valid on each sale date (August and September 2024 used the four original regions: North, South, East, West; the Capital Region reorganization occurred 28 April 2025)
Store exclusions: training store 999 and test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded per house rules
assumptions: Request for gross sales (including VAT) interpreted as requesting sum of gross_amount column, which reflects actual mixed VAT rates by product and date
Calendar months (August and September 2024) used rather than fiscal periods
As-was reporting applied: regions and hierarchies as they existed on each transaction date
caveats: VAT rates varied by product category (standard 24% in August, 25.5% from 1 September 2024; reduced rates 14% and 10% throughout)
The request spans two calendar months but crosses three fiscal periods (FY2024/25 P04, P05, P06) and is not aligned to fiscal week boundaries
Web sales (store 900) are excluded; these figures cover physical store sales only

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' GROUP BY s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Interior Paint defined as product subcategory (123 SKU variants aggregated)
Lahti store identified as store_id 108
Sales quantity from fact_sales_line includes all transactions (members and non-members)
assumptions: Interpreted 'this year' as FY2026/27 (the current fiscal year as of request date 2026-10-05)
Aggregated all Interior Paint product variants in the subcategory rather than reporting individual SKUs
Included staff purchases in unit count; they are recorded in fact_sales_line as sales transactions
Counted units sold gross (not net of returns)
caveats: Period 3 is fully complete in the warehouse (ends before request date of 2026-10-05)
5 units of Interior Paint were returned during period 3; this figure reports units sold at transaction time, not net of subsequent returns
Staff purchases account for 3 transaction lines within the 194 units; isolated separately if a staff-only analysis is needed

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
)
SELECT s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY atv DESC;
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value) is net sales before returns divided by the number of sales receipts
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop and training store excluded
Staff purchases excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
assumptions: Period 4 of FY2026/27 spans fiscal weeks 14-17 (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30)
Store format reflects the version on the sale date
Results ordered by ATV descending for readability
caveats: Store format values in the warehouse are 'Large', 'Medium', and 'Small', not the 'Hyper', 'Standard', 'Express' values documented in the schema
Period 4 is completely loaded in the warehouse as of 2026-10-04

answer.sql: WITH as_of AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, r.period_end_date AS as_of_end FROM dim_date d JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON r.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year AND r.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 8), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN as_of WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end) SELECT as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN as_of JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with and including the as-of week, in any channel
Count distinct member_id (not member_key)
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Trailing 52 weeks as sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday
Fiscal calendar: period end date from ref_fiscal_calendar
Helsinki business dates (sale_date)
Web guest orders have no member key and so are not counted
assumptions: Request was received 7 October 2026, in FY2026/27, so 'last year' is read as the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26, as past accepted requests did
'End of period 8' is the as-of date: Sunday 21 December 2025, the last day of FY2025/26 P08
Trailing 52-week window runs 23 December 2024 to 21 December 2025
Tiers are shown as three rows (Basic, Silver, Gold) with no total row, since only a breakdown by tier was requested
Member tier is the tier as it stood on 21 December 2025, not the member's current tier
caveats: No data problems found that needed correcting: the 52-week window has complete sales for all 364 days, every active member has exactly one dim_member version valid on 21 December 2025, there are no orphan member keys or duplicate sales lines, and no active member's purchases are only in store 999, test articles or cancelled web orders (so excluding them would not change the counts)
The three tiers sum to 29,526 active members; this total was not requested and is not shown in the table
If Sanna meant FY2026/27 P08, that period has not happened yet (the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026), so FY2025/26 is the only reading that gives an answer
Tiers are as at 21 December 2025; many members will have since changed tier, so these counts will not match a current-tier breakdown

answer.sql:
WITH stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsw.closing_units) AS total_closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  sp.category,
  ROUND(CAST(sc.total_closing_units AS DECIMAL) / (CAST(sp.total_units_sold AS DECIMAL) / 4), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM sales_in_period sp
LEFT JOIN stock_at_period_end sc ON sp.category = sc.category
ORDER BY sp.category
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover formula: closing inventory units divided by average weekly sales volume
Last period: most recent complete fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, ending 2026-09-27)
Average weekly sales: total units sold in period divided by weeks in period
Fiscal period span: 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, four weeks
assumptions: Last period interpreted as the most recent complete fiscal period in the warehouse
Weeks of cover calculated using closing inventory at period end and average weekly sales during the period
Sales velocity assumed constant throughout period for cover calculation
All product categories except ZZ Test (test data) included in the analysis
Stock snapshot date matches fiscal period end date (2026-09-27)
caveats: ZZ Test category excluded as a non-operational test category
Weeks of cover is a point-in-time metric and does not reflect intra-period fluctuations or seasonal demand patterns
Cover calculation assumes linear demand; actual inventory cover may vary with sales velocity changes
All 10 active product categories have both sales and closing inventory data; no categories excluded due to missing data

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN params p WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end) SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN params p JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND p.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with and including the as-of week, in any channel
Trailing window as sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday (accepted pattern of REQ-D29 and REQ-D30)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key, so members with several versions are counted once
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 8 is weeks 31 to 34, 24 Nov 2025 to 21 Dec 2025
Sales lines linked to a member only, so guest web orders are not counted
Store 999 and category ZZ Test checked: no active member's purchases touch them, so no filter changed the figures
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 7 October 2026 (in FY2026/27) is read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just ended, as past requests since May 2026 did. The period is therefore FY2025/26 P08
'End of period 8' is the last day of the period, Sunday 21 December 2025, and the window runs 23 December 2024 to 21 December 2025
Tier is as it stood on 21 December 2025 (as-of date), not the member's current tier
No total row given because the request asked for active members by tier only
caveats: Members who bought only as web guests have no member key and cannot be counted as members

Checked for problems and found none: every member has exactly one dim_member version valid on 21 December 2025, there are no duplicate sales line ids in the window, no cancelled web orders among member lines, and the sum of the tiers (29,526) equals the distinct active members
If 'last year' meant calendar year 2025 or FY2026/27 P08 (not yet reached), the answer would differ

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
quarterly AS (
    -- as-is: region from the current store version (Online = the web shop, its own line)
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS q3_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS q3_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM quarterly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN quarterly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region;
definitions_applied: Net sales on company definition: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Sales exclusions: store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test (test articles) removed
Web sales recognition: on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Returns timing: booked on return date, not sale date
Region hierarchy: as-is (current version)
Fiscal period: Q3 = fiscal weeks 27-39
assumptions: Q3 last year = FY2025/26 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27-39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026)
Q3 the year before = FY2024/25 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27-39, 28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025)
Web shop included as separate 'Online' region (store_id 900)

caveats: Capital Region was created on 28 April 2025 (start of FY2025/26); its prior-year FY2024/25 data was historically part of the South region. The numbers for Capital Region in FY2024/25 reflect only its post-establishment portion.
