answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), q3 AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ty.region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region

Web identified by store 900, not by channel_code
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year just completed; the request is dated 6 Oct 2026 in FY2026/27), so Q3 last year is FY2025/26 Q3 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), consistent with how past requests read 'last year'. The year before is FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025).
Regions reported as-is (current hierarchy) because the request did not ask for as-was; this restates last-year-before figures on the five-region structure.

Regional figures are as-is. Region changes since April 2025 move some stores: the Capital Region (Vantaa/Helsinki/Espoo/Kerava stores formerly South) and Kouvola (formerly East, now South) are restated back to FY2024/25. As-was, the Capital Region would not exist for FY2024/25. Older reports on the four old regions will not match.

Growth is not like-for-like. Online growth of 29.7% is large. The figures match the control table and no duplicate lines were found, but the 3 Nov 2025 web-platform migration falls within the quarter and I did not investigate the cause of the increase.

Checks run: no duplicate sales line ids or receipt/line pairs in either quarter, and every region's net sales agree exactly with the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for the same quarters, with the same store counts (Capital Region 5, East 8, North 6, South 10, West 10, Online 1).

Store identified by store_id 102 (Helsinki Pitäjänmäki), joining all store versions through dim_store.store_key

Period 5 is read as fiscal period 5 (P05) of FY2026/27, not calendar month 5

No planned refit closure for store 102 and no non-trading days fall in the period, so the period is a full four weeks of trading.
The period is fully loaded and no duplicate sales lines were found. The staging table stg_sales_line_load only holds 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 and does not touch this period.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, MIN(d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS week_start, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.week_start AS week_start_this_year, ly.week_start AS week_start_last_year, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Prior-year comparison lined up by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Fiscal weeks run Monday to Sunday; FY2026/27 P2 is weeks 5-8 and FY2025/26 P2 is weeks 5-8
Growth % = this year / last year - 1
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Request received 7 Oct 2026, so 'this year' is the current fiscal year FY2026/27 and 'period 2' is FY2026/27 P2 (1 to 28 June 2026, weeks 5-8), which is fully loaded.
'Last year' is the same fiscal weeks of FY2025/26 P2 (26 May to 22 June 2025), the prior-year comparator the fiscal calendar skill gives.
Neither period contains week 53, so no weeks were dropped from the comparison.
'Total company' includes web, as in the accepted total-company request REQ-D03.
Figures are excluding VAT, the company net sales definition.
caveats: Weeks 7 and 8 are distorted by Midsummer timing. Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (stores shut by company rule) fall in FY2026/27 week 7 (19-20 June 2026) but in FY2025/26 week 8 (20-21 June 2025). Week 7 growth of -32.2% and week 8 growth of +76.4% therefore compare a shut-holiday week with a normal one. The week-aligned fiscal comparison is the company convention and is what is shown, not corrected.
The distortion cancels over the period: P2 total net sales are 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70 last year, +8.3%. This total is not in the table because the request asked for weeks.

Store count changed within the periods. Last year 39 stores traded every normal day. This year 38 traded in weeks 5-6 and 37 in weeks 7-8. Kuopio (store 125) is on a refit closure from 15 June 2026 to 26 July 2026. The other reduction is a store that closed before June 2026; I did not identify it. Both are in the totals as they happened, with no like-for-like adjustment, so growth is not LFL.
Web net sales on Monday 22 June 2026 were unusually high (34.5k against a typical 7-16k). This is dispatch catch-up after the Midsummer shutdown and lifts week 8.
Midsummer days show small negative net sales (returns booked on closed days) and are included.

The filter excluding store 999 and ZZ Test removes 34,148.89 EUR of net sales from the whole range 26 May 2025 to 28 Jun 2026, which spans both periods plus the weeks between them. The per-period effect was not calculated.
Checks run: no duplicate sales lines, return lines or web orders in the range. Every web line matches a dispatched order. Weekly totals match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (gap 0.00 in all 8 weeks).
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used because they omit web sales after 3 November 2025.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week),
range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week),
weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
         (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
         AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
  FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.stores AS lfl_stores, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period versus the same fiscal weeks last year, matched week by week
Fiscal calendar: period 4 = fiscal weeks 14-17 (3-30 Aug 2026 vs 28 Jul-24 Aug 2025), aligned by fiscal week number, not calendar date
LFL base: physical stores only (store_id < 900), web shop excluded, open at least 364 days before the first day of the period
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that week in both years (open, not closed, no refit in ref_store_closure)
Week 53 never LFL (not in P4 anyway)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT after returns, returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Control total: store sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
As-is: current dim_store version for store attributes
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as FY2026/27 P4 (the most recent completed P4 as of 5 Oct 2026), compared with FY2025/26 P4
The request asks for one overall figure, so no regional or store breakdown is given
Growth is reported as a percentage of net sales excluding VAT
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, so it has no sales this year and is dropped from the LFL base for P4. About 9,549 EUR of its P4 sales last year is therefore left out of the comparison.

No other LFL exclusions applied in P4: the refits at Tammisto (2024), Pori (Sep-Oct 2025) and Kuopio (Jun-Jul 2026) all fall outside weeks 14-17 in both years. Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) had been open over 52 weeks, so both are in. The base is 38 physical stores.

Store sales before returns for the physical stores match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in both years. The sales lines showed no duplicate keys, and this year's LFL net sales equal the control net sales exactly. Last year's differ only by the Savonlinna exclusion.
Overall LFL is flat (-0.03%). Regions diverge: North +6.53%, Capital Region +2.79%, South -0.71%, West -1.65%, East -3.13%. These were not asked for and are not in the table.

answer.sql: WITH wk AS (SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')), sales AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2), returns AS (SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN wk w ON w.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2), net AS (SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, round(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, round(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, round((ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct FROM net ty JOIN net ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar: period 2 is 4 weeks, fiscal weeks 5 to 8. FY2026/27 P02 runs 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28. FY2025/26 P02 runs 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22.
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on return lines, as in the company's rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales column.
Returns are counted in the week they were booked (return_date), not the week of the original sale. This matches the 'refunds booked on the day' wording in rpt_daily_store_sales.
Total company = all physical stores plus the web shop (store_id 900). The training store (store_id 999) is excluded.

Stores and web are identified through store_key joined to dim_store (store_id), not through channel_code. channel_code is blank from the web-platform migration onward, so it cannot be used for this year.
Growth % = this year / last year - 1, comparing the same fiscal week number and period.
assumptions: 'This year' is FY2026/27 and 'last year' is FY2025/26, given the request date of 2026-10-05. Both P02s are marked fully_loaded.

'Sales' means net sales after returns, excluding VAT, because that is the company's net sales measure. Before returns, the four weeks would be higher by roughly 17,000 to 25,000 EUR each. Gross sales including VAT were not used.
Total company sales includes the web shop, as 'total company' implies. Web is a large part of the total (about 55,000 to 71,000 EUR a week this year, against 42,000 to 49,000 last year).

Staff purchases are kept in. The company's own daily store report includes them (its store figures match the fact table exactly with staff purchases included) and no rule excludes them. They are about 1% of sales and do not change the picture. Excluding them would lower both years slightly.
Weeks are compared by fiscal week number (5 to 8 against 5 to 8). This is not the same calendar dates a year earlier. Fiscal weeks start 6 days later this year because FY2025/26 was a 53-week year.
The request asks for total sales, so I did not adjust for stores that opened, closed or were refitted. The effect of those is given in caveats instead.
caveats: Midsummer shifts between weeks and drives the two outlying growth figures. Midsummer Eve and Day (stores shut by law) fell in fiscal week 8 last year (20 and 21 June 2025). This year they fell in fiscal week 7 (19 and 20 June 2026). So week 7 shows -26.5% and week 8 shows +54.4%. Neither is a real trend. Weeks 7 and 8 combined are 586,868 against 551,168, or +6.5%. The whole period is 1,295,948 against 1,210,936, or +7.0%. Weeks 5 and 6 (+5.4%, +9.5%) are the cleaner comparisons.

Two stores sell less this year than last, for reasons other than demand. Savonlinna (store 129) closed permanently on 2026-01-25. It had about 10,240 EUR of sales across these four weeks last year and none this year. Kuopio (store 125) is closed for a refit from 2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26, which covers weeks 7 and 8. It sold about 19,350 EUR in those two weeks last year and nothing this year. Growth is therefore understated against a like-for-like set of stores.

Correction made: the training store (store 999) is excluded. It records small sales of a few hundred EUR a week, and returns none. It is not a trading store, and the company's daily report leaves it out.

Correction made: the view rpt.v_daily_sales and the views built on it filter web sales on channel_code = 'WB'. That code is blank from the web-platform migration onward, so those views would drop all web sales for this year and understate the growth. I did not use them.

The web figures in rpt_daily_store_sales do not agree with the fact table. answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT d.fiscal_year, fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM first_version fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the store where they enrolled)
Members counted by distinct member_id (one per member, not per version)
Online sign-ups sit under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
Fiscal year from dim_date (FY2025/26 runs 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks)
Store names shown as-is (current store version)

Stores are listed by the store where the member enrolled, not the member's current home store, so later home-store changes do not move anyone.
The web shop (store 900) is shown as its own row, as requested for online sign-ups.

Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in autumn 2024 and traded for the whole of FY2025/26, so their counts are comparable with other stores.

Pori (119) was shut for a refit from 8 September to 12 October 2025 but still shows 24 sign-ups in that window (probably at the web shop's or a member-service point), so it is not a full-year count of store-open sign-ups. This could not be explained from the warehouse and is left in the figure.

definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27 is 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Store identified by stable store_id (107), not by store_key version
Product hierarchy: Cleaning Products is the subcategory under category Cleaning & Household; product version joined via product_key as it stood at sale date
Units sold = sum of fact_sales_line.quantity
In-store channel (channel_id 1, Store); no web lines exist for this store and product set in the period
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27, since the request is dated 2026-10-05, and 'period 5' as the company's fiscal period 5 rather than calendar month 5

Store 107 has no closures in ref_store_closure during the period

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')) SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (not the order date)
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders count)
Click-and-collect counted as web
Including VAT: sum of gross_amount on the sales lines, each at its own VAT rate
Before returns: no refunds deducted
Test articles (category ZZ Test) and store 999 excluded
Helsinki time for date conversion from UTC timestamps
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 P4 29 Jul to 25 Aug 2024, P5 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024, P6 23 Sep to 27 Oct 2024
assumptions: Q2 with no year, in a request received 6 October 2026, is read as FY2024/25 Q2 because the request names FY24/25 explicitly (periods 4 to 6).
Figures are in EUR and include staff purchases, as in the company net sales definition.
Orders are placed in a period by dispatch date; for click-and-collect this is the ready-for-collection date.
Returns are not deducted, as requested. Refunds were not shown as a separate column because the request asked only for sales before returns.
caveats: Corrected: 2 test-article web lines (category ZZ Test) were removed, worth EUR 8.06 gross in P4 and EUR 3.77 gross in P5.

Not used: rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales. They are built on channel_code, which stops being filled after the 3 November 2025 platform migration. This does not affect the FY2024/25 dates asked for, but the views are unreliable for later periods.

The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls inside P5. Gross amounts carry the rate of each line, so the P5 figure mixes both rates correctly. A flat rate applied to net sales would be wrong.

Checks: no duplicate sales lines at sales_line_id or (receipt_id, line_no). The line gross totals matched order_total_gross on every non-cancelled order in range. The net equivalent of these lines (126,242.65 / 122,660.57 / 153,786.32 for P4 / P5 / P6) matches net_sales_before_returns for store 900 in rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. The 257 cancelled orders in the range have no sales lines and are not included.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 3 = fiscal weeks 9 to 13, 29 June to 2 August 2026, taken from dim_date
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date), the same basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
Store scope: physical store 108 Lahti only; web shop (900) is not part of a store figure
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (no effect on this figure)
Versioned dimensions: sku and store joined on natural keys with is_current / version keys, no row multiplication
As-is product hierarchy: current product version decides the subcategory (Interior Paint, category Paint & Decorating)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
assumptions: Period 3 of FY26/27 read as FY2026/27 P03, the fiscal year named in the request; it is complete in the warehouse (loaded through 4 October 2026)
Interior Paint read as the dim_product subcategory 'Interior Paint' (category Paint & Decorating); Exterior Paint, Brushes & Rollers and Wallpaper are not included
Units sold read as units sold at the till, before returns, since the metric dictionary has no definition of net units and the warehouse's own units_sold control measure is gross of returns
Lahti read as store_id 108 (city Lahti, region South); Tampere Lielahti is a different store
caveats: The metric dictionary does not define 'units sold'. I used units before returns; 5 units of Interior Paint were returned at Lahti in the same period (returns dated in P3), so net of returns the figure would be 189.
Included in the 194 are 4 units from staff purchases (staff purchases count in sales under the company definition).

Control check: Lahti total units for all products in P3 (3,927) agrees exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold for the same 35 days; no duplicate receipt lines were found (142 lines, 142 distinct receipt_id + line_no).
Two Interior Paint articles (SKUs 100963 and 101047) have two product versions, both in Interior Paint, so the classification is stable and no correction was needed.
No data problem needed correcting for this request.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2;
definitions_applied: DEF-WEB-RECOGNITION: Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
DEF-NET-SALES: Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
DEF-CLICK-COLLECT: Click-and-collect counted as part of web sales, identified by fulfilment_type
REG-STORE-900: Web shop identified as store 900
REG-RETURN-LAG: Returns booked on return date, matched to original order via sales_line_id
REG-MIGRATION: Platform migration 3 Nov 2025; fulfilment_type used consistently across migration
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year prior to current FY2026/27), following accepted practice for relative-date requests made during FY2026/27
Web shop sales refers to net sales excluding VAT
Only delivered and collected orders included; cancelled and processing orders excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded from share calculations
caveats: None: requested period FY2025/26 P6-P8 is fully loaded in the warehouse (through 2025-12-21)

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (channel_code is not filled from the 3 November 2025 migration)
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, not the original sale date
Click-and-collect counted as web
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (they have no sales lines and are not web sales)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Helsinki time for day boundaries (CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE))
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales not used (deprecated)
assumptions: 'Daily web sales (net)' read as the company definition of net sales: excluding VAT and after returns, with returns booked on the day they were processed to the web shop.
'From 15 to 23 December 2025' read as inclusive of both end dates, nine days, using Helsinki business dates.
The year was stated as 2025, so no relative-year reading was needed.
All figures are in EUR.
caveats: No data problems found in this range. There are no duplicate keys in the sales, return or web-order tables, no delivered or collected orders without a dispatch time, and no web lines without an order. All nine days match the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 to the cent.

21 December is low (611.75) because very few orders were dispatched on that Sunday (18 orders, against 200 to 280 on weekdays). Net returns of 833.90 booked that day also outweigh the dispatches. This is the data as recorded, not an error. 14 December, the previous Sunday, shows the same pattern.

Returns are booked where they are processed. Web orders returned in a physical store (3 to 11 return lines per day in this window) reduce that store's net sales, not web, so they are not deducted here. This follows the company definition and the control total.

Orders placed on 22 and 23 December but not yet dispatched by 23 December fall on later dispatch dates, and returns on these days can relate to earlier sales. The figures therefore do not equal the value of orders placed that day.
Without the return deduction, the figures would be 11714.52, 10967.03, 15214.54, 12189.13, 10258.50, 11379.59, 1445.65, 15720.91 and 11674.00 for the nine days in order.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5), cat AS (SELECT sku, category AS cat_name FROM dim_product, per WHERE per.period_end_date BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to), stock AS (SELECT p.category AS cat_name, sum(w.closing_value) s_val FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key, per WHERE w.week_ending_date = per.period_end_date GROUP BY 1), sales AS (SELECT c.cat_name, sum(f.standard_cost) sold_cogs FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1), rets AS (SELECT c.cat_name, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) ret_cogs FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key, per WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, st.cat_name AS category, round(st.s_val / ((sa.sold_cogs - COALESCE(re.ret_cogs,0)) / per.weeks_in_period), 1) AS weeks_of_cover FROM stock st JOIN sales sa USING(cat_name) LEFT JOIN rets re USING(cat_name), per WHERE st.cat_name <> 'ZZ Test' ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: last period = last fully loaded fiscal period (ref_fiscal_calendar.fully_loaded), FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026
Closing stock = fact_stock_week closing_value (standard cost) at week ending 2026-09-27, the last day of the period
Weeks of cover = closing stock at standard cost divided by average weekly cost of sales over the period (4 weeks)
Cost of sales = sales-line standard_cost less standard_cost_returned on returns in the period
Category taken from the dim_product version valid at the period end date
Training store (999) and test category 'ZZ Test' excluded
Web shop sales (store 900) included as demand
assumptions: 'Last period' means FY2026/27 P05 (ended 2026-09-27), as P06 is in progress and not fully loaded on the request date of 2026-10-07

Cover is measured on a cost basis, not units, because a category's units mix very different item values; a unit-based cover gives different figures (for example Tools & Hardware 6.7 weeks, Seasonal 37.4, Furniture 25.0)
Demand is the actual average of the four weeks of the period, not a forecast, and takes no account of seasonality
Returns are treated as reducing demand (returned goods go back into stock)
Web orders draw on store stock, since there is no stock held under the web shop; staff purchases are counted as demand
Cover is for all stores combined, per category; no store or region breakdown was requested
caveats: 65 outdoor-lighting SKUs and others were moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27; each SKU is placed in its category as at the period end for both stock and sales, so the stock and the sales sit in the same category (using the category stamped on each sales line would have put old sales under the old category)
The 'ZZ Test' category (12 SKUs, with some test sales lines in the period) was excluded; the training store 999 was excluded
Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no stock rows at period end, so it does not affect the result
The backup, staging, tmp and old tables in the warehouse were not used

Seasonal (30.3 weeks) and Garden (26.4) have high cover because September is outside their selling season; the average of the last four weeks understates their peak demand, so the true cover on a seasonal forecast would differ
Cover figures are sensitive to the choice of method (cost vs units, with or without returns); the cost basis net of returns is the one reported

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 3 of FY2026/27, 29 June to 2 August 2026, five weeks (weeks 9 to 13), fully loaded
Units sold means quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (the same basis as units_sold in rpt_daily_store_sales), so before returns
Store-level figure checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for 29 June to 2 August 2026: 3,927 units and 1,048 receipts in both, so the control total agrees
As-is product hierarchy: subcategory read from the current dim_product version, joined by sku and is_current
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither changes this figure)
Natural key store_id 108 used; the fact's store_key was matched to the store version valid on the sale date
Staff purchases included, as for net sales (4 of the 194 units were staff purchases)
Not used: rpt.v_daily_sales, the stg_, bak_ and tmp_ tables, the _old dimensions, or channel_code
assumptions: 'Period 3 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P3 (29 June to 2 August 2026), because the request is dated 5 October 2026 and the current fiscal year is FY2026/27. P3 is complete and fully loaded

'Interior Paint' is read as the subcategory Interior Paint (category Paint & Decorating), covering 33 SKUs sold at Lahti in the period. The subcategory is unchanged across all product versions, so as-is and as-was give the same answer
'Lahti store' is store_id 108 (city Lahti, region South, format Large). The name search also matched Tampere Lielahti (store 116), which is a different store and was left out
'Units sold' is read as units on sales lines, before returns. This is the units_sold basis the warehouse uses. All 142 lines are in-store, because store 108 is a physical store
caveats: No data problems found. Sales lines for this store, subcategory and period have no duplicate lines (142 lines, 142 distinct receipt and line number pairs), and no zero or negative quantities

Returns: 5 units of Interior Paint were refunded at Lahti by return date inside P3, and 6 units were returned from lines sold in P3 whenever they came back. Net of the 5 units refunded in the period, the figure would be 189. The 194 is units sold before returns, as the request says 'sold'
Staff purchases are included in the 194 (4 units). Excluding them would give 190

The figure covers sales dated 29 June to 2 August 2026, all inside the data loaded through 4 October 2026. Returns on P3 sales can arrive up to 30 days later, so the 6-unit sale-cohort return figure is complete only for lines sold before about 4 September

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-05-26' AS start_date, DATE '2025-06-22' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)

                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)

),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,

definitions_applied: DEF-STORE-LEAGUE: ranking by net sales per trading day
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: physical stores only (store_id < 900)

364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region) SELECT ty.region, params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year ORDER BY ty.region

Week 53 never LFL (not in range anyway)
Regions as-is (current dim_store version, five regions including Capital Region)
Staff purchases included
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales

Regions as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, as the request did not ask for as-was

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END AS per, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') UNION ALL SELECT s.store_id, CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'c' ELSE 'p' END, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')), per_store AS (SELECT store_id, sum(CASE WHEN per = 'c' THEN amt END) AS cur_net, sum(CASE WHEN per = 'p' THEN amt END) AS prior_net FROM lines GROUP BY store_id) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round((sum(cur_net) / sum(prior_net) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM per_store WHERE cur_net IS NOT NULL AND prior_net IS NOT NULL

Net sales = net_amount excluding VAT, after line discounts, less returns (refund_net by return date and return store), the same basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales

Like-for-like store set = physical stores (store_id below 900) that traded in both periods; stores identified by store_id so slowly changing dim_store versions (including the April 2025 region re-mapping) do not split a store
Web shop (store_id 900, channel_id 2 and 3) and the Training store (999) excluded
Staff purchases kept in, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Sales channel identified by channel_id, because channel_code is NULL on current-year lines
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (request dated 2026-10-07); period 4 compared with period 4 of the prior fiscal year
'Like-for-like' read as store-only growth in net sales (excluding VAT, net of returns) for stores trading in both periods; online sales are excluded from like-for-like
No written like-for-like rule was available to me, so a store counts as like-for-like if it traded throughout both periods; 38 stores qualify
Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2024-09-02) and Lohja (opened 2024-11-04) are included because they traded for all of both periods, although they were under 12 months old in the 2025 base period
Kuopio is included: its refit closure ended 2026-07-26, a week before P04 started, and Pori's and Vantaa Tammisto's refits fall outside both periods
Growth is the ratio of summed net sales over the 38 stores, not an average of store growth rates
sale_date and return_date are used as the business date; about 0.6% of lines differ from the UTC date, which I took to be local time
caveats: Corrections made: channel_code is NULL on all current-year lines (channel_id is used instead), so a filter on channel_code = 'ST' would have dropped the whole current year
Savonlinna (129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has 9,913.31 EUR of gross sales in P04 2025 and none in P04 2026. It is excluded; keeping it in the base would give -0.96%

Web sales are not in the figure. They moved from 167,225 EUR (home delivery and orders) to 209,106 EUR (home delivery plus click-and-collect, a channel that did not appear in the prior-year lines), so the figure should not be read as total company growth

Format values in dim_store (Medium, Large, Small) do not match the documented Hyper, Standard and Express, and the region values changed on 2025-04-28 (for example South to Capital Region). Neither affects this store-level total, but a regional breakdown would need care

The temporary tables tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and 2025 (37 stores, excluding stores 136 and 137) were not used because they are unowned working tables and still include Savonlinna, so I applied the rule above to the sales data directly
Check queries showed no duplicate sales lines and 28 trading days in every store for both periods; the figures agree with rpt_daily_store_sales store by store

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), lines AS (SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31'), 2) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat, ROUND(SUM(gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'), 2) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT = sum of gross_amount on the sales lines (each line carries its own VAT rate)
Before returns: fact_return_line is not used and no refunds are deducted
As-was regions: region taken from the dim_store version on the line's store_key, valid on the transaction date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, for delivered and collected orders only
Store sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Calendar months: August = 1-31 Aug 2024, September = 1-30 Sep 2024
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own region, Online
Request's explicit gross-instead-of-net and as-was choices followed over the company defaults (net, as-is)
assumptions: August and September 2024 are read as calendar months, because this is a VAT filing, not as fiscal periods (the fiscal year FY2024/25 started 29 April 2024)
Web sales are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (the company web recognition rule) rather than the order date, which moves a few web orders across the month boundary
Online (web shop) is included as its own row because web sales are part of the VAT base and Online is its own region in the as-was hierarchy
There is no Capital Region row because it did not exist before 28 April 2025; the five stores later moved into it (101-105) were in South at the time, and Kouvola (114) was in East
Staff purchases are included, as in the company sales definition
No total row was added because none was asked for
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024. August lines carry 24% and September lines 25.5%, as recorded on each line; the figures are summed from the line gross_amount and not recalculated with one flat rate. The reduced rates (14%, 10%) did not change.

Web lines are dated by dispatch, so a web order placed on 31 August and dispatched in September counts in September (and carries the 24% rate its line was booked at). If the filing needs web sales on the order date, the web figures would differ slightly.
Cancelled or still-processing web orders are not counted, since they have no dispatch. None appeared among the web lines I checked for these months.
Store 999 and test-article lines were excluded. In Aug-Sep 2024 these were about 4,282 EUR and 3,352 EUR gross in store 999 alone.
Returns are not deducted, as asked. The refund_gross on returns is not shown. If the filing needs credit notes netted off, that is a separate figure.

Check against the control table: net sales before returns by store and month, built the same way, matched rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for every store and both months (no differences above 0.50 EUR). I found no duplicate sales lines and no gross/net/VAT inconsistencies in the period.
The two dated-event checks I made showed no problem: all store versions used cover the sale dates, and no store was on a Capital Region version in these months.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')) SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_incl_vat FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (they have no sales lines or dispatch)
Including VAT: sum of gross_amount from the lines, using each line's own VAT rate
Before returns: no refunds deducted
Category ZZ Test excluded, store 999 excluded
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 P4 = 29 Jul to 25 Aug 2024, P5 = 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024, P6 = 23 Sep to 27 Oct 2024 (5 weeks)
Control total against rpt_daily_store_sales (store 900, net_sales_before_returns)
assumptions: Q2 of FY24/25 read as FY2024/25 Q2, fiscal periods 4 to 6, as the request states the periods
Web sales taken as all web shop lines including click-and-collect, since click-and-collect counts as web
Figures are for the web shop as a whole (store 900), one figure per period, with no breakdown

Figures include VAT at each line's own rate. The general rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, so the standard rate is 24% for part of P5 (before 1 September) and 25.5% afterwards. The reduced rates (14%, 10%) were unchanged. Line gross amounts match net x (1 + VAT rate) for every web line checked.
Dating is by Helsinki dispatch date, so an order placed late in one period and dispatched in the next counts in the later period.

Checks that passed: the net equivalents (126,242.65, 122,660.57 and 153,786.32 EUR) agree exactly with net_sales_before_returns for store 900 in rpt_daily_store_sales. answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY atv DESC;
definitions_applied: ATV: net sales before returns divided by number of sales receipts
Store measure: physical stores only, staff purchases excluded, test articles excluded
Fiscal period and calendar dates from dim_date
assumptions: Period 4 this year interpreted as FY2026/27 P04 (current fiscal year as of request date 2026-10-06)
Store format reported as-is (current dimension version)
caveats: Warehouse schema comment indicates format values should be Hyper/Standard/Express, but actual warehouse contains Large/Medium/Small values
Web shop (store 900) excluded per ATV definition; store 999 (training) excluded per policy
Staff purchases excluded from ATV per company definition

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_net_sales_pct FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales = fact_sales_line rows with channel_id 2 (web home delivery) or 3 (click and collect), i.e. the web shop store 900. channel_code is NULL in this date range, so it is not used.
Sales value = net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts).
Loyalty member sale = the web order has a member_key (logged-in order). Guest orders count as non-member.
Period assigned by sale_date, which is the local business date.
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26. The request is dated 2026-10-09, which falls in FY2026/27, and the fiscal year starts in late April or May.
'Periods 9 to 11' are fiscal periods 9, 10 and 11 of that year, reported as three separate rows.
'Share of web sales' is the value share (member net sales divided by total web net sales), not an order count or line count share.
Web sales are shown before returns, and cancelled orders are not an issue. Every web line in the range belongs to a delivered or collected order.
Both web fulfilment types, home delivery and click and collect, are included as web.
caveats: Correction applied: 1,309 web sales lines (EUR 37,981 net) have a NULL member_key on fact_sales_line even though their web order is logged_in with a member_key on fact_web_order. These lines were loaded between 2026-02-10 and 2026-03-02 and fall mostly in P10 and P11. I took membership from fact_web_order.member_key. Using the line-level member_key, as a plain query would, understates the member share: P10 would show 48.9% instead of 67.3%, and P11 58.7% instead of 67.1%. P9 is unaffected at 67.4%.

After the correction the share is stable at about 67% in all three periods. Where both keys exist they never disagree, and every order-level member_key exists in dim_member and was valid on the sale date.
The source of the missing line-level member keys is an ETL gap, which should be fixed in fact_sales_line. I did not trace the cause.
I did not net out web returns from fact_return_line, so the figures are shares of sales before returns.
Shares are rounded to one decimal place.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_gross_sales_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales = fact_sales_line rows with channel_code 'WB' (home delivery and click-and-collect, all booked to the web shop, store_id 900)
Gross sales = gross_amount, which includes VAT
Before returns: fact_return_line not netted off
Fiscal period from dim_date.fiscal_period on sale_date (dim_date agrees with ref_fiscal_calendar)
Q2 of FY2024/25 = fiscal periods 4 to 6, 2024-07-29 to 2024-10-27
Cancelled web orders excluded (they have no sales lines)
Training store (store_id 999) excluded; it has store-channel sales only and none on the web channel
assumptions: 'Web sales' means both web fulfilment types, home delivery and click-and-collect (dim_channel group 'web'), not home delivery alone.
'Q2 of FY24/25' means fiscal year FY2024/25, which started 2024-04-29, not calendar 2024 or 2025.
'Including VAT' means gross_amount as recorded on each line, at the VAT rate in force on the sale date.
Staff purchases are included. There are none on the web channel in this window, so this changes nothing.

I checked these in the warehouse and found no problems: duplicate sales lines, gaps in daily web sales, VAT arithmetic (gross matches net times (1 + VAT rate) on every line), sale_date against the Helsinki-local timestamp, and web order totals against line totals (6,644 orders, EUR 499,578.73 in both).

The Finnish standard VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 2024-09-01. Period 4 and the first week of period 5 are at 24%, the rest at 25.5%. Gross amounts are as booked, so the rate change is in the figures. Do not read the period 4 to period 6 movement as volume alone.
Period 6 has 5 weeks (35 days) against 4 weeks (28 days) for periods 4 and 5, which explains much of its higher figure. Compare per-week figures, not raw period totals.
All three periods are flagged fully_loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar.
Returns are not deducted, as requested. These are gross sales before refunds, so they are not net sales.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS first_period, 4 AS last_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY format;
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value): net sales before returns divided by the number of sales receipts, excluding staff purchases from receipt count
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900)
Exclusions: test articles (category ZZ Test), web shop (store 900), training store (999), staff purchase flag
assumptions: Period 4 of FY2026/27 interpreted as fiscal weeks 14-17 (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30) per fiscal-calendar definition
Store format is stable across store versions and reflects current category mapping (Large, Medium, Small)
caveats: Staff purchases included in net sales but excluded from receipt count per ATV definition
Control total validation (rpt_daily_store_sales) confirms zero gap for net_sales_before_returns
Period 4 is complete as of warehouse load date (2026-10-04)

answer.sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS sales_net_amount,
    SUM(fsl.standard_cost) AS sales_standard_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS returns_refund_net,
    SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned) AS returns_standard_cost
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
    AND dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.category,
    sd.sales_net_amount - COALESCE(rd.returns_refund_net, 0) AS net_sales,
    sd.sales_standard_cost - COALESCE(rd.returns_standard_cost, 0) AS net_cost
  FROM sales_data sd
  LEFT JOIN returns_data rd ON sd.category = rd.category
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
  ROUND((net_sales - net_cost) / net_sales * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM combined
ORDER BY category
definitions_applied: Net sales: sales net amount minus customer refunds, after line discounts and returns; excludes staff purchases
Gross margin percentage: (net sales minus standard cost of goods sold) divided by net sales, expressed as a percentage
Standard cost of goods sold: standard unit cost of units sold minus standard cost of units returned
Fiscal period 6: the period falling between 2025-09-22 and 2025-10-26 in the fiscal calendar
assumptions: Last year: fiscal year FY2025/26 (the most recent complete fiscal year relative to the request date 2026-10-08)
Period 6: fiscal period 6 within FY2025/26
Gross margin is calculated from standard cost, which is the company's standard costing method per dim_product
Staff purchases are excluded (staff_purchase_flag = FALSE) as they are typically non-comparable to retail sales
Returns are linked to original sales via sales_line_id with no orphan returns found
caveats: Gross margin uses standard cost, not actual cost. Actual cost may differ due to price variance, mix effects, or write-offs not reflected in standard cost.
The calculation includes all returns posted during period 6, regardless of the original sale date; most returns in period 6 likely relate to sales in earlier periods.
No stores were closed during period 6 that would exclude them from the category sales (no refits or planned closures in dim_store or ref_store_closure).

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, matched week by week
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
52-week (364-day) opening rule: store open on or before the first day of the period minus 364 days
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure from ref_store_closure)
Week 53 never counts in LFL (not relevant to P4, weeks 14 to 17)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT after returns, with returns booked on their return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2026/27 P4 is weeks 14 to 17 (3 to 30 Aug 2026), compared with FY2025/26 weeks 14 to 17 (28 Jul to 24 Aug 2025), aligned by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Store region and open/close dates taken from the current dim_store version (as-is)
Control total: store net sales for P4 checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P4, the fiscal year current on 7 October 2026. P4 is complete and fully loaded (the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026).
One total LFL figure is given, with no breakdown by region or store, because the request did not ask for one.
Growth is shown in percent to two decimals. Underlying net sales in the LFL base are EUR 1,010,478.52 this year and EUR 1,010,743.32 last year, so the result is essentially flat.
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales in P4 this year, so it is out of the LFL base. Its FY2025/26 P4 sales of EUR 9,549.14 are excluded from the comparator.

The LFL base is 38 stores, each with 4 comparable weeks (152 store-weeks). Both Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) are in the base, because both were open well over 364 days before 3 Aug 2026.

Kuopio (125) refit ran 15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026 and ended before P4 began, so no Kuopio weeks drop out in P4. Pori's refit (Sep to Oct 2025) and Tammisto's (2024) also fall outside the P4 weeks of both years.

Checks: sales lines have no duplicate keys in P4 either year. Store net sales in the data tie exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for P4 (EUR 1,010,478.52 this year, which equals the LFL base since only Savonlinna is out; EUR 1,020,292.46 last year including Savonlinna). Nothing needed correcting.
Not used, per the house rules: rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, and the bak_, stg_, tmp_ and _old tables.
Store-level swings are large in P4 (for example Mikkeli -26%, Lohja +25%) and are hidden in the near-zero total. I did not investigate causes.

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, (coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL) AS is_member FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)), refunds AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, -r.refund_net AS net_amount, (coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL) AS is_member FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)), all_lines AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds) SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN is_member THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_net_sales_pct FROM all_lines GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period ORDER BY fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: periods taken from dim_date / ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2025/26 P09 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026, P10 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026, P11 23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026)
Web channel = channel_id 2 (web home delivery) and 3 (click and collect), i.e. dim_channel.channel_group = 'web'; channel_code is null on these lines so it is not used
Net sales = line value excluding VAT (net_amount) after line discounts, less refunds (refund_net) booked in the period, the same net-of-returns basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales
Refunds are booked in the period of the return_date, not the original sale date
Loyalty member = a sale or refund line tied to a member; guest orders are the non-members
Share = member web net sales divided by all web net sales, in percent
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (request dated 9 Oct 2026, which falls in FY2026/27), and 'periods 9 to 11' are fiscal periods 9, 10 and 11 of that year
'Web sales' includes both web home delivery and click and collect orders

'Sales' means net sales after returns, excluding VAT. Staff purchases were not excluded (none exist on web lines in these periods) and no web orders were cancelled or still processing in these periods
A member's share is counted per fiscal period (period 9 has 5 weeks, 10 and 11 have 4), not cumulatively across the three periods
caveats: Correction: 1,309 web sales lines (about 10,946 + 27,035 EUR net) from logged-in orders placed between 10 Feb and 2 Mar 2026 have a null member_key on the sales line, though the web order itself carries the member. This sits in periods 10 and 11 and would understate the member share (raw lines give 48.9% in P10 and 58.7% in P11 before returns). I took the member from fact_web_order.member_key for those lines (coalesce of line and order member). Period 9 is unaffected.

Before returns, the corrected shares are 67.4% (P09), 67.3% (P10) and 67.1% (P11). The published figures are net of refunds, which lifts each by about 0.4 to 0.6 points because members return somewhat less than guests. If Marketing wants gross web sales before returns, use those figures.
rpt.v_daily_sales filters web on channel_code = 'WB', which is null on all lines in these periods, so that view (and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales) would miss web sales entirely here. I did not use it.
Refunds are attributed to the member status of the original sale, using the corrected member link. Web refunds were 25.5k, 19.4k and 19.6k EUR net in P09, P10 and P11.
Members here means anyone with a loyalty member link; I did not filter by tier, marketing consent or join date. Bak_, stg_, tmp_ and _old tables were ignored as non-authoritative.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))) SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank

answer.sql: SELECT round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT l.format, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

The cohort is complete. Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, and the last sale in the period is 22 June 2025, so the cohort has had more than a year to mature. The latest matching return is dated 23 July 2025.

Data checks found no problems: no duplicate sales lines or return lines, no returns without a sale, no refund above the sold value, no cancelled or processing web orders in the period, and no store changed format between versions.
