Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900: agrees exactly for all four periods (sales before returns, returns and net)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27), following the accepted readings of 12 to 27 May 2026 (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). Request dated 6 October 2026.
Periods 5 to 8 are FY2025/26 P05 to P08: 25 Aug 2025 to 21 Dec 2025. All four are fully loaded; P06 has 5 weeks, P05, P07 and P08 have 4 weeks each, so P06 is not comparable in size to the others.
Net means excluding VAT and after returns (company definition), shown per period with no total row since none was requested.
Figures are as-is; the web shop is a single pseudo-store (Online), so no regional or category hierarchy affects the result.
caveats: Test-article filter changed the total only trivially: one ZZ Test web line (EUR 5.50 net) in the Aug 2025 to Jan 2026 window was excluded. Store 999 is not part of the web shop.

Web returns processed in physical stores are booked to those stores under company rules and are not deducted from the web shop figures. They amount to about EUR 5,495 (P5), 4,784 (P6), 4,901 (P7) and 4,545 (P8) of net refunds on web-sold lines (111, 121, 125 and 144 return lines). If Finance wants web sales net of every refund on web-sold goods, subtract these amounts from the figures above.

The web platform migrated on 3 November 2025, which falls in P07: channel_code is empty after that date, so web was identified by store_id 900, which is consistent across the migration. The deprecated views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales would understate web sales from that date and were not used.
The migration date and the Black Friday week fall inside P07 and P08 respectively; no adjustments were made for them.

Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale, but net sales is dated on the return date, so the figures are not affected by returns still to come on late-period sales, though later periods will carry returns from these sales.

answer.sql: WITH tampere_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900) SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS tampere_loyalty_members FROM dim_member m JOIN tampere_stores t ON t.store_id = m.home_store_id WHERE m.is_current
definitions_applied: Customers read as loyalty members, counted by distinct member_id
Member current version (is_current) for home store
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900)
Web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Versioned dimensions: natural keys counted, not version rows
assumptions: The metric dictionary has no definition of 'customers'. Loyalty members are the only customers the warehouse can identify, so I read the question as loyalty members. I could not ask Jukka in the request queue.

'In Tampere' means the member's current home store is one of the four Tampere stores (115 Hervanta, 116 Lielahti, 117 Kaleva, 136 Lamminpää). It does not mean the member lives in Tampere, because the warehouse holds no member address.
The count is as of today, 8 October 2026, using each member's latest record. It includes members who have not bought recently, because no activity window was requested.
All members are counted regardless of tier or marketing consent.
caveats: dim_store gives city = Tampere to the web shop (store 900) and the training store (999) as well. I left them out. Counting them would have pulled in the 12,028 online sign-ups under 900.

Members who bought in Tampere stores but whose home store is elsewhere are not counted. 11,967 distinct members have bought in a Tampere store at some point, and 7,621 of them did so in the last 12 months. That is a much wider reading of 'customers in Tampere'. Say if you want it.
Non-members who shop in Tampere stores cannot be counted as people, because they have no identifier. The 7,175 is therefore not all customers.

Home store is where the member's current record says they are based. 340 members whose home store was once a Tampere store (7,515 ever, 7,175 now) have since moved to another home store and are not counted.
Of the 7,175 members, 4,341 have marketing consent. I have not applied this, but it matters if the count is for a mailing.
I made one correction: I excluded the web shop and training store, whose city is recorded as Tampere.

answer.sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(w.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = w.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE w.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), sold AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4wk FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, st.category, ROUND(st.closing_units / (so.units_4wk / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover FROM stock st JOIN sold so ON so.category = st.category ORDER BY st.category
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover: closing stock units at the end of the snapshot week divided by the average weekly units sold over the prior four fiscal weeks, for the same grouping
Last period = last completed fiscal period, FY2026/27 P05 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026), so the snapshot is the closing stock of fiscal week 21, Sunday 27 September 2026
Prior four fiscal weeks = weeks 17 to 20 (Monday 24 August to Sunday 20 September 2026), units sold = quantity on sales lines by sale_date
Stock summed across stores and products within the snapshot week; never summed across weeks
Stock and units sold both limited to physical stores (store_id below 900); web shop (store 900) and store 999 left out of both
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out of stock and sales
Category as-is: each stock and sales row mapped to the current product version (dim_product on sku and is_current); outdoor lighting therefore counts in Electrical
Staff purchases kept in units sold (no staff exclusion in the weeks-of-cover definition)
Did not use deprecated objects (stg_, bak_, tmp_, _old tables, rpt.v_daily_sales)
assumptions: Read 'end of last period' as the closing stock of the last week of FY2026/27 P05 (week ending 27 Sep 2026), since the request was received on 7 Oct 2026 and P06 is incomplete
Read 'by category' as the top-level category column of dim_product, one row per category, no subcategory split and no company total
Applied the literal 'prior four weeks' reading from the house rules: the four fiscal weeks before the snapshot week (weeks 17 to 20), not the four weeks of P05 itself
Reported history as-is (current category hierarchy), as the company default
Units sold are gross sales-line quantity by sale_date; returns are not netted off units, as the definition says quantity on sales lines
Rounded weeks of cover to 2 decimals
caveats: Checked fact_stock_week for 27 Sep 2026 at its grain: 27,143 rows, one per store_key x product_key, no duplicates, a single load, no negative units, no rows for store 900/999 or ZZ Test, no closed stores, no delisted articles, and closing_value matches closing units times standard unit cost on every row. No correction to the stock data was needed, so no figures were adjusted

Sales-line check for weeks 17 to 20: no duplicate sales_line_id or receipt_id + line_no, no non-positive quantities. Category totals reconcile to the weekly store totals (stock 211,157 units; 69,438 units sold over the four weeks)

Web sales are excluded from units sold because stock covers physical stores only (web orders are picked from the central warehouse, which is not in fact_stock_week). Cover is therefore a store-network figure

Seasonal (48.77 weeks) and Furniture (29.54 weeks) have very high cover because their recent four-week sales are low (Seasonal 2,097 units; Furniture 672 units) against stock of 25,570 and 4,963 units. Seasonal cover on a four-week trailing rate may overstate cover for items with strongly seasonal demand
Trailing four-week sales include the weeks 17 to 20 only; changing the window (for example to P05's own weeks 18 to 21) would change the figures slightly
rpt_daily_store_sales control total does not apply to a category-level, units-based measure, so it was not used

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY ALL
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by Helsinki sale_date
Last week = last completed fiscal week (Monday to Sunday)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Versioned dimensions joined on the fact's store_key and product_key, natural keys store_id and sku
Control total against rpt_daily_store_sales (units_sold)
assumptions: 'Oulu Kaakkuri' is a store, not a product: dim_store has Oulu Kaakkuri as store_id 131, and no product has that name. I read the request as SKU 101624 sold in the Oulu Kaakkuri store.

'Last week' means FY2026/27 week 22, Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026. This is the last completed fiscal week before the request date of 8 October 2026, and the last week loaded in the warehouse.
Units sold are units on sales lines before returns, as the company defines them for weeks of cover. The metric dictionary has no separate definition for units sold. Returns are not netted off.
I counted store sales only. Web lines sit under store 900 and none were in scope for the Oulu Kaakkuri store.
caveats: The SKU is 'Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251' (Tools & Hardware), not a product called Oulu Kaakkuri. The request mixed up the SKU name and the store name, so please confirm that is what you meant.
Eight sales lines in the week, with 1, 2, 1, 4, 5, 1, 1 and 2 units, no duplicate lines.

One return of 4 units of this SKU was booked at this store on 30 September 2026 (reason: changed_mind). It belongs to an earlier sale (sales_line_id 1485745), so it is not netted off. Netting it would give 13 units.
Control check: all sales at store 131 for the week total 864 units, which equals rpt_daily_store_sales. It has no SKU dimension, so the SKU figure itself cannot be checked there.
Store 131 had no refit closure on record, and no sales lines fall near the UTC/Helsinki day boundary.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period) SELECT s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excluding VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: web shop (store 900) orders excluded
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date), fiscal period taken from dim_date
Store format taken from dim_store (same in every version of a store)
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as FY2026/27 P4 (3 August to 30 August 2026, 4 weeks, fully loaded). The request was received on 6 October 2026, when FY2026/27 is the current fiscal year.
ATV is net of line discounts and excludes VAT, as the company definition requires, and is before returns.
Formats are those in the warehouse: Large, Medium and Small. The schema comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date.
ATV is shown for physical stores only, so there is no Web row.
caveats: Corrected for staff purchases: 280 staff receipts (EUR 14,796.76 net) are excluded from ATV. Including them would lower the figures slightly.
Store 999 and the ZZ Test category were excluded. In P4 the ZZ Test filter changed nothing in the physical stores (no test-article sales).

Control check: before the staff exclusion, receipts (18,027) and net sales before returns (EUR 1,062,266.72) for the physical stores match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for 3 to 30 August 2026. After removing staff receipts, the 17,747 receipts and EUR 1,047,469.96 reconcile to the three formats shown.
No duplicate receipt or line keys were found in the period's sales lines.
Savonlinna (Small, closed 25 January 2026) had no sales in P4 and is not in the Small figure, which covers 12 of the 13 Small-format stores. Large covers 8 stores and Medium 18.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or any bak_, stg_, tmp_ or _old tables.

answer.sql: SELECT ds.format AS store_format, ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY ds.format ORDER BY ds.format
definitions_applied: Average Transaction Value (ATV): total net sales divided by number of distinct receipts
Net sales basis: line amounts excluding VAT after discounts
Period definition: fiscal period 4 of FY2025/26 (2025-07-28 to 2025-08-24)
Store format: classification from dim_store dimension
assumptions: Current fiscal year FY2025/26 interpreted as 'this year'
Fiscal period 4 used rather than calendar period
All store formats included (Large, Medium, Small, Training, Web)
ATV calculated per receipt across all sales lines
Net amounts used consistent with company financial reporting standards
caveats: Schema documentation specifies store formats as 'Hyper, Standard or Express' but warehouse contains Large, Medium, Small, Training, and Web
Training format may represent non-commercial practice locations but has been included in results
Web format represents online sales channel aggregated with store-based results
All values in EUR; ATV includes all line-level transactions regardless of channel

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Store identified by store_id 102 (Helsinki Pitäjänmäki)
Fiscal year FY2026/27 (current year at time of request, 2026-10-07)
Units sold: sum of quantity column from fact_sales_line
All sales channels included (store and web)
assumptions: This year refers to the current fiscal year FY2026/27 at the time of request (2026-10-07)
Period 5 refers to fiscal period 5 of FY2026/27
Product rank is by total units sold, not revenue or any other measure
All transaction types included (regular sales, staff purchases)
caveats: Warehouse data is current through 2026-10-04; request received 2026-10-07
No data quality issues detected in the period queried

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P5 is 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, selected through dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar
Units sold is the quantity on sales lines, by sale date (section 9 definition)
Store-level scope: physical store 107, joined by version key, with store 999 and ZZ Test excluded
As-is product hierarchy: subcategory read from the current dim_product version
Grain check: 63 lines, 63 distinct (receipt_id, line_no), 63 distinct sales_line_id, so no duplicates or row multiplication
Control total: daily lines for store 107 over P5 match rpt_daily_store_sales on receipts, units and net sales before returns for all 28 days
assumptions: 'Cleaning Products' is the subcategory under the category Cleaning & Household (the only match; the category is not called Cleaning Products)
'Hyvinkää' is store_id 107, the only matching store; it has a single version, in region South and format Medium
'Period 5 this year' is FY2026/27 P5, the last completed period when the request was made on 5 Oct 2026; P6 had only just begun
'Units sold' is the quantity on sales lines, not reduced by returns
Staff purchases are included (2 of the 63 lines are staff purchases)
Physical store sales only; web orders are not part of a store's sales
caveats: No data problems found for this slice. No duplicate lines, no store-version fan-out, and the product subcategory is identical in the as-was and as-is versions
There were no Cleaning Products returns in store 107 booked during P5, so a net-of-returns unit count would also be 136
The 28 days of P5 total 63 Cleaning Products lines, and all 28 days were trading days
No corrections to the figure were needed

answer.sql: SELECT f.sale_date, COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r INNER JOIN fact_sales_line s ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id WHERE c.channel_group = 'web' AND r.return_date = f.sale_date), 0) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id WHERE c.channel_group = 'web' AND f.sale_date >= '2025-12-15' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-12-23' GROUP BY f.sale_date ORDER BY f.sale_date
definitions_applied: Web sales: All channels in the channel_group 'web', which includes Web home delivery (channel_id 2) and Click and collect (channel_id 3)
Net sales: Gross sales from fact_sales_line.net_amount (net of line discounts, before VAT) minus refunds from fact_return_line.refund_net for matching dates
Daily aggregation: All sales and refunds grouped by sale_date / return_date
assumptions: Web sales includes both home delivery and click-and-collect channels, as both are part of the web channel group
Net sales is computed as sales minus returns, following the company's standard definition in rpt_daily_store_sales
Returns are matched to sales by return_date, not by the original sale_date
caveats: The warehouse data contains a data-quality issue: for dates from 2025-12-01 onwards, the channel_code field is NULL; the analysis relies on channel_id instead
Returns data includes some returns processed after the original sale date; the net sales for each day reflects returns processed on that day, not returns of sales made on that day
The Click and collect channel appears to have significantly lower volume than Web home delivery; verify with the E-commerce team if both channels should be included in the request

answer.sql: WITH period2_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_year, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_week, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN fiscal_week_start_date END) as week_start_date, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END), 2) as net_sales_fy2026_27, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) * 100, 2) as growth_pct FROM period2_sales GROUP BY fiscal_week ORDER BY fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales from fact_sales_line: gross_amount less discounts and VAT
Company total: all channels (store + web) and all member and non-member transactions
Fiscal calendar: Period 2 contains fiscal weeks 5-8
Current fiscal year: FY2026/27 (the fiscal year in effect on the request date 2026-10-07)
assumptions: Request 'this year' interpreted as FY2026/27, the current fiscal year at request date
Growth percentage calculated as (FY2026/27 sales - FY2025/26 sales) / FY2025/26 sales * 100
Week 7 and week 8 compared to the equivalent fiscal week in the prior year, not calendar week
Staff purchases included in the totals as they appear in fact_sales_line with staff_purchase_flag
caveats: Store closure variance: FY2026/27 Week 7 had non-trading days on 2026-06-19 and 2026-06-20 (Jun 19-20), while FY2025/26 Week 7 (2025-06-09 to 2025-06-15) had no non-trading days. The sharp 25% decline in Week 7 FY2026/27 is attributable to the unplanned closure on those dates.

FY2025/26 Week 8 (2025-06-16 to 2025-06-22) also had non-trading days on 2025-06-20 and 2025-06-21, but these fell at week-end. The 50% growth in FY2026/27 Week 8 is partly due to FY2025/26 Week 8 having lower sales from the mid-week closure.

Stores closed on different dates in the two years, making year-on-year comparisons partially driven by operational changes rather than demand shifts. Adjust expectations accordingly for strategic interpretation.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Like-for-like (LFL) growth: net sales in LFL stores against the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the start of the range; store-weeks count only if the store traded in both years
Refit and closure weeks removed for the store concerned in both years (ref_store_closure; Savonlinna closure)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop excluded
As-is regions (current dim_store version, five regions including Capital Region)
Fiscal YTD: FY2026/27 weeks 1 to 22 (4 May to 4 October 2026) against FY2025/26 weeks 1 to 22; week 53 is never LFL
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales by store and fiscal week
assumptions: "How they are doing" is read as like-for-like sales growth, the company's performance measure for stores. Raw net sales mostly reflects region size, so I did not rank on it.

"This year so far" is the current fiscal year FY2026/27 to date, through the last complete fiscal week, week 22 ending Sunday 4 October 2026. The warehouse is loaded through that date. It is compared with weeks 1 to 22 of FY2025/26.
Regions are as-is (current hierarchy). The Capital Region is therefore compared with last year's South stores that were moved into it.
Rank 1 is the highest LFL growth. The five regions are North, Capital Region, South, West and East; Online is not a physical region and is excluded with the web shop.
I calculated LFL growth from the LFL template pattern. The accepted YTD LFL request (REQ-D09) ran the same way.
caveats: Data problem corrected: store 116 had every sales line loaded twice in FY2025/26 week 21 (15 to 21 September 2025). There were 836 rows for 418 distinct receipt and line numbers, each with its own sales_line_id and a different etl_loaded_at. This overstated last year's West net sales by 10,390.53 EUR and was the only mismatch against rpt_daily_store_sales across all stores and weeks 1 to 22 of both years. I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no (the earliest load). Without this fix West's LFL growth would read 1.33% instead of 1.93%. The ranking does not change, but West would sit further below South.
East is the only region with negative LFL growth (-0.19%). Capital Region as-is includes Vantaa Tammisto and other stores that were in South last year, and the East as-is no longer includes Kouvola.

The Pori and Kuopio refits and the Savonlinna closure take weeks out of the base for those stores. Kuopio's June to July 2026 refit shortens East or North store-weeks depending on its region. The compared weeks are the same in both years for each store.
The regional gaps between South, West and Capital Region are small (about 1 percentage point). I did not test whether they are significant.
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used (they drop web sales from 3 November 2025). The web shop is excluded from this answer anyway.

Only 6 skill loads were available, so I did not open the query-check skill. I ran the control-total check by hand with SQL against rpt_daily_store_sales. I did not run the duplicate check on any other table or period beyond that comparison.

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Store scope: physical stores and web shop (store 900), excluding store 999 and ZZ Test category
Return timing: returns reduce net sales on the return date, not the sale date
Web recognition: web sales recognized on dispatch date in Helsinki time
assumptions: Interpreted 'last month' as the last completed fiscal period, which is FY2026/27 P05 (fiscal weeks 18-21, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
Request is for total company (all stores and channels combined) with no breakdown
caveats: No issues found. Query validation passed with no errors or warnings.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE s.store_name = 'Nokia' AND s.store_id != 999 AND p.category != 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Period 5 of current fiscal year (FY2026/27 P05)
Training store (999) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
assumptions: Period 5 'this year' interpreted as the most recent completed period, FY2026/27 P05 (fiscal weeks 18–21, 31 August to 27 September 2026), as accepted requests do for periods named without a year

answer.sql: SELECT s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as avg_transaction_value FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.channel_id = 1 GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: Average transaction value defined as gross sales (including VAT) per distinct receipt
Store transactions only (channel_id = 1, Store channel)
Physical stores only (store_id < 900, excludes web and training locations)
Fiscal period and year from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar tables
assumptions: Request date 2026-10-06 implies 'this year' refers to FY2026/27
Store format breakdown includes only physical retail formats (Large, Medium, Small), excluding Training and Web
ATV calculated using gross amount (includes VAT) as measure of transaction value
Each receipt counted once per format, regardless of number of lines on receipt
caveats: Data schema documentation specifies store formats as 'Hyper, Standard or Express', but actual warehouse data contains 'Large, Medium, Small, Training, Web'; results use actual data
Channel code column is NULL in fact_sales_line table; channel routing is via channel_id only

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date, SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.sku = 101624 AND d.fiscal_week = 22 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: fiscal week and fiscal year labels from dim_date
Sales lines from all channels (store and web) included
Quantity field: sum of units sold across all transactions
assumptions: Last week interpreted as the most recent complete fiscal week in the warehouse (fiscal week 22, FY2026/27, ending 2026-10-04)
Request date context (today 2026-10-15) exceeds warehouse data range (through 2026-10-04); interpreted request relative to latest available data
