  WHERE s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
  ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, gross_sales_incl_vat FROM web_sales;
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on dispatch date (Helsinki time)
Sales amount including VAT (gross_amount from fact_sales_line)
Before returns (sales lines only, refunds not deducted)
Test articles excluded (category ZZ Test)
Web shop identified as store_id 900
assumptions: Period labels without a year (Q2, P4-P6) interpreted as FY2024/25 as explicitly requested
Before returns means sales before deducting any return/refund amounts
caveats: Gross amount includes VAT at the rate applicable to each line; rates are 24% (standard), 14% (reduced), and 10% (reduced) as per VAT class
Web sales recognised on dispatch_ts_utc converted to Helsinki time, not on the order date
Web returns totalling EUR 44,919.17 (gross) exist for this period but are excluded per request (before returns)

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fs.week_ending_date WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
definitions_applied: Closing stock is the fiscal-week-end snapshot in fact_stock_week, read for one week only and not summed across weeks
Fiscal calendar: weeks run Monday to Sunday, and the warehouse is loaded through Sunday 4 October 2026 (FY2026/27 week 22)
Stock by store covers physical stores only (store_id below 900), with test articles (ZZ Test) and store 999 excluded; this store and SKU are unaffected
Store and product resolved through their natural keys (store_id 124, sku 100011) via the version keys on the fact; each has a single version, so there is no row multiplication
Grain check on fact_stock_week: one row per store_key, product_key and week_ending_date (27,143 rows for each of the last five weeks, no duplicates)
assumptions: 'Last week' is the last completed fiscal week as of the request date (Thursday 8 October 2026): FY2026/27 week 22, Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026. Week 23 is only just under way and is not in the warehouse.
'Jyväskylä Palokka' is store_id 124 (store_key 30), the only store with that name. 'SKU 100011' is Plants & Flowers Kuusela 570 (Garden, Plants & Flowers).
'In stock' is the closing units at the end of the week (Sunday 4 October), the point-in-time figure the request implies.
caveats: No data problem found for this store and SKU. I rolled the stock forward from sales, receipts and adjustments (20 on 30 Aug, then 16, 13, 13, 11 and 11), and every weekly closing matches the units sold, so the 11 is internally consistent.
The figure is the snapshot taken at Sunday close, with the load stamped Monday 5 October 2026 01:00. Anything sold or received after Sunday 4 October is not in it.
The store has no sales of this SKU in week 22 and no receipts or adjustments, so the closing stock is unchanged from the previous week (11 units, valued at 46.64 EUR at standard cost).
Store-level control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply: this is a stock count for one SKU in one store, not net sales.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, 'Cleaning Products' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P05 runs 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026 (28 days, 4 weeks), fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar
Units sold is the sum of quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test are filtered out (the filter changed nothing here)
Staff purchases included (4 of the 136 units)
Product category and subcategory taken as-is, on the current product version
Store identified by the stable store_id (107), not store_key
Control total: all-category units for Hyvinkää over 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026 are 1,626 in fact_sales_line and in rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
assumptions: 'Cleaning Products' is the product subcategory under the category 'Cleaning & Household'. There is no category with that exact name, and the subcategory is an exact match
'Period 5 this year' is FY2026/27 P05. It is the last complete period at the 4 Oct 2026 load, and the request is dated 5 Oct 2026
'Units sold' means units sold before returns, as in rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold. Returns are not netted off
Hyvinkää is store 107, the only store named Hyvinkää. The web shop (store 900) is not part of it
caveats: No data problems found. Sales lines are unique on sales_line_id and on (receipt_id, line_no), and the store-wide total agrees with the control table
Any correction is nil: no ZZ Test or store 999 rows were involved, and the as-is and as-was product versions give the same 136
There are no returns of Cleaning Products sold in this period at Hyvinkää, and none booked at Hyvinkää in the period, so net-of-returns units would also be 136
Cleaning Products sold on 26 of the 28 days; the store traded on all 28 days

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS ps, period_end_date AS pe FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2), sales AS (SELECT d.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key, per WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND f.channel_id = 1 AND d.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1), rets AS (SELECT d.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = r.store_key, per WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND d.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1), net AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id)) SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, rank() OVER (ORDER BY n.net_sales DESC) AS net_sales_rank, n.store_id, c.store_name, round(n.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales FROM net n JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) c USING (store_id), per ORDER BY net_sales_rank
definitions_applied: Fiscal period from ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27 P02, 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28), not calendar June
Net sales = line net_amount (ex VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the period
Returns counted on return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Store identity by store_id (stable across dim_store versions), joined through the store_key on each fact row
Store channel only (channel_id 1); web home delivery and click-and-collect excluded
Pseudo-locations excluded: web shop 900 and training store 999
Rank 1 = highest net sales
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, so period 2 is 1 to 28 June 2026 (the request came on 2026-10-07, and P02 is fully loaded)
'Store ranking' means ranking by net sales (ex VAT, after returns) in EUR, highest first, with no size or like-for-like adjustment
Staff purchases are left in net sales, as in the Data & Analytics report table rpt_daily_store_sales; no definition says to exclude them
Click-and-collect orders belong to the web channel (channel group 'web'), so they are not credited to the collection store
Savonlinna (129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in the period, so it is not listed
The ranking covers stores with sales in the period (38 stores)
caveats: Corrected: fact_sales_line.channel_code is NULL for the June 2026 rows (the web-platform migration), so the view-style filter channel_code = 'ST' returns no rows. I used channel_id = 1 (Store) instead.
Corrected: the web shop (900) and the training store (999, EUR 2,381.03 of store-channel sales, EUR 2,238.50 of it staff purchases) are not real stores and are excluded from the ranking.
Kuopio (125) was closed for a refit from 2026-06-15 (closure runs to 2026-07-26). It traded only 14 of the period's 26 trading days, so its rank of 24 is not comparable with fully trading stores.
The stores are not on equal footing: they differ greatly in size (about 1,300 to 8,400 sqm), so the ranking mostly follows store size. Sales per square metre would give a different order.
Trading days in the period are 26 for most stores, not 28, because stores are shut on some days (is_trading_day false) in the period.

Net sales is not very different from the rpt_daily_store_sales table: I recomputed from the fact tables and the store figures matched that table exactly. Ranks 3 to 5 (Lahti 46,899.91, Vantaa Tammisto 46,414.81, Oulu Kaakkuri 46,021.68) are within about 1.9% of each other, and staff purchases (EUR 529 to 955 at these stores) are enough to change their order if excluded.

No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period. Stores that changed region on 2025-04-28 were handled by store_id, and no region is shown, so the region change does not affect the ranking.

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Period 5 of FY2026/27 taken from ref_fiscal_calendar: 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, 4 weeks (fiscal weeks 18 to 21)
Store identified by store_id 102 (Helsinki Pitäjänmäki), so both versions of the store (store_key 3 and 4) would be included
Products grouped by sku (stable across versions) rather than product_key
Units sold = sum of fact_sales_line.quantity by sale_date
assumptions: FY26/27 means fiscal year FY2026/27 and period 5 means fiscal_period 5 (P05)
Pitäjänmäki means the store 'Helsinki Pitäjänmäki' (store_id 102), the only matching store
'Sold the most units' means gross units sold on receipts in the period, before returns, with staff purchases included
Ties are not an issue: the third-placed product has 42 units and the fourth has 30
caveats: No data problems affected the answer. The period is fully loaded, with all 28 days present, no duplicate sales lines, no refit closures for store 102 and every day a trading day.
Store 102 changed region from South to Capital Region on 2025-04-28 (a new store version). I used store_id instead of store_key, so this does not affect the result.

Staff purchases (29 lines in the period) are counted as sales. Excluding them, the third product drops from 42 to 40 units, and returns take it to 41 net. The top-three ranking is the same either way.
The first two products had no returns in the period.
dim_store.format for this store reads 'Large', although the column comment lists only Hyper, Standard and Express. This does not affect the answer.

answer.sql:
WITH garden_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM dim_product_old WHERE category = 'Garden'
),
garden_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_key FROM dim_product 
  WHERE sku IN (SELECT sku FROM garden_skus)
),
sales_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM garden_products)
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period >= 7 
    AND d.fiscal_period <= 12
),
returns_by_sale AS (
  SELECT 
    sales_line_id,
    SUM(refund_net) as refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line
  GROUP BY sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  s.fiscal_year,
  s.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM sales_with_dates s
LEFT JOIN returns_by_sale r ON s.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period
ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Garden category as defined in dim_product_old (legacy product hierarchy)
Net sales calculated as sale net amount minus refunds (excluding VAT)
Fiscal periods from ref_fiscal_calendar with fiscal_period numbering
Sales line level matching to returns via sales_line_id
assumptions: Garden products identified by matching SKUs from dim_product_old to current dim_product via product_key surrogate keys
Returns linked to original sales by fact_return_line.sales_line_id reference
All sales channels included (store + web)
Net sales excludes VAT as per fact_sales_line.net_amount definition
caveats: All periods P7-P12 are fully loaded in the warehouse
No store closures or trading day restrictions affected the Garden sales during this period
Returns are summed by sales_line_id; unmatched returns would not affect this calculation

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_web_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY p.sku), refunds AS (SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE (f.channel_id IN (2, 3) OR f.channel_code = 'WB') AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY p.sku) SELECT s.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, ROUND(s.gross_web_sales - COALESCE(r.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur FROM sales s JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku = s.sku AND cur.is_current LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sku = s.sku ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web channel after the migration = channel_id 2 (web home delivery) and 3 (click and collect) in dim_channel; the old channel_code 'WB' is not used for lines from 3 Nov 2025

Web sales measured as net sales: line value in EUR excluding VAT after line discounts (net_amount), less refunds excluding VAT (refund_net), following the net sales definition in rpt_daily_store_sales
Refunds booked on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales (returns count in the period they are booked)
Products identified by SKU (stable article number), not by product_key, so slowly changing versions of an article are combined; names come from the current dim_product version
Sale date (sale_date) used for the window, not the UTC timestamp
Staff purchases excluded: none of the web lines carry the staff flag, so nothing was removed
Cancelled web orders carry no sales lines, so no cancelled orders are counted
assumptions: 'Web sales' read as net sales in EUR excluding VAT, after returns, because that is the only sales measure the warehouse defines at company level
Web includes both home delivery and click and collect (both are channel_group 'web' in dim_channel)
'Since the migration on 3 November 2025' read as sale_date from 3 Nov 2025 inclusive, through the latest loaded data (web sales up to 3 Oct 2026)
'Products' read at SKU level, not subcategory or brand
Refunds on web lines sold before the migration (old channel_code WB) but booked on or after 3 Nov 2025 (the last on 3 Dec 2025) are deducted, because refunds are counted on the date they are booked
Ranked by euro value, not by units
caveats: Platform migration trap: lines from 3 Nov 2025 have channel_code NULL and use channel_id instead. Anything filtered on channel_code = 'WB' returns no web sales after migration. The view rpt.v_daily_sales (and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales built on it) filters on 'WB', so it misses all web sales from 3 Nov 2025 and should not be used for this request.
Click and collect (channel_id 3) has no legacy code, so any old-code mapping also drops it. 22,409 lines, EUR 646.6k net, would be lost.

1,473 click-and-collect lines (758 orders, sale dates 12 Jan to 8 Feb 2026) are tagged channel_id 2 (home delivery) instead of 3. This does not affect this answer, since both IDs are counted as web, but a home delivery versus click and collect split would be off for that period.

Ranking depends on the basis. On gross sales before returns, Bedroom Peltola 793 (sku 103390) would be first (EUR 15,533) and Garden Furniture Norvik 499 and Garden Furniture Havu 328 would take places 8 and 10 in place of Sauna & Winter Havu 699 and Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620. Bedroom Peltola 793 drops to fourth after EUR 5,782 of refunds, a high return rate. Net sales is used here.

Web returns in rpt_daily_store_sales (store 900) do not reconcile to the fact tables: the report's net_sales_before_returns differs from the sum of web sales lines on many days, and shows negative net sales on some days (e.g. 1 and 8 Mar 2026). It was not used. Only fact_sales_line and fact_return_line were used.

Slowly changing product dimension: 4,105 product versions for 4,000 SKUs. Grouped by SKU so versions are not split. Four web returns reference a different product version than the original sale; they were matched through the original sales line.
The backup, staging, old and tmp tables (bak_*, stg_*, dim_*_old, tmp_*) were not used.
Web sales are loaded to 3 Oct 2026 (web orders to 4 Oct 2026). The result does not include anything later, and refunds of lines sold near the end of the window may still arrive.
Amounts exclude VAT. Gross (VAT-inclusive) would give the same ranking only if VAT rates were equal across the top products, which was not checked.

answer.sql:
WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: Like-for-like (LFL): physical stores only, web shop (store 900) excluded
LFL base rule: store open_date on or before first day of range minus 364 days (27 Oct 2025 minus 364 = 28 Oct 2024)
LFL store-week rule: only store-weeks trading in both years (open_date/close_date and ref_store_closure checks); weeks compared week by week
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT after returns; returns deducted on their own return date at the store where processed
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Regions as-is (current dim_store version, five regions including Capital Region; Kouvola in South)
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 Q3 = weeks 27-39 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026) vs FY2024/25 Q3 = weeks 27-39 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025), lined up by fiscal week, not calendar date
Control total: store-level net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, stg_, bak_, tmp_, old dims) not used; channel_code not used
assumptions: 'Q3 last year' read as FY2025/26 Q3 (weeks 27-39), compared with FY2024/25 Q3. The request is dated 5 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27. FY2026/27 Q3 has not happened yet, and past requests read an unyeared 'Q3' as the most recent completed one (REQ-D03) and 'last year' as FY2025/26 once in FY2026/27.
Growth is shown by region because the request says 'by region'. No company total row was added.
Regions are as-is (current hierarchy), the management-reporting default.
Savonlinna (129) is kept in the base for all 13 weeks: its close_date is 25 Jan 2026, the Sunday of week 39, so it traded in every week of the quarter and has sales on 25 Jan 2026.
Opening rule is tested against the first day of the whole range (27 Oct 2025), as in REQ-D08.
caveats: Lohja (137, South, opened 4 Nov 2024) is excluded entirely. It opened after 28 Oct 2024 (27 Oct 2025 minus 364 days) and has no sales in week 27 of FY2024/25, so it is not in the LFL base. The South figure covers all other South stores.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, West, opened 2 Sep 2024) is in the base, because it was open more than 52 weeks before 27 Oct 2025.
Pori's (119) refit (8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025) and Tammisto's (104) refit (July to Aug 2024) both fall outside the Q3 weeks, so no store-weeks were dropped for refits. No closures overlap either Q3.

Reclassification effect: Vuosaari, Pitäjänmäki, Lommila, Tammisto and Kerava are in Capital Region as-is for both years. On the old hierarchy (as-was) Capital Region does not exist for FY2024/25. Kouvola is counted in South in both years. Figures are not comparable to old-region reports.

Data problem found: 418 sales lines are duplicated (same receipt_id and line_no, loaded twice) between 2024-10-28 and 2026-01-25, in a store-22 slice of September 2025 (loaded on 16 Sep and again on 23 Sep 2025). All are in FY2025/26 P6, outside Q3 weeks 27-39 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), so they do not affect this answer. Anyone summing September 2025 sales will double-count them.

Control total check passed: net sales per store for both Q3s agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to within 0.50 EUR for all stores (no differences found). The check was done over all stores in the quarter, not only the LFL store-weeks.
Net sales are ex-VAT and after returns, with returns booked on the return date, so a return of a sale from last year or a different quarter reduces this quarter's figure.
Week 53 does not apply (Q3 is weeks 27-39). Data runs through 4 Oct 2026, so the full quarter is loaded.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Web sales: net amount excluding VAT, recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date)
Net sales after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (channel_code is not filled after the 3 November 2025 migration)
Click-and-collect counted as web
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded, because they have no dispatch date and no sales lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Helsinki time conversion of UTC timestamps (UTC+2 in December)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Daily web sales (net)' read as the company definition of web net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, by dispatch date
Days read as Helsinki business days, 15 to 23 December 2025 inclusive (nine days)
'15 to 23 December' read as 2025, the year of the warehouse's most recent December
Returns booked to the web shop (store 900) are deducted on their return date, as the company definition and the control table do
Rows are not filled for days with no web sales; every day in the range has a value
caveats: No data problems found, so no corrections were made. Each daily figure matches rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 to the cent. In the range, the 1,909 dispatched orders and their 3,813 lines have no duplicate lines, no orders without lines, and line counts that match fact_web_order. No test-article or store 999 lines appear in these web orders, so the exclusions did not change any figure.

Sunday 21 December is very low (611.75). Only 18 orders were dispatched that day (3 collected, 15 home delivery), against 187 to 207 on Mondays, and refunds of 833.90 were deducted against sales of 1,445.65. The same pattern shows on Sunday 14 December. It reflects the weekly dispatch pattern, not missing data.

Figures are net of returns deducted on the return date, so they are not the value of orders dispatched that day. Sales before returns by day were: 11714.52, 10967.03, 15214.54, 12189.13, 10258.50, 11379.59, 1445.65, 15720.91, 11674.00.

Refunds on web-order items that were handed in at a physical store are booked to that store, so they are not deducted from web sales. This follows the company definition, and the result matches the control table.
Orders placed in the range that were cancelled, or were still processing when the data was loaded, are not in these figures. Orders dispatched after 23 December are not in them either.

Web net sales are recognised on the dispatch date, so they differ from web sales by order date (sale_date). For example, orders placed on 23 December and dispatched on 27 December count on 27 December.
Do not use the legacy view rpt.v_daily_sales for these dates: it leaves out web sales from 3 November 2025.

answer.sql:
WITH period_5_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.subcategory,
        SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
    INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 118
        AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
        AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    GROUP BY p.subcategory
)
SELECT subcategory, total_units
FROM period_5_sales
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Units sold from fact_sales_line quantity column
Nokia store identified as store_id 118
All sales channels and all sale types included
assumptions: "This year" refers to the current fiscal year FY2026/27
Period 5 refers to fiscal period 5 of FY2026/27
All sales transactions included (store and web channels, staff purchases included)
caveats: Staff purchase transactions are included in the units count; if these should be excluded, the count would differ

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount AS sold_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, sold.format, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(sold.sold_net), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: Return rate = refund_net divided by sold net, as a sale-week cohort: sold lines are chosen by the fiscal period of fact_sales_line.sale_date, and refunds are matched through sales_line_id whenever and wherever they were booked
Net amounts excluding VAT (net_amount for sold, refund_net for refunds)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test left out of sales and returns
Format as-is, taken from the current dim_store version; format is the same in every version of a store
Web shop (store 900, format Web) shown as its own line; web identified by store_id, not channel_code
Fiscal period taken from dim_date (FY2025/26 P2 = 26 May to 22 June 2025, 4 weeks)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Sources: only canonical tables used (fact_sales_line, fact_return_line, dim_store, dim_product, dim_date). No stg_, bak_, tmp_ or old tables and no rpt.v_ views
assumptions: "Last year" read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just completed (the current year is FY2026/27, and past requests in May 2026 and later took FY2025/26). "Period 2" is therefore FY2025/26 P2, 26 May to 22 June 2025.

"Goods sold in period 2" read as the sale-week cohort convention for return rates: the denominator is net sales before returns on lines sold in P2, and the numerator is every refund against those lines, including refunds booked after P2.
Web lines are dated by fact_sales_line.sale_date (the order date), as in the accepted return-rate queries (REQ-D14 to D16), not by the dispatch date used for net sales.
Format as-is, grouped by the format of the store where the line was sold. A web order returned in a physical store is counted under Web, because the refund follows the sold line.
Format values in the warehouse are Large, Medium, Small and Web. The schema comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date.
caveats: Filter that changed the totals: the training store (999) had 126 sale lines in P2 (net 2,222.21 EUR, of which ZZ Test 71.90 EUR) and one ZZ Test web line (3.82 EUR) was also removed. Store 999 shows as its own format, Training, and has no row in the result.

The web rate (12.23%) is about three times the store rates (4.28% to 4.53%). Of its 478 returned lines, 102 were processed in physical stores rather than the web shop. They are included in Web because the refund follows the sold line. Booked by processing location instead, the store rates would be higher and the web rate lower.
The cohort is complete. The latest return against these sales is 23 July 2025 and returns arrive up to about 30 days after the sale (web lag up to 33 days), well before the 4 October 2026 load date.

Data checks found no problems: no duplicate sales or return lines, no orphan returns, no refund above the sold value, no return before its sale, and refund_net matches the pro-rata sold net on every line. The store-level control total against rpt_daily_store_sales was not run, since it is by return date and this is a sale-date cohort by format.
Underlying amounts for reference (EUR excl. VAT): Large sold 400,763.11 and refunded 17,707.57; Medium 552,936.25 and 25,030.11; Small 147,668.20 and 6,319.09; Web 183,098.49 and 22,388.29.

answer.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: A member is counted once by member_id, the stable loyalty number. dim_member has one row per version and has not been counted by row.
Join date is dim_member.join_date, 'Date the member joined'. It is the same on every version of a member.
assumptions: 'Joined' means the loyalty join_date, and the count includes online sign-ups (home_store_id 900).
3 October 2026 is taken as a calendar date. join_date is a DATE column, so no timezone conversion applies.
caveats: No correction was needed. The 29 members each have a single row in dim_member, so counting rows or distinct member_id gives the same figure.
The count matches the staging table stg_member_updates, which also holds 29 members for 3 October. The days either side have 31 to 40 joins, so 29 is plausible for a Saturday.

The latest loaded date in the warehouse is 4 October 2026. Sales for 4 October are thin (1,040 lines against 1,692 to 2,078 on the previous days), which suggests that day is incomplete. This does not affect 3 October, whose sales loaded in full on 4 October.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 is weeks 14 to 17, 3 August to 30 August 2026
Returned units are quantity_returned from fact_return_line, dated by return_date (booked-as-returned date), not by the sale-week cohort used for return rate
As-is product hierarchy: current product version (is_current) decides the subcategory
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Helsinki business date for return_date (checked against return_ts_utc, no mismatches)
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, as the request was received on 5 October 2026, and 'period 4' is fiscal period 4
'Garden Furniture' is the subcategory under the Garden category (there is no category of that name); the separate Furniture category is not included
'Handed back and booked as returned' means return lines dated in P4 by return date, whenever the item was sold
Web returns (booked to the web shop, store 900) are included, since they are goods handed back and booked as returned: 34 of the 92 units
Staff purchases are not excluded (2 lines in the nearby weeks were staff receipts, none in P4 weeks 14-15; at most 1 in week 16)
All return reasons are included (changed_mind 37, defective 20, not_as_described 14, wrong_size_or_fit 14, damaged_in_transit 7)
caveats: No data corrections were needed: no duplicate return line ids, no orphan return lines, no returns dated before their sale, no quantities above the sold quantity, and no Helsinki/UTC date mismatches
Every return line in the period has quantity 1, so 92 units equals 92 return lines
P4 is fully loaded, so the figure is complete
As-is and as-was agree for this subcategory in P4 (all 92 units were Garden Furniture on both versions), so the Garden Furniture subcategory move of outdoor lighting does not affect it
Not checked against rpt_daily_store_sales because that control table has no product dimension and holds values, not units

answer.sql: SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P05 = 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Store scope: store_id 102 (Helsinki Pitäjänmäki) by store_id across both dim_store versions
Units sold = sum of quantity on sales lines, by sale_date (company definition used for weeks of cover)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included (as in net sales)
Product name and category taken from the current product version (as-is), grouped by stable sku
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold for store 102 over the same days
assumptions: 'Period 5 of FY26/27' read as FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, the last completed period
'Sold the most units' read as gross units sold (quantity on sales lines), not net of returned units
Pitäjänmäki read as the physical store 102 Helsinki Pitäjänmäki only; web-shop lines (store 900) are not part of the store
Ranking is by units only; no ties among the top three
caveats: No data problems needing correction were found. The 3,740 units on store 102 sales lines in the period match rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold exactly, with no duplicate line ids and all 28 days present.
Store 102 has two dim_store versions (store_key 3 and 4, split at 28 April 2025 when it moved to the Capital Region). Both are matched on store_id, so the version split does not affect the count.

Returns do not change the top three: the only returned units in the period were 1 on Batteries & Bulbs Havu Pro 791 (net 41, still third, with fourth place on 30), so the ranking is the same on a net-of-returns basis.
The units_sold column in rpt_daily_store_sales is before returns, which is the basis used here.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date in dim_member
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key (dim_member has one row per version)
Taken from the member's first version in dim_member
Online sign-ups (home store 900) included as new members
Join date used as stored (a calendar date, no UTC conversion needed)
assumptions: 3 October 2026 was read as the calendar date of the join_date column, which is a plain DATE.
All new members were counted, including online sign-ups (9 of the 29 sit under store 900) and members at every home store. The request gave no breakdown or filter by store or channel.
No filter on marketing consent or tier was applied.
caveats: The warehouse is loaded through Sunday 4 October 2026, so 3 October is fully covered.

On 3 October, dim_member has 29 version rows for 29 distinct member_ids. Every one of them has valid_from equal to join_date, so no member had a second version and the count is the same on a row basis or a member_id basis.
I found no data problems affecting this figure, so no corrections were made. I did not use the stg_member_updates staging table.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales_as_was FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: EUR excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their return date, not the original sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered or collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
As-was category hierarchy: category taken from the product version on the fact line (product_key), not the current version
Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 from dim_date (28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025)
Web shop (store 900) included, as net sales cover all channels
assumptions: 'The old way, Garden as it was reported at the time' read as an as-was request, so the category comes from the product version valid on the transaction date
FY24/25 read as FY2024/25 (29 Apr 2024 to 27 Apr 2025), 52 weeks, so P7 to P12 is 28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025 and has no week 53
Garden net sales cover all channels (stores and web) because the request names no channel or region and the company net sales definition includes web
One row per fiscal period, as asked, with no total row
caveats: As-was, Garden for FY2024/25 includes the Outdoor Lighting subcategory, which moved to Electrical on 27 Oct 2025 (FY2025/26 P7). On today's (as-is) set-up these figures would be lower by Outdoor Lighting: P7 20,801.86; P8 20,333.08; P9 17,017.21; P10 9,681.00; P11 8,659.00; P12 10,616.84
The figures will not match a Garden number on the current category hierarchy, which excludes outdoor lighting for all history

Web lines for cancelled or still-processing orders have no dispatch date and are excluded. The library's net_lines template would have dated them by order date. None of them fall inside this range as it comes out

Checks done: no duplicate sales line, receipt line or return line IDs in the range, no orphan returns, and the version on each Garden fact line was valid on the sale date. The rpt_daily_store_sales control total does not apply to a category subset, so there was no control-total reconciliation
P12 (5 weeks, to 27 Apr 2025) is much larger than the other periods because of the spring garden season. I saw no data fault behind it

answer.sql:
WITH p3_weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key AND p.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value_eur
FROM p3_weekly_totals
definitions_applied: Average closing stock per the stock skill definition: average of weekly closing values within the period
Stock value at standard cost (closing_value from fact_stock_week)
Physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding web store 900 and training store 999
Current product version (as-is category) per store-and-product-history skill
assumptions: Period 3 'this year' read as FY2026/27 P3 (the current fiscal year at request date 2026-10-08)
Period 3 FY2026/27 comprises fiscal weeks 9–13 (2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02), complete as of warehouse load
Average calculated by summing closing_value across stores and products per week, then averaging those 5 weekly totals
Category 'Paint & Decorating' is the current dim_product version (is_current = TRUE)
caveats: Period 3 FY2026/27 is fully loaded and complete in the warehouse
Stock is counted on week-ending Sundays; the value is semi-additive (additive across stores and products, but never across weeks)

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, after opening, before closure, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day false)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P2 = Monday 1 June to Sunday 28 June 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Stores as-is (current dim_store version, joined on store_id with is_current)
Control total: store-level net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
assumptions: 'Store ranking' read as the company store league table (net sales per trading day), not a ranking on total net sales
'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P2, 1 to 28 June 2026, because the request was received on 7 October 2026 (fiscal year FY2026/27 started 4 May 2026)
Stores that traded for only part of the period stay in the table with their own trading days
Ties are not an issue: ranking uses unrounded net sales per trading day; the figure is shown to two decimals
net_sales and trading_days are shown beside the ranking measure so the per-day figure can be read
caveats: Kuopio (125) was shut for a refit from 15 June 2026 (ref_store_closure, 6 weeks). It traded only 14 days in P2 (1 to 14 June) against 26 for every other store, so it is ranked at 7th on net sales per trading day (1713.84), not on its period total. On total net sales it would be far lower.
Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays and are not counted as trading days, so a full-period store has 26 trading days rather than 28.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales or trading days in P2, so it is not listed.

Net sales per store agree to the cent with rpt_daily_store_sales over 1 to 28 June 2026 for all 38 stores. No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period. Store 999 lines (119 in the period) and ZZ Test articles were removed, as the house rules require.
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales) were not used. The web shop is not part of the store league and is not listed.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal periods from dim_date (4-4-5 pattern, year starting late April)
Helsinki time for the dispatch timestamp (UTC converted)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just ended, following accepted precedent for requests made in FY2026/27 (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). FY2025/26 P5 to P8 run 25 Aug 2025 to 21 Dec 2025.
Periods 5 to 8 are shown as one row per period with no total row, as the request asked for no total.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT, as the company net sales definition requires.
The 3 November 2025 platform migration falls inside P7. It does not affect the result, because web is identified by store 900.
caveats: The figures match the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 exactly in all four periods.
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used. They leave out web sales from 3 November 2025, so they would understate P7 and P8.
Test articles (ZZ Test) in web orders were excluded. This changed only P6, by 5.50 EUR (one row).

Returns booked to the web shop are deducted in the period of the return, not the period of the original sale. Some deductions in P5 to P8 therefore relate to sales from earlier periods, and returns of P8 sales that arrive after 21 December 2025 are not in these figures.
Cancelled and still-processing orders have no sales lines and are not included.
About 418 receipt_id and line_no pairs repeat in fact_sales_line in the Aug 2025 to Jan 2026 range. All of them are store lines. None are web lines, so the web figures are not affected.

answer.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'), r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT w.sku, sum(w.net_amount) - coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS web_net_sales, sum(w.quantity) - coalesce(sum(r.qty_returned), 0) AS net_units FROM w LEFT JOIN r ON r.sales_line_id = w.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC) AS rank, a.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, a.web_net_sales, a.net_units FROM a JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku = a.sku AND cur.is_current ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web channel after the migration = channel_id 2 (Web home delivery) and 3 (Click and collect), both channel_group 'web'; the old channel_code 'WB' is null on lines from 3 November 2025
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns of those same lines
Product identified by sku (stable across versions) via product_key, named from the current dim_product version
Period starts 3 November 2025 (platform migration date, inclusive) on sale_date
assumptions: 'Web sales' is read as net sales excluding VAT, in EUR, net of returns, consistent with how the company's daily net sales report defines net sales; the request does not say whether returns come off
Ranking is by value, not by units
Includes both home delivery and click-and-collect, since both are web channel group
The period runs from 3 November 2025 to the latest data (4 October 2026); no end date was given
Returns are matched to the original sales line, so refunds on web lines in the period are deducted whatever date the refund was booked; no web return in the data predates its sale
caveats: Since the migration the old channel_code is empty on web lines. Filtering on channel_code = 'WB' returns nothing after 3 November 2025, so I filtered on channel_id 2 and 3

Between 12 January and 8 February 2026, 1,473 lines (758 orders) sit under channel_id 2 (home delivery) but have click-and-collect fulfilment in fact_web_order. They are still web, so the top 10 is unaffected, but a split by channel would be wrong for that window

Returns change the ranking noticeably for bulky items. Before returns, Bedroom Peltola 793 would be 1st (15,533.23) and Garden Furniture Raudikko 536 4th, and Sauna & Winter Havu 699 (7,464.39 gross), Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620 (6,850.51) and Interior Paint Kultala 377 (6,821.25) would rank 12th, 16th and 17th. Without the returns deduction the top 10 would contain Garden Furniture Raudikko... and exclude Sauna & Winter Havu 699 and Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620 in favour of Barbecue & Grills Poutaranta Home 851 and Garden Furniture Norvik 499 shifting; if Veikko wants gross web sales, the list changes
Order status in fact_web_order is only delivered or collected for lines in this period (no cancelled or processing orders, and no staff purchases on web lines), so no exclusions were needed
Duplicate sales lines exist (418 receipt/line pairs loaded twice, 15 to 21 September 2025), but they are store lines before the migration and do not affect this result

Data runs to 4 October 2026, so the last days before the request date of 8 October are not included. Seasonal items (Christmas decorations, garden furniture) mean this ranking reflects the 11 months since migration and is seasonally skewed

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), a AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) sales FROM sales f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.sales - coalesce(b.ret,0) DESC) AS rank, a.store_id, d.store_name, round(a.sales - coalesce(b.ret,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id) JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d USING (store_id) ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales = net_amount (EUR excluding VAT) minus refund_net on returns, matching the rpt_daily_store_sales definition
Store identity by store_id (stable across versions), not store_key, so stores with several dim_store versions are counted once
Fiscal year FY2025/26 (2025-04-28 to 2026-05-03, 53 weeks) from ref_fiscal_calendar
Physical stores only: web shop (900) and Training store (999) excluded
Returns counted on the return date and the return store
assumptions: Read 'biggest' as highest net sales, not floor area
Used the latest complete fiscal year, FY2025/26, because FY2026/27 is only partly loaded (period 6 is not fully loaded)
Staff purchases are kept in net sales as they are real sales; excluding them does not change the top 10
Click-and-collect and web lines are not attributed to stores; only lines booked to a store count
caveats: Correction: Tampere Lielahti (116) had 418 sales lines loaded twice around 16-23 Sep 2025, about 10,391 EUR of double-counted sales. I removed the duplicates (one row kept per receipt_id and line_no), which matches rpt_daily_store_sales. This moves Lielahti from 543,132 to 506,895 EUR net and from 7th to 8th, behind Kuopio. The top 10 set is unchanged.

If 'biggest' means floor area, the answer differs: the largest by sqm are Helsinki Pitäjänmäki (8,381), Vantaa Tammisto, Kuopio, Turku Kupittaa and Lahti, with Oulu Kaakkuri, Tampere Lielahti and Tampere Hervanta next.

Pori (119) was closed for a refit for 5 weeks from 8 Sep 2025 and Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, so their FY2025/26 sales are partial. Neither is in the top 10. Kuopio has a refit in June-July 2026 (FY2026/27), which drops it to 14th in the part-year FY2026/27 so far.

Rank is stable across years for the top 2 (Hervanta, Pitäjänmäki). Positions 3 to 10 shift by a place or two between FY2024/25, FY2025/26 and the year to date, as the gaps are small, for example Kuopio and Lielahti are 6k EUR apart.
Old store regions were restated on 28 Apr 2025 (South to Capital Region); this does not affect store-level totals because grouping is by store_id.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT and cover this fiscal year only, not all-time sales.

answer.sql: SELECT dso.region, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as August_2024, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as September_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON f.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN dim_store_old dso ON ds.store_id = dso.store_id INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9) AND ds.store_id < 900 GROUP BY dso.region ORDER BY dso.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales amount: fact_sales_line.gross_amount (net sales plus VAT)
Before returns: only sales lines included, return lines excluded
Regional structure: dim_store_old mapping (North, South, East, West)
Physical stores only: store_id < 900 (excludes web shop and head office)
assumptions: Regional mapping from dim_store_old interpreted as the 'old reports' structure referenced in the request
Pseudo-locations (Online, Head office) excluded as not part of traditional regional reporting
All entries without matching regional mapping flagged but none found in this data
caveats: No data quality issues identified. All 90,953 sales lines in August-September 2024 matched successfully to regions via dim_store_old; 38 distinct physical stores all have valid old regional mappings.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_quarter, cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost), 2) AS gross_margin FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South' GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin = net sales (excl. VAT) minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns
Returns credited back at standard_cost_returned and dated on the return date
Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date (delivered/collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Region as-is: current dim_store version (is_current), so South includes Kouvola (114) and excludes the five stores that moved to the Capital Region on 28 April 2025
Product name and sku taken from the current product version (as-is); margin grouped by stable sku
Q4 = fiscal periods 10-12 (fiscal weeks 40-52), 27 Jan 2025 to 27 Apr 2025, 13 weeks
Web shop (store 900) is in region Online, so no web sales fall in South
assumptions: Q4 of FY24/25 was read literally as FY2024/25 P10-P12, since the year was named in the request
Region read as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, because the request did not ask for as-was
Product reading is by sku (stable article number) and ranked by gross margin in EUR, not margin percentage
Product names are those on the current product version
Ranking uses RANK with no ties in the top 10; the 11th product (Smart Home Tuulikki 855) had 935.46
caveats: As-is South has 10 stores today: 106 Porvoo, 107 Hyvinkää, 108 Lahti, 109 Hämeenlinna, 110 Turku Kupittaa, 111 Turku Härmälä, 112 Raisio, 113 Salo, 114 Kouvola and 137 Lohja. Kouvola (East until 28 April 2025) is included for the whole quarter. Stores 101-105, which were South in this quarter, are in the Capital Region as-is and are not counted. An as-was reading, with the regions as they stood in Q4 FY24/25, would give a different ranking.
The dim_store.region column comment is out of date (says four regions); there are five regions plus Online, so I filtered on region = 'South' using the actual values.
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles were filtered out. Neither is in the South region, so this did not change the South figures.

Checks passed: no duplicate sales line or return line keys in the quarter, no null or zero standard costs, the quarter has 91 days (13 whole weeks), and South stores' net sales for the quarter match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for all 10 stores (gap 0.00).
The figures are small in absolute terms (the top product earned about 2.9k EUR margin in the quarter), so ranks 8 to 10 are close (1177, 1096, 979).

answer.sql: SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY cp.subcategory, cp.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by sale date (metric dictionary, weeks of cover definition)
Fiscal period 5 = FY2026/27 P05, fiscal weeks 18 to 21, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, from dim_date
Store scope: physical store Nokia (store_id 118) only; web shop (store 900) not included
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (none present at Nokia in the period)
As-is product hierarchy (current subcategory and category via dim_product is_current)
Helsinki sale_date used for the date range
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold for store 118, same 28 days
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27, so 'period 5' is FY2026/27 P05, which is complete (ended 27 Sep 2026)
'Units sold' read as units on sales lines, before returns (returned units are not netted off)
'At Nokia' read as sales in the Nokia store (store_id 118), not web orders collected at or delivered near Nokia
Subcategory taken on the current product hierarchy (as-is); at Nokia in this period it makes no difference, as the subcategory on each sold version was the same as the current one
Sales in the store's own sale_date; staff purchases included
caveats: Control check: 2245 units from fact_sales_line at Nokia in the period matches rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold (2245) exactly
No duplicate sales lines, no test articles and no non-positive quantities found at Nokia in the period
Fixings & Fasteners is far ahead at 570 units, as it is a low-price high-count item; ranking is by units, not value
Third place is clear (Storage Boxes 139 against Plants & Flowers and Cleaning Products at 136 each), but the margin is only 3 units
Returns are not deducted from units sold; units after returns could change the ordering of places 3 onwards

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.format;
definitions_applied: Return rate: returned net (refund_net) divided by sold net, on the sale-week cohort
Sale-week cohort: returns attributed to the fiscal week the item was sold, regardless of return date
Exclusions: store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test per net sales scope
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (the complete fiscal year prior to the request date)
Period 2 refers to fiscal period 2 of FY2025/26 (fiscal weeks 5–8; 26 May–22 June 2025)
Store format includes physical store categories (Large, Medium, Small) and Web as a separate format
caveats: Return cohort is complete: all sales in the period are more than 30 days before the data cutoff (4 October 2026), so return data is not outstanding
Web return rate (12.23%) is substantially higher than physical stores (4.28–4.53%), consistent with higher online return expectations
Store 999 (training store) excluded; category ZZ Test excluded per company net sales definitions

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_tampere FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, on the current version of each member (is_current)
Store counts and store-level analyses cover physical stores only (store_id below 900)
Store 999 (training store) left out of all reporting
Home store is the member's home_store_id; the store's city is taken from the current dim_store version
Web shop (store 900) is kept out of the store count
assumptions: The warehouse has no customer table. The only identified customer is the loyalty member, so 'customers' is read as loyalty members.

'In Tampere' is read as a member whose home store is one of the four Tampere stores: 115 Tampere Hervanta (2,788 members), 116 Tampere Lielahti (1,721), 117 Tampere Kaleva (1,692) and 136 Tampere Lamminpää (974).

No activity filter was applied: all current members are counted, whether or not they have bought recently. The request does not define 'customer', and the dictionary's 'active member' (a purchase in the last 52 fiscal weeks) was not asked for.
Counted as of the warehouse load date, Sunday 4 October 2026, using the current member version.
caveats: 'Customer' has no company definition. The figure is loyalty members only. Shoppers who do not use a loyalty card cannot be identified in the data and are not included, so it is not a count of everyone who shops in Tampere. Jukka should confirm that this definition is the one he wants.

Correction: dim_store lists store 900 (the web shop) and store 999 (the training store) with city Tampere. Both are left out. Including them would wrongly add the online sign-ups (12,028 members with home store 900) and test or training records to a Tampere count.

Correction: dim_member keeps one row per member version, so counting rows would give 11,000+ for these stores instead of 7,175 because of the tier, home store and consent changes. Each member is counted once, on the current version. A member who moved home store between versions is counted only at the current home store.

Alternative readings, not used for the answer. Of the 7,175, 4,441 made a purchase in the last 52 fiscal weeks to 4 October 2026 (the dictionary's 'active member'). 7,648 distinct members bought in a Tampere store in that period, including members whose home store is elsewhere. 4,841 of the 7,175 have marketing consent, which matters if the number is meant for a mailing.
Members whose home store is online (store 900) are not placed in Tampere even though the web shop is registered in Tampere.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Member share of sales: net sales before returns on member-linked lines divided by all net sales before returns
Web sales identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (UTC converted to Europe/Helsinki)
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders have a dispatch date)
Guest web orders count as non-member
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Net amounts excluding VAT
Fiscal periods from dim_date (FY2025/26 P9 to P11)
Click-and-collect counted as web
assumptions: 'Last year' on a request dated 9 October 2026 (FY2026/27) is read as FY2025/26, following the precedent for 'last year' in FY2026/27 requests; periods 9 to 11 are therefore 22 December 2025 to 22 March 2026
'Share of web sales' is read as the company's member-share definition applied to web: net sales before returns, not net of returns
A loyalty member is any web order placed logged in, taken from the member key on the order header (fact_web_order.member_key)
Week 53 falls in P12, so it does not affect P9 to P11

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, f.vat_rate AS vat_rate, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 P05 = fiscal weeks 18-21, 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024

Format taken from the current store version (format is the same in every version of every store)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales, net_sales_before_returns measure

definitions_applied: Like-for-like (LFL) growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, compared week by week

Opening rule: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (open_date <= 27 Oct 2025 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no ref_store_closure refit overlap)
Fiscal weeks aligned by week number (weeks 27-39 in both years), not by calendar dates; week 53 never LFL
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT after returns, returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded

assumptions: Read 'Q3 last year' as FY2025/26 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27-39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), because FY2026/27 is the current fiscal year on 5 Oct 2026. This follows the earlier accepted reading of 'last year'.
The comparator is FY2024/25 weeks 27-39 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025), aligned on fiscal week number.

Regions are as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, because the request did not ask for as-was. Capital Region therefore includes stores 101-105 in both years, and Kouvola sits in South in both years.
'By region' means one row per region and no total row; the growth for each region is the combined LFL net sales of its stores, not an average of store growth rates.

Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) is in the base under the 364-day rule. Its comparator quarter was only its 8th to 21st week of trading, so it was still ramping up, and its growth is +39.0%. It lifts West: the +4.77% figure for West includes it.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, the last day of Q3. It traded all 13 weeks in both years, so it stays in East for the whole quarter.

The old reporting objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt_weekly_sales_by_region, dim_store_old, backups and staging tables) were not used.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending
),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, 
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.units_sold_4w, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) END AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c
LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category;
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover = closing stock units at end of fiscal week ÷ average weekly units sold over prior four fiscal weeks
Closing stock aggregated across all physical stores
Physical stores only (store_id < 900); test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Current product category hierarchy (as-is)
Last period = FY2026/27 P05, ending Sunday 2026-09-27 (fiscal week 21)
assumptions: Last period interpreted as the last completed fiscal period in the warehouse (FY2026/27 P05)
Prior four weeks are fiscal weeks 17–20 (the four weeks before the snapshot week)
Results aggregated across all physical stores
Categories grouped at the current hierarchy level

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, not the sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Cancelled and processing web orders excluded from web sales
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company includes the web shop (store 900) as well as the physical stores
Helsinki time for all day boundaries
Last period = last completed fiscal period (fiscal-calendar)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last month' is read as the last completed fiscal period, FY2026/27 P05 (Monday 31 Aug to Sunday 27 Sep 2026, fiscal weeks 18 to 21, 28 days). The company has no calendar-month definition, and fiscal periods are its reporting unit. It is the last period completed before the request date of 9 Oct 2026.
'Whole company' is read as the physical stores plus the web shop (store 900), excluding store 999.
Figure is in EUR excluding VAT, since net sales are always reported ex-VAT.

Store 999 and ZZ Test articles were filtered out. Store 999 had 139 sales lines in the period, which are not in the total.
The figure reconciles to rpt_daily_store_sales over 31 Aug to 27 Sep (1,109,546.52, gap 0.00), and all 28 days are present with no duplicate keys in sales lines, return lines or web orders.

rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used. They silently omit web sales from 3 Nov 2025, and some dashboards still use them, so dashboard figures for this period may be lower than this answer.
