answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank;
definitions_applied: DEF-STORE-LEAGUE: Net sales per trading day, physical stores ranked
DEF-NET-SALES: Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, excluding ZZ Test category
CAL-CLOSED-DAYS: Trading days account for store closures, refits, and closed holidays
REG-STORE-EVENTS: Store openings and closures from ref_store_closure tracked
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: Physical stores only (store_id < 900), excludes web and training stores
assumptions: Interpreted 'period 2 this year' as fiscal period 2 of FY2026/27 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28)
Ranked stores by net sales per trading day in descending order
Included all 38 stores with sales activity during the period
Kuopio (125) had only 14 trading days due to a refit closure mid-period (2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26)
caveats: Kuopio (store 125) was closed for refits during part of the period (counted only 14 trading days vs 26 for others)
Net sales per trading day is a proxy for daily sales productivity; absolute sales volume may vary by store size
Control total validated: query result matches rpt_daily_store_sales control total exactly (1,063,916.20 EUR)

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1 AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT l.subcategory, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
definitions_applied: Return rate = refund_net divided by sold net_amount (excluding VAT)
Sale-week cohort: returns are attributed to the original sale through sales_line_id, whenever and wherever they were booked
Goods selected by the fiscal period of fact_sales_line.sale_date (Helsinki business date)
As-is product hierarchy: current product version (dim_product is_current) for category and subcategory
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Web shop (store 900) lines and web returns included, as in the accepted return-rate requests
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 Q1 = periods 1 to 3, weeks 1 to 13, 28 Apr 2025 to 27 Jul 2025
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just completed (the 6 Oct 2026 request is in FY2026/27); this follows how earlier requests with 'last year' were read in FY2026/27
'Q1' read as fiscal Q1 (P1 to P3, 28 Apr to 27 Jul 2025), not calendar Q1
'Garden' read on the current (as-is) hierarchy, so outdoor lighting is in Electrical for the whole period
Rate is computed on value (net EUR), per the company definition, not on units
Web and store sales are combined in one rate per subcategory, with no web/store split since none was requested
Subcategory names are used as labels; they are unique within Garden, so no separate ID column is needed
caveats: Correction: five outdoor lighting articles (SKUs 100870, 100877, 100879, 100916, 100917) were delisted before the 27 Oct 2025 move of outdoor lighting from Garden to Electrical. answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (the 3 November 2025 platform migration broke channel_code)
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Cancelled and processing orders excluded from web sales (only delivered and collected orders are recognised)

WITH params AS (

JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key

answer.sql:
-- Like-for-like (LFL) net sales growth for P4 FY2026/27 vs P4 FY2025/26
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.region IS NULL
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST;
definitions_applied: DEF-LFL-BASIS: Physical stores only (store_id < 900); web shop excluded
DEF-LFL-OPEN: Store must have been open at least 52 weeks before the first day of the period
DEF-LFL-BOTH-YEARS: Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both comparison years
DEF-LFL-REFIT: Refit weeks from ref_store_closure are excluded for the store concerned in both years
DEF-LFL-WEEK53: Week 53 is never part of LFL (no comparator week)
DEF-NET-SALES: Net sales excluding VAT, after returns; store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
CAL-COMPARE: Comparison by fiscal week number (same weeks in both years)
assumptions: Period 4 'this year' interpreted as FY2026/27 P04 (the current fiscal year), not a past period
Fiscal weeks 14-17 define P4 in both FY2026/27 and FY2025/26
Request for a single total figure; regional breakdown not included per skill guidance
caveats: None. Period 4 FY2026/27 is fully loaded in the warehouse (complete as of 2026-08-30); the prior-year period FY2025/26 P04 is also complete.
LFL base includes 152 store-weeks (out of 160 possible: 40 stores × 4 weeks) - stores that did not trade in matching weeks in both years are excluded
Growth of -0.03% represents a decline of 265 euros on net sales of 1.01 million in the LFL base

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending
),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.units_sold_4w, 0) / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.units_sold_4w, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) END AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c
LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category;
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover: closing stock units divided by average weekly units sold over prior four fiscal weeks
Stock scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900), test category (ZZ Test) excluded
Semi-additive aggregation: closing units summed across stores and products within the snapshot week
assumptions: Last period interpreted as FY2026/27 P05, ending 2026-09-27 (the last completed fiscal period as of warehouse load date 2026-10-04)
Prior four weeks calculated as 34 days before to 7 days before snapshot date (covering fiscal weeks 18-21 of FY2026/27)
Weeks of cover aggregated across all physical stores, one figure per category
caveats: Categories shown are only those with closing inventory at the snapshot date; categories with zero stock do not appear
Seasonal category shows unusually high weeks of cover (48.8 weeks), consistent with pre-holiday inventory buildup typical for seasonal merchandise
Weeks of cover is null for any category with zero sales in the prior four weeks; this does not occur in the current result
Snapshot date is 27 September 2026, the Sunday ending fiscal week 21 of FY2026/27 P05

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT after line discounts, less returns booked on their return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: period 2 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8 (4-4-5 pattern)
Year-on-year comparison lined up by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Growth % = this year / last year - 1, in percent units
Control total: weekly figures checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (store 999 excluded)
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request received 5 Oct 2026). 'Last year' is FY2025/26.

Store 999 and ZZ Test articles are left out, as the company rules require. The weekly totals match the rpt_daily_store_sales control totals exactly, with no gap in any week, so these exclusions did not change the totals.

No duplicate sales lines or missing keys were found in the period. Both periods are fully loaded, since the warehouse is loaded through 4 Oct 2026. No cancelled or processing web orders appear in the sales lines in the range.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY atv DESC;
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value): net sales before returns divided by number of receipts
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900); staff purchases and test articles excluded
Fiscal calendar: Period 4 of FY2026/27 (fiscal weeks 14-17, 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30)
assumptions: Store format is the same across all store versions, so current-version join unnecessary
Net sales before returns means sales amounts from fact_sales_line without accounting for returns
Period 4 is the most recent completed period as of the request date (2026-10-09)
caveats: Staff purchases are excluded from ATV per company definition, reducing net sales by €14,796.76
Category 'ZZ Test' is excluded from the calculation
Web channel (store 900) and training store (999) are excluded; this is an ATV restriction, not a data issue

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT period_end_date AS cutoff FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8), members_at_cutoff AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m, p WHERE m.join_date <= p.cutoff AND p.cutoff BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to), purchasers AS (SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key = f.member_key, p WHERE f.sale_date > p.cutoff - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND f.sale_date <= p.cutoff) SELECT m.tier, count(*) AS active_members FROM members_at_cutoff m JOIN purchasers USING (member_id) GROUP BY m.tier ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

Member must have joined on or before the as-of date
Active member: at least one purchase line in fact_sales_line, store or web, in the 12 months up to and including the as-of date (2024-12-22 to 2025-12-21)
assumptions: 'Last year' read relative to the request date of 2026-10-07, which falls in FY2026/27, so last year is FY2025/26, and 'end of period 8' means the last day of that fiscal period, 2025-12-21

Returns are not netted off: a member who bought and then returned everything still counts as active
Members with no purchase in the 12 months are left out. Enrolled but inactive members are not shown, because the request asked for active members.

dim_member was checked for gaps, overlaps, duplicate current versions and impossible dates, and none were found. The 4,061 staged rows in stg_member_updates all start on or after 2026-09-04, so they do not affect this as-of date.

fact_sales_line has 418 receipt line pairs (receipt_id, line_no) that appear twice under different sales_line_id values, which looks like duplicate loading. This does not change the result, because each member is counted once if they have any purchase.
Sales history in the warehouse starts on 2024-04-29, so the full 12-month look-back is covered.

The backup, staging, tmp and _old tables were not used.

answer.sql:
WITH net_sales AS (
  -- Sales lines from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    cs.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_amount,
    0 AS return_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
    AND cp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, cs.region
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Return lines from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    cs.region,
    0 AS sales_amount,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS return_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, cs.region
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(sales_amount) - SUM(return_amount) AS net_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sales_amount) - SUM(return_amount) DESC) AS rank
  FROM net_sales
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  rank,
  region,
  ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns netted on their return date
Stores only: store_id < 900 (excludes web shop store 900 and training store 999)
As-is reporting: current region hierarchy (Capital Region includes stores that joined in April 2025)
Exclusions: test articles (category ZZ Test) filtered out
assumptions: This year = fiscal year FY2026/27 (4 May 2026 onwards)
Year-to-date = through the last loaded date in the warehouse (4 October 2026 / week 22)
Ranking is by net sales descending
caveats: Data is current through 4 October 2026. The request was received 6 October 2026, so two days of sales are not yet in the warehouse.

The five regions are North, South, East, West and Capital Region. Capital Region was created 28 April 2025 and includes stores 101, 102, 103, 104, 105. This query reports as-is (current hierarchy), so Capital Region totals include those stores for all history.
Test articles (category ZZ Test) have been excluded. Training store (999) has been excluded.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE ss.store_id = 900 AND rs.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales END) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excl. VAT, after returns; returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (dispatch_ts_utc converted from UTC), not the order date; for click-and-collect this is the ready-for-collection time
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code or channel_id, because neither works across the 3 November 2025 platform migration, which falls inside P7
Click-and-collect identified from fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, joined on receipt_id = web_order_id
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; one ZZ Test web line in the window was dropped
Fiscal periods from dim_date (fiscal_year, fiscal_period): P6 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 (5 weeks), P7 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025, P8 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025; all fully loaded
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, any stg_, bak_ or tmp_ table, or the old dim tables
Source grain checked: fact_sales_line is unique on sales_line_id and on receipt_id + line_no for the web lines in the window; each web sales line matched exactly one web order
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26. The request is dated 9 October 2026, which is in FY2026/27, and past requests in a new fiscal year took the fiscal year that had just ended (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35).
'Periods 6 to 8' read as FY2025/26 P6, P7 and P8, each as its own row. Together they run 22 Sep to 21 Dec 2025 and none includes week 53.
'Web shop's sales' read as net sales on the company definition (excluding VAT, after returns), not gross or order value.

Returns are netted against web sales only where the return line was booked to the web shop (store_id 900), as in the accepted web-only queries. Each return was assigned to click-and-collect or home delivery through its original sales line and web order.
Regions and categories play no part in this answer, so as-is versus as-was does not matter.
caveats: Channel columns: channel_code is empty and channel_id is used from 3 November 2025, which falls in P7, and click-and-collect before then carries channel_code WB with no channel_id. I used store_id 900 and fact_web_order.fulfilment_type instead. Using either channel column would have given a wrong P7 and a wrong P8.
Dispatch date versus order date: web net sales sit on the Helsinki dispatch date, so orders placed near a period boundary fall into the period of dispatch.
Excluded: one ZZ Test web line (27 Sep 2025, P6), plus cancelled and processing orders. Their effect on the shares is negligible.

Returns of web purchases booked in physical stores: many returns of web sales lines, both click-and-collect and home delivery, were processed in physical stores and are booked there. By the company rule they reduce those stores' net sales, so they are not netted against web here. If they were also netted against web, the shares would be about 27.51, 25.32 and 27.01 for P6, P7 and P8. Only P6 would move materially (about 0.3 points).
Before returns, the shares would be about 27.88, 25.99 and 27.13 for P6, P7 and P8.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply here: it covers net sales per store without a channel split, and this is a web-only share. I did not reconcile it for store 900.
Returns on web sales can arrive up to 30 days later. For these periods the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026, so returns are complete.

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT l.format AS store_format, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

Sale-week cohort: goods are selected by the fiscal period of the original sale date, and refunds follow the sold line through sales_line_id whenever they were booked
Net amounts excluding VAT
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Physical stores only (store_id below 900)
Store format taken from the store version on the sale date (format is the same in every version of a store)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2025/26 P02, fiscal weeks 5 to 8, 26 May 2025 to 22 June 2025

'What was sold' read as net sales before returns, and 'came back' as refunds on those lines, so the rate is on the sale-week cohort and not on returns booked in the period
'Store format' read as the three physical store formats Large, Medium and Small. The web shop (store 900, format Web) is shown in the caveats only
Staff purchases are left in, as in net sales and the return-rate template
caveats: The warehouse column comment for dim_store.format ('Hyper, Standard or Express') is out of date. The values in use are Large, Medium, Small, Web (the web shop) and Training. The answer uses the real values
Web shop for comparison, not in the table: 12.23% for the same period (sold 183098.49, refunded 22388.29, by order date and refunds following the line). Say if you want Web as a fourth row
The cohort is complete. The last sale in P2 was 22 June 2025 and the last matching return was 23 July 2025, well inside the 30-day return window and the 4 October 2026 load point

Checks done: no duplicate sales lines at sales_line_id or receipt_id and line_no, at most one return row per sales line, no refund above the line value or quantity above the quantity sold, and no return dated before its sale. The physical-store sold net (1101367.56) equals the net_sales_before_returns control total in rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days. No corrections to the data were needed
Store 999 and ZZ Test were filtered out of the sold lines. The filter did not change the totals for this period's formats
Rates are on value (EUR excluding VAT), not on units or number of lines

    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.region IS NULL
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST;
definitions_applied: Like-for-like sales (physical stores only, week-on-week comparison)
Store opening criterion (open 52+ weeks before period start)
Trading week (open and not closed, both years)
Refit closure exclusion (ref_store_closure)
Week 53 exclusion from LFL
Net sales (excluding VAT, after returns, return date timing)
Store scope (store_id < 900, excluding store 999 and test category ZZ Test)
assumptions: Period 1 this year = FY2025/26 P01 (fiscal weeks 1-4, 2025-04-28 to 2025-05-25)
Comparison year = FY2024/25 P01 (fiscal weeks 1-4, 2024-04-29 to 2024-05-26)
Request asks for overall LFL growth, not regional breakdown
Web shop (store 900) excluded from LFL
caveats: No data issues detected; query validates successfully against all checks

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_inc_vat FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6) GROUP BY d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales: transactions with channel_code = 'WB'
Including VAT: using gross_amount column
Q2 FY24/25: fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25', periods 4–6
Before returns: sales line amounts, undeducted
assumptions: Q2 of FY24/25 corresponds to fiscal periods 4, 5, and 6 as stated in the request
VAT is captured in the gross_amount column of fact_sales_line
Web channel is identified by channel_code = 'WB'
caveats: No data quality issues detected; all three periods have complete coverage from start to end date
Period 6 is longer (5 weeks) than periods 4 and 5 (4 weeks each), which explains the higher sales figure

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Average Transaction Value (ATV) = total net sales / number of distinct receipts
Web orders included via fact_sales_line channels 2 (web home delivery) and 3 (click and collect)
assumptions: "This year" refers to fiscal year FY2026/27
ATV is calculated at transaction level using net_amount and distinct receipt_id
All sales channels are included: store (channel 1), web home delivery (channel 2), and click and collect (channel 3)
ATV is presented per fiscal period as requested
caveats: No data quality issues detected
Fiscal period 1 spans 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-31, period 2 spans 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, period 3 spans 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02

answer.sql: SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id (dim_member holds one row per version)
Current tier read from the current member version (is_current = true, valid_to = 9999-12-31)
Canonical dim_member used; stg_member_updates and other staging or backup tables not used
assumptions: "Right now" is read as the current version of each member, as in the warehouse at the request date of 8 October 2026.

"Members on the Gold tier" is read as every loyalty member whose current tier is Gold, whether or not they have bought recently. The metric dictionary has no definition of a tier headcount. It defines only active members (a purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks), which is a narrower count and was not asked for.
No filter on marketing consent or home store, since none was requested.
caveats: The latest sale in the warehouse is 2026-10-04, so the data stops four days before the request date. Tier changes made between 4 and 8 October are not in the warehouse.

Data checks found no problems and no corrections were needed. Each of the 60,000 members has exactly one current version, and the current version is the same as the version valid on 8 October 2026. All tier values are Basic, Silver or Gold.

Counting every version row with tier Gold would give 8,203 (5,791 current plus 2,412 past), which overstates the answer because it includes past versions and members who have since changed tier. Only current versions were counted.
If Marketing wants only Gold members who are currently active buyers, that is a different, smaller number and needs a separate request.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, returns deducted on their own return date
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar from dim_date; prior year lined up by fiscal week number (same period number, same week numbers)
Growth % = this year / last year - 1, in percent
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P02: fiscal weeks 5 to 8, 1 to 28 June 2026, the most recently completed P2 and fully loaded
'Last year' read as FY2025/26 P02: fiscal weeks 5 to 8, 26 May to 22 June 2025, aligned by fiscal week number rather than calendar date
'Total company sales' read as net sales on the company definition (excluding VAT, after returns), with web included
Neither period contains week 53, so no week is dropped from the comparison
Weekly figures are in EUR, rounded to cents; growth is rounded to one decimal
caveats: Midsummer falls in different fiscal weeks in the two years: Midsummer Eve and Day (stores shut by law) were 20-21 June 2025 in week 8 last year, but 19-20 June 2026 in week 7 this year. This is why week 7 shows -32.2% and week 8 shows +76.4%. It is a calendar effect, not a trading collapse or a surge. Weeks 7 and 8 combined are 591,343.83 against 535,679.88, +10.4%. Weeks 5 and 6 are clean comparisons (+3.1% and +10.0%). Taken together, the whole period is 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70, +8.3% (not requested as a total row).

Week 8 this year (22 to 28 June 2026) includes a very high Monday, 22 June, at 70,416.55 (a normal Monday is about 44,000 to 51,000). I did not adjust it; it comes straight from the sales lines and agrees with the control table.
Stores 999 (training) and category ZZ Test were excluded, as the company rule requires. The excluded amount is small: 2,385.03 EUR in the 2026 period and 2,226.03 EUR in the 2025 period.
Results agree with the control total rpt_daily_store_sales on every one of the 56 days in the two periods (difference 0.00).

No data correction was needed for these periods. There are 418 duplicated (receipt_id, line_no) sales lines, but all fall in September 2025, outside both periods, so they do not affect this answer. They would affect any request covering September 2025.
No cancelled or processing web orders fall in the two periods; web revenue is dated on dispatch date in Helsinki time.
I did not use the deprecated rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales views, because they leave out web sales from 3 November 2025 onwards.

answer.sql:
WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_joined
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1
  AND join_date = '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id
New member joins: first version of each member in dim_member (by valid_from date)
Join date is the calendar date the member enrolled, in dim_member
assumptions: Request asks for the specific date 3 October 2026
Count includes all members regardless of tier, home store, or enrollment channel
caveats: Warehouse data is current through 2026-10-04; 2026-10-03 is the last complete trading day with data

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS this_year_net_sales, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only); sale_date is not used for web lines
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900) as part of the total, no breakdown
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: same fiscal week number, Monday to Sunday, compared with the same week of last year (not the same calendar dates)
Store and product versions joined through store_key and product_key as on the transaction date, so no rows multiplied
Control total: weekly figures checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (stores plus store 900, store 999 not in that table) over the same days. They agree to the cent in all 8 weeks.
Deprecated objects not used: no staging, backup or tmp tables, no rpt.v_daily_sales, and no channel_code
assumptions: Read 'period 2 this year' as FY2026/27 P2 (weeks 5 to 8, 1 June to 28 June 2026). It is complete, and the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.
Read 'last year' as FY2025/26 P2 (weeks 5 to 8, 26 May to 22 June 2025). This follows the reading used in past requests made during FY2026/27.
Read 'total company sales' as net sales excluding VAT on the company definition. The request did not ask for gross or including-VAT figures.
Read 'total company' as all physical stores that traded plus the web shop. This is not like-for-like, so no stores were removed for refits, closures or openings.
Growth is (this year / last year - 1) in percent for each fiscal week, rounded to 1 decimal. No row was added for the whole period.
caveats: Midsummer falls in different fiscal weeks: Midsummer Eve and Day (stores shut) fall in week 8 last year (20 and 21 June 2025) but in week 7 this year (19 and 20 June 2026). This is why week 7 shows -32.2% and week 8 shows +76.4%. The same-week comparison is correct under the company rules but misleading week by week. Weeks 7 and 8 combined are 591,343.83 this year against 535,679.88 last year, which is +10.4%. The whole period is 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70, which is +8.3%.

This is total company, not like-for-like. The store count differs between years. Last year had 40 stores. This year Savonlinna (129, closed 25 January 2026) is gone, so there are 39 in weeks 5 and 6, and Kuopio (125) is in a refit from 15 June 2026, so there are 38 in weeks 7 and 8. This pulls this year's growth down. Growth is not a like-for-like measure, and LFL would be a separate request.
Filters changed the totals slightly. Store 999 sales (about 215 to 889 EUR a week) and ZZ Test articles (about 6 to 52 EUR a week) were left out of the sales lines, as the company rules require.
Returns reduce net sales on their return date. The weekly totals therefore include refunds on goods sold earlier, including on shut Midsummer days, when some store rows show small negative net sales.
Web sales are on the dispatch date, so the web part of each week can include orders placed in the previous week.

The source rows were checked and no data defects were found in these weeks: no duplicate sales lines, no zero or negative quantity or amount lines, every web line has a dispatched order, and no processing or cancelled orders carry lines. So no data correction was needed.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date taken in Helsinki time (UTC converted to Europe/Helsinki, day changes at local midnight)
Cancelled orders excluded; processing orders would be included (none on that day)
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (checked: no such orders on the day, so the filter changed nothing)
Did not use channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated table
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 is Monday 1 December 2025, as given in the request
'Web orders placed' means orders placed on that Helsinki calendar day, whatever their later status, with cancelled orders left out per the company definition
Guest and logged-in orders are both included
caveats: 345 orders were placed on the day in total; 19 were cancelled and are excluded, leaving 326 (239 delivered, 87 collected). If cancelled orders should be included, the figure is 345.
The Helsinki date matters: 61 of the 345 orders have a UTC date different from their Helsinki date. Counting by UTC date would give a different number.
No duplicate order ids in fact_web_order, no test-article or store 999 orders on the day, and every counted order has sales lines, so no data corrections were needed.
The count is of orders placed on 1 December 2025; it is not web sales, which are dated on dispatch.

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9) AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999) GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT from fact_sales_line
Sales before returns (return lines excluded)
Regional assignments from dim_store valid at transaction date
assumptions: Excluded web shop (store_id 900) and training store (store_id 999) as non-retail operations
Used North, South, East, West regional classification from dim_store for the period
caveats: No data quality issues detected; all 81,991 sales lines across Aug/Sep 2024 had valid gross amounts

answer.sql: WITH net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin = net sales (excl. VAT) minus standard cost, both after returns; returns credited on their return date at standard_cost_returned
Fiscal calendar: Q4 = P10 to P12 of the fiscal year (27 Jan 2025 to 27 Apr 2025 for FY2024/25), filtered via dim_date
Regions as-is: current store version, so South includes Kouvola (114) and excludes the Capital Region stores (101 to 105) for all history
Products grouped by SKU on the current product version (as-is), per the margin-by-product pattern used in past requests
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales and margin
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); the web shop is its own region (Online) and is not part of South
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
assumptions: Q4 of FY24/25 is read as FY2024/25 P10 to P12 (weeks 40 to 52, 27 Jan to 27 Apr 2025). The request names the year explicitly, so no relative reading was needed.
FY24/25 is the fiscal year FY2024/25, which has 52 weeks, so there is no week 53 to consider.

South is read as-is (current regional hierarchy), the company default, because the request did not ask for as-was. As-was, Kouvola would be in East and the six stores now in the Capital Region would be in South, which would change the ranking.
Top 10 ranks by gross margin in EUR (not margin %), and products are articles (SKU), not subcategories or brands.

Net sales and cost are after returns booked in the quarter, matching the company definition. Returns of goods sold before the quarter reduce the quarter, and returns after 27 April 2025 on goods sold in the quarter are not netted.
caveats: Store-level control total: net sales for the ten South stores (106 to 114 and 137) agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to the cent for the quarter. The check was done at store level, not by product, because the report table has no product dimension.
No data problems found in this range: no duplicate sales or return lines, no orphan dimension keys, no null or non-positive quantities or costs, one current version per SKU and store.
Store 999 and ZZ Test filters were applied. They did not change the South totals, since those items sit in store 999 and web test orders.

Kouvola (114) is in South as-is but was in East until 28 April 2025, and Lohja (137) opened on 4 November 2024, so it was trading for the whole quarter. A Capital Region reading of the old South would give a different list.
The ranking is by gross margin in EUR. The product at rank 2 (Interior Paint Norvik 298) has a much lower margin rate (about 31%) than the leader (about 55%).
Product names and subcategories come from the current product version. SKUs 101888 (Indoor Lighting) and similar articles show their current classification.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (excluding VAT) divided by distinct sales receipts
Physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop (900) excluded
Store 999 (training store) excluded
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Dated by Helsinki sale_date
Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 taken from dim_date (3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, weeks 14-17)
Store format from dim_store (format is the same in every store version)
assumptions: 'Period 4 of FY26/27' is read as FY2026/27 P4, the fiscal year given in the warehouse's label form
'Basket value' is read as the company ATV (average transaction value) and not as a gross-of-VAT figure
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT, since ATV is built on net sales
Returns are not deducted, which is how ATV is defined
Format is the store's format on the sale date, which is the same as its current format for all stores
caveats: The format values in the warehouse are Large, Medium and Small. The schema comment ('Hyper, Standard or Express') is out of date, so the labels follow the data.
Period 4 is fully loaded, so there is no part-period issue.
I found no duplicate sales lines at receipt_id and line_no in P4. The Large, Medium and Small receipt counts (6,508 / 8,641 / 2,598) are consistent with the staff-purchase exclusion.

Before the staff exclusion, my net sales and receipt counts agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales by format for P4 (Large 400,409.69 / 6,607; Medium 528,036.85 / 8,779; Small 133,820.18 / 2,641). The staff exclusion therefore removes 99, 138 and 43 receipts respectively, which is intended.
No test-article lines appear in the physical stores in P4, so the ZZ Test filter did not change the figures.
Store 129 (Small) closed on 2026-01-25 and does not trade in P4. Stores 136 and 137 opened in late 2024 and trade in full. No correction was needed for either.
I did not run the query_check script. The control comparison was done by hand with SQL.

answer.sql: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', f.sale_date), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Sales including VAT: sum of gross_amount on the sales lines, with each line's own VAT rate
Store sales: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 left out
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Before returns: refund lines (fact_return_line) not deducted
Store lines dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Staff purchases included

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 15 AS campaign_id
),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) AS mean_net_sales_per_member
FROM by_group
WHERE member_group IN ('targeted', 'holdout')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'uplift (targeted - holdout)',
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2)
FROM by_group
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift (DEF-UPLIFT): mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member
Net sales scope (DEF-NET-SALES-SCOPE): net sales before returns, excludes store 999 and category ZZ Test
Web recognition (DEF-WEB-RECOGNITION): web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time (delivered or collected orders)
Member versions (REG-MEMBER-VERSIONS): member_key on exposure date linked to current member_id
Campaign window: start_date through end_date plus 7 days (2025-11-24 through 2025-12-07)
assumptions: Campaign identification: matched 'Black Week 2025' exactly by name; found campaign_id 15 active 2025-11-24 to 2025-11-30
Member groups: targeted = distinct member_id with at least one exposure; holdout = members in campaign_holdout table (no overlap by design)
Members with zero sales in the window: counted as zero spend in the average (both groups include non-purchasing members)
caveats: No data issues detected; overlap check returned zero (correct for holdout design)
Uplift interpretation: the €1.41 per-member difference is 17.8% higher spend in the targeted group (1.41 / 7.94)
Campaign window extends 7 days beyond end_date per the template standard; dates are 2025-11-24 through 2025-12-07

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS store_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled')
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((store_sales.store_net_sales + web_sales.web_net_sales) / 
           (store_sales.store_receipts + web_sales.web_orders), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales, web_sales;
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value): net sales before returns divided by number of receipts
Net sales before returns: excluding returns, test articles (category ZZ Test), and store 999
Store receipts: physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding staff purchases
Web orders: counted on Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order, excluding cancelled orders
Web sales: recognized on dispatch date, staff purchases excluded
assumptions: "This year" means FY2026/27 (fiscal year that started 4 May 2026)
"Periods 1 to 3" means fiscal periods 1, 2, and 3 of FY2026/27 (4 May to 2 August 2026)
"Web orders should be in it too" means include web sales and web order counts in the ATV calculation, contrary to the standard ATV definition that excludes web
Staff purchases are included in net sales but excluded from receipt count per the company ATV definition
caveats: The standard Tuomimetsä ATV definition excludes web orders. This calculation includes them per Mika's explicit request, producing a company-wide ATV of 56.14 compared to store-only ATV of 55.52
Web sales are dated by Helsinki dispatch time, which may differ from the UTC order timestamp by up to 3 hours

Store receipts: 66,984 (net sales 3,719,186.33); web orders: 13,004 (net sales 771,530.75)

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day

WITH web_dispatch AS (

    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT n.sku, n.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS total_net_sales

definitions_applied: Members: loyalty program members identified by stable member_id
Current members: the latest version of each member record (is_current = TRUE)
Tampere customers: members whose home_store_id is assigned to a Tampere store location
assumptions: Interpreted 'customers in Tampere' as loyalty members registered to Tampere stores, not web shop (900) or training store (999)
Counted current member versions only, excluding historical versions
Did not require that members have made a purchase; counted all registered members
caveats: This count includes members registered to Tampere but may not have purchased recently
Alternative interpretation: 11,967 distinct members have made at least one purchase transaction at a Tampere store location (includes members from other regions who visited Tampere stores)
Web shop (store 900) is assigned to Tampere in the data but is not a physical location; customers who signed up online (home_store_id = 900) are not included in this count
The query-check validation passed with no deprecated objects or house-rule violations

answer.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900), sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period <= 5 GROUP BY ALL), rets AS (SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_period <= 5 GROUP BY ALL), net AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt,0) net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_week)), pairs AS (SELECT c.region, n1.store_id, n1.fiscal_week, n0.net_sales ly, n1.net_sales ty FROM net n1 JOIN net n0 ON n0.store_id=n1.store_id AND n0.fiscal_week=n1.fiscal_week AND n0.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=n1.store_id WHERE n1.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND n1.store_id NOT IN (136,137)) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(ty)/sum(ly) DESC) AS rank, region, round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM pairs GROUP BY region ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Net sales = store sales lines net_amount (EUR excl. VAT) minus refund_net on return lines, returns taken on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Stores only: store_id below 900, so the web shop (900) and the training store (999) are out
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: this year is FY2026/27, compared with FY2025/26 on the same fiscal weeks (weeks 1 to 21, periods 1 to 5), so weekdays line up
Current region of each store (dim_store.is_current) used for both years, which gives five regions: North, Capital Region, West, South, East
Like-for-like basis: only store-weeks that traded in both years, and stores open for the whole of the base year (stores 136 and 137 opened in Sep and Nov 2024 and are still ramping up)
assumptions: 'How they are doing this year so far' is read as like-for-like net sales growth against the same fiscal weeks last year, because that is the fair comparison across regions. A plain net sales total would mostly reward region size.
'This year' is the fiscal year FY2026/27. 'So far' ends at the close of fiscal period 5 (27 Sep 2026), the last period marked fully loaded. Period 6 is partly loaded and is excluded.
Staff purchases are kept in net sales, as they are in the reporting table.
Region ranking is by growth percentage, with 1 as the best performer.
caveats: Correction: the region mapping changed on 28 Apr 2025. The Helsinki-area stores (101 to 105) moved from South to a new Capital Region, and Kouvola (114) moved from East to South. I used each store's current region for both years so the comparison is not distorted. The dim_store column comment still lists only four regions.

Correction: Kuopio (125, East) was closed for a refit from 15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026 (fiscal weeks 7 to 12). Pori (119, West) was closed for a refit from 8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025, which removes fiscal weeks 20 and 21 of last year from the comparison. I dropped those store-weeks from both years.

Correction: Savonlinna (129, East) closed on 25 Jan 2026 and has no sales this year, but traded last year. It is excluded from the like-for-like figures. East's raw totals fall 11.8% mainly because of this closure and the Kuopio refit, whereas like-for-like it is -0.28%.

Correction: stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (West) and 137 Lohja (South) opened in late 2024. Both grow strongly this year because they are ramping up (about +10% and +28% net-of-returns respectively), so they are excluded as non-comparable. The old temporary like-for-like store lists (tmp_lfl_store_list tables) also leave them out.
The channel_code column is NULL on the sales lines I looked at (from 4 May 2026), so I did not use it. Stores and the web shop were told apart by store_id on the store key.
rpt_daily_store_sales matches my fact-table figures except for West in FY2025/26, where its net-before-returns figure is about EUR 10.4k lower than the fact table. I used the fact tables.

For reference, the unadjusted store net sales for FY2026/27 up to period 5 (all stores, no like-for-like) rank West 1,746,048, South 1,258,389, East 917,436, Capital Region 908,152, North 703,520. This differs from the growth ranking because of region size, the closures and the new stores.
The last days of the loaded data (3 to 4 Oct 2026) look lighter than the same weekdays in earlier weeks. They are outside the period used here and I did not investigate them.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) rn FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE rn = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders); cancelled and processing orders excluded
Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns (returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned); margin % = gross margin / net sales
As-is reporting: categories taken from the current product version (matched on sku and is_current), so outdoor lighting sits in Electrical for all history
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included, as the request is by category and not limited to stores
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: period 6 of FY2025/26 is 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025, 5 weeks
Did not use channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales or any stg_, bak_ or tmp_ table
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27, following how past requests of this kind were read (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). FY2025/26 is named in the answer.
'Period 6' read as fiscal period 6 of that year. The current P6 of FY2026/27 is not used; it has only one week loaded.
Categories reported as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, since the request did not ask for as-was.
One row per category, since the request names the two categories and asks for no further breakdown. No combined Garden plus Electrical row was added.
Web sales are included in both categories, as the request has no channel restriction.
caveats: Duplicate sales lines: fact_sales_line holds 418 receipt lines that were loaded twice (same receipt_id and line_no, identical content, a second load on 23 Sep 2025). They all fall on 15 to 21 Sep 2025, just before period 6. I removed duplicates on (receipt_id, line_no). This did not change the period-6 figures, because none of the 418 lines falls in the period, either by sale date or by web dispatch date. Anyone aggregating weeks 20 and 21 of FY2025/26 should dedupe.

As-is vs as-was: on the current hierarchy, the outdoor lighting articles (1,020 period-6 lines, about 36,065 EUR of net sales before returns) count under Electrical. As-was, they would have been in Garden, because they only moved on 27 Oct 2025, the day after period 6 ended. Garden would then be higher and Electrical lower. Say if you want the as-was view.
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, so returns of goods sold in earlier periods reduce period 6, and returns of period-6 sales arriving later are not in these figures.
No store-level control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales was done, because the figures are for a category subset and that check does not apply to one.
Figures exclude VAT.

answer.sql: SELECT r.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date dd ON r.business_date = dd.calendar_date JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY r.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales from rpt_daily_store_sales (EUR excluding VAT)
Current store dimension (is_current = TRUE)
assumptions: Request for "period 2 this year" interpreted as fiscal period 2 of FY2026/27 (current fiscal year as of request date 2026-10-07)
Ranking ordered by net sales in descending order (primary business metric for store performance)
Web shop (store_id 900) included as a valid location in the ranking
caveats: Store 125 (Kuopio) has partial data: closed for refit 2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26, therefore only 14 trading days of sales data included
All other stores have 26 trading days of data (28 calendar days minus 2 non-trading public holidays: Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day)
Web shop sales reflect all online channel activity aggregated to store_id 900

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_member_count FROM dim_member WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE
definitions_applied: Current member: is_current = TRUE (the latest version of each member record in the slowly-changing dimension)
Member tier: tier column value = 'Gold'
assumptions: Interpreted 'right now' to mean the current state of member records (is_current = TRUE), not a snapshot at a specific date
Counted distinct member records marked as current and on Gold tier

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY cp.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost, both after returns, with returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned
Gross margin percentage: gross margin divided by net sales
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, delivered and collected orders only
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
As-is hierarchy: category taken from the current product version (dim_product.is_current)
Fiscal calendar: period 6 taken from dim_date (22 Sep 2025 to 26 Oct 2025, weeks 22 to 26)
