answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only; cancelled and processing orders excluded)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal calendar: last period means the last completed fiscal period
Helsinki time for date boundaries (UTC timestamps converted)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: The company reports in fiscal periods and has no definition of a calendar month. I read 'last month' as the last completed fiscal period, FY2026/27 P05 (Monday 31 August to Sunday 27 September 2026, 4 whole weeks). The request was received on 9 October 2026 and the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.
'Whole company' means all physical stores plus the web shop (store 900), shown as one total.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT, the company definition of net sales.
caveats: If you meant calendar September 2026 (1 to 30 September) rather than the fiscal period, the figure is 1179035.98 EUR (stores 988592.16 plus web 190443.82). The fiscal-period figure of 1109546.52 EUR is made up of stores 932309.19 plus web 177237.33.

I found no data errors in the range, so there were no corrections to apply. Checks passed: the result equals the rpt_daily_store_sales control total exactly, for both the fiscal period and calendar September. There are no duplicate sales or return lines, and no returns without a matching sale. Return dates and Helsinki-converted timestamps agree.

Store 999 and ZZ Test lines were excluded as the company definition requires. In P05 that removes 112 lines from store 999 (training store) plus 27 test-article lines there, and one ZZ Test line on the web.
Web orders still in 'processing' (296 orders, all placed on or after 1 October 2026) and cancelled orders have no revenue date and are not in the figure. None of them affects P05.

Kemi (store 133) recorded no sales on Monday 31 August 2026, while the other 37 stores traded. It is a very small store (about 350 EUR a day), so this is probably a genuine zero-sales day, but I could not confirm it from the data.

The web shop's net sales are slightly lower than web dispatches alone suggest on some Sundays because returns booked to the web shop (for example on 27 September) are netted against that day. This is the company definition: returns reduce net sales on their return date.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 GROUP BY 1) SELECT 4 AS fiscal_period, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 'FY2025/26' AS comparison_fiscal_year, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period against the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (store 900) never in LFL
LFL base rule: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (open_date <= 2026-08-03 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open/close dates and ref_store_closure checked)
Net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, with returns dated on their return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Same fiscal weeks (14 to 17) lined up, not calendar dates
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for P4 in both years
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as FY2026/27 P4 (weeks 14 to 17, 3 to 30 August 2026), which is complete because the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026
'Last year' read as FY2025/26 P4 (weeks 14 to 17, 28 July to 24 August 2025), consistent with past requests since May 2026
Returned a single LFL total (this year, last year, growth) because no breakdown was requested
Open and close dates taken from the current dim_store version
caveats: Store 129 Savonlinna (closed 25 January 2026) traded in P4 last year but not this year, so it is out of the LFL base. The base is 38 of 39 physical stores, 152 store-weeks.

No refit closure overlaps P4 in either year (Kuopio's refit ended 26 July 2026 and Pori's started in September 2025), so no store lost weeks to refits. Both new stores, Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137), had been open over 52 weeks and are in the base.
Growth is essentially flat at -0.03%, a difference of about 265 EUR on roughly 1.01 million EUR, so it should be read as no change.
Web sales are excluded by definition. Store-level net sales for all physical stores agreed with rpt_daily_store_sales in both years, with no store differing by more than 0.5 EUR.
I found no duplicate sales or return lines, negative or null amounts, or missing days in the P4 data for either year, so no data corrections were made.

Returns are dated on their return date, so P4 net sales include refunds for earlier sales and exclude later returns of P4 sales. Dashboards built on rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, on the date of return (not original sale)
Trading days: days the store was open (after opening, before closure, outside refit closures, not a closed holiday)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900)
Exclusions: store 999 and category ZZ Test
Staff purchases: included in net sales
assumptions: Period 5 last year interpreted as FY2025/26 P5 (fiscal weeks 18-21, 2025-08-25 to 2025-09-21), the most recent completed P5 as of the request date 2026-10-08
Trading day count includes all days dim_date.is_trading_day = true within the period when the store was open and not in a refit
caveats: Store 119 (Pori) has only 14 trading days due to a refit closure from 8 September to 12 October 2025, which began during this period

Control total check shows a discrepancy for store 116 (result 47,679.15 vs rpt_daily_store_sales 37,288.62, gap 10,390.53); the cause is not apparent and should be investigated with the Data & Analytics team

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), spend AS (SELECT l.member_id, SUM(l.net_amount) AS spend FROM lines l, camp c WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end GROUP BY 1), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15), holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15), t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM targeted x LEFT JOIN spend sp USING (member_id)), h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0)) AS avg_spend FROM holdout x LEFT JOIN spend sp USING (member_id)) SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, ROUND(t.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur, ROUND(h.avg_spend, 2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur, ROUND(t.avg_spend - h.avg_spend, 2) AS uplift_eur FROM camp c, t, h
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift: mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member, over the campaign window plus seven days
Targeted member: at least one exposure row in the campaign, reduced to distinct member_id through dim_member
Holdout from campaign_holdout by member_id (not member_key), distinct
Members with no sales counted as zero spend in both groups
Net sales before returns, excluding VAT, on lines linked to the member (member_key mapped to member_id)
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered or collected orders), not the order date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Checked that no member is in both groups
assumptions: Black Week 2025 is campaign_id 15 (24 to 30 Nov 2025); Black Week 2024 is a different campaign and was not used
The measurement window is 24 Nov 2025 to 7 Dec 2025 inclusive (campaign window plus seven days)
Spend is before returns, as the campaign uplift definition says; refunds were not netted off
Uplift is a plain difference of means in euros, with no significance test or confidence interval
Targeted group is 23,818 members and holdout group is 2,747 members
caveats: No data corrections were needed. The two groups do not overlap, no duplicate sales lines or exposure ids were found, every holdout and targeted member had marketing consent on the campaign start date, and no held-out member received a contact.

The uplift is small against the underlying spend: only about 13.8% of targeted members (3,279) and 11.8% of held-out members (323) bought anything in the window. The difference of EUR 1.41 per member is based on 323 holdout buyers and has not been tested for statistical significance.
Targeted plus holdout members come to 26,565, against a mailing_list_size of 26,573 in dim_campaign, so 8 members are not accounted for. The effect on the averages is negligible.

1,951 exposure rows are marked as not delivered. Members were still counted as targeted if they had at least one exposure row, as the definition says. A delivered-only definition would give a different, probably larger, uplift.
The rpt_daily_store_sales control total does not apply to a member subset, so it was not used. Spend by fiscal period was not checked against it.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, delivered and collected orders only
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal calendar: period 2 is 4 weeks, fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday to Sunday
Prior-year comparison lined up by fiscal week number, not by calendar date
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (asked 7 October 2026). Period 2 ran 1 June to 28 June 2026 and is fully loaded.
'Last year' read as FY2025/26, whose period 2 ran 26 May to 22 June 2025, also 4 weeks and fully loaded.
Weeks are lined up by fiscal week number (5 to 8) against the same fiscal weeks last year, as in the accepted weekly year-on-year requests.
Total company includes the web shop and all physical stores that traded, including stores that were closed or being refitted for part of either year.
growth_pct is this year over last year minus 1, in percent, rounded to one decimal. net_sales_this_year is FY2026/27 and net_sales_last_year is FY2025/26. Both are EUR excluding VAT.
caveats: Midsummer falls in different fiscal weeks. Stores shut on Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (Friday and Saturday). This year that was 19 and 20 June 2026, in week 7. Last year it was 20 and 21 June 2025, in week 8. That drives the swing in the two weeks: week 7 is -32.2% and week 8 is +76.4%. Both are real calendar effects, not data errors. Over the whole of period 2 the two Midsummer weeks roughly offset each other (weeks 7 and 8 together: 591,344 this year against 535,680 last year, about +10.4%).

Store 125 (Kuopio) was in a refit closure from 15 June to 26 July 2026. It had no sales in weeks 7 and 8 this year, which lowers those weeks against last year. Store 129 (Savonlinna) closed on 25 January 2026, so it contributes to last year's weeks but not this year's. This is total company growth, not like-for-like, so these store effects are included.

Week 8 this year opens with an unusually high web figure on Monday 22 June (about 34,500 against a usual 7,000 to 16,000 on a Monday). Web sales are recognised on the dispatch date, so web orders that waited over Midsummer were dispatched that day. This is as the definition requires and was not adjusted.
Correction applied: 248 sales lines in store 999 or category ZZ Test, across both years' period 2, were excluded under company rules.

The weekly figures match the rpt_daily_store_sales control total exactly for all 8 weeks. I checked the period for duplicate sales or return lines, orphan returns, missing dimension keys, and web lines tied to cancelled or processing orders, and found none. rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used, because they omit web sales from 3 November 2025.
Period 2 of FY2026/27 has no week 53 issue. Period 2 of both years has exactly 4 fiscal weeks, so all 4 weeks have a comparator.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), sales_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) AS year, SUM(gross_amount) AS sales_incl_vat FROM sales_lines WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) ORDER BY year, month
definitions_applied: Sales including VAT: sum of gross_amount from fact_sales_line, which includes each line's own VAT rate
Web sales: recognised on Helsinki dispatch date, not order date
Store scope: excludes store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test
Before returns: gross sales without deducting refunds
assumptions: Interpreted calendar months August 2024 and September 2024 literally as all sales with calendar dates in those months
Total company figure: all physical stores and web aggregated together, not broken down by store or category
caveats: VAT rate changed on 1 September 2024 from 24% to 25.5% on general-rate items; every line carries its own rate so no flat-rate assumption needed
Verified against rpt_daily_store_sales control total: net sales before returns match exactly (August: 1241886.32, September: 1091919.49 EUR ex VAT)

answer.sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.closing_units) AS closing_units FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), sold AS (SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4w FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, k.category, ROUND(k.closing_units / (v.units_4w / 4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover FROM stock k JOIN sold v ON v.category = k.category ORDER BY k.category
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover = closing stock units at the end of a fiscal week divided by average weekly units sold over the prior four fiscal weeks
Last period = last completed fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, ended Sunday 27 September 2026)
Closing stock is a snapshot: summed across stores and products within the single week-ending date, never across weeks
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by sale_date
Stock and units sold both cover physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store 999 left out
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out of stock and units sold
Category as-is: current product version via sku and is_current
Did not use channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales, stg_/bak_/tmp_ tables or old dim tables
assumptions: 'End of last period' is read as the last week of FY2026/27 P05, week 21, snapshot dated Sunday 27 September 2026. P06 is incomplete (only week 22 loaded) so it is not used.

'Prior four fiscal weeks' is read literally as the four weeks before the snapshot week: fiscal weeks 17 to 20 (Monday 24 August to Sunday 20 September 2026), and not the four weeks of P05 (weeks 18 to 21), which would include the snapshot week.
Units sold are gross units on sales lines (staff purchases included, returns not netted off), as the weeks-of-cover definition says quantity on sales lines.
Categories are as-is (current hierarchy); the outdoor lighting move from Garden to Electrical (27 October 2025) does not affect these weeks, since all the dates are after it.
One row per category as the request says 'by category'; no total row.
caveats: Checked the stock snapshot at its grain for week ending 27 September 2026: 27,143 rows, all distinct on store_key, product_key and week_ending_date, one load, no duplicate store and sku rows, no negative units, and no rows for store 900, store 999 or ZZ Test, so no correction to the stock was needed. All 38 stores in the snapshot are physical stores.

Checked fact_sales_line for fiscal weeks 16 to 21: no duplicate sales_line_id or receipt and line_no, no zero or negative quantities. Web (store 900), store 999 and ZZ Test lines were present in those weeks and were excluded.

The stock snapshot holds only articles the store ranges (carries). Cover is therefore computed on ranged stock, while units sold come from all sales lines in physical stores, including any article not in the snapshot for that store and week. The two sides were not matched at store-and-article level.

Seasonal (48.8 weeks) and Furniture (29.5 weeks) have very low weekly sales against the stock held, so their cover figures are high. Seasonal's stock is largely concentrated in a few high-quantity lines (max 172 units per store and article).
Weeks of cover is a point-in-time ratio based on a four-week sales average and does not allow for seasonality or promotions.
Result is for the data loaded through 4 October 2026.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year,
           5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    -- Total company: group by fiscal week only
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

WITH params AS (

           5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week

web_dispatch AS (

    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,

    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key

weekly AS (

)
SELECT ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_sales,

WITH stock_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category, 
         SUM(fsw.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_cat AS (
  SELECT dp.category,
         SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT s.category,
       ROUND(s.closing_units * 4.0 / sal.total_units_sold, 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_cat s
INNER JOIN sales_by_cat sal ON s.category = sal.category
ORDER BY s.category

Last period = FY2026/27 fiscal period 5 (fully loaded period ending 2026-09-27)

Stock counted at week-ending date 2026-09-27 (Sunday of fiscal week 22)
All quantities measured in units; excludes value calculations
assumptions: Interpreted 'last period' as the most recently fully-loaded fiscal period (P05), not the in-progress P06

Report includes only categories with both closing inventory and period sales; excludes categories with zero stock or zero sales
caveats: Category ZZ Test had 28 units sold during P05 but zero closing stock, suggesting stock-out or a test/placeholder product; excluded from report as it has no inventory to measure cover for

Weeks of cover varies significantly by category: Garden and Seasonal categories show high cover (15.9 and 36.5 weeks), while Cleaning & Household and Tools & Hardware show lower cover (6.56 and 6.6 weeks), indicating different inventory strategies or turnover rates
All figures are current at the end of P05 (2026-09-27); week-ending date stock comes from the Sunday closing, and period sales span the full 28-day period

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY cp.category ORDER BY cp.category

Stores = channel_code ST on real stores only (store_id below 900)

The standard rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, inside this period. 24% applies to sales 26-31 August and 25.5% to sales 1-22 September, so the two standard-rate rows are two parts of one rate class. Both rates are applied as recorded.

Returns are not netted. VAT refunded on returns in the real stores in the period was 11135.97 EUR (return date basis). If Finance wants net VAT after refunds, this must be deducted by rate, and the split of refunds by rate was not calculated.

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS d1, DATE '2025-09-21' AS d2), sales AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.receipt_id, f.line_no) f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.store_key, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d1 AND p.d2 ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.etl_loaded_at), sales_by_store AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(x.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM sales x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key GROUP BY 1), returns_by_store AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key, p WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.d1 AND p.d2 GROUP BY 1), stores AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store, p WHERE p.d2 BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND store_id < 900) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(a.sales_net,0) - coalesce(b.refunds_net,0) DESC) AS rank, st.store_id, st.store_name, st.region, round(coalesce(a.sales_net,0) - coalesce(b.refunds_net,0), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM stores st LEFT JOIN sales_by_store a USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN returns_by_store b USING (store_id) ORDER BY rank

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_week, 13 AS last_week
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND cp.category = 'Garden'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net 
    FROM fact_return_line 
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.subcategory;
definitions_applied: Return rate on sale-week cohort (returns attributed to the fiscal week of original sale, not return date)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded per company scope definition
assumptions: Q1 of last year interpreted as FY2025/26 Q1 (fiscal weeks 1–13, 28 April – 27 July 2025)
Current product version used to identify Garden category; all sales in the period came from Garden
caveats: All return cohorts are complete. Maximum sale date is 30+ days before warehouse load date (4 October 2026), so all returns within 30 days of sale have been captured.
Outdoor Lighting shows €375 total sales with no returns in this period.

answer.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current), per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe, weeks_in_period w FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5), stk AS (SELECT c.category, sum(f.closing_units) units, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe GROUP BY 1), stk_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per WHERE f.week_ending_date=per.pe), sal AS (SELECT c.category, sum(f.quantity) units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku, per WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stk_stores) GROUP BY 1) SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, stk.category, round(stk.units / (sal.units_sold / per.w), 1) AS weeks_of_cover FROM stk JOIN sal USING (category), per ORDER BY stk.category
definitions_applied: Last period = last fully loaded, completed fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, from ref_fiscal_calendar)
Closing stock = fact_stock_week closing_units at the period-end Sunday 2026-09-27
Weeks of cover = closing stock units divided by average weekly units sold over the period (units sold / weeks_in_period = 4)
Category taken from the current product version (dim_product.is_current) for both stock and sales, joined by SKU
Sales scope = lines in the 38 physical stores that hold stock rows at the period end
Fiscal period boundaries from ref_fiscal_calendar, not calendar months
assumptions: Last period read as FY2026/27 P05, because P06 (28 Sep to 1 Nov) is still running and flagged fully_loaded = false
Weeks of cover measured in units, not stock value at cost
Demand is the average weekly sales of the period just ended (4 weeks), a backward-looking rate and not a forecast
Sales are gross units sold, with returns not netted off, and staff purchases included because they deplete stock
Web and other pseudo-location (store_id 900 and above) sales are left out because the stock table holds no stock for those locations
caveats: Outdoor Lighting SKUs (about 65 SKUs) moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27 (the old dim_product version has category Garden). I applied the current category to both stock and sales, so they sit in Electrical, and any comparison with figures from before that date would not be like for like.

Web and pseudo-location sales (about 11,100 units in P05, roughly 14% of store-plus-web units) are excluded because they have no stock rows in fact_stock_week. If the stores also serve web or click-and-collect demand, cover is overstated by about 14%.

Seasonal and Garden demand is moving fast. Weekly Garden sales fell from about 5,900 units in period 3 to about 2,500 in the last four weeks, and Seasonal sales rose from about 220 to about 600 a week. Cover on the P05 rate is therefore not a stable guide: Garden cover would be about 8 weeks on P03 demand, and Seasonal cover (42 weeks) is very sensitive to the seasonal ramp-up.
Furniture (28.6) and Seasonal (42.0) are driven by low unit volumes, so small changes in weekly sales move their cover a lot.
Returns (about 1,900 return lines, 2,300 units in P05) are not netted off sales. Netting them would raise cover slightly (for example Furniture 32.8, Electrical 8.8).
No store closures were recorded in the last two months. Store 129 has no stock rows at the period end and is not in the figures.

The warehouse holds stale backup and staging tables (bak_, stg_, tmp_, _old), which I did not use. fact_stock_week has duplicate store, product and week keys in earlier weeks (7,439 keys across all weeks), but none at 2026-09-27, so the figures are not affected.
All sales lines in the period have a null channel_code, so I identified web sales by pseudo-location store_id (900 and above), not by channel_code.

answer.sql: SELECT f.vat_rate, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21 AND f.channel_code = 'ST' GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
definitions_applied: VAT charged = gross_amount - net_amount per sales line
Store sales only (channel_code = 'ST', excludes web shop and training store)
Period 5 of FY2024/25 = fiscal weeks 18-21 (26 August - 22 September 2024)
assumptions: VAT rates are reported as a percentage (10, 14, 24, 25.5) rather than decimals
Request asks for total VAT charged in stores split by rate, with no sub-grouping by store, region or product category
caveats: The general VAT rate changed from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 (within period 5). The 24% rate applies to 26-31 August (6 days) and 25.5% applies to 1-22 September (22 days). Both are legitimate standard rates during the period.
Reduced VAT rates (10% and 14%) remained unchanged throughout the period.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(net_sales) as net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) = 9
definitions_applied: Net sales = sales minus returns, excluding VAT
Whole company = all open stores (39 stores; store 129 Savonlinna closed 2026-01-25)
Last month = September 2026 (request received 2026-10-09)
assumptions: Last month = the calendar month preceding the request date (September 2026)
Used rpt_daily_store_sales maintained report as the authoritative source for company reporting
caveats: Minor discrepancy identified: fact_sales_line direct calculation yields €1,188,162.10 net sales (€1,235,503 sales minus €56,650 September returns plus €7,148 returns from September sales returned later); the maintained rpt_daily_store_sales reports €1,179,035.98. The €9,126 difference (0.77%) may reflect adjustments, timing of data loads, or staff purchase handling in the reconciliation process. The rpt_daily_store_sales report is the authoritative source used by Data & Analytics.
Store 129 (Savonlinna) was closed 2026-01-25 and has no September sales records; this is expected and not a data issue.
Data is current through 2026-10-04; September 2026 has complete data (30 trading days).

answer.sql:
SELECT cs.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: ATV: net sales before returns divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop (store 900) left out
Staff purchases left out of ATV (NOT staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test left out
ATV dated by sale_date, with no returns netted
Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 is 3 August to 30 August 2026 (4 weeks), selected through dim_date.fiscal_year and fiscal_period
Store format taken from the current dim_store version (format is identical in every version of a store)
Control total against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days (net_sales_before_returns and receipts)
Count of distinct receipt_id, with a check for duplicate lines at the receipt_id + line_no grain
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as FY2026/27 P4 (3 to 30 August 2026): the request was received on 6 October 2026, when FY2026/27 is the current fiscal year, and P4 is complete and fully loaded.

Formats are the warehouse's actual values: Large, Medium and Small. The Hyper/Standard/Express list in the dim_store column comment is out of date. Web and Training appear as formats in dim_store but are not stores for this measure, so they have no row.
Format is reported as-is (current dim_store version). It makes no difference here because no store changes format between versions.
caveats: No data problems needing correction were found for this period: no duplicate sales lines, no receipts split across stores or mixing staff and non-staff lines, and no non-positive line amounts.

Control total: for all 38 physical stores, net sales before returns and receipt counts from fact_sales_line (staff purchases included, ZZ Test out) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for 3 to 30 August 2026. The only store in the control table with no match in my lines was the web shop (900), which is outside this measure. ATV itself cannot be tied to that table because it leaves staff purchases out.

The ATV figures rest on 8 Large, 18 Medium and 12 Small stores (6,508, 8,641 and 2,598 non-staff receipts). Kuopio's refit closure (15 June to 26 July 2026) ended before P4 starts, so it does not affect these figures.
Web orders are not in ATV, so the web shop has no row.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period against the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (open_date on or before 2026-08-03 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that week in both years (open, not closed, no ref_store_closure refit overlap)
Week 53 never LFL (not relevant to weeks 14-17)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns netted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal weeks aligned by week number (weeks 14-17), not by calendar date
Open and close dates taken from the current dim_store version; region as-is (not used in output)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' means FY2026/27 P4, 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (fiscal weeks 14-17). It was complete and fully loaded when the request arrived on 2026-10-07.
The comparator is FY2025/26 P4, fiscal weeks 14-17 (28 Jul to 24 Aug 2025), matched by fiscal week number.
LFL is given as one total figure because no breakdown was requested.
Growth is rounded to 2 decimals in percent units. The underlying LFL net sales are 1,010,478.52 EUR this year against 1,010,743.32 EUR last year.
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026 and is out of the base because it did not trade in P4 this year. The LFL base is 38 stores, 152 store-weeks. Last year's P4 had 39 stores, so Savonlinna's FY2025/26 P4 sales are not in the comparator.

No refit closure overlaps P4 in either year. Kuopio's refit ended 26 Jul 2026, the week before P4 began, so Kuopio is in the base for all four weeks. Tammisto and Pori refits are also outside these weeks.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) had been open more than 52 weeks before 3 Aug 2026, so both are in the base.
Store-level net sales for weeks 14-17 in both years match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, with no differences above 1 EUR. No duplicate sales_line_id values were found in the period.
The result is essentially flat (-0.03%, about -265 EUR on roughly 1.01 million EUR). The rounding at 2 decimals matters for how the figure reads.
rpt.v_daily_sales and the other deprecated objects were not used. Web sales are not part of LFL, so the channel_code break at the Nov 2025 migration does not affect this figure.

answer.sql:
WITH garden_sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
    AND p.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
)
SELECT 
  gs.subcategory,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(gs.quantity), 2) AS return_rate
FROM garden_sales_q1 gs
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON gs.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
GROUP BY gs.subcategory
ORDER BY gs.subcategory
definitions_applied: Return rate calculated as (units returned / units sold) × 100
Q1 defined as fiscal quarters 1 of the fiscal year (periods 1-3)
Last year interpreted as the fiscal year prior to request date (FY2024/25 relative to request date 2026-10-06)
Garden category includes all products with category = 'Garden' in dim_product
assumptions: Return rate includes all returns of goods sold in Q1, regardless of when the return occurred
Units sold and returned are summed by sales line and return line respectively
Partially returned items count towards both units sold and units returned
Only current product versions (is_current = TRUE) are included
caveats: Return rates vary significantly across subcategories, ranging from 0.83% (Edible Plants & Seeds) to 12.04% (Garden Furniture)
Outdoor Lighting has a small sample size (86 units sold) which may affect reliability of the 6.98% return rate
Data includes both store and web channel sales; no channel breakdown provided

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period) SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, s.format, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excl. VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop is out
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal period from dim_date: FY2026/27 P4 (3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, fiscal weeks 14 to 17)
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store format taken from the store version on the sale date (format is identical across all versions of a store)
assumptions: "Period 4 of FY26/27" read as fiscal year FY2026/27, fiscal period 4, a fully loaded period running 3 to 30 August 2026
"Average basket value" read as ATV (average transaction value), as the request says
Format groups are the warehouse values Large, Medium and Small; the schema comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date
The web shop is not a store format for ATV, so no Web row is shown
caveats: Excluded from ATV, as the company definition requires: web orders (store 900), staff purchases (280 receipts in P4), the training store 999 and ZZ Test articles. Store 999 and ZZ Test have no lines in the physical-store data for this period.

Control check: before excluding staff purchases, physical-store net sales before returns (1,062,266.72 EUR) and receipts (18,027) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for P4. The reported ATVs are lower in receipt count only because staff receipts are removed.
No duplicate sales lines or mixed staff/non-staff receipts were found in the period.
Receipts per format after the exclusions: Large 6,508; Medium 8,641; Small 2,598.

answer.sql: WITH trading AS (SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN dim_date d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.is_trading_day AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.calendar_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1,2), net_lines AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 UNION ALL SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2), sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, t.store_id, t.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM trading t JOIN sales s ON s.store_id=t.store_id ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT after line discounts, less returns (refund_net) on the return date
Trading days: days after opening, before closure, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) not included
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar: period 2 taken from dim_date / ref_fiscal_calendar (1 to 28 June 2026, 4 weeks)
Returns booked to the store where they were processed, dated on the return date
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales, store by store
Store open and close dates from the current dim_store version
Part-period stores kept in the table with their own trading days
Ties in rank handled with RANK()
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P2 (1 June to 28 June 2026), the current fiscal year on the request date of 9 October 2026; it is complete and fully loaded
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026, before the period, so it is not listed
Ranking is by net sales per trading day, the company league table convention; net sales and trading days are shown beside it so the ranking can be checked
Web shop (store 900) left out, because store-level analyses cover physical stores only
Rank 1 is the highest net sales per trading day
caveats: Kuopio (125) was shut for a refit from 15 June 2026 to 26 July 2026, so it traded only 1 to 14 June (14 days). It is ranked on those 14 days (rank 7 at 1,713.84 per day). Its period net sales are not comparable with the 26-day stores.
Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays, so a full-period store has 26 trading days rather than 28.
Store totals agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for all 38 stores over the period (zero difference, same number of days with sales), so no correction was needed.
No sales or returns were found on closed holidays, or in Kuopio during its refit. No ZZ Test sales were found in physical stores in the period, so the ZZ Test filter did not change any total.
No duplicate sales lines or return lines were found in the period.
Part-period or small stores rank on a per-day basis, so low-ranked stores are mostly small-format stores. The ranking says nothing about store size.

answer.sql:
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.receipt_id,
    f.store_key,
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' 
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
    AND s.format != 'Training'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key, s.format
)
SELECT 
  format,
  ROUND(AVG(receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format
definitions_applied: Basket value defined as total net amount per receipt (sum of all line items, excluding VAT)
Period 4 of FY2026/27 mapped to fiscal calendar dates 2026-08-03 through 2026-08-30
Average calculated per store format across all receipts with sales in the period
Store format sourced from dim_store.format at time of sale
assumptions: Basket value uses net_amount (excluding VAT) from fact_sales_line for consistency
Web format represents online channel sales processed through the Tuomimetsä web shop store location (store_id 900)
Training store excluded from results as a non-operational test location
Each receipt_id represents one distinct transaction regardless of channel (store or web)
caveats: Schema documentation comments indicate store formats should be 'Hyper, Standard or Express', but actual warehouse data contains 'Large, Medium, Small, Training, Web'. The results reflect actual data format values.
Web channel sales have NULL channel_code in fact_sales_line (not coded as 'WB'), but are correctly identified through store_key 46 (Tuomimetsä web shop) in dim_store.
Training store (store_id 999) is excluded from results; if training sales should be included, Large format value would be 60.66.
Data is current as of query execution; no validation issues detected in the sales data for this period.

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' AND s.is_current = TRUE AND p.is_current = TRUE AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Store identified as Pitäjänmäki (store_id 102, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Capital Region)
Units sold: quantity column from fact_sales_line
As-is reporting: current product and store versions as of request date
Test articles excluded: category = 'ZZ Test' filtered out
Training store excluded: store 999 filtered by store_id = 102
assumptions: Request interpreted as asking for as-is reporting (current product and store names) rather than as-was
Period 5 resolved to fiscal period 5 of fiscal year FY2026/27, not calendar month 5
Units sold refers to quantity in fact_sales_line (excludes returns)
Pitäjänmäki identified by store_name matching 'Pitäjänmäki' (store_id 102)
caveats: The query excludes returned items; units_sold represents gross sales quantities before returns

Store 102 exists in two versions in dim_store due to the April 2025 region reorganisation (South → Capital Region), but the current version (Capital Region, store_key 4) was valid throughout P5 and is used for labelling
No data quality issues identified; all three products have stable single versions with no delisting events during P5

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')), store_sales AS (SELECT p.fiscal_year, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2), store_ret AS (SELECT p.fiscal_year, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2), ns AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.store_id, a.gross_net - coalesce(b.ret,0) net_sales FROM store_sales a LEFT JOIN store_ret b USING(fiscal_year, store_id)), elig AS (SELECT cur.store_id, cur.net_sales cur_ns, pri.net_sales pri_ns FROM ns cur JOIN ns pri ON pri.store_id=cur.store_id AND cur.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND pri.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c, per p WHERE c.store_id=cur.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=p.period_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=p.period_start_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store d WHERE d.store_id=cur.store_id AND d.is_current AND d.close_date IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store d WHERE d.store_id=cur.store_id AND d.open_date > DATE '2025-04-27')) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round((sum(cur_ns)/sum(pri_ns)-1)*100,2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM elig
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 1 of FY2026/27 (2026-05-04 to 2026-05-31, 4 weeks) compared with period 1 of FY2025/26 (2025-04-28 to 2025-05-25, 4 weeks), matched by fiscal period and not by calendar dates
Like-for-like store base: physical stores only (store_id below 900), trading through the whole of both periods
Excluded from the like-for-like base: web shop (900), training store (999), stores with a refit closure overlapping either period, closed stores, and stores opened inside the comparison period
Net sales: EUR excluding VAT, sales lines less refunds booked in the same period (refunds by return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales)
Store identity by store_id, not store_key, so the April 2025 region re-mapping versions do not split a store
Growth = current-period net sales / prior-period net sales - 1, over the same set of stores in both periods
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, because the request is dated 9 Oct 2026 and the fiscal year starts in late April or early May. Period 1 is therefore May 2026, compared with period 1 of FY2025/26.
Like-for-like is read as a store-estate measure. The web shop (a different channel, with its channel coding changed at the platform migration) is excluded.
Net sales means after returns, as in the team's daily store report. Before returns the same stores grow 6.63%.
Staff purchases are included, because nothing in the warehouse says to exclude them from sales.
Stores 136 and 137 (opened Sep and Nov 2024) are kept in the base. They traded for the whole of both periods and had been open more than 12 months by the start of the comparison period.
The headline is unadjusted for the number of trading days, which is how like-for-like is normally reported.
caveats: The base period had one fewer trading day. Stores were shut on 1 May 2025 (May Day), and 1 May 2026 falls before period 1 starts. The base therefore has 27 trading days and the current period 28. Per trading day, like-for-like growth is about 2.9% against the headline 6.7%, so roughly 3.7 points of the headline come from the extra day. Ascension Day (14 May) and Whit Sunday fell inside the 2026 period as trading days, while Ascension 2025 fell outside the comparison period.
FY2025/26 was a 53-week year. The periods are matched by fiscal period and week, which is the correct alignment. Matching by calendar date would shift the comparison by a week.

Store 129 Savonlinna closed on 2026-01-25 and had no sales in the current period. It is excluded, along with the web shop and the training store 999. Including the web shop would also change the figure, because its channel codes differ between the two periods (WB then, channel_id 2 and 3 now).

The refits of stores 119 (Sep to Oct 2025) and 125 (starts June 2026) do not overlap either period, so both stay in the base. Store 119 is only recently reopened and 125 closes shortly after the period. Excluding both (and 136 and 137) gives 6.84%, so the result is not sensitive to this.
Stores 136 and 137 grew about 20% and 26%. Excluding them gives 6.12% on 36 stores. They are included because they met the full-period trading rule, but they were still maturing in the base period.
The warehouse's old like-for-like lists (tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and 2025) were not used. They are stale temporary tables and omit stores 136 and 137.

Checks that found no problem: no duplicate sales or return lines, no non-positive amounts, VAT arithmetic consistent, all stores have a sales line on every trading day, and the sales and returns totals reconcile exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales. Both periods are fully loaded.
The result covers the 38 stores in the base. The sums are 1,103,969.88 EUR in period 1 of FY2025/26 and 1,177,925.94 EUR in period 1 of FY2026/27.

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1, 2), returns AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1, 2), weekly AS (SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week, round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, round(l.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, round(100.0 * (t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct FROM weekly t JOIN weekly l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns, both stores and web
Fiscal period 2 and fiscal weeks 5 to 8 from dim_date / ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27 P02 = 1-28 June 2026; FY2025/26 P02 = 26 May-22 June 2025)
Comparison is by fiscal week number within period 2 (week 5 vs week 5, and so on), not by calendar date
Sales dated by sale_date (Finnish local date) and returns by return_date (refunds booked on the day, as in rpt_daily_store_sales)
Store versions resolved through store_key to dim_store; web shop (store_id 900) counted as part of company sales
Training store (store_id 999) excluded as non-trading
Growth % = this year / last year - 1
assumptions: 'Sales' read as net sales after returns, excluding VAT, in EUR, which is the net sales logic of rpt_daily_store_sales
'Total company sales' read as all channels (stores plus web, home delivery and click-and-collect), not like-for-like
'This year' read as FY2026/27 (the period 2 that has just closed, 1-28 June 2026) and 'last year' as FY2025/26 period 2

Staff purchases (about 1.2% of sales, flagged staff_purchase_flag) are kept in because they are real revenue; the flag is not a documented exclusion, and removing them would change the growth rates by only a few tenths of a point

Fiscal-week alignment was kept as the way to compare weeks, because the request asks for the four weeks of the period; FY2025/26 was a 53-week year, so the fiscal weeks start on different calendar dates (Monday 26 May 2025 vs Monday 1 June 2026)
Did not use the reporting table rpt_daily_store_sales or the view rpt.v_daily_sales; figures are built from the fact tables
caveats: Correction: the training store (store_id 999) has test sales lines (about 200 to 900 EUR a week) in the fact table; these were excluded.

Correction: fact_sales_line.channel_code is NULL from 3 Nov 2025 (web-platform migration; channel_id is used instead). The view rpt.v_daily_sales / rpt.v_weekly_store_sales picks web sales with channel_code = 'WB', so it would drop all web sales this year (about 55 to 71 thousand EUR a week) and overstate nothing but understate this year's growth. I did not use the views and counted web sales by store 900 (web shop), which holds for both years.

Correction: the pre-aggregated table rpt_daily_store_sales does not reconcile to the fact tables day by day (differences of several thousand EUR a day, for example 27 thousand EUR on 22 June 2026 and a zero on both Midsummer days) and excludes web sales lines, so it was not used.

The weekly growth rates for weeks 7 and 8 are not like-for-like and should not be read on their own. Midsummer closure fell in fiscal week 8 last year (20-21 June 2025; stores shut, web only) but in fiscal week 7 this year (19-20 June 2026). That moves a shut-store week from last year's week 8 to this year's week 7, giving -26.5% in week 7 and +54.4% in week 8. Taken together, weeks 7 and 8 are 586,868.35 EUR vs 551,167.61 EUR, +6.5%.

Store 125 is closed for a refit from 15 June 2026 to 26 July 2026 (6 weeks), which reduces this year's store sales in weeks 7 and 8 and is included in the totals (this is total, not like-for-like, sales).
Whole period 2 for reference: 1,295,948.28 EUR this year vs 1,210,935.82 EUR last year, +7.0%.

Click-and-collect orders are counted once, in the web shop, not again at the collection store. Only delivered or collected web orders appear in the sales lines; no cancelled or processing orders are in the sales lines.
No duplicate sales or return lines, unmatched store keys or VAT inconsistencies were found in the two periods; staging (stg_*) and backup (bak_*) tables were ignored.

answer.sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store AS s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND s.store_id != 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
sales_with_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.subcategory,
    sd.fiscal_week,
    sd.net_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) AS refund_net
  FROM sales_data AS sd
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line AS frl ON sd.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sd.subcategory, sd.fiscal_week, sd.sales_line_id, sd.net_amount
)
SELECT 
  subcategory,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(net_amount) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (SUM(refund_net) / SUM(net_amount)) * 100
  END AS return_rate_percent
FROM sales_with_returns
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY subcategory
definitions_applied: Return rate: refund_net divided by sold net, grouped by fiscal week of original sale
Net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, excluding store 999 and ZZ Test category
Sale-week cohort: returns counted in the week the item was sold, not the return date
assumptions: Last year means FY2025/26 (the fiscal year previous to the current FY2026/27)
Q1 means fiscal quarters 1-3 (fiscal periods P1-P3, fiscal weeks 1-13)
Garden subcategories are those with category = 'Garden' in dim_product
caveats: Return rates are calculated from the fiscal week of the original sale, not the return date, per the sale-week cohort definition
The dataset includes both store and web channel sales
Return amounts are in EUR and reflect full or partial refunds; return counts are aggregated to the subcategory level

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_category AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 22 AND 26
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT category, net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * gross_margin / net_sales, 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM by_category
ORDER BY category;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns. Returns reduce net sales on their return date, not the sale date. Excludes store 999 and category ZZ Test.
Gross margin percentage: (net sales minus standard cost of goods sold) divided by net sales, multiplied by 100. Returned units are credited back at standard cost.
Hierarchy: as-is (current product version categories), not as-was.
assumptions: Period 6 last year: FY2025/26 P6 (fiscal weeks 22-26, 22 September to 26 October 2025), read as the prior fiscal year from the current date of 15 October 2026 (in FY2026/27).
Categories: exact category names in dim_product are 'Garden' and 'Electrical'; no category reorganisations applied for this historical period.
caveats: No exceptions or data quality issues detected.
Web sales are recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time.
Gross margin is after returns; the query credits returned units at their standard cost.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: ATV: net sales before returns divided by the number of distinct sales receipts, in EUR excluding VAT
ATV is a store measure: web orders and the web shop (store 900) are left out, so only physical stores (store_id below 900) count
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 4 is fiscal weeks 14 to 17, Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Format taken from dim_store; it is the same in every version of a store, so no as-is or as-was choice arises
Control total: net sales before returns for the physical stores over the period, including staff purchases, matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (1,062,266.72 EUR; 18,027 receipts)
assumptions: 'Period 4 of FY26/27' was read as fiscal year FY2026/27, period 4 (3 to 30 August 2026), which is complete in the warehouse
'Average basket value (so the average transaction value)' was read as the company's ATV metric
Formats are reported as the warehouse holds them (Large, Medium, Small), one row per format, with no total row; the web shop has no format row because web orders are outside ATV
caveats: The dim_store.format column comment ('Hyper, Standard or Express') is out of date. The warehouse holds Large (8 stores), Medium (18 stores) and Small (12 stores) for the physical stores, so those labels are used.

Excluding staff purchases removes 280 receipts (18,027 to 17,747) from the count. The control total comparison (1,062,266.72 EUR) is on all receipts including staff, because staff purchases are in net sales but out of ATV.
Receipts per format: Large 6,508, Medium 8,641, Small 2,598. No duplicate sales lines or mixed staff/non-staff receipts were found in the period.
No data corrections were needed. Web orders and the web shop are not part of ATV; the rpt.v_daily_sales views were not used.

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND p.category NOT IN ('ZZ Test') GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10;
definitions_applied: Web sales: net amount excluding VAT, recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Web channel: identified by store_id 900 (pseudo-store for web shop)
Excluded: test articles (category ZZ Test) and cancelled orders
assumptions: Top 10 ranked by total net sales value in EUR
Web sales measured on dispatch date in Helsinki time per company policy
Returns included in net sales totals (they reduce the line amount)
Staff purchases included in web sales (not filtered out)
caveats: Platform migration on 3 November 2025 changed channel tracking; web sales identified by store_id 900 for consistency across the migration
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale, so recent sales may have associated returns not yet booked
Product rankings reflect dispatch-to-date net sales; same SKU appearing under different product names would show as separate rows

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day -
