364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year;
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period against the same fiscal weeks last year, compared week by week
Fiscal calendar: period 4 = fiscal weeks 14 to 17 (3 to 30 August 2026), compared with weeks 14 to 17 of FY2025/26 (28 July to 24 August 2025), aligned on fiscal week number
Net sales = net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns taken on their own return date
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); the web shop is not LFL
LFL base rule: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (3 August 2026)
A store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure from ref_store_closure)
Week 53 is never part of LFL (not relevant to this range)
Store scope taken from the current dim_store version (as-is)
assumptions: "Period 4 this year" read as FY2026/27 P4, because the request was received on 7 October 2026, in FY2026/27. P4 is complete (3 to 30 August 2026) and fully loaded.
Comparator is FY2025/26 P4, fiscal weeks 14 to 17.
One company-level LFL figure, since no breakdown was requested.
Growth is shown as a percentage rounded to two decimals; the unrounded figure is about -0.026%.
caveats: The figure is essentially flat: LFL net sales were 1,010,478.52 EUR this year against 1,010,743.32 EUR last year, a fall of about 265 EUR.

The LFL base is 38 stores x 4 weeks = 152 store-weeks. Savonlinna (129, closed 25 January 2026) is out, since it did not trade in FY2026/27. Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) are in the base, as both opened more than 364 days before 3 August 2026.
No refit closure overlaps weeks 14 to 17 in either year (Kuopio's ended 26 July 2026; Pori's was in September 2025), so no store-weeks were dropped for refits.

Checks: the store-level net sales used reconcile exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for both years over weeks 14 to 17 (0 stores with a gap). The duplicate-load rows I found (receipt_id and line_no repeated in fact_sales_line, store_key 22, 15 to 21 September 2025) fall outside the weeks used, so no correction was needed.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales or the stg_, bak_ or tmp_ tables.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE cs.store_id = 107 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27 is 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, taken from dim_date
Units sold are the quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Product hierarchy as-is: subcategory read from the current dim_product version
Store 999 and category ZZ Test filtered out (neither changed the result)
Staff purchases included in units sold
Physical store only (store_id 107, below 900)
Control total: units for all categories at the store over P5 (1626) agree with rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27; 'period 5' is its P5, the last complete period (ended 27 September 2026)
'Cleaning Products' read as the subcategory of that name, under the category Cleaning & Household. There is no category called Cleaning Products
'Units sold' read as gross units on sales lines. No Cleaning Products units were returned at Hyvinkää in the period, so net of returns gives the same figure
Hyvinkää read as store_id 107 (the only store with that name)
caveats: No data problems found. Fact rows for the period are unique at receipt_id and line_no, and the store total matches rpt_daily_store_sales
The figure includes 4 units bought by staff (132 units excluding staff purchases)
The as-was and as-is subcategory readings give the same 136 units

answer.sql: SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, count(DISTINCT h.member_id) AS members_held_out FROM dim_campaign c JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Black Week 2025' GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
definitions_applied: Held out = a distinct member_id in campaign_holdout for the campaign (member_id, not member_key)
Black Week 2025 = campaign_id 15 in dim_campaign (24-30 Nov 2025)
assumptions: 'Black Week 2025' means campaign 15, the only campaign with that name. Black Week 2024 is campaign 5 and is a separate campaign.
'Held out' means members kept off the mailing as the control group, as recorded in campaign_holdout.
caveats: No correction was needed. campaign_holdout has 2747 distinct members for campaign 15. This matches dim_campaign.holdout_size (2747).
All 2747 held-out members were marketing-consenting on 24 Nov 2025 and all match a member record. None of them has a contact in fact_campaign_exposure for the campaign.
2747 is 10.3% of the mailing list of 26573, slightly above the nominal 10% holdout_pct (which would be about 2657). The warehouse's recorded holdout is 2747 and I report that figure.

The held-out members (2747) plus the distinct members contacted (23818) come to 26565, which is 8 fewer than the recorded mailing_list_size of 26573. I could not explain the 8-member gap. It does not affect the holdout count.

answer.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE st.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Net sales = sales excluding VAT (net_amount, after line discounts) less refunds excluding VAT (refund_net), as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Web shop = web channel group, home delivery plus click and collect, i.e. the web shop pseudo-store (store_id 900)
Web channel identified by channel_code = 'WB' before the web-platform migration and by channel_id 2 or 3 (dim_channel, channel_group = web) from 2025-11-03
Fiscal periods from dim_date / ref_fiscal_calendar (4-4-5 pattern, fiscal year starting late April or early May)
Returns attributed to the period in which the refund was booked (return_date)
Sales dated by sale_date (local business date), not the UTC timestamp
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, since the request was made on 2026-10-06 during FY2026/27
'Periods 5 to 8' means fiscal periods 5 to 8 of FY2025/26 (2025-08-25 to 2025-12-21)
'Net' means excluding VAT and after refunds, following the company's net sales definition
'Web shop' includes both home delivery and click-and-collect orders
Staff purchases are included; there are none on the web channel in this window
All web orders in the window are delivered or collected; none are cancelled or still processing, so no order-status filter was needed
caveats: Correction: the channel flag changed at the web-platform migration on 2025-11-03. Before it, web lines carry channel_code 'WB' and a null channel_id; from it, they carry channel_id 2 or 3 and a null channel_code. Filtering on channel_code alone would drop all of period 8 and the last week of period 7 (about 377k EUR of sales, 99.6k of it click-and-collect, which never had a legacy code). I filtered on both fields.

Correction: the daily sales report rpt_daily_store_sales is not usable for the web shop. Its store 900 figures do not match the fact table (for example 502 EUR on Sunday 2025-10-26 against about 7,649 EUR in fact_sales_line, and negative net sales on some days), so I computed from the fact tables.

Correction: the existing view rpt.v_daily_sales is not usable for web either. It counts web lines twice or not at all: it treats store_id < 900 as stores and then adds the web lines using channel_code = 'WB', so it would miss click-and-collect and post-migration lines.

Net of refunds: sales excluding VAT were 158,124.35 (P5), 194,176.17 (P6), 166,510.02 (P7) and 249,084.84 (P8), a total of 767,895.38. Refunds excluding VAT were 13,090.51, 17,601.93, 12,143.71 and 17,821.30. If Finance wants sales before returns, use the first set.
Refunds are counted in the period they were booked, so some refunds relate to sales from an earlier period, and refunds on late-December sales will land in P9 or later.

No duplicate sales lines or returns were found in the window, and the sales lines tie out to the web orders (27,829 lines, all with a matching order). The Training store (999) and the staging, backup and tmp tables were not used.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excluding VAT) divided by the number of sales receipts
Staff purchases excluded from ATV (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Web shop (store 900) included at the requester's explicit instruction, which overrides the company default of stores only
Web orders counted as receipts on the Helsinki order date (web sale_date is the order date), cancelled orders excluded
Net amount excluding VAT after line discounts, before returns
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P1 to P3, Monday 4 May 2026 to Sunday 2 August 2026 (13 whole fiscal weeks)
Helsinki business dates (sale_date)
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, channel_code, bak_/stg_/tmp_ tables) not used
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'periods 1 to 3' as P1 to P3 (Q1), 4 May to 2 August 2026, all fully loaded in the warehouse
'Whole company' read as all physical stores plus the web shop, as one combined ATV (not a split by channel)
A web order counts as one receipt, valued at the net amount of its sales lines excluding VAT, so web and store values are on the same basis
Returns are not deducted, as ATV is defined before returns
The figure is ATV for the whole company only, with no breakdown by store or channel, since none was asked for
caveats: Company default ATV is a store-only measure that excludes web orders. Web orders were included because the request explicitly asked for it, so this figure is not comparable with the usual store-only ATV reports (for example the P5 ATV by store).

Corrections: store 999 (training store) lines and 3 web orders consisting only of ZZ Test articles (EUR 6.00 in total) were removed. Staff purchases were excluded: 1,037 store receipts (EUR 48,734.94) in the physical stores. Web has no staff purchases in the period.
Cancelled web orders (519 in P1 to P3) have no sales lines and are not counted. No web orders were still processing in the period.
Basis of the result: 79,943 receipts (66,984 store and 12,959 web) and EUR 4,490,211.64 net sales before returns (EUR 3,719,186.33 store and EUR 771,025.31 web).

Checks: store receipts and net sales before returns for P1 to P3 (including staff purchases, excluding 999 and test articles) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, store by store and day by day (68,021 receipts, EUR 3,767,921.27). No duplicate line or receipt keys, no zero or negative quantity or amount lines, no receipt mixing staff and non-staff lines. The web side was checked against fact_web_order: every non-cancelled web order has lines and its sale_date equals its Helsinki order date.
Web receipts are not checked against rpt_daily_store_sales, which dates web on dispatch date, whereas ATV here counts web by order date.

answer.sql: WITH web_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2), web_returns AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.gross_net - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) AS web_net_sales FROM web_sales w LEFT JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales = line value in EUR excluding VAT after line discounts (net_amount), less refunds excluding VAT (refund_net), as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Web channel identified by the web shop pseudo-location (store_id 900), because the channel code was replaced by channel_id at the web-platform migration
Sales assigned to the period of sale_date; refunds assigned to the period of return_date (refunds booked on the day, as in the daily sales report)
Returns attributed to the channel of the original sales line, not to the store where the goods came back
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last complete fiscal year, FY2025/26. The request is dated 2026-10-09, which falls in FY2026/27 P06, so FY2025/26 is the previous fiscal year.
'Periods 5 to 8' means fiscal periods 5, 6, 7 and 8, with one row per period.
'Net sales' means net of returns, in EUR excluding VAT, following the company's daily sales report. Before returns, the figures would be 158124.35, 194176.17, 166510.02 and 249084.84 for P5 to P8.
Web includes both home delivery and click-and-collect. Cancelled orders have no sales lines, so they add nothing.
No staff purchases appear on web lines, so no exclusion was needed.
caveats: From 2025-11-03 (inside P7) the web lines have channel_code NULL and use channel_id 2 (home delivery) or 3 (click and collect). Before that date they carry channel_code 'WB'. A filter on channel_code = 'WB' would drop about 14,330 web lines from P7 and P8. The rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales views filter on channel_code = 'WB', so they would understate web sales for this period. I identified web lines by the web shop location instead, which covers both regimes.

Web orders returned in physical stores are booked to those stores in fact_return_line. A filter on the web shop's store_key would miss them. Across P5 to P8 these refunds are about 11 thousand EUR in all (P5 about 5.5k, P6 about 4.4k, P7 about 5.0k, P8 about 4.9k, roughly, from the store-by-store breakdown). I included them by linking each return to its original sales line.

Sale dates are the warehouse's own sale_date. They differ from the UTC date of sale_ts_utc on about 5 percent of web lines (orders placed near midnight), so I used sale_date and did not re-derive dates from the UTC timestamps.
I found no duplicate sales or return lines in the period. Every web line has a matching order and every return has a matching sales line. All periods are marked fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar.

FY2025/26 is a 53-week year, but the extra week falls in P12, so periods 5 to 8 are unaffected. Do not compare these periods against FY2024/25 P5 to P8 by week number without checking the calendar. The period start dates are shifted by one day compared with the year before.

answer.sql: SELECT campaign_name, holdout_size FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_name = 'Black Week 2025'
definitions_applied: Holdout: members included on the mailing list but deliberately excluded from campaign contact (control group)
assumptions: Request refers to the campaign named 'Black Week 2025' in dim_campaign
Holdout_size is the authoritative count of members held out (verified against campaign_holdout table)
caveats: Campaign runs 24–30 November 2025; all data as of warehouse load date

answer.sql:
WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_key) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as spending_eur
FROM contacted_members cm
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fsl.member_key = cm.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
definitions_applied: Members contacted: distinct member_key values in fact_campaign_exposure for campaign_id 19
Spending: net_amount from fact_sales_line (excluding VAT), as recorded in warehouse
Campaign period: 4–24 May 2026, matching campaign date range
assumptions: Campaign dates (2026-05-04 to 2026-05-24) used as the spending measurement window
Members contacted refers to those with contact records in fact_campaign_exposure, not members on the mailing list who were not reached
Spending measured as retail net amount (excluding VAT) per warehouse definition
caveats: 15,063 members were successfully contacted out of 16,624 on the mailing list; 1,561 were not reached (likely delivery failures)
Spending figures are net of VAT (fact_sales_line.net_amount does not include gross amounts)
Figure counts only purchases made by members with a matching member_key in their profile; non-member purchases during this period are not included

answer.sql: SELECT old.region, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as august_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as september_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_store_old old ON s.store_id = old.store_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9) GROUP BY old.region ORDER BY old.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales with VAT from fact_sales_line.gross_amount
Sales before returns (receipt/transaction lines only, no returns included)
Regions as defined in dim_store_old (the historical store dimension)
assumptions: Interpreted 'regions as they were at the time, as in the old reports' to mean the 4-region structure in dim_store_old (East, North, South, West)
Sales before returns means transaction lines from fact_sales_line, excluding any returns from fact_return_line
Matched current stores to old regions via store_id
caveats: Store IDs 900 (Online) and 999 (Head office) have no entries in the historical dim_store_old and are excluded. These account for approximately EUR 342,440 (11.7%) of Aug/Sep 2024 total sales.
The table covers 2,573,994.05 EUR out of 2,916,434.09 EUR in total gross sales for the period (88.3% coverage).
If these unmapped sales must be included for VAT filing, their region assignment is not documented in the historical dimension; you may need to route them separately or apply a manual mapping.

answer.sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_value FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.region = 'West' AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'), weekly AS (SELECT p.category, st.week_ending_date, sum(st.closing_value) AS week_value FROM stock st JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = st.product_key GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, 'West' AS region, category, round(avg(week_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_eur FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 11 = 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-22 (ref_fiscal_calendar, 4 weeks, fully loaded)
Stock value = closing_value in fact_stock_week, closing stock at standard cost in EUR (excluding VAT)
Region taken from dim_store at the store_key version recorded on each stock row (West = 10 stores, ids 115 to 123 and 136)
Category taken from dim_product at the product_key version recorded on each stock row
Average stock value = mean of the four weekly closing totals (week-ending 1, 8, 15 and 22 March 2026) per category
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request date of 2026-10-05 falls in FY2026/27 (which began 2026-05-04). Period 11 of the current year has not happened yet.
'Average stock value' means the average of the weekly closing stock value over the period, summed across all West stores and SKUs within each category.
Stock value is at standard cost, as the warehouse holds it, not at selling price.
The West region is the 10 stores currently tagged West; no store changed region or had a refit closure during the period.
caveats: Duplicate load: the week ending 2026-03-08 had every West row loaded twice (7,439 rows duplicated, identical values, a second load on 2026-03-10), which would have doubled that week and overstated the period average by about 25%. I counted each store, SKU and week once.
The West total of the category averages is 813,525.03 EUR, which matches the deduplicated weekly West totals.

All other regions, weeks and checks were clean: no unmatched product keys, no negative units, no SKU counted under two product versions in a store-week, and closing_value equals units times standard unit cost on every row.
Standard costs are revalued each April, so this period is valued at the FY2025/26 standard cost. Comparing with FY2026/27 stock would include a revaluation effect.
The warehouse has a fifth region, 'Capital Region', which is not described in the dim_store region comment (North, South, East, West). It does not affect the West figures.

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting') SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, sold.subcategory, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.refund_net) / SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id GROUP BY sold.subcategory ORDER BY sold.subcategory
definitions_applied: Return rate = refund_net divided by sold net_amount (both excluding VAT), by sale-week cohort
Sold lines selected by the fiscal quarter of fact_sales_line.sale_date; refunds matched through sales_line_id wherever and whenever they were booked
Web (store 900) and stores both included, since the request does not restrict the channel
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Categories and subcategories as-is (current product version, joined on sku and is_current)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: Q1 FY2025/26 = weeks 1 to 13, 28 April 2025 to 27 July 2025
Canonical tables only, with no stg_, bak_, tmp_ or old tables and no rpt views
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year just ended, as in past requests from May 2026 onward), so 'Q1 of last year' is FY2025/26 Q1
No channel restriction was asked for, so web and store sales are both in the base
Subcategories are shown as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, since as-was was not requested
Lines with a null or zero return are kept in the denominator
Rates are in percent units
caveats: Correction: five delisted Garden articles (skus 100870, 100877, 100879, 100916, 100917) still carry Garden / Outdoor Lighting on their current product version. They never got the new version made when outdoor lighting moved to Electrical on 27 October 2025. As-is, outdoor lighting belongs in Electrical, so I left them out of Garden and no 'Outdoor Lighting' row appears. They had 19 sold lines in Q1 and 375 EUR net sales, with no returns, so the effect on the Garden rates is nil.
Q1 FY2025/26 ended 27 July 2025. Returns arrive up to 30 days after a sale and the latest return found was 22 August 2025, so the cohort is complete.
Store 999 and ZZ Test exclusions did not change any Garden subcategory figure that I could see; I did not test the effect of each filter on its own.
The rpt_daily_store_sales control total was not run, since it has no product dimension and the check does not apply to a category subset.
Sold lines and return lines are one row per key in the Q1 range, with no duplicates and no orphan returns, so the joins do not multiply rows. No refund exceeded the sold value or sold quantity.

answer.sql: WITH receipt AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS has_staff_line, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, d.fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_year, round(sum(receipt_net) / count(*), 2) AS atv_eur_excl_vat FROM receipt WHERE store_id <> 999 AND NOT has_staff_line GROUP BY fiscal_year
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales excluding VAT divided by number of receipts (a receipt or web order is one transaction)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 periods 1 to 3 (4 May 2026 to 2 August 2026, 13 weeks, all fully loaded)
Whole company: all stores plus the web shop (home delivery and click and collect)
Training store (store_id 999) excluded
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded
Sales before returns (returns not netted off)
Cancelled web orders excluded (they have no sales lines in the warehouse)
Net amount taken from fact_sales_line.net_amount (after line discounts, excl. VAT)
Channel identified by channel_id, as channel_code is empty
assumptions: Read 'this year' as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (the request is dated 5 Oct 2026) and 'periods 1 to 3' as its fiscal periods 1 to 3, not calendar months
ATV read as average transaction value per receipt in EUR excluding VAT, which matches the net sales basis used in the warehouse reports
Excluded staff purchases and the training store as non-trading sales, since the brief gave no stated company definition; the effect is small
A receipt that contains any staff-flagged line is dropped as a whole
Returns not deducted, since ATV measures the value of the transactions as rung up
One company-wide figure given, with no split by channel, because none was requested
caveats: fact_sales_line.channel_code (ST/WB) is NULL on every row in this period, contrary to its column comment. I used channel_id instead and the web shop (store_id 900) for web identification, so any logic depending on channel_code would drop web.
Training store 999 has 186 receipts (EUR 7,806 net) in the period; I excluded them. Including them gives 56.02.
Staff purchases are 1,169 receipts (EUR 56,090 net, ATV about 47.98); excluded. Including staff purchases (but still excluding the training store) gives 56.05.
Web: 12,962 orders (EUR 771,031 net, ATV 59.48) are included. Stores only (excl. staff and training) give 55.52, so including web lifts the company ATV slightly.
Gross (incl. VAT) ATV on the same basis would be about 70.37; the 56.17 is excl. VAT.

Midsummer Eve and Day (19-20 June 2026) are non-trading days with only web sales; this is expected, not a data fault. No duplicate lines, no gaps in the period, web order totals match the sales lines, and cancelled orders have no lines.
No company definition of ATV was available to me, so the staff and training exclusions are my judgement and should be confirmed with Data & Analytics.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on their join date (dim_member.join_date)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by dim_member version rows
Online sign-ups (home store 900) count as new members and are included
Canonical table dim_member only; no stg_member_updates or other deprecated objects used
assumptions: 'Joined on 3 October 2026' means join_date = 2026-10-03. That is a plain calendar date, so no UTC to Helsinki conversion applies.
All members are included, online sign-ups among them, with no split by store or channel, because the request asks for one count.
The date is inside the loaded range, which runs through 4 October 2026.
caveats: No data problem was found and no correction was needed. All 29 members have exactly one dim_member version, so version rows and distinct member_id agree at 29. Their first valid_from equals their join_date, and no member has a join_date that varies between versions.
Nine of the 29 are online sign-ups (home_store_id 900). The other 20 enrolled at physical stores. These are for information only and are not broken out in the result.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales = fact_sales_line rows with channel_code = 'WB'. Before the Nov 2025 web-platform migration, web lines carry channel_code and a null channel_id.
Sales including VAT = gross_amount
Before returns: fact_return_line not netted off
Company fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 periods 4 to 6 (Q2) run 29 Jul 2024 to 27 Oct 2024; assigned through dim_date on sale_date
Cancelled web orders carry no sales lines, so they are excluded
assumptions: Read 'Q2 of FY24/25' as fiscal year FY2024/25, fiscal quarter 2, which is periods 4, 5 and 6 as the request states
Read 'web sales' as all web lines, home delivery and click-and-collect together, since both carry channel_code WB in this period
Read 'including VAT' as the gross_amount on each line (each line's net_amount plus its own VAT rate)
Assigned each line to a period by sale_date, which matches the Helsinki-time date of sale_ts_utc on every line in scope
Figures are in EUR
caveats: No corrections were needed. In scope there are no duplicate lines, no staff purchases on web lines, no null channel codes, and gross_amount equals net_amount times (1 + vat_rate) on every line. All three periods are marked fully_loaded.

Cancelled web orders are in fact_web_order but have no lines in fact_sales_line (cancelled value in the order table: P4 4,715.64, P5 6,512.99, P6 6,975.83 EUR). Order totals less cancelled orders reconcile exactly to the line totals above.
Returns are not deducted, as requested. Net web sales after returns will be lower.
P6 has 5 weeks (23 Sep to 27 Oct 2024), P4 and P5 have 4 weeks each, so P6 is higher partly because it is longer.
After the Nov 2025 migration, web lines are identified by channel_id 2 and 3 instead of channel_code WB. The query above would need changing for any period from FY2025/26 P08 onwards.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT region, SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_2024_gross_incl_vat, SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sep_2024_gross_incl_vat FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT = sum of gross_amount on the sales lines, each line at its own VAT rate
Before returns: refund lines (fact_return_line) not deducted
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only; cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines)
Store lines dated on sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
As-was regions: region taken from the store version on the sale line (fact store_key), not the current version
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own region, Online
Staff purchases included
assumptions: August and September 2024 read as calendar months (1-31 August, 1-30 September 2024), since this is for a VAT filing, not as fiscal periods
'Regions as they were at the time, as in the old reports' read as as-was: the four regions North, South, East and West, with the Capital Region not yet in existence (it was created 28 April 2025)
Web orders are dated on the dispatch date in Helsinki time per the company definition, so an order placed in late August and dispatched in September counts in September
Online (the web shop, store 900) is shown as its own row rather than being allocated to a physical region, as in past regional reports
No total row given as the request did not ask for one
caveats: The company definition of web sales recognises revenue on the dispatch date; if the VAT filing must follow the order date or invoice date for web orders, the Online figures and month split would differ

The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024; August lines carry 24% and September lines 25.5% (reduced 14% and 10% unchanged). I checked all lines in both months: gross_amount equals net_amount times (1 + vat_rate) on every line
Figures are before returns, as asked; refunds are not deducted, so these are not net-of-returns figures
Excluded store 999 (training) and ZZ Test articles per house rules. No duplicate sales lines were found in the range
Cross-check: net sales before returns, built the same way, agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for every store-day in both months (gap 0.00). I did not find any data problem requiring correction

answer.sql: SELECT dp.sku, dp.product_name, SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5 AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = false GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name ORDER BY SUM(fsl.quantity) DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Best-selling products: ranked by total units sold (gross sales)
Last period: FY2026/27 P05 (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27), the latest fully_loaded fiscal period
Excludes staff purchases from analysis
assumptions: Last period interpreted as the latest fully loaded fiscal period in the warehouse: FY2026/27 P05
Best-selling measured by total units sold, not net of returns
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag = false)
Includes sales from all store locations (store_id < 900) and web channel
caveats: Returns not netted out: actual units retained are lower (e.g. SKU 101624 had 14 returns, SKU 103075 had 24 returns)
Ranking reflects volume, not revenue: higher-value products like SKU 101763 (9.03 EUR/unit) rank below higher-volume items like SKU 101624 (1.88 EUR/unit)
Data current as of period end 2026-09-27; no sales data from periods P01-P04 are included in this ranking

answer.sql:
WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_week,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END), 2) as sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END)) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) as growth_percent
FROM weekly_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_week
ORDER BY fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Total company sales: net sales (excluding VAT) from both store and web channels, excluding staff purchases
Fiscal week: ISO-aligned weeks mapped to fiscal year (fiscal weeks 5-8 of period 2)
Year comparison: FY2024/25 (last year) vs FY2025/26 (this year)
Growth: year-on-year percentage change in net sales
assumptions: This year = FY2025/26; last year = FY2024/25
Period 2 comprises fiscal weeks 5-8 in both fiscal years
Sales includes all customer types (members and non-members)
Growth is calculated as (FY2025/26 - FY2024/25) / FY2024/25 * 100
caveats: Fiscal week 8 sales are significantly lower in both years due to Midsummer holidays (June 21-22): stores are closed on Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (Finnish public holidays). This is not a data quality issue but reflects actual trading days.
Sales figures are net of line-level discounts, shown in EUR excluding VAT

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') SELECT business_date, ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

answer.sql: SELECT 102 AS store_id, 'Helsinki Pitäjänmäki' AS store_name, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 3

Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store identified by stable store_id 102, covering all store versions
Products grouped by stable sku, with the current product version's name
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (the filter changed nothing in this store and period)
Staff purchases included
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold for store 102 over the same days

'Products' means individual articles (sku), not subcategories or brands
'Units sold' is read as units on sales lines before returns, the quantity definition used elsewhere in the library; no top-3 ranking position changes if returns are netted off instead
Ranking uses units only; no tie affects the top 3 (4th place has 30 units)

Returns were not netted off. Netting them would take only 1 unit from third place (Batteries & Bulbs Havu Pro 791, 41 units); ranks and order are unchanged
Helsinki Pitäjänmäki moved from the South region to the Capital Region on 28 April 2025. This does not affect a single-store, single-period answer
No data problems found that needed correction

answer.sql: WITH ty AS (SELECT period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4), ly AS (SELECT period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4), lfl_stores AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= (SELECT s FROM ly) - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ty) AND (SELECT e FROM ty) THEN r.net_sales END) / sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ly) AND (SELECT e FROM ly) THEN r.net_sales END) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN lfl_stores USING (store_id) WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ly) AND (SELECT e FROM ly) OR r.business_date BETWEEN (SELECT s FROM ty) AND (SELECT e FROM ty)
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 is 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30 (4 weeks, fiscal weeks 14-17), compared with period 4 of FY2025/26, 2025-07-28 to 2025-08-24 (the same fiscal weeks)

Net sales: euros excluding VAT, after returns, as in rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales (sales by sale date minus refunds by return date); this matches the sum of fact_sales_line and fact_return_line exactly
Like-for-like store set: physical stores (store_id below 900) that traded in every day of both periods and had been open at least 12 months before the start of the prior-year period
Web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded from the store base
Store identity by store_id (stable across versions), not store_key
Like-for-like growth = this-year net sales divided by last-year net sales for the same set of stores, minus 1
assumptions: 'This year' is FY2026/27, the current fiscal year at the request date (2026-10-07); period 4 is fully loaded in the warehouse
Like-for-like was read as store net sales growth, so web sales are excluded; no like-for-like definition is documented in the warehouse

The 12-month maturity rule is my own reading of standard retail practice. It excludes Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2024-09-02) and Lohja (137, opened 2024-11-04), because their prior-year period was in their first year of trading
Savonlinna (129) is excluded because it closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in this year's period
Staff purchases are kept in net sales, as in the Data & Analytics report table
Kuopio (reopened 2026-07-26 after its refit) and Pori (refit 2025-09-08 to 2025-10-12) are kept in. Both traded on every day of both comparison periods, and neither closure falls inside either period
The result is rounded to two decimals and is the aggregate across 36 stores, not an average of store growth rates
caveats: Excluded from the like-for-like base: Savonlinna (129, closed), Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened Nov 2024). The comparable base is 36 stores, with net sales of 969,960.16 last year and 967,703.65 this year

The result is a small decline and is sensitive to the store set and definition. Including stores 136 and 137 gives -0.03%. Excluding staff purchases gives -0.13%. Excluding Kuopio and Pori as refit-affected stores gives -0.02%. The sign is negative in all four cases but the size is within a fraction of a percent

Store-level growth is widely spread, from -26% (Mikkeli) to +21% (Kokkola) among the base stores. I found no data defect behind the largest declines: every store has all 28 days in both periods, and sales lines and return lines have no duplicate IDs

The warehouse holds old backup, staging and temporary tables (bak_*, stg_*, tmp_lfl_store_list_*, dim_*_old), which I did not use. The tmp_lfl lists are stale and include stores that are not comparable now
The warehouse has no documented like-for-like rule. Please confirm that Finance's definition matches the 12-month maturity and closure treatment used here
Sales lines from this year have a null channel_code (channel_id is used instead). This does not affect the result because the store set is defined from dim_store

answer.sql: SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format, round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT s.store_id::VARCHAR || '-' || f.receipt_id::VARCHAR), 2) AS average_basket_value_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON p.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND p.fiscal_period = 4 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 taken from ref_fiscal_calendar: 3 August to 30 August 2026, 4 weeks, fully loaded
Basket = one receipt, so average basket value = net sales divided by the number of distinct receipts
Net sales are in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), the basis the warehouse uses for sales
Baskets are before returns (sales receipts only, refunds not netted off)
Store channel only (channel_id 1, Store), so web home delivery and click-and-collect are excluded
Store format taken from dim_store through the store_key on each sales line
assumptions: Marjatta wrote 'FY26/27'; I read it as the warehouse label FY2026/27, and 'period 4' as fiscal period 4 (3 to 30 August 2026)
'Average basket value' means average value per receipt, not per item or per customer
Value is net of VAT, in line with the warehouse's sales measures; the gross figure would be higher
Returns are not netted off baskets, because a refund is booked against the original receipt on a different date and is not part of the basket

Staff purchases are kept in: they are real till receipts, and Data & Analytics' own daily store sales report (rpt_daily_store_sales) includes them (18,027 receipts, matching exactly). Leaving them out would lower the receipt count to 17,747 and move each format's average by only a few cents to about one euro
Rows are ordered Small, Medium, Large, and the requested breakdown is by the formats actually in the warehouse
caveats: The sales line column channel_code (ST/WB) is NULL for every line in this period. The legacy rpt.v_daily_sales view filters on it, so it would drop all store sales or mis-assign web sales. I used channel_id instead (1 = Store; 2 and 3 = web). This is a correction to the usual approach

The training store (store_id 999) has 55 receipts (EUR 1,884.86) in the period, booked on the Store channel. I excluded it, together with the web shop (store_id 900), by filtering to store_id below 900

The dim_store column comment says formats are Hyper, Standard or Express, but the warehouse actually holds Small, Medium and Large (stores) plus Web and Training pseudo-formats. I reported Small, Medium and Large

Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales in the period, so 38 stores are included: 12 Small, 18 Medium, 8 Large. No store had a planned refit closure in the period, and every store traded on all 28 days

Checks found no duplicate sales line IDs or repeated line numbers within receipts, no zero or negative amounts, and no unusually large baskets (the largest is EUR 568.67). Totals for receipts (18,027), net sales (EUR 1,062,266.72) and units match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly

Receipt counts behind the averages are Small 2,641, Medium 8,779 and Large 6,607. Medium and Large are only about 45 cents apart (60.15 against 60.60), so I would not read much into that gap; Small is clearly lower, at about 10 euros less

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (not the order date)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web shop identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect counted as web
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales)

assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year that ended 3 May 2026. This follows how accepted requests since May 2026 read it, and the request came in on 6 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27.
'Periods 5 to 8' means fiscal periods P05, P06, P07 and P08, shown as four separate rows.

The four periods sum to 701,457.87. This matches the web shop's total in rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days exactly (gap 0.00).

rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used. They drop web sales from 3 Nov 2025 because they rely on channel_code. P8 runs through December 2025, so using them would have understated P8.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year,
           5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns (return on return date)
Store scope: all trading stores (store_id < 900); web shop (900) included in company total
Excluded: store 999 (training), category ZZ Test
Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date (delivered/collected status)
Hierarchy: as-is (current store version)
assumptions: Period 2 this year: FY2026/27 P2 (fiscal weeks 5-8, 1-28 June 2026) as the most recent completed period 2
Same weeks last year: FY2025/26 P2 (same fiscal week numbers 5-8, 26 May-22 June 2025)
Total company means all stores combined (no regional breakdown)
caveats: Week 7 (16-22 June 2026) shows -32.2% decline due to store 125 (Kuopio) closure for refit (15 June - 26 July 2026); no equivalent closure in FY2025/26 week 7, making year-on-year comparison unequal
Week 8 shows 76.4% growth; no matching operational event identified; Kuopio remains closed
Control total verification passed: result total EUR 1,294,647.64 matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for FY2026/27 P2

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share: click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales
Web sales: recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time, excluding VAT, after returns
Net sales: net amount after line discounts and returns, excluding test articles and store 999
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year prior to the current FY2026/27 as of request date 2026-10-06)
Periods 9 and 10 of FY2025/26 (22 December 2025 to 22 February 2026)
Click-and-collect orders counted by fulfilment_type from fact_web_order, which is consistent across the 3 November 2025 platform migration
Includes click-and-collect orders with status 'delivered' or 'collected'
caveats: Periods 9 and 10 are fully loaded in the warehouse

answer.sql: WITH targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19), wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), spend AS (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND(net_spend,2) AS net_spend_eur FROM spend
definitions_applied: Targeted member: at least one exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member (not exposure rows or member_key)
Net sales before returns, excluding VAT, on lines linked to a member (campaign spend basis)
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order (delivered or collected orders); store sales on sale_date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Members' lines linked through member_key to member_id so every version of a member is picked up
Deprecated tables, staging tables and rpt.v_daily_sales not used
assumptions: Spring Garden Launch 2026 is campaign_id 19 (window 4 to 24 May 2026), the only campaign of that name in dim_campaign.
Contacted means the member has at least one row in fact_campaign_exposure for the campaign, whether or not the contact was delivered or opened.
Spend means net sales before returns, excluding VAT, in EUR, following the company campaign convention. Returns are not deducted.
The spend window is exactly 4 to 24 May 2026 as requested, without the extra seven days used in the campaign uplift definition.
Spend covers all channels (stores and web) and all products.
caveats: No data problem was found that changed the answer. The checks on campaign 19 found no duplicate exposure IDs, no exposures outside 4 to 24 May 2026, no contacts to members without marketing consent on the contact date, and no overlap between the contacted members and the 1,597 holdout members.
31,685 exposure rows reduce to 15,001 distinct members, so counting rows would overstate contacted members about twice over.
The mailing list is 16,624 members including 1,597 held out, which leaves 15,027. 15,001 were contacted, so 26 were on the list but have no exposure row. I did not try to explain the gap.
Of the 15,001 contacted members, 14,814 had at least one contact delivered. If Sanna means delivered contacts only, the count is 14,814 and the spend would need re-running for those members.

Of the 15,001 contacted members, 2,605 made at least one purchase in the window. The spend is 190,687.59 EUR net of VAT across 8,080 lines. Of that, 35,168.92 EUR is web, dated on the dispatch date. A web order placed inside the window but dispatched after 24 May is left out, and one placed earlier but dispatched inside the window is included.
The figure is before returns. Including VAT, the same lines come to 238,805.59 EUR gross. Returns were not netted off.
This is total spend by the contacted members, not spend caused by the campaign. Measuring that needs the holdout comparison (campaign uplift), which was not asked for.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply to a member subset, so it was not run.

answer.sql: WITH web_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2), web_returns AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.refunds_net, 0) AS web_net_sales FROM web_sales s LEFT JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Net sales: EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), after line discounts and after returns (refund_net)
Fiscal calendar: company fiscal year and fiscal periods from dim_date
Web channel: channel_code 'WB' before the web-platform migration (up to 2 Nov 2025), channel_id 2 (web home delivery) and 3 (click and collect) from 3 Nov 2025
Sale date: sale_date, which matches the Helsinki-local date of the UTC timestamp
Returns: refunds are booked in the period of the return date, not of the original sale
Cancelled web orders carry no sales lines, so they are not in the figures
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request date is 9 Oct 2026 and FY2026/27 is still running. Periods 5 to 8 of FY2025/26 run 25 Aug to 21 Dec 2025.

'Web net sales' is read as net of returns, matching how the daily store sales report defines net sales (sales before returns minus refunds). Sales before returns are 158124.35, 194176.17, 166510.02 and 249084.84 for periods 5 to 8.
Web includes both home delivery and click-and-collect, since the request names no fulfilment type.
A return counts as a web return when the original sales line was a web line, wherever the refund was booked.
One row per fiscal period, with no total row, because the request says 'by period'.
caveats: The sales-channel key changed during the period. Lines before 3 Nov 2025 have channel_code and no channel_id. Lines from 3 Nov 2025 have channel_id and no channel_code. A filter on either field alone would drop part of period 7 and all of period 8, so I used both. Before the migration, click-and-collect is not separated from web home delivery.

Part of the web returns are booked on store versions, not on the web shop (store 900). In the four periods, 19,725 EUR of refunds on web lines were booked at stores and 60,657 EUR at the web shop. I counted all of them against web. A filter on the web shop alone gives 5,495 / 4,783 / 4,902 / 4,545 EUR (periods 5 to 8) higher web net sales than my figures.

rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 does not match the fact table. Its daily web figures are shifted, with near-zero Sundays, and the period sums differ from the fact table by up to about 6,000 EUR (period 8). I did not use it. The figures come from fact_sales_line and fact_return_line.

The staging tables (stg_sales_line_load, stg_return_line_load) were not used. The 141 staged return lines are already in fact_return_line, and there are no duplicate receipt lines on web sales in these periods.
Periods 5 to 8 are marked fully loaded in the fiscal calendar, and there is web activity on every day of the four periods.
Store 999 is another non-store location with sales in the same dates, coded as store channel. I treated it as non-web and excluded it.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.format AS store_format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value) = net sales before returns, excluding VAT, divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: web shop (store 900) left out, store 999 (training) left out
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded from ATV
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Fiscal period from dim_date (FY2026/27 P4 = Monday 3 Aug to Sunday 30 Aug 2026, four whole fiscal weeks)
Sales dated by sale_date (the Helsinki business date)
Store format taken from the current store version (format does not change between versions in this warehouse)
Checked against the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for the period (net sales before returns)
assumptions: 'Period 4 of FY26/27' is read as fiscal year FY2026/27, fiscal period 4 (3 to 30 August 2026). It is fully loaded, and the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.

'Store format' is the dim_store.format column. Its actual values are Large, Medium and Small (plus Web and Training, which are not stores in scope for ATV), not Hyper/Standard/Express as the schema comment says.
'Average basket value' is read as the company's ATV definition (net sales before returns excluding VAT, per receipt).
Returns do not reduce ATV, per the company definition.
caveats: The dim_store.format column comment (Hyper, Standard or Express) is out of date. The real values are Large, Medium and Small, and I used those.
Staff purchases (666 lines, about 280 receipts in the period) are excluded from ATV per the company definition. Including them would change the figures slightly.
No store 999 or ZZ Test lines appeared in the period, so those filters did not change any figure.

Control check: net sales before returns and receipts for all physical stores in P4 match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (1,062,266.72 EUR; 18,027 receipts) before the staff-purchase exclusion. The ATV query also drops staff purchases, so its totals are lower than that control by design.
Store counts in the period are Large 8, Medium 18 and Small 12. These are stores with sales in P4 and are not shown in the table.
No duplicate sales lines, no receipts spanning several stores or dates, and no non-positive line amounts were found in the period.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Cancelled and processing orders are not web sales
Fiscal calendar from dim_date (4-4-5 periods, weeks Monday to Sunday)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just ended, following past accepted readings of 'last year' made while FY2026/27 was current
'Periods 5 to 8' read as fiscal periods 5, 6, 7 and 8 of FY2025/26, one row per period: 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025 (P5), 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 (P6), 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025 (P7), 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 (P8)
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT (the company net sales definition), as 'net' was not asked for including VAT
Per-period figures only, with no total across the four periods, since none was asked for
caveats: Each period's figure matches the web shop (store 900) line in rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (gap 0.00 in all four periods)
Web sales are measured on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date, so orders placed late in a period but dispatched in the next count in the next period

Returns are booked where they are processed. Web-sold items returned at a physical store reduce that store's net sales, not the web shop's. In these periods that was 111, 121, 125 and 144 return lines worth about EUR 5,495, 4,784, 4,901 and 4,545 net (P5 to P8). The web figures above exclude them, as the company definition requires
Web returns sent by post are booked to the web shop and are deducted in the period of the return date, which can differ from the period of the sale
One test-article web line (EUR 5.50 net, category ZZ Test) was excluded; the exclusion changes the total by a negligible amount
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used: they leave out web sales from 3 November 2025, which falls inside P7
channel_code was not used to identify web: it is empty from the 3 November 2025 platform migration, so store_id 900 identifies web throughout
No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the web data for these periods

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fwo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(fsl.net_amount), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM fact_sales_line fsl JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsl.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsl.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 43 AND fwo.status <> 'cancelled' AND s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales: recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time, not order date
Click-and-collect share: click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales
Web shop identified as store_id 900 (pseudo-store for online channel)
Cancelled orders excluded from web sales
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded from reporting
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year prior to current FY2026/27 as of request date 2026-10-06)
Periods 9 and 10 refer to fiscal periods P9 and P10 of FY2025/26 (22 Dec 2025 to 22 Feb 2026)
Click-and-collect share calculated from net sales (excluding VAT), after returns
caveats: No data quality issues identified by warehouse validation checks

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'

Order date in Helsinki time, converted from order_ts_utc
Cancelled orders excluded
Processing orders counted (none fell on this day)
Click-and-collect and home delivery both counted as web orders
Guest and logged-in orders both counted

'Placed' means the order timestamp, so the count is by order date, not dispatch date
All fulfilment types and both logged-in and guest orders are included, since the request does not restrict them
caveats: Using the UTC date instead of the Helsinki date would give a different count. Finland was on UTC+2 on 1 December 2025, so Helsinki 1 December runs from 2025-11-30 22:00 UTC to 2025-12-01 21:59 UTC. I used the Helsinki day.

answer.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, u.sku, cp.product_name, u.units_sold FROM units u JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = u.sku AND cp.is_current ORDER BY u.units_sold DESC, u.sku LIMIT 3

Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by Helsinki sale_date
Store scope: physical store only, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki = store_id 102 (both store versions, keyed on store_id)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Product identity by sku (stable across versions), named from the current product version
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) not part of the store figure
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
assumptions: 'Period 5 of FY26/27' read as FY2026/27 P05, 31 August to 27 September 2026
'Sold the most units' read as units sold on sales lines, before returns (the rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold convention); the dictionary defines units sold on sales lines, not net of returns
'Products' read as individual articles (sku), not subcategories or brands

Returns do not change the answer: only 1 unit of the third-ranked article (102244) was returned at the store in the period, leaving it on 41, still well ahead of the 4th place (30)
Store 102 has two versions in dim_store (region South until 27 April 2025, Capital Region after); grouping by store_id handles this and region does not affect the answer
No duplicate sales lines found in the store/period; no corrections to the data were needed
Staff purchases (55 units in total at the store in the period) are included per the company definition; they do not affect the ranking by the margins found

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counted as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, with returns on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Web shop identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar periods from dim_date
Refunds booked to the web shop assigned to the original order's fulfilment type
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 9 October 2026 (in FY2026/27) read as FY2025/26, following how earlier requests worded this way were read
Periods 6 to 8 are FY2025/26 P6 (22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025), P7 (27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025) and P8 (24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025)
'Sales' read as net sales excluding VAT, not gross
Shares given as percent to two decimals, one per period
caveats: P7 and P8 are after the 3 November 2025 web-platform migration, when channel_code stopped being filled; the query avoids channel_code and rpt.v_daily_sales (which drops web sales from that date)
All three periods are fully loaded in the warehouse
Web net sales for each period reconcile exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 (175,588.62, 154,977.27 and 225,265.08 EUR), so no unexplained gap
The period 8 share includes Black Friday week and the run-up to Christmas, and period 7 includes the migration, so the three shares are not a steady trend
No data problem needed correcting beyond the exclusions above

definitions_applied: DEF-NEW-MEMBER: A new member is counted on their join date, at the home store in their first version in dim_member (the store where they enrolled)
assumptions: The date 2026-09-25 is interpreted as September 25, 2026
Counted distinct member_id where join_date equals this date and the row is the member's first version in dim_member

No data quality issues detected by query-check validation

definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order table, not from sales lines
Order date in Helsinki time
Cancelled orders excluded; processing orders included
assumptions: Cyber Monday is 1 December 2025
Order count includes all statuses except cancelled (includes processing orders awaiting dispatch)
