Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: The request was received on 5 October 2026, in FY2026/27. I read 'Q3 last year' as Q3 of last fiscal year, FY2025/26 Q3: fiscal weeks 27 to 39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026. Accepted past requests read 'last year' as FY2025/26 once FY2026/27 had started. The comparator is FY2024/25 Q3, weeks 27 to 39, 28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025.

Regions are shown as-is, on the current five-region hierarchy. The request did not ask for as-was. The Capital Region therefore includes stores 101-105 for both years, although it did not exist in the FY2024/25 Q3 comparator period.
The result is one row per region and has no total row, because only a breakdown by region was asked for.
The result gives LFL growth only, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals; the underlying this-year and last-year net sales are not shown because they were not asked for.

Savonlinna (129) has close_date 25 Jan 2026, which is the last day of week 39. Its daily sales in rpt_daily_store_sales run through 25 Jan, so I treated it as trading in all 13 weeks and kept it in the East base.
The 364-day opening rule was tested against 27 Oct 2025 (start of the range), so the cut-off is 28 Oct 2024.
caveats: Correction: Lohja (137, South, opened 4 Nov 2024) is left out of the LFL base. It had been open for less than 52 weeks before 27 Oct 2025, and it did not trade in the comparator weeks 27 to 28 of FY2024/25. Including it would lift South.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, West, opened 2 Sep 2024) is in the base. It was open for more than 52 weeks before 27 Oct 2025.

No refit closure falls in either Q3 window. Pori (8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025) ends before week 27 and Tammisto's refit (8 Jul to 11 Aug 2024) falls in FY2024/25 Q1, so no store-week was dropped for a refit. The base is 38 stores x 13 weeks = 494 store-weeks in each year.

Savonlinna, which closed on 25 Jan 2026, is included for all 13 weeks because it traded through the last day of the window. From week 40 onward it drops out of LFL, so any later period would be affected.

Capital Region is the five stores 101-105 (Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto, Kerava). Kouvola (114) is in South, not East. These are as-is and differ from the FY2024/25 regions as they stood then.

Store-level net sales for the physical stores, built from sales lines and returns, agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales over the same days: 6,622 store-days across both years, zero mismatches. The only gap against the control is the web shop (store 900), which LFL excludes by definition.
I checked the source rows for the two windows: no duplicate sales_line_id, (receipt_id, line_no) or return_line_id.
No use of rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt_weekly_sales_by_region or any stg_, bak_ or tmp_ table, and no use of channel_code.
South (0.02%) and Capital Region (0.36%) are essentially flat. North (6.73%) and West (4.77%) are the strong regions.
The company LFL total for this quarter is 2.65%. It is not part of the table because the request asked only for the regional breakdown.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) SELECT d.fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
Net amount excludes VAT, after line discounts
Staff purchases excluded from ATV (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Store lines dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Web lines dated by the Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order, not sale_date
Web shop identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code
Cancelled and processing web orders excluded, because they have no sales lines
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2026/27 periods 1 to 3, which is weeks 1 to 13
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
Deprecated objects not used (rpt.v_daily_sales, bak_, stg_, tmp_ and old tables)
assumptions: 'This year' is read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27.

'Periods 1 to 3' is read as FY2026/27 P1 to P3, which runs Monday 4 May 2026 to Sunday 2 August 2026 (91 days, weeks 1 to 13). All three periods are complete, since the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.
'The whole company' is read as all physical stores (store_id below 900) plus the web shop (store 900) in one pooled figure. No breakdown by store, region or channel was asked for.

ATV is normally a store-only measure, and the company definition leaves web orders out. Mika asked for web orders to be included, so I followed the request. Each web order counts as one receipt, and web net sales are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date.
Staff purchases are excluded from the web part too, as in the company ATV definition. No staff-flagged web lines exist in the range.
Net sales before returns are used, with no refunds deducted, as in the ATV definition.
caveats: This is not the standard company ATV, because it includes web orders at Mika's request. The pooled ATV is 56.14 EUR excluding VAT, from 79,988 receipts and 4,490,717.08 EUR net sales before returns.
For reference only, the two parts are: stores 55.52 EUR (66,984 receipts, 3,719,186.33 EUR net) and web 59.33 EUR (13,004 orders, 771,530.75 EUR net). Stores alone is the standard ATV figure.
Excluded from the figure: 1,037 staff-purchase receipts in stores (48,734.94 EUR net), and store 999 and ZZ Test lines.
The store 999 and ZZ Test exclusion removed lines worth about 7,800 EUR net in the range. This includes 3 ZZ Test web lines (6.00 EUR) and 120 ZZ Test lines in store 999.
The figure excludes VAT. Including VAT would need gross_amount and would give a higher ATV.

Store control total: store-level receipts and net sales before returns agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for all stores over 4 May to 2 August 2026, so no gap needed correcting. The web totals (13,004 receipts, 771,530.75 EUR) also match the web shop (store 900) row in rpt_daily_store_sales. The comparison was made on all non-test lines including staff purchases, as the control table includes them.
Source data checks found no duplicate sales lines in the range (sales_line_id and receipt_id plus line_no are unique) and no web lines missing a dispatch date. I made no corrections to the data.
Store 125 Kuopio is in its refit closure from 15 June 2026 (49 trading days in the range in rpt_daily_store_sales). Its receipts only count for the days it traded, and nothing was adjusted for this.

answer.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(rds.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, ds.store_id, ds.store_name, SUM(rds.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON rds.store_id = ds.store_id WHERE rds.business_date >= '2025-08-25' AND rds.business_date <= '2025-09-21' AND ds.is_current = TRUE GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name HAVING SUM(rds.net_sales) > 0 ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Fiscal period: period 5 of FY2025/26, which runs from 2025-08-25 to 2025-09-21
Net sales metric: net_sales from rpt_daily_store_sales (EUR excluding VAT), excluding refunds
Store identification: current version of stores only (is_current = TRUE)
League table: stores ranked by net sales in descending order
assumptions: "Last year" interpreted as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year prior to the current FY2026/27)
Period 5 refers to fiscal period 5, not calendar period
Performance metric is net sales (EUR excluding VAT) as the primary ranking criterion
League table includes all sales channels, including the web shop (store_id 900)
caveats: Store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop) is a pseudo-location representing online sales and is included in the league table; if only physical stores are required, exclude this row
Net sales figures are after line discounts and excluding VAT
All 40 stores have positive sales in this period; no stores were closed during period 5 of FY2025/26

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND ds.store_id = 107 AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
definitions_applied: Cleaning Products identified as subcategory within Cleaning & Household category
Current fiscal year FY2026/27 used for 'this year' interpretation
Store identified by name Hyvinkää (store_id 107)
Units from fact_sales_line.quantity field
Period 5 from fiscal calendar (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
assumptions: Request for 'this year' interpreted as current fiscal year FY2026/27, not FY2025/26
Requested 'Cleaning Products' mapped to dim_product.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
All sales channels included (store sales only in this case, channel_id = 1)
