Refunds of web-sold lines booked at stores were 11.4k EUR (FY2024/25) and 15.2k EUR (FY2025/26); rpt_daily_store_sales leaves these in the stores' returns. Under that report's treatment, regional figures would be lower and the web line higher by those amounts.
Excluding staff purchases would lower store-region sales by about 1.2% (about 40k EUR in each year) if Finance defines net sales that way.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share of web sales = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (dispatch_ts_utc converted from UTC to Europe/Helsinki), not the order date
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date and are tied back to the original order's fulfilment type
Web identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Only delivered and collected orders count; cancelled and processing orders have no dispatch and no sales lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal periods from dim_date (FY2025/26, periods 9 and 10, weeks 35-43, 22 Dec 2025 to 22 Feb 2026)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
Deprecated objects not used (rpt.v_daily_sales, stg_, bak_, tmp_ tables)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27, following how earlier accepted requests were read; period 9 and 10 therefore mean FY2025/26 P09 and P10
'Periods 9 and 10' answered as one share per period, not one combined figure for the two periods
'Web sales' read as web net sales, not order counts, so the share is of net sales, not of orders
Shares shown to one decimal place
caveats: The share is of web net sales, not of web orders. A share of web orders would be a different figure.

Neither channel_code nor channel_id could be used to find web or click-and-collect lines, because the 3 November 2025 platform migration affects the period. Store 900 and fulfilment_type were used instead, so this does not change the result. rpt.v_daily_sales was not used because it leaves out web sales from 3 November 2025.

Web net sales by period in the figures behind the shares: P09 EUR 200,208.58 (click-and-collect 58,536.07); P10 EUR 123,131.15 (click-and-collect 37,861.39). Both match the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 exactly (difference 0.00).
Both periods are fully loaded in the warehouse. No duplicate lines, orders or returns were found, and no web returns were booked outside the web shop.

Refunds are counted on the return date, so some refunds in P9 and P10 belong to orders dispatched earlier, and some P9 and P10 orders will have refunds booked later, up to 30 days after sale. The P10 share could move slightly as late returns arrive.

answer.sql:
WITH period_info AS (
  SELECT 
    weeks_in_period
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period_label = 'FY2026/27 P05'
),
stock_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as quantity_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.category, sb.category) as category,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.closing_units, 0) * pi.weeks_in_period / COALESCE(sb.quantity_sold, 1)::DECIMAL, 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_category s
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_by_category sb ON s.category = sb.category
CROSS JOIN period_info pi
ORDER BY category;
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover: closing stock units divided by weekly consumption rate (period sales / period weeks)
Last period: final fully loaded fiscal period in ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27 P05)
Closing stock: unit inventory at week ending 2026-09-27
Consumption rate: total quantity sold during the 4-week period
assumptions: Last period refers to the most recent fully loaded fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
Stock snapshot at period end date accurately represents inventory position at period close
Weekly consumption is calculated as total period sales divided by 4 weeks
Test category (ZZ Test) excluded as it contains test articles only
caveats: ZZ Test category excluded from results (contains test articles)
Stock data source is fact_stock_week at 2026-09-27; sales data from fact_sales_line during period
Weeks of cover is a snapshot calculation using period-end stock and period-average weekly consumption
Categories with zero closing units but sales would show division handling; no such category present

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM first_version fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the store where they enrolled)
Online sign-ups reported under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
Members counted by distinct member_id, one first version per member, so later tier, home-store or consent versions do not double count or move a member to another store
Fiscal calendar: join dates assigned to the fiscal year through dim_date
Store names shown as-is (current store version)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks), as in past accepted requests. It is not calendar 2025.
The 53rd week (27 April to 3 May 2026) is included, because there is no comparison in this request.
A store with no sign-ups in the year has no row, because the result has no padding rows.
The closed store Savonlinna (129) is shown, since it signed up members before it closed on 25 January 2026.

The total across all stores and the web shop is 14,854 new members. I did not include a total row because you did not ask for one.
Each member is attributed to the store where they enrolled (first version), not to their current home store, which may have changed since.

Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026, so its 113 sign-ups cover only the part of the year before the closure. Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in autumn 2024 and were open all year.

I did not run the query_check script or the rpt_daily_store_sales control comparison. No script runner was available, and that control total covers sales, not members. I checked instead that every member_id has exactly one first version (60,000 members, 60,000 first versions), that join_date equals the first version's valid_from for all of them, and that every home store matches a current dim_store row.
I found no data problem that needed correcting.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open (after opening, before closure), excluding closed holidays (dim_date.is_trading_day) and ref_store_closure refit days
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P2 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday 1 June to Sunday 28 June 2026
Store names and format from the current dim_store version (as-is)
Control total: store-level net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P2, the current fiscal year (it began 4 May 2026), as in the accepted reading of earlier requests such as REQ-D10.
'Store ranking' is read as the company store league table: ranked by net sales per trading day, highest first, rather than by total net sales.
A store that traded only part of the period (Kuopio) is kept and ranked on the days it traded.
Ties are not an issue; rank is by unrounded net sales per trading day, shown to 2 decimals.
caveats: Kuopio (125) was shut for a refit from 15 June 2026 and traded only 14 of the period's 26 trading days (1 to 14 June). Its net sales (23,993.71) are a part-period figure; its rank (7) is on net sales per trading day, so it is not comparable with other stores' total net sales.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no trading days or sales in the period, so it is not listed.
Two closed holidays fall in the period (Midsummer Eve 19 June and Midsummer Day 20 June), so full-period stores have 26 trading days rather than 28.
Store 999 and ZZ Test article lines (121 lines, 2,385.03 net) were excluded.

Checks run: no duplicate sales or return lines, no sales on closed days and none in Kuopio's refit days, and the result total of 1,063,916.20 matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (gap 0.00). No data corrections were needed.
The warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026, so P2 is complete.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect counted as web
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: periods from dim_date (4-4-5 pattern, year starts end of April)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the last full fiscal year, FY2025/26 (the current year on the request date, 9 Oct 2026, is FY2026/27). Past requests made in FY2026/27 read it this way.
Periods 5 to 8 of FY2025/26 run 25 Aug 2025 to 21 Dec 2025 (P5 and P7 to P8 are 4 weeks, P6 is 5 weeks). Week 53 is in P12 and does not affect this range.
Amounts are in EUR excluding VAT, since net sales is the company definition and the request did not ask for VAT-inclusive figures.
caveats: Period 6 has 5 weeks and the others 4, so P6 is not directly comparable with the other periods in length.

The 3 November 2025 web-platform migration falls in P7 and blanked channel_code. Web was identified by store 900, so nothing is missing. The legacy view rpt.v_daily_sales would have left out web sales from that date and was not used.
Test-article lines (category ZZ Test, EUR 5.50 net on web lines) were excluded, a negligible change.
Results match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly in each of the four periods (gap 0.00).
P6 and P8 include late returns booked on their own return dates (up to 30 days after the sale), so a sale made near a period end may be netted against a return in the next period.

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.subcategory, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category = 'Garden'), ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, s.subcategory, round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY s.subcategory ORDER BY s.subcategory
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: Q1 of FY2025/26 is 2025-04-28 to 2025-07-27 (13 weeks, from ref_fiscal_calendar)
Product category and subcategory taken from the product version in force at the sale date (the product_key on the sales line)
Net values in EUR excluding VAT, as in the company's daily sales report (net_amount for sales, refund_net for refunds)
Returns linked to the sales line they refund (sales_line_id), so every refund counts against the quarter the goods were sold in, whenever the return happened
Store and web lines both included; staff purchases included, as the company's daily sales report includes them
Cancelled web orders have no sales lines, so they are not in the sold base
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request date is 2026-10-06 and the company reports on a fiscal calendar (FY2026/27 is the current year). Q1 means fiscal Q1, not calendar Q1 (Jan to Mar)

'Return rate' read as value: refunds excluding VAT divided by net sales excluding VAT on the same lines. The unit-based rate (units returned / units sold) is close: Barbecue & Grills 6.47, Edible Plants & Seeds 0.99, Garden Furniture 12.69, Garden Tools 5.19, Outdoor Lighting 7.23, Plants & Flowers 2.72, Pots & Planters 3.89, Soil & Fertiliser 1.71
'Goods sold in Q1' read as a sales-cohort measure: returns made after the quarter ended (up to 2026-10-04, the latest data) are included, so the figures are final for this cohort
Garden subcategories are those classified under Garden at the time of sale
caveats: Outdoor Lighting was moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27. It is included because it was a Garden subcategory when these goods were sold. If Pekka wants the current Garden hierarchy, drop that row; the other seven rows are unaffected
Using current product classification would have wrongly dropped about 65 reclassified Outdoor Lighting SKUs from Garden. Using the sale-date product version avoids this
Return rates are much higher online than in stores in every subcategory (for example Garden Furniture 20.3% vs 10.5% by units); the blended figures depend on the channel mix
Garden Furniture is the outlier at about 12.9%, and Barbecue & Grills and Outdoor Lighting are about 7%. Edible Plants & Seeds and Soil & Fertiliser are under 2%

Checked and found clean for this window: no duplicate sales or return lines, no returns without a sales line, no returns dated before the sale, no returns exceeding quantity sold, and returns fully loaded to 2026-10-04. Staging and backup tables were not used

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount END) AS gross_sales_august_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount END) AS gross_sales_september_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.region IN ('North','South','East','West') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales = fact_sales_line.gross_amount (EUR including VAT), before returns, so fact_return_line is not netted off
Region as at the time of sale = dim_store.region of the store version in fact_sales_line.store_key (the version valid on the sale date), not the current region
Regions are the four sales regions North, South, East and West, as in the old regional reports
Month = calendar month on sale_date (August 2024 = 1 to 31 Aug, September 2024 = 1 to 30 Sep)
VAT as recorded on each line: 24% standard rate through 31 Aug 2024, 25.5% from 1 Sep 2024, with reduced rates of 14% and 10%
assumptions: Read 'August and September 2024' as calendar months, not fiscal periods, since this is for a VAT filing.
Kept staff purchases, because they are taxable sales and carry VAT. They are 1,130 lines worth 36,741.31 gross over the two months, across all four regions plus the training store.

Left out the web shop (Online) and the training store because the old regional reports show only the four sales regions. The weekly regional sales report has no Online or Head office rows. Figures for both are in the caveats.
Took 'regions as they were at the time' to mean the region the store belonged to on the sale date, as stored on the sales lines.
caveats: Web shop sales are not in the table. Online gross sales were 174,410.47 in August 2024 and 160,395.63 in September 2024 (4,354 and 4,325 lines). If the filing needs total company VAT turnover, add these, because the table covers store sales only.

The Training store (store 999, region 'Head office') has sales lines in both months. I left them out as non-trading test data: 8 August 2024 lines' worth 4,282.23 gross in August (41 non-staff plus 117 staff lines) and 3,351.71 in September (25 plus 100 lines), 7,633.94 over the two months. Finance should confirm these are not real sales.

Region correction: in April 2025 the Helsinki-area stores 101 to 105 moved from South to 'Capital Region', and Kouvola (114) moved from East to South. I used the August and September 2024 regions, so those stores are in South, and Kouvola is in East. The current store dimension would give different regional totals.

Checks that found nothing to correct: no duplicate lines, gross matches net plus VAT on every line, VAT rates match the legal change on 1 September 2024, no gaps in trading days, and the store version on each line matches its sale date.

Two stores did not have a full two months. Vantaa Tammisto (104, South) was closed for a refit until 11 Aug 2024. Tampere Lamminpää (136, West) opened on 2 Sep 2024. Both are included for the days they traded.
The September figures use the new 25.5% standard VAT rate, so month-on-month gross comparisons are not like-for-like with August's 24%.
I did not reconcile to the regional sales reports. Those are net of returns, so they differ from gross-before-returns by design.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), q3 AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_quarter, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ly.fiscal_year AS prior_fiscal_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS prior_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY CASE ty.region WHEN 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own line, region Online
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
As-is hierarchy: region taken from the current store version (five regions including Capital Region, applied to both years)
Fiscal quarter from dim_date: Q3 = P7 to P9 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39
Prior-year comparison lined up by fiscal quarter and week, not by calendar dates
Growth % = (last year / year before - 1) x 100, rounded to one decimal
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: The request was received on 6 October 2026, in FY2026/27, so 'last year' is read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25. This follows how earlier requests in the library read 'last year'.
Q3 means fiscal Q3, not calendar Q3. FY2025/26 Q3 runs 27 October 2025 to 25 January 2026. FY2024/25 Q3 runs 28 October 2024 to 26 January 2025. Both are 13 whole weeks.
Regions are as-is, restated on the current region of each store. The request did not ask for regions as they were at the time.
'Net sales' is taken on the company definition, after returns.
Week 53 is not an issue, because it falls in Q4 of FY2025/26 and not in Q3.
Rows are ordered with the five physical regions first and Online last. Online is the web shop line the request asked for.
caveats: The as-is restatement moves history. The Capital Region was created on 28 April 2025, so the FY2024/25 Q3 figure for the Capital Region covers five stores (101, 102, 103, 104 and 105) that were in South at the time. The South figure for FY2024/25 excludes them, and Kouvola (114), which moved from East to South, is counted in South for both years. Under the regions as they stood at the time, the Capital Region would not exist for the earlier year and the regional growth rates would differ.
The Capital Region growth of 0.4% and the Online growth of 29.7% should be read with this in mind. Online is the web shop, which is in no physical region.

Store changes inside the comparison are not adjusted. Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 September 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 November 2024) are in the totals, and Lohja traded for only part of FY2024/25 Q3. Savonlinna (129) is included for the weeks it traded and closed on 25 January 2026. These are total net sales figures, not like-for-like, so part of the regional growth comes from the newer stores.

fact_sales_line holds 418 duplicated sales lines (same receipt_id and line_no, different sales_line_id, loaded again on 23 September 2025). All of them are dated in September 2025, outside both Q3 windows, so no correction was needed here. Anyone running a September 2025 request should deduplicate them.

The figures reconcile exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales by region for both years. Web orders that were cancelled or still processing do not appear in the Q3 windows, so the dispatch-date rule excluded nothing.
Store 999 and ZZ Test were filtered out. The data contains no other adjustments.

answer.sql: SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27, 31 August to 27 September 2026, dated on sale_date
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, before returns
Products counted by sku, the stable natural key, with the name from the current product version
Store 102 identified by store_id across both store versions
Store 999 and category ZZ Test left out
Staff purchases included
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold for store 102 over the same days
assumptions: 'Period 5 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P5, the last complete period, which ended on 27 September 2026 (request dated 7 October 2026).
'Units sold' is gross units sold, not net of returns, because the request asks for units sold and the control table's units_sold is on the same basis.
Helsinki Pitäjänmäki is store_id 102. Its two store versions (South, then Capital Region from 28 April 2025) are treated as one store.
Staff purchases are kept in, as in the company net-sales and units basis (55 of the store's 3,740 units).
Products are ranked by individual sku, not by subcategory or brand.
caveats: No data problems found, so no corrections were made.
Control total: sales-line units for store 102 in P5 are 3,740, matching rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold (3,740) exactly.
Grain check: 2,121 sales lines, with sales_line_id and receipt_id/line_no both unique. No duplicate rows.
The ZZ Test filter changed nothing: no test-article units were sold at this store in the period.
No ties at the cut-off. The fourth-ranked product has 30 units, against 42 for third place.
Units are before returns. A net-of-returns ranking was not run.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE cs.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY ALL
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 5 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, 28 days, fully loaded)
Units sold = sum of quantity on fact_sales_line, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date), as in rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
Store scope: physical store 107 Hyvinkää only, so no web lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither changes the figure)
Staff purchases included (4 of the 136 units)
As-is product hierarchy: current dim_product version, subcategory 'Cleaning Products' (category Cleaning & Household)
Versioned dimensions joined on store_key and product_key, with is_current for the as-is lookup, counted by natural key
Control total: all-product units and net sales for store 107 in P5 (1,626 units, EUR 27,297.68) match rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27
'Period 5' means fiscal period 5 of FY2026/27, which is complete (ended 27 Sep 2026) and fully loaded
'Cleaning Products' means the subcategory of that name, within the Cleaning & Household category, not the whole category
'Hyvinkää' means store 107, the only store with that name or city
'Units sold' means units on sales lines before returns. This follows the units definition in the stock skill and rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold, which are gross of returns
caveats: No returns for Cleaning Products at Hyvinkää were booked in P5, so the figure is the same before and after returns.

No data problems needing correction were found: there were no duplicate sales lines, no zero or negative quantities, and the store and product dimensions each have a single version for this selection.
The data covers 63 sales lines with net sales of EUR 560.58 excluding VAT.
The dim_store.format column comment is out of date. Hyvinkää is format 'Medium', not Hyper, Standard or Express. This does not affect the answer.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 10 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (not the order date)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, tied back to the order's fulfilment type
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Web identified by store_id 900, fulfilment type from fact_web_order (channel_code unreliable after the 3 Nov 2025 migration)
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: P09 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026, P10 = 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales (they drop web sales from 3 Nov 2025)
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26, the last completed fiscal year, per past accepted requests in FY2026/27. Request was received 6 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27.
'Periods 9 and 10' means FY2025/26 P09 and P10, each shown as its own row. Both periods are fully loaded.
'Web sales' means net sales excluding VAT, per the company definition, not order counts or gross amounts.
If one combined figure for P9 and P10 is wanted instead, it is about 29.8% (click-and-collect net 96,397.46 of web net 323,339.73).
caveats: Web net sales reconcile exactly to the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 (P09 200,208.58 EUR; P10 123,131.15 EUR).
No duplicate sales lines, return lines or web orders were found. No sales lines exist for cancelled or processing orders.
Share is on net sales after returns, so it differs from a share of orders or of gross sales.
Both periods straddle no migration date (the 3 Nov 2025 platform migration is earlier), so fulfilment_type was reliable; no correction to the data was needed.

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id (one dim_member row per version)
Current tier = the member version with is_current = true (valid_to 9999-12-31)
Versioned dimension handling: no joins between versions, no fact tables needed
No staging, backup or deprecated tables used
assumptions: 'Members on the Gold tier' is read as every loyalty member whose current tier is Gold, not only members who have purchased in the last 52 fiscal weeks (the company 'active member' definition would give a lower number)
'Right now' is read as the current version of each member in dim_member; the latest data in the warehouse is dated 4 October 2026, so the figure is as of the 4 October 2026 load, not 8 October
No exclusions for staff, home store or online sign-ups: the 1161 Gold members enrolled online (home store 900) are included
caveats: The count is as of the latest warehouse load (last sales 4 October 2026), so tier changes made between 4 and 8 October are not included
This is all Gold-tier members, not active Gold members; if Marketing wants only those who bought in the last 52 weeks, the number will be lower and the request should say so

Data checks found no problems: every one of the 60,000 members has exactly one current version, the is_current flag matches valid_to everywhere, and the same 5,791 Gold members result when selecting on the version valid on 8 October 2026, so no corrections were needed

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Web orders: counted from fact_web_order, excluding cancelled orders (includes processing orders per company definition)
assumptions: Requester's explicit request to count by UTC calendar day (not the standard Helsinki business date), for alignment with carrier report in UTC
Non-cancelled orders counted (all orders with status delivered, collected, or processing)
caveats: 357 orders all have completed status (delivered or collected); 0 processing orders on this UTC date

UTC/Helsinki boundary effect: 8 orders fall on 2025-11-28 in UTC only, 55 orders fall on 2025-11-28 in Helsinki time only (not UTC). Finland is in winter time (UTC+2) on 28 November 2025. The requester explicitly requested UTC calendar day counting, which accounts for this difference versus standard Helsinki-time reporting

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 10 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, with returns reducing sales on their own return date
Cancelled and processing orders excluded from web sales (only delivered and collected orders have dispatch dates and sales lines)
Web identified by store_id 900, click-and-collect by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, not channel_code
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Helsinki time for UTC timestamps
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: P9 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026 (5 weeks), P10 = 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026 (4 weeks)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' on a request dated 6 October 2026 (FY2026/27) means FY2025/26, as in past accepted requests; periods 9 and 10 of FY2025/26 are both complete and fully loaded
'Periods 9 and 10' answered as one share per period, not a combined figure
Share is of net sales (money), not of order counts, because the request says 'share of web sales'
Refunds on web orders are subtracted from the fulfilment type of the original order
caveats: No data problems needing correction were found. Web net sales tie exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 in both periods (P9 200,208.58 EUR; P10 123,131.15 EUR). No duplicate keys in the web order, sales line or return line tables.

Click-and-collect net sales were 58,536.07 EUR in P9 and 37,861.39 EUR in P10. Taken together, periods 9 and 10 give a share of about 29.8% (96,397.46 of 323,339.73 EUR). This is not in the answer table because the request did not ask for a total.

Periods 9 and 10 fall after the November 2025 platform migration, so channel_code is not filled. The figures use store 900 and fulfilment_type, which work on both sides of the migration. rpt.v_daily_sales would have omitted web sales here and was not used.
A share of web orders (a count) would differ slightly from this share of web net sales.

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount AS sales_net, 0.0 AS refund_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12), rets AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 0.0 AS sales_net, x.refund_net AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = x.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.return_date WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, round(sum(sales_net) - sum(refund_net), 2) AS net_sales FROM u GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Old category set-up: Garden as it stood at the time of sale. The sales and returns tables carry the product version valid on the transaction date (product_key), so Garden here includes the 70 Outdoor Lighting SKUs that were moved to Electrical on 2025-10-27
Net sales = net sales value excluding VAT (net_amount) less refunds excluding VAT (refund_net), the same net-of-returns definition as rpt_daily_store_sales
Returns are booked in the period of the return date, not the period of the original sale
Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 taken from dim_date and checked against ref_fiscal_calendar. These run 2024-10-28 to 2025-04-27, with 4, 4, 5, 4, 4 and 5 weeks. All are marked fully loaded
Channels: stores and the web shop (store_id 900) are both included
Training store 999 and the ZZ Test articles are excluded as non-trading
assumptions: Net sales means after returns (net of refunds), excluding VAT, in EUR. This is how the team's daily store report defines it. Before returns, the six periods would be 62425.14, 59488.98, 67917.63, 61765.26, 115075.23 and 324866.02
'Garden' means the whole old Garden category: Barbecue & Grills, Edible Plants & Seeds, Garden Furniture, Garden Tools, Outdoor Lighting, Plants & Flowers, Pots & Planters and Soil & Fertiliser
All sales channels are in scope (stores and web), since the request names no channel or region
Staff purchases are included. The team's daily report includes them, so I kept them in. Over P7 to P12 they come to about 7503 EUR before returns
'The old way' is read as the category set-up used at the time, which is the version-at-sale-date category, not the current one
Returns of Garden items are counted at the Garden category they carried on the return date. Product keys on returns and sales lines point to the same SKUs, and all were Garden in this window
caveats: The Outdoor Lighting move: from 2025-10-27 those SKUs sit in Electrical, so a current-category query would drop about 94.8k EUR of Garden sales from these six periods (sales before returns, whole window). I did not use that mapping, so the figures keep Outdoor Lighting inside Garden, as reported then
Training store 999 (about 10 Garden lines plus test articles) is excluded. Its Garden lines were worth about 1175 EUR in the window. The test articles (category ZZ Test) are outside Garden anyway
sales.channel_id is NULL for this window because it is only populated from the web migration, so I did not use it. Web lines are identified by store 900 and channel_code WB

rpt_daily_store_sales does not reproduce the fact table for the web shop (store 900). Its daily web figures differ from fact_sales_line by up to several thousand EUR per day, with a Sunday dip. The 40 physical stores match exactly. I built the figures from the fact tables, not that report
Store regions were restated on 2025-04-28 (after P12) and Kouvola moved from East to South. No region breakdown was requested, so this has no effect on the figures
No duplicate sales or return lines, orphan keys, negative amounts or VAT mismatches were found in the window
P12 is the spring peak (5 weeks, about 310k EUR) and P7 to P10 sit around 56k to 63k, so the profile is strongly seasonal

answer.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, p.product_name, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'), r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT w.sku, any_value(w.product_name) AS product_name, sum(w.net_amount) - coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales FROM w LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY w.sku) SELECT sku, product_name, net_sales FROM a ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web channel = channel_id 2 (web home delivery) and 3 (click and collect), the channel_group 'web' in dim_channel
Net sales = line value in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), less refunds (refund_net) on those lines, matching the net-of-returns basis of rpt_daily_store_sales
Product identity = SKU, aggregated across slowly changing product versions (product_key is not used as the grouping key)
Returns linked to the original sales line through fact_return_line.sales_line_id
assumptions: 'Web sales' is read as net sales in EUR excluding VAT, after returns, not units and not gross including VAT
'Since the platform migration on 3 November 2025' is read as sale_date on or after 2025-11-03 up to the latest loaded data (3 October 2026 for web)
'Top 10' ranks products by net sales value
Returns are deducted in full for every returned web line, whenever the return happened (up to 4 October 2026)
Both web fulfilment types (home delivery and click and collect) count as web sales
caveats: Channel field correction: from 3 November 2025 fact_sales_line.channel_code is NULL and only channel_id is filled. Before that date it is the other way round (channel_code ST or WB, channel_id NULL). Filtering on channel_code = 'WB' would return nothing for the period asked, so I filtered on channel_id IN (2, 3). The migration date matches the switch exactly.

Returns correction: ranking on sales before returns gives a different top 10. For example Bedroom Peltola 793 would rank first at 15,533 and Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620 would fall to 16th, because returns on bulky items such as bedroom and garden furniture are high. Bedroom Peltola 793 lost 5,396 EUR (35%) to refunds. Garden Furniture Raudikko 536 lost 1,847 EUR.
Product version correction: dim_product holds several versions per SKU (4,105 rows for 4,000 SKUs), so I grouped by SKU. Each SKU in the top 10 has a single product name.

Latest days are incomplete: web sales lines only appear once an order is delivered or collected. Orders still in 'processing' have no sales lines yet (about 300 orders on 1 to 4 October 2026). 3 October has only 20 web lines against roughly 200 on a normal day, and there are no web lines for 4 October. The last fiscal period (FY2026/27 P06) is flagged as not fully loaded. Recent web sales are therefore understated and may be revised.

Sensitivity: cutting the data off at the end of the last fully loaded period (27 September 2026) leaves the same ten products, with only the 9th and 10th places swapping (Garden Furniture Norvik 499 ahead of Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620).

Cancelled web orders have no sales lines and are excluded naturally. No staff purchases exist on the web channel, and I found no duplicate sales lines, no duplicate return lines, and no orphan product keys.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT. The gross (VAT-inclusive) view would be about 24% higher at the standard VAT rate for these categories, and different for reduced-rate items.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_data AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS store_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_data AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS web_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT store_net_sales FROM store_data) +
        (SELECT web_net_sales FROM web_data) AS total_net_sales,
        (SELECT store_receipts FROM store_data) +
        (SELECT web_orders FROM web_data) AS total_transactions
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(total_net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
    total_transactions AS transactions,
    ROUND(total_net_sales / total_transactions, 2) AS atv
FROM totals;
definitions_applied: ATV (average transaction value): net sales before returns divided by number of transactions
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, excluding store 999 and test articles
Store scope: physical stores (store_id < 900) and web shop (store_id = 900)
Staff purchases: excluded from ATV calculation
Web sales: recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Web orders: identified by fact_web_order join, excluding cancelled orders, counted by distinct web_order_id
Physical store transactions: identified by distinct receipt_id
Return timing: returns reduce net sales on their own return date
assumptions: Request interpreted as P01-P03 FY2026/27 (fiscal periods 1-3 of the current fiscal year, 4 May to 2 August 2026)
Company definition of ATV normally excludes web orders, but the request explicitly asked to include web ('Web orders should be in it too')
Modified ATV includes both physical store receipts and web orders in the transaction denominator
Staff purchases excluded from both store and web ATV (consistent with standard ATV definition)
Web order identification uses fact_web_order join rather than channel_code, as channel_code is unreliable post-November 2025 migration
Cancelled web orders excluded; processing orders excluded from sales-based calculation (only delivered/collected)
ATV formula applied uniformly: (store net sales + web net sales) / (store receipts + web orders)
caveats: This ATV includes web orders, which deviates from Tuomimetsä's standard company definition of ATV as a store-only measure excluding web
Physical stores contribute 82.8% of net sales (EUR 3.72M) and 83.7% of transactions (66,984 receipts); web contributes 17.2% of net sales and 16.3% of transactions
Web average transaction value (59.33 EUR) is 6.5% higher than physical stores (55.52 EUR)
Data is complete as of warehouse load date 4 October 2026; P01-P03 period (through 2 August 2026) is fully loaded

Staff purchases are included in web sales figures per company definition but excluded from ATV, creating a minor asymmetry (staff web orders themselves are in the transaction count but their net amount is not in the numerator)

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, sum(l.amount) AS net_sales FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week, round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, round(p.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, round((t.net_sales / p.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly t JOIN weekly p ON p.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: this year = FY2026/27 period 2 (fiscal weeks 5-8, 1 to 28 June 2026); last year = FY2025/26 period 2 (fiscal weeks 5-8, 26 May to 22 June 2025)
Net sales = net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net, with refunds booked on the return date
Company total = all physical stores plus the web shop (store_id 900), which covers home delivery and click-and-collect
Web lines identified by the web-shop store (store_id 900), because this year's lines carry channel_id and no channel_code
Business date = sale_date, which is the Helsinki local date
Training store (store_id 999) excluded
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, and period 2 means fiscal period 2 (weeks 5-8)
'Same weeks last year' means the same fiscal week numbers in FY2025/26 (weeks 5-8), not the same calendar dates and not the same holiday weeks
Net sales is net of returns, matching how Data & Analytics' rpt_daily_store_sales defines net_sales
Staff purchases are included, as they are in rpt_daily_store_sales. They are about 1% of sales, roughly 2.5k to 4k EUR a week in stores
Amounts are EUR excluding VAT
Growth % = this year / last year - 1, rounded to 1 decimal
caveats: Midsummer (Eve and Day, when stores are shut by law) falls in fiscal week 8 last year (20-21 June 2025) but in fiscal week 7 this year (19-20 June 2026). Matching by week number therefore compares a Midsummer week with a normal week. That gives the -26.5% in week 7 and the +54.4% in week 8, and neither figure is real underlying growth. Midsummer week against Midsummer week (this year's week 7 vs last year's week 8) is +6.8%. The whole of period 2 is 1,295,948.28 vs 1,210,935.82, or +7.0%.

Correction: the pre-built views and tables are not used. rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales identify web sales by channel_code = 'WB', which is null on this year's lines after the web-platform migration (channel_id is used instead). They would therefore drop all of this year's web sales, about 55k to 71k EUR a week, and show a false decline. rpt_daily_store_sales books web orders on the UTC date rather than the Helsinki sale date, so its daily web figures do not match the fact table. The answer is built from fact_sales_line and fact_return_line.
Correction: training store 999 is excluded. It has test sales of about 0.2k to 0.9k EUR a week and no returns, and it is not a trading location.

Store base differs between the two years. Store 129 (Savonlinna) closed on 25 Jan 2026, and store 125 has been in a planned refit since 15 June 2026 (6 weeks, to 26 July 2026), so this year's weeks 7 and 8 lack its sales. Other stores are also missing from the daily store counts on some days. Total-company growth is therefore not like-for-like.
Web share of sales is much higher this year than last year, which contributes to the growth.
Store version history (regions were re-mapped on 28 April 2025) does not affect a company total, so no adjustment was needed.

Checked and found clean for these weeks: no duplicate sales lines (the duplicates in the warehouse are in September 2025 loads, outside the window), no cancelled web orders, no orphan store keys, VAT arithmetic consistent, no non-positive quantities or amounts, and all refunds trace to a sales line.
Fiscal period FY2026/27 P02 is flagged as fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar, as is FY2025/26 P02.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns; returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order (not sale_date, which is the order date)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines); only delivered and collected orders count
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (channel_code is empty after the 3 November 2025 migration)
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, not channel_id or channel_code
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods taken from dim_date: P6 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025 (5 weeks), P7 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025, P8 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26. The request was made on 9 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests made in that fiscal year read 'last year' as FY2025/26. Periods 6 to 8 are therefore FY2025/26 P6 to P8, all fully loaded.

'Sales' read as net sales after returns, which is the company definition. Returns were attributed to click-and-collect or home delivery through the original line's order (sales_line_id to fact_web_order).

Only refunds booked to the web shop (store 900) were counted, following the company rule that returns are booked where they are processed. I did not use the control total in rpt_daily_store_sales, because it has no channel split.
One share per period was returned, with no breakdown and no total.
caveats: No data defects were found for these periods. Web sales lines were unique per receipt_id and line_no. Every web line matched exactly one web order. Cancelled orders had no lines. All delivered and collected orders had a dispatch time.

The 3 November 2025 web-platform migration falls in P7. Neither channel column works across it, so I used store_id 900 and fulfilment_type, which are consistent across the migration. Using channel_code would have lost web sales from 3 November 2025.
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used, because they silently omit web sales from 3 November 2025.

Some refunds on web orders were processed in physical stores, not booked to the web shop. These sit in those stores' sales and are not in the web figures. If refunds were instead followed back to the web order wherever they were processed, the shares would be about 27.51, 25.32 and 27.01 for P6, P7 and P8. Before returns, the shares would be 27.88, 25.99 and 27.13.
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, and these periods ended well over 30 days before the warehouse load date, so the figures are stable.
Net sales in this period (EUR ex VAT, after returns, booked-to-web basis): all web 175,589 in P6, 154,977 in P7 and 225,265 in P8; click-and-collect 48,901 in P6, 39,403 in P7 and 60,899 in P8.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN params WHERE f.sale_date > params.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= params.as_of_end) SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN params JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND params.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with and including the as-of week, in any channel
Distinct member_id count, not member_key (dim_member keeps one row per version)
Trailing window: sale_date > as-of Sunday minus 364 days and <= as-of Sunday (2024-12-23 to 2025-12-21)
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Store 999 and category ZZ Test: left out as house rule (the filter changed no figure)
Cancelled web orders: checked and not counted as purchases (the check changed no figure)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar via fiscal.py
Control-total comparison against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply: this is a member count, not a store sales figure
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 7 Oct 2026 (FY2026/27) means FY2025/26, the same reading accepted for requests in May 2026. 'Period 8' is FY2025/26 P08, 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 (fiscal weeks 31 to 34).
'As of the end of period 8' means the last Sunday of the period, 21 Dec 2025, which is the as-of date.
The 'trailing 52 fiscal weeks' definition is applied as in REQ-D29 and REQ-D30: sales from 23 Dec 2024 to 21 Dec 2025.
Tier is the tier on 21 Dec 2025, not the member's current tier.
Tiers are shown as one row each. No total row, because none was asked for (the total is 29,526).
A web order counts on its order date (sale_date) for the activity test, as in the accepted active-member query.
caveats: Checks run: every member line matches a dim_member version, with no orphan keys. Every active member has exactly one tier version on 21 Dec 2025. No member purchased before their join date. The window has sales on all 364 days. Cancelled web orders and store 999 / ZZ Test lines made no difference to the counts.

The member lines in the window contain 210 repeated receipt_id and line_no pairs. This does not change the counts, because members are counted distinct. It would inflate any sales sum taken from the same lines.
The result uses the member tier at 21 Dec 2025, not today's tier. Counts by current tier would differ for members whose tier has changed since.
If 'last year' was meant as the 12 months before the request, or as FY2026/27, the answer would differ. FY2026/27 P08 has not yet happened.

answer.sql: SELECT cs.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excluding VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop (store 900) excluded
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: period 4 of FY2026/27 is 3 August to 30 August 2026, four whole Monday-to-Sunday weeks
Store format taken from the current dim_store version (as-is)
Control total: net sales before returns per store, all sales lines, compared with rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27. The request is dated 6 October 2026, and in past requests 'P2' asked on 7 July 2026 meant FY2026/27 P2.
'Period 4' read as FY2026/27 P4, 3 to 30 August 2026. It is complete and fully loaded.

'Store format' read as the dim_store.format values Large, Medium and Small. The column comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date, and I checked the distinct values. Web and Training are not physical store formats and have no row.
Format is the same in every version of a store, so as-is and as-was give the same result.
No comparison or other breakdown was asked for, so the table has one row per format.
caveats: Excluding staff purchases, store 999 and ZZ Test articles changes the totals. The unfiltered period held 48,107 lines, including 127 lines in store 999, 57 ZZ Test lines and 6,459 web lines.

Control total: before-returns net sales for all lines in physical stores, excluding store 999 and ZZ Test, matches rpt_daily_store_sales for P4 store by store with no differences. The only store in the report table without a match in my total was 900, the web shop, which I excluded on purpose. The ATV figures themselves exclude staff purchases, so they cannot be reconciled directly to the report table.

Source checks for P4: no duplicate sales_line_id or (receipt_id, line_no) keys; no receipt spans more than one store, date or staff flag; no zero or negative quantities or amounts. 38 groups of identical repeated items within a receipt had different line numbers. I treated them as genuine repeat scans, and they do not change the receipt count.
Savonlinna (129, closed January 2026) has no P4 sales. Kuopio's refit (15 June to 26 July 2026) ended before P4. So 38 stores trade in the period: 8 Large, 18 Medium and 12 Small.
Receipts per format: Large 6,508, Medium 8,641, Small 2,598. Net sales before returns in EUR excluding VAT: Large 394,865.46, Medium 520,763.45, Small 131,841.05.
ATV is before returns by definition, so refunds do not reduce it.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open (after opening, before closure), outside refit closures in ref_store_closure, and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 2 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday 1 June to Sunday 28 June 2026
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P2, the current fiscal year as of the request date (9 October 2026); P2 is complete and fully loaded (warehouse loaded through 4 October 2026).

Ranking is on net sales per trading day, which is the company definition of the league table; ties in the rounded figure (Mikkeli and Espoo Lommila at 947; Kokkola and Raisio at 424) are ranked on the unrounded figure.
Net sales per trading day is rounded to whole euros, following the accepted league-table pattern.
Store attributes (name) are taken from the current dim_store version (as-is).
caveats: Kuopio (125) was in its refit closure from 15 June 2026, so it traded only 14 of the 26 trading days in the period (1 to 14 June). Its 23,993.71 in net sales is for those 14 days, and its rank 7 is on net sales per trading day, not on the period total.

Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays, so every other store has 26 trading days rather than 28. Sales booked on those days are web only, so no store figure is affected.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and is not in the table. Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) are included, since both traded for the whole period.
The store-level net sales add up to 1,063,916.20, which matches the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for the same stores and days exactly (gap 0.00).
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles were filtered out. The rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales views were not used, because they leave out web sales from November 2025.

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, not by version row (dim_member keeps one row per version)
Current tier read from the latest member version (is_current = true, valid_to = 9999-12-31)
dim_member used directly; no deprecated, staging, backup or tmp tables used (stg_member_updates ignored)
assumptions: 'Right now' is read as the current state of the warehouse, which is loaded through Sunday 4 October 2026, so it is the current tier version of each member, not the date the request arrived (8 October 2026).
'Members on the Gold tier' means every loyalty member whose current version is Gold, with no filter on activity (no purchase in the last 52 weeks required) or on marketing consent.
Online sign-ups (home store 900) are included, as the request does not limit it to a store or channel.
caveats: The warehouse is loaded only through 4 October 2026, so tier changes made on 5 to 8 October are not reflected.

Counting version rows instead of distinct members would overstate the figure: Gold has 8,203 version rows in total (5,791 current and 2,412 historical) against 5,791 distinct current Gold members. 2,233 other members were Gold at some earlier point and have since moved to another tier; they are not counted.

Checks on dim_member found no data problem needing correction: exactly one current version per member (60,000 members), no overlapping versions, no duplicate member_key, and the is_current flag agrees with valid_to = 9999-12-31. Using the version valid on 8 October 2026 gives the same 5,791.
This is a count of Gold members, not of active Gold members. It was not checked against recent purchase activity, since the request did not ask for that.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Fiscal period definitions from ref_fiscal_calendar
Net sales (net_amount) excludes VAT
Store-channel exclusion: store_id < 900 (excludes web channel)
Receipts count distinct receipt IDs per store-period
Units sold aggregated from quantity across all lines
assumptions: Period 2 this year interpreted as fiscal period 2 of FY2025/26 (2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22)
League table ranking primary metric is net sales in descending order
Web channel (store_id >= 900) excluded; report covers physical stores only
Staff purchases included in sales (staff_purchase_flag not filtered)
caveats: All 39 active stores have sales data for period 2; no missing stores
Net sales figures are in EUR excluding VAT
Return lines are not deducted from gross sales at the line level in fact_sales_line; actual net sales reflect any refunds booked separately
Data is final as of the warehouse load date

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
definitions_applied: Like-for-like (LFL) net sales growth: same fiscal weeks, this year against last year, week by week
LFL base: physical stores only (store_id below 900), open at least 364 days before the first day of the period
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (refit weeks from ref_store_closure and closed-store weeks drop out)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Week 53 never counts in LFL (not in play for P4)
Fiscal calendar: P4 = fiscal weeks 14 to 17, Monday to Sunday, aligned to the prior year by fiscal week number
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
Current dim_store version used for store attributes
assumptions: 'Period 4 this year' read as FY2026/27 P4 (weeks 14 to 17, 3 to 30 August 2026), the most recent completed P4 on the request date of 5 October 2026
'Last year' read as FY2025/26 P4 (28 July to 24 August 2025), lined up by fiscal week number, not by calendar date
'The stores' read as the LFL store base in total (one figure), with no breakdown by store or region because none was asked for
The answer is given in EUR excluding VAT
caveats: The growth is essentially flat at -0.03% (about EUR 265 lower on roughly EUR 1.01 million), so the stores as a group did neither better nor worse than last year
The LFL base is 38 of the 39 current physical stores, 152 store-weeks. Savonlinna (129) is out because it closed on 25 January 2026 and did not trade in P4 this year
No refit weeks fell in either P4. Kuopio's refit (15 June to 26 July 2026) ended before the period, and Pori's (8 September to 12 October 2025) started after it
Both openings (Tampere Lamminpää 136 and Lohja 137) were open more than 364 days before 3 August 2026 and are in the base
By region as-is (not asked for, for context only): Capital Region +2.79%, North +6.53%, South -0.71%, West -1.65%, East -3.13%

No data problems found in the period: no duplicate sales line ids or receipt lines, no store-weeks with missing trading days, and the sales and returns built from the fact tables match rpt_daily_store_sales store by store for both years
The deprecated views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used. The web shop (900) is outside LFL by definition, so the web channel migration issue does not affect this figure

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: whole fiscal week, Monday to Sunday
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Natural keys store_id and sku used instead of version keys
Control total against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 131 (units_sold matched on all 7 days)
Physical store scope (store_id below 900)
assumptions: 'Last week' asked on 2026-10-08 is read as the last completed fiscal week, FY2026/27 week 22, Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026, which is also the last loaded week.
'Oulu Kaakkuri' is read as the store (store_id 131), not as a product name. SKU 101624 is 'Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251'.
