Shoppers who are not loyalty members are not identifiable in the warehouse, so they cannot be counted. The figure covers members only and understates the true number of customers.

Home store is the member's current home store. A member who enrolled in Tampere but has since moved their home store is not counted, and one who moved to Tampere is counted. A member's home store need not match where they live or shop.
If 'customers' means active members (a purchase in the 52 weeks to Sunday 4 October 2026, store 999 and test articles excluded), the figure is 4,441. Say if that is what is wanted.
Members are not counted by marketing consent, so the figure does not tell you how many of them can be contacted.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: all physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal calendar: period 2 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday to Sunday
Prior-year comparison lined up by fiscal week number, not by calendar date
Growth % = this year / last year - 1
Weekly totals checked against the rpt_daily_store_sales control total: they match exactly for all 8 weeks
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27. Period 2 is 1 to 28 June 2026 (weeks 5 to 8), and last year is FY2025/26 period 2 (26 May to 22 June 2025).
'Total company' includes the web shop, following the accepted total-company reading (REQ-D03). It is not a like-for-like view.
Net sales (excluding VAT, after returns) is the company's standard sales measure, so I used it.
Weeks are compared by fiscal week number (5 to 8 against 5 to 8). Neither year's period 2 contains week 53, so nothing was dropped for it.
caveats: No data corrections were needed for this period. I found no duplicate sales lines in the weeks used. Duplicated receipt lines do exist in the warehouse (418 receipt-and-line keys, all in FY2025/26 period 5, September 2025), but they sit outside this request.

I found no correction to apply, but the weekly growth figures for weeks 7 and 8 are distorted by Midsummer timing. The stores are shut on Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day. Last year these fell on 20 to 21 June (week 8), so week 8 had 5 trading days. This year they fell on 19 to 20 June (week 7), so week 7 had 5 trading days. Week 7 growth of -32.2% and week 8 growth of +76.4% mostly reflect that shift, not trading performance.

Weeks 7 and 8 combined: 591,343.83 this year against 535,679.88 last year, which is +10.4%. The whole of period 2: 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70, which is +8.3%. These two figures are not in the table because only weekly rows were requested.

The company is not the same size in both years. Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026, so it trades in last year's period 2 but not this year's. Kuopio (store 125) was shut for a refit from 15 June to 26 July 2026, which affects weeks 7 and 8 this year. Active store count in the sales data fell from 41 to 40 (weeks 5 and 6) and then 39 (weeks 7 and 8). These are real losses of sales, so they stay in the total, but they depress this year's growth compared with a like-for-like view.

The web shop is much bigger this year. Web lines by order date were about 62k to 71k per week in weeks 5 to 7 this year against about 42k to 49k last year. Web sales are counted here on the dispatch date, so the web share of growth is not shown separately.
The legacy views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used. They leave out web sales from 3 November 2025 onward, and would have understated this year's figures.

answer.sql: SELECT d.calendar_month, SUM(f.gross_amount) as sales_including_vat FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9) AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE GROUP BY d.calendar_month ORDER BY d.calendar_month
definitions_applied: Sales including VAT: gross_amount from fact_sales_line
Before returns: sales lines only, no deductions for returns
Comparable sales basis: staff purchase flag excluded
assumptions: Store sales interpreted as all retail channels (physical stores and web); request did not specify store-only
Before returns means prior to return deductions (fact_sales_line data, not adjusted by fact_return_line)
Calendar months August and September in calendar year 2024
caveats: Sales include both store (ST) and web (WB) channels: August store €1,348,318.90 + web €174,410.47; September store €1,192,571.80 + web €160,395.63
Staff purchases excluded as per standard retail comparability rules

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-05-04' AS d0, DATE '2026-08-02' AS d1),
test_keys AS (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category = 'ZZ Test'),
store_lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM test_keys)
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.d0 AND params.d1
),
web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM test_keys)
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN params.d0 AND params.d1
),
all_lines AS (SELECT * FROM store_lines UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_lines)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM all_lines
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR, excluding VAT) divided by the number of sales receipts
Store 999 (training store) left out
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out
Staff purchases left out of ATV (staff_purchase_flag)
Web shop is store 900, identified by store_id and not by channel_code
Web orders dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (web sales recognition rule)
Cancelled and still-processing web orders have no sales lines, so they are not counted
Store receipts dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Fiscal calendar: P1 to P3 = Q1 = fiscal weeks 1 to 13 of FY2026/27 (4 May 2026 to 2 August 2026)
Fiscal calendar: net sales before returns (returns are not deducted from ATV)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27. P1 to P3 are 4 May to 2 August 2026, 13 weeks, which is complete in the warehouse (loaded through 4 October 2026).

The metric dictionary defines ATV as a store measure with web excluded. You asked for web orders to be included, so I followed your request and added them. Each web order counts as one receipt and its net lines count as sales, the same way a store receipt does.
'Whole company' is stores plus the web shop, with the training store and test articles out.
Staff purchases stay excluded from ATV, as in the company definition. None of the web lines are staff purchases.

Web orders are placed on their Helsinki dispatch date, both for the sales and for the order count. The dictionary counts web orders on the order date. I used dispatch so the numerator and denominator cover the same orders. On order date the web figures are 12,959 orders and 771,025.31 EUR net, against 13,004 orders and 771,530.75 EUR on dispatch, so the company ATV is not materially affected.
Company ATV is reported as one figure for the three periods together, not per period, because you asked for periods 1 to 3 as a whole.
caveats: Correction: the standard ATV definition excludes web orders. Because you asked for them, they are included, so this figure is not comparable with ATV figures reported on the standard store-only basis. Store-only ATV for the same 13 weeks is 55.52 EUR (66,984 receipts); the web shop adds 13,004 orders at about 59.33 EUR each (771,530.75 EUR), which lifts the company figure to 56.14 EUR on 79,988 receipts and 4,490,717.08 EUR net.

Correction: web orders are placed on the Helsinki dispatch date and not on the order date. The channel_code column and the views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used, because they drop web from 3 November 2025.
Correction: store 999, ZZ Test articles and staff purchases were removed (staff purchases per ATV rule). I did not quantify how much each exclusion shifts the result.

Control check: web net sales before returns on the dispatch basis, 771,530.75 EUR, match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly. The store-side control total is higher (3,767,921.27 EUR on 68,021 receipts) because that table includes staff purchases, which ATV excludes. I did not reconcile the staff gap line by line.
No duplicate sales lines were found, and store receipt numbers and web order numbers do not overlap, so distinct receipt counting is safe.
ATV is before returns, so returns processed in the period do not affect it.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date (dim_member.join_date), as in the company definition
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key version rows
Enrolment store taken from the member's first version in dim_member, with online sign-ups under store 900
dim_member used as the canonical member table; no staging or backup tables
assumptions: Read 'signed up' as becoming a loyalty member, counted on the join date, with online sign-ups included. 8 of the 39 are online sign-ups (home store 900) and 31 enrolled in physical stores.
Read '25 September 2026' as the calendar join date, with no time-zone adjustment because join_date is a DATE column.
Counted all new members regardless of marketing consent or tier, since the request did not restrict them.
caveats: Checked the data for problems and found none that needed correcting: there were 39 version rows, 39 distinct member_ids and 39 distinct member_keys for that join date, so no version duplication.
Each of the 39 members' first version starts on 25 September 2026, and no member has more than one join_date.
No joiner had store 999 as the enrolment store. The 25 September total is in line with the neighbouring days (27 to 44 a day).
The warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026, so 25 September is fully covered.

answer.sql: WITH active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21') SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with and including the as-of week, in any channel
Distinct member_id counted, not member_key (one key per member version)
Tier read from the member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Trailing window: sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 8 = fiscal weeks 31 to 34, 24 November 2025 to 21 December 2025
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (checked: they change no counts)
Cancelled web orders excluded (checked: they change no counts)
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 7 October 2026 (FY2026/27) is read as FY2025/26, following how past requests were read (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35, May 2026)
'End of period 8' is the period's last day, Sunday 21 December 2025, so the window runs 23 December 2024 to 21 December 2025
Tier is the tier on 21 December 2025 (as-was), not the member's current tier
Basic, Silver and Gold are the only tier values in dim_member; there is no null tier
caveats: No data problems affected this answer and no corrections were made.
Checks: the 29,526 active members each have exactly one member version valid on 21 December 2025, none have conflicting tiers, and none joined after the as-of date.
Sales cover all 364 days of the window (23 Dec 2024 to 21 Dec 2025), and FY2025/26 P8 is fully loaded.
The 29,526 total is not shown because the request asks for a breakdown by tier only. It is the sum of the three rows.
The query used the library template's pattern, not the library's control-total or query-check scripts, so the answer was not reconciled to rpt_daily_store_sales. That table has no member dimension.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Web net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after line discounts, less returns
Web recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (click-and-collect: ready-for-collection date)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, booked to the web shop
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (channel_code is empty from the 3 November 2025 migration)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded from sales (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Helsinki time conversion of UTC timestamps (timezone('Europe/Helsinki', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
Click-and-collect counted as web
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: Read 'daily web sales (net)' as the company net sales definition: excluding VAT, after returns
Read 15 to 23 December 2025 as inclusive of both end dates, nine days
Dates are Helsinki business dates
Read 'web sales' as including click-and-collect orders, as company policy counts them as web
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or channel_code, since both omit web sales from 3 November 2025
caveats: No data correction was needed: the figures match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 to the cent on all nine days; no duplicate sales lines, no duplicate web orders, no ZZ Test web lines in the range
Sales are dated by dispatch, not by order date, so a day's figure is not the value of orders placed that day

21 December 2025 (a Sunday) is low at 611.75 because only 18 orders were dispatched or made ready that day; 14 December shows the same Sunday pattern. This is a dispatch pattern in the data, not a missing load
Returns are netted on their own return date, so each daily figure includes refunds processed that day for earlier sales (6,843.47 EUR of web refunds across the nine days)
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale, so these figures may change slightly if later returns are booked against the sales; the return date rule keeps the daily figures unchanged
Cancelled orders (about 3 to 11 per day) and orders still processing are not included
Web lines carry a null channel_code in this period, so any report built on channel_code or rpt.v_daily_sales would understate web sales

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period = 1) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 1 GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week, physical stores only
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the period's first day (open_date <= 2026-05-04 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open/close dates and ref_store_closure refit weeks)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns booked on their return date
Web excluded from LFL (store 900 not in the base); store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P1 = weeks 1-4 (4 May to 31 May 2026), compared with FY2025/26 P1 = weeks 1-4 (28 Apr to 25 May 2025), same fiscal weeks, not same calendar dates
Open and close dates taken from the current dim_store version; stores counted by store_id
Control total: store-by-store net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 1 this year' read as FY2026/27 P1, since the request was made on 9 October 2026 and the current fiscal year is FY2026/27; 'last year' is FY2025/26 P1
A single total was returned because no breakdown was requested
Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) are in the LFL base for this period because both were open more than 364 days before 4 May 2026
Growth is the percentage change in LFL net sales, rounded to 2 decimals (6.70%)
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no trading in FY2026/27 P1, so it is out of the LFL base. Its FY2025/26 P1 sales (about 12,014 EUR) are not in the comparison.

No refit closure overlaps P1 in either year (Kuopio's refit starts 15 June 2026, Pori's was in autumn 2025), so no store-weeks were removed for refits. The base is 38 stores x 4 weeks = 152 store-weeks.
Store-level net sales for every store-week in both years matched rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (no differences above 1 EUR), so there was no unexplained gap.

I found 418 duplicated (receipt_id, line_no) rows in fact_sales_line, all in September 2025 and loaded at different times. They are outside the P1 weeks used here and did not affect this answer, but anyone using September 2025 data should de-duplicate them.

Lohja and Tampere were still ramping up last year. Their growth is high (for example, week 1 of Tampere is up about 38%), which lifts the LFL figure a little. Both are in the base under the company's 52-week rule.
Returns for goods sold in P1 can still arrive later, but the net sales definition books them on the return date, so the figure is not affected by late returns of this period's sales.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13) AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name

Interior Paint subcategory from dim_product
Fiscal period 3 = fiscal weeks 9-13 (2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02)
Current fiscal year FY2026/27
assumptions: 'Period 3 this year' interpreted as FY2026/27 P3, the current fiscal year as of request date 2026-10-05
Staff purchases are included in units sold per the company definition of 'units sold'
All 123 Interior Paint product SKUs in the Interior Paint subcategory are included in the query

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines, so orders still processing would be included
Cancelled orders excluded (status <> 'cancelled')
UTC calendar day on order_ts_utc, as the request asked, in place of the company default of the Helsinki order date
Test articles (category ZZ Test) and training store 999 excluded from reporting; checked, and none of the orders that day touch them
assumptions: Black Friday 2025 is 28 November 2025, as the request states
'Placed' means order_ts_utc, the time the order was placed, not the dispatch time

Cancelled orders are not counted as web orders, following the company definition

20 orders placed on 28 November (UTC) were cancelled and are excluded. Including them would give 377.

answer.sql: WITH lfl_store AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND open_date IS NULL), period_lines AS (SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END AS period, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END, st.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') SELECT l.region, round((sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'current' THEN p.amount END) / sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'prior' THEN p.amount END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM period_lines p JOIN lfl_store l USING (store_id) GROUP BY l.region ORDER BY l.region
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excl. VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net, matching rpt_daily_store_sales (reconciled to the euro on 6,622 store-days)
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = fiscal periods 7 to 9 (13 weeks, fiscal weeks 27 to 39)
Comparison base = same fiscal weeks of the prior fiscal year (FY2024/25 Q3, 2024-10-28 to 2025-01-26), so weekday mix and non-trading days are identical (6 closed days in each)
Like-for-like store = physical store (store_id below 900) that traded through both periods and was open before 2024 (open_date null)
Store channel only: web shop (900), click-and-collect and the training store (999) excluded
Region taken from the current dim_store version and applied to both years
Refunds attributed to the store and date where they were booked (as in the daily store sales report)
Staff purchases included, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Read 'last year' as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request is dated 2026-10-05 and FP&A reports on the fiscal calendar. So Q3 = 2025-10-27 to 2026-01-25, against 2024-10-28 to 2025-01-26. Calendar Q3 2025 (July to September) would give different numbers.
Growth is current period net sales divided by prior period net sales, minus 1, summed over like-for-like stores in each region, in percent.

Excluded Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2024-09-02) and Lohja (137, opened 2024-11-04) as non-like-for-like. 137 did not trade for the whole base period. 136 was still ramping up in the base period (+39% year on year) and is absent from the existing tmp_lfl_store_list_2025. Including 136 would lift West well above 2.04%.
Included Savonlinna (129). Its close_date is 2026-01-25, the last day of the quarter, and it traded all 85 days in both periods with no sign of clearance sales.
No refit closure overlaps either Q3 window, so none was excluded. Pori's refit ended 2025-10-12, before the quarter began. Vantaa Tammisto's was in summer 2024 and Kuopio's falls in 2026.
Rate and price effects are not separated out. This is growth in euro net sales, not volume.
caveats: Region structure changed on 2025-04-28. Stores 101 to 105 moved from South to a new 'Capital Region' and Kouvola (114) moved from East to South. Using each year's own region would compare different store groups, so the current mapping was applied to both years. 'Capital Region' is not one of the four regions (North, South, East, West) named in the column comment, so check that Finance wants this split. Under the old mapping South would include the five Capital Region stores, and East would include Kouvola.

Since the web migration (about 2025-10-28 to 11-03), sales lines carry channel_id instead of channel_code. The existing view rpt.v_daily_sales identifies web lines only by channel_code = 'WB', so it misses current-year web lines. I did not use that view and identified stores by store_key joined to dim_store.
Click-and-collect lines (channel_id 3, new this year) and web lines sit on the web shop store key and are excluded from this store like-for-like measure. Online sales are not included.
Training store 999 had sales lines (about 6.9k EUR in the current period and 6.5k in the prior) and was excluded.

Savonlinna closed on the last day of the quarter. If Finance excludes closed stores from like-for-like, East changes slightly. Its sales were 31,895 EUR in the prior period and 31,378 in the current one.
No duplicate sales lines or non-positive amounts were found in either window, and all 85 trading-calendar days had sales for every store. No other data corrections were needed.
North (+6.73%) is driven mainly by the two Oulu stores (+12.2% and +9.2%). South is flat at +0.02%, with Hyvinkää down 10.5% offsetting gains elsewhere. Store-level figures are available on request.
Staff purchases (about 1.2% of store sales) are included in line with the daily store sales report. Excluding them would change growth by less than 0.1 percentage points.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their return date
Web sales dated by Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included in company total
As-was category: product version valid on the transaction date
Fiscal calendar from dim_date (FY2024/25, periods 7 to 12, 28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'FY24/25' read as FY2024/25, which is fully loaded; P7 to P12 are 28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025 (FY2024/25 has 52 weeks, so there is no week 53)
'The old way, as reported at the time (the old category set-up)' read as as-was: Garden is the category on the product version valid on the transaction date, not the current category
Garden net sales are company-wide, web included, since the request names no store, region or channel
Returns are taken from the return line's own product version and dated on the return date, per the company definition
caveats: As-was Garden for FY2024/25 includes the Outdoor Lighting subcategory, which sat in Garden until 26 Oct 2025 and moved to Electrical from 27 Oct 2025 (FY2025/26 P7). Current (as-is) reporting would put it in Electrical for all of FY2024/25, so these figures will not match as-is Garden reports.
Outdoor Lighting inside the figures above (EUR, net): P7 20801.86, P8 20333.08, P9 17017.21, P10 9681.00, P11 8659.00, P12 10616.84. Subtract these for Garden on the current category set-up.
Cancelled and processing web orders have no revenue date and are excluded from web sales.
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles were excluded; the exclusion does not change the Garden figures, since test articles are a separate category.

Checks run: no duplicate sales or return line keys in the range; all-category net sales by period agree to the cent with rpt_daily_store_sales (zero gap in all six periods). The control table has no category dimension, so the Garden split itself cannot be tied to it directly.
The seasonal spring build-up makes P12 (about 308k) several times larger than P7 to P10.

answer.sql:
WITH sales_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.format
),
returns_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.format
)
SELECT 
  sales.format AS store_format,
  ROUND(COALESCE(returns.refund_net, 0) / sales.net_sales * 100, 2) AS return_share_pct
FROM sales_by_format sales
LEFT JOIN returns_by_format returns ON sales.format = returns.format
ORDER BY sales.format
definitions_applied: Physical store sales only (store_id < 900; excludes web/online)
Return share = refund net amount / sales net amount as percentage
Returns matched to original sales lines sold in the period
Period identified as FY2025/26 P02 (2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22)
Net amounts exclude VAT
assumptions: Last year interpreted as previous complete fiscal year (FY2025/26)
Returns are refunds issued for items sold in the period, regardless of when returned
Return share expressed as percentage of net sales value
caveats: Period fully loaded in warehouse (confirmed)
No planned store closures during the period
Store format values in data are Large, Medium, Small (not schema-documented Hyper, Standard, Express)

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

Web identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code or channel_id (channel columns break at the 3 November 2025 migration)

Cancelled and processing orders excluded because they have no dispatch and no sales lines
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods taken from dim_date.fiscal_year and fiscal_period, not calendar months
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 over the same days
Deprecated objects not used (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, stg_, bak_, tmp_ and old tables)
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as FY2025/26. The request was received on 9 October 2026, in FY2026/27. This follows the precedent of REQ-D04, D08, D28 and D35, which read 'last year' as FY2025/26 during FY2026/27.
'Periods 5 to 8' means FY2025/26 P05 to P08: 25 Aug 2025 to 21 Dec 2025, with P06 running 5 weeks (22 Sep to 26 Oct) and the others 4 weeks. All four are fully loaded.

'Web' means the web shop as store 900. Returns booked to store 900 reduce web net sales on the return date, per the company convention (as in REQ-D17, D19 and D21).

Web net sales as defined here only deduct returns booked to the web shop (store 900). Web-order lines also come back through physical stores. The in-store refunds for web-order lines, by return date, are EUR 5,495.34 (111 lines) in P05, 4,783.52 (121) in P06, 4,901.43 (125) in P07 and 4,545.10 (144) in P08. Control total: web net sales for each period match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 to the cent (net sales, and the before-returns and returns components). That table is built on the same dating convention, so it confirms the totals but cannot independently confirm the convention.

No duplicate rows were found in fact_sales_line (web lines), fact_web_order or fact_return_line. Every web line has a delivered or collected order. The web-line channel_code stays populated through this window, but it was not used.
Period 7 starts on 27 October 2025, just before the 3 November 2025 web migration. Using store 900 instead of channel_code or channel_id avoids the channel-column break across that date.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), quarterly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM quarterly ty JOIN quarterly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ty.region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT after returns, with returns reducing sales on their own return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only), not the order date
Web shop identified by store_id 900 (region Online), not by channel_code or channel_id, because the web platform migrated on 3 November 2025 inside this quarter
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Regions as-is (current dim_store version), so the Capital Region covers stores 101-105 in both years and Kouvola (114) sits in South in both years

Q3 FY2025/26 is 27 October 2025 to 25 January 2026 and Q3 FY2024/25 is 28 October 2024 to 26 January 2025; both are 13 weeks, and both quarters are complete in the warehouse
Regions as-is, which is the management reporting default, since the request did not ask for as-was
Net sales after returns, which is the company definition of net sales, excluding VAT

WITH p(per, d0, d1) AS (VALUES ('PY', DATE '2024-10-28', DATE '2025-01-26'), ('CY', DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25')),

  SELECT c.* FROM cur c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE s.open_date IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z JOIN p ON z.closure_start_date <= p.d1 AND z.closure_end_date >= p.d0 WHERE z.store_id = c.store_id)),
net AS (
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE st.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE st.store_id < 900)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, l.region,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN per = 'CY' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN per = 'PY' THEN amt END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM net JOIN lfl l USING (store_id) GROUP BY l.region ORDER BY l.region
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: Q3 FY2025/26 is P07 to P09, Monday 2025-10-27 to Sunday 2026-01-25 (13 weeks, 85 trading days). Comparison is Q3 FY2024/25, 2024-10-28 to 2025-01-26 (13 weeks, 85 trading days). Same fiscal quarter, week for week.

Net sales: net_amount (excluding VAT, after line discounts) less refund_net. Returns are booked on the return date at the store that took them back, as in rpt_daily_store_sales. My store totals match that report to the cent.
Store channel only: stores with store_id below 900. Web home delivery, click-and-collect and the web shop pseudo-location are excluded. Training store 999 is excluded.

Channel identified by the store the line is booked to, not by channel_code. From about 4 November 2025 channel_code is NULL on sales lines because of the web-platform migration, and channel_id is NULL on older lines. Filtering on either column alone would drop or misclassify rows.

Like-for-like store: open before 2024 (open_date is null), so a full year's trading history before FY2025/26. Must also have no planned refit closure overlapping either quarter, and must trade on every trading day of both quarters. 37 stores in the base.

Regions restated to the current structure for both years, using each store's current dim_store version. The 28 April 2025 realignment created Capital Region (Helsinki Vuosaari and Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto, Kerava, all previously South) and moved Kouvola from East to South.
Growth = (Q3 FY2025/26 net sales / Q3 FY2024/25 net sales - 1) x 100, summed over the like-for-like stores in each region.
assumptions: "Q3 last year" means fiscal Q3 of the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (the request is dated 5 Oct 2026, so the current year is FY2026/27). Comparator is fiscal Q3 of FY2024/25. FY2025/26 is a 53-week year, but the extra week is in P12 and does not touch Q3.
Growth is on net sales after returns, excluding VAT. Gross (before-returns) sales were not used.
Staff purchases are kept in, because the Data & Analytics daily store report (rpt_daily_store_sales) includes them. Excluding them moves the regional figures by less than 0.4 percentage points.
Regions follow today's structure for both years, so that each region covers the same stores in both quarters. The as-booked 2024/25 regions would not be comparable.
Savonlinna (129, East) is kept in. Its close_date is 2026-01-25, the last day of the quarter, but it traded on all 85 trading days in both quarters. Excluding it moves East from 1.62 to 1.80.
Vantaa Tammisto (104) and Pori (119) are kept in. Their refits ended 2024-08-11 and 2025-10-12, outside both quarters. Excluding them would move Capital Region to 2.15 and West by about 0.5 points.
The variance in the two quarters' non-trading days (Independence Day fell on a Friday in 2024 and a Saturday in 2025) was not adjusted for. Both quarters have six non-trading days.
caveats: CORRECTION: channel_code is NULL on all sales lines from 4 Nov 2025 (web-platform migration), with channel_id filled instead. A filter on channel_code = 'ST' would have dropped most of the current-year store sales and understated growth. I identified store sales through the store the line is booked to, which works in both periods.

CORRECTION: Regions were restated. On 28 April 2025 four South stores plus Kerava moved to the new Capital Region and Kouvola moved from East to South. Joining each sale to its as-booked store version would compare different store sets in the two years. Both quarters use today's regions.

CORRECTION: New stores excluded. Tampere Lamminpää (136, West, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, South, opened 4 Nov 2024, mid-way through the comparison quarter with only 77 trading days) are not like-for-like. Store 136 was still ramping up in the base quarter: monthly sales roughly doubled between Sep 2024 and Dec 2025 against flat sales at similar-sized stores. Including it lifts West from 2.04 to 4.77. The temporary tables tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and 2025 also leave both stores out. Whether 136 should count is a policy call for Finance; the written like-for-like definition was not in the warehouse.
Excluded from the store sales: web orders (including click-and-collect) and the training store 999, which has small test sales of about EUR 1k per quarter booked as store sales.

Backup, staging, tmp and old dimension tables were not used. The warehouse tables and the views under rpt were used. The two rpt views (rpt.v_daily_sales and v_weekly_store_sales) were not used because they don't reflect returns.

Regional figures are small-sample: Capital Region 5 stores, East 8, North 6, South 9, West 9 (after dropping 136). Capital Region (+0.36%) and South (+0.02%) are essentially flat. Their moves are within what one store can do: Vantaa Tammisto (-4.6%) and Hyvinkää (-10%) are the main drags.

Sensitivities, in percentage points of growth: excluding staff purchases Capital +0.26, East +1.57, North +6.89, South -0.31, West +2.29 (approximate for West; the rest are from the full-base run). Including store 136 West +4.77. Excluding Savonlinna East +1.80.
Growth is nominal: no adjustment for price inflation, VAT-rate changes, or the April standard-cost revaluation (the latter affects cost, not sales).

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units_sold FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Last period = last completed fiscal period: FY2026/27 P5 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026)
Products grouped by stable sku, named from the current dim_product version (as-is)
Web shop (store 900) included as part of the company total
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, channel_code, stg_/bak_/tmp_ tables) not used
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last period' read as FY2026/27 P5, the last complete fiscal period as of the request date (8 Oct 2026). P6 has only one week loaded.
'Best-selling' read as ranked by net sales in EUR excluding VAT (the company's sales measure), not by units. Units sold (net of returns) are shown alongside.
Web orders are included, since the request does not limit it to stores. The company total includes the web shop.
Product identity is the sku. Each product carries its current name and category (as-is), though none of the top 10 changed name.
Units are net of returned units (quantity sold minus quantity returned in the period).
caveats: Rankings are by net sales value. A ranking by units would look quite different. For example, Fixings & Fasteners Nordhem 594 (sku 101763) sold 474 units for 4,262 EUR net, which puts it 11th by value, just outside the top 10. Say if you want units as the measure.

Control check: net sales over P5 for stores (store_id below 900) is 932,309.19 EUR, which matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. The web shop (store 900) is 177,237.33 EUR and also matches. No unexplained gaps.
Excluding store 999 and ZZ Test articles is standard. I did not measure how much it changes the total or the ranking. None of the top 10 products are test articles.
Returns are deducted on the date they were processed, not the sale date, so the figures include refunds for goods sold before P5 and exclude refunds that will arrive later for P5 sales.
Outdoor Lighting Kultala 862 (sku 100927) moved from Garden to Electrical in October 2025. Under the as-is convention it counts as Electrical, which does not affect this product-level ranking.
No duplicate sales lines (receipt_id + line_no) were found in the period, and no sku has more than one current product version.

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2), sold AS (SELECT st.format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date WHERE st.store_id < 900), ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format, round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 2 of FY2025/26 is 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22 (ref_fiscal_calendar)
Net sales in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount for sales, refund_net for returns)
Store format taken from the store version in force at the sale date (fact_sales_line.store_key to dim_store)
Return rate = refund_net on returns of lines sold in the period divided by net_amount sold in the period
Returns linked to the original sale through fact_return_line.sales_line_id
Stores only: store_id below 900, so the web shop (900, format Web) and the training store (999) are excluded
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26. The current fiscal year is FY2026/27 (started 2026-05-04, request dated 2026-10-06). 'Period 2' is fiscal period 2, not calendar month 2.
'What was sold came back' is read as a cohort: refunds on lines sold in period 2, whenever the return was booked. This differs from the 'returns booked on the day' basis of rpt_daily_store_sales.
The share is measured in value (EUR excluding VAT), not units. On units the rates are lower: Large 2.37%, Medium 2.44%, Small 2.39%.
Staff purchases are kept in, as they are in the Data & Analytics daily store sales report. Taking them out moves each rate by 0.02 to 0.03 points (Large 4.45, Medium 4.56, Small 4.30).
'Store format' means the three store formats only. The web shop is not a store format and is not shown.
caveats: Format labels in the data are Large, Medium and Small. The dim_store column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express, which is out of date.
The training store (999) is excluded. It had 126 lines and EUR 2,222 net in the period, almost all of it staff purchases. It is not part of the daily store sales report either.

Returns on period 2 sales are complete: the longest gap between sale and return in the data is 30 days, and the data runs to 2026-10-04. Of the EUR 49,057 refunded on these sales, EUR 7,105 was booked after 2025-06-22. A 'returns booked in the period' basis would leave that out and add refunds on earlier sales.
Duplicate sales lines exist (418 receipt and line pairs, loaded twice, all in September 2025). None fall in period 2, so no correction was needed. They would inflate sales for September 2025.
The store sales figures I compared match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, store by store, for the period. No store changed format between versions; the 2025-04-28 store versions changed region only.
No returned quantity or refund amount exceeds what was sold, and there are no orphan returns.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), period_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.category, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM period_sales ty JOIN period_sales ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date; only delivered and collected orders count
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included in the company total
As-is product hierarchy: current category per sku (is_current)
Fiscal calendar: period 8 of each fiscal year, lined up by period number (weeks 31-34 in both years)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' on 5 October 2026 (FY2026/27) means FY2025/26, and 'the year before' means FY2024/25, matching how past requests asked in FY2026/27 were read. The comparison is FY2025/26 P8 (24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025) against FY2024/25 P8 (25 Nov to 22 Dec 2024).
Both periods are four weeks (fiscal weeks 31-34) and fully loaded, so the weeks line up and week 53 is not involved.
Categories are reported as-is, on the current product hierarchy, because the request did not ask for as-was.
Growth is FY2025/26 against FY2024/25, in percent.
Net sales cover all channels (stores and web) because the request gave no channel scope.
caveats: The outdoor lighting subcategory moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 October 2025, which is before FY2025/26 P8. On the current hierarchy (as-is), outdoor lighting is in Electrical in both years. This is why the Garden figure for FY2024/25 is 36,765.02 and not the 56,269.57 that the old Garden definition would give. If you want the figures as they were reported at the time (as-was), Electrical would be 142,914.41 in FY2024/25 against 171,210.97 (+19.8%), and Garden would be 56,269.57 against 36,813.07 (-34.6%). Those as-was changes come from the reclassification, not from trading.

I excluded store 999 (training store) and ZZ Test articles from the figures, as the company definition requires. In P8 they total about 2.2k EUR (FY2024/25) and 2.5k EUR (FY2025/26) of net sales across all categories. They fall in ZZ Test or store 999, so they would not have been in the Garden or Electrical figures anyway.

Web lines on cancelled or still-processing orders are left out because they have no dispatch date. The standard net_lines template does not drop them explicitly. I filtered them out so web revenue is only counted on dispatch.

My total net sales across all categories for P8 match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in both years (1,373,188.97 and 1,435,696.60, gap 0.00, web included). The control table has no category dimension, so the Garden and Electrical split itself is not independently checked.

The warehouse has 418 duplicated receipt lines (same receipt_id and line_no, loaded again on 23 September 2025). They are all for sales on 15-21 September 2025, so none touch either P8 window and no correction was needed here. They would overstate any query that covers that week.

Growth in Garden is flat (+0.1%) and Electrical is +5.4%. Both are small-sample category figures (about 2,000 and 8,500 lines in the FY2025/26 period), and each is a single four-week period, so the figures are sensitive to period timing.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('FY2024/25',DATE '2024-11-25',DATE '2024-12-22'),('FY2025/26',DATE '2025-11-24',DATE '2025-12-21')) t(fy,s,e)), cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS cur_category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current), sales AS (SELECT per.fy, c.cur_category AS category, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku WHERE st.store_id<>999 AND c.cur_category IN ('Garden','Electrical')), rets AS (SELECT per.fy, c.cur_category AS category, -r.refund_net AS amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku=p.sku WHERE st.store_id<>999 AND c.cur_category IN ('Garden','Electrical')), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) SELECT category, 8 AS fiscal_period, round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' THEN amt END),2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, round(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' THEN amt END),2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2025/26' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN fy='FY2024/25' THEN amt END)-1),2) AS growth_pct FROM u GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) less refund_net on returns
Returns are deducted in the period of the return date, not the original sale date
Fiscal period 8 taken from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2024/25 P08 is 2024-11-25 to 2024-12-22 and FY2025/26 P08 is 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-21, both 4 weeks
Stores and the web shop (store 900) both count, so web home delivery and click-and-collect are included
Staff purchases are included, matching how rpt_daily_store_sales is built
Training store (store_id 999) is excluded, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Test articles (category ZZ Test) are excluded
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26. On the request date (5 Oct 2026) FY2026/27 is still in progress and has not reached period 8. 'The year before' is FY2024/25.
'Period' means a fiscal period (1 to 12) from the company fiscal calendar, not a calendar month.
Net sales covers all channels and all stores, with no like-for-like store filter, because none was requested.
Net sales is after returns, as in the Data & Analytics daily store sales report.
Each article is classified by the category on its current dim_product version, for both years. Garden and Electrical are therefore the same product sets in both years (see caveats).
caveats: CORRECTION: Outdoor Lighting (68 current SKUs) moved from Garden to Electrical in dim_product on 2025-10-27. Joining sales through the stored product_key puts it in Garden for FY2024/25 P08 and in Electrical for FY2025/26 P08. That would make Garden look about 35% down and Electrical about 20% up, both wrong. I restated FY2024/25 to the current classification, so Outdoor Lighting sits in Electrical in both years. Roughly EUR 19.3k of FY2024/25 P08 net sales moved from Garden to Electrical. On the restated basis Electrical is +5.41% and Garden is -1.23%.
If you want the old classification (Outdoor Lighting in Garden) for both years, the figures will differ. Electrical would be lower and Garden higher by the Outdoor Lighting amount in each year.

channel_code is NULL on all sales lines from 2025-11-03 onwards (the web-platform migration moved to channel_id), so I did not filter or split by channel_code. Stores and the web shop are separated by store_id instead (900 is the web shop).
Training store (999) sales and ZZ Test articles are in fact_sales_line and were removed. They are small, a few hundred EUR per period.

rpt_daily_store_sales matches the fact tables exactly for physical stores, but its store 900 (web) figures do not match fact_sales_line day by day. They are shifted between days, with swings of up to about EUR 12k a day. I used the fact tables, so the figures here will not match that report's web rows.

Fiscal periods 8 are 4 weeks in both years, so no week adjustment was needed. No store-closure or refit adjustment was made, so planned closures in ref_store_closure may affect the comparison between years.

The prior-year figure (FY2024/25) is built from the same product hierarchy. No sales lines were missing, duplicated or cancelled in these periods: web orders in them are all delivered or collected, and sales_line_id and (receipt_id, line_no) are unique.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, matched by fiscal week number
LFL base: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
52-week opening rule: open_date on or before the period's first day minus 364 days (3 Aug 2026 minus 364 days = 4 Aug 2025)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure in ref_store_closure)
Week 53 never LFL (not relevant here, as P4 is weeks 14-17)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns; returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: P4 = fiscal weeks 14 to 17, Monday to Sunday
Week-aligned prior-year comparator, not calendar-date aligned
Stores taken as-is from the current dim_store version
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: "Period 4 this year" read as FY2026/27 P4, the current fiscal year. Request received 7 Oct 2026. P4 is fiscal weeks 14-17, 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, and is complete.
Prior year is FY2025/26 weeks 14-17, 28 Jul to 24 Aug 2025.
One total LFL figure given, since no breakdown was requested. Growth is shown as a percentage, rounded to 2 decimals (-0.0262% unrounded).
The LFL base is 38 stores (152 store-weeks, 4 per store).
caveats: LFL growth is essentially flat at -0.03%. This year's LFL net sales are EUR 1,010,478.52 against EUR 1,010,743.32 last year. A difference of EUR 264.80 is well inside normal noise.
Savonlinna (129) is excluded because it closed on 25 Jan 2026 and did not trade in P4 this year. Its P4 FY2025/26 net sales of EUR 9,549.14 are left out of the comparator.

Kuopio (125) was in the base for all four weeks. Its refit (15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026) ended before P4. Pori and Tammisto refits also fall outside these weeks in both years, so no refit weeks were dropped.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) both meet the 52-week rule for P4 and are in the base.

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year,
           n.store_id,
           cs.region,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d  ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, cs.region
),
regional_sales AS (
    SELECT fiscal_year,
           CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Online' ELSE region END AS region,
           SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM q3_sales
    GROUP BY fiscal_year, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Online' ELSE region END
)
SELECT region,
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) AS last_year_q3,
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) AS prior_year_q3,
       ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) / 
                      MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM regional_sales
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY CASE WHEN region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, region

Returns reduce net sales on their return date, not the original sale date

assumptions: Q3 last year interpreted as Q3 FY2025/26 (fiscal weeks 27-39, 27 Oct 2025 – 25 Jan 2026)

Growth percentage = (current_year / prior_year − 1) × 100, rounded to one decimal place
caveats: None. Totals validated against rpt_daily_store_sales for both periods: FY2025/26 Q3 = 3,845,652.46; FY2024/25 Q3 = 3,610,885.71

Outside the scope of this request: store 116 has 418 duplicated receipt_id and line_no pairs in the week of 15 to 21 Sep 2025 (P05). This does not affect web figures, but any store-level P05 figure for store 116 should be checked.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 (3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, fiscal weeks 14 to 17)
Returns dated by return_date (when the item was handed back and booked), not by the date of the original sale
Units counted as the sum of quantity_returned on fact_return_line
As-is product hierarchy: current product version (is_current) decides the subcategory
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Web returns (booked to the web shop, store 900) included
Helsinki business date: return_date matches the Helsinki date of return_ts_utc on every line in scope
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'period 4' means fiscal period 4 of that year, which is complete and fully loaded.
'Garden Furniture' is the subcategory of that name (category Garden), not the Furniture category and not Bathroom Furniture.
'Handed back and booked as returned' means counting by return date and units returned. It does not mean the sale-week cohort used for return rate.

Returns made in stores and web returns booked to the web shop are both counted, because the request does not restrict the channel. Of the 92 units, 58 were booked in physical stores and 34 on the web shop.
Staff purchases are not excluded: one returned line relates to a staff purchase. Company definitions include staff purchases outside ATV.
caveats: Corrections made: store 999 and ZZ Test were filtered out. They did not change the total, because no Garden Furniture returns in the period fell under either.
Control check: all returns in the period (excluding store 999 and ZZ Test) total EUR 74,361.18 net refund in fact_return_line, which equals returns_net in rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days.
Integrity checks on the 92 return lines found no orphan lines, no returns dated before the sale, no returned quantity above the quantity sold, no SKU mismatches and no duplicate lines.
The two Garden Furniture articles with more than one product version (SKUs 100527 and 100583) are both still Garden Furniture in every version, so the as-is and as-was results are the same here.
Later returns of goods sold in P4 are not counted, because the question is about returns booked in P4.
The figure counts units, not value. Refund value (net of VAT) for these lines is EUR 13,180.28 (EUR 8,010.14 in stores and EUR 5,170.14 on the web).

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned FROM fact_return_line frl JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
definitions_applied: Returns counted by return date (the date the item was handed back and booked as returned), not the original sale date
Garden Furniture identified as a subcategory within the Garden product category
assumptions: Interpreted 'period 4 this year' as fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30), the current fiscal year as of the request date 2026-10-05
Interpreted 'Garden Furniture' as the subcategory 'Garden Furniture' under the Garden category, not a separate 'Furniture' category
caveats: The warehouse contains two separate product categories: 'Garden' and 'Furniture'. The request referred to 'Garden Furniture', which exists as a subcategory only within Garden; no 'Garden Furniture' category itself exists at the category level

answer.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS web_orders_placed FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
definitions_applied: Web order = one row in fact_web_order (web_order_id is unique)
Placed date taken from order_ts_utc, not dispatch time or the Finnish-local sale_date on the sales lines
Day boundaries are the UTC calendar day, 2025-11-28 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 UTC, as the carrier report requires
Both fulfilment types counted: home delivery and click and collect (dim_channel ids 2 and 3)
Logged-in and guest orders both counted
assumptions: 'Placed' includes orders later cancelled, since they were placed on the day; 20 of the 377 are cancelled
Guest orders are included, since the request does not limit the count to members
Click-and-collect orders count as web orders
No test or staff orders were excluded because none could be identified from the order table
caveats: Of the 377 orders, 357 are not cancelled and 20 are cancelled. Excluding cancellations would give 357.
Counting by Finnish local day (sale_date on the sales lines) gives a different number of web receipts for 28 November, because lines are dated in local time. This is why the UTC timestamp was used.
The 20 cancelled orders have no sales lines in fact_sales_line, so a count from the sales lines gives 357 UTC-day receipts, not 377. Count from fact_web_order to include cancelled orders.
In this period channel_code is NULL on web sales lines. The rpt.v_daily_sales view filters web lines on channel_code = 'WB', so it would not find them. I did not use that view.

Checks found no duplicate web_order_ids and no gaps in the order ID sequence for the day (90055240 to 90055616, 377 consecutive IDs). Order and line counts reconcile for every non-cancelled receipt, and there are no orders in the staging table for that day.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, by distinct member_id
Member versions: dim_member keeps one row per version, so I counted distinct member_id and used each member's first version
Store 999 and test articles are not relevant to this member count, and no member has the training store as home store
assumptions: 'Signed up on 25 September 2026' means a join_date of 2026-09-25 in dim_member, with no time-zone conversion because join_date is a plain date
All channels counted: 31 stores plus 8 online sign-ups (home store 900)
Members are counted once, whatever their later tier, consent or home-store changes
caveats: The warehouse covers sales and joins up to 4 October 2026, so 25 September 2026 is fully loaded
dim_member has 39 version rows with that join date, all first versions of 39 distinct members. There were no duplicates, and no member's join_date differs between versions
The 39 includes 8 online sign-ups (home store 900)
No data problems were found that changed the answer, so no corrections were made

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Pitäjänmäki store identified as store_id 102
Period 5 of FY26/27 defined as 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27 per ref_fiscal_calendar
Units sold measured from fact_sales_line.quantity (original sales, not net of returns)
Joined across dim_store, dim_product to identify products and filter by location
assumptions: Store name resolved to Helsinki Pitäjänmäki (store_id 102) via fuzzy match on store_name
Question asks for units at point of sale, not net of subsequent returns
Interpreted 'period 5 of FY26/27' as the fiscal period, using calendar dates from ref_fiscal_calendar
caveats: One unit of SKU 102244 (Batteries & Bulbs Havu Pro 791) was returned during the period; 42 units shown are gross sales
Two units of SKU 102244 were staff purchases, included in the total of 42
Query results based on warehouse data as of 2026-10-15; figures reflect all channel_codes (store and web) sold at that store location

answer.sql: WITH targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, m.member_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id < 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)) SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, (SELECT SUM(l.net_amount) FROM lines l JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = l.member_id WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') AS net_sales_before_returns_eur
definitions_applied: Targeted (contacted) member: at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, on lines linked to the member, before returns (campaign spend convention)
