answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Last period = last completed fiscal period: FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026 (28 days)
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns deducted on their own return date, not the sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date; only delivered and collected web orders count
Store 999 (training store) excluded
Category ZZ Test (test articles) excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included as part of total company sales
As-is product hierarchy: current product version per SKU, grouped by sku
Control total: the same net sales basis for P05 sums to 1,109,546.52, equal to rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales and the stg_/bak_/tmp_/old tables not used
assumptions: 'Best-selling' read as highest net sales value (EUR excluding VAT). The warehouse has no definition of 'best-selling'; net sales is the company's sales metric.
'Last period' read as FY2026/27 P05, the last completed fiscal period as of the request date 8 Oct 2026. P06 has only its first week loaded.
Products ranked by SKU, whatever versions or categories the SKU held over time (current product name used)
Company-wide ranking across all physical stores and the web shop, since no store, region or channel was specified
Net sales are after returns booked in the period, including returns of goods sold before the period
caveats: If 'best-selling' means units sold, the top 10 is a completely different list. It is led by cheap items: Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251 (757 net units), Fixings & Fasteners Nordhem 594 (474), Batteries & Bulbs Havu Pro 791 (465). Only Fixings & Fasteners Nordhem 594 appears in both top-10 lists, in this ranking at 11th place by value. Cushions & Throws Tuulikki 338 is 15th by value and 8th by units.
Net sales are after returns booked in P05, so a product with many returns ranks lower than on gross sales before returns.

Corrections applied: store 999 and ZZ Test articles removed; web lines taken on the Helsinki dispatch date and cancelled or still-processing web orders left out; rpt.v_daily_sales (which drops web sales from 3 Nov 2025) not used. None of these changes the P05 total against the control (checked: identical to the cent).
Checked: no duplicate sales lines in the period, and no SKU has more than one current version or shares a name with another SKU.
Outdoor Lighting Kultala 862 sits in Electrical as-is; it was in Garden before 27 Oct 2025. This does not affect the P05 ranking since the ranking is by SKU.
The figures are net of VAT and EUR; the period is 4 weeks (28 days), and the ranking is not adjusted for products listed or stocked in only some stores.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin = net sales (excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns; returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned
Returns dated on their own return date, not the original sale date
Web lines (if any) recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, delivered/collected orders only
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Region and product attributes taken as-is (current store and product versions)
Fiscal calendar: Q4 = periods 10 to 12, weeks 40 to 52 of FY2024/25, 27 January to 27 April 2025 (91 days)
Products identified by the stable sku, named from the current product version
Control total: net sales of the same query, by store, agrees exactly (gap 0.00) with rpt_daily_store_sales for all regions over the same dates
assumptions: 'Q4 of FY24/25' read as fiscal year FY2024/25, fiscal quarter 4 (P10 to P12), 27 January to 27 April 2025

'South region' read as-is, the company default: the current South region of 10 physical stores, applied to the whole quarter. This includes Kouvola (moved from East to South) and excludes the five stores (Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto, Kerava) that were South before 28 April 2025 and are now in the Capital Region
'Gross margin' read as the euro amount (not the percentage), ranked in descending order
'Product' read as the article (sku), not brand or subcategory
The web shop (store 900, region Online) is in no physical region, so web sales do not count toward South
caveats: As-was alternative not shown: if the requester wants the South as it stood during Q4 FY24/25 (including Vuosaari, Pitäjänmäki, Lommila, Tammisto and Kerava, excluding Kouvola), the ranking would differ. Ask if that reading is wanted.

Figures are in EUR excluding VAT, after returns, at standard cost. Returns processed in the quarter reduce margin even where the original sale was earlier, and returns of Q4 sales that arrive after 27 April 2025 are not netted.
Standard cost is revalued each April, and this quarter sits just before the April 2025 revaluation, so it uses the pre-revaluation costs.

Checks done: no duplicate sales lines, receipt lines or return lines in the period; each sku has exactly one current product version; sales-line standard cost matches quantity times unit cost on every line; the 10th product (978.84) is clearly ahead of the 11th (935.46), so there is no tie at the cut-off.
Test store 999 and ZZ Test articles were filtered out. Products sold in South stores do not include any web sales.

answer.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, sum(x.amount) AS net_sales FROM daily x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.business_date GROUP BY ALL), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2) SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.fiscal_week, w.fiscal_week_start_date AS week_start_date, round(c.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ly.fiscal_year AS prior_year_fiscal_year, ly.fiscal_week AS prior_year_fiscal_week, ly.fiscal_week_start_date AS prior_year_week_start_date, round(ly.net_sales, 2) AS prior_year_net_sales, round(100.0 * (c.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct FROM weeks w JOIN weekly c ON c.fiscal_year = w.fiscal_year AND c.fiscal_week = w.fiscal_week JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week_start_date = w.fiscal_week_start_date - INTERVAL 364 DAY ORDER BY w.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales = net_amount of sales lines (EUR excl. VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net of returns, as in the rpt_daily_store_sales definition
Returns are deducted on the return date (refunds booked on the day)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2026/27 period 2 = fiscal weeks 5-8 (1 Jun - 28 Jun 2026)
Total company = all physical stores plus the web shop (store 900, home delivery and click-and-collect)
Training store 999 excluded
Staff purchases included (as in the existing daily store sales report)
Sale date is the Helsinki local date (sale_date)
assumptions: Period 2 'this year' means FY2026/27 P02 (request dated 2026-10-07; fiscal year starts May 2026)

'Same weeks last year' is read as the 364-day (52-week) shift, not the same fiscal week number. FY2025/26 was a 53-week year (week 53 at the end), so FY2026/27 week N starts 7 days later in the calendar than FY2025/26 week N. Matching on week number would put this year's Midsummer week (week 7) against a week with no holiday, so the calendar-aligned weeks FY2025/26 weeks 6-9 are used. The prior-year fiscal week numbers are shown
Total company is reported as booked, not like-for-like: stores that were closed or refitting in either year are not excluded
Net sales excludes VAT, as the warehouse net amounts do
Staff purchases are left in net sales; no definition in the schema says to exclude them
caveats: rpt_daily_store_sales is not reliable for the web shop (store 900): web sales are on different dates from the fact tables (e.g. a Sunday with 13 receipts against about 170 orders in the facts), so weekly web totals are off by up to about 25,000 EUR. Physical stores match the facts exactly. The answer is built from fact_sales_line and fact_return_line, not from that report

The view rpt.v_daily_sales identifies web sales with channel_code = 'WB'. Since the web-platform migration on 2025-11-03 web lines carry channel_id 2 or 3 and a null channel_code, so that view drops all current web sales. It was not used; web is identified by the web-shop store (store_id 900), which is valid in both years
Training store 999 has sales and returns in the facts (about 2,400 EUR in June 2026) and was excluded

Week 7 (15-21 Jun 2026) is not a clean comparison: it contains Midsummer (stores shut Friday and Saturday, as in the comparison week last year) and store 125 was closed for a refit from 15 Jun 2026. Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, so 38 stores traded in weeks 5-6 and 37 in weeks 7-8 against 39 last year. Growth is therefore understated against a like-for-like store base
Week 8 growth (-0.82%) also reflects store 125 being shut for the whole week and the Savonlinna closure

A duplicate load exists in fact_sales_line for store 116 on 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21 (418 duplicated lines). It is outside the weeks compared here, so no correction was needed, but it would inflate any query covering those dates
Cancelled and processing web orders have no sales lines in the fact table, so they are not in net sales

answer.sql: SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY cp.subcategory, cp.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27 is fiscal weeks 18 to 21, 31 August to 27 September 2026 (dim_date)
Units sold are the quantity on sales lines, by Helsinki sale_date (the weeks-of-cover definition of units sold)
Store scope: Nokia is store_id 118 (a single dim_store version, region West, format Medium); store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither changed the figures)
As-is product hierarchy: subcategory taken from the current product version (is_current)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Control total: my units for the 28 days match rpt_daily_store_sales units_sold for store 118 (2245 units, 28 days)
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'period 5' is FY2026/27 P05, the last completed period (31 August to 27 September 2026)
'Nokia' is the store Nokia (store_id 118); there is no other store or city of that name
'Units sold' is units on the sales lines before returns, not net of units returned
Subcategories are ranked on the current product hierarchy (as-is). It makes no difference here, because no Nokia line in the period has a different subcategory in its sale-date product version
Staff purchases are counted (10, 2 and 3 units in the three subcategories)
caveats: Neither the metric dictionary nor the skills define 'units sold' for a ranking. I used units on sales lines before returns. If units returned in the period were taken off, the order of places 2 and 3 would change: Indoor Lighting would be 147, Cleaning Products 134 and Storage Boxes 130, which would move Cleaning Products into 3rd place ahead of Storage Boxes. Fixings & Fasteners (563) and Indoor Lighting would stay 1st and 2nd.

The Nokia total (2245 units over 28 trading days) reconciles exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales, so no gap was found. No duplicate sales lines, no test-article lines and no part-period problem were found.
The gap between 1st place (570 units) and the rest is very large compared with places 2 and 3. Plants & Flowers and Cleaning Products tied at 136 units just behind Storage Boxes (139).

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1), sl AS (SELECT st.store_id, any_value(st.store_name) AS store_name, sum(s.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM sales s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id), rt AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sl.sales_net - coalesce(rt.refunds, 0) DESC) AS rank, sl.store_id, sl.store_name, round(sl.sales_net - coalesce(rt.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM sl LEFT JOIN rt USING (store_id) ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales = sales net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the period
Fiscal year FY2025/26 (2025-04-28 to 2026-05-03, a 53-week year) from ref_fiscal_calendar
Physical stores only: store_id below 900, so the web shop (900) and the training store (999) are excluded
Store identified by stable store_id, not by store_key version
Duplicate sales lines removed by receipt_id and line_no, keeping the first load
Returns attributed to the store and return date on the return line, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Biggest' is read as highest net sales, not floor area, because the request came without a measure and sales is the usual business reading. Floor area gives a different list, for example Helsinki Pitäjänmäki (8,381 sqm) first, then Turku Kupittaa, Kuopio, Oulu Kaakkuri, Vantaa Tammisto.
Period is FY2025/26, the latest complete fiscal year. FY2026/27 is only partly loaded (period 6 is flagged as not fully loaded), so it is not used.
Staff purchases are included as ordinary sales. Excluding them changes the amounts but not the top 10 or its order.
Amounts are in EUR excluding VAT, shown as whole-year totals with no adjustment for opening dates or refits.
caveats: Tampere Lielahti had its sales lines loaded twice for 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21 (836 duplicate rows, reloaded 2025-09-23). I removed the duplicates. Left in, they would add about 10,400 EUR and put Lielahti at 543,132 before returns, ahead of Kuopio, which is wrong. After the correction it is 8th, behind Kuopio.
dim_store comments say format is Hyper, Standard or Express, but the data holds Large, Medium and Small. Format is not used in this answer.

Stores were reassigned to new regions on 2025-04-28 (for example the Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kerava stores moved from South to Capital Region). Region is not used here, and joining on store_key would not split store totals across versions because I grouped by store_id.

Pori was shut for a 5-week refit from 2025-09-08 to 2025-10-12, inside the year, but it is not near the top 10. Kuopio's refit (2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26) falls in FY2026/27 and does not affect these figures.
Savonlinna closed on 2026-01-25, so its year is partial. It is ranked far outside the top 10.
The amounts match rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales for every store in the period, so the dashboard table is consistent with this answer.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2024/25' as fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period >= 7 AND d.fiscal_period <= 12 GROUP BY d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Net sales calculated excluding VAT (net_amount from fact_sales_line)
Garden category defined by dim_product_old historical classification
Fiscal periods P7-P12 of FY2024/25 per ref_fiscal_calendar
Sales includes staff purchases and all transaction types
assumptions: Old category structure sourced from dim_product_old table
Garden SKUs include all 899 products classified as Garden in dim_product_old
Staff purchases included in net sales (not excluded)
caveats: Category reclassification: 65 SKUs formerly in Garden have been reclassified to Electrical in the current product taxonomy. If this query were run against current product categories, the totals would differ by the sales of these 65 reclassified SKUs.
Period 12 shows elevated sales (EUR 325,651.60) representing 47.2% of the P7-P12 total, consistent with year-end seasonal patterns in Garden category

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM first_version fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the enrolling store)
Members counted by distinct member_id (first version only, so later versions of a member are not counted again)
Online sign-ups sit under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 runs 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, including week 53 (no comparison was asked for, so week 53 stays in)
Store names as-is (current store version)
Join date is a Helsinki business date and needs no UTC conversion
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 Apr 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks), as in past accepted requests (e.g. REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35 asked in May 2026). The request was received on 7 Oct 2026, during FY2026/27.
'Each store' covers every store where at least one member enrolled in the year, plus the web shop (store 900) as the online line; no total row is given
Members are attributed to the store where they enrolled, not to a later home store
caveats: The result uses fiscal year FY2025/26, not calendar 2025. On calendar 2025 (1 Jan to 31 Dec 2025) the company total would be 14,629 new members, against 14,854 for FY2025/26. Per-store figures for calendar 2025 can be produced on request.
FY2025/26 has 53 weeks, so the year is one week longer than a normal fiscal year, and week 53 (27 Apr to 3 May 2026) is included.

Enrolling store was taken from each member's first dim_member version. About 6% of these members have since moved to another home store; counting them at their current store would give different per-store numbers. All 113 Savonlinna sign-ups no longer show Savonlinna as home store, because the store closed on 25 Jan 2026 and its members were re-assigned.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026, so its 113 covers only the part of the year it was open.
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in autumn 2024, so they trade for the whole of FY2025/26. No store opened during the year.

Checks run on the data: no duplicate members, no member whose first version starts on a different date than the join date, and no unknown home stores. The control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply to member counts.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date taken in Helsinki time (UTC timestamp converted at local midnight)
Cancelled orders excluded
Processing orders would be included (none on this day)
Guest and logged-in orders both counted
Click-and-collect counted as web
assumptions: Cyber Monday read as Monday 1 December 2025, as stated in the request
Order count by order date, not dispatch date, as the company definition for web orders
Delivered and collected orders both count (the day had no processing orders)
caveats: Filtering on the UTC date instead of the Helsinki date would give 274 orders (before cancellations are checked), not 326. Orders placed between 00:00 and 02:00 Helsinki time on 1 December fall on 30 November in UTC, and late-evening orders on 1 December Helsinki time fall on 1 December UTC. The Helsinki-date figure of 326 is the one reported.
19 cancelled orders placed that day were excluded, as the company definition requires.
No duplicate order ids and no test-article (ZZ Test) orders were found among that day's orders, so no further corrections were needed.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Web net sales on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Click-and-collect as share of all web sales
Fulfilment type from fact_web_order (works across platform migration)
Web shop identified as store_id 900
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Only delivered and collected orders included; cancelled orders excluded
Returns booked to web shop tied back to order's fulfilment type
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year before the current FY2026/27)
Periods 6, 7, 8 of FY2025/26 (22 September to 21 December 2025)
Click-and-collect recognised on dispatch date when order became ready for collection
Helsinki local time used throughout for date boundaries
caveats: Request received 2026-10-09; periods 6-8 of FY2025/26 are complete in the warehouse
UTC/Helsinki timezone edge: 5 orders in fact_web_order and 8 in fact_sales_line move between days when converted from UTC to Helsinki midnight; warehouse dates are Helsinki dates
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale; these periods are months past and return lag is complete

answer.sql: SELECT cs.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR, excluding VAT) divided by distinct sales receipts, dated by sale_date
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop (store 900) not included
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
FY2026/27 period 4 taken from dim_date (fiscal_period = 4)
Format taken from the current dim_store version (format is the same in every store version)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (net_sales_before_returns) for the same days, store by store
Did not use channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated, staging, backup or tmp object
assumptions: 'Period 4 of FY26/27' is read as FY2026/27 P4, which is fiscal weeks 14 to 17, Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026. The period is complete and the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026.
'Average basket value' is read as ATV, as the request says, using the company definition: returns are not deducted and staff purchases are left out.

'Store format' is read as dim_store.format. The warehouse values are Large, Medium and Small (the column comment's Hyper, Standard and Express is out of date). The Web and Training formats are not shown because the web shop and store 999 are outside ATV.
Only the three physical-store formats are shown, and there is no company-wide total row because the request asks for a breakdown by format.
caveats: Store 999 (127 lines in the period) and ZZ Test articles were filtered out. In P4 the ZZ Test lines (57) all sit in store 999, and 737 staff-purchase lines were also excluded. These filters change the totals compared with a raw sum of fact_sales_line.

The control total reconciles. Per-store net sales before returns and receipt counts from fact_sales_line (all lines, staff included, 999 and ZZ Test out) match rpt_daily_store_sales for every physical store over 3 to 30 August 2026, with zero differences.

Source rows were checked for the period. There are no duplicate sales_line_id or (receipt_id, line_no) rows. No receipt spans more than one store or date, and none mixes staff and non-staff lines. There are no zero or negative receipts.
Receipts and stores behind each figure: Large 6,508 receipts over 8 stores, Medium 8,641 over 18, Small 2,598 over 12. These are 17,747 non-staff receipts over 38 stores in total.
Returns are deliberately not deducted, as the ATV definition requires, so these figures are higher than a net-of-returns basket value would be.

answer.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(r.net_sales) DESC) as position, s.store_id, s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales), 2) as net_sales_eur, SUM(r.receipts) as receipts, SUM(r.units_sold) as units_sold FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current WHERE r.business_date >= '2025-05-26' AND r.business_date <= '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales from rpt_daily_store_sales (maintained by Data & Analytics)
Period 2 of FY2025/26 defined as 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22 per ref_fiscal_calendar
Physical stores only (store_id < 900; excludes web channel)
Net sales figures exclude VAT and include deductions for line discounts
assumptions: Interpreted 'this year' as the current fiscal year FY2025/26 (as of 2026-10-15)
Ranked stores by period net sales in descending order as the primary performance metric
Included receipts and units sold as contextual metrics alongside net sales
caveats: Web/online channel (store_id 900+) excluded; league table covers physical stores only
Net sales figures are before returns; returned items are excluded from this calculation
Period dates determined from warehouse fiscal calendar; if calendar has been updated since data load, dates may shift

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2;
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share: click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales
Web net sales: recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time, after returns, excluding VAT, store 900 only, test articles (ZZ Test) excluded
Click-and-collect net sales: web net sales for orders with fulfilment_type click_and_collect, including refunds
Return lag: returns booked to web shop on their return date, not on original sale date
Fiscal period: period numbers within fiscal year, one row per period
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year 2025/26, running 29 April 2025 to 27 April 2026), the prior year relative to the current fiscal year FY2026/27
Periods 6, 7, 8 refer to fiscal periods (Q2 of the fiscal year, covering 13 weeks from 22 September to 21 December 2025)
Share expressed as a percentage in standard units (27.9 means 27.9%, not a decimal)
Cancelled web orders excluded; only delivered and collected orders included
caveats: Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale, so web sales data is complete through 21 December 2025 with a margin for late returns
Query control check confirms web net sales total (555,830.97 EUR) matches rpt_daily_store_sales control total exactly
Click-and-collect includes both home delivery and click-and-collect routes; this query isolates click_and_collect fulfilment type only
Period 6: 27.9% of web sales; Period 7: 25.4% of web sales; Period 8: 27.0% of web sales

answer.sql: WITH active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT '2025/26' AS dummy_unused, m.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS active_members FROM active a JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21' GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks ending with the as-of week and including it, in any channel (store or web)
Window as in the accepted queries (REQ-D29, REQ-D30): sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday (valid_from <= as-of date <= valid_to)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from sales work
Staff purchases kept in, because any purchase counts
assumptions: Asked on 7 October 2026 (FY2026/27), 'last year' is read as FY2025/26, in line with the 12 to 27 May 2026 readings (REQ-D04, REQ-D08, REQ-D28, REQ-D35). FY2025/26 is named in the answer.
Period 8 of FY2025/26 runs from 24 November 2025 to 21 December 2025 (weeks 31 to 34). 'End of period 8' is therefore Sunday 21 December 2025, the as-of date.
The trailing window is 22 December 2024 to 21 December 2025.
Member sale lines are dated by sale_date, as in the accepted active-member queries. Web lines use the order date, not the dispatch date.
No total row was added, since the request asks for the split by tier only.
caveats: The 'dummy_unused' column in the SQL string is a leftover and should be ignored. The result table has only the tier and active_members columns.
The store 999 and ZZ Test filter did not change the count. The total is 29,526 with or without it. Every member counted has a real-store or web purchase in the window.

fact_sales_line has 418 duplicated receipt_id and line_no pairs (836 rows), loaded in mid-September 2025 and identical in date, member and amount. They do not affect a distinct member count, so no correction was needed. They would double count any sum of sales.
All 29,526 active members have exactly one dim_member version valid on 21 December 2025, and none joined after that date. The tier split therefore has no overlap or gap. The tiers sum to 29,526.
The tier is the one held on 21 December 2025. Members who changed tier afterwards appear under their tier on that date, not their current tier.

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(f.quantity) DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Pitäjänmäki store identified as store_id 102 from dim_store
Period 5 of FY26/27 date range from ref_fiscal_calendar (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
Units sold calculated from fact_sales_line quantity field summed by product
assumptions: Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag = TRUE) included in units sold, as the request did not specify exclusion
Current store dimension used (dim_store filtered on is_current = TRUE)
caveats: Staff purchases represent 1.5% of total units at this store during the period (55 of 3740 units) and do not affect the top-3 ranking

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period = 5 WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 5 taken from ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27 P05, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, 4 weeks, fully loaded)
Store identified by stable store_id 102 across all dim_store versions (store_key), not by a single store_key
Products grouped by stable sku, not by product_key version
Units sold = sum of fact_sales_line.quantity (gross units sold, before returns)
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27, since the request is dated 2026-10-07 and the company uses a fiscal calendar; period 5 is therefore 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27
Helsinki Pitäjänmäki read as store_id 102 (the only store with that name)
Units sold counts all sales lines, staff purchases included; returns not netted off, because 'units sold' was asked for rather than net units
All lines at this store in the period are store-channel sales (channel_id 1), so no web lines are included
caveats: No data problems found that needed a correction for this store and period: no duplicate sales lines, no non-positive quantities, no sales on non-trading days, no sales dated outside the store version's validity, no closures recorded for the store, and one product version per top SKU in the period
The staging table stg_sales_line_load holds rows dated 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04 only, outside this period, so it does not affect the result
Staff purchases are included: 2 of the 42 units for sku 102244 were staff purchases. Excluding them would give 40 and leave the ranking unchanged
The store changed region from South to Capital Region on 2025-04-28 (new store_key); this does not affect the result because the store is matched by store_id
The top three are clear of fourth place (30 units), so the ranking is not sensitive to small data differences

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), by_year AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.category, ty.fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ly.fiscal_year AS comparison_fiscal_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS comparison_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM by_year ty JOIN by_year ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included, as in total-company net sales
As-is reporting: current product category for all history
Fiscal period 8 matched to fiscal period 8 of the prior year (same period number, 4 weeks each)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Request received 5 October 2026 (FY2026/27). 'Last year' is read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25, the reading past requests used for relative years. Period 8 is 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025 in FY2025/26 and 25 Nov to 22 Dec 2024 in FY2024/25.
Growth is FY2025/26 P8 against FY2024/25 P8, as a percentage.
Reported as-is, since the requester did not ask for as-was.
Net sales include the web shop and all physical stores, because no channel or store scope was requested.
Both P8s are 4 weeks and fully loaded. Week 53 of FY2025/26 is in P12, so it does not affect this comparison.
caveats: Correction for the outdoor lighting move: from 27 October 2025 (FY2025/26 P7) the outdoor lighting subcategory moved from Garden to Electrical. As-is, I put outdoor lighting in Electrical in both years. The raw as-was category tags would have put 19,504.55 EUR of FY2024/25 P8 outdoor lighting sales under Garden and understated Electrical's growth.

As-was, FY2024/25 P8 would read Garden 56,269.57 and Electrical 142,914.41. Growth would then be Garden -34.6% and Electrical +19.8%. Those figures are not comparable, because the category contents differ between the years. Ask if you want the as-was view.

Control total check: net sales for all categories across the whole company in P8 equal rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in both years (FY2024/25 1,373,188.97; FY2025/26 1,435,696.60). There are no duplicate receipt lines, and no cancelled or processing web orders in either P8.
The Garden figures include web sales (FY2025/26 5,443.12 EUR; FY2024/25 6,356.90 EUR as-is). Electrical includes web sales of 24,977.12 EUR in FY2025/26 and 20,657.82 EUR in FY2024/25 as-is.

Garden is flat (+0.1%) and Electrical is up 5.4%. Neither figure is adjusted for store openings, closures or refits, since this is total net sales and not like-for-like. Tampere (136) and Lohja (137) opened in FY2024/25, Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 so it trades in neither P8, and Pori's refit ended 12 October 2025. If you need underlying growth, ask for LFL.

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_aug_2024, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_sep_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales = fact_sales_line.gross_amount (EUR including VAT), before returns (fact_return_line not used)
Region as at the time of sale: fact_sales_line.store_key joined to the dim_store version valid on the sale date, not the current store row
Calendar months by sale_date, which is the local Finnish business date
VAT as recorded on each line: 24% standard rate to 31 Aug 2024 and 25.5% from 1 Sep 2024, 14% and 10% reduced classes; gross_amount reconciles to net_amount x (1 + vat_rate) on every line
Web shop (store_id 900, region Online) treated as its own region row
assumptions: August and September 2024 mean calendar months (1-31 Aug, 1-30 Sep), not fiscal periods
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag = true) are included, because they are taxable sales that belong in a VAT filing
Web shop sales are included as a separate Online row because they carry VAT and are part of gross sales; Finance can drop that row if it is filed elsewhere
The 'old reports' regions are the four regions North, South, East and West held on the store version valid at the time (for example Kouvola was East, and the stores now in Capital Region were South)
caveats: Excluded the Training store (store_id 999, region Head office), 283 test lines worth 7,633.94 EUR gross across the two months, because it is not a trading store

Using the current store row would give the wrong answer: since 28 Apr 2025 stores 101-105 are in Capital Region and Kouvola (114) is in South, but in Aug-Sep 2024 they were South and East. The store_key on each sales line already points to the version valid on the sale date, so no remapping was needed
Tampere Lamminpää (store 136) opened on 2 Sep 2024 and is in West for September only, with 19,657.54 EUR gross
The 1 Sep 2024 change of the standard VAT rate from 24% to 25.5% is in the data, so September gross is not comparable with August on a like-for-like VAT basis
The Online row is a channel, not a geographic region, and is included on top of the four sales regions
Checked and found no problem: no duplicate lines, no days missing and no lines outside the store version validity
413 web lines have a UTC timestamp on a different calendar day from sale_date, because the Finnish local date is used; the sale_date was used as recorded

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Current member version: dim_member.is_current = true (valid_to = 9999-12-31), one row per member_id
Loyalty tier as held on the member dimension (Basic, Silver, Gold)
Members counted by member_id (loyalty number), not by member_key, because dim_member keeps one row per version
assumptions: 'Right now' means the current version of each member as of the latest load in the warehouse (data runs to 4 October 2026 with a load on 5 October; the request came in on 8 October)
Every member in dim_member counts, whether or not they have shopped recently or consented to marketing, since the question asked only for tier
The answer is a single headcount of Gold members, with no breakdown by region, store or consent
caveats: No data problems found, so no corrections were made. Each of the 60,000 members has exactly one current version, none are open-ended without being flagged current, and tier values contain no blanks or odd spellings.
Counting all version rows with tier Gold would give 8,203 rows (2,412 of them superseded). Those are past versions, so they are excluded.
stg_member_updates holds recent tier changes, but all of its keys are already in dim_member and its current rows match the dimension. It changes nothing.
The count reflects data to 4 October 2026. Tier changes after that date, or between then and 8 October, are not in the warehouse.

answer.sql: WITH dedup AS (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id) AS rn FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'), sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.rn = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), rets AS (SELECT s.store_id, SUM(r.refund_net) AS returns_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1), tdays AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN dim_date d WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND d.is_trading_day AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0)) / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0), 2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND((COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0)) / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM dim_store cs JOIN tdays t ON t.store_id = cs.store_id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON sa.store_id = cs.store_id LEFT JOIN rets re ON re.store_id = cs.store_id WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (store 900) excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 5 (25 Aug 2025 to 21 Sep 2025, 4 weeks)
Store-level control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (net_sales_before_returns, returns_net and net_sales)
Store identity via dim_store.store_key on the fact row, name from the current store version
assumptions: 'Period 5 last year' was read as FY2025/26 P5, since the request was asked on 8 October 2026 in FY2026/27. This follows past readings of 'last year' in FY2026/27 (REQ-D04, REQ-D08, REQ-D28, REQ-D35). If FY2026/27 P5 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026) was meant, that is a separate run.
Ranking is on net sales per trading day, the company league-table definition. Total net sales are shown alongside for reference.
Ties in rank are not an issue: all 39 per-day values are distinct.
Store attributes (name) are taken from the current dim_store version; format and region were not asked for and are not shown.
caveats: Correction: store 116 Tampere Lielahti had duplicated sales lines in fact_sales_line from 15 to 21 September 2025. 418 receipt_id and line_no keys were loaded twice with different sales_line_id values, which doubled the store's sales on those days and overstated net sales before returns by 10,390.53 EUR (49,995.41 against the control total of 39,604.88). I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no (earliest etl_loaded_at). After this, store 116 matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (net sales 37,288.62). Without the correction it would have ranked about 4th instead of 7th. The duplicate load should be fixed at source.

Pori (119) was closed for a refit from 8 September 2025, so it trades only 14 days in this period (25 Aug to 7 Sep); it is ranked on those days only, as per the league-table rule. Its net sales per trading day is not comparable with a full-period store, and its total net sales is for a half period.
All other stores matched rpt_daily_store_sales on sales, returns and net sales to the cent, for 25 Aug to 21 Sep 2025.
No closed holidays fall in this period, so every open day counts as a trading day (28 days for a full-period store). Stores trade on all weekdays, including Sundays, in this warehouse.
Store 999 and ZZ Test were excluded; no other store totals changed in this period as a result of those filters among the 39 physical stores listed.
Returns are booked where processed and on the return date, so some refunds in the period relate to sales made before 25 Aug 2025, and some sales in the period will be refunded after 21 Sep 2025.

answer.sql: WITH receipts AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS is_staff_purchase, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY f.receipt_id) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, round(sum(receipt_net) / count(*), 2) AS atv_eur_excl_vat FROM receipts WHERE NOT is_staff_purchase
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales divided by number of transactions (receipts and web orders)
Net sales excl. VAT (net_amount, after line discounts)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 periods 1 to 3 (2026-05-04 to 2026-08-02, 13 weeks)
Company-wide: all stores plus the web shop (store 900), home delivery and click-and-collect both included
Web channel identified by channel_id (2 and 3), not channel_code, which is NULL on current rows
Training store (store 999) excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location
Staff purchases excluded
Cancelled web orders excluded (they have no sales lines)
Transactions counted as distinct receipt_id, with a web order counted as one transaction
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (request dated 2026-10-05), so periods 1 to 3 run 4 May to 2 Aug 2026
ATV measured on net sales excl. VAT, because the warehouse's sales reporting is ex-VAT
ATV taken before returns, as sales value per transaction; refunds are not deducted
Staff purchases left out because they are discounted internal sales, not customer baskets; no written ATV definition was available to me, so this is my reading
Web orders in the same basket measure as store receipts: one order = one transaction
caveats: Correction: the existing view rpt.v_daily_sales / rpt.v_weekly_store_sales filters web sales on channel_code = 'WB', which is NULL on current rows, so it would drop all web orders (about 12,960 orders, EUR 771k net). I used channel_id instead.
Correction: store 999 (Training store) has 186 receipts (EUR 7.8k net) in the period; these are excluded. Left in, they would pull the ATV down slightly.
Staff purchases (about 1,037 store receipts in real stores, plus 132 on the training store) are excluded. Including them gives 56.05 instead of 56.17.

Net of returns the figure would be about 53.12 (refunds of about EUR 177k net in stores and about EUR 66k at the web shop were deducted in this check, with training store excluded). I did not deduct returns in the headline figure.
Receipts in the base: 79,946 (about 66,984 store, 12,962 web); net sales EUR 4.49m.
All three periods are marked fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar. Period 3 is a 5-week period, so the 13-week window is correct.
The answer is a single company-wide figure for the three periods combined, not an average of period-level ATVs.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(f.vat_rate*100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 P5 = 26 Aug 2024 to 22 Sep 2024 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Stores only: store_id below 900 (web shop excluded), store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
VAT charged = gross_amount minus net_amount on each sales line, using each line's own VAT rate (no flat rate applied to a net total)
Lines dated by sale_date (stores, Helsinki business date)
Grain checked: one row per receipt_id and line_no; no duplicate lines in the period
Control total: net sales before returns agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for every store and day (0 mismatches over 1,056 store-days, 938,729.24 EUR)
assumptions: 'In the stores' read as physical stores only (store_id below 900); the web shop is left out
'Period 5 of FY24/25' read as FY2024/25 P5, 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024
'VAT charged' read as the VAT on sales lines. Returns are not netted off; the dictionary does not say how returns enter a figure including VAT
Rates are split as recorded on the lines (10%, 14%, 24%, 25.5%), not by dim_product.vat_class
Amounts are in EUR
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls inside this period. The 24% row covers sales from 26 to 31 Aug 2024 and the 25.5% row covers 1 to 22 Sep 2024. The standard-rate VAT is therefore split across two rows, and the two should be added together if a single standard-rate figure is wanted.

Total VAT charged on sales across all rates is 235,091.12 EUR (the sum of the four rows; no total row was asked for). Net sales behind it: 10% 1,506.05; 14% 5,835.96; 24% 225,441.92; 25.5% 705,945.31.

Returns are not deducted. Refunds booked in the stores in the same period carried VAT of 1.20 (10%), 10.48 (14%), 5,094.72 (24%) and 6,029.57 (25.5%), 11,135.97 in total. VAT net of refunds would be roughly 223,955.15 EUR. This is shown for information only; the dictionary has no rule for it.
No store 999 or ZZ Test lines fall in this period within stores, so the standard filters did not change the total.
The 24% and 25.5% rows match dim_product.vat_class 'standard' either side of 1 September 2024; reduced rates (10% and 14%) are unchanged, as expected.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 3 is fiscal weeks 9 to 13, Monday 29 June to Sunday 2 August 2026, five whole weeks and fully loaded
Units sold are the quantity on sales lines, before returns, dated by Helsinki sale_date (the same basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold)
Store identified by natural key store_id 108 (Lahti), a physical store
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded, which does not change this figure
Interior Paint is the subcategory under Paint & Decorating, taken from the current product version (as-is)
Staff purchases are included, as they are in net sales
Control total: all-category units and net sales at Lahti for the period were checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'period 3' means fiscal period 3 of that year.
'Interior Paint' means the subcategory of that name. The only paint-related categories are in Paint & Decorating: Interior Paint, Exterior Paint, Brushes & Rollers and Wallpaper & Decor Film.
'Lahti store' means store_id 108, Lahti. The other store with 'lahti' in its name is Tampere Lielahti (116), which is a different store.
'Units sold' means units on sales lines before returns. The dictionary does not define a net-of-returns unit count.
As-is and as-was give the same answer here: every Interior Paint line sold at Lahti in the period was already under Interior Paint in its own product version.
caveats: 194 units came from 142 sales lines. The 142 lines had unique receipt_id and line_no pairs, so no duplicate lines were found.
Of the 194 units, 4 were staff purchases. They are included.

Returns are not netted off. Five Interior Paint units were returned at Lahti in the period (by return date). Six units from period 3 sales have been returned so far, counted by sale date. Netting by return date would give 189 units.

Lahti totals for the period reconcile exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales: 3,927 units and 67,202.85 EUR net sales before returns across all categories, over 35 trading days. The control table has no product dimension, so the Interior Paint figure itself cannot be checked against it.
Lahti had no refit closure in the period, and store 108 has a single version in dim_store, so the store's history does not change the answer.
No data problems were found that needed a correction.

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT f.quantity, p.sku, cp.product_name FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT sku, product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM lines GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026, four weeks, fully loaded)
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by Helsinki sale date
Store scope: physical store 102 Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, identified by store_id across its store versions
Product identity: sku (stable across versions), named from the current product version
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither changes the result)
Control total: units for store 102 in the period (3,740) match rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold exactly
assumptions: 'Period 5 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P05, the current fiscal year. It is also the last completed period.
'Helsinki Pitäjänmäki' is store_id 102, the only store with that name.
'Units sold' is the quantity on sales lines before returns. Returned units are not deducted, and the company definition of units sold in the weeks-of-cover metric is the quantity on sales lines.

A product is a sku, not a product version, so units are added across any versions of an article.
Ranking is by units sold; the third place (42) is clear of the fourth (30), so there is no tie at the cut-off.

Store 102 was in the South region before 28 April 2025 and is in the Capital Region now. The region has no effect on this store-level answer.
Returns were not netted off the units. If net-of-returns units are wanted, the ranking could differ.
All three top products are store sales (no web lines at store 102).

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time, not order date
Net sales: amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web identified by store_id 900 (pseudo-store), not channel_code
Returns included and booked to their return date, not original sale date
Cancelled orders excluded (status IN delivered, collected)
Store 999 and test products (category ZZ Test) excluded
assumptions: Request for daily web sales (net) interpreted as aggregate net sales per calendar date
Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Includes both home delivery and click-and-collect fulfilment types as web
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale; net sales for each day reflects sales and returns processed that day
No padding: only dates with sales/returns activity are shown
caveats: Requested range spans two fiscal periods (FY2025/26 P08 and P09) and does not align with fiscal weeks
UTC/Helsinki time boundary: some orders placed or dispatched near midnight Finnish time may have been processed on a different UTC date
December 21 shows notably lower sales (611.75) compared to other days in the range; recommend verification
Control total match: queried total 93,720.40 equals rpt_daily_store_sales control total

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           s.region,
           f.gross_amount AS gross_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) >= DATE '2024-08-01'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) <= DATE '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(l.business_date) = 8 THEN l.gross_sales ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
       SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(l.business_date) = 9 THEN l.gross_sales ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM lines l
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT: sum of gross_amount from fact_sales_line
Before returns: excludes fact_return_line entirely
As-was region: region from store version on transaction date
Net sales exclusions: training store (999) and test articles (ZZ Test) excluded
Web sales recognition: dispatch date in Helsinki time, not order date
assumptions: August and September 2024 mapped to calendar dates 2024-08-01 to 2024-09-30
Regions as they were at the time include Online (web shop), which was a distinct region in August-September 2024
Web dispatch status limited to delivered or collected (excludes processing and cancelled)
caveats: VAT rate changed from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 for standard-rate products; reduced VAT rates (14%, 10%) unchanged. Each line carries its own VAT rate, ensuring accuracy across the rate change.
Online region represents the web shop (store 900) and is included as it constitutes a distinct region in the warehouse as-was structure for this period.
Training store (999) and test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded per company standards.
Web returns processed during this period are excluded (before returns).
