Regions and store names are as-is; Vantaa Tammisto (104) appears under its current record
No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period (sales_line_id and return_line_id are unique)

answer.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region_label FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id <> 999), lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS d, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, st.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)), tagged AS (SELECT CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'CY' WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' END AS yr, c.region_label, amt FROM lines l JOIN cur c USING (store_id)) SELECT region_label AS region, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'CY' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26_q3, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'PY' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25_q3, round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'CY' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'PY' THEN amt END) - 1), 2) AS growth_pct FROM tagged WHERE yr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_label ORDER BY region_label
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Returns counted on return_date, in the region of the store that took the return (web shop for web returns)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar: Q3 is fiscal periods 7 to 9, 13 weeks
Training store (store_id 999) excluded
Web shop (store_id 900, covering home delivery and click-and-collect) reported as its own line, outside the regions
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26. The request is dated 6 Oct 2026, which falls in FY2026/27 Q2. 'Q3' is read as fiscal Q3, not calendar Q3.

Q3 FY2025/26 is 2025-10-27 to 2026-01-25. The year before, Q3 FY2024/25, is 2024-10-28 to 2025-01-26. Both are 13 weeks, and the 53rd week of FY2025/26 falls in Q4, so it does not affect the comparison.
Both years are restated to the current region structure (see caveats), so the comparison is like for like by region.
Staff purchases are kept in net sales, since they are real sales and no definition excludes them. They total about 40.4k EUR gross of returns in FY2025/26 Q3 and about 46.4k in FY2024/25 Q3.
All stores trading in the period are included, including those that opened or closed during it. No like-for-like store filter was requested.
caveats: Correction: the region assignment changed on 2025-04-28. Stores 101 to 105 moved from South to a new Capital Region, and Kouvola (114) moved from East to South. Joining on the store version in force at the sale date would put FY2024/25 Q3 under the old regions and FY2025/26 Q3 under the new ones, so the growth figures would be wrong. I used each store's current region for both years.
Correction: the training store (store_id 999) has sales lines. They were excluded: 6,889 EUR in FY2025/26 Q3 and 6,479 EUR in FY2024/25 Q3 before returns. It has no returns in either period.

Correction: web sales cannot be found by channel_code. Lines loaded from 2025-11-04 onward have channel_code NULL and use channel_id (2 = home delivery, 3 = click-and-collect), while earlier lines have channel_code WB and no channel_id. All web lines sit on store_id 900, so web was identified by store. A filter on channel_code = 'WB', as the view rpt.v_daily_sales uses, would understate current-year web sales and so the web growth rate.

The web shop growth of 28.12% is much higher than any region. Part of it is the recorded move of web volume, with click-and-collect lines (channel 3) present only in the current year, whose sales stay under store 900. I did not check whether click-and-collect was reported under another channel in the earlier year. Treat the web comparison with caution.

rpt_daily_store_sales does not reconcile to the fact tables. Its net sales before returns are 4,045,754 EUR (FY2025/26 Q3) and 3,785,276 EUR (FY2024/25 Q3). The fact tables give 4,049,250 and 3,794,498 including the training store, and 4,042,362 and 3,788,019 excluding it. Its returns match the fact table (200,101.57 and 174,390.39). I used the fact tables, not the report table, and the report table's gap should be investigated.

Growth for North and West reflects stores 136 (Tampere Lamminpää, opened 2024-09-02) and 137 (Lohja, opened 2024-11-04), which are in the base for the whole of FY2024/25 Q3 only for 136. Lohja was open only from 4 Nov in the earlier year, which lifts South's growth. Savonlinna (129, East) closed on 2026-01-25, the last day of the current-year quarter, and is included in full.
Returns are booked by return date, not by the date of the original sale, so some refunds in a quarter relate to sales from before it.

The warehouse holds backup, staging, temporary and old-version tables (bak_*, stg_*, tmp_*, *_old). None of them was used, and the table-level duplicate checks found no duplicate sales lines or returns in either period.

answer.sql: SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Store sales: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop (store 900) is left out
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded from sales work
Including VAT: sum of gross_amount from the sales lines, each line at its own VAT rate (no flat rate applied to a net total)
Before returns: no refunds from fact_return_line deducted
Staff purchases included (they count in sales, only ATV excludes them)
Dated on sale_date (Helsinki business date), which matched the Helsinki conversion of sale_ts_utc on every line in the range
Control total: net_amount for the same lines matches rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales_before_returns for stores below 900 in both months (1101807.91 for August and 964016.09 for September)
assumptions: August 2024 and September 2024 are calendar months (1 to 31 August and 1 to 30 September 2024), as the request names the months and not fiscal periods
Store sales means the physical stores only, with no web shop and no click-and-collect web orders
Staff purchases are kept in the figure, as in the company net sales definition
Returns are not shown because the request says before returns
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024. The August figure is at 24% on standard-rated lines and the September figure at 25.5%, so the two months' VAT content differs. Reduced rates (14% and 10%) did not change. The line-level gross_amount carries the right rate, and I checked that it equals net times (1 plus the line VAT rate) on every line.

Store 999 and ZZ Test lines were removed, which changes the totals. Including store 999, the August gross for stores would be 1369277.19 and the September gross 1212263.83. Under 1 percent of either month.

Including VAT, the net-sales control total in rpt_daily_store_sales cannot be applied directly to the gross figure. I checked it on the net amounts of the same lines, and it agreed exactly in both months.
No duplicate rows found in fact_sales_line for these two months: sales_line_id and receipt_id with line_no are both unique, and no sale_date disagreed with its Helsinki-converted timestamp.

Web sales (store 900) are excluded as they are not store sales. If Finance wants store plus web including VAT, that is a separate figure, and web would need dating on the dispatch date, not the order date.

answer.sql: WITH net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin = net sales minus standard cost, both after returns (returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned)
Net sales excluding VAT, returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Fiscal Q4 of FY2024/25 = P10 to P12, 27 Jan 2025 to 27 Apr 2025 (dim_date fiscal_quarter = 4)
Regions as-is (current dim_store version via store_id and is_current)
Products as-is (current dim_product version via sku and is_current)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Web shop (store 900, region Online) is not in the South region, so no web sales are included
Staff purchases included
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Q4 of FY24/25 read as fiscal year FY2024/25, quarter 4, as named in the request (not the most recent completed Q4).

South read as the current (as-is) region, which is the company default for management reporting. This includes Kouvola (114, moved East to South on 28 April 2025) and excludes the five stores (101 to 105) that were South at the time but are now Capital Region. Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) is included.
A product is a sku, shown with its current name and grouped across all its versions.
Returns are attributed to the region of the store where they were processed, on the return date, not to the original selling store.
caveats: Under as-was regions (the four-region structure at that time), the South list would differ: it would include stores 101 to 105 and exclude Kouvola. This list uses as-is.
Kouvola (114) traded as an East store at the time but is counted in South here, as the current hierarchy puts it.
Store 999 and ZZ Test were excluded as standard; the request did not ask for them and they do not belong in sales reporting.

Control check: net sales for each of the 10 South stores over the quarter match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (difference 0.00). The check covers store totals only, not the product ranking. No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the range.
Margin values come from standard cost recorded on the lines. Standard costs are revalued each April, and the quarter ends on 27 April, so the quarter sits almost wholly on the pre-revaluation costs.
Absolute amounts are small because they are one quarter of sales for ten South stores only.

answer.sql: WITH store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_week = 27), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current CROSS JOIN range_start rs WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= rs.first_day - 364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), by_region AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM by_region ty JOIN by_region ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week, physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop excluded
LFL base rule: store open_date on or before the first day of the requested range minus 364 days (range starts 27 Oct 2025, so cut-off is 28 Oct 2024)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open/close dates and ref_store_closure refit weeks checked)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns; returns reduce net sales on their return date (refund_net)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Regions as-is: current dim_store version (is_current) used for all history, so the Capital Region includes its six stores in both years and Kouvola sits in South in both years
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39 (P7 to P9), compared with weeks 27 to 39 of FY2024/25 by fiscal week, not calendar date
Control total: store-level net sales and net sales before returns for all stores for the 13 weeks in both years agree with rpt_daily_store_sales (zero differences above 0.5 EUR)
No deprecated objects used (no rpt.v_daily_sales, no channel_code, no stg_/bak_/tmp_ tables)
assumptions: 'Q3 last year' read as FY2025/26 Q3 (fiscal weeks 27 to 39, 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), the fiscal year that ended in May 2026 and was current before FY2026/27 began; the comparator is FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025). This follows the May 2026 precedents (REQ-D04, D08) that took last year as FY2025/26. I asked no one; if Finance meant calendar Q3 or FY2026/27 Q3, which is not complete, the answer would differ.
Regions taken as-is (current hierarchy), the company default for management reporting; the request did not ask for as-was
One row per region with no total row, since the request asks for growth by region only; the this-year and last-year net sales are shown to support the growth figure
caveats: Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) is excluded from the LFL base because it had not been open 364 days before 27 Oct 2025; this removes the South's Lohja sales from both years
Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) is in the base for all 13 weeks (open more than 364 days before 27 Oct 2025)
Savonlinna (129, East) closed on Sunday 25 Jan 2026, the last day of week 39, so it traded all 13 weeks and stays in the East figure; it is not in the base after that date
Refit closures (Tammisto 2024, Pori 2025, Kuopio 2026) all fall outside weeks 27 to 39 of both years, so no store-weeks dropped for refits
Checked fact_sales_line for duplicate loads in both 13-week ranges: none (sales_line_id and receipt_id+line_no unique); no data corrections were needed
Week 53 is not in Q3, so no effect; web shop (store 900) is not part of LFL by definition
South LFL (0.02%) is essentially flat; South as-is includes Kouvola (moved from East on 28 April 2025) in both years, so the South and East figures differ from as-was regions

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member = a distinct loyalty number (member_id) whose join_date is 25 September 2026
Counted by member_id, not member_key, because dim_member keeps one row per version of a member
assumptions: Read 'signed up' as the join_date in dim_member, the date the member joined
Counted all sign-up routes together, in-store and online. 8 of the 39 are online sign-ups (home_store_id 900) and 31 are tied to a store
Used the calendar date 25 September 2026 as stored. join_date is a plain date, so there is no UTC-to-Helsinki shift to apply
caveats: No data problem needed correcting. All 39 member_ids have exactly one row in dim_member, each dated 25 September 2026. No member has conflicting join dates across versions, and every member has exactly one current row.
stg_member_updates also holds 39 rows for that date. All of them are already in dim_member, so they were not added again.
The loyalty program's own sign-up log is not in the warehouse, so I could not check the count against it.

Some of the 39 are Silver or Gold from their join date, although each has only one version row. That looks unusual for new members. I did not exclude them, because the request counts sign-ups regardless of tier.

answer.sql:
WITH period2_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    SUM(rpt.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date
)
SELECT 
  ps_current.fiscal_week,
  ps_current.fiscal_week_start_date,
  ROUND(ps_current.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2026_27,
  ROUND(ps_prior.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((ps_current.net_sales - ps_prior.net_sales) / ps_prior.net_sales) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM period2_sales ps_current
LEFT JOIN period2_sales ps_prior 
  ON ps_current.fiscal_week = ps_prior.fiscal_week 
  AND ps_prior.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ps_current.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ps_current.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: revenue after returns, as reported in rpt_daily_store_sales (maintained by Data & Analytics)
Period 2: fiscal period 2 defined by ref_fiscal_calendar, spanning fiscal weeks 5-8
Fiscal week: week number within the fiscal year; fiscal week dates from dim_date
Growth percentage: ((current year value - prior year value) / prior year value) × 100
assumptions: "This year" = FY2026/27 (current fiscal year as of request date 2026-10-07)
"Last year" = FY2025/26 (immediately prior fiscal year)
Total company = all stores in rpt_daily_store_sales (physical stores plus web/online channel)
caveats: Week 7 of FY2026/27 shows a notable decline of -32.21% vs the prior year; verify this reflects actual trading conditions
Week 8 of FY2026/27 shows strong growth of 76.36%; the week 7 decline followed by week 8 surge may indicate a shifted shopping pattern or promotional timing difference between years
Data currency depends on ETL load timing; verify the load date of rpt_daily_store_sales matches your reporting cutoff

answer.sql:
WITH web_sales_by_fulfilment AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    wo.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as sales_value
  FROM fact_web_order wo
  JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(wo.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
    AND wo.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, wo.fulfilment_type
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN sales_value ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(sales_value), 
    2
  ) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web_sales_by_fulfilment
GROUP BY fiscal_year
definitions_applied: Web sales: orders from fact_web_order table
Click-and-collect share: sum of click-and-collect order values as a percentage of total web order values
Completed orders only: status IN ('delivered', 'collected'), excluding cancelled and processing orders
Order value: order_total_gross in EUR
Fiscal periods: fiscal_period 9 and 10 as defined in dim_date
assumptions: Last year: FY2025/26 (the previous fiscal year from current FY2026/27 as of request date 2026-10-06)
Sales value metric: order_total_gross (total order value in EUR including VAT) rather than order count
Completed transactions: orders with status 'delivered' or 'collected' are included; 'cancelled' and 'processing' are excluded from the calculation
Date matching: web orders matched to fiscal periods using the order_ts_utc timestamp converted to calendar_date
caveats: Click-and-collect share calculated by value (EUR), not by order count. By count, the share would be 29.66% (2830 of 9545 completed orders).
Cancelled and processing orders are excluded. If these should be included, the share would be 29.86% (all 9715 orders including incomplete ones).
Some web orders may have missing or null order_total_gross values; these would not be included in the calculation.
The timestamp conversion to fiscal period assumes order_ts_utc dates correctly align with the fiscal calendar in dim_date.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week),
range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week),
weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)),
store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)),
web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, matched week by week
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns taken on their own return date
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) excluded from LFL
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (open_date <= 2026-05-04 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no ref_store_closure overlap)
Week 53 never counted (not relevant to P1, which is weeks 1-4)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P1 = weeks 1-4 (4 May to 31 May 2026) vs FY2025/26 weeks 1-4 (28 Apr to 25 May 2025), lined up by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Regions as-is (current hierarchy); the headline is a single company total, so regions do not affect it
Control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 1 this year' read as FY2026/27 P1. The 9 Oct 2026 request falls in FY2026/27, and P1 is fully loaded (ended 31 May 2026).
'This year' read as the current fiscal year (FY2026/27), with FY2025/26 P1 as the comparator.
One company total was returned because no breakdown was asked for.
Only the growth percentage was returned, since the request asks for growth. The underlying figures are 1,177,925.94 EUR this year and 1,103,969.88 EUR last year.
Staff purchases kept in net sales, as the company definition says.
Open and close dates taken from the current dim_store version.
caveats: No data correction was needed. Sales lines and returns have no duplicate keys or orphan returns in either year. Net sales by store match rpt_daily_store_sales for all physical stores in both P1 windows, with no differences above 0.50 EUR.

answer.sql:
WITH campaign_params AS (
  SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, '2025-11-24'::DATE AS window_start, '2025-12-07'::DATE AS window_end
),

targeted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign_params)
),

holdout_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id
  FROM campaign_holdout
  WHERE campaign_id = (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign_params)
),

member_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    m.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= (SELECT window_start FROM campaign_params)
    AND f.sale_date <= (SELECT window_end FROM campaign_params)
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND m.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.member_id
),

targeted_with_sales AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(ms.total_net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM targeted_members tm
  LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON tm.member_id = ms.member_id
),

holdout_with_sales AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(ms.total_net_sales, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM holdout_members hm
  LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON hm.member_id = ms.member_id
),

stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(net_sales), 2) AS targeted_avg,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(net_sales), 2) FROM holdout_with_sales) AS holdout_avg
  FROM targeted_with_sales
)

SELECT 
  targeted_avg AS avg_spend_per_targeted_member,
  holdout_avg AS avg_spend_per_holdout_member,
  ROUND(targeted_avg - holdout_avg, 2) AS uplift_euros
FROM stats
definitions_applied: Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, store 999 and ZZ Test category excluded
Campaign uplift as mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member
Campaign window plus seven days (2025-11-24 to 2025-12-07)
Targeted members as those with at least one exposure in fact_campaign_exposure
Members with zero sales counted as zero in the average
Web sales dated on dispatch date in Helsinki time
assumptions: Black Week 2025 campaign (campaign_id 15) runs 2025-11-24 to 2025-11-30; uplift window extends to 2025-12-07 (plus 7 days per company definition)
Campaign exposure is the source of truth for targeted members; no filtering by successful delivery
Holdout members never received contacts and serve as the control group
caveats: Targeted members identified from campaign exposure: 23,818 members. Holdout members: 2,747. The mailing list size was 26,573; the 8-member difference likely reflects members who left or changed marketing consent after the campaign target date.
No data quality issues detected. Uplift of €1.62 per member (targeted €9.64 vs holdout €8.02) represents a 20.2% higher average spend for exposed members over the 14-day window.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')), eligible AS (SELECT DISTINCT st.store_id FROM dim_store st WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND st.close_date IS NULL AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date < DATE '2025-07-28') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c, per p WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= p.e AND c.closure_end_date >= p.s)), sales AS (SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS s_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible) GROUP BY ALL), rets AS (SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS r_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible) GROUP BY ALL), net AS (SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.s_net - coalesce(r.r_net, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, store_id)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round(100 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM net

Like-for-like store base: physical stores (store_id below 900) trading for the whole of both periods, with no closure, no refit closure and no opening inside or shortly before either period
Net sales: line net_amount (EUR, excluding VAT, after line discounts) less refund_net on returns booked in the same period, matching the rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales definition
Store identity by store_id (stable across versions), so the April 2025 region reassignments do not affect the base
Web shop (store 900) excluded as not a store; training store (999) excluded as a pseudo-location
LFL growth = (current-period net sales of LFL stores / prior-period net sales of the same stores) - 1, in percent
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27, and 'period 4' as fiscal period 4 (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30), not calendar April; the request date of 2026-10-07 is after the period closed and ref_fiscal_calendar shows P4 fully loaded
Like-for-like means store sales only, excluding online sales; the growth is a single company-wide figure since no breakdown was asked for

The warehouse documents no formal LFL rule, so I used the standard test: a store is in the base if it traded every day of both periods. Stores 136 (opened 2024-09-02) and 137 (opened 2024-11-04) opened before the prior-year period started, so they are included
Net sales are after returns and include staff purchases, as in the maintained daily store sales report
Returns are netted against the store where they were booked, in the period of the return date, not the original sale date
The tmp_lfl_store_list_2024/2025 and bak_/old/stg_ tables are scratch or backup objects and were not used
caveats: Correction: Savonlinna (store 129, closed 2026-01-25) has 9,913.31 EUR gross sales (9,549.14 net) in the prior-year period and no sales this year; it is excluded from both periods. Leaving it in would pull the growth figure down by about 1 percentage point.
Correction: the web shop (store 900, +25% on net sales) and the training store (999) are excluded; the web shop would have lifted the figure well above the store-only result

Correction: from the web-platform migration, current-year sales lines carry channel_id (1 = store) and a null channel_code, while prior-year lines carry channel_code ST/WB. I identified stores through dim_store (store_id below 900), not channel_code, so both years are treated the same way

The like-for-like result is essentially flat: -0.03% (net sales 1,010,743.32 EUR in P4 FY2025/26 vs 1,010,478.52 EUR in P4 FY2026/27 across 38 stores). Stores are widely dispersed, from about -24% (Mikkeli, 127) to about +22% (Lohja 137, Kokkola 123).

Sensitivity on the store base: excluding the two newest stores (136 Tampere Lamminpää and 137 Lohja, opened Sept and Nov 2024, still ramping up in the prior-year period) gives -0.23%; excluding Kuopio (125, reopened 2026-07-26 after a 6-week refit, the weeks just before P4) as well gives -0.41%. If Finance applies a stricter maturity rule than 'open throughout both periods', the figure moves by up to about 0.4 points. The sign stays slightly negative or flat.
Staff purchases are included. Excluding them would give about +0.14%; before returns the figure is +0.01%. None of these changes the conclusion that growth is flat.

All 28 trading days are present in both periods for every store in the base, with no duplicate sales lines and no orphan returns. The daily report table and the fact tables agree for stores. No public holidays or non-trading days fall in either window.

Refit closures (104 in 2024, 119 in 2025, 125 in June-July 2026) all fall outside both P4 windows, so none removes sales days from the comparison. Store 125 was closed for six weeks to 26 July 2026 and its current-period sales may include a post-refit effect.

assumptions: Q2 of FY24/25 read as FY2024/25 P4, P5 and P6 (29 July 2024 to 27 October 2024), as the request states

Including VAT read as gross_amount from the lines; refunds not shown because the request excludes them
Orders are dated by dispatch (or ready-for-collection) date, so an order placed in a period but dispatched in the next falls in the next period
caveats: Two ZZ Test web lines dispatched in the range were excluded: 8.06 EUR gross in P4 and 3.77 EUR gross in P5
VAT rate changed from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, inside P5; each line's own rate is used, so the P5 figure mixes both rates
These are gross sales before returns, so they are not net sales and not comparable to the company net sales figure, which is excluding VAT and after returns
Do not use rpt.v_daily_sales for this: it is built on channel_code. The channel_code fault starts in November 2025, so the Q2 FY24/25 range is not affected here
Checks run: no duplicate sales lines, every web line has a matching web order and sits in store 900, and gross matches net times (1 + VAT rate) on every line in range

answer.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, DATE(d.fiscal_week_start_date) as week_start, DATE(d.fiscal_week_end_date) as week_end, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE p.sku = 101624 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week = 22 GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
definitions_applied: Units sold: gross transaction quantity from fact_sales_line before returns
Last week: most recent complete fiscal week in warehouse (week 22, FY2026/27)
Fiscal calendar: ISO weeks with fiscal year boundaries
assumptions: Last week interpreted as the latest complete fiscal week (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04), since warehouse data ends 2026-10-04 and request received 2026-10-08
SKU 101624 identified by numeric value; product name in request ('Oulu Kaakkuri') does not match warehouse record
caveats: Product name mismatch: SKU 101624 in warehouse is 'Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251' (Tools & Hardware), not 'Oulu Kaakkuri' as stated in request
Warehouse data extends only to 2026-10-04; cannot provide data for calendar week ending 2026-10-15
4 units of SKU 101624 were returned in week 22; this figure reports gross sales (183) not net after returns (179)

answer.sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2), rets AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) AS garden_net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns
Fiscal periods from the company fiscal calendar (FY2024/25 P07 = 2024-10-28 to 2024-11-24 ... P12 = 2025-03-24 to 2025-04-27)
Product category as reported at the time: the product version in force on the sale date (fact product_key), so Garden includes the Outdoor Lighting subcategory
Returns are counted in the period the refund was booked (return_date), using the product version at the return date
All sales channels (stores and web) included
Training pseudo-location (store_id 999) excluded, matching the daily store sales report
assumptions: 'The old category set-up' is read as the category hierarchy before Outdoor Lighting was moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27. The warehouse's historical product versions give this directly.
'Net sales' is read as net of returns and excluding VAT, the same way the Data & Analytics daily store sales report defines it.
Staff purchases are kept in, as in the daily store sales report. Web sales are included because the request does not limit it to stores.
'P7 to P12 of FY24/25' is read as FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 of the company fiscal calendar, all marked fully loaded.
caveats: Correction for the category change: 'Outdoor Lighting' sat under Garden until 2025-10-27 and now sits under Electrical. Grouping by today's category would drop it from these periods. I used the version valid on each sale date, so it is included. The outdoor lighting part of gross sales is about 22.9k in P7, 21.5k in P8, 18.7k in P9, 10.8k in P10, 9.2k in P11 and 11.7k in P12.
Correction for the training location: store 999 (Training) holds a small amount of sales, which I excluded. It is not in the daily store sales report either.
These figures will not match current Garden figures. They follow the old category set-up, as requested.
The daily store sales report's web figure for P7 is about 1.9k lower than the fact table's web sales. I could not find the cause, and did not use the report for this answer.

P12 (about 310k) is far above P7 to P10 (about 56k to 63k) and P11 (about 109k). This looks like the spring season and not a data fault. I found no duplicate sales or return lines, no orphan returns and no category mismatches in the period.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost), 2) AS gross_margin FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South' GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin = net sales minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns (returned units credited back at standard_cost_returned)
Net sales excluding VAT, after line discounts; returns dated on their return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only); web shop (store 900) falls in region Online, so it is in no South figure
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Region as-is: current dim_store version (is_current), so South is the current 10 South stores, including Kouvola (114)
Product as-is: grouped by sku on the current product version (name, category)
Fiscal calendar: Q4 = periods 10 to 12 (27 Jan 2025 to 27 Apr 2025, 13 weeks) of FY2024/25
Ranking by gross margin in EUR (absolute amount, not margin %)
assumptions: Q4 of FY24/25 was read as fiscal year FY2024/25, quarter 4 (periods 10 to 12), as written in the request.
South read as the current (as-is) South region, the company default, since as-was was not requested.
Top 10 ranks products by gross margin in EUR, not by margin percentage.
A product is an article (sku) and is shown under its current name; the 12 other candidates beyond rank 10 do not tie with rank 10 (rank 11 is about 935 EUR against 979 EUR at rank 10).
Gross margin is the figure after returns, per the company definition.
caveats: Region is as-is. The 28 April 2025 reorganisation moved Helsinki Vuosaari (101), Helsinki Pitäjänmäki (102), Espoo Lommila (103), Vantaa Tammisto (104) and Kerava (105) from South to the new Capital Region, and moved Kouvola (114) from East to South. This answer therefore excludes those five stores even though they were South during FY2024/25, and includes Kouvola. An as-was reading (regions as in Jan to Apr 2025) would give different figures and possibly a different ranking; I did not produce it because the request did not ask for it.
Filters applied: store 999 and category ZZ Test were left out. I did not measure how much they change the total.
Web orders are not part of South (the web shop is region Online).

Checks run: no duplicate sales or return lines in the quarter, no null or zero costs, line costs equal quantity times the standard unit cost of the product version, and every line's product version is valid on the sale date. The rpt_daily_store_sales control total was not applicable (it has no product dimension) and was not run.
FY2024/25 Q4 is fully loaded in the warehouse and has no week 53, so no calendar edge cases apply.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS web_orders_placed FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
definitions_applied: Web order = one row in fact_web_order, counted by distinct web_order_id
Day of placement = UTC calendar date of order_ts_utc, as requested
Placed orders include cancelled and click-and-collect orders (all statuses)
assumptions: Black Friday 2025 is 28 November 2025, as the request states, and the UTC day runs 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 UTC on that date.
'Placed' counts every order that was placed, so the 20 orders later cancelled are included. Both home delivery and click-and-collect count as web orders.

I used fact_web_order as the source because it holds one row per order with its placement timestamp. Its 377 distinct orders contain no duplicate order IDs, and none of them also sit in the staging table stg_web_order_load.
caveats: Of the 377 orders, 20 were cancelled (11 home delivery, 4 click-and-collect with logged-in members, 7 guest... see breakdown: cancelled orders have no sales lines). Excluding cancelled orders the figure is 357. Use 357 if the carrier's report only covers orders that were actually shipped or collected.

Counting by the warehouse's sale_date on the sales lines gives a different number. In the sales line table, receipts with sale_date = 2025-11-28 total 402 for the web channels, and 350 non-cancelled orders fall on that date, because sale_date is not the UTC date. I did not use it, since you asked for UTC days.

The sales line table has no channel_code values from 3 November 2025 onwards. Web lines carry channel_id 2 (home delivery) or 3 (click and collect) instead. Anything that filters on channel_code = 'WB' misses all web sales for Black Friday 2025 and returns zero. I avoided this by counting from fact_web_order, which has no channel column.
No correction to the 377 figure was needed.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, n.store_id
)
SELECT ty.store_id, cs.store_name, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ty.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.store_id;
definitions_applied: DEF-LFL-BASIS: Like-for-like compares physical stores week by week
DEF-LFL-OPEN: A store must have been open at least 52 weeks (364 days) before the first day of the period
DEF-LFL-BOTH-YEARS: A store-week counts only if the store traded in both the current year and the prior year
DEF-LFL-REFIT: Refit closure weeks are excluded from both years for the affected store
DEF-LFL-WEEK53: Week 53 is never included in LFL comparison
DEF-NET-SALES: Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: Physical stores only (store_id < 900); web shop and training store excluded
DEF-TIMEZONE: Web order revenue recorded on Helsinki dispatch date, not UTC
assumptions: Period 4 this year is FY2026/27 P04 (fiscal weeks 14-17, 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30)
Last year is FY2025/26 P04 (same fiscal weeks in the prior fiscal year)
Request asks for store-level breakdown (not regional summary) based on 'the stores' (plural)
Store-level LFL is calculated for all 38 physical stores that meet the LFL criteria
caveats: Web shop (store_id 900) is excluded from LFL by definition; control total gap of EUR 184,965 is web shop sales
Lohja (store 137) entered the LFL base on 3 November 2025; this is its first full period in the comparison
Tampere Lamminpää (store 136) entered the LFL base on 2 September 2024; it has one full prior-year comparison
Stores meeting the opening rule are only those open at least 52 weeks before P04 start (2025-06-01)
UTC/Helsinki timezone edge: some web orders and transactions near midnight appear in different days depending on timezone; results use Helsinki time throughout

answer.sql: SELECT count(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date in Helsinki time (day changes at local midnight, UTC+2 on 1 December 2025)
Cancelled orders excluded, processing orders counted
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and ZZ Test filter checked (no test orders on the day)
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 is read as Monday 1 December 2025, as the request states
Placed means the order timestamp, so the count is by order date and not dispatch date
All fulfilment types (home delivery and click-and-collect) and both guest and logged-in orders are included
caveats: Day boundaries are Helsinki midnight, so the window is 30 November 2025 22:00 UTC to 1 December 2025 21:59 UTC. A UTC-date count would give a different figure.
345 orders were placed on the day. 19 were cancelled and are excluded, leaving 326 (239 delivered, 87 collected).
No test-article or store 999 orders fell on the day, so the ZZ Test and store 999 filter did not change the total.
No duplicate order IDs were found in fact_web_order, so no de-duplication was needed.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 3 of FY2026/27 runs 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02 (5 weeks), fully loaded in the warehouse
Interior Paint = dim_product.subcategory 'Interior Paint' (category Paint & Decorating), using the product version in force at the sale date via product_key
Lahti store = store_id 108 (store_key 13), matched on store_id so every store version is included
Units sold = SUM(fact_sales_line.quantity) on store-channel lines (channel_id 1) attributed to the Lahti store, matching the units_sold basis of rpt_daily_store_sales
Sale date from fact_sales_line.sale_date, mapped to the fiscal period through dim_date
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, which started on 2026-05-04. The request date is 2026-10-05, so period 3 is already complete.
'Lahti store' means the physical Lahti store (store_id 108). Tampere Lielahti is a different store and is excluded.
'Units sold' is gross units sold in the store channel, before returns.
Staff purchases count as sales, as they do in the daily store sales report.
caveats: No correction was needed. I checked for duplicate sales lines, store and product version splits and incomplete loading, and found none affecting Lahti Interior Paint in this period. The warehouse does hold 418 duplicated (receipt_id, line_no) pairs elsewhere, none of them for Lahti in this window.
The 194 units include 4 units from 3 staff-purchase lines, all on 2026-08-01. Excluding staff purchases gives 190.
The figure is before returns. 6 units from 6 return lines were returned against these sales. Net of returns it would be 188.
Click-and-collect web orders picked up at Lahti are not counted. They are booked to the web channel, and 5 Interior Paint units fall in this period. Including them would give 199.
Lahti has no planned closure in the closure table, and sales were recorded on every day of the period.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_member_count FROM dim_member WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE
definitions_applied: Member count: distinct member_id (company design for slowly-changing dimension deduplication)
Current version: is_current = TRUE (latest version of each member record)
assumptions: Right now = current member state in the warehouse as of 2026-10-04 (latest data load)
Gold tier members = all members (active or not) with current tier = 'Gold'
Not filtered to active members (those with purchases in trailing 52 weeks)
caveats: Warehouse last updated 2026-10-04, four days before request received 2026-10-08
Count represents members with current tier status Gold as of the latest data load, not members whose tier was Gold at request time

answer.sql: WITH p1_2025 AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2025 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-04-28' AND '2025-05-25' GROUP BY store_id), p1_2026 AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) as sales_p1_2026 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT p1_2026.sales_p1_2026, p1_2025.sales_p1_2025, ROUND(((p1_2026.sales_p1_2026 - p1_2025.sales_p1_2025) / p1_2025.sales_p1_2025 * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct FROM p1_2025 INNER JOIN p1_2026 ON p1_2025.store_id = p1_2026.store_id
definitions_applied: Like-for-like: stores with sales activity in both comparable periods
Net sales: sales excluding VAT, after line discounts
assumptions: Requested fiscal year is the current one (FY2026/27) given today's date
Like-for-like comparison uses stores with sales in both period 1 instances
Web channel (store_id >= 900) excluded from store sales analysis
caveats: One store (Savonlinna, store 129) was open in period 1 FY2025/26 but closed 2026-01-25, correctly excluded from LFL set
Period 1 runs different calendar dates in each fiscal year (P1 FY2025/26 is 28 Apr–25 May; P1 FY2026/27 is 4–31 May) due to fiscal week anchoring

answer.sql: SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Current member version only (dim_member.is_current = true, valid_to = 9999-12-31)
Members counted as distinct loyalty numbers (member_id), not member_key rows
Tier taken from dim_member.tier
assumptions: 'At the moment' means the latest version of each member, as the warehouse stands on the request date (2026-10-07)
Every loyalty member on file counts, with no filter on marketing consent, home store or join date
Members who have left the programme are not flagged anywhere in dim_member, so none could be excluded
caveats: dim_member keeps one row per version of each member, so counting every row with tier = 'Gold' gives 8,203 rows (2,412 of them superseded versions) and 8,024 distinct members, which includes 2,233 who are no longer Gold. Only current versions are counted here.

Checks run on the data: each of the 60,000 members has exactly one current version, no tier values are blank or misspelled, no current version starts after the request date, and there are no duplicate keys among the Gold rows. No corrections to the data were needed.
The staging table stg_member_updates and the backup and old tables were not used. They are not the maintained dimension.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, outside refit closures, and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 and training store 999 excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P2 is fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday 1 June to Sunday 28 June 2026
Store attributes (name) taken from the current store version (as-is)
Ties broken by RANK on net sales per trading day
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P2, the current fiscal year (it began 4 May 2026), 1 to 28 June 2026. It is complete in the warehouse, which is loaded through 4 October 2026
Ranking is on net sales per trading day, the company league table definition, not on total net sales
A store that traded for only part of the period is still listed with its own trading days
Net sales and net sales per trading day are in EUR excluding VAT

answer.sql: WITH web_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')), combined AS (SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, w.net_amount AS amt FROM web_lines w JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON w.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date UNION ALL SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web_lines w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date) SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt END)/sum(amt),2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct FROM combined WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net amount excluding VAT, less refunds (net of returns)
Fiscal calendar periods from ref_fiscal_calendar (period 6 = 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025, period 7 = 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025, period 8 = 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025)
Web shop = pseudo-location store_id 900, web order lines only
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Only delivered and collected orders counted; cancelled orders have no sales lines
Sales dated by sale_date; refunds dated by return_date (refunds booked in the period)
Share = click-and-collect net sales divided by total web net sales, in percent
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026), because the request came on 9 October 2026 in FY2026/27 and periods are fiscal periods
'Sales' means net sales after returns, excluding VAT, in line with the company's net sales definition
Refunds on web lines are attributed to the fulfilment type of the original order and to the period of the return date, including refunds made at physical stores for web purchases
Staff purchases are excluded from the question's scope by construction (there are none on web lines)
caveats: Channel coding changed at the web-platform migration on 3 November 2025 (fiscal period 8): before it, web lines have channel_code WB and a NULL channel_id; after it, channel_code is NULL and channel_id is 2 (home delivery) or 3 (click and collect). Filtering on either field alone would drop or mix part of period 8 and miss click-and-collect before the migration, so I classified every line through fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, which is populated throughout.

Web returns are booked at various store_keys, not only the web shop; 343 click-and-collect and 913 home-delivery refund lines are at store 900, and many more at physical stores. I joined refunds to the original sales line instead of filtering returns by store, so none are lost.
Click-and-collect share before returns would be slightly different (27.65, 26.63 and 26.56 percent for periods 6, 7 and 8); the requested net-of-returns figures are 27.26, 26.03 and 26.39.

Checks run in the window found no duplicate receipt lines, no lines on cancelled orders, no zero or negative lines, and order totals matching their line totals. Cancelled orders (136 click-and-collect, 361 home delivery in the window) carry no sales lines, so they do not affect the shares.
Period 6 is a 5-week period and periods 7 and 8 are 4 weeks, so absolute amounts are not comparable across the three periods, but the shares are.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales / all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns, with returns netted on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, not channel columns (the 3 Nov 2025 platform migration broke channel_code)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders have dispatch dates and sales)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar periods from dim_date (FY2025/26 P09 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026; P10 = 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026)
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated, stg_, bak_ or tmp_ objects
assumptions: Read 'last year' as FY2025/26. The request was received on 6 Oct 2026, during FY2026/27, and accepted past requests made in FY2026/27 read 'last year' as FY2025/26.
Read 'periods 9 and 10' as fiscal periods P09 and P10 of that year, and gave one share per period, since the request names two periods and does not ask for a combined figure.
Read 'web sales' as web net sales on the company definition (excluding VAT, after returns) and not as order counts.
Booked returns to the fulfilment type of the original order, so refunds reduce the click-and-collect or home-delivery side that the sale belonged to.
Used current-version product category for the ZZ Test exclusion; this has no effect on the result because test articles are excluded either way.
caveats: The result reconciles exactly to the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for store 900 (web): P09 net web sales 200,208.58 EUR and P10 123,131.15 EUR, with a gap of 0.00 in both periods.

Underlying amounts: P09 click-and-collect net 58,536.07 EUR of 200,208.58 EUR web net; P10 click-and-collect net 37,861.39 EUR of 123,131.15 EUR web net. For both periods combined the share is about 29.8%.

Both periods fall across the 3 Nov 2025 web platform migration only in the sense that they come after it. channel_code is not filled in them, so a query built on channel_code or on rpt.v_daily_sales would have left web sales out. This query avoids both.
No duplicate keys were found in fact_web_order, fact_sales_line or fact_return_line.

Refunds on web orders are netted on their own return date, so these period figures include returns of sales made earlier, and returns of sales made late in P10 may still arrive after the period ends. The shares are based on the data loaded to 4 Oct 2026.
Both periods are fully loaded and fall wholly within the data, and neither includes week 53, which sits in P12.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'), per_cat AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS growth_pct FROM per_cat ty JOIN per_cat ly ON ly.category=ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND ty.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their return date (refund_net)
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date; cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: period 8 is a 4-week period (weeks 31 to 34), FY2025/26 from 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025, FY2024/25 from 25 Nov to 22 Dec 2024
Same-period comparison by fiscal period number, not calendar dates
Category as-is: current product version (dim_product joined on sku and is_current)
Outdoor lighting counted in Electrical for all history
Web shop (store 900) included, since the request is not limited to physical stores
Control total: store-level net sales for P8 in both years agree with rpt_daily_store_sales, with no differences above 0.50 EUR
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25. The request came in on 5 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and earlier requests asked in May 2026 also took FY2025/26.
Growth is FY2025/26 P8 against FY2024/25 P8, in percent.
The request does not say as-is or as-was, so the company default (as-is) was used.
Web and store sales are both included, as the request names no channel.
Net sales are excluding VAT, the company default.
Returns are booked on their return date, so a P8 return of an earlier sale lowers P8 net sales.
caveats: Correction: five outdoor lighting articles (SKUs 100870, 100877, 100879, 100916 and 100917) were delisted between February and September 2025, before or around the 27 October 2025 move to Electrical. Their only dim_product version still says Garden, although the company rule puts outdoor lighting in Electrical for all history. I counted them in Electrical (anything with subcategory 'Outdoor Lighting'). This moves 828.53 EUR of FY2024/25 P8 net sales from Garden to Electrical. They had no net sales in FY2025/26 P8. Without the correction, Electrical would be 162,418.96 and 171,210.97 (growth 5.41%), and Garden 36,765.02 and 36,813.07 (growth 0.13%). Garden growth is therefore very sensitive to this fix.
The two periods are comparable: both have four whole fiscal weeks (31 to 34), and week 53 is in P12 so it does not affect them.
The data checks found no duplicate sales or return lines in either period, and no web lines without a dispatch date.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales covers the whole company by store, not the category subset, and it matched. The category figures themselves have no separate control.
Returns from later sales are not netted back to the sale week here, because net sales is by return date. The sale-week return rate would be a different figure.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only; cancelled and processing orders excluded)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal calendar: period 2 is fiscal weeks 5 to 8; prior year lined up by fiscal week number, not by calendar date
Control total: weekly result matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for all eight weeks
Growth % = this year divided by last year, minus 1, in percent
assumptions: Period 2 this year is read as FY2026/27 P2 (1 June to 28 June 2026), fully loaded in the warehouse
Last year is read as FY2025/26 P2 (26 May to 22 June 2025), the same fiscal weeks 5 to 8
Total company means all stores plus web, with web included as part of the total and not shown as a separate line
Net sales on the company definition, excluding VAT, since no other basis was requested
Week 53 is not involved (FY2025/26 week 53 falls in P12)
Growth is shown per week and rounded to one decimal; no period total row was added because only the four weekly figures were asked for
caveats: Midsummer sits in different fiscal weeks in the two years: this year it is in week 7 (Midsummer Eve 19 June 2026, Midsummer Day 20 June 2026), last year in week 8 (20 and 21 June 2025). The stores were shut on those two days each year, so week 7 growth (-32.2%) is pushed down and week 8 growth (+76.4%) is pushed up by the holiday timing, not by trading. Read weeks 7 and 8 together: combined this year was 591,343.83 against 535,679.88 last year, +10.4%.
Over the whole of P2, net sales were 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70 last year, +8.3% (calculated from the four weeks above, not given as a table row).

Kuopio (store 125) was closed for a refit from 15 June 2026, which covers weeks 7 and 8 this year, and Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026 and so trades in neither of this year's P2 weeks. Both stores are in last year's trading, so total company growth is held back slightly. Neither is removed, because the request is for total company sales and not like-for-like.

Web net sales grew strongly (weeks 5 to 8: 52,105 / 60,692 / 44,949 / 72,985 this year against 40,688 / 35,417 / 44,352 / 30,548 last year) and account for much of the growth in the weeks without a holiday. Web order counts support this (3,423 delivered or collected orders in the comparable window last year, 4,456 this year).

Checks found no data problem: no duplicate sales lines on receipt_id and line_no or sales_line_id in the relevant dates, every web sales line has a web order row, and the result agrees with the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for each week.
rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used because they omit web sales from 3 November 2025.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(l.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_incl_vat FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 3
