answer.sql: WITH sl AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY cs.store_id, cs.store_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Store-level analysis covers physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) excluded
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded

Store names and IDs from the current dim_store version (as-is)

assumptions: 'Biggest' is read as highest net sales, the company's measure of store size in its league table. It is not read as floor area (sqm). Ranked by sqm the list would differ: Pitäjänmäki 8,381, Kupittaa 7,844, Kuopio 7,814, Tammisto 7,732, Kaakkuri 7,613, Lahti 7,036, Lielahti 6,761, Hervanta 6,705, Kaleva 4,518 and Seinäjoki 4,199 or Lommila 4,827 (Lommila is 10th by sqm after Kaleva 4,518 is passed over for the larger Lommila and Kouvola 4,676, Mikkeli 4,179 and Lappeenranta 4,738), so sqm would need a separate request.

No period was given. I used the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (53 weeks, 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026), as the most recent full year, so refits and part-years do not distort the ranking. FY2026/27 is only 22 weeks old and Kuopio is in the middle of a refit closure.
Ranked by total net sales for the year, not by net sales per trading day.
Stores are shown under their current names and as-is hierarchy; region is not part of the answer.
caveats: Data problem corrected: fact_sales_line holds 418 duplicated lines (same receipt_id and line_no loaded twice, 16 Sep 2025 and 23 Sep 2025 loads), all in the week of 15 to 21 September 2025 at store 116 Tampere Lielahti. I kept the first load of each line. The deduplicated store totals match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly; counting the duplicates would have overstated Lielahti's net sales.

Results are sensitive to the ranking basis for 10th place only. Ranked on net sales per trading day, Pori (119) would take 10th place (about 1,188 per day) ahead of Nokia (about 1,157 per day), because Pori was shut for a 5-week refit in September and October 2025. The first nine stores are the same under both measures and in the same order apart from minor swaps: Oulu Kaakkuri, Lahti, Turku Kupittaa and Vantaa Tammisto keep their places 3 to 6, and Kuopio, Tampere Lielahti and Tampere Kaleva keep 7 to 9.
The year includes fiscal week 53 (27 April to 3 May 2026) because there is no year-on-year comparison in this request.

The ranking is for FY2025/26, not the current year to date. On FY2026/27 to 4 October 2026, Lahti and Oulu Kaakkuri swap places and Kuopio drops out of the top 10 during its 6-week refit (15 June to 26 July 2026). If Leena meant the current year, or a different period, the list should be re-run.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts, less returns
Returns booked on their return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
As-was category hierarchy: category taken from the product version on the fact line
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included in company net sales
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 (4-4-5 pattern, 52-week year, no week 53)
assumptions: Read 'the old way, Garden as it was reported at the time (the old category set-up)' as an as-was request. Garden therefore includes the Outdoor Lighting subcategory, which sat in Garden until it moved to Electrical on 27 October 2025.
Read 'P7 to P12 of FY24/25' as fiscal_year FY2024/25, 29 April 2024 to 27 April 2025. P7 to P12 is the second half of the year.
Included web sales and web returns (store 900), since the request asks for Garden net sales without limiting it to physical stores.
One row per period, with no total row, because none was requested.
caveats: These figures are as-was. On the current (as-is) category set-up, where Outdoor Lighting counts as Electrical for all history, Garden would be lower: P7 37,069.41, P8 36,765.02, P9 47,385.02, P10 50,146.62, P11 100,509.14, P12 297,616.35. Use the as-is figures if you need a like-for-like comparison with Garden from FY2025/26 onwards.
The as-was Garden figure for FY2024/25 will not match current Garden reporting. It does match how Garden was reported at the time, which is what was asked for.
Garden is strongly seasonal. P12 (spring) is about five times P7 to P10.

Corrections made: store 999 and ZZ Test removed (the training store holds no FY2024/25 Garden sales, so no change to the Garden figures); web dated on the Helsinki dispatch date and not the order date.
I found duplicated sales lines (836 lines, same receipt and line number loaded twice) for store key 22 on 15 to 21 September 2025. They fall in FY2025/26, so they do not affect this answer.

Control check: total company net sales for P7 to P12 (all categories) matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly in every period (difference 0.00). The control table has no category split, so the Garden split itself could not be checked against it.
The data is complete for FY2024/25. No cancelled or processing web orders exist in that year, so none had to be excluded.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar fc ON f.sale_date >= fc.period_start_date AND f.sale_date <= fc.period_end_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND fc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fc.fiscal_period = 3 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
definitions_applied: Interior Paint: products in Paint & Decorating category with subcategory Interior Paint
Lahti store: store_id 108
Period 3 of FY2026/27: fiscal period 3 in fiscal year FY2026/27 (2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02)
Units sold: quantity field from fact_sales_line, excluding returns
assumptions: Interior Paint refers to the subcategory Interior Paint, not a specific product name
Request asks for units sold (not units returned or net units), so all positive quantities in fact_sales_line are included
Date range is applied via fiscal calendar reference, covering the full fiscal period regardless of calendar dates

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 3 is 29 June 2026 to 2 August 2026 (ref_fiscal_calendar, fully loaded, 5 weeks)
Units sold = sum of quantity on sales lines, by Helsinki sale_date
Store identified by stable store_id (108) via the store_key on the sales line
Product scope by sku with the current product version (as-is): subcategory Interior Paint, category Paint & Decorating
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (the filter changes nothing here)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales and units sold
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Lahti' means store 108 (city Lahti, region South); Tampere Lielahti (store 116) is a different store whose name only partly matches
'Units sold' is gross units on sales lines before returns; returned units are not subtracted
'Period 3 of FY26/27' means fiscal year FY2026/27 period 3, 29 June to 2 August 2026
'Interior Paint' means the subcategory of that name in Paint & Decorating
Staff purchases are included (4 of the 194 units)
caveats: No data problems needed correcting for this request. There were no duplicate sales lines, no web lines, no test articles and no store closures or non-trading days for Lahti in the period.

The Lahti store's all-product units for the period (3,927 units over 1,048 receipts, 35 days) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. That control table has no product dimension, so it checks the store and period, not the Interior Paint share.
Two Interior Paint SKUs (100963, 101047) have two product versions; both versions carry the Interior Paint subcategory, so the as-is and as-was readings are the same.
The figure is gross of returns. Units returned in the period are not netted off; tell me if you want the net-of-returns count.

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2024-09-01' THEN f.gross_amount END), 2) AS aug_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' THEN f.gross_amount END), 2) AS sep_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales = fact_sales_line.gross_amount (EUR including VAT), before returns (fact_return_line not used)
Region as at the time of sale: the store version in fact_sales_line.store_key, not the current dim_store row
Calendar months, with sale_date as the date of sale
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own region 'Online', as in rpt.v_daily_sales
Staff purchases kept in, since they are taxable sales
assumptions: 'August and September 2024' means calendar months 1-31 August and 1-30 September, not fiscal periods.

'Regions as they were at the time' means the region on the store version valid on the sale date. In 2024 the five Capital Region stores (101-105) were still in South, and Kouvola (114) was in East. These changed on 2025-04-28.
Web sales have no geographic region in the warehouse, so they are reported as a separate 'Online' row. The VAT filing needs them, and the old reports kept web separate from the store regions.
Staff purchases are included in gross sales because VAT applies to them. They are not separately identifiable in the answer table.
Gross sales are taken as stored in gross_amount. I checked every line: gross equals net times (1 + VAT rate) to within 2 cents.
caveats: Correction: I excluded the 'Training store' (store 999, region 'Head office'), which is a non-trading test location. It has 283 lines worth EUR 7,633.94 gross (August 4,282.23, September 3,351.71), and 217 of them are flagged as staff purchases. The warehouse total for the two months is EUR 2,916,434.09. The table sums to EUR 2,908,800.15, which is that total less the training store.
Using current store regions would give a different split. Stores 101-105 would show as 'Capital Region' and Kouvola would move from East to South. I did not do this, as requested.

Finnish VAT rates changed on 2024-09-01, from 24% to 25.5%. The August lines carry 24% and the September lines carry 25.5%, as the law requires. The rates are applied correctly in the data, so I made no adjustment. Reduced-rate lines (14% and 10%) run through both months.
Tampere Lamminpää (136, West) opened on 2024-09-02, so it contributes to September only.
Vantaa Tammisto (104) was closed for a refit from 2024-07-08 to 2024-08-11 and has no sales in that window. This is expected and nothing was imputed. There are no sales on non-trading days.

I found no duplicate sales lines or orphaned store keys, and no sale_date values that disagree with Helsinki local time. Web order timestamps are in UTC, but sale_date is already the local date, so month boundaries are right.

The online figures use the web lines in fact_sales_line, which are the same lines rpt.v_daily_sales counts as WB. Web orders that were cancelled are not separately excluded because fact_sales_line holds only the lines as booked. Check this with Finance if cancelled orders should come out.

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount - f.standard_cost AS margin FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South' AND s.store_id < 900 UNION ALL SELECT p.sku, -(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South' AND s.store_id < 900) SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_quarter, l.sku, (SELECT max(product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = l.sku) AS product_name, round(sum(l.margin), 2) AS gross_margin_eur FROM lines l GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Fiscal Q4 of FY2024/25 = fiscal periods 10 to 12, 2025-01-27 to 2025-04-27 (ref_fiscal_calendar and dim_date agree; 13 weeks, fully loaded)
Gross margin = net sales excluding VAT (net_amount) minus standard cost (standard_cost), in EUR
Margin is net of returns: refund_net minus standard_cost_returned is deducted, with returns counted on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Region taken from the store version in force on the sale or return date (fact store_key joined to dim_store), not from the current store record
Products grouped by sku (stable article number) rather than product_key, so versions of one article are combined
Physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop 900 and the training store 999 are excluded
assumptions: Gross margin is read as an absolute EUR amount, not a percentage

'South region' is read as the South region as it was during Q4 FY2024/25. Stores 101-105 (Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kerava area) were in South until 2025-04-27 and moved to Capital Region on 2025-04-28, and Kouvola (114) was in East then and joined South on 2025-04-28. The South stores in the period are therefore 101-113 and 137 (Lohja). Under today's region map the ranking would change a lot (for example rank 7 to 10 become Cookware Nordhem 469, Power Tools Havu Pro 689, Indoor Lighting Havu 419 and Smart Home Tuulikki 855, and every margin is lower). Say if you want the current map instead

Staff purchases are kept in, matching how rpt_daily_store_sales reports net sales. Excluding them gives the same top 10 in nearly the same order, with margins lower by up to about 80 EUR per product (the small difference is that rows 9 and 10 stay in place, and the ranking beyond 10 swaps ranks 11 and 12)
Web orders are not attributed to South, because web lines sit on the web-shop pseudo-store 900 (region Online), including click-and-collect orders
Product name is the article description (identical across the versions of each sku)
caveats: Region history: the 2025-04-28 regional reorganisation means 'South' differs between the period and today. This answer uses the period's structure. The current South structure gives a different top 10
The training store 999 (Head office), which holds sales in the period, was excluded because it is not a trading store
Staff-purchase lines (about 1 to 2 percent of lines) were left in. They are sold at a discount, so margins are slightly lower than they would be without them. The top 10 is unaffected

Checks done with no problems found: no duplicate sales or return line IDs in the period, no staged rows (stg_) overlapping the period, every return maps to a sales line, refund amounts and standard costs reconcile to the sales lines and to dim_product, sale_date matches Helsinki local date, and my sales totals for stores 101, 106 and 108 match rpt_daily_store_sales before returns
Old, backup and staging tables (bak_, dim_*_old, stg_, tmp_) were not used

Returns are booked on the return date, so some refunds deducted in Q4 relate to sales made before 27 January 2025 (about 94 of 1,528 South return lines), and some Q4 sales may be returned after the quarter ends. This is the same cut-off the daily sales report uses

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
definitions_applied: Closing stock: snapshot of units at the end of a fiscal week, from fact_stock_week
Fiscal calendar: weeks run Monday to Sunday, stock counted on the week-ending Sunday
Last completed fiscal week: FY2026/27 week 22 (28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026), the last week loaded
Store identified by stable store_id 124 and article by stable sku 100011, joined through the version keys
Physical store only, no web stock
assumptions: Request received Thursday 8 Oct 2026, so 'last week' is the last completed fiscal week, week 22 of FY2026/27, ending Sunday 4 Oct 2026. The current week (5 to 11 Oct) is not complete and not loaded.
'SKU 100011 Jyväskylä Palokka' means SKU 100011 (Plants & Flowers Kuusela 570, Garden) at store 124 Jyväskylä Palokka.
Units are the closing_units figure for the week-ending snapshot, not an average over the week.
caveats: No data problems found. Store 124 and SKU 100011 each have a single version, and the snapshot has exactly one row for this store, article and week.
Stock roll-forward checks out: 13 units at 27 Sep, 2 units sold in week 21 (21 and 24 Sep, store sales lines), none in week 22, no receipts or adjustments, so 11 units at 4 Oct.
Stock is the same 11 units at 27 Sep and 4 Oct because nothing sold or was received in week 22.

answer.sql: WITH wo AS (SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_net AS (SELECT wo.dispatch_date AS business_date, wo.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, wo.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN w.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_net w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns; returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (click-and-collect: the ready-for-collection date), not on the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code or channel_id
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods from dim_date (fiscal_year and fiscal_period columns)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year that just ended on 3 May 2026. The request was made on 6 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and the history shows 'last year' taken as the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26 in the May 2026 requests REQ-D04, D08, D28 and D35. Periods 9 and 10 of FY2025/26 run 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026 (5 weeks) and 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026 (4 weeks).
One share per period, since the request names two periods and gives no sign that a single combined figure was wanted. The share is not combined across the two periods.
'Web sales' read as net sales on the company definition, meaning after returns. The before-returns shares are 28.95% for P9 and 30.62% for P10.

Refunds are counted as web sales only when booked to the web shop (store 900), as the company definition and rpt_daily_store_sales do. Each refund is assigned to click-and-collect or home delivery by the type of the original order, found through sales_line_id.
caveats: Correction: the channel_id on the sales lines is wrong for part of the period. Click-and-collect lines with sale dates from 12 Jan to 8 Feb 2026 (1,473 lines in my check) carry channel_id 2 (web home delivery) instead of 3. channel_code is empty after the 3 Nov 2025 migration. I did not use either column. I took click-and-collect from fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, so the shares are unaffected. A channel_id-based query would understate click-and-collect for those weeks.

Correction: web sales are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order, not on sale_date, which is the order date on web lines. Cancelled orders (99 click-and-collect and 261 home-delivery orders in the nearby window) have no lines and are not counted.

Excluded: web orders returned in a physical store are booked to that store and are not in the web figures. For P9 this is 1,100.14 EUR of click-and-collect and 4,657.68 EUR of home-delivery refunds. For P10 it is 1,655.62 EUR and 3,356.20 EUR. If refunds followed the original order, the shares would be about 28.9% for P9 and 30.2% for P10, as I estimated from the refund amounts and did not run as a query.

Control total: my web net sales agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900. P9 is 200,208.58 net, from 219,929.50 before returns less 19,720.92 returns. P10 is 123,131.15 net, from 137,569.07 before returns less 14,437.92 returns.
Dates: P9 and P10 are fully loaded in the warehouse, and the window does not run past 4 Oct 2026.

Web returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, so later returns on orders from the end of P10 may still be booked in P11 and move that period's figures. The P9 and P10 figures here count only returns booked on dates within the two periods.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), by_category AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.category, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM by_category ty JOIN by_category ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') ORDER BY ty.category
definitions_applied: Net sales = net_amount excluding VAT, after returns; returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered/collected orders only); web shop (store 900) included as part of company net sales
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
As-is reporting: category taken from the current product version (dim_product on sku and is_current); outdoor lighting counted in Electrical for all history
Fiscal calendar via dim_date: period 8 = weeks 31 to 34 (FY2025/26: 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025; FY2024/25: 25 Nov to 22 Dec 2024), 4 weeks each, fully loaded
Did not use deprecated tables, rpt.v_daily_sales, or channel_code
assumptions: Request received 5 Oct 2026 in FY2026/27. 'Last year' is read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25, consistent with past readings in FY2026/27 (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). Period 8 of FY2025/26 does not include week 53.
Growth is FY2025/26 P8 against FY2024/25 P8, aligned on period number and fiscal week, not calendar dates.
Net sales cover all channels (stores plus the web shop), since no store-level or channel scope was requested.
Reported as-is (current category hierarchy), as management reporting does by default; no as-was figures were requested.
One row per category, no total row, since none was asked for.
caveats: Correction: five delisted outdoor lighting articles (skus 100870, 100877, 100879, 100916, 100917) have only a Garden version in dim_product and no Electrical version, because they were delisted before the 27 Oct 2025 recategorisation. A plain join on the current product version would leave them in Garden. I moved them to Electrical by subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting', as required by the as-is rule. This moved 828.53 EUR from Garden to Electrical in FY2024/25 P8. The unadjusted figures would have been Garden 36,765.02 and Electrical 162,418.96 for FY2024/25, giving Garden growth of 0.1% and Electrical growth of 5.4%.

Using as-was categories (the hierarchy on the sale date) would give very different numbers. Outdoor lighting was in Garden before 27 Oct 2025, so FY2024/25 P8 would have about 19.5k EUR more in Garden and less in Electrical, and the growth rates would change sharply. This answer is as-is only.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales was not run because this is a category subset, to which the check does not apply.

Checks run on the source rows for both periods: no duplicate sales lines, return lines, web orders or current product versions; no orphan product keys; every web line belongs to a delivered or collected order. Both periods are fully loaded.

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week = 22 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name
definitions_applied: Fiscal week, Monday to Sunday, from dim_date
Units sold as the quantity on sales lines, by Helsinki sale_date (metric dictionary wording used for weeks of cover)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (no effect on this figure)
Physical store only (store_id below 900); web shop store 900 not included
Staff purchases included (none in this case)
Versioned dimensions: store and product matched on their natural keys store_id 131 and sku 101624
Control check: store 131 receipts and units per day agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for 28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026
assumptions: "Oulu Kaakkuri" is the store (store_id 131, Oulu, North, Large format). SKU 101624 is Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251, so the name does not belong to the product.
"Last week" is the last completed fiscal week as of the request date, Thursday 8 October 2026. That is FY2026/27 week 22 (in P6), Monday 28 September to Sunday 4 October 2026, fully loaded.
"Units sold" is the quantity on sales lines, before returns. No company metric defines net units, and none of the 8 lines in this window has a return recorded against it.
The answer is for the Kaakkuri store only. Web or click-and-collect orders for this SKU are not counted, because web lines are booked to the web shop (store 900).
caveats: No data problems found: no duplicate sales lines, no returns on these lines, and the Helsinki date matches the UTC timestamp on every line.

Sales came on six of the seven days, with none on Wednesday 30 September (a normal trading day). Friday 2 October had 9 units from two receipts of 4 and 5 units; Monday 28, Thursday 1 and Saturday 3 Oct each had 1 or 2.

The sales lines have channel_code NULL and channel_id 1. This is the expected effect of the November 2025 web-platform migration and does not affect the figure, which is filtered on the store and not on the channel.

answer.sql: SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%B %Y') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', f.sale_date)
definitions_applied: Sales including VAT = sum of gross_amount on the sales lines, each line at its own VAT rate
Before returns: no refunds deducted
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded

364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - Closed store (Savonlinna, 129) drops out
Week 53 never LFL (not in range)

38 of the 39 physical stores are in the base, each for all 4 weeks (152 store-weeks per year). Tampere Lamminpää (136, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, opened 4 Nov 2024) both qualify under the 364-day rule.

The Lohja and Tampere opening dates in dim_store (2024) differ from the dates in the lfl-and-store-league skill text (1 Sep 2025 and 3 Nov 2025). I used the dim_store dates, and both stores qualify under the 364-day rule either way.

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.format,

INNER JOIN dim_store s ON ps.store_key = s.store_key

Store format from dim_store current version

Staff purchases and all sales channels included

One transaction = one receipt_id; multiple lines on a receipt are summed for that transaction's value
All receipts weighted equally in average calculation, regardless of format or line count
Returns are excluded (processed through fact_return_line table, not affecting sales table figures)
Web format (store_id 900) treated as a store format equivalent to physical retail locations
caveats: Store format mismatch: schema documentation states formats are 'Hyper, Standard or Express' but actual data contains Large, Medium, Small, Training, and Web. This indicates the data schema documentation is outdated.
Channel code data quality: all channel_code values are NULL for period 4; schema specifies these should be 'ST' (store) or 'WB' (web). Unable to separately analyze by sales channel.
Training format has very low transaction volume (55 receipts) and may not be representative of operational patterns.
Web format (online channel) has distinct characteristics: 3,229 receipts with higher average basket value (64.76) than physical Large/Medium formats, suggesting different customer behaviour.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Fiscal weeks run Monday to Sunday, compared with the same fiscal week number last year (not calendar dates)
Growth % = (this year / last year - 1) x 100
UTC timestamps converted to Helsinki dates
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, channel_code, bak_/stg_/tmp_ tables) not used
assumptions: Request received 7 Oct 2026, so 'period 2 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P2 (fiscal weeks 5 to 8, 1 to 28 June 2026), which is complete in the warehouse. The warehouse is loaded through 4 Oct 2026.
'Same weeks last year' is read as the same fiscal weeks 5 to 8 of FY2025/26 (26 May to 22 June 2025), lined up by fiscal week number. Last year means the fiscal year before FY2026/27.
Total company includes the web shop (store 900), as in past total-company requests.
No week 53 is involved: P2 has four weeks in both years.
Figures are as reported, with no adjustment for store openings, closures or refits, because the request is total company net sales, not like-for-like.
caveats: No errors or corrections were needed in the P2 data. Totals match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for every week in both years. Web lines all belong to delivered or collected orders, and there are no duplicate sales or return lines in the P2 range.

Midsummer moves between fiscal weeks, which causes the large swings in weeks 7 and 8. Midsummer Eve and Day (stores shut by law) fell on 20 and 21 June 2025, in last year's week 8, and on 19 and 20 June 2026, in this year's week 7. Week 7 this year is therefore -32.2% and week 8 is +76.4% against weeks with the closure on the other side. These two weeks are not comparable on trading days. Weeks 5 and 6 (+3.1%, +10.0%) and the period as a whole are the cleaner read. The period total is 1,294,647.64 this year against 1,195,882.70 last year, +8.3%.

The store base differs between the years. Savonlinna traded in last year's P2 (about 9.7k net sales) but closed on 25 Jan 2026, so it contributes nothing this year. Kuopio is shut for a refit from 15 June 2026 to 26 July 2026, so it is missing from this year's weeks 7 and 8 (about 24k net sales in this year's weeks 5 and 6, 39k in last year's four weeks). The web shop is up from about 151k to 231k across the period. Growth is therefore not like-for-like.

Duplicate sales lines exist in the warehouse for September 2025 (418 repeated receipt_id and line_no pairs, from a reload on 23 Sep 2025), outside this request's period, so they do not affect these figures. Anyone using September 2025 should deduplicate.

answer.sql: WITH act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), tier AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m WHERE m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21') SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, t.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members FROM act a JOIN tier t ON t.member_id = a.member_id GROUP BY t.tier ORDER BY CASE t.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

answer.sql: WITH camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15), holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), spend AS (SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS spend FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id CROSS JOIN camp c WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend,0)) a, count(*) n FROM targeted g LEFT JOIN spend sp ON sp.member_id = g.member_id), h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend,0)) a, count(*) n FROM holdout g LEFT JOIN spend sp ON sp.member_id = g.member_id) SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, t.n AS targeted_members, h.n AS holdout_members, ROUND(t.a,2) AS avg_spend_targeted, ROUND(h.a,2) AS avg_spend_holdout, ROUND(t.a - h.a,2) AS uplift_eur FROM t, h

Campaign window plus seven days (24 Nov to 7 Dec 2025)
Targeted member: at least one exposure row, reduced to distinct member_id through dim_member
Holdout from campaign_holdout by member_id
Net sales before returns, on lines linked to the member
Members with no sales counted as zero
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date; cancelled and processing orders have no lines
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included

assumptions: 'Black Week 2025' is campaign_id 15 in dim_campaign (24 to 30 Nov 2025, email+sms+push, all members with marketing consent). The 2024 edition (campaign 5) was not used.
Spend means net sales excluding VAT before returns, as the campaign uplift definition says, not gross sales and not after refunds.
The window is the campaign window plus seven days, so 24 Nov to 7 Dec 2025 inclusive, Helsinki dates.
A targeted member has at least one exposure row, whether or not the contact was delivered or opened (the definition does not require delivery).
Amounts are rounded to 2 decimals. The uplift is the difference of the unrounded means, which is 1.41.
caveats: No corrections to the data were needed. Targeted and holdout counts reconcile with no overlap, every exposure row maps to a member version with marketing consent on the contact date, and the sales lines in the window have no duplicate grain.

Spend counts only purchases made as a member in the window (3,279 of 23,818 targeted and 323 of 2,747 held-out members bought). Purchases made without a loyalty card are not attributable to any group.
The uplift is small, about 1.41 euros per member (about 18% above the holdout average). With only 323 buyers in the holdout, it has not been tested for statistical significance.
Dating web lines on the dispatch date moves some orders. Orders placed in the window but dispatched after 7 Dec are excluded, and orders placed earlier but dispatched in the window are included.

The campaign record gives a mailing list of 26,573 and holdout of 2,747. The exposure table has 23,818 distinct targeted members, so 23,818 + 2,747 = 26,565, 8 short of the list size. The holdout is also about 10.3% of the list, not exactly 10%. I used the exposure and holdout tables as the group definitions and did not investigate the 8 further.
The control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply to a member subset, so it was not run.

364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT '2026-02-23'::DATE AS start_date, '2026-03-22'::DATE AS end_date
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category,
           SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND cs.region = 'West'
      AND cs.store_id < 900 
      AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_closing_value_eur
FROM weekly
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Stock semi-additivity: add across stores and products, never across weeks
Stock snapshot at week-ending Sunday (fiscal week)
Physical stores only (store_id < 900)
Exclude ZZ Test category products
Current dimensions: as-is store region and product category
assumptions: Period 11 last year = FY2025/26 P11 (fiscal weeks 44–47, 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-22)
West region = current West region (as-is reporting, after April 2025 reorganisation)

caveats: Stock is counted only on week-ending Sundays; intermediate-day values are not available
This covers only articles stocked by physical stores in the West region; web orders are picked from a central warehouse not included here
All 10 categories with stock in the West region in this period are shown; no categories had zero stock

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
regional_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank, region, ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM regional_sales
ORDER BY rank;

Warehouse loaded through 2026-10-04 (FY2026/27 week 22), covering 22 whole or partial fiscal weeks of the current fiscal year.

answer.sql: WITH targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), member_lines AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_spend_eur FROM member_lines l JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = l.member_id

The spend window is 4 to 24 May 2026 inclusive, exactly as asked, which is the campaign window itself. I did not add the seven extra days that the campaign uplift definition uses, because the request gave explicit dates and did not ask for uplift

The figures match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly in every period, both before returns and after returns.

Some refunds on web-order lines (about 111 to 144 lines, EUR 4.5k to 5.5k net per period) were processed in physical stores and are booked to those stores, not the web shop. They are not deducted from web net sales, in line with the company definition and the control table. Deducting them would lower web net sales by roughly 3% in each period.
Net sales are after returns, so each period's figure is reduced by returns booked in that period, including returns on sales made in earlier periods.
Period 6 is 5 weeks long; P5, P7 and P8 are 4 weeks each, so P6 is not directly comparable by size. Week 53 of FY2025/26 is in P12 and not in the range.

Excluded cancelled orders (about 881 between Aug 2025 and Jan 2026) have no sales lines, so they do not affect the totals. Orders placed in the last days of a period but dispatched in the next count in the next period.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.sales_line_id) AS copy_no FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE copy_no = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) <= 10 ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their own return date
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 and training store 999 left out
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 runs 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026 (53 weeks)
Versioned dimensions: counted by store_id, names from the current dim_store version
Control total: store totals checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
Deprecated objects avoided (no rpt.v_daily_sales, stg_, bak_, tmp_ or old dim tables)
assumptions: 'Biggest' is read as highest total net sales, because the company defines store size by sales (net sales and the league table), not floor area. It is not read as sales area in sqm.

No period was given, so I used the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 Apr 2025 to 3 May 2026), including week 53. Past requests read 'last year' the same way. The warehouse is loaded to 4 Oct 2026, and FY2026/27 is only 22 weeks old.
Ranked on total net sales, not net sales per trading day (the league-table measure), because 'biggest' asks about size.
Net sales are shown in EUR excluding VAT, rounded to cents.
Store names are the current ones. Region does not affect the ranking.
caveats: Correction: store 116 Tampere Lielahti had 418 sales lines loaded twice (an identical second copy loaded 23 Sep 2025, for sales dates 15 to 21 Sep 2025), which added EUR 10,390.53 of net sales. I kept the first copy of each receipt line. After that, store 116 (EUR 506,894.85) matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. Without the fix it would show EUR 517,285.38 and rank 7th, ahead of Kuopio. With the fix it ranks 8th.
The other 38 physical stores match rpt_daily_store_sales to the cent, and the top 10 store set does not change with the duplicate fix.
Excluded as not a store: the web shop (store 900) and the training store (999). The web shop would otherwise appear in a total-company ranking.

The top 10 are the same stores if the period is the trailing 52 complete weeks to 4 Oct 2026. Some ranks shift by one or two places. Over the current year to date (4 May to 4 Oct 2026) Kuopio drops to 14th because its refit closed it 15 June to 26 July 2026, and Pori enters the top 10.

Pori (119) had a 5-week refit closure (8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025) in FY2025/26 and ranks 15th on total sales (EUR 384,978.00). Adjusted for its weeks closed it would rank roughly level with Nokia in 10th place. Ranked on net sales per trading day, the 10th place would likely go to Pori rather than Nokia.

If 'biggest' meant sales area, the ranking is different: Helsinki Pitäjänmäki (8,381 sqm), Turku Kupittaa, Kuopio, Vantaa Tammisto, Oulu Kaakkuri, Lahti, Tampere Lielahti, Tampere Hervanta, Espoo Lommila and Lappeenranta. Say so if that is what you wanted.

The dim_store.format column comment is out of date. Actual formats are Large, Medium and Small (plus Web and Training). The top 8 stores by sales are all Large format, while Tampere Kaleva and Nokia are Medium.

answer.sql:
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.net_amount) DESC) AS rank,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date >= DATE '2025-05-26'
  AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2025-06-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales: fact_sales_line.net_amount (excluding VAT, after line discounts)
Physical stores only: store_id < 900 (excludes web orders and pseudo-locations)
Period 2 FY2025/26: fiscal period 2 of 2025/26 fiscal year (2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22)
Receipts: distinct receipt_id per store per period
Units: sum of quantity across all line items per store
assumptions: League table ranking is by net sales (descending, highest first)
This year interpreted as fiscal year 2025/26 (current at 2026-10-15)
Period 2 refers to fiscal period 2 (not calendar month 2)
Staff purchases included in sales totals (staff_purchase_flag not filtered)
Web orders (channel_code = WB) excluded from store league; physical stores only
caveats: No planned store closures during the period
All 39 physical stores had sales activity; no stores with zero sales
Net sales in EUR, excluding VAT; receipts and units provided for context only

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 15 AS campaign_id
),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) AS mean_net_sales_per_member
FROM by_group
ORDER BY CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
definitions_applied: DEF-UPLIFT: Campaign uplift is mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member
REG-EXPOSURE-FANOUT: Distinct member_id from fact_campaign_exposure to prevent double-counting contacts
REG-MEMBER-VERSIONS: Member_id reconciled from fact_campaign_exposure member_key via dim_member
DEF-NET-SALES-SCOPE: Net sales before returns on member-linked lines; members with no sales count as zero
DEF-WEB-RECOGNITION: Web sales dated on dispatch date in Helsinki timezone
NET-SALES-EXCLUSIONS: Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
assumptions: Campaign window: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-07 (campaign end date plus seven days)
Uplift measured over the extended campaign window including the seven-day post-window period
Figures in EUR, rounded to two decimal places
Holdout members are members in campaign_holdout table; targeted members have at least one exposure row
caveats: No data issues identified; query-check validation passed

answer.sql: SELECT p.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY p.subcategory ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27 is 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, 4 weeks, fully loaded
Store identified by store_id 118 (Nokia), joined through store_key
Product subcategory taken from the product version in force at the sale (product_key)
Units sold = sum of fact_sales_line.quantity, before returns
Store channel only: web and click-and-collect lines sit on the web shop pseudo-store 900
Staff purchases included, as in the team's rpt_daily_store_sales (2,245 units matches the fact table)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, since the request is dated 2026-10-09 and period 5 has already ended
'Nokia' means the Nokia store (store_id 118); it is the only match in dim_store
'Units sold' is gross units sold, not net of returns
Subcategory is the grouping level, not category
Click-and-collect orders collected at Nokia are not counted, because they are booked to the web shop
caveats: No data problems affected this result: period 5 is fully loaded, all 28 days have sales, there are no duplicate sales lines, every line matches a product version, and no test articles were sold at Nokia

Third place is close. Storage Boxes has 139 units, against 136 for Plants & Flowers. Excluding the 34 staff-purchase units would leave Storage Boxes tied with Cleaning Products at 136, with Plants & Flowers at 134

Netting off returns would not change the first two places. Storage Boxes had 9 units returned at Nokia in the period, the most of any subcategory, and the rest of the ranking was not re-run net of returns
Subcategory names are stable across product versions. The outdoor lighting SKUs changed category from Garden to Electrical, which does not affect a subcategory ranking
dim_store lists Nokia's format as 'Medium', although the column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express; this is not used in the result

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines by sale date (metric dictionary wording used for weeks of cover)
Fiscal calendar: period 3 of FY2026/27 = weeks 9 to 13, 29 June to 2 August 2026 (5 weeks, complete)
Store scope: physical store 108 Lahti, by store_id across versions
As-is product hierarchy (current dim_product version) for the Interior Paint subcategory
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
sale_date used as the Helsinki business date
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (units_sold and receipts for store 108)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'period 3' means fiscal period 3 (29 June to 2 August 2026), which was complete when the request was received on 5 October 2026.
'Lahti store' means store 108 Lahti. The name match on 'Lahti' also returns Tampere Lielahti (116), which is a different store and was not included.
'Units sold' means units on sales lines, before returns. The metric dictionary defines no net-of-returns unit measure, and this is the same basis as the units_sold column in rpt_daily_store_sales.
'Interior Paint' is the product subcategory Interior Paint within Paint & Decorating.
caveats: No corrections to the data were needed. I found no duplicate sales lines (142 lines, all distinct). The daily units and receipts for Lahti match rpt_daily_store_sales on every day in the period. Lahti had no refit or closure. The two Interior Paint articles with more than one product version stayed in Interior Paint across versions.

The 194 units are before returns. Five units of Interior Paint were returned at Lahti in the same period, for refund_net EUR 178.11. They would give about 189 units net if you want units after returns.
The 194 includes 3 staff-purchase lines, because staff purchases count in sales.
The warehouse notes show the dim_store.region comment is out of date. This does not affect the answer, because the request is for a single store with no region split.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN params WHERE f.sale_date > params.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= params.as_of_end) SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN params JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND params.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with the as-of week and including it, in any channel
Distinct member_id count, never member_key
Trailing window: sale_date > as-of Sunday minus 364 days and <= as-of Sunday
Tier read from the member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Fiscal calendar: end of period 8 is the last day of FY2025/26 P08, Sunday 21 December 2025
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles are excluded from sales reporting (checked: excluding them leaves the count unchanged at 29,526)
assumptions: 'Last year' means FY2025/26, the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27, as in the accepted readings from May 2026. FY2025/26 P08 ran 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025.
'End of period 8' means the as-of date is the period's last day, Sunday 21 December 2025. The trailing window is therefore 22 December 2024 to 21 December 2025.
Tier is the tier on the as-of date, not the member's current tier.
Staff purchases count as purchases, in line with the net-sales definition.
Guest web orders have no member and so cannot count.
caveats: A member whose tier changed after 21 December 2025 appears under the tier they held on that date, not their current tier.

I checked for duplicate or overlapping dim_member versions, members who joined after the as-of date, and activity only in store 999 or ZZ Test articles. I found none, so no corrections were needed. The three tiers sum to 29,526 distinct active members.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, the stg_ or bak_ tables, or the old dimension tables.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales in LFL stores for the period vs the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
LFL base: physical stores only (store_id < 900), web shop excluded
Opening rule: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (4 May 2026)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure from ref_store_closure)
Week 53 never LFL (not relevant to P1)
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, returns booked on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: weeks aligned by fiscal week number (weeks 1-4 in each year), not by calendar date
Current dim_store version used for open/close dates (as-is)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales (physical stores, P1 of both years): no gaps
assumptions: 'Period 1 this year' read as FY2026/27 P1, fiscal weeks 1-4 (4 May to 31 May 2026), the current fiscal year as of the request date 9 October 2026
Comparator is FY2025/26 P1, weeks 1-4 (28 April to 25 May 2025)
A single total LFL growth figure returned, as no breakdown was requested
Growth shown in percent units, rounded to 2 decimals (6.70%)
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales in FY2026/27 P1, so it drops out of the LFL base for all four weeks; the base is 38 physical stores (152 store-weeks)
No refit closures overlap P1 in either year (Tammisto 2024, Pori Sep 2025 and Kuopio Jun 2026 fall elsewhere), so no store-weeks were removed for refits

Stores 136 (Tampere Lamminpää, opened 2 Sep 2024) and 137 (Lohja, opened 4 Nov 2024) have been open more than 52 weeks before 4 May 2026 and are in the base; their growth (+21% and +25%) is among the highest, which lifts the total somewhat

Calendar effect: last year's P1 included May Day (1 May 2025) when stores were shut (27 trading days vs 28 this year). The week-aligned LFL comparison does not adjust for this, so some of the 6.7% is one extra trading day this year
Regions are as-is (current hierarchy), not used in this single-figure answer
Warehouse is loaded to 4 October 2026, so P1 FY2026/27 is fully loaded

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

Order date converted to Helsinki time from UTC timestamp
Cancelled orders excluded from count
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 refers to the specific date 1 December 2025
Processing orders included in count (per warehouse convention that processing orders count as placed)

answer.sql: SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, not by dim_member row
Tier read from the current member version (is_current = true, valid_to 9999-12-31)
Tier values Basic, Silver and Gold as in dim_member
assumptions: 'Right now' is read as the current version of each member in dim_member, which was valid on the request date of 8 October 2026 and is the same as the latest load (data runs to 4 October 2026).

'Members on the Gold tier' is read as all enrolled loyalty members whose current tier is Gold, whether or not they have bought recently. The company 'active member' definition was not applied because the request does not ask for active members.

The 2,412 older Gold version rows (2,233 distinct members) were excluded because they are superseded versions and counting them would double-count members.

Of the 5,791 current Gold members, 4,827 made at least one purchase in the 52 fiscal weeks ending Sunday 4 October 2026 (the company 'active member' definition). If Marketing means active Gold members, that is the figure to use.
The warehouse holds sales to 4 October 2026, so changes made after that date are not in the count.

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2), sales AS (SELECT f.store_key, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1), ret AS (SELECT r.store_key, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r, p WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1), st AS (SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, coalesce(sum(s.amt),0) - coalesce(sum(r.amt),0) net_sales FROM dim_store st LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_key = st.store_key LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.store_key = st.store_key WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING coalesce(sum(s.amt),0) <> 0) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, store_id, store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, round(net_sales,2) AS net_sales FROM st ORDER BY sales_rank
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar period boundaries from ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27 P02 = 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28, 4 weeks)
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excl. VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the period (return date, not original sale date)
Store identity via the store_key version on each fact row, rolled up to store_id
Stores only: web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Rank by net sales, highest = 1
Reconciled to rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales: store totals match to the cent
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request dated 2026-10-07), not calendar 2026 or last year's P02
'Period 2' read as fiscal period 2 on the company's 4-4-5 style fiscal calendar, not calendar February or the second period of any other calendar
Ranking measure is net sales (EUR excl. VAT, net of returns), since no measure was named
Staff purchases kept in net sales, as in the D&A daily report; excluding them would only swap ranks 4/5 (Vantaa Tammisto and Oulu Kaakkuri), 14/15/16 (Vaasa, Lappeenranta, Joensuu)
Total period sales are ranked, not sales per trading day or per square metre; format and size are not normalised
Web shop is not a store, so it is not ranked (its net sales would have been 230,731.44, rank 1 if included)
Closed stores with no sales in the period (Savonlinna, closed 2026-01-25) are left out rather than shown with zero
caveats: Kuopio (store 125) was closed for a planned refit from 2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26, so it traded only 14 of the 28 calendar days in P02 and its rank of 24 is understated. Its sales per day (about 1,714) were slightly above its P01 rate (about 1,643); at that daily rate over the 26 trading days other stores had, it would have made roughly 44,600 and ranked about 7th. Not adjusted in the table; treat its rank as not like-for-like.
Midsummer Eve and Day (2026-06-19 and 06-20) are non-trading days for all stores, so every other store has 26 trading days in the period.
The period is fully loaded (ref_fiscal_calendar.fully_loaded = true), with no duplicate sales or return lines found.
Several ranks are close: Lahti, Vantaa Tammisto and Oulu Kaakkuri (3 to 5) are within 900 EUR of each other, and Mikkeli and Espoo Lommila (22 and 23) differ by 5.51 EUR.
Regions in dim_store changed on 2025-04-28 (South to Capital Region for some stores); no region is shown, so this does not affect the ranking.
