answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognition: Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order, not order date
Web identification: store_id = 900
Return timing: refunds reduce net sales on the return date, not the sale date
Exclusions: store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from net sales
Fiscal calendar: fiscal periods and weeks from dim_date
assumptions: Interpreted 'last year' as FY2025/26, the fiscal year previous to the current FY2026/27
Web orders with status 'delivered' or 'collected' are included; cancelled and processing orders excluded
Return lines identified by sales_line_id and dated on their own return_date
caveats: Query verified against rpt_daily_store_sales control total; web net sales for the period match exactly at EUR 701,457.87
Fiscal periods 5–8 of FY2025/26 span fiscal weeks 18–34 (25 August to 21 December 2025), a complete period range in the warehouse
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale; the period covers all returns booked through 21 December 2025

answer.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900), lfl_stores AS (SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' GROUP BY 1 INTERSECT SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1), agg AS (SELECT sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' AND business_date <> DATE '2025-05-01') AS ly_net_sales, sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND business_date <> DATE '2026-05-07') AS ty_net_sales FROM daily JOIN lfl_stores USING (store_id)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round((ty_net_sales / ly_net_sales - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM agg
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 1 from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2026/27 P01 (2026-05-04 to 2026-05-31) against FY2025/26 P01 (2025-04-28 to 2025-05-25), 4 weeks each, matched by fiscal period rather than calendar month
Net sales as in rpt_daily_store_sales: EUR excluding VAT, sales less refunds booked on the day (it reconciles exactly to fact_sales_line and fact_return_line)
Like-for-like store base: physical stores (store_id below 900) that traded on every day of both periods, which gives 38 stores
Web shop (900) and the training store (999) excluded
Trading-day matching using dim_date.is_trading_day: the same number of trading days in both periods
Store identified by store_id, which is stable across the slowly changing store versions
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27, and 'period 1' means fiscal period 1, which is the four weeks from 4 May to 31 May 2026.

Like-for-like growth means store sales only. The web shop has no store base, so it is left out. Growth is net sales (after returns, excluding VAT) in the current period against the same fiscal period last year.

Stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2024-09-02) and 137 Lohja (opened 2024-11-04) are kept in the base. Both had been open for over 17 months before the current period and traded fully in both periods.
Staff purchases are kept in net sales, as in the Data & Analytics report table (about 1.4% of store sales).
The tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 table was not used, because it is an undocumented temporary list. It leaves out stores 136 and 137 and includes Savonlinna, which has closed.
No refit closure overlaps either period. Vantaa Tammisto closed in July to August 2024, Pori in September to October 2025 and Kuopio from 15 June 2026, so no store was removed for a refit.
Growth is rounded to two decimals.
caveats: Correction, trading days: last year's period 1 had 27 trading days, because 1 May 2025 (May Day) is flagged as non-trading and all stores were shut. This year's period had 28. Comparing the full periods gives +6.70% (EUR 1,177,925.94 against EUR 1,103,969.88), of which roughly 3.7 points is the extra day. I matched the days by dropping Thursday 7 May 2026, the Thursday of fiscal week 1 that lines up with last year's closed May Day. That leaves 27 days against 27 and gives +3.01% (EUR 1,137,159.94 against EUR 1,103,969.88). If Finance wants the unadjusted figure, it is +6.70%.

Correction, store base: Savonlinna (129) closed on 2026-01-25. It had EUR 12,480.97 of net sales (before returns) in last year's period and none this year, so it is excluded. That leaves 38 like-for-like stores. Including it would pull growth down.

Correction, channel coding: from FY2026/27 the sales lines carry channel_id instead of channel_code (channel_code is null for the whole current period). A filter on channel_code = 'ST' would silently drop all of this year's store sales. I identified stores by store_id below 900 instead.

Sensitivity: if the two stores opened in late 2024 (136 and 137) were treated as not yet mature and left out, the day-matched growth would be +2.42% (36 stores). Last year's period was their 5th to 8th month of trading, so ramp-up could be flattering the growth rate.

Region labels changed in dim_store from 2025-04-28 (stores 101 to 105 moved from South to Capital Region, store 114 from East to South). This does not affect a total, but any regional LFL split would need a stable region mapping.
The dim_store 'format' values in the data (Small, Medium, Large, Web, Training) differ from the Hyper, Standard and Express named in the schema comment. This does not affect the result.
Exactly 4 weeks are compared on both sides. FY2025/26 is a 53-week year, but that extra week falls in P12 and does not touch period 1.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Last period = last completed fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026)
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns deducted on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900) included
Products grouped by stable sku, current product version (as-is) for name
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Best-selling' is not defined in the metric dictionary. I read it as highest net sales value (EUR excluding VAT), the company's default sales measure, not units sold.
'Last period' means FY2026/27 P05, the last fully loaded fiscal period as of the request date 2026-10-08. P06 is only partly loaded (one week).
Web sales are included, because the request says 'our' products without limiting it to stores.
Products are shown on the current (as-is) version, so Outdoor Lighting Kultala 862 sits in Electrical for the whole period.
Sales lines for web orders that are cancelled or still processing are left out, because they have no dispatch date and are not web sales.
caveats: The ranking is by net sales value. A ranking by units would be very different. For example, Fixings & Fasteners Nordhem 594 is 2nd by units (474) but 11th by value, and Interior Paint Norvik 298 is 24th by units. Tell me if Commercial wants a units ranking.
Net sales in this ranking are after returns booked in the period, including returns of goods sold earlier, so a product's figure can be reduced by returns of earlier sales.
Store 999 (2,690.92 EUR net before returns in the period) and ZZ Test articles are excluded, as the house rules require. This does not change any product in the top 10.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or any stg_, bak_, tmp_ or _old tables. The view leaves out web sales from 3 Nov 2025.
Control check: total company net sales for P05 on this definition is 1,109,546.52 EUR, which equals the rpt_daily_store_sales total for the same days exactly. No unexplained gap.
No duplicate sales lines were found in the period, and all store sale dates fall inside 31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026.

VAT charged calculated as the difference between gross_amount (including VAT) and net_amount (excluding VAT)
Fiscal period 5 of FY2024/25 spans 2024-08-26 through 2024-09-22
assumptions: The question requests VAT charged on positive sales transactions, not net of refunds
VAT rates as recorded in the warehouse product dimension are as intended

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), agg AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS growth_pct FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales = net_amount excluding VAT after returns, returns deducted on their own return date
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39 (FY2025/26: 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026; FY2024/25: 28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025), selected through dim_date.fiscal_quarter
Regions as-is (current dim_store version by store_id and is_current), so the Capital Region covers stores 101 to 105 in both years and Kouvola (114) is in South in both years
Web shop (store 900, region Online) shown as its own line
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only); cancelled and processing orders excluded; click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code, so the 3 November 2025 migration (inside FY2025/26 Q3) does not affect the result
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Asked on 6 October 2026 (FY2026/27), 'last year' is read as FY2025/26, and 'the year before' as FY2024/25, in line with past readings (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35)
'Q3' is the fiscal Q3 of each year (P7 to P9, weeks 27 to 39), not calendar Q3
Regions as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, since no as-was was requested
Both Q3s are fully loaded and complete; neither includes week 53, so no week was dropped
Online is reported as its own row alongside the five physical regions; no company total row was added because none was requested
Net sales after returns, excluding VAT, per the company definition
caveats: Store 999 and ZZ Test sales were filtered out, as the rules require; they were about EUR 6,887.98 (FY2025/26 Q3) and EUR 6,485.90 (FY2024/25 Q3) before returns, so the filter changes the totals slightly

Control total: store-level net sales for all 40 physical stores in both quarters agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to within 0.50 EUR, and the Online figure for each year equals the store 900 figure in that table

Found 418 duplicated receipt lines (same receipt_id and line_no, different sales_line_id, loaded again on 23 Sep 2025) in fact_sales_line. They are all in September 2025, in physical stores, so they fall outside Q3 of both years and no correction was needed here. Anyone analysing P5 of FY2025/26 should de-duplicate them

The Online growth of 29.67% is large. It is the web shop on a like-for-like dispatch-date basis, but the web platform migrated on 3 November 2025, inside the FY2025/26 Q3 window, and the quarter also includes Black Friday and Christmas. I did not investigate the cause of the growth

Growth is calendar-week aligned by fiscal quarter, not LFL: it includes the new stores Tampere Lamminpää (opened Sep 2024) and Lohja (opened Nov 2024) and Savonlinna, which closed on 25 Jan 2026 (the last day of FY2025/26 Q3), plus Pori's refit closure of 8 Sep to 12 Oct 2025 (outside Q3). Do not read these as like-for-like growth

answer.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count FROM dim_member WHERE is_current = TRUE AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Current member version: dim_member is slowly changing with one row per version, so only the row with is_current = TRUE is counted. Each member then counts once, by member_id.
Loyalty tier as held in dim_member.tier (Basic, Silver or Gold)
assumptions: 'At the moment' means the latest version of each member, which is the current state of the warehouse. The latest data in the warehouse is dated 4 October 2026, and the request came in on 7 October 2026.
'Gold-tier loyalty members' means every member whose current tier is Gold. I applied no filter on marketing consent, home store or join date, because the request did not ask for one.
caveats: Counting every row with tier = 'Gold' would give 8,203 instead of 5,791. The extra 2,412 rows are old versions of members, and many of those members have since changed tier or appear more than once. Only is_current rows were counted.

Checks found no data problem to correct. Each of the 60,000 member_ids has exactly one current row, and that row is the one with valid_to = 9999-12-31. Tier values are clean, with no spelling variants. The pending member updates in stg_member_updates are already in dim_member.
The count is as of the last data load on 4 October 2026. Any tier changes made on 5 to 7 October are not in the warehouse yet.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Click-and-collect counted as web channel
Click-and-collect share: click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales
Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Store 999 and test articles (ZZ Test) excluded
Cancelled web orders excluded
assumptions: 'Last year' interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year current one year prior to request date 2026-10-09)
'Periods 6 to 8' refers to fiscal periods 6, 7, 8 (26 Sep–26 Oct, 27 Oct–23 Nov, 24 Nov–21 Dec 2025)
Share expressed as percentage on 0–100 scale
caveats: Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale; a refund may be booked in a later period than the original sale
Query validated against control total (rpt_daily_store_sales); match is exact with zero gap
Fulfilment_type from fact_web_order identifies click-and-collect on both sides of the November 2025 platform migration

answer.sql:
WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, 
       COALESCE(cs.store_name, CASE WHEN fv.home_store_id = 900 THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Unknown' END) AS store_name,
       COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY fv.home_store_id
definitions_applied: New member: counted on join date, at the home store in the member's first version (enrolling store)
Online sign-ups: members with home_store_id 900
FY2025/26: fiscal year 2025/26, 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026
assumptions: Last year was interpreted as FY2025/26 based on the request date of 7 October 2026
Store names and regions from the current store version (is_current = true)
First version of each member determined by earliest valid_from date
caveats: Online signups appear under store_id 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop) with 2932 new members, the largest group in the period
All members with a join_date in FY2025/26 are counted once, regardless of subsequent tier or home store changes

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_in_tampere FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
definitions_applied: Customer read as loyalty member, counted by distinct member_id (not member_key, which is one key per version)
Member version: current version (is_current) of dim_member, so the home store is the member's latest
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 and training store 999 excluded
Tampere stores taken from dim_store current version by city: 115 Tampere Hervanta, 116 Tampere Lielahti, 117 Tampere Kaleva, 136 Tampere Lamminpää
Members counted as of the warehouse load point, 4 October 2026
assumptions: The metric dictionary has no definition of 'customers'. The only identified customers in the warehouse are loyalty members, so I read 'customers' as loyalty members, as Marketing and CRM would normally mean. I did not ask in the request queue, so please confirm.
'In Tampere' is read as the member's home store (dim_member.home_store_id) being one of the four Tampere stores. The warehouse has no address or city on members.
'Have' is read as all members registered and not removed, regardless of recent activity, as of the latest data (4 October 2026).
The count uses each member's current home store. Members who moved home store are counted only where they are now.
caveats: dim_store gives city = Tampere to the web shop (store 900) and the training store (store 999) as well as the four real stores. Filtering on city alone would wrongly pull them in, so I kept store_id below 900. Their members were not counted.

Members who signed up online have home store 900 (12,028 members, 20% of all 60,000). Their city is unknown, so some of them will live in Tampere but are not in the 7,175. The figure is therefore a lower bound on Tampere residents who are loyalty members.
Customers who shop without a loyalty card cannot be counted, because the warehouse has no customer identifier for them. The figure does not cover them.

dim_member holds several versions per member (89,314 rows for 60,000 members). Counting rows would overstate the figure, so I counted distinct member_id on current versions only. The data had exactly one current version per member.

Alternative readings, if Marketing wanted one: 4,441 of the 7,175 were active (at least one purchase in the 52 weeks to 4 October 2026); 7,515 distinct members have had a Tampere home store at some point, including those who have since moved to another store.
Not checked against a control total: rpt_daily_store_sales holds sales only, not member counts.

answer.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')), sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_of_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN days d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2), refunds AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN days d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2), net AS (SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.gross_of_returns - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week, ROUND(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(l.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM net t JOIN net l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Company fiscal calendar: period 2 is fiscal weeks 5 to 8 (FY2026/27: 1-28 June 2026; FY2025/26: 26 May-22 June 2025)
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the same week (the rpt_daily_store_sales definition)
Total company = all physical stores plus the web shop (store 900), including click-and-collect
Training store (store 999) excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location
Staff purchases included, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki local date); returns dated by return_date
Channel identified through dim_store (store_key to store_id), not channel_code, because channel_code was replaced by channel_id at the web-platform migration on 2025-11-03
Growth % = this year / last year - 1, comparing the same fiscal week number
assumptions: 'This year' is the current fiscal year FY2026/27 and 'last year' is FY2025/26; 'sales' means net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Weeks are compared by fiscal week number (5 to 8), the company's own calendar, rather than by calendar date
Returns are deducted in the week the refund is booked, not the week of the original sale
Closed and refitting stores stay in the total company figure; this is not a like-for-like comparison
caveats: The growth figures for weeks 7 and 8 are distorted by Midsummer. In 2025 Midsummer Eve and Day (20-21 June) fell in fiscal week 8, and in 2026 (19-20 June) they fell in fiscal week 7. Physical stores are shut by law on those days, so only the web shop traded. This is why week 7 shows -26.5% and week 8 shows +54.4%. Weeks 7 and 8 combined are 586,868 against 551,168 last year, which is +6.5%. Weeks 5 and 6 are not affected.
The Kuopio store (125) has a planned 6-week refit from 15 June to 26 July 2026, which starts in fiscal week 7. Its lost sales are in the total and depress this year's weeks 7 and 8.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026. It traded last year but contributes nothing this year, which slightly lowers the total growth.
Correction: the training store (999) has sales lines, including staff-flagged ones, in both years. They were removed, about 0.2% of sales per week.

Correction: I did not use the existing views or reporting tables for the answer. rpt.v_daily_sales only counts web sales where channel_code = 'WB', which would drop all web sales after the 2025-11-03 migration. The web figures in rpt_daily_store_sales do not match the web sales lines (receipts and amounts differ, and 1 June 2025 shows 897 against 7,999). The answer is built from fact_sales_line and fact_return_line.

I checked that the two periods contain no duplicated lines, orphan keys, VAT mismatches, negative amounts or late-loaded rows. There are 418 duplicated receipt lines in 15-21 September 2025 (a reload on 23 September), but they are outside this request and nothing was removed for them.
Web shop orders are included in full. No cancelled or processing orders appear in the sales lines for these weeks.

answer.sql:
WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(rpt.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  current_year.fiscal_week,
  current_year.fiscal_week_start_date,
  current_year.fiscal_week_end_date,
  ROUND(current_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(prior_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(((current_year.net_sales - prior_year.net_sales) / prior_year.net_sales) * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM weekly_sales current_year
INNER JOIN weekly_sales prior_year 
  ON current_year.fiscal_week = prior_year.fiscal_week 
  AND current_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND prior_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY current_year.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales from rpt_daily_store_sales (sales after returns, excluding VAT)
Fiscal calendar week definitions from dim_date
Fiscal period 2 encompasses fiscal weeks 5 through 8
Fiscal year FY2025/26 is current year; FY2024/25 is prior year
assumptions: Request for 'this year' interpreted as the most recent complete fiscal period 2, which is FY2025/26 (May 26 – June 22, 2025)
Prior year interpreted as FY2024/25 period 2
Net sales defined as total company sales across all stores and channels, after returns, excluding VAT
Growth percentage calculated as (current year - prior year) / prior year × 100
caveats: Store count differs between years: FY2025/26 has 40 stores in this period, FY2024/25 has 38 stores. Stores 136 and 137 are new in FY2025/26 and did not exist in the prior year, so growth includes contribution from new locations.
Week 8 in both years has lower sales than weeks 5–7, suggesting possible partial week or promotional pattern differences
All values are in EUR, excluding VAT

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5), sales AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY p.sku), refunds AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe WHERE s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY p.sku), names AS (SELECT sku, arg_max(product_name, valid_from) product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.gross_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net,0) DESC) AS rank, sales.sku, names.product_name, round(sales.gross_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net,0), 2) AS net_sales FROM sales LEFT JOIN refunds USING (sku) JOIN names USING (sku) ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales = line value in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount) minus refunds excluding VAT (refund_net), the same net-of-returns basis as rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales
Returns are booked on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales. A refund made in the period for a sale from an earlier period is deducted
Products are aggregated by SKU across all product versions, not by product_key
Sales channel taken from channel_id, with store, web home delivery and click and collect all included. channel_code is empty for this period
Fiscal calendar from ref_fiscal_calendar
assumptions: 'Last period' means fiscal period 5 of FY2026/27, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27. It is the latest fully loaded period at the request date of 2026-10-08. Period 6 started 2026-09-28 and is still partial (fully_loaded = false), so I did not use it

'Best-selling' means highest net sales value in EUR excluding VAT. The request did not say whether to rank by value or by units. A ranking by units would give a very different top 10, led by low-priced items such as fixings and cushions
All channels are included (stores, web home delivery, click and collect), since the request says 'our' products without limiting the channel
Staff purchases are kept in. They are genuine sales and the company's own daily report includes them
Product names are shown as per the latest product version. SKU is the identifier
caveats: Correction: store 999 'Training store' (139 sales lines, EUR 2,690.92 net in the period) is a test location, not real trading, so I left it out of both sales and refunds. It sits in rpt_daily_store_sales and the rpt.v_daily_sales view, so those reports are overstated by that amount and by any refunds booked there. It does not change which 10 products make the list. Smart Home Tuulikki 855 would be about EUR 46 higher with it

Correction: fact_sales_line.channel_code is NULL for every line in this period (it is only filled for the legacy ST/WB codes), so I used channel_id instead. Filtering on channel_code would silently drop all sales

Returns change the order. Ranked on sales before returns, Home Office Peltola 918 is 2nd (EUR 8,627.98 sold, EUR 1,162.80 refunded across 10 units) and Outdoor Lighting Kultala 862 is 3rd. After returns they swap places and are 2 EUR apart. Living Room Havu Pro 936 and Power Tools Nordhem 370 also move up and Smart Home Tuulikki 855 moves down. The same 10 products appear either way

Excluding staff purchases (715 lines, EUR 15,448 in the period) would not change the top 10 membership. It would lower the values of several products, for example Interior Paint Norvik 298 by about EUR 214 before returns

The refunds are matched to products by the return date and the product on the return line. Refunds in the period for goods sold before 31 August are included, so net sales can include refunds for earlier sales
I checked sales lines for the period and found no duplicate line ids, no non-positive quantities or amounts, and no sales lines without a product. The VAT arithmetic reconciles to within rounding
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or the bak_/stg_/tmp_/_old tables

answer.sql: WITH targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted) AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_eur_excl_vat FROM lines
definitions_applied: Targeted member: at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member (not distinct member_key or exposure rows)
Campaign window from dim_campaign: 4 to 24 May 2026, used as requested (no 7-day extension)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, before returns, on lines linked to the member (campaign convention); store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, from delivered and collected orders only; web lines identified by store 900, not channel_code
Members with no purchases count in the member total but add zero to spend
Member versions resolved to member_id so version changes do not duplicate members
Timestamps converted from UTC to Helsinki time
assumptions: 'Contacted' means any contact row in fact_campaign_exposure for campaign 19 (Spring Garden Launch 2026, 4 to 24 May 2026), whether or not it was delivered or opened
'Spend' means net sales excluding VAT before returns on the members' own member-linked purchases in all channels (stores and web), the same basis as the campaign uplift definition
'Those members' means the contacted members only; the 1,597 holdout members are not included
'Between 4 and 24 May 2026' is read as inclusive of both days, which is also exactly the campaign window
Only purchases recorded against a loyalty member key can be attributed to a member; purchases made without scanning the card are not included
caveats: Contact rows are not one per member: 31,685 contact rows (email and SMS) covered 15,001 distinct members, and 15,063 distinct member_key versions, so counting rows or keys would overstate the number of members

15,001 is 26 fewer than the 15,027 implied by the mailing list (16,624 list size minus 1,597 holdout). Every campaign shows a similar small shortfall, so I took it as systematic; the contact table is what was actually contacted, so I used it. I did not find the cause
Only 14,814 of the 15,001 members had at least one delivered contact; the 15,001 counts anyone with a contact row
Of the 15,001 contacted members, 2,605 bought something in the window. The spend figure is therefore EUR 190,687.59 across all 15,001, an average of about EUR 12.71 per contacted member
Spend is not an effect of the campaign: it includes purchases the members would have made anyway. Measuring the effect needs the holdout comparison (uplift), which was not asked for

The figure is before returns. Refunds booked by these members in the same dates were EUR 8,231.32 excluding VAT, which would give about EUR 182,456 net of returns. Including VAT, spend before returns was EUR 238,805.59

The campaign-uplift template in the library joins web orders with a LEFT JOIN on delivered/collected orders and falls back to the order date for web lines without a dispatch, which would pull cancelled or processing orders in by order date. I did not use it as written and required a delivered or collected order for web lines. For these members no cancelled or processing orders turned up, so the number is unaffected

Web sales were dated by dispatch date. Using the order date instead would give EUR 191,576.11 (stores 155,518.67 plus web 36,057.41 against 190,687.59 here), so the choice moves the figure by under EUR 900
No duplicate sales lines were found in the period, the warehouse was fully loaded for the period, and all contact timestamps fall inside 4 to 24 May in Helsinki time

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date taken in Helsinki time (UTC converted with timezone('Europe/Helsinki', ...)), so the day changes at local midnight
Cancelled orders excluded; processing orders would count (none on this day)
Click-and-collect counted as web
Test articles (ZZ Test) excluded from reporting, checked on the orders' lines
Deprecated objects not used (no channel_code, no rpt.v_daily_sales)
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 is Monday 1 December 2025, as stated in the request
'Web orders placed' means all non-cancelled orders on the Helsinki order date, with home delivery and click-and-collect both included
Guest and logged-in orders both included
caveats: 19 further orders were placed on the day and cancelled; they are excluded, so including them the figure would be 345
Order times run from 2025-11-30 22:03 UTC to 2025-12-01 21:54 UTC, which is the Helsinki day (UTC+2). A count by UTC date would give a different number

Checked for problems and found none: web_order_id is unique in fact_web_order (94,876 rows, 94,876 ids), all 326 orders have sales lines, none contain ZZ Test articles, and none has a zero total, a zero line count or a missing dispatch time. No correction was needed
The warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026, so 1 December 2025 is fully covered

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, s.store_id, p.category, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31') SELECT region, SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS august_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat, SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat FROM lines WHERE NOT (store_id = 999 OR category = 'ZZ Test') GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
definitions_applied: Gross sales as the sum of gross_amount on sales lines (each line carries its own VAT rate: 24% to 31 Aug 2024, 25.5% from 1 Sep 2024 for standard-rate goods, with 14% and 10% unchanged)
Before returns: fact_return_line is not used
As-was regions: the region on the dim_store version the fact line points to (store_key), which gives four regions plus Online in 2024
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Cancelled and processing web orders left out because they have no sales lines or dispatch date
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own region, Online
Store 999 and category ZZ Test left out
Calendar months, 1 to 31 Aug 2024 and 1 to 30 Sep 2024, as the request names months
Control total: net sales before returns by store and day for the same lines matched rpt_daily_store_sales on all 2,335 store-day cells, with no differences
Deprecated objects and channel_code not used
assumptions: August and September 2024 are read as calendar months, not fiscal periods, because this is a VAT filing and the request names the months
As-was means the region as it stood on the transaction date. This is as the requester asked ('as they were at the time, as in the old reports'), which differs from the company default of as-is

Web orders are dated by Helsinki dispatch date, the company rule for web sales, even though this is a VAT filing. An order placed in late July and dispatched in August is in August, and an order placed on 30 Sep and dispatched in October is not in September
Gross sales means the gross_amount of sold lines, including staff purchases, which the net sales definition also includes
Online is listed as its own row because web is not part of any physical region
Figures are in EUR including VAT, rounded to 2 decimals
caveats: Correction: store 999 and ZZ Test lines are excluded. This removes 7,645.77 EUR of gross sales across Aug and Sep 2024 in total. If Finance's VAT filing must cover these lines, they would need to be added back
Correction: web sales are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date rather than the order date. Using the order date would move some web amounts between August, September and the neighbouring months

The September figures mix VAT rates (25.5% on standard goods from 1 Sep, 24% on August standard goods), as the lines carry. Web lines dated by dispatch carry the rate applied at order time, so a web order placed in late August and dispatched in September keeps 24%. Finance should check this is the treatment wanted for VAT timing
No returns or refunds are deducted, as requested. Refunds booked in these months are not shown, and the dictionary does not say how returns enter a figure including VAT

As-was regions are the four old regions (East, North, South, West) plus Online. Stores that later moved to the Capital Region (101 to 105) appear under South, and Kouvola (114) appears under East, as they were in 2024. The new stores Tampere Lamminpää (136, West, opened 2 Sep 2024) and Lohja (137, South, opened 4 Nov 2024) have sales only from their opening, so Lohja contributes nothing in Aug or Sep 2024
No duplicate sales lines, missing store or product versions or version-date mismatches were found in the range used

answer.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recognition_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM lines WHERE recognition_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns divided by the number of sales receipts
Net amount excluding VAT, before returns
Staff purchases excluded from ATV
Store 999 (training store) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (store_id 900 identifies web, not channel_code)
Store receipts dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Cancelled web orders excluded (they have no sales lines)
Fiscal calendar: P1 to P3 = FY2026/27 weeks 1 to 13, 4 May to 2 August 2026
Control totals checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'periods 1 to 3' as P1 to P3, 4 May to 2 August 2026 (13 whole weeks, complete in the warehouse, which is loaded through 4 October 2026).

The company ATV definition leaves web orders out. You asked for them in, so I followed your request and counted each web order as one receipt. Web orders are counted and valued on the dispatch date, the same date that recognises web sales, so numerator and denominator use the same date.
ATV is the average over all receipts in the period, stores and web together. It is not an average of the store ATV and the web ATV.
No breakdown was asked for, so the answer is a single company-wide figure in EUR excluding VAT.
caveats: This figure is not the standard company ATV, which covers physical stores only. Following your request, web orders are included. For reference, the stores-only ATV for the same period is 55.52 (3,719,186.33 EUR over 66,984 receipts). The web part is 59.33 (771,530.75 EUR over 13,004 orders). These two figures are shown only for context, not as part of the answer.
Staff purchases are excluded from both stores and web: 1,037 store receipts worth 48,734.94 EUR. There were no staff purchases on web orders.

Store 999 (training store) was excluded: 54 receipts (all test articles, 451.55 EUR) plus 132 staff-training receipts (7,354.71 EUR). Three web orders containing only ZZ Test articles (6.00 EUR) were also excluded.

Web orders dispatched in the period include some placed in late April and early May (before 4 May). Web orders placed in the last days of P3 but dispatched after 2 August are not included. 519 orders placed in the period were cancelled and are not counted.
Web orders still in 'processing' status have no sales lines and no dispatch date, so they are not in the figure. None were placed in this period.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, because they silently drop web sales from 3 November 2025. The channel_code and channel_id columns were not used to identify web.

Control check: the store receipts (68,021 including staff) and net amounts (3,767,921.27 EUR before the staff exclusion) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. The web figures (13,004 orders, 771,530.75 EUR) also match the store 900 rows in rpt_daily_store_sales exactly. No duplicate sales lines or receipt IDs were found, and no Helsinki/UTC date mismatches on the sale dates.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, by distinct member_id (stable loyalty number, not member_key version)
Members counted from dim_member, the canonical versioned member table; no staging, backup or tmp tables used
Online sign-ups (home store 900) are included, since they are members who joined
assumptions: 'Joined on 3 October 2026' means dim_member.join_date = 2026-10-03, the date the member joined, read as a Helsinki business date
No breakdown by store, tier or channel was asked for, so the answer is one total
Online sign-ups (9 of the 29) and members without marketing consent are included, as the request does not exclude them
caveats: 3 October 2026 is covered by the warehouse load: the latest sale date and latest join date are both 4 October 2026, and the last ETL load was 5 October 2026 01:00
No duplicates found: each of the 29 members has exactly one row in dim_member for that join date, and no member_id has more than one join_date
29 is in line with neighbouring days (29 to 49 per day from 30 August to 4 October 2026), so I found no sign of missing or doubled rows
dim_member.join_date is a plain date, so I could not check it against the UTC/Helsinki day edge; a sign-up near midnight could fall on a different day if join_date was derived from a UTC timestamp
No corrections were needed

answer.sql: SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, not by dim_member version rows
Tier read from the current member version (is_current, valid_to = 9999-12-31)
Loyalty-number counts follow the metric dictionary's member_id rule; 'active member' definition deliberately not applied because the request did not ask for activity
assumptions: 'Members on the Gold tier right now' is read as all enrolled loyalty members whose current tier is Gold, whether or not they have bought recently
'Right now' means the current version of each member as loaded in the warehouse; the latest data is dated 4 October 2026, four days before the request date of 8 October 2026
No filter on marketing consent or home store (online sign-ups under store 900 are included)
caveats: dim_member has several rows per member (one per tier, store or consent change), so counting rows would have overstated the figure: there are 8,203 Gold version rows in total, of which 2,412 are historical. Only the 5,791 current versions are counted, and each member has exactly one current version.
The warehouse is loaded to 4 October 2026, so tier changes made between 5 and 8 October 2026 are not reflected.
Only members whose current version is Gold are counted. Members who were Gold earlier and have since moved to another tier are excluded.

If 'members' should mean active members (a purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks to Sunday 4 October 2026, store 999 and ZZ Test excluded), the Gold count is 4,827. That figure uses a different definition and is not the answer given.

Data checks on dim_member found no problems: no member without a current version, no member with two current versions, no overlapping validity periods and no duplicate member keys. The stg_member_updates staging table was not used.
No corrections were needed to the figure.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period) SELECT s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR, excluding VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop is excluded
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date); returns do not enter ATV
Fiscal period 4 taken from dim_date (fiscal_year FY2026/27, fiscal_period 4)
Format taken from dim_store on the sale date's store version; the format is the same in every store version
Control total: store-day net sales before returns and receipt counts checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: "Period 4 this year" was read as fiscal period 4 of the current fiscal year, FY2026/27. The period runs 3 August to 30 August 2026 (fiscal weeks 14 to 17) and was fully loaded when the request was received on 6 October 2026.
"Store format" means the dim_store format (Large, Medium, Small). The Web and Training formats do not appear because web orders and store 999 are outside ATV.
ATV for a format is total net sales before returns divided by total receipts in all its stores, not an average of the store-level ATVs.
Result values are in EUR excluding VAT, rounded to 2 decimals.
caveats: Corrections and exclusions applied: web shop (store 900), staff purchases, store 999 and ZZ Test articles were left out of ATV. In the period this removed 3,229 web receipts, 55 receipts at store 999 and 24 ZZ Test receipts, plus staff receipts at the stores. Staff purchases are 280 receipts, shown by the control reconciliation below.
Receipts behind the figures: Large 6,508, Medium 8,641, Small 2,598 (17,747 in total). Net sales before returns: Large 394,865.46, Medium 520,763.45, Small 131,841.05 (EUR, excluding VAT).

Checks found no data problems in the period: no duplicate sales lines at receipt and line number, no receipt spanning several stores, dates or staff flags, and no zero or negative quantities or amounts.

Including staff purchases, store-day net sales before returns and receipt counts match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for all 1,064 store-days (38 trading physical stores x 28 days; Savonlinna closed 25 January 2026), 1,062,266.72 EUR and 18,027 receipts.
The deprecated views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales were not used.
Small stores have a clearly lower ATV, about 10 EUR below Large and Medium. Large and Medium differ by only 0.40 EUR.

answer.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT s.format AS store_format, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar p ON p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND p.fiscal_period = 2 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY sales_line_id) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, sold.store_format, round(100 * coalesce(sum(refunds.refund_net), 0) / sum(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunds ON refunds.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id GROUP BY sold.store_format ORDER BY CASE sold.store_format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 2 of FY2025/26 = 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-22 (4 weeks, from ref_fiscal_calendar; fully loaded)
Return rate = refunds excluding VAT (refund_net) divided by net sales excluding VAT (net_amount) of the same lines
Returns are tied to the original sales line (sales_line_id), so the cohort is goods sold in the period, whenever they were returned
Store format taken from dim_store at the store version on the original sale (fact_sales_line.store_key)
Store sales only (channel ST, store_id below 900)
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag = true)
Training store (999) excluded
assumptions: 'Last year' means the fiscal year before the current one (FY2026/27, as of the 2026-10-05 request date), so FY2025/26, period 2
Return rate is measured by value (EUR excluding VAT). The unit-based rate is lower, about 2.4% in every format, because returned items are on average higher priced
'Store format' means the physical store formats in dim_store, so the web shop (format Web) is not a row
Returns are counted whenever they happened, up to 33 days after the sale, to the latest data load; no returns are outstanding for the period
Staff purchases were left out of the customer return rate; their return rate is about 2%, so including them would lower each rate slightly
caveats: Formats in dim_store are Large, Medium and Small, but the column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express. I used the values as stored

102 returns of goods sold in the period were booked at a different store than the sale, and all of them are web orders returned in a store. Grouping by the return's store_key would have put web sales into the store formats, so I grouped by the sale's store_key and left web out
The Web channel (6,351 lines, about 183k EUR net sales in the period) is excluded, so its return rate is not shown
The Training store (999) has test sales of about 2.2k EUR net in the period, with no returns, and is excluded
Staff purchases (678 lines, about 13k EUR net across the three formats) are excluded; this is my own choice because no definition was provided, so confirm it matches Commercial's convention
Store format is by sale-date store version. Region changed for some stores from 2025-04-28 but format did not, so the result is unaffected
Staging tables (stg_*) hold only 3-4 Oct 2026 loads that are already in the fact tables, so they do not affect this period
Differences between formats are small (4.30% to 4.56%)

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P05'), sales AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) gross_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND st.store_id <> 999), rets AS (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key, p WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND st.store_id <> 999) SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, sales.gross_net - rets.ret AS net_sales_eur FROM p, sales, rets
definitions_applied: Net sales = line value in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), after line discounts, minus refunds excluding VAT (refund_net); this matches rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales
Whole company = all physical stores plus the web shop (store 900), home delivery and click-and-collect
Returns are deducted on the date the refund was booked (return_date), web returns included
Fiscal calendar from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2026/27 P05 runs 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27 and is flagged fully_loaded
Channel taken from channel_id, not channel_code
assumptions: 'Last month' is read as the last complete fiscal period before the request date of 9 October 2026. That is FY2026/27 P05, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27. The current period, P06, started on 28 September, is not fully loaded and is still running.
Staff purchases are included in net sales, as in rpt_daily_store_sales. They come to 12,842.22 EUR net, all in physical stores.
Net sales are in EUR excluding VAT. Net sales are reported after returns.
caveats: Correction: the training store (store_id 999, 'Training' format, head office) was excluded. It has 2,690.92 EUR of test sales in the period, and it is not a real trading location.

Correction: web sales are identified by channel_id (2 = home delivery, 3 = click-and-collect). In recent data channel_code is NULL, so the view rpt.v_daily_sales, which filters on channel_code = 'WB', would drop all web sales (193,492.09 EUR net in the period). I did not use that view.

Composition of the result (EUR excluding VAT): physical stores 983,903.11 before returns, web shop 193,492.09, total 1,177,395.20 before returns, less 69,980.90 of refunds (51,593.92 stores, 18,386.98 web), giving 1,107,414.30.
Cancelled web orders have no sales lines in the warehouse, so they add nothing.

rpt_daily_store_sales matches my store figures exactly. For the web shop it is built on dispatch date, not order date, and shows 195,624.31 against my 193,492.09 for the period (a difference of 2,132.22). The report's company total is 1,109,546.52. I used the order date (sale_date) in fact_sales_line, which is the fiscal-calendar basis for the other channels.

If 'last month' means calendar September 2026 (1 to 30 September), net sales on the same basis are 1,174,613.10 EUR (1,248,875.34 sales less 74,262.24 refunds). That range runs into P06, which is not fully loaded.

Checks that came up clean: no duplicate sales lines, no orphan store keys, VAT and gross amounts consistent on all period lines, every period return links to a sales line, daily sales present for all 7 days of each week, and 39 to 40 trading locations each week. The closed store 129 (Savonlinna, closed 25 January 2026) has no sales in the period.

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 2) as vat_rate, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) as vat_charged FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 AND f.channel_code = 'ST' GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate

All sales lines in the period, including staff purchases, are included in the total
caveats: All 37,745 store sales lines in FY2024/25 P05 have valid VAT rates; no missing or invalid data
Four distinct VAT rates appear in the data (10%, 14%, 24%, 25.5%), matching Finnish VAT classification for different product categories

definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (excluding VAT) divided by distinct sales receipts
Physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop (900) and training store 999 left out
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Dated by sale_date, Helsinki business date
Fiscal calendar from dim_date (fiscal_year and fiscal_period columns)
Format taken from the store version on the sale date (format is the same in every store version)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales_before_returns
assumptions: Request received 6 Oct 2026, so 'this year' is FY2026/27 and 'period 4' is FY2026/27 P4, which ran 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (fiscal weeks 14 to 17) and is fully loaded
'ATV by store format' read as one row per format, not per store
Formats are the values in dim_store: Large, Medium and Small, since the schema comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date
caveats: The dim_store format comment (Hyper, Standard or Express) is out of date. Actual store formats are Large, Medium and Small, so I used those.

Control total: store-by-day net sales before returns (all lines, including staff purchases) matched rpt_daily_store_sales exactly over 3 to 30 Aug 2026 across 1,064 store-days, with receipt counts also matching. The ATV filters (staff and test articles out) are not part of that comparison, as the check does not apply to ATV.
No duplicates found in fact_sales_line for the period, and no receipt spans several stores, dates or staff flags.

Every one of the 38 stores that traded in P4 is included: Large 8, Medium 18, Small 12. Kuopio's refit (15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026) ended before P4 and Savonlinna closed in January 2026, so neither affects the period.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date WHERE ds.store_id = 108 AND dp.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%' AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND dd.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13 AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
definitions_applied: Regular customer sales (staff purchases excluded)
Fiscal period 3 of FY2026/27 (weeks 9-13, 29 June to 2 August 2026)
Product selection by product_name prefix match
assumptions: Interior Paint interpreted as all products with product_name beginning with 'Interior Paint'

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS lfl_net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS lfl_net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM params JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
definitions_applied: LFL growth: net sales of the LFL stores in the period against the same fiscal weeks last year, matched by fiscal week number
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (opening, closing and ref_store_closure refit weeks drop out)
Week 53 never counts (not in P4 anyway)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web lines dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (no web lines count in the physical-store LFL figure)
Fiscal calendar: the period is read from dim_date as fiscal weeks 14 to 17, aligned on fiscal week numbers, not calendar dates
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Read 'period 4 this year' as FY2026/27 P4, fiscal weeks 14 to 17 (Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026), which is complete in the warehouse (loaded through 4 October 2026)
Read 'last year' as the same weeks of FY2025/26, P4, weeks 14 to 17 (28 July to 24 August 2025)
Read 'the stores' as the physical stores in the LFL base and returned one company-wide LFL figure, since no breakdown was requested
Regions would be as-is (current hierarchy) if a breakdown were wanted; none is given here
Returned the LFL growth percentage together with the two net sales figures it is computed from (EUR excluding VAT)
caveats: Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales in P4 this year, so it is out of the LFL base. It sold about EUR 9,549 in P4 last year, which is not counted.

The base is 38 physical stores (152 store-weeks). The two newer stores, Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137), opened more than 52 weeks before 3 August 2026 and are in. Kuopio's 2026 refit (15 June to 26 July) ended before P4, and no refit closure falls in either year's P4, so no store-weeks were dropped for refits.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales. They omit web sales from 3 November 2025, and this answer does not depend on them.
My store-level net sales matched rpt_daily_store_sales for every physical store in both years' P4 weeks, with no gap above EUR 0.5.

The warehouse has duplicated (receipt_id, line_no) sales lines in fiscal week 21 of FY2025/26 for store 116. That week is outside the P4 range, so it does not affect this answer. The duplicates should still be reported to the data team.

The company is flat on a like-for-like basis (-0.03%), but individual stores moved a lot. For example, Mikkeli (127) was down about 26% and Hämeenlinna (109) about 18%, while Oulu Kaakkuri (131) and Lohja (137) were up. A regional split can be supplied if wanted.

answer.sql: WITH web_lines AS (SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) AS net_after_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03') SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(w.net_after_returns) DESC) AS rank, w.sku, c.product_name, c.category, sum(w.net_after_returns) AS web_net_sales_eur FROM web_lines w JOIN dim_product c ON c.sku = w.sku AND c.is_current GROUP BY w.sku, c.product_name, c.category ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web channel = dim_channel channel_group 'web': channel_id 2 (Web home delivery) and 3 (Click and collect), which replaced channel_code WB at the platform migration
Net sales = line value excluding VAT (net_amount) after line discounts, less refunds (refund_net) on the same sales line
Products grouped by sku (stable article number), not by product_key (one key per product version)
Product name and category taken from the current version of each sku
Sale date (sale_date) used for the migration cut-off, on or after 3 November 2025
Cancelled and processing web orders carry no sales lines, so they are excluded
Web lines carry no staff purchases, so no staff-purchase filter was needed
assumptions: 'Web sales' means net sales in EUR excluding VAT, net of refunds, the same basis as the company's net sales definition (rpt_daily_store_sales)
'Top 10 products' means individual skus (articles), ranked by web net sales value, not by units
Both web home delivery and click-and-collect are counted as web
The period runs from 3 November 2025 to the latest loaded web sales date, 3 October 2026
Refunds are attributed to the original sale line, so a refund is deducted whenever it was booked
Rank is a dense ordering of net sales with no ties in the top 10
caveats: Since the migration, web lines have channel_code NULL and a channel_id. Filtering on channel_code = 'WB' would return no web sales after 2 November 2025, and the old rpt.v_daily_sales view, which filters on 'WB', misses them.

Channel_id 2 (home delivery) holds 758 click-and-collect orders (1,473 lines, EUR 43,819 net) dated 12 Jan to 8 Feb 2026. They are mislabelled but still web, so they are included and the total is unaffected. A breakdown by channel would be wrong for that period.

Returns matter here: refunds are about 11 percent of web net sales since the migration. Ranked before returns, Bedroom Peltola 793 would be first (EUR 15,533 gross, 5,396 refunded) and Sauna & Winter Havu 699 and Christmas Decorations Kuusela 620 would fall outside the top 10, with Garden Furniture Norvik 499 inside it. The list above is after returns.
The 10th place is close: Interior Paint Kultala 377 is 11th at EUR 6,444.60, about EUR 166 behind Garden Furniture Norvik 499.

Refunds booked after 3 November 2025 on web sales made before the migration are not deducted (they belong to the earlier period). Among the top-ranked skus this is four refunds, about EUR 856, and does not change the ranking.

Web sales data runs to 3 October 2026 only. 296 web orders (218 home delivery, 78 click-and-collect) are still processing and have no sales lines yet. Cancelled orders (1,701 since migration) have no lines and are excluded.
The Christmas and garden items dominate partly because the period covers one Christmas season and one summer season, so the ranking is seasonal and a longer or shorter window would change it.
The warehouse holds backup, staging, temp and old dimension tables (bak_*, stg_*, tmp_*, dim_*_old). None of them were used.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counted as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, tied back to the original order's fulfilment type
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (UTC converted to Europe/Helsinki), not the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type (channel columns break at the 3 Nov 2025 migration)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded from web sales (only delivered and collected orders count)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods from dim_date (FY2025/26 P09 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026; P10 = 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the fiscal year FY2025/26, the most recent complete fiscal year when the request was received on 6 Oct 2026 (FY2026/27 is the current year), in line with how accepted requests from May 2026 read it
'Periods 9 and 10' reported as one row per period, since the request names two periods and the template's grain is the period
Share is of web net sales (money), not of web order counts, as the request says 'share of web sales'
Period 9 has five weeks and period 10 has four; both are fully loaded in the warehouse
caveats: Combined across both periods the share is 29.8%, if a single figure is wanted (click-and-collect 96,397.46 of web 323,339.73 EUR net)

Period 9: click-and-collect 58,536.07 EUR of 200,208.58 EUR web net sales; period 10: 37,861.39 EUR of 123,131.15 EUR. The web net totals match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly in both periods
fact_sales_line has 418 duplicated (receipt_id, line_no) pairs, all store (ST) lines from September 2025, outside these two periods and not web, so they do not affect this answer
rpt.v_daily_sales / channel_code were not used because they omit web sales from 3 Nov 2025, which falls inside the requested year
Cancelled orders (104 click-and-collect and 269 home delivery between mid-Dec 2025 and early Mar 2026) are excluded as they are not web sales

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT business_date, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Cancelled orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded

Helsinki time conversion for dispatch timestamps

Date range 15 to 23 December 2025 inclusive, 9 days, all inside the loaded data

Net sales are after returns. Refunds booked to the web shop in the window were 339.04, 362.29, 986.98, 829.40, 1061.19, 1104.90, 833.90, 900.72 and 425.05 EUR for 15 to 23 December respectively. Sunday 21 December is low (611.75 EUR net) because few orders were dispatched that day (18 orders), and refunds on the day (833.90 EUR) are larger than the day's dispatched sales would otherwise absorb.
Web sales follow the dispatch date, so an order placed on one day may appear on a later day. 101 cancelled orders in the order window were excluded.
