answer.sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current), movements AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id <> 999 UNION ALL SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND st.store_id <> 999), by_cat AS (SELECT category, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amount END) AS net_sales, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amount END) AS prior_net_sales FROM movements WHERE category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY category) SELECT category, 8 AS fiscal_period, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, round(net_sales,2) AS net_sales, 'FY2024/25' AS prior_fiscal_year, round(prior_net_sales,2) AS prior_net_sales, round((net_sales/prior_net_sales-1)*100,2) AS growth_pct FROM by_cat ORDER BY category
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT) less refund_net on returns, with returns deducted on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Fiscal calendar: period 8 taken from dim_date (FY2025/26 P08 = 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-21, FY2024/25 P08 = 2024-11-25 to 2024-12-22), both 4 weeks and fully loaded
Product category taken from the current version of each SKU (dim_product.is_current), joined via sku
Training store 999 excluded
Web shop (store 900, home delivery and click and collect) included with the stores
Staff purchases included, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: The request was read as of 2026-10-05, when the current fiscal year is FY2026/27. 'Last year' is therefore FY2025/26 and 'the year before' is FY2024/25.
'Period 8' is the fiscal period 8 of the company calendar, not calendar month 8.
'Garden and Electrical' is answered as one row per category, not a combined figure. Garden plus Electrical combined is 207951.91 in FY2025/26 and 199622.79 in FY2024/25, growth 4.17%.
Net sales means company-wide net sales after returns, in EUR excluding VAT. Both store and web sales are included.
Staff purchases are left in because the team's daily sales report includes them. No definition in the warehouse says to remove them. Tell me if Commercial wants them out.
caveats: Correction, category move: 65 Outdoor Lighting SKUs were reclassified from Garden to Electrical from 2025-10-27. In the FY2024/25 P08 data they sit under Garden and in the FY2025/26 P08 data under Electrical. I restated FY2024/25 on the current classification, so Outdoor Lighting counts as Electrical in both years. This moves 19340.33 of net sales (20595.77 sales less 1255.44 returns) from Garden to Electrical in FY2024/25. Left as recorded, FY2024/25 would show Garden 56462.85 and Electrical 143159.94. That would make Garden growth -35.1% and Electrical growth +19.6%, both wrong. Garden plus Electrical combined is the same either way.

Correction, training store: store 999 (Training store, Head office) has sales lines in both years, including Garden and Electrical. I excluded them. They are not customer sales, and the daily sales report leaves them out too.
Correction, test articles: the 'ZZ Test' category has sales lines. None fall in Garden or Electrical, so they do not touch this answer.
The Outdoor Lighting restatement means the Garden and Electrical rows follow the current hierarchy. They will not match any report that was run on the category as recorded at the time.

Pre-aggregated tables (rpt_daily_store_sales, rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt_weekly_sales_by_region) have no product category, so I used the fact tables. The daily report books web sales to different dates than the sales lines (sales on 6 and 7 December appear on the next trading day), so the report is not a clean check at period level for web. The Garden and Electrical figures do not depend on it.
Returns are deducted in the period they were booked, whichever period the original sale fell in. Returns are assigned to a category by the product on the return line.

The Independence Day closure (6 December, a non-trading day) falls inside P08 in both years. Both periods have 4 weeks and 39 stores plus the web shop, so the comparison is like for like in length. It is not a like-for-like store comparison and nothing was done about store openings or refits. The one refit that ended near the window, store 119, finished on 2025-10-12, before P08.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after line discounts, less returns booked on their return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Total company: physical stores plus the web shop (store 900)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Prior-year comparison lined up by fiscal week number, not calendar date
Growth % = this year / last year - 1
Fiscal weeks run Monday to Sunday; period 2 is weeks 5 to 8
Control total: weekly figures match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (physical stores plus store 900)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'last year' means FY2025/26. Period 2 is read as FY2026/27 P2, which is complete (1 to 28 June 2026), against FY2025/26 P2 (26 May to 22 June 2025).
Sales are net sales excluding VAT in EUR, on the company definition. The request did not say net or gross.
'Total company' includes the web shop, as in earlier total-company requests.
Neither year's P2 contains week 53, so nothing was dropped for week 53.
caveats: Midsummer moves between weeks. The stores shut for Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (19 and 20 June 2026), which fall in FY2026/27 week 7. Last year they were 20 and 21 June 2025, in FY2025/26 week 8. The weekly growth figures of -32.2% in week 7 and +76.4% in week 8 are mostly this calendar shift, not a trading change. Weeks 7 and 8 together are 591,343.83 against 535,679.88, which is +10.4%. The whole period is 1,294,647.64 against 1,195,882.70, which is +8.3%. These two aggregates are not in the table.

Kuopio (store 125) was shut for a refit from 15 June 2026 to 26 July 2026, so it has no sales in weeks 7 and 8 this year. Last year it sold 11,609.76 in week 7 and 6,699.18 in week 8. This pulls down this year's weeks 7 and 8 and is a real effect, not a data error.

Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026. It has no sales this year, but it sold 9,737.24 across P2 last year. The figures are total company, not like-for-like, so the two closed or shut stores affect the growth. I made no adjustment for them.
Web sales are on the dispatch date, so web revenue for orders placed late in one week may fall in the next.

No data errors found. The query returned no duplicate sales lines, return lines or web orders in either period, and no cancelled or processing web orders were included. The weekly totals reconcile exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_sales_gross FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Web sales: fact_sales_line records with channel_code = 'WB'
Including VAT: gross_amount field (EUR including VAT)
Before returns: sales lines from fact_sales_line, not adjusted for fact_return_line
Fiscal period: mapped via dim_date table
assumptions: FY24/25 interpreted as FY2024/25 (warehouse label format)
Q2 corresponds to fiscal periods 4, 5, and 6
Web channel identified by channel_code = 'WB' in fact_sales_line

answer.sql: WITH lfl_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id < 900 AND store_id NOT IN (129, 137) AND is_current = TRUE), store_current_region AS (SELECT store_id, region AS current_region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)), sales_q3_fy25_26 AS (SELECT s.store_id, scr.current_region, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN store_current_region scr ON s.store_id = scr.store_id INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND f.channel_code = 'ST' GROUP BY s.store_id, scr.current_region), sales_q3_fy24_25 AS (SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN lfl_stores ls ON s.store_id = ls.store_id INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND f.channel_code = 'ST' GROUP BY s.store_id) SELECT sq26.current_region AS region, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sq26.sales, 0)), 2) AS sales_q3_fy25_26, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sq25.sales, 0)), 2) AS sales_q3_fy24_25, CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(sq25.sales, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(COALESCE(sq26.sales, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(sq25.sales, 0))) / SUM(COALESCE(sq25.sales, 0)), 1) END AS lfl_growth_pct FROM sales_q3_fy25_26 sq26 FULL OUTER JOIN sales_q3_fy24_25 sq25 ON sq26.store_id = sq25.store_id GROUP BY sq26.current_region ORDER BY sq26.current_region
definitions_applied: Like-for-like stores: physical locations open for the full duration of both Q3 periods
Fiscal calendar: Q3 spans three fiscal periods (periods 7, 8, 9); FY2025/26 Q3 runs 2025-10-27 to 2026-01-25; FY2024/25 Q3 runs 2024-10-28 to 2025-01-26
Store channel: only store sales included (channel_code = 'ST'), excluding web and pseudo-locations
Net sales: EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts
assumptions: Stores that changed regional classification (stores 101-105 moved South→Capital Region, store 114 moved East→South effective 2025-04-28) are treated as same-store comparisons at their current regional assignment
Store 129 (Savonlinna, East) excluded: closed 2026-01-25, exactly at Q3 end, creating asymmetry
Store 137 (Lohja, South) excluded: opened 2024-11-04 during Q3 FY2024/25, not a full-period comparable
Pseudo-locations (Online store 900, Head office 999) excluded from like-for-like base
caveats: CRITICAL: All regions show 92-93% like-for-like sales decline year-over-year in Q3. This warrants urgent investigation. The magnitude of decline is consistent across all regions, suggesting either a systematic business issue, a data quality problem, or a measurement methodology change between periods. Data is marked as fully_loaded in the fiscal calendar, so incomplete loading is not the issue.

Capital Region stores (101-105) were reclassified from South on 2025-04-28. Historical Q3 FY2024/25 sales for these stores are counted in South region; current period counted in Capital Region. This is methodologically correct for same-store comparison but creates asymmetry in regional totals.
Store 114 (Kouvola) moved from East to South on 2025-04-28 and is assigned to South in current period, though it was historically East. Similar region-bridging applies.
Query execution used 29 of 30 available queries.

answer.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY p.product_name, p.sku ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Units sold = sum of quantity column from fact_sales_line table
Period 5 = fiscal period 5 from the company's ref_fiscal_calendar
Store identified by store_id in dim_store table
Current time context: request dated 2026-10-07
assumptions: Period 5 this year interpreted as FY2026/27 P05 (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27), the most recently completed period 5 as of the request date
All transaction types included in units sold (staff purchases and regular sales)
Positive quantities only (fact_sales_line records in the forward direction)
caveats: Data verified: 2121 sales lines for Helsinki Pitäjänmäki in FY2026/27 P05 provide a solid sample
No missing product names or store identifiers found in the result set
All three products have distinct SKUs and names; no aggregation of variants applied

answer.sql: SELECT ds.format AS store_format, ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS average_transaction_value FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND rfc.fiscal_period = 4 WHERE fsl.sale_date >= rfc.period_start_date AND fsl.sale_date <= rfc.period_end_date AND ds.store_id < 900 GROUP BY ds.format ORDER BY ds.format
definitions_applied: Average transaction value = total net sales (excluding VAT) ÷ number of distinct receipts
Period 4 = fiscal period 4 in the retail calendar
Store format from dim_store current versions
Net sales from fact_sales_line including both store and web channel sales
assumptions: Request for 'this year' interpreted as current fiscal year FY2026/27
Store format refers to physical store classifications only; web channel (store_id 900) excluded
Transaction value measured by receipt (one receipt may contain multiple lines)
Net amount used rather than gross amount (excluding VAT per standard retail reporting)
Training store (store_id 999) excluded as a non-standard retail location
caveats: Web sales (3229 receipts, €209105.59 total) and training store sales (55 receipts, €1884.86) excluded from this report; if inclusion is required, web ATV is €64.25
Period 4 FY2026/27 spans 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30 (past data relative to request date 2026-10-06)
No data quality issues detected: all 48107 sales lines in the period have valid net_amount and store_key values

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) >= DATE '2024-08-01'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) <= DATE '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.business_date)
         WHEN 8 THEN 'August 2024'
         WHEN 9 THEN 'September 2024'
       END AS month,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) AS sales_incl_vat
FROM lines l
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.business_date)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.business_date);
definitions_applied: DEF-VAT-GROSS: Sales including VAT, calculated as the sum of gross_amount on the sales lines; every line carries its own VAT rate
REG-VAT-CHANGE: General VAT rate changed from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024; reduced rates (14% and 10%) did not change
DEF-NET-SALES-SCOPE: Training store 999 and test category ZZ Test excluded as company policy
DEF-WEB-RECOGNITION: Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date, not order date
TEAM-SALES-BEFORE-RETURNS: Figures report original sale amounts, not net of returns
assumptions: Interpreted 'store sales' as total company sales across all channels (physical stores and web)
Calendar dates: August 1–31, 2024 and September 1–30, 2024
Web orders included only if status is 'delivered' or 'collected'; 'processing' and 'cancelled' excluded
Physical store sales dated by sale_date; web sales by dispatch_date in Helsinki time
caveats: Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test (test articles) are excluded from all figures per company policy
VAT rate rose on 1 September 2024 from 24% to 25.5% general rate. August figures use 24%, 14%, 10% rates; September includes 25.5% plus 24%, 14%, 10% for items from the previous day and refunds
Web orders dated by dispatch, not order date. Cancelled and processing orders are not included.
The net sales before returns underlying these gross figures total €1,241,886.32 in August and €1,091,919.49 in September, validated against rpt_daily_store_sales

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, round(avg(wk_value),2) AS avg_stock_value_at_cost_eur FROM (SELECT f.week_ending_date, sum(f.closing_value) AS wk_value FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY 1) t
definitions_applied: Stock value at cost = closing_value in fact_stock_week (closing units at standard unit cost)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 3 = 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02, fiscal weeks 9 to 13, five weekly stock counts (week-ending Sundays 5, 12, 19, 26 July and 2 August 2026)
Category = Paint & Decorating (all four subcategories: Interior Paint, Exterior Paint, Brushes & Rollers, Wallpaper & Decor Film), taken from the product version joined on product_key
Average stock = sum of closing value across all stores and SKUs for each weekly count, then the simple mean of those five weekly totals
Whole chain = all 38 physical stores that hold stock
assumptions: 'This year' is read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, since the request is dated 2026-10-08. Period 3 is therefore 29 June to 2 August 2026.
'Average stock' is read as the mean of the five end-of-week closing stock values in the period. Each week has equal weight.

'Whole chain' means all stores in the stock table. No pseudo-locations are present: the web shop (900) and training store (999) hold no stock rows. Savonlinna (129, closed 2026-01-25) holds none either.
'Paint & Decorating' means the product category of that name. It does not include 'Home Textiles & Decor', which is a separate category.
caveats: No data problem needing a correction was found for this question, so no corrections were applied. Checks run: all five weeks are loaded in full (fiscal period 3 is flagged fully_loaded). There are no duplicate store and SKU rows, no negative or null values, and closing_value equals closing units times the current standard unit cost in every week. No Paint & Decorating SKU changed category between product versions. The Garden to Electrical outdoor-lighting reclassification does not touch it. The weekly totals run smoothly from 341.1k to 349.2k euro.

Three Paint & Decorating SKUs delisted on 2026-07-01 (101007, 101166, 101187) appear only in the first week, at zero value, so they do not affect the average. The number of SKU rows per week falls from 2,699 to 2,674 after the first week because of this.
The figure is stock valued at standard cost, which is revalued each April. It is not valued at purchase price or at selling price.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_start, (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4) py_end, (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_start, (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) cy_end), lfl_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM dim_store s, per WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900 AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date < per.py_start) AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date > per.cy_end) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=s.store_id AND ((c.closure_start_date<=per.py_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.py_start) OR (c.closure_start_date<=per.cy_end AND c.closure_end_date>=per.cy_start)))), agg AS (SELECT sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.py_start AND per.py_end then d.net_sales end) py, sum(case when d.business_date BETWEEN per.cy_start AND per.cy_end then d.net_sales end) cy FROM lfl_stores st JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales d ON d.store_id=st.store_id, per) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, round(100*(cy/py-1),2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM agg
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 4 from ref_fiscal_calendar: 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (FY2026/27) against 28 Jul to 24 Aug 2025 (FY2025/26), both 4 weeks, fiscal weeks 14 to 17
Net sales = sales excluding VAT after line discounts, less refunds booked on the day of the return (the definition in rpt_daily_store_sales.net_sales)
Like-for-like store set: physical stores only (store_id below 900), trading on every day of both periods, with no refit closure overlapping either period and not closed since
Excluded the web shop (store 900, including click-and-collect) and the training store (999)
Staff purchases left in, as in the company's daily store sales report
Stores identified by store_id (stable across versions), not store_key
assumptions: 'This year' means FY2026/27 and 'last year' means FY2025/26, the same fiscal period 4, which is fully loaded in the warehouse
The comparison is fiscal-period against fiscal-period (same fiscal weeks 14 to 17), not the same calendar dates and not 52 weeks back
No written like-for-like rule was available. I used 'the store traded on every day of both P4 windows and was not shut for a refit in either', which gives 38 stores
Stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2 Sep 2024) and 137 Lohja (opened 4 Nov 2024) are included because both traded fully in both windows, even though they were under 12 months old at last year's P4
The answer is the growth rate across all 38 stores combined (sum of current net sales over sum of prior-year net sales), not an average of store growth rates
Request read as one overall LFL figure, not a store-by-store or regional breakdown
caveats: Result: like-for-like net sales were flat, -0.03%. 38 stores, EUR 1,010,478.52 this year against EUR 1,010,743.32 last year

Excluded from like-for-like: store 129 Savonlinna (closed 25 Jan 2026, no sales in P4 2026); the web shop 900; and the training store 999, which has small sales in both years (about EUR 2,500 last year, EUR 1,900 this year) and must not be counted as a store
Total stores including all trading locations were not flat: the web shop is not a store and is left out of this figure

FY2025/26 was a 53-week year, so last year's P4 started 371 days before this year's rather than 364. The comparison is fiscal-week aligned, which is the company calendar, but the calendar dates differ by 6 days

Refit closures in the table do not overlap either P4 window: store 104 (Jul to Aug 2024), store 119 (Sep to Oct 2025) and store 125 (15 Jun to 26 Jul 2026). Store 125 reopened one week before this year's P4 began, so its sales may still be settling. Leaving 125 out gives -0.19%

Leaving out stores 136 and 137 (under 12 months old at last year's P4) gives -0.23%; leaving out all three (125, 136, 137) gives -0.41%. The conclusion is the same in every case: sales were flat to slightly down

The tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 tables were not used. They are unlabelled working lists, still contain store 129 (since closed) and exclude 136 and 137, and cannot be tied to a stated rule

Stage tables (stg_*) hold only 3 to 4 October 2026 and do not overlap P4, so they do not affect the figure. Sales and refund lines had no duplicate IDs, and the daily report table matched the fact tables exactly for every store in both periods
Returns are counted on the date of the refund, not the date of the original sale, so a refund in P4 can relate to an earlier sale

answer.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND d.store_id <> 999), r AS (SELECT sum(x.refund_net) AS amt FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = x.store_key WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND d.store_id <> 999) SELECT round(s.amt - r.amt, 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM s, r
definitions_applied: Net sales = sales line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns
Whole company = all physical stores plus the web shop (store_id 900), home delivery and click and collect both included
Sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki local date), returns dated by return_date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales
Store and web joined via the surrogate store_key to dim_store
Staff purchases included, as in the team's daily store sales report
Cancelled web orders carry no sales lines, so nothing to remove
assumptions: Request received 9 Oct 2026, so 'last month' is read as calendar September 2026 (1-30 Sep), not a fiscal period; the warehouse is loaded through 4 Oct 2026, so September is complete
'Net sales' means EUR excluding VAT and after returns, the definition in rpt_daily_store_sales
Returns are deducted in the month they are booked, not matched to the month of the original sale
Staff purchases (13,499.45 EUR net in physical stores) are kept in the total
caveats: Training store (store_id 999, head office training location) rang up 3,084.66 EUR net in 160 lines in September; it is not a real trading location, so it is excluded

The channel_code column is NULL on sales lines since the web-platform migration, so the web shop must be identified by channel_id or store_id 900. The view rpt.v_daily_sales filters on channel_code = 'WB' and so would drop all of September's web sales (205,567.52 EUR gross of returns) from a company total

rpt_daily_store_sales agrees exactly with the fact tables for physical stores (988,592.16 EUR net), but its web shop figure for September (190,443.82 EUR) is 4,422.88 EUR higher than the fact tables (186,020.94 EUR), with daily differences in both directions, apparently a date-basis difference. I used the fact tables, so the answer is 4,422.88 EUR lower than the report's total of 1,179,035.98 EUR (which also includes the report's own web figure)
Split of the answer: physical stores 988,592.16 EUR, web 186,020.94 EUR (sales 205,567.52 minus returns 19,546.58); total returns 74,262.24 EUR on 1,248,875.34 EUR of sales before returns
If 'month' meant fiscal period P05 (31 Aug-27 Sep 2026, the last fully loaded period) the figure would differ; not calculated

answer.sql: WITH receipts AS (SELECT f.receipt_id, s.format AS store_format, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS any_staff FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY f.receipt_id, s.format) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, store_format, round(avg(receipt_net), 2) AS average_basket_value_eur_excl_vat FROM receipts WHERE NOT any_staff GROUP BY store_format ORDER BY CASE store_format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Basket = transaction = one receipt (all lines sharing a receipt_id summed), not one line
Average basket value = total net sales of the receipts divided by the number of receipts
Basket value in EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), matching the net sales convention used in rpt_daily_store_sales
Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 taken from dim_date (fiscal_year = FY2026/27, fiscal_period = 4), which is 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)

Store format taken from the dim_store version in force at the sale date (via store_key); each store keeps the same format across its versions, so no sale lands in a different format than the store's own
Physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop (900) and the training store (999) are left out
Sales receipts only, before returns; refunds are not netted off the basket
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) left out of the baskets
assumptions: Read 'period 4 of FY26/27' as fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27, 3 to 30 August 2026, and not as calendar month 4 or quarter 4
Read 'by store format' as the physical store formats only, so the web shop (format 'Web') and click-and-collect or home-delivery orders are not a row
Read 'average basket value' as net of VAT in EUR, as the company reports sales net of VAT
Excluded staff purchases because they are not ordinary customer baskets. This is my choice, since the request did not say; including them would give Small 50.67, Medium 60.15 and Large 60.60
Simple mean of all receipts in each format, so every receipt counts equally and larger stores weigh more because they have more receipts, rather than an average of store averages
caveats: Correction: the 55 receipts (127 lines, EUR 1,884.86) booked to the training store 999 in the period are excluded. They are not real trading and would otherwise sit in an extra 'Training' format.
Correction: web shop sales (3,229 receipts: 2,230 home delivery and 999 click-and-collect) are excluded, because they belong to no store format.
Correction: 280 staff-purchase receipts are excluded (Large 99, Medium 138, Small 43). They lower the averages only slightly (by 0.08 to 0.12 EUR).

The dim_store column comment says formats are Hyper, Standard or Express, but the data holds Small, Medium and Large (plus Web and Training). I used the values in the data. The regional labels in dim_store also differ from the comment (a 'Capital Region' value exists, and the stores moved region in April 2025). This does not affect the result.
fact_sales_line.channel_code is empty for the period (it has no ST or WB values), so I used channel_id and store_id < 900 to separate stores from web.

The receipt count for physical stores including staff purchases (18,027 receipts, EUR 1,062,266.72) ties exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for the period, and I found no duplicate lines, no non-positive amounts and no receipt split across stores or dates. Receipts in the result: Small 2,598, Medium 8,641, Large 6,508.
The period is fully loaded and the Kuopio refit closure ended on 26 July 2026, before the period began, so no store was shut during it. Savonlinna, closed since January 2026, has no sales.
Using gross (VAT-inclusive) baskets instead would give higher figures. The mean gross basket was about 63.6 for Small, about 75.6 for Medium and about 76.1 for Large.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, by distinct member_id, taking the member's first version in dim_member
Online sign-ups (home store 900) are counted as new members
Members counted by natural key member_id, not member_key, so later versions do not duplicate them
Source is dim_member only; no deprecated, staging, backup or tmp tables used
assumptions: 25 September 2026 is read as the calendar date, a Friday. It is the date the members joined, so there is no UTC/Helsinki conversion.
'New members' means all loyalty sign-ups, in stores and online, as one total. Jukka asked for no breakdown, so there is no split by enrolling store.
No tier, consent or other filter was applied.
caveats: No data problem was found. The warehouse is loaded to 4 Oct 2026, so 25 Sep is fully covered. Each of the 39 members has exactly one version starting on the join date. There are no duplicate member_id or version rows. No member has more than one join_date.
Online sign-ups account for 8 of the 39. The other 31 enrolled in 18 different physical stores. Ask if you want the split by store.
The query counts first-version rows, so a later change of tier, home store or consent would not add a second count.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), by_year AS (SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period, py.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / py.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct FROM by_year ty JOIN by_year py ON py.category = ty.category AND py.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their return date, not the original sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only; cancelled and processing orders excluded)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
As-is reporting: categories taken from the current product version (outdoor lighting counted in Electrical in both years)
Fiscal calendar: period 8 is fiscal weeks 31 to 34, compared by fiscal week number, not calendar dates
Web shop (store 900) included, since the request is for category sales and not for physical stores only
Control total: daily net sales by store checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: Request received 5 October 2026 (FY2026/27), so 'last year' is read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25, as in past accepted requests
Growth is FY2025/26 P8 against FY2024/25 P8, as a percentage change in net sales
Garden and Electrical are shown as two separate categories, not combined, since the request names them separately
Category reporting is as-is (current hierarchy), the company default, because the requester did not ask for as-was
Web sales are included in the category figures
caveats: Outdoor lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 October 2025, and P8 FY2024/25 sits before that move. I reported as-is, so EUR 19,504.55 of outdoor lighting net sales in FY2024/25 P8 counts under Electrical. On an as-was basis, FY2024/25 Electrical would be 142,914.41 and Garden 56,269.57 (a correction of this size moves the growth figures to about +19.8% for Electrical and about -34.6% for Garden, which would be misleading because the categories are not like for like). Commercial should use the as-is figures for a like-for-like category comparison.

Period 8 is dated 24 November to 21 December 2025 against 25 November to 22 December 2024: four weeks each, lined up by fiscal week number (31 to 34). Week 53 is not in P8, so it does not affect this comparison.

During the checks I found 418 duplicated sales lines (loaded twice, on 16 and 23 September 2025) in store 116 on 15 September 2025, in FY2025/26 P5. They are outside period 8 and do not affect these figures. They would overstate P5 and should be fixed before anyone reports on that period.

The query's daily net sales by store match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for both periods (EUR 1,435,696.60 for FY2025/26 P8 and EUR 1,373,188.97 for FY2024/25 P8 across all categories), so no unexplained gap remains.
Garden is essentially flat (+0.13%), partly because it is a small category in this December period and no longer includes outdoor lighting in either year on the as-is basis.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
    1 AS period_from,
    3 AS period_to,
    ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT net_sales FROM store_sales), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT net_sales FROM web_sales), 0)) / 
           (COALESCE((SELECT receipts FROM store_sales), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT orders FROM web_sales), 0)), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales st
CROSS JOIN web_sales w
LIMIT 1
definitions_applied: Net sales (excluding VAT, after returns, excluding store 999 and category ZZ Test)
Staff purchases excluded from transaction value
Store scope: store_id below 900 for receipts
Web recognition: sales on dispatch date (Helsinki time), orders on order date (Helsinki time)
Cancelled web orders excluded from order count
assumptions: Periods 1 to 3 this year = FY2026/27 P1-P3 (periods 1-13 of current fiscal year)
Request for web orders to be included overrides company standard definition (ATV normally store-only measure)
Web orders and store receipts treated as equivalent transaction units for combined ATV
caveats: This calculation deviates from company's standard ATV definition, which excludes web orders (store-only ATV for this period is 55.52 EUR)
Blended metric combines two different transaction types: physical store receipts (66,984 count, 3,719,186.33 EUR, ATV 55.52 EUR) with web orders (12,959 count, 771,025.31 EUR, ATV 59.50 EUR)
Web sales recognized on dispatch date while store sales use sale date; dates converted from UTC to Helsinki time for web data
No data quality issues detected in the specified period

answer.sql: WITH weekly_totals AS (SELECT fsw.week_ending_date, SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_total_value FROM fact_stock_week fsw INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key WHERE dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND dp.is_current = TRUE AND fsw.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02' AND ds.store_id < 900 GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date) SELECT AVG(weekly_total_value) as average_stock_value_eur FROM weekly_totals
definitions_applied: Paint & Decorating product category
Stock value at standard cost in EUR from fact_stock_week.closing_value
Whole chain excludes non-physical locations (store_id < 900)
Average calculated from weekly aggregated totals
assumptions: "This year" refers to fiscal year FY2026/27 (current as of request date 2026-10-08)
"Period 3" refers to fiscal period 3
"For the whole chain" means all physical store locations aggregated (store_id < 900)
Average stock interpreted as mean of weekly total stock values across the period

answer.sql: SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by sale date
Store-level analysis covers physical stores only (Nokia is store_id 118)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Subcategory reported as-is (current product version via sku and is_current)
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P5 = 31 Aug 2026 to 27 Sep 2026 (weeks 18 to 21)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (units_sold and net_sales_before_returns)
assumptions: 'Nokia' is the store Nokia (store_id 118, region West, format Medium), the only match in dim_store
'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, and 'period 5' is its P5, which is complete (ended 27 Sep 2026)
'Units sold' is gross units on sales lines, not net of returned units, as in the weeks-of-cover definition
Subcategories are as-is (current hierarchy); as-was gives the same top 3 because none of the top subcategories changed
Staff purchases are included, as in net sales and units sold; no definition excludes them from unit counts
caveats: No data problems found. Nokia's 1,250 sales lines for the period have no duplicate lines, and units (2,245) and net sales before returns (29,540.71 EUR) match rpt_daily_store_sales on all 28 days, store 118, with no test-article lines affecting them.
Fixings & Fasteners (570 units) is far ahead of the rest because it is a low-priced, small-pack range (about 43 SKUs, 189 lines). I checked it and the quantities are ordinary, not outliers.

Third place is close. Storage Boxes has 139 units, Cleaning Products and Plants & Flowers 136 each. If returned units were netted off (7 for Fixings, 5 for Indoor Lighting, 9 for Storage Boxes, 2 for Cleaning Products, 7 for Plants & Flowers), third place would go to Cleaning Products (134 against 130). I reported gross units sold as the company definition reads.
The period has 28 days, all within the warehouse load (through 4 Oct 2026).

answer.sql: SELECT p.subcategory, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.refund_net) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY p.subcategory ORDER BY p.subcategory
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: Q1 of FY2025/26 runs 2025-04-28 to 2025-07-27 (13 weeks, from ref_fiscal_calendar)
Return rate by sale cohort: refunds are tied to the original sales line (fact_return_line.sales_line_id), so returns booked after the quarter count against the Q1 sale
Return rate on value: refund_net divided by net_amount, both in EUR excluding VAT
Product hierarchy as at the sale date: fact_sales_line.product_key points to the product version in force on that day
Training store (store_id 999) excluded as a pseudo-location, not a trading store
Web shop (store_id 900) sales and returns included, as web lines are goods sold
Returns are one row per sales line, so there is no double counting
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because today (2026-10-06) falls in FY2026/27. 'Q1' is read as fiscal Q1 (28 Apr to 27 Jul 2025). If Pekka meant calendar Q1 2025 (Jan to Mar), the answer would differ.

'Return rate' is read as returned value divided by sold value (net of VAT). A unit-based rate is very close: Barbecue 6.47, Edible Plants 0.99, Garden Furniture 12.69, Garden Tools 5.19, Outdoor Lighting 7.23, Plants & Flowers 2.72, Pots & Planters 3.89, Soil & Fertiliser 1.71.
Staff purchases (about 1.5% of Garden lines) are kept in, since they are real goods sold and real returns. Taking them out moves each rate by 0.1 percentage points or less.
Each row's subcategory is the one assigned to the article on the sale date, using the product-version key stored on the sales line.
Sales and returns are measured at the 'Garden' category level, with all web and store channels combined.
caveats: Correction: the 136 Garden sales lines (net EUR 2,496) booked to the 'Training store' (store_id 999) were excluded. They had no returns. It changes Barbecue & Grills from 7.25 to 7.26 and Garden Furniture from 12.85 to 12.87.

Reclassification: Outdoor Lighting was a Garden subcategory until 2025-10-26 and has been Electrical since 2025-10-27 (73 articles). I kept it in Garden because that is where these goods sat when they were sold in Q1 2025. If Pekka wants today's Garden range only, drop that row. The seven remaining subcategories do not change. The Outdoor Lighting figure is 7.16% (net sales EUR 50,870, refunds EUR 3,640).
The test articles in category 'ZZ Test' (92 sales lines in the period) are not Garden and are not in the result.
Returns are measured up to 2026-10-04. The longest gap between a Garden Q1 sale and its return was 34 days, so the Q1 2025 cohort is fully matured and further returns are not expected.

The staging tables (stg_*), backup tables (bak_*) and old dimension tables (*_old) were not used. The staging tables hold only 3 to 4 October 2026 loads, which duplicate rows already in the fact tables.

Garden Furniture (12.87%) is the clear outlier, followed by Barbecue & Grills and Outdoor Lighting (about 7%). Edible Plants & Seeds (0.96%) and Soil & Fertiliser (1.58%) are the lowest, partly because many lines are multi-unit and low value.

answer.sql: SELECT s.format AS store_format, count(distinct f.receipt_id) AS transactions, round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(distinct f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_eur_ex_vat FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE staff_purchase_flag) GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 4 = 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
ATV = net sales (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) divided by number of distinct receipts
Transaction = distinct receipt_id
Store format taken from dim_store through the sales line's store_key (version valid at the sale date)
Store channel only (channel_id 1); store_id below 900
Staff purchases excluded (whole receipts flagged staff_purchase_flag)
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (request dated 6 Oct 2026), so period 4 is 3 to 30 Aug 2026
ATV is measured on net sales before returns, because a return is not a new basket and refunds can relate to earlier periods
Staff purchases are not customer baskets, so those receipts are left out of both numerator and denominator
Web orders (home delivery and click-and-collect, store_id 900) are left out because they have no store format
ATV is excluding VAT, matching the net-sales basis of the daily sales report
caveats: Training store 999 (127 lines, 55 receipts, EUR 1,884.86) is excluded as it is not a trading store
Web shop (store_id 900; 3,229 orders in the period) excluded from the store-format breakdown

280 staff-purchase receipts excluded (17,747 customer receipts remain across the 38 trading stores in the period; counts reconcile with rpt_daily_store_sales). Including them gives Large 60.60, Medium 60.15, Small 50.67
If ATV is wanted after returns (rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales divided by receipts, staff included), the figures are lower: Large 57.31, Medium 57.27, Small 48.87
The dim_store column comment says formats are Hyper, Standard or Express, but the data holds Large, Medium and Small (8, 18 and 12 stores respectively in the period); I used the values in the data
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 Jan 2026 and has no sales in the period; Kerava's later closure-free status and the Kuopio (125) refit ended 26 Jul 2026, so all 38 stores traded the whole period
Period 4 is complete in the warehouse (ref_fiscal_calendar fully_loaded = true), with no duplicate lines and gross/net/VAT consistent on every line

answer.sql: SELECT cs.format AS store_format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (EUR excl. VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop is out and store 999 is out
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Test articles excluded (category ZZ Test)
Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 taken from dim_date: fiscal weeks 14 to 17, 3 August to 30 August 2026 (Helsinki sale_date)
Format taken from the current store version (dim_store is_current); format is the same in every store version
Control total: net sales before returns and receipt counts for all 38 stores match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for the period
assumptions: Read 'period 4 of FY26/27' as FY2026/27 P04, which is complete in the warehouse (it ended 30 August 2026)
Read 'average basket value' as the company metric ATV (average transaction value), as the request itself equates them
Stores are grouped by the three formats the warehouse holds for physical stores (Large, Medium, Small). The Web format is not shown because ATV excludes web orders
The request does not ask for a total across all formats, so none is given
caveats: The dim_store.format column comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date. The actual values are Large (8 stores), Medium (18 stores) and Small (12 stores), plus Web for store 900, which is excluded from ATV

The control total in rpt_daily_store_sales matches before the staff-purchase exclusion. The ATV figures are therefore lower in count than the control: 236 Large, 330 Medium and 100 Small staff-purchase lines were removed, and each receipt is wholly staff or wholly non-staff
The format ATVs are on receipts: Large 6,508 receipts and 394,865.46 EUR, Medium 8,641 receipts and 520,763.45 EUR, Small 2,598 receipts and 131,841.05 EUR (net sales before returns, excl. VAT)

The checks found no duplicate sales lines and no test-article lines in the period, and no receipt spans more than one store or date. channel_code is not populated since the November 2025 migration, so it was not used

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')) SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 3
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (not the order date)
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders have dispatch dates and sales lines)
Including VAT = sum of gross_amount on the sales lines, using each line's own VAT rate
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 Q2, P4 = 29 Jul to 25 Aug 2024, P5 = 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024, P6 = 23 Sep to 27 Oct 2024
Timestamps converted from UTC to Helsinki time before dating
assumptions: Q2 of FY24/25 means fiscal year FY2024/25, quarter 2 (periods 4 to 6), as the request states.
Read 'before returns' as gross sales lines only, with no refunds deducted. Refunds including VAT (refund_gross) are not included or shown.
Web sales dated by Helsinki dispatch date, the company default, even though the figure is gross and before returns. For click-and-collect this is the ready-for-collection date.
Figures are in EUR including VAT.
caveats: Two web order lines for test articles (category ZZ Test) were excluded, as is standard.

The net equivalents (excluding VAT, before returns) were 126242.65, 122660.57 and 153786.32 for P4, P5 and P6. They match the net-sales-before-returns control total in rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly for all three periods.

The VAT-inclusive figures use each line's own rate. The general rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls in P5, so the periods are not at a uniform rate. Gross is not net multiplied by a flat rate.
No duplicate sales lines or web orders were found, and the order totals and line counts agree with the sales lines. No data problem required a correction.
Orders are dated by dispatch, so an order placed near the end of a period and dispatched in the next one is counted in the next period.

answer.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(d.net_sales) DESC) as rank, s.store_id, s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(d.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d INNER JOIN dim_store s ON d.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE WHERE d.business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales (excluding VAT) from rpt_daily_store_sales
Fiscal period 2 FY2026/27 (01 June – 28 June 2026)
Current store master records only
assumptions: Period 2 this year interpreted as fiscal period 2 of current fiscal year (FY2026/27)
Ranking metric interpreted as net sales value (most recent complete period)
Web shop (store_id 900) included as active sales channel
caveats: Training store (store_id 999) excluded from ranking; had zero sales activity during the period
Web shop (store_id 900) represents online channel, not a physical location
All figures are net sales excluding VAT in EUR

answer.sql: SELECT m.home_store_id as store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as new_members FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = true WHERE m.join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND m.join_date <= '2026-05-03' AND m.join_date >= CAST(m.valid_from AS DATE) AND m.join_date <= CAST(m.valid_to AS DATE) GROUP BY m.home_store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY m.home_store_id
definitions_applied: Last year as fiscal year FY2025/26 (2025-04-28 to 2026-05-03)
New members as members whose join_date falls within the fiscal year
Members attributed to their home_store_id at the time of signup using valid_from/valid_to date ranges
Deduplication via COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) to handle slowly changing dimension
assumptions: Last year refers to fiscal year 2025/26, which ended approximately 5 months ago
Members are grouped by their home_store_id at signup time (earliest valid record for join_date), not their current home store
Online sign-ups are identified by home_store_id = 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
caveats: 6,402 members (43% of new members in FY2025/26) subsequently changed their home_store after signup. These members are attributed to their original home store at signup, not their current home store.
Members may have changed tier, marketing consent, or other attributes after signup; only their home_store_id at signup is used for attribution.
No data quality issues detected; all members have valid home_store_id values.

answer.sql: SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, one row per order
Order date taken in Helsinki time (UTC timestamp converted to Europe/Helsinki)
Cancelled orders excluded, processing orders included
Test articles (ZZ Test) and store 999 excluded; none found on this day
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 read as Monday 1 December 2025, as given in the request
The day is the Helsinki calendar day, not the UTC day
Cancelled orders are not counted as web orders, in line with the company definition and past web-order requests
Guest and logged-in orders are both counted
Click-and-collect and home delivery orders are both counted
caveats: Order timestamps are stored in UTC. Filtering on the UTC date would give 274 orders instead of 326, so the Helsinki day was used.
19 orders placed on the day were cancelled and are left out. Counting them would give 345.
No order placed on the day was still in processing, and all 326 counted orders have sales lines. No duplicate order IDs and no ZZ Test orders were found, so no other corrections were needed.

answer.sql:
-- Top 10 products by gross margin in the South region, Q4 FY2024/25 (as-is)
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 10 AS first_period, 12 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_product AS (
    SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
      AND cs.region = 'South'
      AND n.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name
)
SELECT sku, product_name, gross_margin
FROM by_product
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
definitions_applied: Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost of goods sold, after returns
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns; store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
South region: current region assignment (as-is)
Web sales recognized on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Returns deducted on return date at their standard cost
assumptions: Q4 FY2024/25 interpreted as fiscal periods 10-12 (fiscal weeks 40-52, 27 January to 27 April 2025)
As-is reporting used (current product and store versions) since as-was was not specified
Web shop (store 900) excluded from regional analysis per company convention that web is not assigned to any physical region
Ranked by absolute gross margin amount (EUR), not percentage
Gross margin pct shown in validation but excluded from final result as not requested
caveats: Web orders booked to regional totals via Helsinki dispatch date; all other transactions use sale date for region assignment

The Capital Region currently includes stores that historically were in South (101, 102, 103, 104, 105), but this period (Q4 FY2024/25) falls entirely before the 28 April 2025 region reorganisation, so historical and current region boundaries are identical for this period
No data quality issues found; query-check validation passed all checks

answer.sql: WITH web_lines AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount, o.member_key AS order_member FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11) SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_member IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct FROM web_lines GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Member share of sales: net sales before returns on member-linked lines divided by all net sales before returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (dispatch_ts_utc converted to Europe/Helsinki)
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders have sales lines)
Guest web orders count as non-member
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Net amount excluding VAT, before returns
Fiscal periods from dim_date (FY2025/26 P9 to P11, as-is hierarchy)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 (net_sales_before_returns)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26: the request was made on 9 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests in that position (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35) took FY2025/26
'Periods 9 to 11' read as FY2025/26 P9 (22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026, 5 weeks), P10 (26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026, 4 weeks) and P11 (23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026, 4 weeks), one row per period
Web sales taken as all of store 900, click-and-collect included, as the company counts it
Returns not netted off, because member share is defined before returns
Member status taken from fact_web_order.member_key (logged_in orders) rather than from the line's member_key, for the reason given in the caveats
caveats: Data defect corrected: in fact_sales_line, web lines for logged-in orders have a null member_key on lines sold between 9 Feb and 1 Mar 2026 (fiscal weeks 42 to 45). 706 lines in P10 and 603 lines in P11 are affected. The order header in fact_web_order still carries the member key for every one of these orders. I used the order-level member key. Using the line member_key as it stands would understate the member share: 51.76% in P10 (not 67.52%) and 55.81% in P11 (not 66.70%). P9 is not affected. The correction moves 21,669.74 EUR of net sales in P10 and 16,311.55 EUR in P11 from non-member to member. The line-level member_key should be fixed in the warehouse.
The web net sales totals (EUR excluding VAT, before returns) match rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 exactly in all three periods: 219,929.50 in P9, 137,569.07 in P10 and 149,798.62 in P11.

The ZZ Test filter changed one total: P11 web net sales are 4.00 EUR lower with the filter, from a test article on a web order. The other two periods were unaffected. The control total above is without that filter, so it still matches.
P9 is a 5-week period and P10 and P11 are 4 weeks, so the euro amounts are not directly comparable between periods. The shares are.
Week 53 and the web migration of 3 November 2025 do not fall in these periods, so neither affects the result.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6), sales AS (SELECT p.category, f.net_amount AS net_amt, f.standard_cost AS cost_amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999), rets AS (SELECT p.category, -r.refund_net AS net_amt, -r.standard_cost_returned AS cost_amt FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, category, round(sum(net_amt),2) AS net_sales_eur, round(100*(sum(net_amt)-sum(cost_amt))/sum(net_amt),2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM u GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 period 6 = 22 Sep 2025 to 26 Oct 2025 (5 weeks), taken from ref_fiscal_calendar
Net sales = net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) less refund_net on returns booked in the period
Gross margin % = (net sales less standard cost of units sold, net of standard cost of units returned) / net sales
Sale date (local date) used for sales; return_date used for returns, matching how rpt_daily_store_sales books refunds
Category taken from the product version in force at the sale or return date (fact table product_key)
All channels included: stores and the web shop
Training store 999 excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location
assumptions: 'Last year' means the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26. The current year FY2026/27 is in progress and its period 6 (28 Sep to 1 Nov 2026) is not fully loaded.
'Period 6' means fiscal period 6 of the company's fiscal calendar, not calendar month 6.
Categories reported as they were classified at the time (as-was), which is how the warehouse stores them.
Net sales are after returns, as in the company's daily net sales report; gross margin uses standard cost, the only cost in the warehouse.
Staff purchases are included, as they are in rpt_daily_store_sales. They come to about 2.3k EUR net in Electrical and 1.8k EUR in Garden, at lower margins (about 31% and 32%).
Web shop sales are included, taken from fact_sales_line.
caveats: Outdoor Lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 Oct 2025, the day after this period ended. The figures use the old hierarchy, so Garden includes Outdoor Lighting (about 34.1k EUR net sales after returns, margin about 37.3%). On today's hierarchy, Garden would be about 113.8k EUR at about 40.2% margin and Electrical about 219.7k EUR at about 41.0%. Compare with later periods or this year's period 6 only on one basis. The 'ZZ Test' products are not in either category.

Corrected: sales rung through store 999 (Training store, head office) were excluded. They are test transactions, are not in rpt_daily_store_sales and amount to a few hundred euros in these categories.
Before returns, net sales are 194,617 EUR (Electrical) and 157,923 EUR (Garden). Returns booked in the period were about 9.0k EUR and 10.0k EUR.

Not corrected: rpt_daily_store_sales shows higher web-shop (store 900) sales than fact_sales_line (for example 10,131 vs 5,922 EUR on 22 Sep 2025). Its store rows match the fact table exactly. I used the fact table and did not use the report for web sales, and I did not find the cause of the difference.

Gross margin is at standard cost (revalued each April), not actual purchase cost, so it is a standard margin. Cost in the sales lines matched quantity times the product standard cost on every line in these categories.

answer.sql: WITH web_lines AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date, f.net_amount, o.member_key AS order_member_key FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')) SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN w.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct FROM web_lines w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Member share of sales: net sales before returns on member-linked lines divided by all net sales before returns
Web = store_id 900, not channel_code or channel_id
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (dispatch_ts_utc converted to Europe/Helsinki), not the order date in sale_date
Only dispatched orders (delivered or collected) count as web sales; cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines
Guest web orders count as non-member
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Net amounts excluding VAT, before returns
Fiscal calendar from dim_date (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales_before_returns for store 900: P9 219929.50, P10 137569.07, P11 149798.62, all matching exactly
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales or any stg_, bak_, tmp_ or _old table
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26. The request was received on 9 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests in the same position (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35) took the previous fiscal year.
'Periods 9 to 11' read as FY2025/26 P9 (22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), P10 (26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026) and P11 (23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026). All three are fully loaded.
'Loyalty members' read as any web order placed while logged in. That is any order with a member key on fact_web_order, whatever the tier or consent status.

'Share of web sales' read as net sales (excluding VAT, before returns) from member orders divided by total web net sales, per the member-share definition. Returns and VAT-inclusive figures are not used.
The result is by period only, with no breakdown by tier, fulfilment type or other dimension, because none was asked for.
caveats: Data defect corrected: for web orders placed from 9 Feb to 1 Mar 2026 (655 logged-in orders, about 1,309 sales lines), fact_sales_line.member_key is null even though fact_web_order shows the order as logged_in with a member key. The defect falls in P10 and P11. Taking membership from the line would understate the member share: 51.8% in P10 and 55.8% in P11, against 67.5% and 66.7% after correction. I used fact_web_order.member_key for every order. P9 is unaffected (68.0% either way).
The defect only reaches a few lines in early March: 72 lines on 37 orders in March, the rest in February.
The member-share figures use the member status of the order, not the member version on each line, so they do not depend on dim_member versions. Every order member_key found a matching dim_member row.

Store 999 and ZZ Test filter: P11 includes 4.00 EUR of ZZ Test web lines, which is removed. This changes the P11 total slightly (149,802.62 to 149,798.62) and has no visible effect on the percentage. No ZZ Test lines were found in P9 or P10.

Dating is by dispatch date, so an order placed in one period and dispatched in the next counts in the later period, and orders still processing at the date of the data load are excluded. All three periods are well before the 4 October 2026 load date.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 10 AS first_period, 12 AS last_period
),
south_stores AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM dim_store
    WHERE is_current = TRUE AND region = 'South' AND store_id < 900
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_product AS (
    SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, 
           SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN south_stores ss ON ss.store_id = n.store_id
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
)
SELECT sku, product_name, gross_margin, ROUND(100.0 * gross_margin / net_sales, 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM by_product
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Gross margin: net sales minus standard cost of goods sold, both after returns
Net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, store 999 and test articles excluded
Region hierarchy: as-is (current)
Web sales: revenue recognized on dispatch date in Helsinki time
assumptions: South region interpreted as current as-is stores (106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 137)
Q4 of FY24/25 interpreted as fiscal periods 10–12 (27 Jan – 27 Apr 2025)
Products ranked by absolute gross margin value (EUR)
Gross margin percentage calculated as 100 × (gross margin / net sales)
caveats: Data loaded through 27 April 2025; FY2024/25 Q4 is complete
Web sales and returns are included (web sales on dispatch date); store 999 and test articles are excluded
All ten products shown have positive gross margin
Region reorganization occurred 28 April 2025 (after this period); as-is region assignment applied

SELECT
  f.vat_rate * 100 AS vat_rate_percent,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC
definitions_applied: Physical stores only (store_id < 900); web shop and store 999 excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
VAT calculated as gross_amount minus net_amount per line
Fiscal period P05 FY2024/25 = fiscal weeks 18-21 (2024-08-26 to 2024-09-22)
assumptions: Period 5 of FY24/25 read as fiscal period 5 of FY2024/25 (explicitly named)
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls within this period. Sales before 1 September are at 24%; sales from 1 September onward are at 25.5%. Reduced rates (14% and 10%) did not change.
VAT charged is the difference between gross and net amounts; every line carries its own VAT rate, so totals reflect the actual rates applied on each sale.

definitions_applied: Fiscal week runs Monday to Sunday (dim_date), so last week is fiscal week 22 of FY2026/27, 28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026

Store and product joined through the surrogate keys store_key and product_key, then identified by store_id 124 and SKU 100011
Stock figures taken from fact_stock_week, not from the backup, staging or tmp tables

definitions_applied: Fiscal period 3 of FY2026/27, 29 Jun to 2 Aug 2026 (5 weeks), from ref_fiscal_calendar and dim_date
