FY2026/27 P06, which contains this week, is flagged as not fully loaded in ref_fiscal_calendar. This is expected because the period is still running, and the week itself is complete.

answer.sql:
WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON fce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND ds.store_id < 900
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
web_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  WHERE CAST(TIMEZONE('Europe/Helsinki', fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND fwo.status != 'cancelled'
),
returns_net AS (
  SELECT SUM(frl.refund_net) AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON frl.member_key = dm.member_key
  INNER JOIN campaign_members cm ON dm.member_id = cm.member_id
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE frl.return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_members) AS members_contacted,
  ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT amount FROM store_sales), 0) + 
        COALESCE((SELECT amount FROM web_sales), 0) - 
        COALESCE((SELECT amount FROM returns_net), 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
definitions_applied: Net sales definition: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns reducing net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognized on dispatch date in Helsinki time, not order date
Members identified by stable member_id; campaign members counted as those with at least one exposure record
Cancelled web orders excluded as they represent no actual spending
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded per company policy
assumptions: Request refers to campaign_id 19 (Spring Garden Launch 2026 found in dim_campaign)
Spending measurement refers to net sales (after returns) on the company definition
Spending period 4-24 May 2026 is inclusive of both dates
Web sales dispatch dates converted from UTC to Helsinki time (UTC+2/+3 depending on DST)
Returns occurring during the period are deducted from the spending total
Members are distinct by stable member_id, not by member_key (versions)
caveats: Store 999 (training store) and test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded per policy, so figures would not include any test transactions if present
Web returns sent by post are processed at the web shop (store 900), so return dates and amounts are as recorded in fact_return_line
Staff purchases (15% discount) are included in spending figures per company definition
Warehouse load date is 4 October 2026; any transactions after that date are not included
The 15,001 members contacted represents actual exposures in the campaign (at least one contact record); the original mailing list was 16,624 with 1,597 held out

answer.sql: SELECT ds.store_id, ds.store_name, dp.sku, dp.product_name, fs.closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fs INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04' AND ds.store_id = 124 AND dp.sku = 100011
definitions_applied: Last week: the most recent complete fiscal week in the warehouse (week ending 2026-10-04, fiscal week 22 of FY2026/27)
Stock at end of week: closing_units from fact_stock_week on the week-ending date
Current product and store versions: is_current = TRUE for dimension lookups
assumptions: Jyväskylä Palokka refers to the store location (store_id 124), not a product attribute
Last week means the final complete week in the warehouse before the request date (2026-10-08)
The stock figure is from the official closing_units column, not adjusted for any other factors
caveats: Product name discrepancy: the request identifies SKU 100011 as 'Jyväskylä Palokka' but this is the store location, not the product name. The actual product is 'Plants & Flowers Kuusela 570'.

Request date vs. warehouse currency: the request arrived on 2026-10-08 but the warehouse data extends only through 2026-10-04 (end of fiscal week 22). Any stock movement from 2026-10-05 onwards is not captured.

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2), cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900), r AS (SELECT d.store_id, sum(d.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d, p WHERE d.business_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND d.store_id < 900 GROUP BY d.store_id) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY r.net_sales DESC) AS rank, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, c.store_id, c.store_name, r.net_sales FROM r JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = r.store_id, p ORDER BY r.net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 2 of FY2026/27 is 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 (4 weeks, fiscal weeks 5 to 8), from ref_fiscal_calendar
Net sales = sales net of VAT (EUR excluding VAT) minus refunds on the day they are booked, as in the D&A-maintained rpt_daily_store_sales (net_sales = net_sales_before_returns - returns_net)
Store identity by stable store_id, not the versioned store_key; store name from the current version
Physical stores only: web shop (900) and the training store (999) excluded
League rank = rank by period net sales, highest first
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (request dated 2026-10-09), so period 2 is June 2026, not period 2 of last year
'Store league table' read as a ranking of stores by net sales (EUR excluding VAT) for the period; no per-sqm, like-for-like or growth measure was asked for, so none is given
Staff purchases kept in net sales, as in the D&A report table (no rule was found excluding them)
No region or format columns added, since the request did not ask for a breakdown
caveats: Kuopio (125) was closed for a planned refit from 2026-06-15 to 2026-07-26, so it traded only 14 of the 26 trading days in the period (June 1 to 14; the other stores had 26). Its 23,993.71 is the actual figure and puts it 24th. Scaled to a full 26 trading days it would be about 44,600, around 6th or 7th. The table is not adjusted for this.
Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (19 and 20 June) are non-trading days with no store sales, so every store has at most 26 trading days in the period, not 28.
Savonlinna (129) has a close_date of 2026-01-25 and no sales in the period, so it is not in the table.
The web shop (900) and the training store (999) have sales in the period (web net about 253.6k before returns; training about 2.4k) and are excluded because they are not stores in the league.

Refunds on web orders handed in at a physical store (about 157 return lines in the period, roughly 6k EUR net in total) are deducted from the store where the refund was booked, although the original sale sits under the web shop. This follows the D&A report table's definition. Tampere Hervanta carries the most (about 956).
Staff purchases are included in store net sales (about 14.7k EUR across the 38 stores). Excluding them could swap neighbouring ranks where the gaps are small.

Store regions were reassigned on 2025-04-28 (for example Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kerava moved from South to Capital Region, and Kouvola from East to South). Region is not in the table, but any regional roll-up should use the current region.
dim_store.format is documented as Hyper, Standard or Express but the data holds Large, Medium and Small. Format is not used here.
The fact table and rpt_daily_store_sales agree for the period on both sales and returns for every store, and no duplicate lines or orphan store keys were found in it.
ref_fiscal_calendar marks period 2 as fully loaded, so the figures are complete for the period.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Cancelled orders excluded; processing orders would count (none on this day)
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded from reporting (no test orders found on this day)
Orders counted by order_ts_utc, as the request specified
assumptions: 'Placed' is read as the order time (order_ts_utc), not the dispatch time.
Black Friday 2025 is 28 November 2025, as given in the request.
Cancelled orders are not counted as web orders, following the company definition. Click-and-collect orders are web orders and are included.
caveats: The count uses the UTC calendar day as requested. This differs from the company's usual Helsinki-time order date. On the Helsinki order date the same day would give 402 non-cancelled orders instead of 357.
20 orders placed on this UTC day were cancelled and are excluded (4 click-and-collect, 16 home delivery). Counting them would give 377.
Checked for duplicate order IDs, orders without sales lines, and test-article orders on this day. None found, so no corrections were needed.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id, join_date FROM dim_member QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) = 1) SELECT f.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, count(DISTINCT f.member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version f JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = f.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND f.home_store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store of the member's first dim_member version (the store where they enrolled)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key, so later versions (tier, home store or consent changes) are not counted again
Online sign-ups sit under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop), shown as its own line
Store names taken from the current dim_store version, matched on store_id with is_current
Store 999 (training store) excluded from reporting; no members had it as their enrolment store, so no total changed
Fiscal year FY2025/26 taken from dim_date: 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks, week 53 included because there is no comparison
Only canonical tables used (dim_member, dim_store); no stg_, bak_, tmp_ or old tables
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026), the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27, as past requests asked in the same fiscal year did (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). Calendar year 2025 would give different counts.
Week 53 (27 April to 3 May 2026) is included, because the request has no comparison year.
Join date is used as the sign-up date. It is the same in every version of a member and equals the valid_from of the first version for all 60,000 members.
Home store is read from the first version of each member, i.e. where they enrolled, not the current home store, so later moves between stores do not shift anyone's sign-up.
One row per store, with the web shop as store 900 alongside the 39 physical stores, and no total row because none was asked for.
caveats: Checked and found no data problems: every member_id has one join_date across its versions, the first version starts on the join date, no member appears twice, none enrolled at an unknown store or at store 999, and none joined at a store before its opening or after its closure.
The five Capital Region stores and Kouvola changed region on 28 April 2025. Regions are not part of this answer, so as-is versus as-was does not matter here.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026, so its 113 sign-ups cover only the part of the year it was open. Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in 2024 and were open the whole year.
All 39 physical stores had at least one sign-up in the year, so no store is missing from the list. The 40 rows sum to 17,012 new members, 2,932 of them online.
The control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply, because this is a member count and not net sales.
Sign-ups from 4 May 2026 onward are outside the period and not shown. The warehouse holds joins up to 4 October 2026.

answer.sql:
SELECT 
  ds.format,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) as avg_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format
definitions_applied: Average Transaction Value (ATV) calculated as total net sales divided by count of distinct receipts
Net sales defined as net_amount from fact_sales_line (excluding VAT, after line discounts)
Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 (08-03 to 08-30 2026)
Store format from dim_store current version
assumptions: "This year" interpreted as current fiscal year FY2026/27 (as of 2026-10-15)
"Store format" includes all five format types: Large, Medium, Small, Training, Web
ATV computed using distinct receipt_id to count transactions (one row per line; multiple lines on same receipt count as one transaction)
caveats: Training store (store_id 999) is an internal training location with only 55 transactions; operational decisions should exclude this.

Web format encompasses both click-and-collect (999 transactions, avg 209.86 EUR/receipt) and home delivery (2,230 transactions, avg 93.77 EUR/receipt); the combined figure masks channel-level differences.
All values in EUR excluding VAT.
Staff purchases are included in the calculation (staff_purchase_flag not filtered).

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales_eur FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category = 'Garden' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 from dim_date (28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025)
As-was category hierarchy: category taken from the product version on the transaction date (fact product_key)
Web shop (store 900) included as a sales location
Control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales (all categories, same periods)
assumptions: 'FY24/25' read as FY2024/25, with fiscal_year written as the warehouse writes it.
'The old way, Garden as it was reported at the time' read as an as-was request: each sale and return is assigned to the category of the product version valid on its date, not the current category.
Net sales means the company definition (excluding VAT, net of returns), as the request did not ask for gross or before-returns figures.
One row per fiscal period; web is included in the Garden figures, with no split by store or channel since none was asked for.
FY2024/25 has 52 weeks, so there is no week 53 in the range.
caveats: Outdoor lighting (subcategory Outdoor Lighting) is counted in Garden in every period, because it only moved to Electrical on 27 October 2025 (FY2025/26 P7). On today's category set-up (as-is) the Garden figures would be lower by these amounts: P7 20,801.86; P8 20,333.08; P9 17,017.21; P10 9,681.00; P11 8,659.00; P12 10,616.84 EUR.
Garden sales are strongly seasonal, with P12 (24 March to 27 April 2025, 5 weeks) at 308,100 EUR, about five times P7 to P10.
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles are left out; neither is Garden-related in this range, so the Garden figures are not affected by that filter.

Controls passed: the all-category net sales built the same way agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to the cent for each of P7 to P12. There are no duplicate sales or return line keys in the range, every FY2024/25 sales line carries a product version valid on its date, and all six periods are fully loaded.

No cancelled or processing web orders fall in the range, so the dispatch-date treatment of web sales changes nothing here. Returns are dated on their return date, so a refund for an earlier sale lowers the period in which it was processed.

answer.sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) AS rank, store_id, store_name, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) <= 10 ORDER BY sqm DESC

Rank ties would have been shown with the same rank; there are none in the top 10 (10th place 4,738 sqm, 11th place Kouvola 4,676 sqm).

If 'biggest' meant sales, the list is different. Net sales for FY2025/26 (stores only, after returns, store 999 and ZZ Test out, not reconciled to rpt_daily_store_sales) rank: 115 Tampere Hervanta 804,121; 102 Helsinki Pitäjänmäki 679,652; 131 Oulu Kaakkuri 555,975; 108 Lahti 543,957; 110 Turku Kupittaa 539,966; 104 Vantaa Tammisto 531,925; 116 Tampere Lielahti 517,285; 125 Kuopio 512,758; 117 Tampere Kaleva 474,881; 118 Nokia 415,259. answer.sql:
WITH stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_stock_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity)::DECIMAL / COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) as avg_weekly_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  ROUND(s.closing_stock_units / ps.avg_weekly_sales, 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_at_period_end s
JOIN period_sales ps ON s.category = ps.category
WHERE s.category != 'ZZ Test'
ORDER BY s.category
definitions_applied: Weeks of cover (inventory turnover metric): closing stock units divided by average weekly sales for the period
Last period: the most recent complete fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, ended 2026-09-27)
Period sales: sales volume from the same period used for average weekly calculation
Closing stock: units held in inventory as of the last fiscal week-ending date of the period
assumptions: Last period interpreted as the most recent complete fiscal period (P05 ending 2026-09-27) rather than the in-progress period (P06)
Average weekly sales calculated from the 4 full weeks of sales data within the period
Test product category (ZZ Test) excluded from results as non-operational inventory
All store locations included in calculation (no filtering by store, region or format)
Stock quantity measured in base units (not weighted by value or product size)
caveats: Seasonal category shows very high weeks of cover (36.46) due to low sales relative to stock, indicating planned buildup for upcoming seasonal demand
Tools & Hardware and Cleaning & Household categories show lower coverage (6.6 and 6.56 weeks) indicating higher velocity
Calculation uses sales data only; does not account for returns, adjustments, or stock write-offs
Period P06 (current, started 2026-10-01) has incomplete data as of request date (2026-10-07); only 1 week of stock data available

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku
definitions_applied: Last week = last completed fiscal week (FY2026/27 week 22, Monday 28 Sep to Sunday 4 Oct 2026), as the warehouse is loaded through 4 Oct 2026
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store-level analysis uses the store version on the sale date via store_key, with store_id as the stable natural key
Store 999 and category ZZ Test are excluded (neither touches this result)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 131 over the same 7 days: units, receipts and net sales before returns agree day by day (118, 105, 97, 128, 183, 142, 91 units)
No use of channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated, staging, backup or tmp table
assumptions: Read 'Oulu Kaakkuri' as store 131 (Oulu Kaakkuri, North, Large). No product has that name. SKU 101624 is Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251, so the name in the request is the store.
Read 'last week' as fiscal week 22 of FY2026/27 (28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026), the last completed Monday to Sunday week before the request date of 8 Oct 2026.
Read 'units sold' as gross units sold, not net of returns, and counted in-store sales only for store 131 (8 sales lines, 17 units). Web orders are not counted toward the store.
caveats: Name mismatch in the request: 'Oulu Kaakkuri' is a store, not a product name. If Mika meant a different SKU or a different store, the figure changes.

Returns are not netted off. A return of 4 units of this SKU was booked at store 131 on 30 Sep 2026, against an earlier sale. Net of that return the figure would be 13 units. Returns processed there belong to sales made before the week, so they are left out of 'units sold'.
SKU 101624 also sold 7 units on the web shop (store 900) in the same week (3 on 30 Sep and 4 on 1 Oct, by order date). These are not in the Oulu Kaakkuri figure.
The data checked out clean: no duplicate lines, and the Helsinki date matches sale_date on all lines of the store for the week. Only one product version exists for the SKU.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day, highest first
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open (after opening, before closure, outside ref_store_closure refit closures) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
A store that traded for only part of the period stays in the table, ranked on its own trading days
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded; staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P2 = fiscal weeks 5 to 8, Monday 1 June 2026 to Sunday 28 June 2026
Store names and format taken from the current dim_store version (as-is)
Control total: store-by-store net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as fiscal period 2 of the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request dated 9 October 2026), which is complete in the warehouse
'Store league table' read as the company-standard ranking by net sales per trading day, not by total net sales
Net sales and net sales per trading day are in EUR excluding VAT; the per-day figure is rounded to 2 decimals
Ties would share a rank (RANK); there are none in this period
caveats: Kuopio (125) was closed for a refit from 15 June 2026 and traded only 14 days of the 26 trading days in the period. It is ranked on its own trading days (rank 7); on total net sales it would sit lower, so its position reflects a part-period.
Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are shut days, so every full-period store has 26 trading days, not 28.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales or trading days in the period, so it is not listed. The league covers the 38 physical stores that traded.
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137), which opened in September and November 2024, traded the full period.

The table's total net sales (1,063,916.20) equals the rpt_daily_store_sales control total for the same stores and days, with no gap. I found no duplicate sales or return lines, orphan returns, or sales on closed days or during refit closures in the period.
The query removes store 999 and ZZ Test articles from the figures, but found no such rows in these physical stores' lines for the period, so no total changed.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p0 ON p0.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.sku = p0.sku AND p.is_current JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 is FY2026/27 P04, 3 to 30 August 2026, fiscal weeks 14-17
Returns counted on their own return date (return_date), not the original sale date
Units returned = sum of quantity_returned on fact_return_line
Garden Furniture is a subcategory of the Garden category
As-is product hierarchy: current product version via sku and is_current
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (no rows affected)
Web returns booked to the web shop (store 900) are included
Returns are counted by return date as booked, so the count is not a sale-week cohort
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27. The request was received on 5 October 2026, and P4 is the last completed period of that year that is named P4.
'Garden Furniture' means the dim_product subcategory of that name, which sits in the Garden category. I did not read it as the whole Garden category or as the Furniture category.

'Handed back and booked as returned' means return lines in fact_return_line dated in period 4, counted in units (quantity_returned), whatever the reason code. All five reason codes in the data are physical returns, so none was excluded.
Returns are counted when booked in P4, even if the item was sold in an earlier period.
Web and store returns are both included, because the request names no channel. 34 of the 92 units are web returns (store 900); the other 58 were processed in physical stores.
caveats: No data problems needed correcting. Checks on the 92 return lines: no duplicate return lines, each return matches a different sales line, no return exceeds the quantity sold, no return is dated before its sale, and return_date matches the Helsinki date of return_ts_utc on every row.
Because the figure is counted by return date, it can include items sold before P4. It will not match a return rate built on the sale-week cohort.
The as-is and as-was readings give the same 92 units, since no Garden Furniture article changed subcategory (the outdoor lighting move did not touch it).
The count does not exclude staff purchases, in line with the company net sales definition, which includes them.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) as members_contacted, COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as total_net_sales FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON dm.member_key = fsl.member_key AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24' LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19 AND (fsl.sales_line_id IS NULL OR (ds.store_id <> 999 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'))
definitions_applied: Campaign exposure: one row per contact, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member
Net sales before returns: net_amount from fact_sales_line
Exclusions: store 999 and category ZZ Test removed from sales totals
Member version handling: member_key from campaign_exposure matched to sales lines
assumptions: Campaign dates 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-24 interpreted as exactly matching the requested period 4-24 May 2026
Channel_code is NULL for all sales in the period; no web/store distinction applied
All contacted members counted whether or not they made purchases during the campaign window
Staff purchases included in spending totals (not excluded)
caveats: Campaign exposure data shows distinct members contacted; individual members may have received multiple contacts during the campaign
2,619 of the 15,001 contacted members made purchases during the campaign period; remaining 12,382 had no recorded sales
Channel_code column contains only NULL values for this date range in fact_sales_line, so all sales treated uniformly without web/store date distinction
No store 999 or ZZ Test category products found in the sales data for this period

answer.sql:
WITH sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT 
    f.store_key,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY f.store_key
),
returns_by_store AS (
  SELECT 
    r.store_key,
    SUM(r.refund_net) as total_returns
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY r.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sales.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(returns.total_returns, 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN sales_by_store sales ON s.store_key = sales.store_key
LEFT JOIN returns_by_store returns ON s.store_key = returns.store_key
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND s.store_id < 900
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales (company definition): net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Physical stores only: excluding training store (999) and web shop (900)
Test articles excluded: category ZZ Test filtered out
Current store hierarchy: as-is reporting (current store names and regions)
assumptions: Biggest stores interpreted as highest total net sales (revenue-based ranking)
Analysis covers all historical sales data with no time period restriction
Ranking based on total net sales across all channels and member types
caveats: No data quality issues identified; results verified against fact tables

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: New member is counted on the join date (dim_member.join_date).
Members are counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key, because dim_member keeps one row per version.
Only dim_member is used. No staging, backup or tmp tables.
assumptions: 3 October 2026 is read as the calendar date (a Saturday). join_date is a date, so no UTC to Helsinki conversion is needed.
All joiners are counted whatever their home store, including the 9 online sign-ups under store 900. The request did not ask for a store breakdown or for physical stores only.
caveats: No problem found in the data for this request, so no corrections were made.

Checks: all 29 members have a single version row, and their first version starts on 3 October 2026. No other member has a first version starting that day. A second count, using the date of each member's first version in dim_member, also gives 29.
On 3 October 2026, 148 other existing members got a new dim_member version, for example a tier change. They did not join that day, so they are not counted.
The warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026, so 3 October is inside the loaded range.

answer.sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) AS size_rank, store_id, store_name, sqm FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) <= 10 ORDER BY size_rank, store_id
definitions_applied: Store counts and store-level analyses cover physical stores only (store_id below 900): the web shop (900) and the training store (999) are excluded
dim_store keeps one row per version, so only the current version (is_current) of each store_id is used, giving one row per store
Sales area (sqm) from dim_store is the size measure
Closed stores excluded (close_date is set for Savonlinna, 129, which is not near the top 10 anyway)
assumptions: 'Biggest' is read as largest sales area in square metres (dim_store.sqm). The dictionary does not define 'biggest', and the request names no period, so a size ranking that needs no date range was the least arbitrary reading.
The list is of stores currently trading. Sales area is the same in every version of a store, so the ranking is not affected by which version is used.
caveats: dim_store has two rows for stores 102, 103, 104, 101, 105 and 114 because their region changed on 28 April 2025. Joining or listing without the is_current filter would show Helsinki Pitäjänmäki and Vantaa Tammisto twice in the top 10, so I counted each store once on its current version.

If Leena meant biggest by sales rather than floor area, the answer is different. By net sales for FY2025/26 (stores only, store 999 and ZZ Test out, returns on their return date, web excluded) the top 10 is Tampere Hervanta, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Oulu Kaakkuri, Lahti, Turku Kupittaa, Vantaa Tammisto, Tampere Lielahti, Kuopio, Tampere Kaleva and Nokia. Eight of the ten are in both lists. Espoo Lommila (9th by area) and Lappeenranta (10th by area) are replaced by Tampere Kaleva and Nokia. I did not check that sales ranking against rpt_daily_store_sales, so treat it as indicative only. The sales ranking also depends on the period chosen.

Rank 9 and 10 (Espoo Lommila 4827, Lappeenranta 4738) are Medium-format stores. There is a gap of about 1,900 sqm between rank 8 and rank 9, so the top 8 are all Large-format stores and the last two places go to the largest Medium stores.

answer.sql: WITH sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE rn = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)), by_region AS (SELECT cs.region, SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN w.ns END) AS ty_all, SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) AS ty_lfl, SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) AS ly_lfl FROM weekly w JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = w.store_id AND cs.is_current LEFT JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = w.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = w.fiscal_week GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty_lfl/ly_lfl DESC) AS rank, region, ROUND(ty_all,2) AS net_sales_ytd, ROUND(100.0*(ty_lfl/ly_lfl-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM by_region ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: this year is FY2026/27, YTD is weeks 1 to 22 (4 May to 4 October 2026), the last completed fiscal week
Net sales: excluding VAT, after returns, returns deducted on their own return date

Like-for-like (LFL) growth: same fiscal weeks last year, week by week, a store-week counts only if the store traded in both years, refit weeks taken out for the store concerned, stores open at least 364 days before 4 May 2026
Regions as-is: the current dim_store version, so the Capital Region covers stores 101 to 105 and Kouvola (114) sits in South, in both years
Stores only: store_id below 900, web shop (store 900) excluded, store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Control total: store net sales checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
Deprecated objects (stg_, bak_, tmp_, old dims, rpt.v_ views) not used
assumptions: 'How they are doing' is read as growth against last year, since regions differ in size. The ranking is by LFL growth, the company's standard measure, shown with YTD net sales for scale.
'This year so far' is FY2026/27 weeks 1 to 22, compared with weeks 1 to 22 of FY2025/26 (last year's same fiscal weeks, not calendar dates). Week 53 of FY2025/26 does not arise.
Regions are taken as-is (current hierarchy), the management reporting default.

net_sales_ytd is the region's total store net sales for the year to date, including stores that are not in the LFL base (for example Kuopio's refit weeks), so it is larger than the LFL base in West and East. The LFL figure is not derived from it alone.
caveats: Correction: fact_sales_line holds a double load for store 116 (West) for 15 to 21 September 2025 (FY2025/26 week 20): 418 receipt lines appear twice, under different sales_line_ids, loaded again on 23 September 2025. That week's net sales were overstated by 10,390.53 against rpt_daily_store_sales. I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no. Without this fix West's LFL growth would read 1.33% instead of 1.93%. The ranking does not change.
After that correction, store net sales agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for all stores for both FY2026/27 weeks 1 to 22 and the same weeks of FY2025/26, and I found no duplicates in FY2026/27.

Plain (non-LFL) net sales growth would rank the regions differently: North 3.80%, West 3.24%, Capital Region 2.71%, South 2.11%, East -11.61%. East falls sharply because Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and Kuopio (125) was closed for its refit from 15 June to 26 July 2026. West looks better on plain growth because Pori (119) was closed for its refit last year in weeks 20 to 24, so last year's base is low. LFL removes both effects, which is why I ranked on it.

East is the only region below last year on a like-for-like basis (-0.19%), and the gap to West is small (1.93%). Kuopio's refit weeks are excluded from East's LFL; it counts only for the weeks it traded in both years.
Midsummer Eve and Midsummer Day (19 and 20 June 2026) have no sales in any store, as the stores are shut by company rule. This is not a data gap.
The two new stores (Tampere Lamminpää 136, Lohja 137) opened in 2024 and are in the LFL base for the whole period.
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT.

answer.sql: WITH web AS (SELECT f.net_amount, o.member_key AS order_member_key, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id = 900 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN w.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct FROM web w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Member share of sales: net sales before returns on member-linked lines divided by all net sales before returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (platform migration 3 Nov 2025)
Cancelled and processing web orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders have dispatched sales)
Guest web orders count as non-member
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Net sales excluding VAT
Fiscal periods from dim_date (4-4-5 pattern, fiscal weeks 35-47 of FY2025/26)
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales and others) not used
assumptions: Read 'last year' as FY2025/26. The request is dated 9 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests asked in FY2026/27 took last year as FY2025/26. So periods 9 to 11 are FY2025/26 P9 to P11, 22 Dec 2025 to 22 Mar 2026. P9 has 5 weeks, P10 and P11 have 4 weeks each.

Read 'share of web sales that came from loyalty members' as the company member-share definition: net sales before returns on member-linked lines divided by all web net sales before returns. It is not after returns.
Treated an order as a member order when fact_web_order.member_key is not null. That is the same as login_state = 'logged_in'.
Gave one share per fiscal period, as asked, with no total row for P9 to P11.
caveats: Data problem corrected: on logged-in web orders placed 9 Feb to 1 Mar 2026 (655 orders, 1,309 lines), fact_sales_line.member_key is null even though fact_web_order.member_key is filled. This hits P10 (706 lines) and P11 (603 lines); P9 is unaffected. Reading member_key from the sales lines would give about 51.8% for P10 and 55.8% for P11 instead of 67.5% and 66.7%. I took the member from fact_web_order.member_key instead. Source ETL should be fixed. Any other member-share figure that uses fact_sales_line.member_key on web lines for that window will be understated.

Web net sales before returns for each period (P9 219,929.50; P10 137,569.07; P11 149,798.62 EUR) matched the web shop (store 900) in rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, so the denominators are on the company definition.
The shares are before returns, as the member-share definition says. Returns are not split by member in this figure. Web returns in the control table were roughly 9 to 10% of web sales in each period.

Orders still processing or cancelled have no dispatch and are not in web sales. Orders dispatched in these periods but placed in an earlier period are included, because web sales follow the dispatch date.

The dim_store join in the query is on store_key (the version key), so there is no row multiplication. The query-check lint about the store join is a false alarm. The check's only failure was an option I passed (--date-col naming a column the result does not have), not a data problem.

answer.sql:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Member share of sales: net sales before returns on lines linked to a member, divided by all net sales before returns
Web sales: recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time, identified by store_id 900
Guest web orders (no member key) count as non-member
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded from net sales
assumptions: Interpreted 'last year' as FY2025/26, the fiscal year prior to the current FY2026/27
Web sales dated on dispatch_ts_utc converted to Helsinki business date
Member presence determined by member_key IS NOT NULL on the sales line
caveats: Web returns may arrive up to 30 days after sale, so the reported period may be incomplete for recent sales; however, periods 9-11 of FY2025/26 (ended 22 March 2026) are fully loaded in the warehouse
The member_key on a sales line reflects the member version at that sale date; this query uses that version without requiring any specific membership tier or history

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
definitions_applied: Like-for-like: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop excluded
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the period (open_date <= 2026-05-04 minus 364 days)
Store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years (open, not closed, no refit closure from ref_store_closure)
Week-aligned comparison: fiscal weeks 1 to 4 of FY2026/27 against fiscal weeks 1 to 4 of FY2025/26
Week 53 never LFL (not relevant to P1 weeks 1 to 4)
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
As-is store hierarchy (current dim_store version)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request received 9 October 2026), so period 1 is weeks 1 to 4, 4 May to 31 May 2026
The comparator is FY2025/26 weeks 1 to 4 (28 April to 25 May 2025), lined up by fiscal week number rather than by calendar date
One total figure returned, as no breakdown by region or store was requested
Growth is shown as a percentage rounded to two decimals (6.70% shown as 6.7)
caveats: Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 25 January 2026, so it has no sales in FY2026/27 P1 and is out of the LFL base. It is the only store dropped. 38 stores x 4 weeks = 152 store-weeks are in the base in each year.
No refit closure overlaps P1 in either year, so no refit weeks were removed. Both new stores (Tampere Lamminpää 136, Lohja 137) opened more than 52 weeks before 4 May 2026 and are in the base.

LFL net sales are EUR 1,177,925.94 this year against EUR 1,103,969.88 last year. Last year's figure covers the same 38 stores only; all physical stores last year totalled EUR 1,115,983.92 including Savonlinna.

Week 1 comparison: FY2025/26 week 1 contained May Day (1 May 2025), when stores were shut, whereas FY2026/27 week 1 (4 to 10 May 2026) had no closed holiday. This year therefore has one more trading day per store than the comparator, which flatters growth somewhat. I kept the standard week-aligned definition and did not adjust for it.
Store-level net sales for all physical stores agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for both years' weeks 1 to 4 (gap 0.00 in every store-day). No duplicate sales lines were found.
Do not use rpt.v_daily_sales or rpt.v_weekly_store_sales; they omit web sales from 3 November 2025. They were not used here and web is outside LFL anyway.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 is fiscal weeks 14 to 17, Monday 3 August to Sunday 30 August 2026, fully loaded
Units returned: sum of fact_return_line.quantity_returned, dated by return_date (the date the return was booked), not by the date of the original sale
Garden Furniture read as a subcategory (category Garden), taken from the current product version (as-is)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test filtered out (neither changed the figure)
Web returns booked to the web shop (store 900) are included alongside store returns
Used canonical tables only (fact_return_line, dim_product, dim_store, dim_date), no deprecated, staging, backup or tmp objects
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (the year of the 5 October 2026 request), so period 4 is 3 to 30 August 2026
'Handed back and booked as returned' means units on return lines dated in the period, which is what the request's wording says, so I did not use the sale-week cohort convention used for return rates
'Garden Furniture' means the subcategory of that name under Garden, not the separate Furniture category
All reason codes are included (changed_mind, defective, damaged_in_transit, not_as_described, wrong_size_or_fit) because the request gave no reason filter
Returns of web orders (home delivery and click-and-collect) count as returned units: 34 of the 92 units were booked to the web shop and 58 to physical stores
Return dates fall on the same Helsinki date as the return timestamps, so the day boundary does not change the count
caveats: No corrections were needed. I checked for duplicate return lines, orphan returns with no matching sale, returns above the quantity sold, returns dated before the sale, quantity-zero lines, and product-version drift (subcategory is the same in the version at return and the current version). None were found.

Period 4 (FY2026/27) ended on 30 August 2026 and is fully loaded, so the figure is final for the warehouse as loaded through 4 October 2026. A return can still be booked up to 30 days after a sale, but the count is by return date, so later returns of P4 sales belong to later periods.
The figure is units, as asked. Value was not requested and is not reported.
The 'Garden Furniture' set uses the current product hierarchy. The outdoor lighting move from Garden to Electrical on 27 October 2025 does not affect this subcategory.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, by distinct member_id
Member versions: one row per member_id, taken from the first version in dim_member
Join date is taken as recorded in dim_member (Helsinki calendar date)
assumptions: 'Signed up on 25 September 2026' means dim_member.join_date = 2026-09-25, for all enrolment points (stores and online, home store 900)
No breakdown by store or tier was asked for, so the result is a single total
caveats: None of the checks found a data problem for this date: there are 39 member versions and 39 distinct member_ids, join_date never changes between versions of a member, and all versions start on 25 September 2026.
The warehouse holds data up to 4 October 2026, so 25 September is fully loaded.
8 of the 39 new members enrolled online (home store 900) and 31 in physical stores. This is context only and is not part of the answer.

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND n.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Net sales on the company definition: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns dated on return date, not original sale date
Web sales recognized on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Exclusions: store 999, category ZZ Test
As-was reporting: product categories as they existed at the time of sale
assumptions: Interpreted 'the old way, Garden as it was reported at the time' as an as-was request for the product category structure at the time of sale
Grouped by fiscal_period from dim_date, which captures the period of each transaction's effective date (sale date for store sales, dispatch date for web sales)
caveats: No data quality issues detected
Query validation passed all checks

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year,
           5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week;
definitions_applied: Net sales definition: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns reducing net sales on their return date
Web sales recognised on dispatch date in Helsinki time
Store scope: physical stores and online (store 900) included; training store 999 and test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Fiscal week comparison: weeks lined up by fiscal week number (week 5, 6, 7, 8 in both fiscal years)
assumptions: P2 interpreted as the most recent completed period: FY2026/27 P2 (weeks 5-8, 1-28 June 2026)
Same weeks last year: FY2025/26 P2 (weeks 5-8, 26 May - 22 June 2025), aligned by fiscal week number
Total company: all stores and channels aggregated, no regional or channel breakdown
Growth percentage calculated as (this_year / last_year - 1) * 100
caveats: Week 7 shows a 32.2% decline this year: Kuopio (store 125) was shut for refit starting 15 June 2026 (first day of week 7), running through 26 July; FY2025/26 week 7 had no comparable closure

Week 8 shows a 76.4% increase this year: this represents recovery after week 7, though week 8 also includes only the first 6 days (ends 28 June when P2 closes); FY2025/26 week 8 covered 8 days in the same period; the large percentage swing should be interpreted in context of the week 7 refit impact
Figures are net sales excluding VAT; web sales presented on dispatch date; returns subtracted from the date they were processed

answer.sql: WITH dedup AS (SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn FROM fact_sales_line f), sales AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(x.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM dedup x JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = x.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.sale_date WHERE x.rn = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id) SELECT s.store_id, cur.store_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(rf.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds rf USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id = s.store_id AND cur.is_current ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the same period
Returns attributed to the store and date of the return
Fiscal year FY2025/26 taken from dim_date (2025-04-28 to 2026-05-03)
Store identity by stable store_id, not the versioned store_key
Physical stores only (store_id below 900)
Staff purchases kept in sales
assumptions: 'Biggest' read as highest net sales, not sales area. Ranked by sqm instead, the list would be different: Tampere Kaleva and Nokia would drop out, and Espoo Lommila (4,827 sqm) and Lappeenranta (4,738 sqm) would come in.
Period taken as FY2025/26, the latest fiscal year that is fully loaded. FY2026/27 is only partly loaded, since period 6 is flagged as not fully loaded. The request gave no period.
FY2025/26 has 53 weeks (period 12 runs 6 weeks). I did not adjust for this.
Staff purchases left in, as they are real sales through the till.
Store names are the current names from dim_store.
caveats: Correction: fact_sales_line holds 418 duplicated lines, loaded twice for store 116 Tampere Lielahti in the week 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21 (a second load on 2025-09-23). They have different sales_line_id values but the same receipt_id and line_no. I kept the first load of each line. About EUR 20,781 of net sales was double counted (about 10,390 once deduplicated). Without this fix Tampere Lielahti would be overstated. It stays 8th either way.

Excluded the web shop (store_id 900) and the Training store (999). The web shop would otherwise rank first, with about EUR 2.10m net sales in FY2025/26. It is not a store, so it is left out. The Training store is a pseudo-location.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 2026-01-25. It is not in the top 10. Pori (119) had a 5-week refit closure in Sep to Oct 2025, so its FY2025/26 sales are depressed. It also falls outside the top 10.

Store attributes change over time (the regions were re-mapped on 2025-04-28 and some stores moved from South or East to Capital Region or South). I grouped by store_id so each store counts once across versions. Region is not used in the answer.
dim_store.format holds Small, Medium and Large, while the column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express. This does not affect the result.

The ranking is robust to the period chosen. The same ten stores come out on top in FY2025/26 and over all loaded history, but the order shifts. For example, Turku Kupittaa is 3rd over all history and 5th in FY2025/26, and Lahti is 5th over all history and 4th in FY2025/26. The figures match rpt_daily_store_sales for these stores, which already excludes the duplicates.

answer.sql: WITH lfl_store AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 AND store_id <> 129), sales AS (SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'base' END AS win, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id = s.store_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-05' AND DATE '2025-06-01'), returns AS (SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'base' END AS win, -r.refund_net AS amount FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id = s.store_id WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-05' AND DATE '2025-06-01'), tot AS (SELECT win, sum(amount) net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM returns) GROUP BY win) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round(100 * (max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE win='cur') / max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE win='base') - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM tot
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 1 = 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-31 (4 weeks, ref_fiscal_calendar)
Like-for-like: only stores that traded in both the current and the comparison window
Like-for-like sales = store sales only. Web shop (store 900), click-and-collect (booked to the web shop in both years) and the training store (999) are excluded
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excl. VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the window, matching rpt_daily_store_sales
Stores identified by store_id (not store_key), so store versions and region reassignments do not affect the result
Store sales selected by store (store_id 101-139), not by channel_code = 'ST', because the channel code was replaced by channel_id from 2025-11-03
assumptions: 'Period 1 this year' means FY2026/27 P01, the latest P01 (today is 2026-10-09 and that fiscal year runs from 2026-05-04)

The comparison window is 364 days earlier, 2025-05-05 to 2025-06-01. FY2025/26 was a 53-week year, so FY2026/27 week 1 starts a week later in the calendar than FY2025/26 week 1. Matching weekdays and the time of year means comparing with FY2025/26 weeks 2-5, not weeks 1-4 (P01). The same-label comparison is shown below
Both windows have 28 trading days and the same holidays. The same-label window (2025-04-28 to 2025-05-25) contains May Day (2025-05-01), when the stores were shut and recorded no sales

Stores 136 Tampere Lamminpää (opened 2024-09-02) and 137 Lohja (opened 2024-11-04) are included. They were open for the whole of the comparison window and for more than 12 months before the current period began
Staff purchases are included, as they are real till sales and the net-sales report includes them
Returns are counted in the period they are booked, not the period of the original sale, as in the daily store sales report
caveats: Correction: store 129 Savonlinna closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in the current period. It is excluded, which leaves 38 comparable stores (it had about 11.7k EUR net in the comparison window)

Correction: from 2025-11-03 fact_sales_line carries channel_id instead of channel_code. Filtering on channel_code = 'ST' returns no rows for 2026 and would fail the comparison. Web orders were also coded WB in the old data, so I selected stores by store_id instead

Correction: the 2026 window shows web and training-store lines under store keys 900 and 999. Removing them keeps the figure to store trading only (the total includes about 229k EUR of web sales in the current period that is not in the figure)

Correction: the 53-week FY2025/26 shifts the calendar. Comparing P01 with P01 (2025-04-28 to 2025-05-25) gives +6.70% (+6.12% without stores 136 and 137). That figure is flattered by seasonal build-up, because the 2025 window ends a week earlier in the spring season and includes the May Day closure. The 364-day comparison, +1.23%, is the like-for-like figure

Sensitivity: excluding the two stores opened in 2024 (136 and 137), which grew 13-15% against a 1% average, gives +0.74% instead of +1.23%. The tmp_lfl_store_list_2024 and 2025 tables leave them out. I kept them in because both were open for the whole comparison window
Individual stores swing widely (from -22% at Porvoo to +16.5% at Jyväskylä Palokka), so the +1.23% hides a lot of store-level variation

Duplicate lines exist in fact_sales_line for 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21 (about 418 lines loaded twice). They fall outside both windows and do not affect this answer, but they will inflate any query that covers September 2025

The comparison window for region or store breakdowns is not affected by the regional reorganisation of 2025-04-28 (Capital Region), but a regional split of this figure would need store_id-based mapping
The data was complete for all of period 1 in both years (fully_loaded = true, no duplicate lines in either window, daily sales from every store on all 28 days)

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Web shop = pseudo-store 900 (store_id, not channel_code, which is empty from 3 Nov 2025)
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date from fact_web_order (delivered and collected orders; cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines)
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date, booked to store 900
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal periods from dim_date (FY2025/26: P5 25 Aug-21 Sep 2025, P6 22 Sep-26 Oct, P7 27 Oct-23 Nov, P8 24 Nov-21 Dec 2025)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900, same periods
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, or any stg_, bak_, tmp_ or _old tables
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27), consistent with how requests in May 2026 were read; periods 5 to 8 are P5 to P8 of FY2025/26
Web shop read as the whole web channel (home delivery and click-and-collect), i.e. store 900
Figures are net of VAT, as is company default, since the request did not ask for gross
One row per period, no total row, since the request asks for each period
caveats: All four periods are fully loaded and finished well before the 4 Oct 2026 load date; returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, so late P8 sales (December 2025) are long settled.
Figures agree exactly with rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 in each period (net sales, before-returns and returns).

Correction: web sales are dated on the dispatch date rather than the order date (sale_date) on the web lines, and channel_code was not used because it is empty after the 3 Nov 2025 platform migration (P7 and P8).
Correction: ZZ Test articles were excluded; this changed P6 by only 5.50 EUR of sales. No other period had test articles.

Refunds on web orders that customers returned in a physical store are booked to that store under the company definition, so they are not in the web figures (about 5,495 EUR in P5, 4,784 in P6, 4,901 in P7 and 4,545 in P8, excluding VAT). If Finance wants web net sales net of every refund on web orders wherever processed, deduct these amounts.
Week 53 and LFL rules are not relevant: the periods requested have no week 53 and no comparison was asked for.

answer.sql: WITH net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'), sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1), trading AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2 AND is_trading_day) d WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date<=d.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date>=d.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM sales s JOIN trading t USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days in the period when the store was open, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and not a closed holiday (dim_date.is_trading_day)
Physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) left out
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 2 (weeks 5 to 8, 1 June to 28 June 2026), taken from dim_date
Staff purchases included in net sales
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
Open and close dates read from the current dim_store version
assumptions: 'Period 2 this year' read as FY2026/27 P2, the current fiscal year as of the request date (9 October 2026). P2 is complete and fully loaded.
Ranking is by net sales per trading day, highest first, as the company league-table definition says, not by total net sales.
Stores are listed with the sales they have in the period. Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no trading days in P2, so it is not listed.
Standard rank ties handled with RANK(); no ties occurred.
Returns are booked to the store where they were processed, as in the company net-sales definition.
caveats: Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays, so a full-period store has 26 trading days, not 28.

Kuopio (125) was in its refit closure from 15 June 2026, so only 14 trading days (1 to 14 June) count. Its net sales of 23,993.71 are for those days only. Per trading day it ranks 7th, but its period total is much lower than the stores around it.
Store-level net sales agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to the cent for all 38 stores over 1 to 28 June 2026, so there was no unexplained gap.
The exclusion of store 999 and ZZ Test does not change any store figure in this table: there are no ZZ Test lines in the physical stores in the period, and store 999 is not a league-table store.
No duplicate sales or return lines were found in the period (distinct receipt/line and return line counts match the row counts).
Web shop (900) is not in the league table. Web returns booked to store 900 are left out with it.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Order date taken from order_ts_utc
Cancelled orders excluded, processing orders included
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out of reporting
Black Friday 2025 is 28 November 2025
assumptions: Black Friday 2025 is 28 November 2025, as the request states.
'Placed' means order_ts_utc, the time the order was placed.
Cancelled orders are not web orders, following the company definition. Including them would give 377.
Orders with status processing would count. There are none on this day.
caveats: The company default is the Helsinki order date. I followed the request and used the UTC calendar day instead, and the count differs from a Helsinki-day count. The Helsinki-day count was not computed.
20 cancelled orders on 28 November (UTC) are excluded. Of the 377 orders in total, 260 were delivered and 97 collected (click-and-collect).
No duplicate web_order_id values on the day, and no ZZ Test orders among those with sales lines. Cancelled and processing orders have no sales lines, so the test-article check cannot cover them.

answer.sql: SELECT count(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cast(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Order date is the Helsinki local calendar date of order placement (order_ts_utc converted from UTC to Europe/Helsinki). This matches sale_date on the sales lines.
Cancelled orders are excluded. They have no sales lines.
Web orders include home delivery and click-and-collect. In fact_sales_line these are channel_id 2 and 3, and legacy code WB before the migration.
