answer.sql: SELECT cp.category, ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value FROM fact_stock_week fsw JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND cs.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2026-03-01', '2026-03-08', '2026-03-15', '2026-03-22') GROUP BY cp.category ORDER BY cp.category
definitions_applied: Average stock value from weekly closing snapshots at standard cost
As-is reporting (current region and category structure)
Store scope excludes web (900) and training stores (999)
assumptions: Interpreted 'last year' as FY2025/26, the fiscal year prior to the current FY2026/27
Interpreted 'period 11' as fiscal period 11, which spans weeks 44-47 (23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026)
Interpreted 'average stock value' as the average of weekly closing values across all stores and products in each category
Used as-is reporting (current West region definition, current category definitions)

answer.sql: WITH sales_data AS (SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as sales_net, COALESCE(SUM(f.standard_cost), 0) as cost_goods FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY p.category), return_data AS (SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as returns_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0) as returns_cost FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY p.category) SELECT s.category, ROUND(s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0), 2) as net_sales, ROUND(((s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) - (s.cost_goods - COALESCE(r.returns_cost, 0))) / (s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0))) * 100, 2) as gross_margin_pct FROM sales_data s LEFT JOIN return_data r ON s.category = r.category ORDER BY s.category
definitions_applied: Net sales: sales net amount (after line discounts and VAT exclusion) minus refunds, both from recorded transactions
Gross margin percentage: (net sales - standard cost of goods sold) / net sales * 100, where COGS includes returned goods cost
Fiscal period: FY2025/26 Period 6 (22 Sep 2025 – 26 Oct 2025)
Standard cost: the standard unit cost from dim_product revalued each April
assumptions: Last year refers to fiscal year 2025/26 (the most recent complete fiscal year relative to today 15 Oct 2026)
Period 6 refers to fiscal period 6 within that fiscal year
Net sales includes both store and web channel transactions
Gross margin is calculated on the net sales value (excluding VAT) and gross cost (including cost of returns)
caveats: Gross margin calculated at the line level using standard cost; standard cost was last revalued in April 2026 and may not reflect actual COGS for all products if actual costs have changed
Web orders and store purchases are included without separation
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag = true) are included in the calculation

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Web orders counted from fact_web_order, not from sales lines
Web orders counted on the Helsinki order date (order_ts_utc converted from UTC to Europe/Helsinki, day changes at local midnight)
Cancelled orders excluded; orders still processing would be included (none on this date)
Click-and-collect counted as web, guest and logged-in orders both included
Store 999 and category ZZ Test left out (checked: no order on the day touches either)
Deprecated objects not used (rpt.v_daily_sales, channel_code, stg_/bak_/tmp_ tables)
assumptions: Read 'Cyber Monday, 1 December 2025' as the calendar date 1 December 2025 in Helsinki time, as given in the request.
Read 'number of web shop orders' as the company definition of web orders (placed on the day, cancelled excluded), not web sales recognised on the dispatch date.
Staff purchases, guest orders and click-and-collect orders are all included, since the web order definition has no exclusion for them.
caveats: 19 orders placed on 1 December 2025 (Helsinki time) were cancelled and are excluded. Counting them would give 345.
Counting by UTC date instead of Helsinki date gives 267, because Finland was UTC+2 and the Helsinki day starts at 22:00 UTC the evening before. 326 uses the Helsinki date.
Of the 326 orders, 239 are delivered and 87 are collected. None are still processing.
Order ids are unique in fact_web_order (no duplicates on the day or overall). All 326 orders have sales lines, and none are test or store 999 orders, so no correction changed the count.
Plausibility check: 326 is well above the roughly 120 to 150 non-cancelled orders on ordinary days that week, and below Black Friday (28 November: 402).

answer.sql: SELECT count(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00:00' AND status <> 'cancelled'
definitions_applied: Web order = one row in fact_web_order, home delivery and click-and-collect both counted
Cancelled orders excluded (status <> 'cancelled'); delivered and collected orders counted
Business date = Finnish local date (Europe/Helsinki, UTC+2 in December), matching the sale_date on the sales lines
Cross-check against fact_sales_line on channel_id 2 and 3 (web home delivery and click and collect) with sale_date = 2025-12-01
assumptions: Cyber Monday 2025 is Monday 1 December 2025, as stated in the request
'Web shop orders' means orders that went through, so cancelled orders are not counted
Guest and logged-in orders are both included
The day is the Finnish calendar day, not the UTC day
caveats: Timestamps in the warehouse are UTC. The Finnish day of 1 December runs from 22:00 UTC on 30 November to 22:00 UTC on 1 December. A filter on the UTC date would give a different count, because the two days overlap only partly.
19 orders placed on 1 December were cancelled and are excluded. Including them gives 345 orders placed.

From the web-platform migration, web sales lines have a NULL channel_code and are identified by channel_id (2 = home delivery, 3 = click and collect). A filter on channel_code = 'WB' misses them, and the rpt.v_daily_sales view has the same gap.

The result agrees with the sales lines: 239 home-delivery and 87 click-and-collect orders, 326 in all, each with a sale_date of 1 December. fact_web_order has no duplicate order ids and no processing-status orders on the day.

answer.sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(s.closing_value) AS avg_stock_value FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_store st ON s.store_key = st.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON s.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date WHERE st.region = 'West' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 11 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
definitions_applied: Fiscal period definition from ref_fiscal_calendar: FY2025/26 period 11 runs 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-22
Region definition from dim_store: West region includes 10 stores (Tampere Hervanta, Tampere Lielahti, Tampere Kaleva, Nokia, Pori, Rauma, Vaasa, Seinäjoki, Kokkola, Tampere Lamminpää)
Stock value from fact_stock_week: weekly closing_value at standard cost in EUR, averaged across all store-product combinations in scope
Product category from dim_product: 10 distinct categories present in data for West region in period 11
assumptions: Interpreted 'last year' as the previous fiscal year (FY2025/26), relative to the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (current date 2026-10-15)
Interpreted 'period 11' as fiscal period 11 (not calendar month 11), based on standard warehouse conventions
Averaged closing_value across all 4 weeks in period 11 (2026-02-23, 2026-03-01, 2026-03-08, 2026-03-15, 2026-03-22) and all store-product combinations
Included only product versions that were current or valid during period 11 dates (join via week_ending_date)
Included only store versions that were valid during period 11 dates (all West region stores have valid_from before 2026-02-23)
caveats: All 37,233 stock records for West region in period 11 have non-null closing_value; no imputation needed

Furniture category shows substantially higher average stock value (545.77 EUR) compared to other categories (36.78 to 166.11 EUR), which is typical for larger furniture items stored by unit value rather than unit count
Result includes one store (Tampere Lamminpää, store_key 42) opened 2024-09-02; it was operational during period 11
No data quality issues detected; all joins completed successfully

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT r.fiscal_year, r.fiscal_period, r.period_end_date AS as_of_end FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE r.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period = 8), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN p WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end) SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN p JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND p.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks, ending with and including the as-of week, in any channel
Distinct member_id counted, never member_key (one key per member version)
Trailing window: sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 P08 ends Sunday 21 December 2025 (fiscal weeks 31 to 34)
Guest web orders have no member key and are not counted
Purchase counted without the store 999 / ZZ Test filter, as in accepted requests REQ-D29 and REQ-D30; checked that the filter would change nothing
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26. The request is dated 7 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and past requests took the previous fiscal year for 'last year'.
'End of period 8' was read as the last day of FY2025/26 P08, Sunday 21 December 2025. The window is 23 December 2024 to 21 December 2025, 52 whole fiscal weeks.
'Active members by tier' was read as one row per tier (Basic, Silver, Gold), with no total row because none was asked for.
Tier is the tier on 21 December 2025, not the member's current tier.
caveats: FY2025/26 has 53 weeks, but P08 is not affected: it runs weeks 31 to 34, with four weeks.

No corrections were needed. The counts matched with and without the store 999 and ZZ Test filter (no member bought only from those), there were no duplicate sales lines, and no member keys were left unmatched in dim_member. Exactly one member version was valid on the as-of date for each active member, so the three tiers add up to the 29,526 active members.
Staff purchases are included in the activity test (1,761 active members have at least one staff-purchase line), in line with the company net sales rule and past accepted requests.
If you meant FY2026/27 P08, that period has not happened yet. The warehouse is loaded only to 4 October 2026, which is in P06.

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold FROM fact_sales_line fsl INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13 AND fsl.store_key = 13 AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
definitions_applied: Units sold: quantity from fact_sales_line (point-in-time sales, before returns)
Store: Lahti (store_id 108)
Product: Interior Paint (Paint & Decorating category, Interior Paint subcategory)
Period: FY2026/27 P03 (fiscal weeks 9-13, 29 June to 2 August 2026)
assumptions: Period 3 this year interpreted as FY2026/27 P03 (fiscal year 2026/27 is the current fiscal year)
Interior Paint identified by subcategory = 'Interior Paint' in Paint & Decorating category (123 product SKUs)
Units sold measured as quantity from fact_sales_line at the point of original sale, not adjusted for subsequent returns
caveats: Lahti store (store_id 108) has one version (store_key 13) with valid_from 2000-01-01, covering the entire period
Period 3 is fully loaded in the warehouse (complete as of the request date 2026-10-15)

answer.sql: SELECT p.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE f.store_key = 24 AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.subcategory ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 5 defined by ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2026/27: 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
Units sold counted from fact_sales_line (gross transaction quantities)
Store identified by dim_store (Nokia = store_id 118, store_key 24)
assumptions: "This year" interpreted as FY2026/27 (fiscal year containing the current date 2026-10-15)
"Period 5" matched to fiscal_period 5 in the fiscal calendar
Store identified by exact name match to "Nokia"
caveats: Units sold are gross quantities from transactions; returns tracked separately in fact_return_line are not deducted
Single store named Nokia identified (store_id 118); result is for that store only

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines by sale date (metric dictionary, weeks-of-cover wording), before returns
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 3 = fiscal weeks 9 to 13, 29 June to 2 August 2026, from dim_date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither affects this store or subcategory)
Staff purchases included (4 units)
As-is product hierarchy (current product version); both Interior Paint SKUs with multiple versions kept the same subcategory in every version, so as-was gives the same figure
Store scope by store_id 108 via the versioned dim_store key
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 108, 29 June to 2 August 2026: fact table units 3927, report units 3927, net sales before returns 67202.85 in both, receipts 1048 in both
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year FY2026/27 (the request was received 5 October 2026), and period 3 is fully loaded
'Lahti store' means store_id 108 (city and name Lahti, format Large, region South); the other store with a similar name is Tampere Lielahti (116), which is not Lahti
'Units sold' means gross units on sales lines, not net of returns, following the company's units-sold wording
'Interior Paint' means the subcategory Interior Paint within Paint & Decorating; Exterior Paint (83 units at Lahti in the period) is not included
Store sales only: Lahti is a physical store, and web lines belong to store 900, not to Lahti
caveats: No data problems affected this figure and no corrections were needed: no duplicate sales lines, no non-positive quantities, all 35 days of the period have sales, and store 108 has no refit closure in ref_store_closure

6 units of Interior Paint sold at Lahti in the period were returned (refund 220.12 EUR excluding VAT); returns are not netted from the 194, so net of returns the figure would be 188. Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, so the last weeks of the period may still collect more
dim_store.format for Lahti is 'Large', which the column comment (Hyper, Standard or Express) does not list; this has no effect on the answer
channel_code is empty on these store lines (it stopped being filled from the November 2025 web platform migration), so the lines were identified by store_id, not channel_code

answer.sql: WITH targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-15 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25 00:00:00'), lines AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS recog_date FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-15' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted)) SELECT 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, 19 AS campaign_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, round(sum(net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_eur_excl_vat_before_returns FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id <> 999 AND category <> 'ZZ Test'
definitions_applied: Campaign window from dim_campaign: Spring Garden Launch 2026 is campaign 19, 4 to 24 May 2026, email+sms
Targeted member = at least one row in fact_campaign_exposure for the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member (exposure has one row per contact, and member_key is a version key)
Spend = net sales before returns: net_amount excluding VAT, after line discounts, on lines linked to the member (the member-level convention in the campaign uplift definition)
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (dispatch_ts_utc converted from UTC to Europe/Helsinki), not the order date; store lines dated on sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (the filter changed nothing in this result)
Staff purchases included
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key
Reported excluding VAT, as all net sales are
assumptions: 'Contacted' is read as having at least one contact row in the campaign exposure table, whether or not the message was delivered or opened. 14,814 of the 15,001 had at least one delivered contact.

'Those members' means the 15,001 contacted members, so the spend figure covers every contacted member, purchasers or not. Only 2,605 of them bought anything in the window. The holdout group is not included.

'Spend' is read as net sales excluding VAT, before returns. Net sales after returns is the company definition for sales reporting, but returns were not netted here because the request asks what members spent. I did not check how much of this spend was later returned.
The period is exactly 4 to 24 May 2026 (the campaign window), without the extra 7 days used in the uplift calculation, because the request gives the dates explicitly.
Spend covers all channels (stores and web) for the targeted members.

Prefilter in the SQL: web orders are dispatched 0 to 7 days after the order in fact_web_order, so restricting to order dates from 15 April 2026 loses no lines dispatched in the window. It only keeps the query fast.
caveats: The exposure table gives 15,001 distinct contacted members, but the dim_campaign figures imply 15,027 (mailing list 16,624 minus 1,597 holdout), a gap of 26. I could not find the cause in the warehouse: there is no overlap with the holdout, no contacted member lacks marketing consent, and the staging contact table holds no campaign 19 rows. The count here follows the exposure table. If the 26 were contacted but are missing from the table, both figures would be slightly low.
If dispatch date is not used and web lines are dated on the order date instead, spend would be 191,576.08 (2,626 purchasers) rather than 190,687.59. I used the company rule, dispatch date.
Figures are before returns. Refunds booked in the window or later are not deducted.
Staging, backup and old tables, and the rpt.v_daily_sales views, were not used. The views drop web sales from 3 November 2025.
The reported spend is for the 15,001 contacted members as a group. It is not an uplift figure: no comparison with the holdout was made, and the request did not ask for one.

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
definitions_applied: FY2024/25 period 5 = fiscal weeks 18-21, 26 Aug 2024 to 22 Sep 2024 (dim_date)
Stores = physical stores only (store_id below 900): web shop 900 and training store 999 left out
Test articles (category ZZ Test) left out (none were sold in physical stores in this period)
VAT charged = gross_amount minus net_amount summed on the sales lines, grouped by each line's own vat_rate (no flat rate applied to a net total)
Store sales dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Control total: net sales before returns for these lines (938,729.24) matches rpt_daily_store_sales exactly
assumptions: 'Period 5 of FY24/25' is read as FY2024/25 P05, i.e. 26 Aug 2024 to 22 Sep 2024.
'VAT we charged in the stores' is read as VAT on sales lines in the physical stores. Web orders, including click-and-collect, are excluded because they are booked to the web shop (store 900).
'VAT charged' is taken as VAT on sales before returns. It is not netted against VAT refunded on returns, which are shown separately in the caveats.
Rates are shown as percentages. The general rate changed from 24% to 25.5% on 1 Sep 2024, inside this period. Both rows are real and are not a data error.
No total row was given because the request asked only for a split by rate.
caveats: The 24% row covers 26-31 Aug 2024 and the 25.5% row covers 1-22 Sep 2024, because of the general VAT rate rise on 1 Sep 2024. The 14% and 10% rates did not change.
Store 999 (training store) is excluded. It had 140 lines and 685.00 EUR of VAT in the period.
Web shop (store 900) VAT of 30,846.16 EUR in the period is excluded, since the request is about stores.

VAT refunded on store returns booked in the period (by return date) is not deducted: 10%: 1.20, 14%: 10.48, 24%: 5,094.72, 25.5%: 6,029.57 EUR (11,135.97 in total). Net of refunds, VAT would be 149.47, 807.14, 49,010.48 and 173,987.66 EUR.
Checks found no problems: no duplicate sales lines, no orphan store keys, no negative lines, and gross_amount equals net_amount times (1 + vat_rate) on every line. No data corrections were needed.

answer.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6), cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS current_category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current), lines AS (SELECT 'sale' AS kind, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS std_cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key, per WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id <> 999 UNION ALL SELECT 'return', p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key, per WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id <> 999) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, c.current_category AS category, round(sum(net), 2) AS net_sales, round(100 * (sum(net) - sum(std_cost)) / sum(net), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM lines l JOIN cur c USING (sku) WHERE c.current_category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY c.current_category ORDER BY c.current_category
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 6 of FY2025/26 runs 2025-09-22 to 2025-10-26 (5 weeks), taken from ref_fiscal_calendar
Net sales = line value excluding VAT after line discounts, less refunds excluding VAT booked in the period (the same definition as rpt_daily_store_sales: net sales before returns minus returns)
Gross margin % = (net sales - standard cost of units sold net of standard cost of units returned) / net sales, at standard cost as carried on the fact tables
Returns are counted in the period in which the refund is booked (return_date), not in the period of the original sale
All sales channels included (stores and web shop); staff purchases included, as in the daily store sales report
Category is the article's current category (dim_product is_current, joined by SKU), so history is on today's category structure
The Training store (store 999) is excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location
assumptions: Read 'last year' as the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request was received on 2026-10-08 and the company reports on a fiscal calendar, and 'period 6' is a fiscal period. FY2026/27 P06 is also not fully loaded.
Read 'net sales' as net of returns and excluding VAT, and 'gross margin %' as margin on net sales at standard cost, because the warehouse carries no actual-cost or supplier-rebate data.

Restated the history to the current category structure, so that Outdoor Lighting counts under Electrical. I did this so the figures line up with how the categories are reported today and with this year's period 6. The as-reported alternative is in the caveats.
Kept staff purchases in, because the daily store sales report does not remove them. Staff purchases are 841 store lines worth 16,956 net, plus 138 lines at the Training store, which is excluded.
caveats: Correction 1, category reclassification: the Outdoor Lighting subcategory (about 68 SKUs) moved from Garden to Electrical on 2025-10-27, the day after period 6 ended. The warehouse stamps each sale with the category at the time of sale, so a plain join puts Outdoor Lighting in Garden for this period. I restated it to Electrical. It is worth 36,402.47 of net sales before returns, and 36,119.15 after returns.

As reported at the time (Outdoor Lighting in Garden), the figures are Garden 147,932.68 net sales with 39.52% gross margin, and Electrical 185,576.57 with 41.63%. If you need figures that match last year's published numbers, use these.

Correction 2, Training store: store 999 (Training store, head office) has 138 sales lines (about 4,174 net across all categories) in the period. Test-type sales do not belong in trading results, so I excluded them. It has no returns.

Five Outdoor Lighting SKUs still sit in Garden in the current product table, so the reclassification was not applied to them. They are all delisted, with last sales between January and August 2025, so they have no sales in this period and do not affect the figures.

The warehouse's daily store sales report (rpt_daily_store_sales) is not reliable for web sales. Its web figures for this period are shifted across days: Sundays are near zero and Mondays are roughly doubled. They are also 985.62 lower in total than the sales lines. I used the fact tables rather than that report.
Gross margin uses standard cost, which is revalued each April. It is not actual purchase cost, so it is a standard margin.
Net sales excluding VAT before returns are 231,019.73 for Electrical and 121,520.58 for Garden on the restated basis. Returns reduce them by about 4.9% and 6.3% respectively.

answer.sql: WITH receipt_totals AS (SELECT s.format, f.receipt_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS is_staff, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY s.format, f.receipt_id) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, format AS store_format, round(avg(receipt_net), 2) AS average_basket_value_eur FROM receipt_totals WHERE NOT is_staff GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
definitions_applied: Fiscal period 4 of FY2026/27 taken from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar: 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026, 4 weeks, fully loaded
Average basket value = average value of a receipt: sum of net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) over distinct receipt_id
Physical stores only: store_id below 900, which leaves out the web shop (900) and the Training store (999)
Store format taken from dim_store through fact_sales_line.store_key (the store version valid at the sale date)
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded
Returns not netted off the baskets
assumptions: Read 'period 4 of FY26/27' as FY2026/27 fiscal period 4 (3 to 30 Aug 2026), not calendar April
Basket value is in EUR excluding VAT, matching the company's net sales reporting; including VAT the averages would be Large 76.06, Medium 75.57, Small 63.61
Web orders are left out because the request asks for store format and web orders have no store format
Staff purchases are left out because they are not customer baskets; they are under 2% of receipts, and including them would change the averages by about 0.1 (Large 60.60, Medium 60.15, Small 50.67)
Returns are not deducted from the basket, since a basket is the value of the transaction at the till
Receipts are counted by distinct receipt_id; each receipt belongs to one store, one date and one staff status, so none is split or double-counted
caveats: Format labels are Small, Medium and Large in dim_store, although the column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express. I reported the labels the data holds.

The Training store (999) had sales in the period: 55 receipts and about EUR 1,885 net. I excluded it as non-trading test data, and it would have been wrongly counted if formats were taken without filtering.
Web shop sales are also in fact_sales_line (3,229 orders), and the rpt.v_daily_sales view mixes them into totals. I excluded them from the store formats.
fact_sales_line.channel_code is empty for every line in the period, so I identified stores through dim_store, not channel_code.
Savonlinna (store 129) was closed on 25 Jan 2026 and has no sales in the period. The Kuopio refit (store 125) ended on 26 Jul 2026, before the period, so it is included for the full four weeks.

Checks found no problems: no duplicate receipt lines, no receipts spanning stores or dates, no non-positive amounts, VAT arithmetic consistent, and fact totals match rpt_daily_store_sales for all 1,064 store-days. The period is marked fully loaded.
Averages are based on 6,508 (Large), 8,641 (Medium) and 2,598 (Small) receipts, excluding staff purchases.

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: a member record with join_date equal to the target date
Distinct member_id: counted unique members (dim_member is slowly changing; all members have only one join_date across all versions)
assumptions: Join date '2026-09-25' interpreted as calendar date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
Counted all members with matching join_date regardless of version history, since join_date is stable across slowly-changing versions
caveats: All 39 members are current versions (is_current = true); no orphaned old records
No data quality issues detected; member counts for nearby dates (39–44 sign-ups per day) are consistent

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the first version in dim_member
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key or version row
Online sign-ups (home store 900) included as new members
assumptions: 25 September 2026 is read as the calendar join date; join_date is a plain date, so no UTC/Helsinki conversion applies
All sign-up channels count: 31 store enrolments and 8 online sign-ups under store 900
No breakdown by store was asked for, so a single total is given
caveats: No data problems affected this count. Each of the 39 members has exactly one version row, one distinct join_date, and a first-version valid_from equal to the join date.
25 September 2026 lies inside the fully loaded fiscal periods (loaded through 27 September 2026), so the day is complete.
The count reflects dim_member as of now; the 25 September cohort has had no tier, store or consent changes recorded since joining.

answer.sql: WITH web AS (SELECT f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 'P9-P10' AS periods, round(100.0 * sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect') / sum(net_amount), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct FROM web
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2025/26 periods 9 and 10 run 2025-12-22 to 2026-02-22 (5 + 4 weeks), taken from dim_date and ref_fiscal_calendar
Web sales: sales lines with channel_id 2 or 3 (web home delivery and click and collect, channel_group = web), using the post-migration channel key
Click and collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, joined on receipt_id = web_order_id
Sales value is net_amount, which is EUR excluding VAT and after line discounts
Cancelled web orders are excluded, because they have no sales lines (all web lines in the window belong to delivered or collected orders)
sale_date is the Helsinki local date and was used as the date of sale
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26. The request is dated 2026-10-06, which falls in FY2026/27 P06.
'Periods 9 and 10' are fiscal periods 9 and 10 combined, giving one share for the two periods. No per-period breakdown was requested.
'Share of web sales' means share of sales value (EUR excl. VAT, before returns), not share of order count. For reference, by order count it is 1,830 of 6,178 orders, or 29.6%.
Returns are not netted off. If refunds were deducted the share would be about 30.1% (C&C refunds 12,279.65 and home delivery refunds 29,810.74, both excl. VAT).
caveats: Channel mis-coding corrected: from 2026-01-12 to 2026-02-08 the sales lines of 758 click-and-collect orders (1,473 lines, EUR 43,819.29 net) carry channel_id 2 (Web home delivery) instead of 3 (Click and collect). Counting by channel_id alone would give a share of only 17.3% (60,496.25 of 347,431.30). I classified by fulfilment_type from fact_web_order, which gives 104,315.54 net for click and collect out of 347,431.30 total web net, or 30.02%. The corrected figure agrees with the order-level gross totals in fact_web_order (130,883.27 for click and collect, 304,910.64 for home delivery).
Before the web-platform migration on 2025-11-03, lines carry channel_code (WB) and no channel_id. This does not affect periods 9 and 10, which fall after the migration.

The mis-coding looks like a source-system or ETL issue in the channel mapping, and it should be fixed upstream. Any other report that splits web sales by channel_id for 12 Jan to 8 Feb 2026 will understate click and collect.
The gross-basis share (including VAT) is 30.03%, so the choice of net or gross basis does not change the result.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27 runs 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Store identified by stable store_id (118, Nokia), joined through the store_key version on each sales line
Subcategory taken from the product version in force at the sale (product_key)
Units sold = sum of fact_sales_line.quantity (gross units sold, before returns)
assumptions: 'This year' read as the current fiscal year FY2026/27, since the request is dated 2026-10-09 and the fiscal year starts in late August
'Period 5' read as fiscal period 5 (FY2026/27 P05), not calendar month 5
'Nokia' read as the store Nokia (store_id 118, city Nokia, West region); it is the only store with that name or city
Units sold counted gross: returns are not netted off, as the request asks for units sold and not net units
Staff purchases are counted as sales (no rule in the warehouse excludes them)
Subcategory is the product's subcategory, not the category
caveats: No data problems found for Nokia in this period: all 28 days present and all trading days, no closures for store 118, no duplicate sales lines or receipt lines, no product-key versions outside their validity dates, and no differences between sale_date and the Helsinki-local date of the timestamp

Staff purchases are 21 units in Nokia's P05 sales. Excluding them would not change the first two places (Fixings & Fasteners 560, Indoor Lighting 150), but it would turn third place into a tie at 136 units between Storage Boxes and Cleaning Products, so the third place depends on staff purchases being counted

Outdoor Lighting appears under both Electrical and Garden in the product table for some SKUs. This does not affect the answer, because Outdoor Lighting is not among Nokia's top subcategories and grouping is by subcategory name
Nokia's Fixings & Fasteners units are down from 792 in P03 and 620 in P04, but are still far ahead of second place

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name, fsw.week_ending_date, fsw.closing_units FROM fact_stock_week fsw JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key WHERE p.sku = 100011 AND s.store_name ILIKE '%Jyväskylä%Palokka%' AND fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
definitions_applied: Closing stock from fact_stock_week at the week-ending Sunday
Last completed fiscal week (FY2026/27 week 22)
Physical store only (store_id < 900)
assumptions: Interpreted 'last week' as the last completed fiscal week, which is week 22 of FY2026/27 (28 Sept – 4 Oct 2026), since the warehouse is loaded through 4 October 2026
Jyväskylä Palokka identified as store_id 124

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 AND s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
definitions_applied: Product subcategory 'Cleaning Products' within 'Cleaning & Household' category
Store 107 (Hyvinkää, South region)
Sales line quantity summed across all units sold
assumptions: 'This year' interpreted as FY2025/26, the fiscal year current at the request date of 2026-10-05
'Cleaning Products' interpreted as the subcategory within the warehouse, not a separate category (exact category is 'Cleaning & Household')
All sales channels (store and web) included

answer.sql: SELECT (SELECT mailing_list_size - holdout_size FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 19) AS members_contacted, SUM(f.net_amount) AS spending_may_4_to_24_2026 FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key WHERE m.is_current = true AND f.sale_date >= '2026-05-04' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 19)
definitions_applied: Members contacted = mailing list size minus holdout size for the campaign
Spending = sum of net sales amount (EUR, excluding VAT) from fact_sales_line
Current member records only (is_current = true at time of purchase)
assumptions: Spring Garden Launch 2026 mailing refers to campaign ID 19 with start date 2026-05-04 and end date 2026-05-24
Date range 'between 4 and 24 May 2026' is inclusive of both 4 May and 24 May
Spending is measured as net amount (excluding VAT); request did not specify gross vs net
All sales channels (store and web) are included in spending calculation
caveats: The campaign holdout group includes 1,597 members who received no contact
Spending total includes only members who made at least one purchase during the period; the full contacted population of 15,027 may include members with zero purchases
The mailing list size (16,624) comes from campaign setup and may include members who were no longer active at the time of contact

answer.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2), sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1), refunds AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1), latest AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net, 0) DESC) AS rank, sales.store_id, latest.store_name, round(sales.sales_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur FROM sales LEFT JOIN refunds USING (store_id) JOIN latest USING (store_id) ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 2 = 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28 (4 weeks, fiscal weeks 5 to 8), taken from ref_fiscal_calendar; the period is fully loaded
Net sales = sales lines net of VAT (net_amount, after line discounts) minus refunds net of VAT (refund_net), in EUR
Refunds are counted in the period in which they are booked (return_date) and at the store where they are booked, the same as the Data & Analytics daily store sales report (rpt_daily_store_sales)
Store identity through the store_key version on each fact row, mapped to store_id and the current store name
Physical stores only: store_id below 900
Staff purchases are included, as in the daily store sales report
Rank 1 is the highest net sales
assumptions: 'This year' is read as the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, because the request is dated 2026-10-09 and that year began on 2026-05-04. 'Period 2' is read as fiscal period 2, not calendar month 2.
'Store league table' is read as stores ranked by net sales for the period, highest first. No other ranking measure was asked for, so sales per square metre or growth against last year are not shown.
Net sales excludes VAT and is after returns, matching the company's daily store sales report. Gross-of-VAT and before-returns figures are not shown.

Web shop (store 900) sales are not part of a store league table, so web and click-and-collect sales are not credited to any store. All of 900's sales lines sit under the web shop, not the pickup store.
Stores that have no sales in the period are left out and not shown as zero rows.
caveats: Excluded the web shop (store_id 900): 253,566.50 EUR of sales lines before returns in the period, which is not a physical store.
Excluded the Training store (store_id 999): 2,381.03 EUR of sales in the period. It is a head-office training location, not a trading store.
Savonlinna (store_id 129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in period 2, so it is not in the table.

Kuopio (store_id 125, rank 24) was shut for a refit from 2026-06-15 and had no sales after that date, so it traded only the first 14 of the period's 26 trading days. Its net sales of 23,993.71 EUR and its rank are not comparable with the other stores. The refit runs to 2026-07-26, which is 6 weeks, so it also covers 2 weeks of period 3.

Two days in the period, Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June), are non-trading days, so physical stores sold nothing on them. All stores except Kuopio therefore show 26 trading days. The 528 sales lines on those two days all belong to the web shop and are excluded.

Several stores have two versions in dim_store because the region changed on 2025-04-28 (for example the Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kerava stores moved from South to Capital Region, and Kouvola from East to South). Sales were therefore joined on store_key and grouped by store_id, so each store appears once. Region is not shown in the table.
The format values in dim_store (Small, Medium, Large) differ from those documented in the column comment (Hyper, Standard, Express). Format is not used in this answer.

Checks run: sales lines in the period have no duplicate (receipt_id, line_no) pairs, no rows are waiting in the staging load table, and the figures per store agree with rpt_daily_store_sales to the cent.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM lines f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'), yr AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, sum(n.net_sales) net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT ty.region, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, round(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct FROM yr ty JOIN yr ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns booked on their return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (orders delivered or collected), not the order date; cancelled and processing orders excluded
Web shop is store_id 900, region Online, shown as its own line; channel_code not used because it is empty after 3 November 2025
Regions as-is: current dim_store version (is_current), so the Capital Region covers stores 101-105 in both years and Kouvola (114) sits in South in both years
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = periods 7 to 9, fiscal weeks 27 to 39, taken from dim_date.fiscal_quarter
Same fiscal quarter in each year compared, not the same calendar dates
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales, store by store, over both quarters
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated, stg_, bak_ or tmp_ table
assumptions: 'Q3 last year' read as FY2025/26 Q3 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026), because the request was made on 6 Oct 2026 in FY2026/27. Past requests read 'last year' as the previous fiscal year from May 2026 onward.
'Q3 the year before' read as FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025)
Regions reported as-is (current hierarchy), as the company default, because the request did not ask for as-was
Week 53 of FY2025/26 is not in Q3, so it has no effect on this comparison
Staff purchases are included, as in the company net sales definition
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT
caveats: Duplicate load found in fact_sales_line: 418 receipt lines (receipt_id and line_no) from 15 to 21 Sept 2025 appear twice, with different sales_line_id and etl_loaded_at values. This falls outside both Q3 windows, so it does not change the figures here. I still de-duplicated on (receipt_id, line_no) in the query as a safeguard. Anyone summing that week from the raw table will double count it.

Because of the region restatement, the Capital Region figures for FY2024/25 are shown on the current five-region structure. As-was, that region did not exist before 28 April 2025, and Capital Region stores sat in South (and Kouvola in East). South, East and the Capital Region are therefore not comparable with what was reported at the time.
Store-level net sales agreed with rpt_daily_store_sales for every store, including the web shop (store 900), across both quarters, so there was no unexplained gap.

Online growth of 29.7% is high and sits across the web platform migration of 3 November 2025, which falls inside FY2025/26 Q3. Web is identified by store_id 900 rather than channel_code, so the migration does not affect the totals.

Returns for the quarter are booked on their return date, so the most recent returns on late-December and January sales may still arrive up to 30 days later. This only matters for returns booked after the warehouse load date, and Q3 ended well before 4 Oct 2026, so the figures are complete.

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, l.subcategory, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY l.subcategory ORDER BY l.subcategory
definitions_applied: Return rate = returned net (refund_net) divided by sold net, in percent
Sale-week cohort: lines selected by the fiscal period of the original sale date, with refunds matched through sales_line_id whenever and wherever they were booked
Fiscal calendar: Q1 = P1-P3 = fiscal weeks 1-13 of FY2025/26 (28 Apr 2025 to 27 Jul 2025), taken from dim_date
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
As-is hierarchy: current product version (is_current) for category and subcategory
Web lines (store 900) included, dated by the sale (order) date, as in the accepted REQ-D14 and REQ-D16 readings
Net amounts excluding VAT
assumptions: 'Last year' was read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year just completed (the request was received 6 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27). This matches how REQ-D14 and REQ-D16 were read.
'Q1' was read as the fiscal Q1 (P1-P3, weeks 1-13), not calendar Q1.
'Garden subcategory' was read on the current (as-is) hierarchy, because no as-was reading was requested.
Physical stores and the web shop (store 900) are both included, because the request names no channel scope.
Staff purchases are included, as they are in sales figures.
Subcategories are shown at the natural grain of the question, with no total row.
caveats: Outdoor lighting moved from Garden to Electrical on 27 Oct 2025. As-is, 68 outdoor lighting articles are in Electrical for all history, so their Q1 FY2025/26 sales (1,448 lines that were Garden at the time) are not in this Garden table. An as-was view would add them back as a Garden subcategory.

Five outdoor lighting articles (SKUs 100870, 100877, 100879, 100916, 100917) were delisted before the move. They have no Electrical version and are still Garden / Outdoor Lighting in the current product version. They appear as the 'Outdoor Lighting' row: 19 lines, EUR 375 net sold, no returns, so 0.0%. The row is tiny and not meaningful. Drop it if you want Garden to mean only the articles still ranged.

Return cohort is complete. The last sale in the cohort was 27 Jul 2025, the latest matched return was booked on 22 Aug 2025, and the warehouse is loaded to 4 Oct 2026, well past the 30-day return window.

Checks found no duplicate sales or return lines, no returns without a matching sale, no refunds above the sold amount, no cancelled web orders in the cohort, and no sales lines lost in the dimension joins.
Store 999 test sales were excluded: 136 lines in the Garden-related cohort. No ZZ Test lines fell in the Garden scope.

The 8 rows (before rounding) have sold net of EUR 176,074.46 (Barbecue & Grills), 74,584.72 (Edible Plants & Seeds), 406,939.18 (Garden Furniture), 276,601.44 (Garden Tools), 375.00 (Outdoor Lighting), 441,427.45 (Plants & Flowers), 144,538.28 (Pots & Planters) and 147,290.55 (Soil & Fertiliser).

I did not run the query_check script or the rpt_daily_store_sales control. That control total is net sales per store per day with no product dimension, so it does not apply to a return rate by subcategory.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with each return deducted on its own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (UTC dispatch timestamp converted to Europe/Helsinki), not the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code (channel_code is not filled from the 3 November 2025 platform migration)
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders are web sales)
Click-and-collect counted as web
Store 999 and test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: periods 5 to 8 of FY2025/26 (weeks 18 to 34, 25 Aug to 21 Dec 2025)
Did not use rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, or any stg_, bak_, tmp_ or _old table
Control total: result matches rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 in each of the four periods
assumptions: The request was received 9 Oct 2026, in FY2026/27. I read 'last year' as the previous fiscal year, FY2025/26, as past requests did in the same situation (May 2026 requests).
'Periods 5 to 8' means fiscal periods P05 to P08 of that year, reported as one row per period, since the request says 'by period'.
'Web net sales' is the company definition: net of returns, excluding VAT, in EUR.
Returns are deducted only where they are booked to the web shop (store 900), as the control table does.
caveats: Returns of web orders that customers took back to a physical store are booked to that store, not to the web shop, so they do not reduce web net sales here. This follows the company definition and matches the control total. If they were deducted from web instead, web net sales would be lower by about 5,495 (P5), 4,784 (P6), 4,901 (P7) and 4,545 (P8) EUR net.
The 3 November 2025 web-platform migration falls in P7. Web was identified by store 900, so the figures run across it without a gap. The legacy views, which drop web from that date, were not used.
FY2025/26 P5 to P8 is fully loaded and all four periods are complete. Returns can arrive up to 30 days after a sale, and the P8 sales are more than nine months old, so the figures will not change.
One test-article web line (EUR 5.50 net, dispatched in P6) was excluded under the ZZ Test rule.

Outside this request: in store 116 (Tampere Lielahti), the 15 to 21 Sep 2025 sales lines (P5) are loaded twice (418 receipt and line numbers duplicated). This does not affect web figures, but any store-level or total-company P5 figure would be overstated unless it is de-duplicated.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), web_lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
definitions_applied: Click-and-collect share = click-and-collect net sales divided by all web net sales (click-and-collect counts as web)
Net sales excluding VAT, after returns
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (for click-and-collect, the ready-for-collection date), not the order date
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code or channel_id
Click-and-collect identified by fact_web_order.fulfilment_type, which works across the 3 November 2025 platform migration
Cancelled and still-processing orders excluded (only delivered and collected orders count as sales)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Fiscal periods from dim_date (4-4-5 pattern, FY2025/26 P6 = 22 Sep to 26 Oct 2025, P7 = 27 Oct to 23 Nov 2025, P8 = 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025)
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900
assumptions: 'Last year' is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26. The request was received on 9 October 2026, in FY2026/27, and earlier accepted requests made in FY2026/27 read 'last year' as FY2025/26.
'Periods 6 to 8' is read as fiscal periods P6, P7 and P8, one share per period, with no overall total.
The share is of web net sales (money), not of web order counts, because the request says 'share of the web shop's sales'.
caveats: The data check against rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 matched exactly: web net sales were 175,588.62 in P6, 154,977.27 in P7 and 225,265.08 in P8. Click-and-collect net sales were 48,901.47, 39,403.04 and 60,899.16.

The web platform migration on 3 November 2025 falls inside P7. channel_code stops being filled from that date, so the share uses store 900 and fulfilment_type from fact_web_order. Using channel_code or the legacy view rpt.v_daily_sales would have dropped web sales from 3 November onward and distorted P7 and P8. Neither was used.

Refunds on web orders processed in a physical store are booked to that store under the company definition and are not deducted from web sales here. Over P6 to P8 these were about 1,917 / 1,406 / 1,288 EUR on click-and-collect orders and about 2,867 / 3,496 / 3,257 EUR on home-delivery orders. Only returns booked to the web shop (store 900) reduce the web figures.

Duplicate receipt and line rows (418 extra rows, re-loaded on 23 September 2025) exist in store 116 for 15 to 21 September 2025. They affect only that physical store, not the web shop or these figures. Web order IDs and web sales line IDs have no duplicates.
Web orders that were cancelled (no sales lines) or still processing are not in the sales figures.
19 web test lines in category ZZ Test exist in the warehouse and are excluded.
The periods are complete and fully loaded in the warehouse (fully_loaded is true for FY2025/26 P6 to P8).

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = '2026-09-25' AND is_current = true
definitions_applied: A new member signup is counted when join_date equals the specified date
Only current member records (is_current = true) are counted to avoid double-counting historical versions
assumptions: The date 25 September 2026 refers to the calendar date, not a fiscal period
