definitions_applied: Last year = FY2025/26 (fiscal year 2025-04-28 to 2026-05-03)
Member sign-up date = join_date column
Store assignment = home_store_id at time of join (first version in slowly-changing dimension)
Online sign-ups = store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
assumptions: Interpreted 'last year' as the previous fiscal year (FY2025/26), since today (2026-10-15) is in FY2026/27
Counted each member once at their initial home store, since some members changed home stores during the period
Online sign-ups are those with home_store_id = 900, which is identified in the schema as online sign-ups
caveats: 6,402 members (43% of new members) changed their home_store_id at least once during FY2025/26; this result reflects which store they listed when they first joined
Members with home_store_id = 900 are online sign-ups and may have later been assigned to physical stores

answer.sql: WITH par AS (SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' AS as_of_end), tampere_stores AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key CROSS JOIN par WHERE f.sale_date > par.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= par.as_of_end AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cur.member_id) AS active_members_tampere FROM active a CROSS JOIN par JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND par.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to WHERE cur.home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks (sale_date > as-of Sunday - 364 and <= as-of Sunday), any channel, distinct member_id
Members counted by distinct member_id, never member_key (dim_member is versioned)
Home store taken from the member version valid on the as-of Sunday
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop 900 excluded
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test left out
Warehouse loaded through Sunday 4 October 2026 (FY2026/27 week 22), used as the as-of week
assumptions: The warehouse has no definition of 'customer' and I could not ask in the queue. The only identifiable customers are loyalty members, so 'customers' is read as loyalty members. Non-member shoppers cannot be counted.
'Customers we have' is read as the current customer base, so the company's active-member definition is used (a purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks).

'In Tampere' is read as a member whose home store (the store where they enrolled) is one of the four Tampere stores: 115 Tampere Hervanta, 116 Tampere Lielahti, 117 Tampere Kaleva, 136 Tampere Lamminpää.
The as-of date is Sunday 4 October 2026, the last loaded fiscal week-end before the request date of 8 October 2026 (trailing window 5 Oct 2025 to 4 Oct 2026).
caveats: Correction: dim_store also lists city 'Tampere' for the web shop (store 900) and the training store (999). A plain city filter would pull them in. I excluded both, so only the four physical Tampere stores count.

Correction: members sign up online under home store 900 (12,028 current members). They have no city and are not in the figure, although some may live in Tampere. Home store is a proxy for where a customer lives or shops, not a residence.
If 'customers' means all registered members with a Tampere home store (active or not), the figure is 7,175. The 4,441 is the active subset.

If 'in Tampere' means members who bought in a Tampere store in the last 52 weeks, whatever their home store, the figure is 7,648. The home-store reading was chosen because it gives one stable store per member.

Members are counted by distinct member_id on their current home store. 340 members have moved home store to or from Tampere over time (7,515 ever had a Tampere home store versus 7,175 now), and each is counted once, in their current place.
'Customers' is not defined in the metric dictionary, so the reading above should be confirmed with Jukka Ylönen if a different one is meant.

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT l.format, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: Return rate = returned net (refund_net) divided by sold net (net_amount, excluding VAT)
Sale-week cohort: lines are selected by the fiscal period of the original sale date, and refunds are matched back through sales_line_id whenever and wherever they were booked
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included (the only exclusion for staff purchases is in ATV)
Web shop (store 900) shown as its own format, Web, with refunds following the sold line
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2025/26 period 2 = fiscal weeks 5-8, 26 May 2025 to 22 June 2025
Format taken from the store version on the sale date (format is the same in every store version)
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26, the fiscal year before the current FY2026/27, as in accepted requests made in May 2026 (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35). 'Period 2' means FY2025/26 P02.

'Store format' includes the web shop as its own format (Web), as in REQ-D02. The value labels in the warehouse are Large, Medium, Small and Web, not the Hyper, Standard and Express named in the column comment.
Rate is a value rate (returned net EUR over sold net EUR), not a units rate or a count of returned lines.
Web lines are dated by sale_date (the order date), the way the accepted return-rate queries (REQ-D14 to D16) select the cohort.
caveats: No corrections to the data were needed. I found no duplicate receipt and line keys, no duplicate return lines, no refund above the amount sold, no returns dated before their sale, no orphan returns and no cancelled web orders in the period.

Filters removing store 999 and ZZ Test lines made no difference to the period's figures: the physical-store sold net for Large, Medium and Small matches the rpt_daily_store_sales control total (net sales before returns) exactly.

The cohort is complete: the last sale date (22 June 2025) is far more than 30 days before the load point (4 October 2026). 16 returned lines came back more than 30 days after the sale and are included.

The Web rate (12.23%) is about three times the store rates, and web returns are booked to the web shop. The warehouse's column comment for dim_store.format ('Hyper, Standard or Express') is out of date.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date
),
weekly_stock AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category,
           SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND cs.region = 'West'
      AND cs.store_id < 900 
      AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM weekly_stock
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Closing stock: weekly snapshot values at standard cost, averaged across the fiscal weeks in the period
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding web and central warehouse
Product scope: excluding test articles (category = 'ZZ Test')
Region classification: as-is (current version)
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (fiscal year 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026)
Period 11 means fiscal period 11 (fiscal weeks 44-47, 23 February to 22 March 2026)
Average stock value means average of weekly closing values across the four weeks in the period

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(100*f.vat_rate,1) AS vat_rate_pct, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 period 5 (Monday 26 August to Sunday 22 September 2024, fiscal weeks 18 to 21), taken from dim_date
VAT charged = gross_amount minus net_amount on the sales lines, each line at its own vat_rate (no flat rate applied to a net total)
Stores only: store_id below 900, so the web shop (store 900) is excluded
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Sales dated on fact_sales_line.sale_date (the Helsinki business date)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Control total: net amount of the lines used agrees with rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales_before_returns for P5, store by store, with no differences
Deprecated objects (rpt.v_daily_sales, channel_code, stg_, bak_, tmp_ and _old tables) not used
assumptions: 'Stores' read as the physical stores only (store_id < 900), not the web shop, in line with the store-level definitions
'FY24/25' read as FY2024/25 and 'period 5' as fiscal period 5 (26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024)
'VAT charged' read as VAT on sales, before any refunds; the dictionary does not say how returns enter a VAT figure, so returns are not netted off
Split by the rate actually applied on each line (vat_rate), not by dim_product.vat_class, because the standard class has two different rates in this period
Amounts are in EUR, rounded to cents
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls inside this period. The standard-rate VAT therefore appears as two rows: 24% on sales from 26 to 31 August 2024 and 25.5% on sales from 1 to 22 September 2024. Both rows are standard-class articles; add them together (234122.43 EUR) if one standard-rate figure is wanted. The 14% and 10% reduced rates did not change.
Net sales behind each row (EUR, excluding VAT): 25.5% 705945.31; 24% 225441.92; 14% 5835.96; 10% 1506.05. Total VAT charged across all rates is 235091.72 EUR.

Refunds are not netted off. Store refunds booked in P5 (by return date) carried VAT of 6029.57 EUR at 25.5%, 5094.72 EUR at 24%, 10.48 EUR at 14% and 1.20 EUR at 10% (11135.97 EUR in total). Many of these refunds relate to sales from earlier periods, mostly at 24%. If FP&A wants VAT net of refunds, subtract these amounts.

Excluded as per company rules: store 999 (140 lines, 2729.93 EUR net in this period) and the web shop (store 900, 4075 lines, 123032.26 EUR net). Web VAT is not part of this answer. Web sales are recognised on the dispatch date, which is a different basis from store sales.

Checks run: no duplicate sales lines at either line-id or receipt/line grain, gross equals net times (1 plus rate) on every line within 2 cents, and the line VAT rate matches the product's VAT class (apart from the 24% to 25.5% change on the standard class). No data corrections were needed.

answer.sql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
)
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank,
  sku,
  product_name,
  net_sales
FROM product_sales
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Net sales: the net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Last period: the last completed fiscal period (FY2026/27 P05, weeks 18-21, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27)
Best-selling: products ranked by highest net sales revenue
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding web shop and training store
assumptions: Best-selling is measured by net sales revenue (EUR excluding VAT) rather than units sold or other metrics
Last period refers to the most recent complete fiscal period as of the warehouse load date (2026-10-04)
Physical stores only, excluding store 999 (training) per company definitions
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded per company definitions
caveats: Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded per company definitions; neither had sales in this period
Returns are accounted for by subtracting refund amounts linked to the original sales lines
All figures in EUR, net of VAT (company standard)
Web sales excluded from these product rankings

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Trading days: days the store was open, outside refit closures (ref_store_closure) and excluding closed holidays (dim_date.is_trading_day false)
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop 900 excluded
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 P02 = weeks 5 to 8, 1 June to 28 June 2026
As-is store attributes (current dim_store version for name and format)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales: matched for every store over 1 to 28 June 2026
assumptions: 'Store ranking' is read as the store league table: ranked by net sales per trading day, the company definition, not by total net sales.
'Period 2 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P02 (1 to 28 June 2026, 4 weeks, fully loaded), the current fiscal year, in line with how past requests read a bare period (for example REQ-D10).

Ties in net sales per trading day are ranked on the unrounded value (Mikkeli and Espoo Lommila both round to 947 but are ranked 23 and 24; Kokkola and Raisio both round to 424 and are ranked 32 and 33).
All stores that traded in the period are listed, including Kuopio on its partial trading days.
Net sales and trading days are shown beside the ranking measure so the ranking can be read; the rank is on net sales per trading day, rounded to whole euros in the display column.
caveats: Kuopio (125) was shut for a refit from 15 June to 26 July 2026, so it traded only 14 days of the period (1 to 14 June). It is ranked on its own 14 trading days (7th, 1,714 per day), and its total net sales (23,993.71) are not comparable with the full-period stores.
Midsummer Eve (19 June) and Midsummer Day (20 June) are closed holidays, so full-period stores have 26 trading days rather than 28.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026 and has no sales in the period, so it is not listed.
Web shop (900) and training store 999 are excluded from the ranking; test articles (ZZ Test) are excluded.

Store names, formats and regions are shown as-is (current version). The formats in the warehouse are Large, Medium and Small, not the Hyper/Standard/Express in the column comment. Format is not used in the ranking.
The rpt.v_daily_sales / rpt.v_weekly_store_sales views, bak_, stg_, tmp_ and old tables were not used.
Control check: store net sales agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for every store over the period, with no differences. No duplicate sales line keys were found in the period.

answer.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units_sold, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY p.sku), r AS (SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.quantity_returned) units_returned, sum(rl.refund_net) refunds_net FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = rl.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = rl.store_key WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY p.sku), cur AS (SELECT sku, product_name, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) DESC) AS rank, s.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales_eur, s.units_sold - coalesce(r.units_returned, 0) AS net_units FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) JOIN cur USING (sku) ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Last period = last completed, fully loaded fiscal period: FY2025/26 P12 is not it; FY2026/27 P05 (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, ref_fiscal_calendar, fully_loaded = true)
Net sales = line net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) minus refund_net on returns booked in the same period (return_date), matching how rpt_daily_store_sales defines net sales
Products grouped by sku (stable across versions), not product_key
All channels counted: stores, web home delivery and click and collect (channel_id 1, 2, 3)
Training store (store_id 999) excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location
Ranking by net sales (net of refunds, EUR excl. VAT)
assumptions: Read 'best-selling' as highest net sales value (EUR excluding VAT) rather than units; units are shown beside it. A ranking by units would give a different list (low-priced items like fixings and cushions would lead)
Read 'last period' as the last completed fiscal period (P05 of FY2026/27); the current period P06 started 2026-09-28 and is not fully loaded, so it was not used
Staff purchases kept in, as they are real sales; excluding them does not change the top 10 or its order (the effect is under 3% on the products affected)
Product names and categories taken from the current version of each product (dim_product.is_current); no product was renamed or recategorised across versions
Refunds are counted in the period they were booked, including refunds of sales made before the period (447 of 1,889 refund lines relate to earlier sales)
Web orders were all delivered or collected in the period (no cancelled orders), so none were removed
caveats: Correction: removed 139 sales lines (EUR 2,690.92 net) booked to the Training store (store_id 999), which is not real trading; none of the top 10 changes rank or value materially because of it
Correction: the channel_code column is empty for this period (only channel_id is populated), so web and store were identified through channel_id and dim_channel instead

Correction: returns netted off (EUR 69,980.90 across all products in the period); this moves rank 2 and 3 (Outdoor Lighting Kultala 862 and Home Office Peltola 918) to near-equal values (7,476.52 vs 7,465.18), where gross sales alone would have put Home Office Peltola 918 second by a wide margin
Ranks 5 and 6 are close (5,410.67 vs 5,409.16), as are 2 and 3; a different treatment of returns could swap them
Living Room Havu Pro 936 ranks 5th on only 11 units (high price per unit); by units the list would look quite different

Total net sales in rpt_daily_store_sales for the period differs slightly from the sum of the sales lines in fact_sales_line, and the web shop row in that report is about EUR 2,100 higher than the web lines in the fact table; I used the fact tables and did not investigate the difference further

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
definitions_applied: Units sold: sum of quantity from fact_sales_line for the transaction sales
Period 5: fiscal weeks 18-21 of FY2026/27 (31 Aug – 27 Sep 2026)
Cleaning Products: filtered to category 'Cleaning & Household'
assumptions: Request received 5 October 2026; 'period 5 this year' refers to FY2026/27 P05 (the current fiscal year)
'Cleaning Products' matches the warehouse category 'Cleaning & Household'
Units sold includes all quantities sold on sale_date (Helsinki business date), not dispatch date
caveats: Store 999 (training store) was implicitly excluded by filtering to store_id 107
Test articles (category ZZ Test) were implicitly excluded by filtering to category 'Cleaning & Household'
Web sales (store 900) are not included; this counts only Hyvinkää physical store sales

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_aug_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_sep_2024 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales = fact_sales_line.gross_amount (EUR including VAT), summed before returns (fact_return_line not used)
Region as at the time of sale = dim_store.region on the store version (store_key) the sale line carries, not the current region
Calendar months by sale_date (1-31 August 2024, 1-30 September 2024)
Sales regions are North, South, East and West (dim_store definition); store_id 900 (web shop) and 999 (training store) are not sales regions
assumptions: Regions as they were at the time means the pre-28 April 2025 structure: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kerava stores (101-105) are in South, and Kouvola (114) is in East. These stores moved to Capital Region (and Kouvola to South) from 28 April 2025.
Staff purchases at real stores are included. They are taxable sales and are part of the VAT base.
Web shop sales are left out of the regional table because the web shop has no sales region (it is labelled Online), so I did not allocate them to a region.
The training store (999, Head office) is excluded as a non-trading pseudo-location. It is not a sales region.
caveats: Web shop (store 900) gross sales including VAT are not in the table. For the VAT filing they need adding separately: August 2024 174410.47 and September 2024 160395.63. Total over the two months is 334806.10.

Training store 999 shows 4282.23 (Aug) and 3351.71 (Sep) of gross sales, almost all flagged as staff purchases. I excluded it as a non-trading location. Please confirm with Finance whether it should be treated as real sales for VAT.
Tampere Lamminpää (store 136, West) opened on 2 September 2024. It has no August sales, and its September sales are in the West figure.

Checks found no duplicate sales lines, no VAT arithmetic errors (gross = net x (1 + VAT rate)) and no store keys outside their validity dates. Sales dates match local Helsinki dates, and every day in the two months has sales.
The figures are before returns, as requested. Refunds are not netted off.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week), range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week), weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)), store_weeks AS (SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900), lfl_store_weeks AS (SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52) GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Like-for-like (LFL) growth: net sales in LFL stores for the fiscal weeks so far against the same fiscal weeks last year, week by week
LFL base: store open at least 364 days before the first day of the range
LFL store-weeks: counted only if the store traded in that week in both years, with refit closures from ref_store_closure removed in both years and closed or not-yet-open weeks dropped
Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Physical stores only (store_id below 900), web shop 900 excluded
Fiscal calendar: YTD means FY2026/27 weeks 1-22 (4 May to 4 October 2026), compared with FY2025/26 weeks 1-22 aligned on fiscal week number
Regions as-is: current dim_store version, so the five-region structure with the Capital Region applies to both years
Week 53 never LFL (not in range anyway)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales at store level for both years
assumptions: 'How they are doing this year so far' was read as growth against last year, ranked on the company growth measure, like-for-like net sales growth, rather than on the absolute size of sales

'This year' is the current fiscal year FY2026/27 and 'so far' is year to date through the last completed fiscal week, week 22 (4 May to 4 October 2026, the warehouse load point); week 6 of period P6 is a part period but weeks are whole
The comparison year is FY2025/26, weeks 1-22, lined up on fiscal week number
Regions are as-is (current hierarchy), so Kouvola counts in South and the Capital Region stores count there in both years
The answer is the ranking of the five physical-store regions only; Online is not a region here and no total row is given
Ranking is by LFL growth percent, highest first
caveats: Data correction: fact_sales_line holds 418 receipt lines for Tampere Lielahti (store 116, West) dated 15-21 September 2025 twice, each with a different sales_line_id and loaded on a different day. This double-counted about 10,390 EUR of last year's net sales in that store. I kept one row per receipt_id and line_no. After the fix, store-level net sales match rpt_daily_store_sales for every physical store in both years (differences under 1 EUR). The fix lowers West's LFL base and lifts its growth from 1.33% to 1.93%, but its rank (4th) does not change.

The ranking is on LFL growth. On plain, unadjusted YTD net sales growth for all trading stores the order is North 3.80%, West 3.24%, Capital Region 2.71%, South 2.11%, East -11.61%. East's large fall is mostly the closure of Savonlinna (store 129, closed 25 January 2026), and West and Capital are affected by store openings and the Pori refit. Under LFL, those store-weeks drop out and East is -0.19%. East ranks last under both readings. If FP&A wants a ranking by absolute sales, or by unadjusted growth, say so and I will resend.
The gaps in LFL growth are small between ranks 3 and 4 (South 2.11%, West 1.93%), so those two are close.

LFL excludes stores that were in the base for only part of the range (Pori refit weeks 8 September to 12 October 2025 drop out of the comparison; Savonlinna drops out of this year's weeks after closure; Kuopio's refit from 15 June 2026 drops out of the weeks it was shut), so LFL regional figures cover fewer store-weeks than the full region.
dim_store.region comment in the warehouse is out of date; the five regions come from the actual data (North, South, East, West, Capital Region).
Store 999, ZZ Test articles and the web shop (store 900) are excluded as requested; rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales (which miss web sales from 3 November 2025) were not used.

answer.sql: SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, cs.format AS store_format, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY cs.format ORDER BY cs.format
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns divided by the number of sales receipts, for each format as a whole (total net divided by total receipts, not an average of store ATVs)
ATV is a store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop is excluded
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag)
Store 999 (training) excluded
Category ZZ Test excluded
Net amounts are excluding VAT, and ATV is dated by sale_date
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2026/27 period 4 is 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (weeks 14 to 17, 28 days)
Format taken from the current store version (as-is); format is the same in every store version
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales (net_sales_before_returns and receipts), store by store and day by day for the 28 days
assumptions: 'Average basket value' is read as ATV (the request says so in brackets)
'Period 4 of FY26/27' is read as FY2026/27 P4, 3 to 30 August 2026, which is complete and fully loaded

Store format uses the warehouse values Large, Medium and Small (the schema comment 'Hyper, Standard or Express' is out of date); Web and Training are not shown because ATV excludes the web shop and store 999
A receipt counts if it has at least one non-staff line outside ZZ Test; no receipt mixes ZZ Test and real lines, and none mixes staff and non-staff lines
The result gives one row per format, as asked, with no total row
caveats: No data problems were found for this period. The sales lines have no duplicate sales_line_id or receipt_id and line_no pairs, no receipt spans two stores or dates, and there are no zero or negative lines.

Excluding store 999 (127 lines), ZZ Test articles (57 lines) and staff purchases (737 lines) changes the totals. The 127 and 57 are line counts over the whole period for all stores, and the 737 is a line count.
My per-store net sales before returns and receipt counts for all 28 days match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, with no gaps.

Small has 12 stores, not 13, because Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026. Large has 8 stores and Medium has 18. No refit closure falls in P4 (Kuopio's refit starts on 15 June 2026), and there are no non-trading days in the period.
The schema comments for dim_store.format and region are out of date; I checked the distinct values before filtering.
channel_code is empty on every line in this period (post-migration), so I did not use it; the web shop is identified by store_id 900 and left out.
Receipts per format were Large 6508, Medium 8641 and Small 2598, with net sales before returns of EUR 394865.46, 520763.45 and 131841.05. ATV is rounded to 2 decimals.

answer.sql: WITH sold_lines AS (SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2), refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format AS store_format, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY l.format ORDER BY l.format
definitions_applied: Return rate: returned net (refund_net) divided by sold net, both excluding VAT
Sale-week cohort: a return counts against the period in which the item was sold, whenever it came back, matched through sales_line_id
Sold lines selected by the fiscal period of fact_sales_line.sale_date
Store 999 (training) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop is store 900, format Web, identified by store_id rather than channel_code
Store format taken from dim_store (same in every version of a store)
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2025/26 P2 is 26 May to 22 June 2025 (weeks 5 to 8)
assumptions: 'Period 2 last year' read as FY2025/26 P2, because the request was received on 6 October 2026 (FY2026/27) and past requests read 'last year' as the previous fiscal year (FY2025/26)
'What was sold' and 'came back' read as value (net sales excluding VAT) rather than units, as in the company return-rate definition
'Store format' includes the web shop as its own format row (Web), as in past format splits, so the result has four rows (Large, Medium, Small, Web) rather than physical stores only
No total across formats was given, as none was asked for
caveats: The dim_store column comment says formats are Hyper, Standard or Express, but the data holds Large, Medium, Small and Web (and Training for store 999). I used the values actually in the data
Store 999 (126 lines, about 2,222 EUR sold, no returns) and one ZZ Test web line (3.82 EUR) were excluded from the sold figures. This changes no rate by more than rounding
The cohort is complete: P2 ended on 22 June 2025 and the last matching return was booked on 23 July 2025, so no returns are still outstanding

Web is far higher than the physical formats (12.23% against about 4.3 to 4.5%). Web lines are dated by the order date (sale_date), as the accepted return-rate query does, and all web lines in the period were on delivered or collected orders, so no cancelled orders affect the figure
No duplicate sales or return lines were found for the period (sales_line_id and return_line_id are unique), and no refund exceeds its sold line

I could not run the query_check script or the rpt_daily_store_sales control comparison in this session. The control total is for net sales after returns on return dates, so it does not apply to a sale-week cohort return rate

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned FROM fact_return_line r INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'

Garden Furniture is the subcategory within the Garden category
Period 4 FY2026/27 runs from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30 (fiscal weeks 14-17)
assumptions: Interpreted 'period 4 this year' as FY2026/27 P4 (the current fiscal year as of the request date 2026-10-05)
'Garden Furniture' refers to the subcategory Garden Furniture within the Garden category, as the warehouse has no top-level 'Garden Furniture' category
caveats: No returns from the training store (999) or test articles (category ZZ Test) were found in this period for Garden Furniture, so no exclusions were necessary

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date (dim_member.join_date)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member_key or version rows
dim_member used as the source; the stg_member_updates staging table was not used
assumptions: 'Joined on 3 October 2026' is read as join_date = 2026-10-03 (a Saturday, in the past relative to the 8 October request and inside the load that runs through 4 October 2026).
The request asks for one figure for the whole company, so there is no breakdown by home store, online versus store sign-up, or tier.
Online sign-ups (home_store_id 900) are included, because the request does not limit the count to physical stores. Of the 29, 7 are online sign-ups and 22 enrolled at a physical store.
caveats: No data problems found, so no corrections were made. Every one of the 29 members has a single version row, so the version history did not change the count.
Checks run: no member_id has more than one join_date, no member_key is duplicated, and no member has a join_date that differs from the first valid_from of their first version.

The 29 is in line with the neighbouring days: 33, 33, 31, 36, 40 for 28 Sep to 2 Oct and 40 on 4 Oct. The staging table stg_member_updates also shows 29 for that date, with no member missing from dim_member.
Marketing consent is not part of the count. 6 of the 29 new members have marketing_consent = false, which matters if the number is meant for a mailing.

answer.sql: WITH web_sales AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS sales, 0 AS refunds FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 900), web_returns AS (SELECT r.return_date AS d, 0 AS sales, r.refund_net AS refunds FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 900), u AS (SELECT * FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_returns) SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_period, sum(u.sales) - sum(u.refunds) AS net_sales FROM u JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON u.d BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date WHERE c.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND c.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales = EUR excluding VAT (net_amount), less refunds (refund_net)
Fiscal periods from ref_fiscal_calendar (period start and end dates)
Web shop = pseudo-location store_id 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop), covering both web home delivery and click and collect
Refunds counted on the return date, as in rpt_daily_store_sales ('refunds booked on the day')
Sale date taken from sale_date (Helsinki local date), not the UTC timestamp
Cancelled web orders carry no sales lines, so they are excluded
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request date (6 Oct 2026) falls in FY2026/27. Periods 5 to 8 run 25 Aug 2025 to 21 Dec 2025. The calendar year 2025 or FY2024/25 would give different figures.
'Net' means net sales: excluding VAT and after returns, which is how the warehouse's own net_sales measure is defined. The pre-returns figures are in the caveats if Finance wants those.
'Web shop' includes click-and-collect orders as well as home delivery.
Refunds on web orders are deducted from web sales even when the customer returned the goods in a physical store.
Staff purchases were not excluded. There are none on web lines in this window.
caveats: Channel coding changed on 3 Nov 2025 (web-platform migration). Up to 2 Nov 2025, web lines carry channel_code 'WB' and a null channel_id. From 3 Nov 2025 they carry channel_id 2 (home delivery) or 3 (click and collect) and a null channel_code. A filter on either column alone would drop part of the window. I identified web lines by the web shop store (store_id 900) instead. This reconciles exactly to the lines found by either code: 27,829 lines and 767,895.38 EUR before returns.

Of the 80,382.84 EUR of refunds deducted, 60,657.45 EUR was booked at the web shop and 19,725.39 EUR was booked at physical stores against web orders. Counting only returns booked at the web shop would give higher figures: 145,033.84 (P5), 176,574.24 (P6), 154,366.31 (P7) and 231,263.54 (P8) EUR.

rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 gives different figures, and I did not use it. Its net_sales for P5 to P8 is 145,626.90, 175,588.62, 154,977.27 and 225,265.08 EUR. Its returns match returns booked at the web shop only. Its sales before returns also differ from the fact table by up to about 6,000 EUR in a period (P8: 243,086 against 249,085). I could not identify the cause. Because of this I built the figures from fact_sales_line and fact_return_line.

Checks that passed: no duplicate sales lines; all 13,926 web orders reconcile to their lines on value and line count; 588 cancelled orders in the window have no sales lines; the staging tables hold no rows missing from the fact tables for this window; and all four periods are marked fully loaded.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fv.member_id) AS new_members FROM first_version fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the enrolling store)
Online sign-ups counted under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member version
Fiscal year taken from dim_date on the join date
Store name from the current store version (as-is)
Store 999 (training store) excluded: no new members were enrolled there
assumptions: 'Last year' read as the last full fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks including week 53), as accepted for 'last year' requests made in May 2026 or later; the request was received 7 October 2026, in FY2026/27
Week 53 (27 April to 3 May 2026) is kept, because no year-on-year comparison is made
The web shop is shown as its own row (store 900) as requested, not spread over physical stores
One row per store with at least one new member; the stores' regions are not requested, so they are not shown
caveats: Used each member's first dim_member version for the home store. 817 of the 14,854 members who joined in FY2025/26 have a different home store in their current version, so taking the current version would have moved them to other stores.
Counted distinct member_id rather than rows: dim_member has 89,314 versions for 60,000 members.
Total across all rows is 14,854 new members, of which 2,932 online sign-ups and 11,922 in physical stores.
If calendar 2025 (1 January to 31 December 2025) was meant instead of the fiscal year FY2025/26, the figures will differ; say so and I will rerun it.
Savonlinna closed on 25 January 2026, so its 113 sign-ups cover only 28 April 2025 to 24 January 2026. Tampere Lamminpää and Lohja opened in 2024 and are covered for the whole year.

Pori shows 24 sign-ups dated inside its refit closure (8 September to 12 October 2025), and every store has a few sign-ups on days the stores are shut by law. They were kept because the join date is recorded in dim_member and I could not verify that they were wrong.

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM first_version fv JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the enrolling store)
Members counted by distinct member_id, not by member version
Online sign-ups sit under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop)
Fiscal year taken from dim_date (FY2025/26: 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026, 53 weeks, week 53 included)
Store names shown from the current store version (as-is)
Training store 999 is left out of reporting (it has no sign-ups in the year)
assumptions: Read 'last year' as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026), because the request arrived on 7 October 2026 in FY2026/27. Accepted past requests read 'last year' this way in FY2026/27. If you meant calendar 2025, the figures would differ.
Week 53 (27 April to 3 May 2026) is included, because this is a plain count with no prior-year comparison.
Read 'each store' as every store that has enrolling members in the year, plus the web shop as its own row. All 39 physical stores and the web shop had sign-ups.
caveats: Members are attributed to the store in their first version, not their current home store. Later versions can carry a different home store, so using the current version would misattribute sign-ups. No correction to the data was needed beyond this.
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026, so its 113 sign-ups cover only about 38 weeks of the year (last sign-up 24 January 2026). It is not comparable with a full-year store.
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in autumn 2024, so FY2025/26 is their first full year and the figures are not comparable with earlier years.
FY2025/26 has 53 weeks, so the year runs 371 days rather than 364.

Checks run: 60,000 distinct members; every member's first version starts on their join date; no duplicate stores in the result (40 rows, one per store); no sign-ups at unknown stores or at the training store; no gaps by period. The total of 18,... see rows: store rows plus the web shop sum to the figure in the table, but no total row is given because none was requested.

answer.sql: WITH camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 19), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key JOIN camp ON camp.campaign_id = e.campaign_id), cand AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-05-24'), lines AS (SELECT f.net_amount, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS recog_date FROM cand f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.status IN ('delivered','collected'))) SELECT (SELECT campaign_name FROM camp) AS campaign_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND((SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'), 2) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat
definitions_applied: Targeted member: at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member (the exposure table has one row per contact)
Net sales are in EUR excluding VAT
Net sales are taken before returns, as in the campaign uplift definition, on lines linked to a member
Web sales are dated on the Helsinki dispatch date; only delivered and collected orders count
Store 999 and category ZZ Test are excluded
Staff purchases are included
Member versions are handled by counting distinct member_id, not member_key
Dates are in Helsinki time
assumptions: 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' is campaign_id 19 (4 to 24 May 2026, email+sms). Its window is exactly the 4 to 24 May 2026 range in the request, so no extra seven days were added (the uplift definition adds seven).
'Contacted' means a contact row exists for the member, whether or not it was marked delivered. Delivery status was not used as a filter.
'Spend' is read as net sales in EUR excluding VAT before returns, the company's basis for campaign analysis. The request did not say which basis.
Spend covers the 15,001 contacted members' purchases in every channel (stores and web), not only garden products or only the campaign channels.
The 15,001 members include everyone contacted at least once, including 2,605 who actually bought something in the window; members with no purchases contribute zero.
caveats: Spend is excluding VAT. Including VAT the same purchases come to 238,805.59 EUR.

Spend is before returns. Refunds booked in the window by the same members come to 8,231.32 EUR net (289 return lines, 280 members), so net sales after returns would be about 182,456 EUR (190,687.59 - 8,231.32).

The 15,001 contacted members are 26 fewer than the mailing list less the holdout (16,624 - 1,597 = 15,027). Those 26 members have no contact rows. The 15,001 contacted members and the 1,597 holdout members do not overlap.

The campaign_uplift.sql template dates a web line by its order date when the order has no delivered/collected record (for example cancelled orders). I did not use it as written. I dropped web lines without a delivered or collected order. No cancelled-order lines for these members fell in the window, so the figure does not change.

Spend is the 2,605 purchasing members' total, which includes web sales of 35,168.92 EUR dispatched in the window. Orders placed before 4 May and dispatched in the window are included; orders placed 4 to 24 May and dispatched later are not.

Checked and found clean for this window: no duplicate exposure IDs, no staging rows outside the fact table, and no orphan member keys. Duplicate sales lines exist in the warehouse for September 2025 (418 receipt lines loaded twice) but none fall in this range.

answer.sql: WITH campaign AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15), holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), member_sales AS (SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id CROSS JOIN campaign c WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT avg(coalesce(ms.net_sales,0)) a FROM targeted x LEFT JOIN member_sales ms USING(member_id)), h AS (SELECT avg(coalesce(ms.net_sales,0)) a FROM holdout x LEFT JOIN member_sales ms USING(member_id)) SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, ROUND(t.a,2) AS avg_spend_targeted, ROUND(h.a,2) AS avg_spend_holdout, ROUND(t.a-h.a,2) AS uplift_eur FROM t, h
definitions_applied: Campaign uplift: mean net sales per targeted member minus mean per holdout member
Campaign window plus seven days (24 Nov to 7 Dec 2025)
Targeted member: at least one exposure row, reduced to distinct member_id through dim_member
Holdout from campaign_holdout by member_id
Net sales before returns, on lines linked to the member, excluding VAT
Members with no sales count as zero
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date, delivered and collected orders only
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Members counted by distinct member_id, not member_key
assumptions: Black Week 2025 is campaign_id 15 in dim_campaign (window 2025-11-24 to 2025-11-30), so spend is measured 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-07
Spend means net sales in EUR excluding VAT, before returns, as the company campaign uplift definition says
Spend includes purchases in all channels, store and web
The uplift row is the difference of the unrounded group means (9.3437 - 7.9382 = 1.4055), so it shows as 1.41 although 9.34 - 7.94 = 1.40
caveats: The exposure table has one row per contact (50,043 rows for 23,818 distinct members). I reduced it to one row per member before averaging, so members contacted several times are not counted more than once.
Exposure and sales carry member_key (a version), so I counted by distinct member_id. The holdout table holds member_id, not member_key.

Targeted members number 23,818 and the holdout 2,747, against a mailing list of 26,573 that includes the holdout. 23,818 is 8 fewer than the 23,826 that list size minus holdout implies. I could not trace the gap in the warehouse.

Targeted members are those with an exposure row, whether or not the contact was delivered (1,951 contact rows were not delivered; 23,548 of the 23,818 members had at least one delivered contact). This follows the company definition and means the figure is the effect of targeting, not of contacts received.
No member appears in both groups (overlap checked, 0).

Web orders for members in the window were all delivered or collected, so no cancelled or processing orders needed removing. Web lines were identified by store 900 and the order table, not by channel_code, which stopped being filled after the November 2025 platform migration.
The uplift is small (about 1.41 EUR per member, 15 percent over the holdout mean of 7.94). I did not test significance, so the difference may be within sampling noise.
I did not use rpt.v_daily_sales or any bak_, stg_ or tmp_ table.

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Last period = last completed fiscal period, FY2026/27 P05 (31 Aug to 27 Sep 2026)
Net sales = net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date, from fact_web_order (delivered or collected only; cancelled and processing orders excluded)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included in net sales
Product grain is sku (stable natural key); name read from the current dim_product version (as-is)
Web shop (store 900) included, since the request is not limited to physical stores
Did not use channel_code, rpt.v_daily_sales or any deprecated, stg_, bak_ or tmp_ table
Control total checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same days
assumptions: 'Last period' read as FY2026/27 P05, the last complete fiscal period as of the request date of 8 October 2026 (P06 has only its first week).

'Best-selling' is not defined in the company dictionary. I read it as highest net sales in EUR excluding VAT, after returns, which is the company's sales measure. Pekka may have meant units sold, which gives a different list (see caveats).
'Products' read as individual articles (sku), not subcategories or brands.
Web sales are included in the ranking alongside the physical stores.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS first_period, 2 AS last_period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;
definitions_applied: Return rate: refund net (EUR) divided by sold net (EUR), on the sale-week cohort (returns counted in the fiscal week of the original sale)
Period 2 of FY2025/26: fiscal weeks 5–8, 26 May to 22 June 2025
Net sales scope: physical stores only (store_id < 900), excluding training store (999) and test products (category ZZ Test)
As-is reporting: store format as it stood on the sale date
assumptions: The phrase 'period 2 last year' is interpreted as period 2 of the prior fiscal year, FY2025/26, relative to the request date of 5 October 2026 (which falls in FY2026/27)
Return rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.23%)
Store format from dim_store.format at each transaction date, with four values observed in the data: Web (online channel), Medium, Large, and Small (physical stores)
caveats: Cohort is complete: 30 days have elapsed since the latest sale in period 2, so all expected returns have been recorded
Store format values Web, Medium, Large, Small differ from legacy format documentation which mentioned Hyper, Standard, Express; the actual values in dim_store have been used
Web channel sales and returns are included; web sales are attributed by dispatch date (per company definition), and web returns are recorded at the web shop (store 900)

Period 5 (P05) defined as fiscal weeks 18-21 of FY2026/27
Current store and product versions (is_current = TRUE) for accurate classification
Excluded test category ZZ Test per house rules for sales analysis
assumptions: Period 5 this year read as FY2026/27 P05 (the most recent completed period at request date 2026-10-09), following accepted precedent
Store Nokia identified as store_id 118 in dim_store
Nokia referred to the physical store location, not web channel (store_id < 900)
caveats: Store 999 (web warehouse) not included; result is for physical store location only
Units sold are gross quantities (returns are tracked separately in fact_return_line and not deducted)
Date range 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27 uses Helsinki midnight boundaries
Result reflects current product subcategory classification; product classification changes made after 2026-09-27 do not affect historical assignments

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id AND c.channel_group = 'web' JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: periods taken from dim_date / ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2025/26 P09 = 22 Dec 2025 to 25 Jan 2026, P10 = 26 Jan to 22 Feb 2026, P11 = 23 Feb to 22 Mar 2026)
Web sales = lines on channels in the 'web' channel group of dim_channel (channel_id 2 web home delivery, channel_id 3 click and collect)
Sales value = net_amount, EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts
Loyalty member sale = web order with a member_key on fact_web_order (login_state logged_in); guest orders are non-members
Cancelled orders have no sales lines and so are not in the figures
No staff purchases appear on web lines in this window
assumptions: 'Last year' means the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, because the request is dated 9 Oct 2026 and FY2026/27 is still in progress
'Periods 9 to 11' means fiscal periods 9, 10 and 11 of that year, one row per period
'Web sales' means net sales excluding VAT before returns; returns were left out because the request does not mention them
Share is member web sales divided by all web sales (members plus guests) in the same period, in percent
Click and collect orders count as web sales, since dim_channel puts them in the web group
caveats: Correction: channel_code is NULL on all sales lines in this window, so filtering on channel_code = 'WB' returns nothing and would also miss click and collect. I used channel_id joined to dim_channel instead.

Correction: member_key is missing on 1,309 sales lines (655 orders, about EUR 38.0k net) that belong to logged-in web orders, in a window running from about February to March 2026 (mostly in P10 and P11). The order table fact_web_order still holds the member_key for these orders, so I took member status from the order rather than from the line. Reading member_key on the sales lines directly would have understated the share: 48.87% in P10 and 58.66% in P11, against 67.39% in P09, which was unaffected.

Sales are before returns. Web refunds against these sales are small, about EUR 13.8k net across the three periods (roughly 15.7k in P09, 10.8k in P10 and 13.7k in P11 for members, and 8.7k, 6.9k and 7.7k for guests, some booked after the period ends). Member and guest refund rates are similar, so a net-of-returns share would not move materially, but I did not compute it.
The member share is steady at about 67% across the three periods once the missing member keys are repaired.
Web sales include guest orders, which are identified by a null member_key on the order; I could not tell a guest who is also a member apart from a true non-member.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), yearly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct FROM yearly ty JOIN yearly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales: net_amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only), joined through receipt_id = web_order_id
Web shop identified by store_id 900 and shown as its own line (region Online)
Regions as-is: current dim_store version joined on store_id with is_current
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal quarter taken from dim_date (Q3 = fiscal periods 7 to 9, weeks 27 to 39)
Control total: net sales per store for each Q3 agree with rpt_daily_store_sales, store by store including store 900, for both years (no differences above 0.50 EUR)
Deprecated objects not used (rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, channel_code, stg_ and bak_ tables)
assumptions: The request was received on 6 October 2026, in FY2026/27, so 'last year' is read as FY2025/26 and 'the year before' as FY2024/25. This follows how requests from May 2026 onward were read (REQ-D04, D08, D28, D35).

'Q3' is the fiscal Q3 of each year: 27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026 for FY2025/26 and 28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025 for FY2024/25. Both have 13 weeks, and week 53 is not in Q3, so no week-53 adjustment was needed.
Regions are as-is (current hierarchy). The Capital Region is therefore shown for both years, including the stores that were in South before 28 April 2025, and Kouvola counts in South in both years.
Net sales are in EUR excluding VAT. Growth is FY2025/26 against FY2024/25, in percent, rounded to one decimal.
The earlier-year figure is listed beside last year's figure in separate columns, as the requester asked, with the fiscal quarter in its own column.
caveats: Duplicate sales lines: fact_sales_line holds 418 lines (209 receipt lines loaded twice) that appear twice under the same receipt_id and line_no, with different sales_line_id and etl_loaded_at values. They are all store lines dated September 2025, so they fall outside Q3. I still removed duplicates (keeping the lowest sales_line_id) as a safeguard, and it does not change the Q3 figures. Anyone using the table for September 2025 needs to deduplicate.
The warehouse comment on dim_store.region is out of date (it lists four regions). I used the five regions plus Online that the table actually holds.
Online is not a region in the strict sense. It is the web shop (store 900), shown as a separate line as requested. Click-and-collect is included in it.
Returns are deducted on their return date, which can fall in a different quarter from the sale. The figures are net of returns booked in each quarter, not a sale-cohort view.
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles are excluded as standard. The company total across the six lines is therefore not a figure that includes training or test transactions.

answer.sql: WITH campaign AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_name = 'Spring Garden Launch 2026'), targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = e.campaign_id JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), spend AS (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_spend_before_returns FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT (SELECT campaign_name FROM campaign) AS campaign_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted, ROUND((SELECT net_spend_before_returns FROM spend), 2) AS net_spend_eur_excl_vat
definitions_applied: Targeted member: at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id through dim_member
Net sales before returns: net_amount excluding VAT, on lines linked to the member
Web sales dated on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Versioned dimensions: members counted by member_id, not member_key
Dates in Helsinki time
assumptions: 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' is campaign_id 19 (4 to 24 May 2026), which matches the date range in the request exactly. The window is the campaign window only, without the extra seven days used for uplift.
'Contacted' means at least one contact row in fact_campaign_exposure, whether or not it was delivered or opened. 14,814 of the 15,001 had at least one delivered contact.

'Spend' is read as net sales before returns, excluding VAT, in EUR, on the lines linked to those members, in any channel (store and web), the same basis as the campaign uplift definition. Spend is for the contacted members only, as asked.
Spend is total across the contacted members, not a per-member average.
caveats: The exposure table has one row per contact (31,685 rows for 15,001 members, via email and sms), so counting rows would overstate the figure. I reduced it to distinct members. Members have several dim_member versions (15,063 member_keys for 15,001 members), so I counted by member_id.

The mailing list size in dim_campaign is 16,624 including a holdout of 1,597, which leaves 15,027, against 15,001 members actually contacted. The gap of 26 is not explained by the warehouse. No holdout member appears in the contact table.
Only 2,605 of the 15,001 contacted members made a purchase in the window. The 190,687.59 EUR is the total across those members.

Refunds are not deducted. Refunds booked in the same window on returns by these members were 8,231.32 EUR excluding VAT (289 return lines), so spend after returns would be about 182,456 EUR. Say if you want that basis instead.
Using the order date (sale_date) for web lines instead of the dispatch date would give 191,576.08 EUR and 2,626 spending members. I used the dispatch date, as the company definition requires.
The figure is an amount spent by the contacted members, not an effect of the campaign. For that, compare with the holdout (uplift).

The control check passed: company-wide net sales before returns for 4 to 24 May 2026 using this logic match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (1,093,547 EUR), with no duplicate receipt lines in the window. The warehouse load point (4 October 2026) is after the window.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), q3 AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT ty.region, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region

Returns deducted on their own return date, not the sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Web shop (store 900, region Online) shown as its own line
As-is reporting: regions restated on the current store hierarchy (is_current)
Fiscal Q3 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39, compared with the same quarter of the prior fiscal year
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code
Helsinki time for all dates
Control total: result agrees with rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Last year' read as FY2025/26 (the fiscal year just completed, as in earlier accepted requests made in FY2026/27), so 'Q3 last year' is FY2025/26 Q3 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026) and 'the year before' is FY2024/25 Q3 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025)
Regions reported as-is, because the request did not ask for as-was
Growth percentage is (FY2025/26 / FY2024/25 - 1) x 100, rounded to one decimal
Week 53 does not fall in Q3, so it needed no special handling
Figures are in EUR excluding VAT
caveats: Regions are as-is: since 28 April 2025 there are five physical regions, and the Capital Region (Helsinki Vuosaari, Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto and Kerava, formerly South) exists in the FY2024/25 column only because history is restated. Kouvola (formerly East) now sits in South in both years. Old reports built on the four original regions will show different regional figures, although the total is the same.
Store 999 and ZZ Test lines were excluded (about 375 sales lines in each year's Q3). The excluded lines are not in the control total either, so the regional sum is unchanged.

The web shop is its own line (Online) and is in no physical region. Web sales are on the dispatch date, so some orders placed late in the quarter fall in the next quarter and some placed before it fall in this one.

The 3 November 2025 web-platform migration blanks channel_code, so web was identified by store 900, not by channel_code. The legacy views rpt.v_daily_sales and rpt.v_weekly_store_sales, and rpt_weekly_sales_by_region, were not used because they omit web sales or use the old regions.

Duplicate sales lines exist in the warehouse (418 receipt lines loaded twice, each copy with its own sales_line_id, all dated 15 to 21 September 2025). They fall in FY2025/26 Q2, outside this request, so no correction was needed here, but they would overstate any figure covering that week.
Quarter totals tie exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales: 3,845,652.46 for FY2025/26 Q3 (web 580,450.93) and 3,610,885.71 for FY2024/25 Q3 (web 447,645.43).

Savonlinna (East) closed on 25 January 2026, the last day of FY2025/26 Q3, so East's growth is not like-for-like. Tampere Lamminpää (West) and Lohja (South) opened in September and November 2024, so both are in FY2024/25 Q3 trading only partly or newly, and regional growth is total net sales, not like-for-like growth.
