answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.region IS NULL;
definitions_applied: DEF-LFL-BASIS: LFL compares net sales in LFL stores for a period with the same fiscal weeks last year
DEF-LFL-OPEN: A store is in the LFL base for a period only if it had been open at least 52 weeks (364 days) before the first day of the period
DEF-LFL-BOTH-YEARS: A store-week counts only if the store traded in that fiscal week in both years
DEF-LFL-REFIT: Refit weeks are taken out for the store concerned, in both years, using ref_store_closure
DEF-LFL-WEEK53: Week 53 is not part of LFL, because it has no comparator week
DEF-NET-SALES: Net sales is the net amount excluding VAT, after returns; store 999 and test articles excluded
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: Physical stores only (store_id below 900); the web shop is not part of LFL
CAL-COMPARE: Comparison uses identical fiscal week numbers across years
assumptions: Interpreted 'period 4 this year' as P4 of FY2026/27 (fiscal weeks 14-17), the most recent completed period
Applied prior-year comparison to same fiscal weeks in FY2025/26 (also weeks 14-17)
No regional breakdown was requested, so returned the company total only
Used the current version of dim_store to determine store eligibility and closure status

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS tampere_loyalty_members FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
definitions_applied: Members counted by distinct member_id, not by dim_member rows
Current member version (is_current) for home store
Physical stores only (store_id below 900) for store-based counts
Store 999 (training store) left out
Store 900 (web shop) left out of the Tampere stores; online sign-ups sit under store 900 and are not Tampere
Warehouse loaded through 4 October 2026, so 'now' is that date
assumptions: 'Customers' is not defined in the company dictionary. I read it as loyalty-programme members, the only customers the warehouse can identify and count, since non-member receipts and guest web orders carry no customer ID.

'In Tampere' is read as members whose current home store is one of the four physical Tampere stores: 115 Tampere Hervanta (2,788), 116 Tampere Lielahti (1,721), 117 Tampere Kaleva (1,692) and 136 Tampere Lamminpää (974). Home store is where the member enrolled or last moved to; it is not a measure of where they live.

All members on the register are counted, whether or not they have bought recently. I did not apply the 'active member' definition (a purchase in the trailing 52 weeks), because the request did not say active.
caveats: 'Customers' is undefined in the house knowledge. If Jukka means active customers, the active-member figure (at least one purchase in the 52 weeks to Sunday 4 October 2026, store 999 and ZZ Test excluded) for the same Tampere home stores is 4,441, made up of 1,708, 1,052, 1,034 and 647 across stores 115, 116, 117 and 136. Please confirm which figure is wanted.

Trap avoided: dim_store lists the web shop (store 900, region Online) and the training store (store 999) with city Tampere. Filtering on city alone would wrongly bring in the 12,028 online sign-ups and any store 999 members. Both are excluded.

Members whose home store was in Tampere at some earlier point but who have since moved to a store elsewhere are not counted. 7,515 distinct members have had a Tampere home store in any version, which is 340 more than the 7,175 who have one now. 747 of the 7,175 changed home store at some point in their history; the count uses the current one.

Customers who live in Tampere but are not loyalty members, or who shop in Tampere without a member card, cannot be counted from the warehouse. Members who live in Tampere but have a home store in another city, or online (store 900), are not included.
Of the 7,175, 4,841 have marketing consent. If this is for a campaign list, use the consent figure rather than the headline count, because members are only contacted with consent.

Store 136 Tampere Lamminpää opened on 2 September 2024, yet 362 of its 974 members have a join date before that opening. They were presumably enrolled elsewhere or migrated and then reassigned to Lamminpää. They are counted because their current home store is Lamminpää.
No stg_ or bak_ tables were used. dim_member holds exactly one current row per member (60,000 members in all), so there is no double counting from versions.
The store-level control total against rpt_daily_store_sales does not apply, because this is a member count and not a sales figure.

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year,
           5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2026_27, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week;
definitions_applied: DEF-NET-SALES: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
DEF-NET-SALES-SCOPE: store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
DEF-WEB-RECOGNITION: web sales on Helsinki dispatch date, not order date
CAL-COMPARE: fiscal weeks aligned by week number across years
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: total company includes all physical stores plus web shop 900
assumptions: Period 2 is FY2026/27 period 2 (weeks 5-8, 1-28 June 2026) — the most recent completed period as of the request date
Prior year is FY2025/26 period 2 (weeks 5-8, 26 May - 22 June 2025) — the same fiscal week numbers
Columns are named to show fiscal years: net_sales_fy2026_27 is this year, net_sales_fy2025_26 is last year
Growth percentage is this year divided by last year, minus 1, multiplied by 100
caveats: Store 125 underwent a refit closure from 15 June to 26 July 2026, affecting week 7 (15-21 June) and week 8 (22-28 June). The -32.2% decline in week 7 and 76.4% increase in week 8 reflect this closure and its impact on comparable sales.
Total company net sales include both physical stores and web channel. Web sales are recorded on dispatch date (Helsinki time) to the web shop (store 900).
Returns reduce net sales on their return date, not the date of original sale. A 30-day return window means period 2 sales figures may still receive returns booked in later periods.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount AS net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' UNION ALL SELECT p.sku, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03') SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net), 2) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, not the order date
Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns reduce net sales on their own return date
Web identified by store_id 900, not channel_code or channel_id
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Click-and-collect counted as web, dated on the ready-for-collection date
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
Product identified by stable sku, named from the current product version (as-is)
Helsinki time conversion of UTC timestamps
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales (store 900)
assumptions: 'Top 10 products by web sales' is ranked by web net sales in EUR excluding VAT, after returns, not by units or gross value including VAT.
'Since the platform migration on 3 November 2025' means dispatch dates from 3 November 2025 (inclusive) up to the end of the warehouse load, 4 October 2026.
A product is an article (sku), so all of its versions are combined. Name and category come from the current version.
Returns booked to the web shop from 3 November 2025 are deducted, including any for goods dispatched before the migration, because a return reduces net sales on its own return date.

WITH net_lines AS (
    -- Sales from stores (excluding web shop and training store)
    SELECT cs.region, 
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
      AND s.store_id < 900
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- Returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT cs.region,
           -r.refund_net AS net_sales
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
      AND s.store_id < 900
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM net_lines
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC;

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank;
definitions_applied: DEF-STORE-LEAGUE: stores ranked by net sales per trading day
DEF-STORE-SCOPE: physical stores only, store_id < 900
DEF-NET-SALES: net amount in EUR excluding VAT, after returns
DEF-NET-SALES-SCOPE: no store 999, no ZZ Test category products
CAL-CLOSED-DAYS: trading days exclude closed public holidays (dim_date.is_trading_day = false)
REG-STORE-EVENTS: trading days account for store open_date and close_date
REG-REFITS: trading days exclude weeks in ref_store_closure
REG-STAFF-PURCHASE: staff purchases included in net sales

definitions_applied: Units sold = quantity on sales lines, dated by sale_date (Helsinki business date), before returns
Last completed fiscal week from fiscal-calendar (Monday to Sunday, FY2026/27 week 22)
Store scope by stable store_id (131) through the store_key version, product by stable sku (101624) through the product_key version
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither changes this figure)

Returns were not deducted. The same store booked 4 units of this SKU as returned during the same week. Net of those returns the figure would be 13, but the company definition of units sold is the quantity on sales lines, so the answer is 17.

answer.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date), period_days AS (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day), trading_days AS (SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN period_days pd WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900 AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date) AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date) GROUP BY 1), sales_dedup AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1), net_lines AS (SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), store_sales AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day FROM store_sales ss JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current ORDER BY rank
definitions_applied: Store league table: physical stores ranked by net sales per trading day

Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) and training store (999) excluded

Stores that traded for only part of the period stay in the table, ranked on their own trading days
Control total: result checked against rpt_daily_store_sales for the same stores and days
assumptions: 'Period 5 last year' is read as FY2025/26 P5, because the request was received on 8 October 2026, in FY2026/27. This follows how earlier 'last year' requests were read once the new fiscal year had started.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY cp.category

Control check: net sales over P6 for all categories, 1,293,219.69, match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly (0 store-days differ). The control total cannot be taken by category, so the category figures are checked only through this total.
Net sales are excluding VAT. Standard costs are the April-revalued standard cost for FY2025/26. Percentages are rounded to one decimal place.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')) SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_gross_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period IN (4,5,6) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (fact_web_order joined on receipt_id = web_order_id), not on the order date
Web identified by store_id 900, not by channel_code
Including VAT: sum of gross_amount from the lines, each with its own VAT rate (24%, 25.5%, 14%, 10%)
Before returns: fact_return_line not used
Cancelled and processing orders excluded (no dispatch, no sales lines)
Category ZZ Test excluded
Click-and-collect counted as web, with dispatch_ts_utc as the ready-for-collection time
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 P4 29 Jul to 25 Aug 2024, P5 26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024, P6 23 Sep to 27 Oct 2024
Control total: net web sales before returns checked against rpt_daily_store_sales store 900
assumptions: 'Q2 of FY24/25' read as fiscal year FY2024/25, periods 4 to 6, as the request states
One figure per period, so no quarter total row
'Before returns' read as no refunds deducted; refund_gross not shown

Dispatch-date recognition used for web, per company definition, so orders placed in late July 2024 and dispatched in P4 count in P4, and orders placed in P6 but dispatched after 27 Oct 2024 fall outside
caveats: No data corrections were needed for this range. Checked: no duplicate sales lines, gross_amount equals net_amount times (1 + vat_rate) on every web line, and order_total_gross equals the line gross total on every dispatched order.

The VAT rise from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 falls inside the quarter. P4 has only 24% standard-rate lines. From P5, VAT is taken at the order date, so orders placed up to 31 August 2024 and dispatched in P5 still carry 24%.
Two web test lines in ZZ Test fall near this range, and any in the quarter are excluded. Sales lines on store 999 do not appear on web orders.

The control total matches: net web sales before returns equal rpt_daily_store_sales for store 900 in each period (P4 126,242.65; P5 122,660.57; P6 153,786.32), so the gross figures sit on a reconciled net base.
Figures are before returns and not reduced by refunds. Returns arriving later would lower net sales, and the request asked for the pre-return view.
rpt.v_daily_sales and channel_code were not used. The quarter is before the 3 November 2025 migration, so channel_code would have worked, but the company rule is store_id 900.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: ATV = net sales before returns (excluding VAT) divided by the number of distinct sales receipts
Store measure: physical stores only (store_id below 900), so the web shop is excluded
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded from ATV
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: period 4 of FY2026/27 is 3 Aug to 30 Aug 2026 (fiscal weeks 14 to 17)
Lines dated by sale_date, which is the Helsinki business date
Format taken from the store version on the sale date (format is the same in every store version)
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales on net_sales_before_returns, receipts and units
assumptions: Read 'period 4 of FY26/27' as fiscal year FY2026/27, period 4, written 'FY2026/27' in the warehouse
Read 'average basket value' as the company metric ATV (average transaction value), as the request states
Formats are those in dim_store (Large, Medium, Small); the web shop (Web) is not shown because ATV is a store measure
Reported ATV in EUR excluding VAT, rounded to 2 decimals
caveats: Staff purchases are excluded from ATV per the company definition. This removes 280 receipts and about EUR 14,797 of net sales across the three formats from the figures.
The stated dim_store.format comment (Hyper, Standard, Express) is out of date. The warehouse holds Large, Medium and Small for stores, plus Web (store 900) and Training (store 999).
The store 999 training store and the web shop (store 900) are left out of the result. Test-article lines (ZZ Test) exist only in store 999 and one web order, so they do not affect the store figures.
No duplicate sales lines were found in the period (sales_line_id and receipt_id plus line_no are unique), and no receipt spans several stores or mixes staff and non-staff lines.

The query reconciles exactly to rpt_daily_store_sales for P4: 18,027 receipts, 70,194 units and EUR 1,062,266.72 net sales before returns across all 1,064 store-days, with no day-level differences. That control total includes staff purchases, so the ATV figures are slightly different (staff purchases removed).

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 5 of FY2026/27, 31 August to 27 September 2026 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Units sold = quantity on sales lines, by sale date
Store scope: Hyvinkää is store_id 107 (physical store, one version only)
As-is product hierarchy: current product version for the subcategory
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded (neither touches this figure)
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Control-total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: 'Cleaning Products' is the subcategory under the category Cleaning & Household. I did not include the category's other subcategories (Laundry & Ironing, Storage Boxes).
'This year' is the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, so 'period 5' is FY2026/27 P05, the last completed period at the request date of 5 October 2026.
'Units sold' is units on sales lines (quantity), not net of returns. Hyvinkää had no returns of Cleaning Products booked in the period, so the result is the same either way.
Hyvinkää means the physical store only, store_id 107. The web shop (store 900) is not part of a store's figures.
caveats: No data problems found, so no corrections were applied.
Daily receipts, units and net sales before returns for the whole of store 107 match rpt_daily_store_sales on every day of the period.
The 136 units include 4 units bought by staff.
There were no sales of Cleaning Products at Hyvinkää on 9 and 15 September.

answer.sql: WITH lfl_sales AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND r.store_id != 129 GROUP BY d.fiscal_year) SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) * 100, 2) as lfl_growth_percent FROM lfl_sales
definitions_applied: Like-for-like stores: stores present in tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 (37 stores open in both calendar years 2024 and 2025)
Comparable store base for analysis: 36 stores (LFL list minus store 129 which closed 2026-01-25)
Net sales: reported in rpt_daily_store_sales, excluding VAT, after line discounts and returns
Period 4: fiscal period as defined in ref_fiscal_calendar (FY2025/26 P4: 2025-07-28 to 2025-08-24; FY2026/27 P4: 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30)
Growth calculation: (current year sales - prior year sales) / prior year sales × 100
assumptions: Request 'this year' interpreted as current fiscal year FY2026/27 (as of 2026-10-15)
Prior year comparison is FY2025/26 (the immediately preceding fiscal year)
Used pre-defined LFL store list (tmp_lfl_store_list_2025) as the baseline for comparable stores
Store 129 (Savonlinna, closed 2026-01-25) excluded from both periods for true like-for-like comparison
caveats: One store (129, Savonlinna) closed between the comparison periods and was excluded to maintain like-for-like validity. Prior year sales recalculated excluding this store: FY2025/26 P4 net sales 969,960.16 EUR (36 comparable stores)

The LFL store list (tmp_lfl_store_list_2025) was created at an earlier date and represents stores open in both 2024 and 2025; one additional qualification (store closure) was applied for this specific comparison
No adjustments made for price changes, promotional activity, or other non-like-for-like factors

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC
definitions_applied: Net sales: revenue excluding VAT and after line discounts
Store league table: ranking of physical stores by sales performance
Fiscal period: company's 13-week accounting period
assumptions: Last year interpreted as FY2025/26 (the previous completed fiscal year)
Period 5 refers to the fifth fiscal period of FY2025/26 (2025-08-25 to 2025-09-21)
League table ranked by net sales in descending order
Excluded web channel sales and pseudo-locations (store_id >= 900)
caveats: FY2025/26 P05 data is fully loaded and complete
All 39 physical stores have sales recorded for the period

answer.sql: SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned FROM fact_return_line frl INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND frl.return_date >= (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4) AND frl.return_date <= (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4)
definitions_applied: Returns measured from fact_return_line, joining dim_product by product_key
Garden Furniture identified as subcategory within Garden category
Fiscal period calendar used to determine period 4 date range
assumptions: This year interpreted as FY2026/27 (fiscal year containing request date)
Period 4 refers to fiscal period 4 (2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30)
Product-fact joins via product_key handle slowly changing dimensions correctly

answer.sql:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
definitions_applied: Web net sales (net amount excluding VAT, after returns)
Web shop identified by store_id 900
Web sales recognised on Helsinki dispatch date
Returns booked on their own return date, not on the date of original sale
Cancelled orders excluded from web sales
Test articles (category ZZ Test) excluded
Training store (store_id 999) excluded
assumptions: Request for daily breakdown implies one row per calendar day
Web sales include click-and-collect orders, recognised on ready-for-collection date
Dispatch date converted to Helsinki time (Europe/Helsinki timezone) per company reporting standard
caveats: Data validated against rpt_daily_store_sales control total with zero gap
December 2025 dates fall after the 3 November 2025 platform migration; web identified by store_id 900 rather than channel_code
Some orders crossing the UTC/Helsinki midnight boundary may be on different dates if evaluated at UTC midnight vs Helsinki midnight, but all dates reported in Helsinki time per standard
Returns can arrive up to 30 days after sale; figures include returns booked through 2025-12-23

answer.sql: SELECT ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2024/25 P05 = 26 Aug 2024 to 22 Sep 2024 (4 weeks, fully loaded)
Figures including VAT: VAT is gross_amount minus net_amount summed from each line, using the line's own vat_rate and never one flat rate
Store scope: physical stores only (store_id below 900); web shop (900) left out
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included, as in net sales
Store lines dated by sale_date, which is the Helsinki business date
Control total: net sales before returns and receipt counts match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly for every store-day in the period (EUR 938,729.24 and 16,368 receipts)
assumptions: 'Period 5 of FY24/25' read as FY2024/25 P05 (26 Aug to 22 Sep 2024)
'In the stores' read as the physical stores (store_id below 900). Online and click-and-collect web orders are left out
'VAT charged' read as the VAT on sales lines. The company dictionary does not define a VAT figure net of refunds, so returns are not netted off
Rates are shown as percentages (25.5 means 25.5%)
caveats: The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024, which falls inside this period. Standard-rated VAT is therefore split between 24% (26 to 31 Aug) and 25.5% (1 to 22 Sep), as requested. The reduced rates of 14% and 10% did not change

Refunds in the stores in the same period carried VAT of about EUR 5,094.72 at 24%, EUR 6,029.57 at 25.5%, EUR 10.48 at 14% and EUR 1.20 at 10%, by return date. These are not netted off the figures above. If FP&A wants VAT net of refunds, subtract these amounts

Excluded 36 store-999 lines and 36 ZZ Test lines (trading-day test sales in store 999 only, a few euros of VAT in total). Store 999 had VAT of about EUR 656 across all its lines in the period. These exclusions change the VAT total only marginally

No data problems found for these stores in this period: no duplicate sales lines, no null amounts, gross equals net times (1 + rate) on every line, each line's rate matches its product's vat_class and the date of sale, and the data reconciles to the daily control table

answer.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY ALL
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: FY2026/27 period 5 is 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27, 4 weeks, fully loaded
Store identified by stable store_id 107 (Hyvinkää), joined through the store_key on each sales line
Product category taken from the product version on each sales line (product_key), subcategory 'Cleaning Products'
Units sold = sum of quantity on fact_sales_line
Sale date taken from sale_date and mapped to the fiscal period through dim_date
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27 (request dated 2026-10-05), so period 5 is 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-27
'Cleaning Products' means the subcategory of that name. It sits inside the category 'Cleaning & Household', which also holds Laundry & Ironing and Storage Boxes; those are not counted
'Units sold' is gross units sold, not net of returns
Staff purchases are counted as sales, in line with rpt_daily_store_sales, which also includes them
Hyvinkää is the single physical store 107 (one store version, no closures); web and click-and-collect lines are not attributed to the store
caveats: The corrections I checked for made no difference to this figure. In period 5 there were no duplicate lines, no late or reloaded data, no store closures, and no product changing subcategory.

I found duplicated sales lines (same receipt_id and line_no, loaded twice) in the warehouse in the week 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21, last year's period 5. They do not touch this answer, but any year-on-year comparison against last year's period 5 would double count that week unless deduplicated.
Staff purchases account for 4 of the 136 units. Excluding them gives 132.
There were no returns of Cleaning Products at Hyvinkää in the period, so net and gross units are the same.
I did not use the backup, old, staging and tmp tables (bak_*, *_old, stg_*, tmp_*) in the answer.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS garden_net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns
Returns deducted on their own return date, not the original sale date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Staff purchases included
As-was category hierarchy: the product version carried on each fact line, valid on the transaction date
Fiscal calendar from dim_date: FY2024/25 periods 7 to 12 (weeks 27 to 52, 28 Oct 2024 to 27 Apr 2025)
Web shop (store 900) included in company net sales
assumptions: 'The old way, Garden as it was reported at the time' read as as-was: category taken from the product version in force on the transaction date. Outdoor lighting therefore stays in Garden for the whole of FY2024/25, as it was reported then.
'P7 to P12 of FY24/25' read as fiscal periods 7 to 12 of FY2024/25, 28 October 2024 to 27 April 2025. All six periods are complete and in the warehouse.
Garden net sales cover all channels (physical stores and web) because the request names no channel or store scope.
One row per fiscal period, as the request says 'for each period'. No total row was added.
caveats: Outdoor Lighting is included in Garden in these figures (about 20.8k in P7 and 20.3k in P8, and smaller amounts after that). On the current hierarchy, which moved outdoor lighting to Electrical from 27 October 2025, Garden for the same periods would be lower by those amounts. The two views differ only in how sales are split between categories.
Returns are deducted in the period the refund was booked, so the net sales of a period can include refunds for goods sold in an earlier period.

Cancelled and still-processing web orders are excluded because they have no dispatch date. I made no other correction. I found no duplicate sales or return lines and no product version out of line with its sale date.
There is no per-category control total. I checked the same query without the category filter against rpt_daily_store_sales for P7 to P12 and every period matched to the cent, with zero in store 999.

answer.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'holdout' AS grp FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15 UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE x.campaign_id = 15), sales AS (SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1), refunds AS (SELECT m.member_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1), per_group AS (SELECT g.grp, count(*) AS members, sum(coalesce(s.sales_net,0) - coalesce(r.refund_net,0)) / count(*) AS avg_spend FROM grp g LEFT JOIN sales s USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (member_id) GROUP BY g.grp) SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur, round(max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur, round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN avg_spend END) - max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN avg_spend END),2) AS uplift_eur FROM per_group
definitions_applied: Campaign window: dim_campaign start_date to end_date for Black Week 2025 (campaign_id 15), 2025-11-24 to 2025-11-30 inclusive
Holdout group: campaign_holdout rows for campaign 15, which are keyed on member_id
Members matched across all dim_member versions by member_id, not by a single member_key
Spend: net_amount (EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) on sales lines dated in the window, across all channels (store, web home delivery, click and collect)
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded
Refunds (refund_net) booked in the window subtracted, matching the company net sales definition of net of returns
Averages over every member in the group, including members who bought nothing
Uplift in euros: average spend per targeted member minus average spend per held-out member
assumptions: Targeted members are those with at least one contact for campaign 15 in fact_campaign_exposure: 23,818 distinct members. Held-out members: 2,747.
Each group is measured on everyone in it regardless of whether the contact was delivered or opened, so zero-spend members count and the figure is the effect of the campaign as sent.
Spend means money kept: sales net of refunds booked in the same window. Refunds are attributed to the member who received them, even if the original purchase was before the window.
Staff purchases are excluded because they are not driven by the campaign.
Non-member sales and guest web orders cannot be attributed to a group and are left out.
VAT excluded throughout (net_amount basis), so the figures are comparable with the company's net sales.
Before refunds, with staff purchases excluded, the averages are 4.70 (targeted) and 4.04 (held out), an uplift of about 0.66. Including staff purchases and ignoring refunds gives 4.74 and 4.06.
caveats: Channel codes: channel_code is NULL on sales lines in the campaign week, so the existing rpt.v_daily_sales view (which finds web lines with channel_code = 'WB') would miss all web sales. I did not filter on channel_code and kept all channels via the member link; web sales are 2,297 lines in the window.

Member matching: campaign_holdout holds member_id while the fact tables hold member_key, and members have several versions. I mapped everything through member_id. Joining the holdout to member_key directly would have dropped some members.

Group size check: the campaign record says 26,573 on the mailing list and 2,747 held out, which implies 23,826 targeted. The exposure table identifies 23,818 members, so 8 members on the list have no contact rows and cannot be identified. The effect on the averages is negligible.

No member appears in both the holdout and the exposure table. The two groups look comparable at campaign start: all have marketing consent, with similar loyalty tier mix, online sign-up share and join dates.

The uplift is small in absolute terms. Only about 8% of members in either group bought anything in the week (1,899 of 23,818 targeted and 181 of 2,747 held out). The holdout has only 181 buyers, so the 0.68 uplift is a point estimate with wide uncertainty and no significance test was run.
The result covers spend only in the seven-day campaign window. Any pull-forward or later effect is not included.
I did not use the backup, staging, tmp or old tables, which are not documented as sources of record.

answer.sql: WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), by_region AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM by_region ty JOIN by_region ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region
definitions_applied: Net sales: net amount excluding VAT, after returns, with returns deducted on their own return date
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (delivered and collected orders only; cancelled and processing orders excluded)
Web shop is store_id 900, shown as its own region line (Online)
Regions as-is: current dim_store version, so the Capital Region covers stores 101-105 in both years and Kouvola (114) is in South in both years
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded
Fiscal calendar: Q3 = periods 7 to 9 = fiscal weeks 27 to 39, taken from dim_date fiscal_quarter
Staff purchases included
Control total check against rpt_daily_store_sales
assumptions: The request was received on 6 October 2026 (FY2026/27). 'Last year' is read as FY2025/26, following past requests asked in the same fiscal year, and 'the year before' as FY2024/25. So the comparison is Q3 FY2025/26 (27 Oct 2025 to 25 Jan 2026) against Q3 FY2024/25 (28 Oct 2024 to 26 Jan 2025).
Regions are as-is, the management reporting default. The request did not ask for as-was.
Growth is FY2025/26 against FY2024/25: (last year / year before - 1) x 100, rounded to one decimal.
Both Q3s are 13 weeks (weeks 27 to 39) and neither contains week 53, so no week-53 adjustment was needed.
Both years are complete in the warehouse (loaded through 4 October 2026), so the quarters are fully loaded.
No total company row was added because the request asked only for the regions and the web shop.
caveats: Filters changed the totals: store 999 and ZZ Test lines were excluded. In Q3 FY2025/26 that was about 6,888 EUR of net sales, and in Q3 FY2024/25 about 6,486 EUR. Both are small against the regional totals.

Control total check: for the same days, store by store (including the web shop, store 900), net sales agree with rpt_daily_store_sales for all stores and both years. No unexplained difference remains.
Source checks found no duplicate sales lines or return lines in either quarter, and each store has exactly one current version. No corrections to the data were needed.

Rows from rpt.v_daily_sales, rpt.v_weekly_store_sales and the channel_code column were not used. The channel_code column is empty from 3 November 2025, which falls inside Q3 FY2025/26, so the web shop was identified by store_id 900 instead.
Online growth of 29.7% includes the change in how web sales are dated: they are dated on the dispatch date. Web returns are booked to the web shop on their return date.

Savonlinna (129, East) closed on 25 January 2026, the last day of Q3 FY2025/26, and Pori (119, West) had a refit closure from 8 September to 12 October 2025, before this quarter. Neither affects the quarter in any way that needed adjusting. This is a plain regional comparison, not like-for-like, so new stores (Tampere Lamminpää and Lohja, which opened in autumn 2024) are included in full.

On the as-is basis the Capital Region figures include the same six stores' history in both years, so the Capital Region and South growth rates are comparable. An as-was reading would show no Capital Region for FY2024/25 (the region only exists from 28 April 2025).

answer.sql: SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE cs.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5 GROUP BY 1,2,3
definitions_applied: This year means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27
Period 5 of FY2026/27: Monday 31 August to Sunday 27 September 2026 (fiscal weeks 18 to 21, 28 days, complete)
Units sold are the quantity on sales lines, by sale_date (Helsinki business date)
Store 999 and the ZZ Test category left out of sales work (neither touches this result)
Staff purchases included (4 of the 136 units)
Versioned dimensions joined on store_id/sku with is_current (as-is)
Physical store scope: Hyvinkää is store_id 107, not the web shop (900)
assumptions: 'Period 5 this year' is read as FY2026/27 P05, the current fiscal year, which was complete when the request was received on 5 October 2026

'Cleaning Products' is read as the subcategory of that name, which sits in the category Cleaning & Household; the other subcategories in that category (Laundry & Ironing, Storage Boxes) are not included
'Units sold' is the quantity on the sales lines (gross units sold), not net of returns
Hyvinkää means the physical store 107 only; web orders are not attributed to it
The category reading is as-is (current product version); the as-was reading gives the same 136 units
caveats: No units returned for Cleaning Products at Hyvinkää were booked with a return date in P5, so net of returns would also be 136 units

The company metric dictionary has no formal definition of 'units sold'; I used sales-line quantity, which is the definition the weeks-of-cover metric uses and which matches rpt_daily_store_sales.units_sold
As a control, total store 107 units for P5 across all products (1,626 units) and net sales before returns (27,297.68 EUR) match rpt_daily_store_sales exactly, over all 28 days
No duplicate receipt and line numbers were found in the period for this store
channel_code is not filled on any of this store's lines in the period (the web platform migration of 3 November 2025), so store lines were identified by store_id, not channel_code
Subcategory-level units cannot be checked against rpt_daily_store_sales, which has only a total units figure per store and day

answer.sql: WITH first_version AS (SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no FROM dim_member) SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members FROM first_version fv LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND fv.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
definitions_applied: New member: counted on the join date, at the home store in the member's first dim_member version (the store where they enrolled)
Members counted by distinct member_id, one first version per member, so later tier, store or consent versions do not double count
Online sign-ups sit under store 900 (Tuomimetsä web shop) and are shown as their own row
Fiscal year from dim_date: FY2025/26 is 28 April 2025 to 3 May 2026 (53 weeks, week 53 included because there is no comparison)
Store name taken from the current dim_store version (as-is)
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 7 October 2026 is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26 (28 Apr 2025 to 3 May 2026), as in past accepted requests made during FY2026/27. If calendar 2025 was meant, the counts will differ
Week 53 (27 Apr to 3 May 2026) is kept because the request has no comparison
Stores are listed by enrolling store (store_id) with no region or format breakdown, since none was asked for
Stores with no new members in the year would be absent. None are, every store appears
caveats: The count uses the home store from each member's first version, not the current one. 3,829 members have changed home store since joining, so counting on the current version would credit the wrong stores
Savonlinna (129) closed on 25 January 2026, so its 113 new members cover only the part of the year it was open (last join 24 January 2026)
Tampere Lamminpää (136) and Lohja (137) opened in autumn 2024 and are open for the full year. No sign-ups fall before an open date or after a close date
Total across all rows is 14,854 new members, of which 2,932 signed up online. A total row is not shown because the request did not ask for one

Member data checks were clean: one first version per member with no ties, valid_from equal to join_date on every first version, and every home store found in dim_store. Staging and backup member tables (stg_member_updates, bak_ tables) were not used

answer.sql:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT l.region,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31') AS august_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(l.gross_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM lines l
WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY l.region
ORDER BY l.region
definitions_applied: Gross sales including VAT = sum of gross_amount on the sales lines (each line carries its own VAT rate)
Before returns: refunds (fact_return_line) not deducted
As-was regions: region taken from the store version on the fact line (store_key), not the current version
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date (fact_web_order, delivered or collected orders only)
Web shop (store 900) reported as its own region, Online
Staff purchases included
Dates are Helsinki business dates; web dispatch timestamps converted from UTC to Helsinki time
Fiscal calendar not used: calendar months as asked
assumptions: August and September 2024 are read as calendar months (1-31 Aug and 1-30 Sep 2024), not fiscal periods, because this is for a VAT filing.

'Regions as they were at the time' is read as as-was: the four regions South, West, East and North, plus Online for the web shop. The Capital Region did not exist until 28 April 2025, so Helsinki Vuosaari, Helsinki Pitäjänmäki, Espoo Lommila, Vantaa Tammisto and Kerava are in South, and Kouvola is in East.
The request did not say which date to use for web sales, so the company default applies: web lines fall in the month of their Helsinki dispatch date, not their order date.
Online is included as its own row because web sales are part of company sales and belong in the VAT filing. It is not in any physical region.
'Before returns' is read as gross sales with no refunds deducted, so no refund column is shown.
caveats: The VAT filing basis may differ from the company rule on web timing. Web gross by order date for Aug-Sep 2024 would be 334,806.10, against 333,871.63 by dispatch date as sent. Web orders ordered in late September but dispatched in October fall outside this table, and orders from late July dispatched in August fall inside it. Finance should confirm which date the VAT filing needs for web orders.

The general VAT rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 (reduced rates 14% and 10% unchanged). The figures sum gross_amount line by line, so August carries 24% and September 25.5% on standard-rated articles. A flat rate was not applied to net totals.
Store 999 and ZZ Test articles were excluded: 285 lines worth 7,645.77 gross sat in the window and are not in the table.

Control check: net sales before returns by region, taken from the same lines, total 1,241,886.32 for August and 1,091,919.49 for September. Both match rpt_daily_store_sales net_sales_before_returns exactly.

The window had no duplicate sales line keys, gross_amount equalled net_amount x (1 + vat_rate) on every line, and no web orders were cancelled or still processing, so none were excluded for that reason.
Amounts are in EUR including VAT. Refunds are excluded as asked, so these figures are not net sales.

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv_eur FROM fact_sales_line f INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3) AND (f.staff_purchase_flag IS NULL OR f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE) GROUP BY d.fiscal_period ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
definitions_applied: Average Transaction Value (ATV): net sales divided by count of distinct receipts, one receipt per transaction whether store or web
Fiscal year FY2026/27 (current year at data load date 2026-10-04)
Fiscal periods 1, 2, 3 as defined in ref_fiscal_calendar
Net sales: net_amount column (EUR, excluding VAT) from fact_sales_line
Transaction: one distinct receipt_id; multiple lines may appear on one receipt
Both channels: store sales (ST) and web sales (WB, including home delivery and click-and-collect) included
assumptions: Request for 'this year' interpreted as FY2026/27, the current fiscal year as of the data load date (2026-10-04)
Staff purchases excluded (staff_purchase_flag = TRUE) from ATV calculation, consistent with retail industry practice for customer metrics
Channel data inconsistency resolved: rows with null channel_code matched to channel_id values where available
caveats: Data load date is 2026-10-04; request received 2026-10-05. Periods 1, 2, 3 of FY2026/27 are fully complete.
433 staff purchase receipts (1.6% of period 1 total) excluded from ATV; 341 in period 2 (1.4%), 395 in period 3 (1.4%)

Warehouse schema shows channel data inconsistency: some fact_sales_line rows carry channel_code (ST, WB), others carry channel_id (1, 2, 3). Both are present in the same periods. Query consolidates to single channel representation.
Data quality: all net_amount values positive (range 0.61–572.02 EUR), no zero-amount lines, supporting data integrity

answer.sql: WITH as_of AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN as_of WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end) SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members FROM active a CROSS JOIN as_of JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to GROUP BY cur.tier ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
definitions_applied: Active member: at least one purchase in the trailing 52 fiscal weeks ending with the as-of week and including it, in any channel
Trailing window taken as sale_date > as-of Sunday minus 364 days and <= as-of Sunday (27 Dec 2024 would be wrong; window is 23 Dec 2024 to 21 Dec 2025)
Count distinct member_id, not member_key, so members with several versions are counted once
Tier read from the dim_member version valid on the as-of Sunday (21 Dec 2025)
End of period 8 = period_end_date in ref_fiscal_calendar (Sunday 21 December 2025)
Store 999 and category ZZ Test excluded from sales work (no member in the window bought only from them, so the filter changed nothing)
assumptions: 'Last year' asked on 7 October 2026 (FY2026/27) is read as the last completed fiscal year, FY2025/26, following how earlier requests in FY2026/27 were accepted. So 'period 8 last year' is FY2025/26 P08, 24 Nov to 21 Dec 2025, and the as-of date is Sunday 21 December 2025.
'As of the end of period 8' is treated as the as-of week being the last week of P8 (week 34).
A purchase means any sales line linked to a member in fact_sales_line, store or web, dated on sale_date (the Helsinki order date for web lines).
Tier is shown as it stood at the end of P8 (as-was on that date), not the current tier.
No total row given because the request asks for a breakdown by tier only.
caveats: If 'last year' was meant as FY2024/25 (P8 ended 22 December 2024), the figures would be different; the answer uses FY2025/26 P8.

Checks run: the window is fully loaded (FY2025/26 P8 fully_loaded = true); no duplicate sales_line_ids in the window; every member key on sales lines in the window exists in dim_member; every active member had exactly one dim_member version valid on 21 December 2025 (tiers sum to 29,526, equal to the distinct active members); no active member's purchases were in store 999 or ZZ Test articles, no non-positive lines, and no cancelled web orders among them.
Staff purchases are included (1,761 active members have at least one staff-purchase line in the window), as the company definition counts any purchase.
No corrections to the data were needed. I did not run the query-check or fiscal scripts, as no script runner was available.

answer.sql: WITH period_end AS (SELECT period_end_date AS as_of_date, period_end_date - INTERVAL 1 YEAR + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS window_start FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8), tier_at_date AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m, period_end p WHERE p.as_of_date BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to), buyers AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key CROSS JOIN period_end p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.window_start AND p.as_of_date AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) SELECT t.tier, count(*) AS active_members FROM tier_at_date t JOIN buyers b USING (member_id) GROUP BY t.tier ORDER BY CASE t.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: end of period 8 of FY2025/26 is 2025-12-21 (ref_fiscal_calendar)
Member tier taken from the dim_member version valid on 2025-12-21 (slowly changing dimension, not the current tier)
Members counted once by member_id, not by member_key version
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded from the activity test
assumptions: Today is 2026-10-07, which falls in FY2026/27, so 'last year' means FY2025/26 and 'end of period 8' means Sunday 2025-12-21
No company definition of 'active member' was available, so I used at least one purchase (store or web) in the 12 months up to and including 2025-12-21, i.e. 2024-12-22 to 2025-12-21
Staff purchases made on a loyalty card do not count as activity, since this is a marketing audience figure
Only members who had joined by 2025-12-21 are in scope; the tier version valid on that date ensures this
Returns were not netted off: a member who bought and returned still counts as having purchased
Members with no purchase in the window are treated as inactive and not shown. Marketing consent was not used as a filter
caveats: 'Active member' is not defined in the warehouse schema I was given, so the figures depend on my 12-month purchase rule. Treat the totals as indicative until Marketing confirms the definition
Using the current tier (is_current) instead of the tier on 2025-12-21 would misstate the tiers, because members have moved between tiers since then. I used the historical tier version
For comparison, if staff purchases are counted as activity the figures are Basic 14668, Silver 10986, Gold 3903. The difference is 85 members in total
For comparison, enrolled members on 2025-12-21 regardless of purchases were Basic 29304, Silver 15035, Gold 4336, 48675 in total. Roughly half of Basic members had no purchase in the prior 12 months

fact_sales_line holds 418 receipt/line_no pairs in the window that appear twice under different sales_line_ids. This does not change the member counts, because the same member is counted once, but it would inflate any sales value
The dim_member history is clean: no overlaps, gaps or duplicate keys, and every member has exactly one current version. Sales data starts 2024-04-29, so the whole 12-month window is covered

answer.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders FROM fact_web_order WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
definitions_applied: Web shop orders counted from fact_web_order table, where each row represents one distinct web order placed via the e-commerce channel
Order date derived from order_ts_utc (timestamp of order placement, UTC) on the calendar date 2025-12-01
assumptions: Cyber Monday identified as the calendar date 1 December 2025, confirmed as a Monday in dim_date table
Order date determined by UTC timestamp conversion to calendar date; all orders placed on 2025-12-01 in UTC included regardless of local time zone
caveats: All 291 orders are distinct (no duplicate order IDs in the result); orders span from 00:11 to 23:33 UTC on the date

No filtering applied on order status, fulfilment type, or member login state; count includes all web orders placed on the date (delivered, processing, cancelled, collected, home delivery, and click-and-collect combined)

answer.sql: SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format, round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS average_transaction_value_eur FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4 AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format ORDER BY s.format
definitions_applied: Fiscal calendar: period 4 of FY2026/27 runs 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-30 (4 weeks), and it is fully loaded
ATV = net sales (net_amount, EUR excluding VAT, after line discounts) divided by distinct receipts
Transaction = distinct receipt_id
Store channel identified by channel_id = 1, because channel_code is NULL on all lines since the web-platform migration (Nov 2025)
Store format taken from dim_store through the store_key on each sales line
Staff purchases (staff_purchase_flag) excluded
Returns not netted off: sales before returns, per receipt
assumptions: 'This year' means the current fiscal year, FY2026/27, because the request is dated 2026-10-06 and P04 is 3-30 Aug 2026. The same period last year (FY2025/26 P04) was not used.
ATV is measured excluding VAT, matching the warehouse's net sales convention. The gross (VAT-inclusive) ATV is Large 76.06, Medium 75.57, Small 63.61.

Store formats are those in dim_store: Small, Medium and Large. The column comment says Hyper, Standard or Express, but the data does not use those names, so I took Small, Medium and Large as the formats Store operations means.
Only physical stores are in scope. The web shop (store_id 900, with home delivery and click-and-collect) is excluded because it is not a store format.
Staff purchases are not customer transactions, so they are left out of the average.
caveats: The training store (store_id 999, format 'Training') has test sales in the period (55 receipts, about 1,885 EUR net). It is not a real store format and is excluded.

Staff purchases are excluded (100 to 330 lines per format). The company reporting table rpt_daily_store_sales includes them in its receipt counts and net sales, so receipt counts here are slightly lower than that table. Including staff purchases would give Large 60.60, Medium 60.15 and Small 50.67.

channel_code is NULL for every sale since Nov 2025, so filters on channel_code = 'ST' or 'WB' return nothing for this period. The view rpt.v_daily_sales filters web lines on channel_code = 'WB' and would miss all current web sales. I used channel_id instead.
Savonlinna (store 129) closed on 2026-01-25 and has no sales in the period. The 38 trading stores in the figures are 8 Large, 18 Medium and 12 Small.
Kuopio (store 125) was shut for a refit until 2026-07-26, so it was open for the whole of P04.
The data looked clean for the period: no duplicate sales lines, no non-positive amounts, and no receipt split across stores, dates or staff flags.

answer.sql:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  ROUND(AVG(f.closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 11
  AND s.region = 'West'
  AND s.is_current = TRUE
  AND p.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category
definitions_applied: Average stock value: mean of closing_value per product instance per week-ending date
West region: stores with region = West (10 stores: Tampere Hervanta, Pori, Nokia, Seinäjoki, Tampere Lamminpää, Rauma, Kokkola, Vaasa, Tampere Lielahti, Tampere Kaleva)
Period 11 last year: fiscal period 11 of FY2024/25 (2025-02-24 to 2025-03-23)
Current versions: is_current = TRUE for stores and products to ensure consistency with warehouse history tracking
assumptions: Last year interpreted as the previous fiscal year (FY2024/25) relative to current fiscal year (FY2025/26)
Stock value measured by closing_value column, which is closing stock at standard cost in EUR
Average computed across all product SKUs and all weeks in the period
Only current versions of stores and products included to reflect the latest master data
caveats: The ZZ Test category has no stock records in the West region during period 11 of FY2024/25; it is excluded from the result
Furniture category shows notably higher average stock value (495.30) compared to other categories, suggesting either higher inventory levels or higher unit costs
Period 11 contains 4 week-ending dates (2025-03-02, 2025-03-09, 2025-03-16, 2025-03-23); averages are computed across these four snapshots

answer.sql: WITH contacted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19), web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), spend AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key JOIN contacted c ON c.member_id = m.member_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900 WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted, (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM spend) AS net_sales_before_returns_eur
definitions_applied: Targeted/contacted member = at least one fact_campaign_exposure row in the campaign, counted as distinct member_id (exposure carries member_key, so it was reduced through dim_member to one row per member)
Spend = net sales excluding VAT, before returns, on lines linked to the member (the campaign-uplift convention)
Web sales recognised on the Helsinki dispatch date, only for delivered or collected orders
Store 999 (training store) and category ZZ Test excluded; staff purchases included
Member versions: member_key on lines and exposures mapped to the stable member_id
Guest web orders have no member key, so they are not attributed to any member
Dates in Helsinki time; not rpt.v_daily_sales and no stg_, bak_ or tmp_ tables used
assumptions: Reading of 'contacted': any member with at least one contact row in the campaign, whether or not the contact was delivered or opened.

The mailing is Spring Garden Launch 2026 (campaign_id 19, 4-24 May 2026, email+sms). Its window is exactly the 4-24 May range the requester gave, so I used 4-24 May inclusive and did not add the 7-day tail that the uplift definition uses.
'Spend' means purchases (net sales before returns, excluding VAT, in EUR), in all channels (stores and web), not only garden products.
'Those members' is the set of contacted members, whatever their purchase history. Their purchases were counted in 4-24 May whether or not they came after the member's contact.
caveats: The 15,001 contacted members are fewer than the 15,027 you get from mailing_list_size minus holdout_size (16,624 - 1,597). I counted from the contact records, so members with no contact row are not included. I did not trace the 26 members.

Of the 15,001 members, 14,814 had at least one delivered contact. If 'contacted' should mean delivered only, the count is 14,814 and the spend figure would change. I did not recompute the spend for that group.

No holdout member appears among the contacted members. Contacted members come from 31,685 contact rows (email and sms), reduced to one row per member. Some members changed version during the campaign (15,063 member keys for 15,001 members), so counting member_key would overstate the number of members.

Spend is before returns, in line with the campaign definition. The company's general net sales definition is after returns. Refunds booked 4-24 May to these members were 8,231.32 EUR net, which would bring the figure to about 182,456.27 EUR. That is an approximate cross-check, not a separate validated query: it removes refunds booked in the window regardless of when the item was sold.
Only 2,605 of the 15,001 contacted members bought anything in the window. The rest count as zero spend.

Web orders are dated on their dispatch date, not their order date. An order placed before 4 May but dispatched in the window is included, and one placed in the window but dispatched after 24 May is not. Using order dates instead would give a different figure: web lines dated by order date sum to about 36,057 EUR against about 35,169 EUR by dispatch date.
This figure is for these members' own purchases. It is not the uplift attributable to the campaign. Measuring that would need the holdout comparison, which was not asked.

The template for the uplift query in the library would count cancelled or still-processing web orders at their order date. I excluded them, though none of the contacted members had such lines in this period.
Sales data for the period is fully loaded (loaded up to 1 July 2026). No test-store or test-article lines appeared for these members in the window, so those exclusions did not change the total.
